title: CSK Set to Release Prashant Veer Ahead of IPL 2027 Auction
content:
Why CSK Looks to Release Prashant Veer?

When CSK signed Prashant Veer for INR 14.2 crore at the IPL 2026 auction, expectations were understandably high. However, the 20-year-old left-arm spin-bowling all-rounder from Uttar Pradesh did not quite deliver value for money, scoring just 90 runs in six games without taking a wicket.

Although judging a player so early in his career may be unfair, franchises must make decisions that serve the team’s larger interests. CSK has struggled to build a settled, balanced squad, and another season of underperformance could put further pressure on the team.

With the men in yellow aiming for a strong comeback after missing the playoffs for three consecutive seasons, strengthening key areas will be crucial. Releasing Veer could therefore turn out to be a difficult but practical option if the Chennai Super Kings believe the funds can be used more effectively elsewhere. Ultimately, the franchise must prioritize balance, impact, and long-term team-building before making its final call on the youngster carefully.

How Chennai Super Kings Might Benefit From Releasing Veer?

At present, the five-time champions have 2.4 crores remaining in their purse, while an annual increase of 5 in the salary cap could take their auction budget to 7. Trading Veer, signed for INR 14.2 crore, would add that amount to their available funds and lift the projected purse to 21. Such flexibility could help the franchise address areas of improvement before the IPL 2027 mini auction.

Importantly, CSK also bought another rising talent, Kartik Sharma, for INR 14.2 crore in the previous year’s IPL auction, and his 295 runs in 11 matches, including two fifties, could strengthen his case for retention. Consequently, Veer’s position may become more uncertain. Moreover, Chennai Super Kings need an explosive finisher who can eventually take over from MS Dhoni.

They must also add greater depth to their bowling attack. Addressing these needs with a larger purse could give the management more room to rebuild a mightier squad. That financial room may prove decisive in fixing weaknesses without compromising the team’s long-term plans for a serious title challenge in 2027 overall. A clever auction strategy could help CSK assemble a well-balanced unit capable of challenging the strongest sides in the upcoming season.

title: Kieron Pollard Withdraws From SA20 2027
content:
Kieron Pollard has pulled himself out of SA20 2027, leaving Joburg Super Kings searching for a replacement ahead of the upcoming season. This unexpected decision comes just a day after the West Indies legend was named the Mumbai Indians’ coach for the upcoming Indian Premier League season.

His withdrawal adds an intriguing twist to the franchise cricket landscape. The exit leaves JSK scrambling to fill a crucial spot in its squad.

Why Kieron Pollard Pulled Out From SA20 2027?

Former West Indies all-rounder Kieron Pollard was signed by JSK for a whopping R1.5 million on October 7 ahead of the SA20 2027 auction. However, the 39-year-old has now withdrawn from the tournament, avoiding a potentially awkward situation in franchise cricket. JSK is owned by the Chennai Super Kings group, while the Mumbai Indians’ owners also operate MI Cape Town in the SA20. Pollard had previously featured for MI Cape Town in the competition.

The development comes against the backdrop of Pollard’s long-standing association with MI. Having represented the franchise across multiple T20 leagues, he has established himself as one of its most influential players. His exit from the SA20 allows him to focus on his new responsibilities with the five-time IPL champions.

An MI source had earlier clarified that the franchise had no objection to Pollard playing for another team in a different league. The source had told Cricbuzz that the decision to play for Joburg Super Kings was entirely up to Kieron Pollard.

JSK Set to Begin its Search for Pollard’s Replacement

CSK chief executive Kasi Viswanathan confirmed that Kieron Pollard has withdrawn from the upcoming tournament after informing the franchise that he is unable to play. Consequently, the team is actively searching for a new player to fill his spot. Losing an experienced T20 cricketer like Pollard could prove to be a significant setback for Joburg Super Kings ahead of SA20 2027.

Renowned for his excellent all-round ability, the legendary cricketer was expected to bring explosive hitting, valuable experience, and an additional bowling option to the squad. Finding a suitable replacement will now be a priority for JSK as it looks to maintain its balance and strengthen its title ambitions. Replacing a T20 veteran with Pollard’s experience and proven match-winning abilities will not be an easy task.

Although the franchise can explore alternative options in the market, identifying someone who offers a similar combination of power, athleticism, and composure could prove challenging. Joburg Super Kings’ replacement decision will therefore be crucial in determining how effectively they manage this unexpected change ahead of the tournament.

title: Mumbai Indians Appoint Kieron Pollard as Their Head Coach Ahead of IPL 2027
content:
Mumbai Indians are turning to one of their most iconic figures to lead their next chapter, appointing Kieron Pollard as head coach ahead of IPL 2027. The appointment arrives following Mahela Jayawardene’s recent departure from the franchise.

From winning matches for MI on the field to guiding the five-time champions from the dugout, Kieron Pollard is now set to begin a new chapter in his long-standing association with the franchise.

Kieron Pollard’s Connection With MI

Kieron Pollard, renowned for his excellent all-round skills, has been part of the Mumbai Indians since 2010. Across 189 games for the franchise, he scored 3,412 runs and picked 69 wickets. He has delivered many match-winning performances in nail-biting situations, making him one of the most prominent figures in the team’s history.

After his final appearance as an MI player in 2022, Pollard transitioned into the coaching setup and served as the franchise’s batting coach. That experience has now led to his elevation as head coach, placing him in charge following Jayawardene’s recent exit. Beyond the Indian Premier League, he has also played for Mumbai Indians’ sister franchises across various T20 leagues, strengthening his connection with the wider MI network.

Speaking about the appointment, owner Nita Ambani praised the West Indies legend’s contribution and commitment to the franchise. She expressed confidence that the qualities that made him excel as a player would help him shine as a coach, too. Her endorsement reflects MI’s belief that his familiarity with the team, its expectations, and its winning culture can help guide the side into its 2027 campaign.

Pollard’s Appointment: A Massive Advantage for Mumbai Indians

Although Pollard has been away from the Indian Premier League as a player for several years, he remains active across global T20 competitions. This year, he featured for the Trinbago Knight Riders in the Caribbean Premier League and MI New York in MLC. Recently, he was signed by Joburg Super Kings ahead of the 2027 SA20 season.

Such continued playing experience could give the West Indies legend a coaching edge. Staying active provides match practice and a dual perspective, as experiencing contests from the middle offers empathy and a better understanding of players’ difficulties, helping him develop realistic strategies from the sidelines.

Moreover, his journey with MI, dating back to 2010 across playing and support-staff roles, means he understands the franchise’s culture, standards, and demands. Together, all these factors could benefit MI as it prepares for the upcoming IPL season. December brings his first major assignment, when he will help finalize retentions ahead of the mini-auction.

title: Who Is Jason Rowles?
content:
When the hammer came down at R2.9 million, Johannesburg had its answer. Jason Rowles, an 18-year-old from St David’s Marist Inanda, became the most expensive player at the Betway SA20 Season 5 auction, and he is ours.

This isn’t a squad-filler signing. Rowles is a left-handed top-order batter who also bowls left-arm spin, and he’s a Joburg boy who now gets to call the Wanderers home. In a season where Faf and Pollard bring the experience, Rowles brings the future.

Jason Rowles: Age and Personal Details

Jason Rowles’ Cricket Career

Jason Rowles is a Johannesburg-born allrounder who came through St David’s Marist Inanda and the Lions pathway. Just over a year ago, he was playing in the Schools SA20 finals. He finished runner-up in Volume 1 and then captained his school in Volume 2. He has risen quickly since then.

He was South Africa’s leading run-scorer at the 2026 U19 World Cup, with 280 runs from five innings at 70.00. That included 98 against Afghanistan and an unbeaten 125 off 101 balls against Tanzania. As captain on the England tour in July, he scored 201 at Hove. That made him only the second South African to score a double hundred in Youth Tests.

Jason Rowles’ Career Stats

Rowles is a player who has shown great potential across various formats that he has featured in.

Youth International Stats

Rowles’ youth numbers show a batter who goes big once he gets in. Five fifties and a double hundred in eight Youth Test innings is serious consistency. A strike rate above 93 in Youth ODIs shows he can score quickly while holding an innings together.

His left-arm spin adds another dimension to his game. He has taken 19 wickets in 24 Youth ODIs, with best figures of 3/20 and an economy rate of 4.37. While his batting has produced the bigger headlines, his bowling gives him another way to contribute.

Domestic and T20 Stats

His senior record is still thin, and that is the honest part of this story. Five List A games and a single T20 aren’t enough to judge him. That one T20 was an unbeaten 45 off 31 balls at No. 4 for SA Emerging, and it came just two days before the auction. It was a timely reminder of what he can do.

Why Did Joburg Super Kings Pay R2.9 Million for Jason Rowles?

MI Cape Town pushed hard from his base price of R200,000, but the Super Kings didn’t blink, paying almost 15 times that figure (roughly ₹1.69 crore). That tells you how highly we rate him.

Rowles joins as one of our U23 picks, but nobody spends R2.9 million on a bench warmer. Expect him to slot into the top or middle order as a left-handed option, with a few overs of left-arm spin when conditions suit. He will be batting around Faf du Plessis and Kieron Pollard, which is the best classroom an 18-year-old could ask for. For the Super Kings, this is a long-term bet on a local boy. Patient, homegrown investments like this have always defined the franchise.

FAQs

Which team bought Jason Rowles in the SA20 2027 auction?

Joburg Super Kings (JSK) signed Jason Rowles at the SA20 2027 auction after a bidding war with MI Cape Town. He became the most expensive player at the auction.

How much did Joburg Super Kings pay for Jason Rowles?

Joburg Super Kings bought Jason Rowles for R2.9 million (approximately ₹1.69 crore), nearly 15 times his base price of R200,000.

Has Jason Rowles made his international debut for South Africa?

No. As of October 2026, Jason Rowles has not made his senior international debut for South Africa. He has represented the country at Under-19 level, including the 2026 ICC U19 World Cup.

Why did Joburg Super Kings sign Jason Rowles?

JSK signed Rowles as a promising young allrounder. Head coach Albie Morkel revealed that the franchise had been monitoring him for over a year and was impressed by his performances at a development camp.

title: Ayush Mhatre Undergoes Surgery, Set to Miss Competitive Cricket for At Least 3 Months
content:
Mumbai’s rising cricketer Ayush Mhatre underwent surgery after suffering a Grade 4 right hamstring injury, putting him on the sidelines for the next two to three months.

This setback has raised concerns over his fitness and recovery, as the young batter is forced to face another long absence from competitive cricket.

Ayush Mhatre Faces Another Injury Layoff

Ayush Mhatre suffered a Grade 4 right hamstring injury during Mumbai’s Ranji Trophy encounter against Chandigarh while running between the wickets. The incident occurred in his first match since recovering from a previous left hamstring injury sustained during the Chennai Super Kings’ IPL clash against Sunrisers Hyderabad months ago.

Following the latest setback, Ayush Mhatre successfully underwent surgery at Kokilaben Hospital in Mumbai, performed by Dr. Dinshaw Pardiwala, a prominent orthopedic surgeon of the city. It is expected that the 19-year-old must remain out of action for at least two to three months. His absence has already forced Mumbai to make changes to its batting order, creating an additional challenge for the team during the ongoing domestic season.

Furthermore, Mhatre’s latest injury comes as a major setback for his personal growth, as he faces another lengthy recovery period at a crucial phase of his career. Recurring injuries can interrupt a player’s progress, making consistent performances and regular match practice difficult to maintain.

A Big Blow For CSK Ahead of IPL 2027

Chennai Super Kings could face serious concern ahead of the 2027 IPL season as young batter Ayush Mhatre battles another hamstring injury. His latest setback, a Grade 4 right hamstring injury suffered during Mumbai’s Ranji Trophy match against Chandigarh, is expected to keep him out of cricket for two to three months. Having recently returned to the cricket field after recovering from a left hamstring injury sustained during CSK’s IPL clash against SRH months ago, the youngster now faces another demanding rehabilitation period. The recurrence of such injuries raises questions about his availability and readiness for the upcoming season.

Despite his extraordinary batting skills, maintaining consistent fitness will be essential for Mhatre to establish himself as a dependable option for CSK. Returning from surgery does not automatically guarantee immediate match readiness, as rehabilitation and rebuilding fitness take time. Even if he recovers before the 2027 Indian Premier League, limited preparation could affect his early performances. Therefore, the Super Kings will hope he completes his recovery successfully, regains full fitness and avoids further setbacks. Losing a talented young batter would turn out to be a big blow to the franchise’s plans.

title: Ruturaj Gaikwad Scores a Sizzling Hundred Against Jharkhand in Ranji Trophy
content:
Ruturaj Gaikwad stole the spotlight with a magnificent century against Jharkhand in a Group C clash of the 2026-27 Ranji Trophy, adding another memorable chapter to his batting journey. His composed strokeplay strengthened Maharashtra’s dominance, setting the stage for a commanding first-innings total.

Beyond the runs, his knock demonstrated composure, technique, and the ability to deliver when his team needed it most. This timely contribution from Ruturaj Gaikwad provided crucial support to his teammates in building a mammoth score.

Centuries From Ruturaj, Digvijay and Ankit Power Maharashtra to an Imposing Total

Maharashtra stamped its authority over Jharkhand in the Ranji Trophy, piling up a massive first-innings total after dismissing the opposition for just 169. A valuable century from Ruturaj Gaikwad added firepower to an already dominant batting display. The right-hander’s fluent 101 complemented the outstanding contributions of Digvijay Patil, who scored 148, and Ankit Bawne, who hammered 169, as Maharashtra built a mammoth total.

Together, the three batters laid a perfect foundation for Maharashtra’s commanding position in the contest. Digvijay’s impressive hundred and Ankit’s substantial contribution provided the backbone of the innings, while the CSK batter’s century ensured that the scoring momentum continued. These collective efforts from the Maharashtra batters powered the side to a formidable 527/5 before the declaration, establishing a massive 358-run first-innings lead.

Gaikwad’s century added significant value to Maharashtra’s dominant batting performance, showcasing his composure and ability to build a substantial innings. Displaying excellent timing and smart shot selection, the CSK batter’s knock ensured that the team maintained its scoring momentum and strengthened its grip on the contest.

Can Jharkhand Prevent Maharashtra From Securing a Memorable Win?

Jharkhand ended Day 3 at 130/1 in its second innings, with Shikhar Mohan and Utkarsh Singh unbeaten on 74 and 45, respectively. Both batters appeared settled at the crease, offering their team a glimmer of hope after conceding a massive 358-run first-innings deficit. Their growing partnership will be crucial as Jharkhand attempts to resist Maharashtra’s bowling attack and steer the game towards a draw.

Despite Jharkhand’s improved response, Maharashtra remains in a commanding position as the visitors trail by 228 runs. With a day still remaining, the visitors will need sustained concentration and patience to avoid defeat. Meanwhile, the hosts have a strong opportunity to seal the victory if their bowling unit provides early breakthroughs and puts sustained pressure on the opposition batters. Capitalizing on its substantial lead and complementing its batters’ efforts with disciplined bowling could bring Maharashtra closer to an emphatic victory.

title: Sarfaraz Khan Smashes a Stunning Century Against Himachal Pradesh
content:
Sarfaraz Khan roared back into the spotlight with a splendid hundred against Himachal Pradesh in the Ranji Trophy, reminding everyone of his extraordinary batting skills.

His fearless stroke play and determination turned the spotlight firmly onto him, as the right-hander delivered a statement performance when it mattered most. Adding an unbeaten 139 to his name, Sarfaraz Khan has laid a perfect foundation for a potentially monumental innings.

Mumbai tightened its grip on the Ranji Trophy 2026-27 clash against Himachal Pradesh after reaching 398/4 at the end of Day 2, establishing a commanding 258-run lead. Having dismissed Himachal Pradesh for just 140 in the first innings, Mumbai capitalized on the opportunity to seize control. With two days still remaining, the hosts face mounting pressure as the visitors occupy a position of considerable strength.

At the heart of Mumbai’s imposing total stood Sarfaraz Khan, who showcased his class with a fluent 139 off 213 deliveries. A composed yet aggressive approach from the Chennai Super Kings lad frustrated the opposition bowlers and kept the scoreboard moving steadily. Contributions from his fellow batters further strengthened Mumbai’s position, transforming a promising start into a mammoth total. Their collective efforts ensured that the team built a substantial advantage rather than relying on a single individual’s heroics.

Meanwhile, Mumbai will look to extend its lead and put further pressure on the opponents as the contest progresses. The hosts must find a way to recover from their disappointing first innings and prevent the visitors from taking complete control. Confidence remains high in the Mumbai camp, as the CSK batter continues to stay at the crease with ample time left in this fixture.

Why This Knock Was Crucial For Sarfaraz Khan?

This outstanding knock served as a timely reminder of Sarfaraz Khan’s remarkable batting ability. Possibilities of transforming his unbeaten 139 into a mammoth score remain very much alive as long as the CSK batter stays at the crease.

Khan last represented India in a Test match against New Zealand in 2024. Although he was recently selected in the squad for the 2-match series ahead of the Sri Lanka tour, he did not feature in the playing eleven in either of the games. Importantly, his past domestic performances for Mumbai have already underlined his run-scoring ability, and this latest effort has strengthened his case for another opportunity at the international level.

As the Ranji Trophy is one of India’s premier domestic cricket competitions, delivering an outstanding performance can massively raise a player’s profile and secure high-level national recognition. If Sarfaraz continues producing impressive performances and maintains his excellent form throughout the season, he could put himself firmly back in contention for a place in the Indian national team.

title: Kartik Sharma to Lead Rajasthan Ahead of Ranji Trophy Round Two
content:
A new chapter awaits Kartik Sharma in his cricketing journey as he is set to captain Rajasthan ahead of its second round of Ranji Trophy 2026–27. At just 20, the young batter is ready to embrace a fresh challenge and make his mark beyond the crease.

Stepping into the captaincy spotlight, Kartik Sharma will look to combine his batting prowess with tactical maturity as Rajasthan begins a fresh chapter under his leadership.

Kartik’s Phenomenal Run in Domestic Cricket

Rajasthan has turned to promising youngster Kartik Sharma to lead the side against Railways in its second Ranji Trophy 2026–27 fixture. Regular skipper Manav Suthar’s departure for India A duty in New Zealand has opened the door for the 20-year-old to take charge of the team. This opportunity marks a significant milestone in Kartik’s cricketing career, built on impressive red-ball performances.

Sharma first announced himself during the 2024–25 Ranji Trophy season, smashing a brilliant 115 off just 113 deliveries against Uttarakhand. His temperament was equally evident in Rajasthan’s opening match this season against Tamil Nadu. With the team struggling at 31/4, the right-hander delivered a gritty 42 off 75 balls in the second innings and stitched a crucial 78-run partnership with Mahipal Lomror, protecting the side from a potential batting collapse. The knock highlighted his ability to adapt when the situation demanded patience rather than aggression.

Speaking on the eve of the clash against Railways, the right-hander reflected on his previous leadership experience, revealing that he had captained Rajasthan at the Under-19 level. Prioritizing his teammates’ comfort, he emphasized that because the squad mostly comprised his contemporaries alongside a few senior players, he would strive to remain humble in his approach to everyone.

Kartik Sharma Credits CSK Stint for Improving His Game

Kartik Sharma credits his stint with Chennai Super Kings for improving his match awareness and teaching him the patience required to adapt his batting to different situations. He stated that MS Dhoni had deeply influenced his batting approach by advising him to prioritize timing over power hitting. Chennai Super Kings veteran MS Dhoni encouraged Kartik to play according to his natural timing, reinforcing the importance of adapting his approach to suit his abilities. Advice from Dhoni has helped the youngster develop a more composed and smart approach at the crease.

The right-handed batter also enjoyed an outstanding IPL outing with CSK in his debut season months back, scoring 295 runs across 11 games, including two fifties. Alongside his promising red-ball performances in domestic cricket, his IPL exploits have raised his profile at a young age. Having already demonstrated his batting talent across formats, Sharma now has an exciting opportunity to showcase his leadership skills and make a mark as Rajasthan’s captain.

title: Anshul Kamboj Recalled to India's Test Squad Ahead of New Zealand Series
content:
A fresh opportunity awaits Anshul Kamboj as he earns a place in India’s Test squad for the New Zealand series. The right-arm pacer will look to make the most of this chance and showcase his potential.

After a year away from the national Test side, Anshul Kamboj has been recalled with renewed hopes. This comeback offers him a valuable opportunity to prove his ability at the highest level of Test cricket.

Kamboj’s Recent Domestic Performances Offer Big Boost

Anshul Kamboj’s recent stellar domestic performances and standout IPL exploits have caught the attention of both selectors and fans alike. Last year, he made his Test debut against England, but that appearance also marked his most recent outing for the national side. Following a year away, the pacer has returned to the squad with an opportunity to make a stronger impression.

His performances in domestic cricket have boosted his prospects, while the IPL 2026 season further underlined his wicket-taking ability. Representing Chennai Super Kings, Kamboj finished as the franchise’s leading wicket-taker, claiming 21 wickets across 14 games. Such consistency has raised expectations ahead of the upcoming red-ball assignment. However, succeeding at the international level demands different skills, including patience, discipline, and the ability to handle pressure.

Meanwhile, Anshul’s selection reflects the impact of his recent performances and gives him another chance to establish himself at the international level. Whether he features in the playing eleven or waits for his opportunity, making the most of every chance will be essential to his progress in Indian cricket.

A Tough Challenge Lies Ahead For Anshul Kamboj

Although Anshul Kamboj picked only one wicket during his Test debut against England last year, judging a bowler on limited opportunities would be unfair. Despite his recall, a demanding challenge awaits the Chennai Super Kings lad against New Zealand.

Facing a formidable opponent in unfamiliar conditions will require determination, patience, and tactical awareness. New Zealand has established itself as a strong Test side at home, and India has struggled during recent visits. Whenever Kamboj gets an opportunity in the playing eleven, he must demonstrate his ability to thrive under pressure. Proper planning, effective strategies against individual batters, and disciplined execution will be vital to his success.

Ultimately, selection alone will not define his comeback as consistent performances will matter the most. Kamboj must remain composed, adapt to changing conditions, and deliver when required. By combining control with attacking intent, he can contribute valuable breakthroughs and strengthen India’s bowling attack during a challenging series, while also positioning himself as a prime candidate for future red-ball assignments.

title: Allan Donald Named JSK Bowling Coach for SA20 2027
content:
Joburg Super Kings have strengthened their coaching setup by appointing former South African legend Allan Donald as bowling coach ahead of the 2027 season. His arrival brings fresh energy and immense cricketing expertise to the franchise.

Donald brings valuable experience and reputation to Joburg Super Kings setup, making his arrival more exciting.

JSK Apoint New Bowling Coach

Allan Donald will join newly appointed head coach Albie Morkel’s backroom team at JSK ahead of the upcoming 2027 season. The South-African legend has featured for his country in 72 Tests and 164 ODIs between 1991 and 2003. Fans and fellow cricketers admired his tremendous speed, competitive spirit and ability to challenge batters, with his appointment adding valuable international experience to JSK’s coaching setup.

Through tailored guidance, Donald can help young bowlers sharpen their skills, improve their game plans, and build the confidence needed to thrive under pressure. Valuable lessons in pace bowling, discipline, and match awareness can be drawn from his extensive playing career. Furthermore, his previous tenure as the bowling coach of the Bangladesh cricket team has strengthened his coaching credentials. JSK can benefit from his technical knowledge and build the ability to challenge quality batting line-ups the upcoming SA20 season.

The former South-African pacer’s appointment gives Joburg Super Kings an experienced mentor who understands the demands of the sport. His ability to analyse batters, develop bowling tactics and guide players through high-pressure situations could prove crucial during the fifth SA20 season. Working alongside Albie Morkel, Allan can help the franchise establish a clear bowling strategy, improve consistency and build a competitive squad. By encouraging younger players to embrace challenges, his presence will help them improve their bowling plans and deliver stronger performances throughout the tournament.

Allan Donald Coaching Experience

Beyond his international achievements, Allan Donald served as Durban Super Giants’ bowling coach during the 2025 SA20 season. That experience helped him understand the league’s demands and the challenges of franchise cricket. He also has got a deep understanding of local pitches and playing conditions, which he developed during his playing spell with South Africa. These insights can now be used by him to strengthen JSK’s bowling attack and guide the franchise towards a successful 2027 season.


Meanwhile, Donald’s arrival could provide the franchise’s bowlers with a valuable opportunity to learn from one of South Africa’s greatest pacers. title: Ayush Mhatre Suffers Grade 4 Hamstring Tear, Faces Another Injury Layoff
content:
Ayush Mhatre just can’t seem to catch a break from hamstring injuries. After spending nearly six months away from competitive cricket following an injury during IPL 2026, the CSK youngster has suffered another setback in his first major match back.

The 19-year-old reportedly sustained a Grade 4 tear in his right hamstring during Mumbai’s opening fixture of the Ranji Trophy 2026-27 season against Chandigarh.

Mhatre, who was recently named Mumbai’s vice-captain, had made a promising start to his innings. He was batting in the 40s when he felt discomfort while running between the wickets. He eventually departed for 48.

Ayush Mhatre Hamstring injury

However, what caught everyone’s attention was that he did not return to the field during Chandigarh’s innings. Substitute fielders took his place before reports confirmed the extent of his injury.

Following the game, Mumbai captain Siddhesh Lad said:

“It seems that he will not be with the team for some time now… The way he was limping in the match, it does not look like he would be available for the second or the third match.”

ESPNcricinfo later reported that Mhatre could remain out of action for over a month. Other reports suggest a recovery period of four to six weeks, which means he could miss the remaining matches in the first phase of Mumbai’s Ranji Trophy campaign.

This is terrible news for CSK fans, who would never want to see such a promising youngster struggle with recurring injuries. Mhatre’s free-flowing batting and fearless approach have already made him an exciting prospect for Chennai.

For now, everyone will be hoping he makes a full recovery.

Ayush Mhatre’s Performances for CSK

In 2025, Mhatre became the youngest player to represent Chennai Super Kings. He joined the franchise as an injury replacement and immediately made a name for himself.

The youngster scored 240 runs in just seven innings at an impressive strike rate of 189, giving CSK fans a glimpse of his potential.

In his second season, Mhatre could feature in only six innings before a hamstring injury ruled him out of the remainder of IPL 2026. Despite the limited opportunities, he still managed to score 201 runs at a strike rate of nearly 178. His performances across both seasons have shown why CSK rate him so highly. However, his recurring fitness issues have now become a concern.

Mhatre previously underwent rehabilitation at the BCCI’s Centre of Excellence (CoE) in Bengaluru. Hopefully, another carefully managed recovery will help him return stronger and reduce the risk of further injuries.

For CSK, the priority will be getting their young batter back to full fitness rather than rushing his return ahead of IPL 2027.

content:

Amalraj told reporters that youngsters were organising high-speed riding events through social media platforms and confirmed that authorities had arrested those involved in recent incidents.

The franchise donated 63 motorcycles to Chennai Police, consisting of 38 Honda Shine and 25 Royal Enfield Bullet bikes, to help ease traffic congestion, strengthen patrolling and improve road safety enforcement across the city. title: Eric Simons Set to Join England as Their Test Bowling Coach
content:
England’s red-ball revolution is gathering momentum as Eric Simons emerges as a key addition to the support team of the newly appointed head coach, Stephen Fleming.

His arrival as the Test bowling coach signals a fresh chapter in the team’s coaching setup, bringing valuable expertise to a side eager to strengthen its red-ball cricket ambitions.

Eric’s First Assignment to Commence Ahead of the Upcoming South-African Tour

Former South-African cricketer Eric Simons becomes the first support staff member to join the backroom team of the newly appointed Test head coach of England, Stephen Fleming.

Simons has an extensive cricketing background, having served as South-Africa’s head-coach from 2002 to 2004 and India’s bowling coach between 2010 and 2012. During his playing spell, he represented South-Africa in 23 ODI matches in 1994 and 1995. These experiences across international cricket have helped him gain deep insights into bowling tactics, player development and team management. Bringing valuable knowledge to England’s preparations for upcoming Test assignments, this appointment is highly anticipated.

Meanwhile, Eric is set to begin his first assignment as England’s Bowling coach in December, ahead of the South-African tour. His arrival would mark an important step in Fleming’s efforts to build his coaching team and establish a fresh direction for the Test side. With international experience and familiarity with innovative coaching methods, Eric could play a crucial role in England’s red-ball campaign as the team prepares for demanding challenges ahead.

What Attracts England to Add Eric Simons to Their Coaching Setup?

A strong professional bond with Fleming is one of the major factors behind Eric Simons’ expected appointment as England’s Test bowling coach. The duo has worked together across several franchise competitions, including CSK in the IPL, JSK in SA20 and TSK in MLC. Their shared experience has given them a deep understanding of each other’s coaching philosophies, communication styles and game plans. This familiarity could help them establish an effective working partnership within the team’s red-ball setup.

Beyond their existing connection, Simons brings extensive coaching experience gained across international teams and franchise environments. Exposure to different players, conditions, and competitive formats has helped him develop a flexible approach to bowling strategies and player management. Such adaptability could prove valuable as England revamp their Test coaching setup under Stephen. The combination of mutual trust, tactical understanding and broad coaching expertise makes Eric a promising addition to the team’s backroom staff.

title: Brevis' Blistering 83 Lights Up Titans’ Clash Against Eastern Storm
content:
Dewald Brevis delivered a breathtaking display of power as the Titans dominated Eastern Storm in a Pool B clash of the CSA T20 Challenge 2026. His explosive 83 off just 26 balls transformed the contest into a spectacular batting showcase, leaving spectators amazed by his fearless stroke play and extraordinary hitting ability.

With boundaries flowing and sixes soaring, Dewald Brevis stole the spotlight and propelled his team towards a commanding total.

Titans Thrash Eastern Storm by 99 Runs

Winning the toss and opting to bat first, Titans produced a commanding performance against Eastern Storm, posting a formidable 260/4 in 20 overs. Lhuan-dre Pretorius’ fluent 80 off 53 balls laid a strong foundation for a good score, while Dewald Brevis’ magnificent 83 from just 26 deliveries boosted the momentum and helped the team post a massive total. The CSK batter’s remarkable knock put the opposition under immense pressure and gave the innings a spectacular finish.

Pretorius and Brevis stitched a 103-run partnership for the second wicket from just 39 balls, combining measured aggression with explosive finishing. Later, Donovan Ferreira added an unbeaten 38 off 16 balls. Together, their efforts carried the Titans to a mammoth total in a statement-making team display.

Chasing 261, Eastern Storm struggled against the Titans’ bowling attack. Tabraiz Shamsi led the attack by claiming three wickets for 21 runs from his four overs, while the other bowlers offered him support with spells of their own. Eastern Storm finished on 161/7 in 20 overs, with Kabelo Sekhukhune top-scoring for his side with 41 off 26 balls. Ultimately, the 99-run victory underlined the winning side’s balance across departments and ability to turn individual brilliance into a comprehensive team performance.

Titans Make it Five in a Row

With five wins from 5 games, the Titans remain atop Pool B and have established themselves as the team to watch in the CSA T20 Challenge 2026. CSK batter Dewald Brevis emerged as the latest hero in the Titans’ emphatic 99-run victory over Eastern Storm, thanks to his brilliant 83. Consistency, confidence, and a lineup full of match-winners have powered their campaign.

Moreover, the squad combines international T20 specialists with domestic talent. Brevis brings explosive hitting, Lhuan-dre Pretorius offers firepower, captain Donovan Ferreira provides finishing strength, and Tabraiz Shamsi adds experience and control. Domestic players can learn from these experienced international T20 stars’ composure, decision-making, and ability to deliver under pressure. Maintaining this balance will matter as the tournament advances.

Given five victories secured and several players capable of changing matches, the Titans have reason to believe they can remain a serious threat in the later stages. Their unbeaten run makes them contenders for the CSA T20 Challenge 2026 title, although tougher tests lie ahead.

title: Samson's Fifty in Vain
content:
West Indies neutralize Sanju Samson’s masterclass to clinch the second T20 despite his breathtaking fifty. Although India lost the contest, the right-hander’s fighting knock stood out, showcasing his exceptional batting skills.

The Chennai Super Kings batter’s magnificent half-century showcased resilience, timing, and determination.

Hope’s Hundred Neutralizes Samson’s Heroics

Batting first in the second T20 encounter against West Indies in Lucknow, the hosts posted an imposing 249/5 from 20 overs, thanks to Sanju Samson’s fluent 82 off 41 deliveries. Elegant strokeplay, fearless intent, and exceptional timing highlighted his innings. Tilak Varma contributed a valuable 44 and captain Shreyas Iyer added 40 from 18 balls each, providing crucial support to India’s mammoth total. Roston Chase proved economical with the ball, producing a decent spell of 3/24 from his four overs, while the other bowlers failed to offer him support.

Coming in to chase the challenging target of 250, the visitors stumbled to 5/2 early in the innings. However, captain Shai Hope produced a brilliant 102 from just 45 balls, anchoring the chase with remarkable composure and aggressive strokeplay. Contributions from the other batters further boosted the visitors’ momentum, enabling them to achieve the target with 6 wickets in hand and 9 balls to spare, levelling the 5-match T20I series 1-1. India’s bowling struggled to contain the opposition, with most bowlers conceding runs freely.

Ultimately, Sanju’s outstanding display with the bat could not prevent India’s defeat in a high-scoring thriller. While the result was disappointing, the CSK batter’s knock reaffirmed his immense potential and left fans appreciating a performance worthy of a greater reward.

Sanju Samson Does it Again

Sanju Samson has once again silenced his critics with a splendid 82 in the second T20 against West Indies. Having faced scrutiny over his place in the team, he was temporarily sidelined months ago after a few disappointing outings. Still, whenever an opportunity presented itself, the CSK batter put forth his utmost effort. Even in the first T20I game, when he was dismissed for just 11 runs, doubts resurfaced about his consistency, yet Sanju Samson responded brilliantly when another opportunity arrived.

What makes his innings special is the effortless combination of elegant timing and powerful shot-making. Rather than allowing previous failures to affect his confidence, he displayed composure and attacking intent throughout his knock. Despite India’s defeat, Samson’s performance offered a powerful reminder of his talent. Samson’s comeback reinforces a timeless sporting truth, proving that form is temporary, but class is permanent.

title: Jason Rowles Becomes the Costliest Buy in the 2027 SA20 Auction
content:
Jason Rowles has set the SA20 2027 auction alight after Joburg Super Kings signed the teenage sensation in a record-breaking deal. The 18-year-old all-rounder became the costliest buy of the auction, underlining the extraordinary faith franchises have placed in his potential.

JSK won a fierce bidding battle with MICT to sign the young cricketer. This landmark move adds an interesting chapter to Rowles’ rapidly rising cricket journey.

Jason Rowles Gets a Wonderful Opportunity to Grow Among T20 Greats

Johannesburg Super Kings emerged victorious from an intense bidding war with MI Cape Town to acquire the services of Jason Rowles for a whopping R2.9 million. Their aggressive pursuit eventually secured the 18-year-old at the highest price of the 2027 SA20 auction, reflecting the franchise’s belief that his talent can flourish alongside established T20 cricketers and under the guidance of experienced campaigners.

Alongside the giants of the game such as Kieron Pollard, Faf du Plessis and Jamie Overton, Rowles now joins a squad that blends proven experience with youthful ambition. Having more T20 legends around him gives the youngster a great opportunity to learn from them, and understand the demands of the shortest format of the game. Furthermore, learning directly from accomplished players can boost his skills while allowing him to bring fresh energy and fearless intent to the team.

The franchise’s decision therefore represents more than a record signing; it signals a commitment to nurturing the next generation while maintaining a formidable core of experience. For Rowles, the move also creates a valuable stage to test his skills, absorb advice, and thrive under pressure. Meanwhile, Joburg Super Kings gain a player whose potential could prove decisive during the season ahead throughout the long and demanding campaign.

Proteas Legend Graeme Smith Praises the Signing of Rowles

SA20 League Commissioner and former South-African captain Graeme Smith hailed Rowles as the standout moment of the auction, praising the league’s role in bringing together global stars and South Africa’s emerging talents. He noted that the competition has become a home for world-class players, with the legends of the game like Faf du Plessis, Shimron Hetmyer and Trent Boult sharing the stage with the country’s brightest young cricketers. Smith said Rowles’ record bidding battle demonstrated the confidence franchises have in the next generation.

Reflecting on the youngster’s rapid rise, Proteas legend Greame Smith highlighted the remarkable journey from last year’s Rain Schools SA20 Final to a professional squad packed with T20 giants. Such a transition captures the pathway the league set out to build, creating opportunities for future stars to learn, compete and grow alongside established players. Ultimately, Rowles’ breakthrough could become an inspiring example of how the SA20 environment can transform youthful potential into a future franchise cricket star today.

title: Kieron Pollard Joins JSK Ahead of SA20 2027
content:
JSK has delivered a blockbuster surprise by acquiring Kieron Pollard for R1. 5 million in the 2027 SA20 auction. The legendary Mumbai Indians figure now begins a fresh chapter in yellow, bringing experience, power, and proven T20 instincts to the Super Kings setup.

Few expected this move, making Pollard’s arrival one of the auction’s most intriguing developments. Suddenly, Joburg Super Kings have now added a truly global T20 icon.

Pollard’s Move to Joburg Super Kings: Why Was It So Unexpected?

For almost two decades, Kieron Pollard has been one of the key figures of the Mumbai Indians franchise, but the veteran all-rounder will now wear the Super Kings colors for the first time ahead of the 2027 SA20. Having represented Mumbai Indians franchises across the globe in various franchise leagues, including MI Cape Town in the SA20, Pollard sets to begin his new chapter away from blue. Interestingly, MICT did not bid for the West Indies legend during the auction.

Throughout his T20 spell, the all-rounder has built a reputation for aggressive batting, smart bowling, sharp fielding, and calm leadership in high-pressure environments. Meanwhile, JSK has secured someone who understands franchise cricket deeply and can potentially guide younger players within the dressing room. Beyond his experience, the legendary cricketer’s ability to contribute across departments gives the Super Kings another tactical option during crucial moments. Notably, his presence also brings familiarity with dressing rooms, pressure situations, and the demands of building winning habits across long franchise seasons.

Whether that experience translates into consistent performances for Johannesburg, however, remains one of the major talking points surrounding this surprising signing.

Did JSK Make the Right Decision by Signing Kieron Pollard?

Questions will surround JSK’s decision to invest in a 39-year-old cricketer instead of pursuing younger talents. Nevertheless, Kieron Pollard has shown that age alone cannot define his value in the shortest format of the game. Months ago, he registered a century for MI New York in the Major League Cricket against Washington Freedom, combining power with smart shot selection that has made him a valuable T20 performer. Furthermore, his contribution in the Major League Cricket was not limited to batting, as he also impressed with his fielding there.

Performances suggest that the all-rounder can still influence games in departments when conditions suit him. However, the West Indies legend will face the test when he steps onto the SA20 stage for the Super Kings. Supporters will want to know whether his experience can translate into consistent match-winning contributions against younger and quality opponents. Ultimately, the signing raises as many questions as it answers. Pollard’s role at JSK and the franchise’s strategy for the future will become clearer as the 2027 SA20 season unfolds.

Shockwaves hit SA20 as Faf du Plessis returns to Joburg Super Kings in the 2027 auction. Released months earlier, the South-African legend has returned to the franchise that became his home from the league’s beginning again.

JSK Wins an Intense Bidding War With MICT to Buy Faf

Joburg Super Kings secured Faf du Plessis for a whopping R2.7 million in a thrilling SA20 2027 auction battle. Months after releasing their long-time leader, JSK entered the bidding and engaged in a fierce battle with MICT before winning the race for his signature. Since the inaugural season, the legendary batter has remained closely connected with the franchise, completing four seasons while guiding the side to the playoffs every time. Expectations will naturally rise around the franchise, especially with Faf bringing his proven influence back into the dressing room. Again, JSK has reunited with the main pillar who has shaped its story since the inaugural season.

title: Ayush Mhatre Appointed Mumbai's Vice-Captain Ahead of Ranji Opener
content:
Mumbai have handed Ayush Mhatre a bigger responsibility ahead of their Ranji Trophy opener against Chandigarh, naming the right-hander vice-captain. With excitement building around the opening clash, the CSK batter’s elevation adds a fresh spark to Mumbai’s campaign.

Mumbai Looks to Groom Young Talent as Mhatre Handed Leadership Responsibility

Pawar pointed to Mhatre’s recent success with India Under-19, where he guided the team to a championship victory months ago. According to the selector, Mhatre is a smart cricketer whose abilities make him an ideal player to groom alongside an experienced leader.

Surprisingly, Suryakumar Yadav has been omitted from Mumbai’s 16-man squad for the upcoming 2026-27 Ranji Trophy. Acknowledging the fact, Pawar noted that Suryakumar has been phenomenal in guiding India to the 2026 T20 World Cup triumph. However, Mumbai’s selectors wanted to create opportunities for their younger players during the opening fixture. Therefore, the decision was taken not to consider the senior batter for this fixture, allowing the team’s next generation to take on greater responsibility.

Beyond his batting skills, the CSK batter’s vice-captaincy could become an important step in his development. Leading India to the 2026 Under-19 World Cup championship glory has already demonstrated his ability to handle responsibility under pressure. Now, working alongside Lad, he can gain valuable lessons about managing a senior domestic side. Such exposure may help Mumbai build a stronger leadership group for the matches ahead.

His return follows a hamstring injury suffered during Chennai Super Kings’ clash with Sunrisers Hyderabad in the Indian Premier League in April, which forced him to remain sidelined for months. Consequently, the Ranji Trophy opener offers him a meaningful platform to regain rhythm and confidence at this important stage of his career.

Alongside his return to competitive action, the vice-captaincy gives the young batter another valuable avenue for growth. Playing in one of India’s leading domestic tournaments will test his skills against experienced opponents while exposing him to the demands of leadership. Furthermore, working closely with Siddhesh Lad can help him learn decision-making, strategic thinking and team management. Ultimately, this opportunity could mark an important chapter in Mhatre’s cricketing journey.

title: Anshul Kamboj Makes His ODI Debut For India Against West Indies
content:
Anshul Kamboj’s one-day journey has finally begun, with the CSK bowler receiving his cap against West Indies in the third ODI in Chandigarh. India had already sealed the series, leaving all eyes on the young star making his debut.

With expectations high and an opportunity to showcase his skills, Anshul Kamboj stepped onto the international stage. Everyone waited eagerly for his first international spell today.

A Debut That Didn’t Go Kamboj’s Way as West Indies Chase Down 352

Unfortunately, Kamboj’s much-awaited debut turned into a difficult outing as he struggled to contain the West Indian batting attack. The Chennai Super Kings pacer emerged as the most expensive bowler for his side, conceding 82 runs from his 9 overs and picking no wickets. Against a fearless attack, the Indian bowlers’ plans repeatedly broke down under pressure throughout the evening. Despite the expensive spell from Anshul, his selection reflected the faith India has placed in his ability.

Batting first, India posted a mammoth 351/7 from allotted 50 overs. Their strong total appeared capable of testing the visitors, yet West Indies responded with remarkable confidence. Shai Hope produced a magnificent 162, anchoring the chase and keeping the scoreboard moving throughout the innings. His stunning knock ensured that his side achieved the challenging target of 352 set by the hosts with 5 wickets in hand and 10 balls to spare.

Throughout the second innings, Indian bowlers struggled to create sustained pressure as the West Indies batters attacked with intent. Repeated boundaries kept the hosts searching for answers, while Hope controlled the chase with remarkable composure. Nevertheless, one difficult debut should not completely overshadow Kamboj’s potential, especially considering the promise he has shown in domestic cricket. Future opportunities will reveal whether he can adapt and deliver at the international level.

What Lies Ahead for Anshul Kamboj After a Challenging One-Day Debut?

Questions will now surround Anshul’s place in India’s future plans after a challenging one-day debut. He had a valuable chance to prove his worth, particularly because India had already won the first two matches and clinched the series before this contest. Because little pressure was on the result, the occasion offered him an ideal platform to settle into international cricket and demonstrate his talent.

Having already impressed in first-class cricket, the Chennai Super Kings lad entered the game with expectations that he could translate his domestic promise onto the bigger stage. Today’s expensive spell, however, exposed areas that will need attention before his next opportunity.

Judging a player after only one international performance would be premature, but competition among India’s fast bowlers remains fierce. Every chance matters, and whenever opportunities arrive, players must perform consistently to strengthen their claims for a place in the Indian team.

title: Ruturaj Gaikwad Shines with a Stylish Half-Century in the Third ODI Against West Indies
content:
Ruturaj Gaikwad lit up the third ODI against West Indies with a stunning half-century, adding momentum to India’s innings. His assured strokeplay and calm presence reflected his quality and confidence with the bat.

Gaikwad’s 57 stood out as a contribution on a big stage, with the composed right-hander showing confidence and class when his side needed stability.

Rohit, Rahul and Ruturaj Steer India to 351/7 Against West Indies

India posted a formidable 351/7 in 50 overs against West Indies in the third ODI in Chandigarh, recovering strongly after losing the initial two wickets for just four runs. Rohit Sharma’s sizzling 92 off 85 balls and KL Rahul’s unbeaten century formed the backbone of the innings, while the CSK batter’s composed 57 from 69 deliveries added a crucial contribution.

Stitching an outstanding partnership of 137 runs for the third wicket, Rohit Sharma and Ruturaj Gaikwad steadied the Indian innings. Later, Rahul carried the acceleration forward with a magnificent 129 off 87 balls, ensuring the hosts finished with a mammoth total. By balancing patience with well-timed attacking shots and rotating the strike effectively, Gaikwad provided valuable support to fellow batters Rohit and Rahul.

Despite the early trouble, India found the right balance between caution and aggression. The CSK batter’s innings underlined his ability to adapt to ODI cricket, while Rohit provided experience and Rahul supplied a powerful finish. Together, their efforts transformed a difficult beginning into a strong batting display, giving the visitors a challenging target of 352. Ultimately, the recovery highlighted India’s batting depth and resilience on an important day, strengthening the team’s overall position and showcasing the value of calm partnerships after an early collapse.

Why This Half-Century From Ruturaj Gaikwad was Special For Him?

Having received limited opportunities at the international level, the Chennai Super Kings lad’s 57 carries added significance. He had announced himself with a century against South Africa last year, but the opening two matches of this series offered little scope to make an impact. In those games, Ruturaj Gaikwad scored unbeaten 13 and 31, entering the chase only after India was close to the winning mark.

Today, Ruturaj Gaikwad received the opportunity he needed. With India already clinching the series 2-0, the pressure was lower, allowing him to express his game. Continued performances of this quality could strengthen his case for becoming a regular member of India’s one-day set-up in the future, provided he continues to seize opportunities with the same assurance and growing consistency. More importantly, the knock gave him confidence and demonstrated that he can contribute when given a meaningful chance.

title: WI ODIs: Anshul Kamboj Set to Replace Injured Prasidh Krishna in India's Squad
content:
An exciting opportunity has arrived for Anshul Kamboj as the CSK pacer earns a spot in India’s one-day squad ahead of the third ODI against West Indies, replacing Prasidh Krishna. A hamstring injury struck Prasidh during the second ODI, ruling him out for the remainder of the series.

Kamboj gets a big chance to step into the spotlight and make his presence felt on the biggest stage. For him, this call-up could become a special moment, one that marks the beginning of a new chapter in his cricketing journey.

Anshul Earns the ODI Call-up After Impressive Recent Form

Prasidh Krishna suffered a hamstring injury during the second ODI against West Indies in Guwahati and bowled only five overs before leaving the field. Consequently, the BCCI named Anshul Kamboj as his replacement for the final ODI. Initially, the CSK bowler had been playing for India against Australia in a List-A test match in Puducherry but left the game after his senior-team call-up, with Prafull Hinge replacing him. The departure came after an outstanding spell in which he had already shown control and discipline.

Earlier in the contest, Kamboj impressed with disciplined bowling, claiming three wickets for 34 runs from 17.3 overs in Australia A’s first innings. His effectiveness has often come from maintaining accurate lengths and controlling the flow rather than constantly chasing wickets. Such consistency can make him valuable in longer spells under high-pressure situations too, especially when the objective is to build pressure and force mistakes.

Also, the right-arm pacer enjoyed a brilliant IPL 2026 campaign with Chennai Super Kings months back. Across 14 games, he picked 21 wickets and finished as the franchise’s leading wicket-taker for the season. That performance added momentum to his growing reputation and now gives him a strong platform as he enters India’s one-day set-up.

Will Anshul Kamboj Get the Chance to Play in the Final ODI Against West Indies?

Having already clinched the ODI series 2-0 against West Indies, India could use the final match to test its bench strength. Mohammed Siraj was not selected in the playing eleven for either of the first two games despite being part of the squad, while Kamboj has now joined the set-up as Prasidh’s replacement. Therefore, the final team combination could provide an interesting look at India’s pace options.

Another possibility is that the management could rotate players such as Gurnoor Brar or Auqib Nabi, depending on the final combination and workload considerations. This young bowler, however, has a great opportunity if the team decides to hand him an ODI cap. Making an immediate impact would therefore be very important to strengthen his case for future assignments. Competition for places among India’s fast bowlers remains significant at this stage, making a magnificent performance crucial for him to stay in the selectors’ wider plans.

title: How Many Trophies Have Joburg Super Kings Won?
content:
Joburg Super Kings have won 0 SA20 trophies through the 2026 season. JSK have qualified for the playoffs in all four editions but have never reached the final. Their best campaign came in 2024, when they progressed to Qualifier 2. Across five knockout matches, JSK have recorded only one victory. 

JSK Trophy Records: Quick Facts

Here is JSK’s SA20 record, highlighting the team’s journey and overall performance in the tournament. 

Joburg Super Kings Trophy Record by Season

JSK have qualified for the SA20 playoffs in all four seasons but are yet to reach the final. Here is their complete season-by-season record. 

How Close Have JSK Come to Winning SA20? 

Joburg Super Kings have come close to the SA20 title on every occasion, consistently reaching the playoffs while still pursuing their maiden championship dream. 

SA20 2023: Semifinalists

JSK’s SA20 2023 campaign began on an impressive note, with the team finishing second in the league stage during their debut season. They met Sunrisers Eastern Cape in the semifinal but lost the contest by 14 runs, ending their hopes of reaching the final. Sunrisers Eastern Cape went on to beat Pretoria Capitals in the final by 4 wickets, winning the inaugural SA20 title. 

SA20 2024: Qualifier 2

JSK’s SA20 2024 campaign remains their best run in the competition, earning them their highest finish to date. Finishing 4th in the league stage, Joburg Super Kings went on to face Paarl Royals in the Eliminator, defeating them by nine wickets. This remains their only knockout victory through 2026. 

They then faced Durban Super Giants in Qualifier 2 but suffered a 69-run defeat. The result ended their campaign one victory short of reaching the final and remains JSK’s best SA20 finish ever in the tournament history.

SA20 2025: Eliminator Exit

In SA20 2025, JSK reached the playoffs for the third consecutive season. Joburg Super Kings faced defending champions Sunrisers Eastern Cape in the Eliminator. 

However, Sunrisers Eastern Cape won the match by 32 runs, ending JSK’s SA20 2025 title hopes. The defeat ended their campaign at the first knockout hurdle, preventing them from progressing further in the playoffs. 

SA20 2026: Another Eliminator Defeat

In JSK’s SA20 2026 campaign, the side claimed the final available playoff position before facing Paarl Royals in the Eliminator. In the Eliminator, Paarl Royals batted first, posting a formidable 210/5 in 20 overs. 

They then restricted JSK to 174/8, sealing a comfortable 36-run victory. The defeat ended another season without a title for Joburg Super Kings, who once again failed to progress beyond their first knockout match. 

SA20 Champions by Season

Only two teams won the SA20 title during the competition’s first four seasons. Sunrisers Eastern Cape won three titles, while MI Cape Town lifted the trophy in 2025. Joburg Super Kings do not feature in the list because they have never reached the SA20 final.

Sunrisers Eastern Cape’s three titles make them the most successful team in SA20 history through 2026. JSK remain one of the four franchises yet to win the competition.

Why Have JSK Not Won an SA20 Trophy?

Reaching the knockout stage has not been a problem for JSK, with the side qualifying for the playoffs in four consecutive seasons. JSK’s playoff record highlights a clear difference between the team’s league-stage consistency and knockout results. JSK has won only one out of the first five knockout matches the side has played and has never reached an SA20 final. 

These numbers show that the Joburg Super Kings have put themselves in contention by reaching the playoffs every time. However, they haven’t converted those appearances into a final berth. As a result, the Joburg Super Kings’ total number of titles remains zero, despite their consistent presence in the competition’s later stages. 

Frequently Asked Questions

How many trophies have Joburg Super Kings won?

Joburg Super Kings have won 0 SA20 trophies through the 2026 season. JSK have reached the playoffs in every season but are still searching for their first title.

Have Joburg Super Kings ever reached the SA20 final?

No, Joburg Super Kings have never reached the SA20 final. Their closest attempt came in 2024, when they progressed to Qualifier 2.

How many times have JSK qualified for the playoffs?

JSK qualified for the playoffs four times between 2023 and 2026. They reached the knockout stage in each of their first four SA20 seasons.

What is JSK’s best SA20 finish?

JSK’s best SA20 finish was reaching Qualifier 2 in 2024. They defeated Paarl Royals in the Eliminator before losing to Durban’s Super Giants.

JSK ne kitni trophies jeeti hain?

JSK ne 2026 season tak koi SA20 trophy nahi jeeti hai. Team chaar baar playoffs mein pahunchi hai, lekin abhi tak final mein jagah nahi bana saki.

MS Dhoni’s Influence Acts as a Major Factor Behind Zaheer Khan’s Appointment as CSK Head Coach

Former Indian captain MS Dhoni played a key role in Zaheer’s appointment as Chennai Super Kings’ head coach ahead of IPL 2027. Kasi Viswanathan said the management group considered the former Indian pacer before agreeing on his appointment. Viswanathan stated that Dhoni played the major role in the decision, while reports said the franchise wanted an Indian coach with IPL experience and familiarity with domestic conditions. The legendary cricketer’s next responsibility will be preparing the five-time champions for the upcoming IPL campaign. Under the new setup, Zaheer will have the authority to choose his support staff, according to Kasi Viswanathan, giving him an opportunity to shape the coaching setup around his methods.

title: CSK's 2018 Comeback: Winning the Title After a Two-Year Ban
content:
After serving a two-season IPL suspension, Chennai Super Kings returned to the tournament in 2018 with MS Dhoni back as captain and several familiar players reunited. The CSK comeback in 2018 quickly became one of the franchise’s defining seasons as Chennai rebuilt its squad and immediately challenged for the title.

For the story behind the suspension, our Why Was CSK Banned for 2 Years? guide explains the complete case. This article focuses on what happened after CSK returned—from rebuilding the squad to winning the IPL 2018 title.

CSK Return to IPL After Two Years

After completing its two-season suspension, CSK officially returned to the IPL in 2018. The BCCI formally welcomed CSK and Rajasthan Royals back into the league after both franchises completed their suspensions. CSK’s return also reunited the franchise with MS Dhoni and several members of its established core, including Suresh Raina and Ravindra Jadeja.

With the familiar core restored, CSK entered the 2018 season as a competitive side rather than simply a returning franchise. The team’s performance that season would ultimately determine how its comeback was remembered.

How CSK Built Their IPL 2018 Squad

CSK took an experience-heavy approach when rebuilding for IPL 2018. MS Dhoni, Suresh Raina and Ravindra Jadeja were retained before the auction, while Dwayne Bravo and Faf du Plessis returned through Right to Match (RTM) cards under the IPL’s 2018 player rules

The emphasis on established players attracted attention and led to the team being labelled “Dad’s Army.” Rather than relying primarily on younger players, CSK’s recruitment suggested a clear preference for experience, proven IPL performers and continuity within the squad.

That strategy gave CSK a strong blend of continuity and experience heading into their first season back after the two-year suspension—and the results ultimately validated the approach.

CSK’s Road to the 2018 IPL Final

CSK’s 2018 campaign began dramatically against Mumbai Indians. Chasing 166, Chennai were reduced to 118/8 before Dwayne Bravo’s 68 off 30 balls and Kedar Jadhav’s late contribution secured a memorable comeback.

Across the season, CSK’s success was built on contributions throughout the squad. Ambati Rayudu led the team with 602 runs, while Shardul Thakur was CSK’s leading wicket-taker with 16 wickets. The experienced core also played a significant role in keeping the team competitive throughout the campaign.

CSK’s biggest test came in Qualifier 1 against Sunrisers Hyderabad. Chennai were struggling at 62/6 before Faf du Plessis scored an unbeaten 67, guiding CSK to a two-wicket victory and a place in the final.

The win set up CSK’s championship clash with Sunrisers Hyderabad.

How CSK Won the IPL 2018 Final

CSK faced Sunrisers Hyderabad (SRH) in the IPL 2018 final, with the title carrying enormous significance after two seasons away. SRH posted 178/6, setting Chennai a challenging target. CSK’s chase was led by Shane Watson, who produced a magnificent unbeaten 117 off 57 balls, striking 11 fours and eight sixes. His explosive innings helped Chennai reach 181/2 in 18.3 overs, winning the final by eight wickets.

The victory sealed CSK’s third IPL title, bringing them level with Mumbai Indians’ three championships at the time. After two difficult years, Chennai had returned and reclaimed the IPL crown.

Why the 2018 CSK Comeback Became Special

The 2018 CSK comeback became special because the franchise returned to contention immediately after two seasons away. Despite questions surrounding its experienced squad, CSK reached the final and won the IPL 2018 title, securing their third IPL championship.

The victory provided a powerful sporting response to the disruption caused by the suspension and restored CSK’s place among the IPL’s leading teams. For supporters, however, the achievement meant something more: after two seasons apart, CSK became CSK again.

title: 2013 IPL Spot-Fixing Scandal: How It Led to CSK's Suspension
content:
The 2013 IPL controversy is often linked to Chennai Super Kings because of the punishment that followed, but CSK was not found guilty of spot-fixing. The franchise’s suspension was instead connected to the betting activities of Gurunath Meiyappan, who was found to be a CSK team official.

This distinction is important because the term CSK spot fixing case is commonly used to describe the wider controversy, even though the established finding against Meiyappan concerned betting. Understanding this difference explains how the 2013 scandal ultimately led to CSK’s two-season suspension. 

What Happened in the 2013 IPL Spot-Fixing Scandal?

The 2013 IPL Spot-Fixing Scandal shook the tournament after allegations of betting and spot-fixing emerged during the season. Investigations by the Delhi and Mumbai Police brought several players and team officials under scrutiny, placing the IPL under significant public and regulatory pressure.

For CSK, the controversy centred on Gurunath Meiyappan, who was associated with the franchise as a team official. His activities during the tournament came under investigation, including allegations concerning betting on IPL matches. In October 2013, the Supreme Court constituted the Mudgal Committee to investigate allegations of betting and spot-fixing in the IPL, including matters concerning individuals connected with the controversy.

What Was Gurunath Meiyappan’s Role?

Gurunath Meiyappan was closely associated with Chennai Super Kings and was treated as a team official under IPL rules. The Supreme Court record noted that he formed an integral part of CSK and had access to sensitive team information.

The Mudgal Committee found allegations concerning Meiyappan’s betting activities and passing on information to be proved. Investigations established that he was in contact with bookmakers and placed bets on IPL matches, including matches involving CSK.

Importantly, the established allegations concerned betting and passing on information, not a finding that Meiyappan had fixed matches. The spot-fixing allegation was treated separately and required further investigation.

What Did the Mudgal Committee Find?

The Mudgal Committee established key findings concerning Gurunath Meiyappan, including his role and association with Chennai Super Kings and his involvement in betting on IPL matches. The committee also found that Meiyappan had passed on information. However, the allegation of match-fixing was treated separately.

The Supreme Court’s May 2014 order recorded that the fixing allegation required further investigation rather than being established by the committee’s findings. These distinctions clarified the specific findings against Meiyappan.

Why Was CSK Suspended?

Gurunath Meiyappan’s position within Chennai Super Kings was central to the disciplinary consequences. Because he was treated as a CSK team official, the findings concerning his conduct had implications for the franchise itself.

The Justice R. M. Lodha Committee subsequently determined the appropriate disciplinary action and, in July 2015, imposed a two-season suspension on CSK. The punishment kept the franchise out of the 2016 and 2017 IPL seasons.

The suspension followed the findings concerning Meiyappan’s conduct and did not amount to a finding that CSK had fixed matches. For the complete case and the reasons behind the two-year punishment, read our Why Was CSK Banned for 2 Years? guide.

Was CSK Found Guilty of Spot-Fixing?

No. CSK was not found guilty of spot-fixing or match-fixing. The CSK spot fixing case is often used broadly to describe the 2013 controversy, but the established finding concerning Gurunath Meiyappan was that he had engaged in betting on IPL matches.

The Justice Mudgal Committee had stated that the spot-fixing allegations against Meiyappan required further investigation, while the subsequent disciplinary process focused on his betting-related conduct.

title: CSK During the Ban: What Happened in 2016 and 2017?
content:
Chennai Super Kings were suspended from the IPL for two seasons, keeping the franchise out of the 2016 and 2017 editions. While CSK itself did not play during this period, its core was split across the IPL, with MS Dhoni, Suresh Raina, Ravindra Jadeja, R. Ashwin, Dwayne Bravo and Faf du Plessis among the familiar names representing other teams. For CSK fans, the two-year absence meant seeing established players in different colours while waiting for the franchise to return to the IPL. 

Why CSK Did Not Play IPL 2016 and 2017

Chennai Super Kings missed the 2016 and 2017 IPL seasons after the Justice R. M. Lodha Committee imposed a two-season suspension on the franchise. The punishment followed findings against CSK team official Gurunath Meiyappan over betting during the 2013 IPL. The suspension applied to the franchise rather than its players. Our Why Was CSK Banned for 2 Years? The guide covers the complete case and suspension. 

What Happened to CSK Players?

CSK’s players were not banned individually when the franchise was suspended. The two new franchises were allowed to select players from the squads of suspended CSK and Rajasthan Royals, splitting several prominent CSK names between Rising Pune Supergiant and Gujarat Lions.

The split also created an unusual leadership dynamic. MS Dhoni captained Rising Pune Supergiant in 2016, while Suresh Raina captained Gujarat Lions during the same season. Dhoni remained with Pune in 2017, but Steve Smith took over as captain. Raina continued to lead Gujarat, making him the central CSK-associated figure at the franchise throughout its two-season existence.

For CSK supporters, this meant that although the franchise itself was absent, several of its most recognisable players remained visible in the IPL. The familiar yellow jersey was replaced by new colours, but much of the established CSK core could still be followed during the suspension.

How CSK Fans Stayed Connected During the Ban

CSK remained out of the IPL in 2016 and 2017, but the Yellow Army did not simply disappear. With former CSK players representing Rising Pune Supergiant and Gujarat Lions, supporters still had familiar names to follow during the franchise’s absence.

Some supporters continued wearing CSK yellow while attending matches involving Pune and Gujarat. For sections of the Yellow Army, following MS Dhoni, Suresh Raina and other former CSK players became a way of staying connected to the franchise while it was suspended.

Supporting these players in different colours was not the same as replacing CSK. The temporary franchises provided familiar faces to cheer for, while the loyalty of many supporters remained firmly attached to Chennai until the team’s return in 2018.

How CSK Prepared for Its IPL Return

Ahead of IPL 2018, CSK finally had the opportunity to rebuild around familiar players. The franchise retained MS Dhoni, Suresh Raina and Ravindra Jadeja before the auction, immediately restoring three major pieces of its old core.

The subsequent auction gave Chennai the opportunity to bring back more familiar names while constructing its first squad in three years. For the full story of what happened next, read our CSK 2018 Comeback guide.

title: Nathan Ellis' Five-Fer Powers Australia to a Thrilling Victory Over Zimbabwe
content:
Nathan Ellis produced a sensational match-winning spell as Australia defeated Zimbabwe by 59 runs in a thrilling first ODI at Harare Sports Club.

His splendid five-wicket haul turned a tense contest on its head, crushing Zimbabwe’s hopes of completing a remarkable chase and rescuing his team from another potential upset.

Australia Survives Zimbabwe Scare by Securing a Brilliant 59-Run Victory

Opting to bat first, Australia posted 294/8 in their 50 overs in the first ODI against Zimbabwe at Harare Sports Club. Matt Renshaw anchored the innings brilliantly with a maiden ODI century, smashing 109 from 94 balls. Cooper Connolly contributed a valuable 51, while Newman Nyamhuri stood tall for Zimbabwe with his brilliant spell of 5/62 in nine overs.

Coming in to bat second, chasing a difficult target of 295, Zimbabwe’s top-order batsmen struggled to score runs against an attacking bowling efforts from Australia. Craig Ervine provided the resistance with 59 from 60 balls, while Sikandar Raza added a valuable 57 as the pair briefly steadied the innings. Ellis then delivered the decisive blow for Australia, removing Ervine before completing a stunning five-wicket haul.

The right-arm pacer’s magnificent spell of 5/31 in 9.1 overs, supported by valuable spells from other bowlers, halted Zimbabwe’s momentum, restricting the hosts to 235. Eventually, the visitors completed a convincing 59-run win, with the CSK bowler emerging as the key force behind the successful defence of the total.

Australia Takes 1-0 Lead After Ellis Saved His Side from Zimbabwe Upset

Australia moved 1-0 ahead in the three-match ODI series after defeating Zimbabwe by 59 runs in the first game at Harare. This result prevented the hosts from producing another upset against the visitors, following previous instances of Australia being stunned by Zimbabwe in white-ball encounters. Renshaw’s splendid century helped Australia reach 294/8, giving the visitors a strong total to defend.

Zimbabwe appeared capable of mounting a serious challenge when Craig Ervine and Sikandar Raza stitched an outstanding 98-run partnership for the fifth wicket. Their resistance brought the hosts closer to the required rate before the bowling side struck back with crucial breakthroughs. The Chennai Super Kings bowler then became the turning point, dismissing the settled Ervine and delivering a sensational five-fer, with his spell breaking Zimbabwe’s momentum and ensuring the hosts did not reach closer to the target. Consequently, Australia avoided another upset and began the series on a winning note, while Nathan Ellis emerged as the team’s savior during the most critical phase of the match.
