title: Complete History of Chennai Super Kings: Journey, Captains, Trophies and Legacy
content:
Every summer, a sea of yellow fills the stands, echoing chants of “Dhoni… Dhoni…” long before the first ball is bowled. For millions, the story of Chennai Super Kings isn’t just about cricket. It’s about loyalty, belief, and the long-haired boy from Jharkhand who became the heartbeat of a franchise that would redefine consistency in the Indian Premier League.

But the history of Chennai Super Kings began even before MS Dhoni walked out in yellow. Formed in 2008 as one of the IPL’s original franchises, CSK quickly built a culture of stability, fearless cricket, and unwavering fan support. Over the years, the franchise has celebrated multiple IPL titles, countless playoff appearances, and a legacy that stretches far beyond trophies.

Let’s look back at the complete history of Chennai Super Kings, tracing the franchise’s remarkable journey from its inception to becoming one of the most successful and admired teams in IPL history, while revisiting its iconic captains, championship triumphs, memorable finals, ownership, coaching philosophy, and enduring legacy.

CSK Captains

Leadership has always been one of the defining pillars of Chennai Super Kings’ success. While only a handful of players have captained the franchise, each leadership transition has marked an important chapter in CSK’s journey. From building a dynasty under MS Dhoni to preparing the next generation of leaders, captaincy has played a crucial role in shaping the franchise’s identity.

  1. MS Dhoni

No captain has influenced Chennai Super Kings more than MS Dhoni. Appointed ahead of the inaugural IPL season in 2008, he transformed CSK into one of the most successful franchises in T20 cricket. His calm leadership, tactical brilliance, and unwavering faith in his players became the foundation of CSK’s culture. Although he stepped down before the 2022 season, Dhoni returned midway through the campaign before leading CSK to their fifth IPL title in 2023. He once again handed over the captaincy to Ruturaj Gaikwad ahead of IPL 2024 but resumed leadership during the 2025 season after Gaikwad suffered an injury.

Captaincy Record: 244 matches, 145 wins, 98 losses, 60.12% win percentage, 5 IPL titles (2010, 2011, 2018, 2021, 2023) and 2 Champions League T20 titles (2010, 2014).

  1. Suresh Raina

Fondly known as “Chinna Thala,” Suresh Raina was CSK’s trusted deputy throughout the Dhoni era. Whenever Dhoni was unavailable, Raina stepped in as captain and ensured the team maintained its competitive edge. His leadership reflected the stability and depth that defined Chennai Super Kings during their most successful years.

Captaincy Record: 6 matches, 2 wins and 4 defeats as stand-in captain between 2010 and 2019.

  1. Ravindra Jadeja

Ravindra Jadeja, affectionately called “Cricket Thalapathy” by the Yellow Army, was entrusted with the captaincy ahead of the 2022 season as CSK began planning for the future. While the transition proved challenging and the captaincy eventually returned to Dhoni, Jadeja remained an integral part of the squad. A year later, he cemented his legacy by striking the winning runs in the unforgettable 2023 IPL final.

Captaincy Record: 8 matches, 2 wins and 6 defeats during IPL 2022.

  1. Ruturaj Gaikwad

Ruturaj Gaikwad became CSK captain ahead of the 2024 season, signalling the franchise’s long-term vision for a new era. His appointment represented the next phase in CSK’s leadership journey, although an injury early in the 2025 season forced him to step aside, with Dhoni returning to lead the team.

Captaincy Record: 33 matches, 14 wins, 19 defeats and a 42.42% win percentage.

For a complete captain-by-captain timeline, detailed records, statistics, and leadership milestones, read our All CSK Captains guide.

CSK Trophies

Championships define legacies, and Chennai Super Kings have built one of the greatest in IPL history. Every title has marked a turning point in the franchise’s journey, reflecting its resilience, consistency, and ability to rise to the occasion. Rather than being remembered solely for the trophies themselves, each triumph tells a unique story that has strengthened CSK’s bond with the Yellow Army.

  1. 2010 & 2011: The Beginning of a Dynasty

After narrowly missing out on the title in the inaugural years, Chennai Super Kings finally broke through in 2010 to lift their maiden IPL trophy. It was more than just a championship—it validated the team’s philosophy of backing experienced players and trusting the process. A year later, CSK became the first franchise in IPL history to successfully defend their title by winning the 2011 season. Back-to-back championships announced to the cricketing world that Chennai Super Kings were not just contenders but a dynasty in the making.

  1. 2018: The Greatest Comeback

Few championship victories carry as much emotion as CSK’s triumph in 2018. Returning to the IPL after a two-year suspension, many questioned whether the franchise could reclaim its place among the league’s elite. Instead, Chennai Super Kings silenced every doubt by lifting the trophy in their very first season back. The unforgettable “Whistle Podu” comeback remains one of the most inspiring chapters in IPL history and is still celebrated as one of cricket’s greatest redemption stories.

  1. 2021: Back on Top

After enduring their most difficult IPL campaign in 2020, where they failed to qualify for the playoffs for the first time, CSK responded in trademark fashion. Under MS Dhoni’s leadership, the team regrouped, adapted to a season split between India and the UAE, and reclaimed the IPL trophy in 2021. The title reinforced the franchise’s ability to bounce back stronger, regardless of the setbacks it faced.

  1. 2023: Winning Until the Last Ball

CSK’s fifth IPL title in 2023 perfectly captured the franchise’s fighting spirit. In a thrilling final that went down to the very last delivery, Chennai Super Kings held their nerve to script one of the most dramatic finishes in IPL history. The victory saw CSK equal Mumbai Indians’ record of five IPL titles, reaffirming their place among the league’s greatest franchises. 

Want to revisit every title-winning campaign? Check out our comprehensive CSK Trophy List guide. 

CSK Finals

One of the biggest reasons Chennai Super Kings are regarded as the IPL’s benchmark franchise is their remarkable consistency in reaching the final. While most teams measure success through occasional championship wins, CSK have built their legacy by regularly competing on the biggest stage. Their repeated appearances in IPL finals reflect a culture of excellence, resilience, and an ability to perform under pressure year after year.

  1. 2008: A Strong Beginning

CSK announced their arrival by reaching the IPL final in the league’s inaugural season. Although they fell short of lifting the trophy, the campaign established them as one of the competition’s strongest teams from the very beginning.

  1. 2010–2013: Four Consecutive Finals

Between 2010 and 2013, Chennai Super Kings achieved an extraordinary feat by reaching four consecutive IPL finals. The period included back-to-back championship victories in 2010 and 2011, followed by two hard-fought runners-up finishes. It cemented CSK’s reputation as the most consistent franchise of the early IPL era.

  1. 2015: Another Shot at Glory

After continuing to dominate the league stage in the years that followed, CSK once again reached the IPL final in 2015. Their sixth final appearance in just eight seasons further highlighted the team’s remarkable ability to remain among the league’s elite despite changing challenges and opponents.

  1. 2018 & 2019: A Fairytale Return

Returning to the IPL after a two-year suspension, CSK wasted no time reclaiming their place at the top by reaching the 2018 final and lifting the trophy. A year later, they reached yet another final, narrowly missing out on consecutive championships in one of the closest finishes in IPL history. These back-to-back appearances reinforced the franchise’s resilience and winning mentality.

  1. 2021 & 2023: Adding to the Legacy

Following a disappointing 2020 campaign, CSK bounced back to win their fourth IPL title in 2021, proving that setbacks were only temporary. Two years later, they reached another final and lifted their fifth championship, equalling the record for the most IPL titles. Every finals appearance has added another chapter to CSK’s enduring legacy, showcasing a team that continues to rise when the biggest prizes are on the line.

Explore the CSK Finals List for a complete look at every IPL final in the franchise’s history.

CSK Owners

Ownership stability has been one of the biggest reasons behind Chennai Super Kings’ sustained success. Unlike many IPL franchises that have witnessed frequent changes in management, CSK have largely retained a consistent leadership structure since their inception in 2008. 

The franchise is owned by Chennai Super Kings Cricket Limited (CSKCL), which was formed after the demerger from India Cements. Over the years, the Srinivasan family’s continued involvement and a stable promoter group have helped maintain the franchise’s long-term vision, both on and off the field.

Today, CSKCL is backed by a diverse group of shareholders, with EWS Finance & Investments Pvt. Ltd. emerging as the largest promoter. The franchise continues to be among the most valuable sports brands in India, reflecting strong governance, commercial success, and sustained on-field performances.

Major Shareholders of CSKCL 

For a detailed breakdown of CSK’s ownership history, promoter changes, shareholding pattern, and net worth, read our CSK Owners guide. 

CSK Coaches

Behind Chennai Super Kings’ sustained success stands one of the IPL’s greatest coaching minds: Stephen Fleming. Appointed as head coach in 2009, the former New Zealand captain became the architect behind CSK’s culture of consistency, trust, and composure. While MS Dhoni led the team on the field, Fleming played an equally vital role behind the scenes, helping shape the franchise into one of the most successful teams in T20 cricket.

Fleming’s coaching philosophy mirrored Dhoni’s leadership style: back experienced players, avoid panic during difficult phases, and build a stable environment where individuals could thrive. This partnership became the driving force behind CSK’s remarkable consistency, multiple IPL titles, and numerous finals appearances. Rather than constantly rebuilding the squad, Fleming focused on continuity, allowing players to perform with clarity and confidence.

Although Stephen Fleming is no longer associated with Chennai Super Kings, his contribution to the franchise remains immeasurable. His partnership with Dhoni transformed CSK into a model franchise, and his legacy will forever place him among the greatest coaches in IPL history.

Explore the CSK Coaches guide to discover the coaching philosophy behind CSK’s sustained success. 

Final Word

For nearly two decades, Chennai Super Kings have stood as the gold standard of consistency in the IPL. From unforgettable title triumphs and iconic leaders to remarkable comebacks and a loyal Yellow Army, every chapter has strengthened the franchise’s legacy. To explore each milestone in greater detail, dive into our dedicated guides on CSK Captains, CSK Trophies, CSK Finals, CSK Owners, and CSK Coaches.

title: Wiaan Mulder's Shock Release by JSK Headlines the SA20 2027 Auction Build-Up
content:
Wiaan Mulder’s release by Johannesburg Super Kings ahead of the SA20 2027 auction has caught the attention after he was JSK’s highest-priced signing last season.

Mulder Released by Joburg Super Kings After Becoming Their Highest-Buy Last Season

The investment reflected the team’s confidence in his all-round ability and proven performances across formats. Throughout the previous campaign, the South-African cricketer delivered decent contributions with both the bat and ball. Renowned for generating useful bounce and maintaining impressive economy, his power-hitting caliber with the bat make him a dependable all-round option.

Releasing the versatile all-rounder could prove costly if another franchise acquires his services. With proven match-winning potential, Wiaan is expected to be one of the most sought-after names in the upcoming auction.

Did JSK Make a Costly Mistake by Parting Ways With Mulder?

Following an aggressive squad revamp, JSK parted ways with several established players while attempting to rebuild after falling short of the championship despite reaching the playoffs every season. Among the biggest surprises was the exit of Mulder, who is known for his exceptional bowling and fearless batting.

Perhaps the team believes it can re-sign him at a lower price or pursue another replacement during the upcoming auction. Disciplined bowling skills and power-hitting ability of the 28-year old cricketer make him a highly desirable all-rounder, with the possibility of every franchise entering the bidding war for the South-African lad remaining high.

title: JSK Released Players 2027: Full Joburg Super Kings List
content:
The players released by JSK ahead of the SA20 Season 5 auction have sent shockwaves through the competition, with Joburg Super Kings opting for one of the biggest squad overhauls in the league’s history. In a bold move, the franchise parted ways with long-time captain Faf du Plessis, record signing Wiaan Mulder, and Proteas pacer Nandre Burger, signaling the end of an era after four seasons without a title.

While JSK have retained a strong core and made several pre-signings, the JSK released players list reflects a clear shift towards rebuilding the squad under a new leadership group ahead of the 2026/27 SA20 season.

JSK released players 2027

While the franchise has retained the core of its squad and added a few exciting pre-signings, several high-profile names have been released in a move that signals a fresh approach for the upcoming season.

Faf du Plessis

Faf du Plessis‘ release marks the end of an era for Joburg Super Kings after captaining the franchise across all four SA20 seasons. Under his leadership, JSK won 16 of their 40 matches, while he established himself as the franchise’s leading run-scorer with 1,029 runs at an average of 32.15 and a strike rate of 143.19, including 1 century and 7 fifties.

However, an injury-laden 2026 campaign restricted him to just five matches, and with Stephen Fleming stepping down as head coach, JSK may have opted for a complete leadership transition.

Wiaan Mulder

Wiaan Mulder arrived at Joburg Super Kings as their most expensive signing at the SA20 2025 auction, costing R9 million, but failed to consistently justify the investment. In the previous season, the South African all-rounder managed 137 runs in 10 innings while picking up nine wickets at an economy rate of nearly 10, making him one of the high-profile releases as JSK looked to rebuild their squad for the 2026/27 season.

Nandre Burger

Nandre Burger’s release appears to be part of Joburg Super Kings’ wider squad overhaul before the auction. The left-arm pacer claimed 7 wickets in 7 matches last season but has struggled with recurring back injuries, including a lumbar stress reaction that affected his availability.

Combined with JSK’s intent to free up auction funds and reshape the squad under a new coaching setup, the franchise chose to move on from the South African quick.

Daniel Worrall

Daniel Worrall largely served as a backup option for Joburg Super Kings during the previous SA20 season, featuring in just 4 matches and claiming 4 wickets. With limited opportunities and JSK looking to refresh their pace attack, the franchise appears to have prioritised younger and more dynamic bowling options. We are in a squad overhaul phase with no room for mediocrity. 

Reece Topley

Joburg Super Kings signed Reece Topley for R1 million at the SA20 2025 Player Auction, but the England left-arm pacer did not feature in a single match during the 2025/26 season. Having occupied an overseas slot without making an on-field impact, his release allows JSK greater flexibility to strengthen other areas of the squad.

Imran Tahir

Imran Tahir’s release brings an end to a memorable stint with Joburg Super Kings, having claimed 18 wickets in 22 matches for the franchise. Although the 47-year-old recently captained the Guyana Amazon Warriors to the Global Super League title, JSK appear to have shifted towards a younger spin unit comprising Prenelan Subrayen, Jarren Bacher, and Akeal Hosein, making Tahir’s departure part of the team’s long-term transition. The younger brigade will be leading the spin attack. 

Rivaldo Moonsamy

Rivaldo Moonsamy struggled to make an impact during his limited opportunities with Joburg Super Kings, scoring just 14 runs in 4 matches. Having failed to deliver in crucial games, the franchise likely opted to release the wicketkeeper-batter in search of a more reliable option.

Neil Timmers

Neil Timmers featured in just 2 matches during the previous SA20 season, scoring 47 runs. While his release may come as a surprise, JSK’s strong batting core and preference for younger, long-term prospects likely made it difficult for the youngster to retain his place in the squad. He might be bought back in the auction. 

Jorich van Schalkwyk

Jorich van Schalkwyk was initially brought in by Joburg Super Kings as a temporary replacement during the tournament. However, after becoming unavailable following his selection for South Africa’s ICC Under-19 World Cup squad, JSK replaced him with Duan Jansen, making his release a straightforward squad management decision rather than a performance-related one.

Steve Stolk

Steve Stolk did not feature in a single match for Joburg Super Kings during the previous SA20 season, making it difficult to justify a retention. With Matthew de Villiers emerging as a promising young batter, JSK appear to have backed the latter as their long-term option. However, Stolk remains a strong candidate to be re-signed if available at the auction.

Shubham Ranjane

Shubham Ranjane‘s release reflects Joburg Super Kings’ intent to build a new core ahead of SA20 Season 5. The Indian batter left the tournament midway through the previous season due to national commitments and managed 101 runs in six matches before his departure. With JSK undergoing a significant squad overhaul, the franchise has seemingly chosen to move in a different direction.

Brandon King

Brandon King’s release comes after an injury-hit campaign that saw him ruled out and replaced by Matthew de Villiers during the previous season. Having retained Matthew de Villiers as their preferred wicketkeeper-batter, JSK chose not to use an overseas slot on King. 

Michael Pepper

Michael Pepper was signed by Joburg Super Kings as a temporary replacement for Shubham Ranjane after the latter departed for national duty during the 2025/26 season. Having fulfilled a short-term role, Pepper was not retained as JSK reshaped their squad for next season. His release was largely a contractual decision rather than one based on performance.

Richard Gleeson

Richard Gleeson’s release forms part of Joburg Super Kings’ extensive squad rebuild after 4 seasons without a title. The England pacer claimed 9 wickets in 6 matches, but an economy rate exceeding 10 runs per over, combined with his age, 38, and the need to free up valuable overseas slots, likely influenced the franchise’s decision to move on and target younger international talent.

What Do These Releases Mean for JSK’s Auction Strategy?

This is JSK’s first major move since parting ways with head coach Stephen Fleming, and it points to a reset. Releasing expensive players such as Wiaan Mulder and Nandre Burger may be more about freeing auction funds than ending their association with the franchise. JSK could still buy either player back at a lower price.

In contrast, Imran Tahir and Richard Gleeson may be out of their plans as the franchise looks to build around a younger core. The releases of Steve Stolk, Neil Timmers, and Michael Pepper likely reflect limited opportunities, insufficient impact, and stronger alternatives within the squad.

What Does JSK’s Retained Core Look Like?

The JSK retained players 2027 list shows that the franchise plans to build its new core around Donovan Ferreira. Rilee Rossouw adds experience to the batting unit, while James Vince should bring much-needed stability at the top of the order. Jason Holder brings balance as an all-rounder, while Akeal Hosein offers control and experience in the spin attack.

The main concern is the pace attack. Following the releases of Nandre Burger, Daniel Worrall, and Wiaan Mulder, JSK lack depth and proven wicket-taking options among their fast bowlers. Strengthening that department should be one of their biggest priorities at the SA20 Season 5 auction, even if it means buying back one of their released players at a lower price.

title: JSK Releases Faf du Plessis Ahead of SA20 2027 Auction
content:
Johannesburg witnessed the end of a remarkable chapter as Faf du Plessis was released by Joburg Super Kings ahead of SA20 2027 auction, following the veteran batter’s unforgettable four-season spell with the franchise.

Across those campaigns, his captaincy transformed JSK into consistent contenders, making his exit one of the biggest talking points before the upcoming season.

JSK Faces a Challenging Task Ahead of Filling Faf’s Void

Throughout his stint as the captain from 2023 to 2026, Faf built Joburg Super Kings into one of the most powerful teams in SA20 history. His tactical awareness, strategic thinking, and ability to inspire team-mates guided the side to the playoffs every single season. Although the elusive championship remained out of reach, JSK earned a reputation as one of the tournament’s mightiest and most competitive units under his captaincy.

Meanwhile, the former South-African batter continued proving that age has not diminished his batting excellence. He recently achieved a milestone by becoming the first player to score three T20 centuries after turning 40. Earlier this year, he showcased his class in Major League Cricket for TSK, producing a brilliant century during a high-pressure chase against Seattle Orcas that reaffirmed his remarkable consistency and match-winning caliber.

Consequently, Joburg Super Kings now hold a huge responsibility in replacing both their captain and key batter. Leadership qualities comparable to the South-African are difficult to find, while his dependable run-scoring at the top of the order leaves another significant void. Selecting the right successor will demand careful planning, because the franchise must identify someone capable of maintaining its competitive standards while guiding the next generation towards the title that narrowly escaped them for 4 consecutive seasons.

Did Joburg Super Kings Make the Right Decision by Releasing Faf?

Despite maintaining a magnificent form with the bat, Faf du Plessis’ release appears to reflect Joburg Super Kings’ long-term planning rather than his on-field performances. The franchise may have decided the time was right to invest in young rising talents capable of serving the team for several years. Management could also believe that revamping the squad is necessary to build a new core for the future.

Ultimately, four consecutive playoff appearances without winning the title may have influenced the management to choose a fresh path. Consistent success established JSK among the competition’s elite sides, yet the absence of silverware likely encouraged a broader squad renovation. Fresh leadership, new combinations, and emerging players might provide the spark the team believes is required to overcome the final obstacle. Even so, replacing a leader and batter of Faf du Plessis’ stature will remain a demanding assignment, considering the lasting impact he made throughout his tenure.

title: Matthew Short's Heroics Guides Welsh Fire Towards Their Fourth Victory of The Hundred Tournament
content:
Matthew Short produced a remarkable innings, smashing an unbeaten half-century that powered Welsh Fire to a commanding victory against Southern Brave in The Hundred. His composed approach blended perfectly with aggressive stroke play throughout the chase.

Meanwhile, fans witnessed a fearless display as the Australian all-rounder controlled the contest and ensured his side crossed the finish line with confidence and style.

Welsh Fire’s Clinical All-Round Display Crushes Southern Brave

Southern Brave posted 115 for 8 from their 100 balls after struggling to build lasting partnerships throughout the innings. Marcus Stoinis stood tall for his team with a brilliant 55 from 39 deliveries, anchoring the innings while wickets continued to tumble around him. Sam Cook delivered a disciplined spell, claiming 3 for 14 from 20 balls and restricting the scoring rate below par.

WF approached the chase aggressively despite early breakthroughs from the opposition bowlers. Short remained composed from the beginning, displaying a fearless approach and smart shot selection. His unbeaten 60 from 41 deliveries kept the required rate under control and completely shifted the momentum towards the visitors. The CSK lad’s amazing knock dismantled the bowling unit, helping his side march closer to the winning line.

Ultimately, Welsh achieved the target with six wickets in hand within 95 balls, registering their fourth victory of the tournament. Consistent contributions from both the bowling and batting departments highlighted the team’s growing balance. Cook’s economical spell created the perfect platform before Matthew’s match-winning knock finished the task, extending WF’s impressive run with another convincing all-round performance.

Another Day, Another Batter Delivers for WF

Consistency continues to define the Fire’s impressive campaign, with a different batter stepping forward whenever the team requires a decisive contribution. This time, Short embraced the responsibility and delivered an outstanding unbeaten innings that helped the team achieve the target with ease. Every successful performance strengthens the encouragement within the dressing room and reinforces the determination that anyone in the batting order can become the match-winner.

Confidence has transformed this line-up into one of the mightiest batting units in the tournament. Different batsmen have repeatedly produced winning knocks, preventing the opponents from relying on the plans against a single star performer. Regardless of the opponents or playing conditions, Welsh possesses the depth and versatility to adapt their approach effectively. Such dependable contributions from multiple batters make the side increasingly difficult to contain, while the CSK all-rounder’s latest heroics further underline the phenomenal strength and balance of an already formidable batting set-up.

title: CSK Released Players 2027: Predicted List Ahead of IPL Auction
content:
The build-up to the IPL 2027 auction is underway, and the spotlight is already on the CSK released players 2027 discussion. After enduring back-to-back disappointing seasons, Chennai Super Kings find themselves at a crucial crossroads. With IPL 2027 set to be the final season before the next mega auction, the franchise must make some tough squad decisions to rebuild its core and address key weaknesses. 

While the official release list is yet to be announced, this article predicts the players who could be released based on their IPL 2026 performances, squad roles, fitness, auction value, and the team’s future requirements. This page will be updated once CSK confirms its official list.

Has CSK Announced Its Released Players List for IPL 2027?

No, Chennai Super Kings have not announced their official list of released players for IPL 2027. The Chennai Super Kings released players 2027 list remains unconfirmed, and the franchise has not issued any official statement regarding player releases. 

Until CSK or the IPL announces the final squad changes, any names circulating online should be treated as predictions. This page will be updated as soon as the official list is released.

CSK Predicted Released Players 2027

Note: The players listed above are predictions only and not CSK’s official released players list for IPL 2027.

Why CSK May Release These Players

The 2026 IPL certainly didn’t happen the way CSK would have hoped it to be. While they improved from their previous campaign from 2025, it was still way off the mark from where they would want to be. And somewhere along the lines, the blame has to fall on players who didn’t perform to the reputation with which they arrived in the squad.

Therefore, these are the CSK players that might get released before the 2027 IPL.

Zak Foulkes

Zak Foulkes never managed to break into CSK’s playing XI during IPL 2026, spending the entire season as an unused backup overseas option. With Jamie Overton and Akeal Hosein already offering greater balance and proven T20 credentials, Foulkes struggled to find a realistic path into the side.

Among the CSK released players 2027 predictions, Foulkes stands out as one of the most likely candidates to make way. His medium-pace bowling is not ideally suited to Chepauk’s slower surfaces, making him more useful only in a handful of away fixtures. Retaining an overseas player for such a limited role may not be the most efficient use of a squad spot. While CSK could continue to view him as a long-term prospect, the franchise is more likely to pursue an overseas player capable of making an immediate impact.

Rahul Chahar

Rahul Chahar’s underwhelming IPL form over the last three seasons could force CSK into making a difficult decision. Since 2024, the leg-spinner has represented three different franchises but has featured in only 11 matches, with his best return being 9 wickets in a season. Bought for ₹5.2 crore, Chahar was expected to strengthen CSK’s spin department but failed to establish himself in the playing XI.

The presence of Shreyas Gopal as a backup spinner further reduces the need to retain another experienced leg-spinner who has struggled for consistency. While Chahar’s experience remains valuable, CSK may prefer to reinvest that budget in a younger spinner or another specialist better suited to their plans.

Matt Henry

Matt Henry arrived with an excellent international reputation, but that success has not translated consistently into the IPL. Although he remains one of New Zealand’s most dependable fast bowlers, the modern IPL places a premium on bowlers who possess greater variation, adaptability, and the ability to influence games across different phases of an innings. 

Henry’s skill set has often been more effective in international cricket than in franchise T20 competitions, where conditions and batting approaches demand greater versatility. With overseas slots being among the most valuable assets in any IPL squad, CSK may look to replace Henry with a pacer better suited to their tactical requirements. His experience is undeniable, but the franchise could prioritise a more dynamic T20 specialist.

Matt Short

Matt Short arrived with an impressive T20 reputation but failed to make a lasting impression during his brief stint with CSK. He was handed a crucial opportunity in the away fixture against Sunrisers Hyderabad but couldn’t contribute significantly with either bat or ball. Across his three appearances, Short struggled to justify his selection, and once Dewald Brevis returned to the squad, he was pushed out of the playing XI. 

More importantly, his preferred batting position is in the top three, a role already occupied by Aayush Mhatre, Sanju Samson, and captain Ruturaj Gaikwad. With Kartik Sharma also emerging as a promising option and overseas spots at a premium, CSK may look elsewhere. His off-spin could still offer some value, but unless the management sees him as a genuine all-round option, a release appears more likely.

Gurjapneet Singh

Gurjapneet Singh entered IPL 2026 with plenty of expectations as the local pace prospect, especially after getting opportunities following Khaleel Ahmed’s injury. However, he struggled to capitalise on those chances, managing only 4 wickets in 8 appearances while failing to consistently trouble opposition batters.

Although CSK have shown patience with young Indian fast bowlers in the past, Gurjapneet’s performances did little to strengthen his claim for a regular spot. The addition of Aakash Madhwal also changes the equation, giving CSK another domestic pace option with greater IPL experience. Gurjapneet remains a long-term prospect, but if the franchise wants to strengthen its bowling attack immediately, moving on from him ahead of the auction would be a logical decision.

Spencer Johnson

Spencer Johnson joined CSK as a replacement for Nathan Ellis but failed to make the impact the franchise would have hoped for. Across his limited opportunities, the Australian left-arm pacer struggled to adapt to IPL conditions, continuing a trend from his previous stint with Gujarat Titans. While Johnson has established himself as a dangerous bowler in the Big Bash League, he has yet to consistently replicate that success in the IPL.

With Ellis expected to return ahead of him in the pecking order and CSK already possessing several pace-bowling options, Johnson’s place in the squad looks uncertain. Releasing him would also allow CSK to target an overseas bowling all-rounder, a profile that could provide greater balance alongside Jamie Overton.

Kuldip Yadav

Kuldip Yadav’s inclusion on this list is perhaps the harshest prediction, considering he never got the opportunity to play a match after joining CSK as an injury replacement for Khaleel Ahmed. However, with IPL 2027 being the final season before the next mega auction, CSK are expected to prioritise immediate success over developing inexperienced players.

The franchise already has a strong pace unit featuring Khaleel Ahmed, Aakash Madhwal, Nathan Ellis, and Jamie Overton, leaving very little room for another uncapped fast bowler. While Kuldip could still be viewed as a player for the future, CSK may prefer to use the squad spot on someone who can contribute straight away in what could be a title-defining season.

Prashant Veer

Prashant Veer arrived at CSK with huge expectations after being signed for ₹14.2 crore and was widely viewed as a potential long-term successor to Ravindra Jadeja. However, his debut season failed to justify that investment, as he managed only 90 runs in 6 matches and went wicketless despite being picked as a batting all-rounder.

Injuries early in the campaign certainly disrupted his rhythm, but CSK may still view his price tag as too steep for the returns they received. Rather than moving on completely, the franchise could release Veer and attempt to buy him back at a significantly lower price during the auction. That approach would free up valuable funds while still allowing CSK to retain a player they believe has long-term potential.

What These Releases Could Mean for CSK

If these predicted releases materialise, CSK’s 2027 release decisions could give the franchise greater flexibility to reshape its squad ahead of a crucial IPL 2027 campaign. 

Releasing several overseas players would open up valuable slots, allowing CSK to target emerging T20 talents or proven match-winners who better suit their style of play. Strengthening the overseas core with players capable of making an immediate impact could become one of the franchise’s biggest priorities. 

The middle order is another area that may require attention. While Shivam Dube and Dewald Brevis remain talented options, both endured inconsistent campaigns in IPL 2026. CSK could look for an overseas batter or batting all-rounder who can either complement the existing middle order or provide genuine competition for places.

The franchise may also look to strengthen its Indian pace attack. Although the current group possesses plenty of potential, it still lacks the experience and consistency needed to challenge for the title. Bringing in an established Indian fast bowler with proven IPL pedigree would add depth, leadership, and greater reliability to the bowling unit.

With IPL 2027 marking the final season before the next mega auction, CSK are likely to prioritise players who can deliver immediate results rather than long-term projects. Expect the franchise to focus on experienced performers in key roles while selectively investing in younger talents capable of becoming part of the team’s future core.

Players CSK Are Likely to Retain

While the official retention list is yet to be announced, CSK are expected to retain the core of their squad heading into IPL 2027. Players such as Ruturaj Gaikwad, Sanju Samson, Aayush Mhatre, Dewald Brevis, Shivam Dube, Jamie Overton, Khaleel Ahmed, Noor Ahmad, Kartik Sharma, and Akeal Hosein are all likely to remain part of the franchise’s plans due to their importance across departments.

For a detailed breakdown of the players expected to stay with the franchise, check out our dedicated CSK Retained Players 2027 page.

When Will the Official CSK Release List Be Announced?

As of now, CSK have not announced their official released players list for IPL 2027. The final retention and released players lists are expected to be announced on November 15, 2026, ahead of the IPL 2027 auction. The Chennai Super Kings released players list 2027 will be updated as soon as the franchise confirms which players it will retain and release for the upcoming season.

FAQs

  1. Have CSK announced their released players for IPL 2027?
    No, CSK have not officially announced their released players for IPL 2027, and the list in this article is based on predictions.
  1. Which players could CSK release before IPL 2027?
    Players such as Zak Foulkes, Rahul Chahar, Matt Henry, Matt Short, Gurjapneet Singh, Spencer Johnson, Kuldip Yadav, and Prashant Veer could be released based on current squad requirements and recent performances.
  1. When will the CSK released players list be announced?
    The official CSK released players list 2027 will be announced once Chennai Super Kings or the IPL confirms the squad changes ahead of the IPL 2027 auction.
  1. What happens to a player after an IPL team releases him?
    A released player becomes eligible to register for the IPL auction, where any franchise can bid to sign him for the upcoming season.

title: Joburg Super Kings Retained Players 2027
content:
A new era has officially begun at Joburg Super Kings. With Stephen Fleming stepping down as head coach, Albie Morkel taking charge, and franchise icon Faf du Plessis released ahead of the auction, the team’s bold reset is impossible to ignore. The JSK retained players 2027 list reflects the first phase of that transition as the franchise looks to finally end its four-season title drought and build a squad capable of winning SA20.

JSK Retained Players 2027

Following another playoff exit in 2026, Joburg Super Kings have chosen to reshape their squad with an eye on long-term success. The retention list reflects a clear shift towards a younger core while preserving key performers capable of leading the franchise’s pursuit of its maiden SA20 title.

Donovan Ferreira

Donovan Ferreira was always going to be among the first names on the retention list and is widely expected to take over the captaincy. Since joining JSK in the inaugural season, the dynamic all-rounder has been the man for all seasons, contributing with the bat, behind the stumps, and with his off-spin. In 32 innings, Ferreira has amassed 555 runs at a strike rate of nearly 160 while also claiming 16 wickets in 17 bowling innings. With his match-winning ability and leadership potential, fans will be hoping he can lead JSK into a new era.

Rilee Rossouw

Few players bring the blend of experience and firepower that Rilee Rossouw offers. Although an injury cut short his SA20 2026 campaign after just three matches, the left-hander still managed 91 runs before being sidelined. Across his time with JSK, Rossouw has scored 481 runs, while his overall T20 record of more than 10,000 runs underlines the pedigree he brings. His ability to dominate bowling attacks makes him an invaluable part of the squad.

Prenelan Subrayen

After arriving from Durban’s Super Giants ahead of last season, Prenelan Subrayen quickly proved his worth with several disciplined performances. The off-spinner featured in seven matches and picked up six wickets, including a match-winning spell of 3/14 that showcased his ability to control the middle overs. With Imran Tahir no longer part of the squad, JSK appear to be placing their faith in Subrayen to spearhead the spin attack as they build towards the future.

Jarren Bacher

At just 22 years old, Jarren Bacher remains one of JSK’s most exciting long-term prospects. The off-spinning all-rounder replaced Reece Topley in the squad last season but didn’t get an opportunity to feature. Despite that, the franchise has continued to back his talent and potential, highlighting the faith they have in his abilities. Whether he breaks into the playing XI this season or in the years ahead, JSK clearly see Bacher as a player for the future.

Dian Forrester

Dian Forrester is another exciting all-rounder whom the Super Kings family rates highly, having also been picked by the Chennai Super Kings franchise in the IPL. Primarily a batting all-rounder, he impressed for JSK by scoring 175 runs in just eight innings at a strike rate of over 165, while his bowling opportunities remained limited. However, his overall T20 numbers tell a bigger story. Across 43 innings, Forrester has amassed 867 runs and has also claimed 19 wickets in 26 matches, proving his value as a genuine all-rounder. Expect him to feature regularly throughout the season.

Janco Smit

Janco Smit was brought into the squad last season as a promising pace option, and although his only appearance didn’t go according to plan, the management’s continued faith speaks volumes. The 25-year-old conceded 37 runs in his four-over spell, but judging him on a single outing would be premature. Still early in his professional journey, Smit possesses the raw talent to develop into a dependable fast bowler.

Duan Jansen

Often introduced as Marco Jansen’s brother, Duan Jansen is steadily carving out an identity of his own in the SA20. The 26-year-old featured in five matches for JSK last season and impressed with seven wickets, while also showing he can contribute valuable runs lower down the order. His overall T20 record further highlights his all-round credentials, with 64 wickets and 391 runs at a strike rate of 144 in just 57 matches. A genuine pace-bowling all-rounder with finishing ability is a rare asset, making Jansen an important part of JSK’s plans.

Matthew de Villiers

JSK’s continued faith in Matthew de Villiers reflects their belief in his long-term potential. While the wicketkeeper-batter endured a modest SA20 2026 campaign, scoring 151 runs in 11 innings, his domestic record paints a far more promising picture. De Villiers has amassed 545 runs in just 18 T20 matches, including five half-centuries, showcasing the consistency that made him one of South Africa’s brightest young batting prospects. With another year of experience behind him, he has all the tools to become one of the franchise’s cornerstone players.

Leus du Plooy

Leus du Plooy has been a mainstay for JSK since joining the franchise. Although he has occasionally moved in and out of the playing XI, his consistency with the bat has never been in doubt. Across 29 innings, the left-hander has amassed 829 runs, including six half-centuries, at a strike rate of nearly 150. In a format dominated by power-hitters, players like Du Plooy offer invaluable stability while still maintaining an attacking intent, making him a crucial part of JSK’s batting core.

JSK Pre Signings (Overseas)

Joburg Super Kings have used the SA20 pre-signing window to reshape their squad ahead of Season 5. By securing players before the auction, JSK have added experience, filled key roles, and established the core around which the rest of their squad can be built.

These signings also offer an early indication of the balance and playing style the franchise may pursue under its new coaching setup. Yet, several gaps remain, particularly in the pace department, meaning the auction will still play a major role in completing the JSK squad for the 2026/27 season.

Akeal Hosein

Akeal Hosein is no stranger to the Super Kings family, but this pre-signing signals that his role is set to become much bigger. With Imran Tahir moving on, the experienced left-arm spinner is expected to be one of the leaders of JSK’s bowling attack. During his previous stint with the franchise, Hosein picked up seven wickets in 11 matches, while his global T20 record is nothing short of exceptional, boasting 275 wickets and 1,259 runs. His experience, control, and all-round value make him a massive addition ahead of the auction.

Jason Holder

The signing of Jason Holder is nothing short of a statement of intent from Joburg Super Kings. One of the finest pace-bowling all-rounders in world cricket, Holder brings leadership, experience, and unmatched balance to the squad. Across 367 T20 matches, he has amassed 3,562 runs and claimed 402 wickets, underlining his ability to influence games in every department. Few players improve a T20 side as significantly as Holder, making him one of the marquee additions ahead of SA20 2027.

James Vince

If consistency had a face, it would be James Vince. Widely regarded as one of the finest opening batters in T20 cricket, the Englishman arrives with a phenomenal record of 13,777 runs in 491 T20 matches, including 89 half-centuries and eight centuries. Vince also enjoyed a productive campaign for JSK last season, scoring 263 runs in just seven innings with two fifties while stepping up as stand-in captain when required. 

What the Retentions Reveal About JSK’s Strategy

There are a lot of clear takeaways from the retentions that JSK have made ahead of the auction.

A Clear Shift in Direction

Joburg Super Kings have finally drawn a line under the past. The departures of Faf du Plessis, Imran Tahir, Reece Topley, and Richard Gleeson signal more than just a change in personnel; they mark the start of a new era. Instead of holding on to an aging core, the franchise has invested in younger players who can lead the team for years to come. It is a bold reset, but one that gives JSK a clear identity heading into SA20 2027.

Jason Holder Headlines the Pre-signings

While Akeal Hosein and James Vince continue their journey with JSK through pre-signings, the arrival of Jason Holder is the headline move. One of the finest T20 all-rounders of the modern era, Holder brings proven quality with both bat and ball, invaluable leadership, and the ability to change games in every phase. Whether it’s breaking partnerships with the ball, finishing innings with the bat, or guiding younger players, Holder elevates every team he represents. His signing sends a strong message that JSK are targeting nothing less than the SA20 title.

The Strongest Core in Franchise History

For the first time since the SA20 began, Joburg Super Kings look like a complete side even before the auction. With Donovan Ferreira, Jason Holder, James Vince, Akeal Hosein, Leus du Plooy, Rilee Rossouw, Dian Forrester, Duan Jansen, and Prenelan Subrayen already secured, the franchise has a balanced core covering every department. Instead of rebuilding from scratch, JSK have established a foundation that can compete with any side in the tournament.

The Auction Is About Completing the Puzzle

Unlike previous seasons, JSK are not entering the auction searching for answers. They already have a settled core and now need only a handful of additions to complete the squad. With the biggest purse available; R21.5 million (approximately US$1.2 million)—the franchise is in a strong position to target specific roles rather than overhaul the team. If they make the right moves at the auction, Joburg Super Kings could emerge with one of the most balanced squads in SA20 history.

What Will JSK Look for at the SA20 2027 Auction?

With a strong core expected to remain intact, Joburg Super Kings are unlikely to overhaul their squad at the SA20 2027 auction. Instead, the franchise will probably focus on filling a few key gaps that improve squad balance while staying true to the Super Kings’ philosophy of backing specialists for defined roles.

  1. South African Top-Order Batter

One of JSK’s biggest priorities could be finding a reliable South African batter for the No. 3 position. Rilee Rossouw was expected to anchor that role, but with his future uncertain and Matthew de Villiers still developing, the franchise may look for a proven domestic batter who can slot in behind Faf du Plessis and James Vince. Ideally, the player should be capable of maintaining a strike rate above 150 while counterattacking if an early wicket falls.

  1. Overseas Specialist

Assuming James Vince, Akeal Hosein, and Richard Gleeson occupy three overseas slots, JSK could use the remaining spot on a genuine T20 specialist. Rather than another conventional batter or bowler, the ideal player would be someone who can finish innings at a strike rate above 150 while also contributing a couple of overs, providing greater flexibility in South African conditions.

  1. Local Spinner

A quality South African spinner could be another important target to strengthen the squad. While Akeal Hosein remains the first-choice option, a dependable local spinner would allow JSK to rotate their overseas combination based on conditions without weakening the bowling attack. It would also reduce the need to rely on an overseas spinner in every match.

  1. Middle-Order Wicketkeeper

Although Donovan Ferreira is more than capable of keeping wickets, his all-round abilities are better utilised as a batter and bowling option. Signing a specialist wicketkeeper who can also strengthen the middle order would give the coaching staff greater tactical flexibility while allowing Ferreira to focus on impacting games in multiple departments.

How many overseas players can JSK have?

Joburg Super Kings can sign a total of 7 overseas players. Out of which only 4 can feature in the squad. For now, they already have signed 3 overseas players in Holder, Hosein, Vince, and du Plooy. Therefore, it will be interesting to see what their approach will be in the upcoming auction.

However, the JSK retentions showcase that they have a strong core to build around and with a hefty purse, nobody will be surprised to see them walk away with some big local names from the auction.

What Are SA20 Pre-Signings?

SA20 pre-signings are direct agreements completed between franchises and players before the league’s auction. They allow teams to recruit new players or retain existing squad members without competing for them through open bidding.

Franchises often use these deals to secure marquee international cricketers, leading domestic players, and core squad members they do not want to risk losing. Every pre-signing counts towards the team’s salary cap and final squad limit. Teams can build squads of up to 19 players while meeting the required domestic and overseas player quotas. The remaining positions are then filled through the SA20 player auction.

title: JSK Appoints Albie Morkel as Their New Head Coach Ahead of the Upcoming SA20
content:
Johannesburg welcomes a fresh chapter as Albie Morkel has been appointed as Joburg Super Kings’ new head coach for the upcoming SA20 tournament in 2027, replacing Stephen Fleming after four memorable seasons. The appointment marks an exciting transition for the franchise.

Bringing experience, leadership, and strong Super Kings values, the South-African now carries the responsibility of guiding JSK towards championship glory after years of consistent playoff appearances.

Morkel’s Super Kings Journey Continues with a New Role

Returning to the Super Kings family in a different capacity, Morkel begins an exciting coaching journey with JSK. The former all-rounder represented Chennai Super Kings from 2008 to 2013 and played a vital role in the franchise’s early success. During his spell, he lifted IPL trophies in 2010 and 2011 while making valuable contributions with both the bat and ball whenever his side needed him.

Perhaps the CSK legend’s most memorable IPL moment came in 2012 when he smashed Virat Kohli for 28 runs in the 18th over during an extraordinary chase against Royal Challengers Bangalore. That stunning assault helped Chennai pull off one of the league’s most thrilling victories from the edge of failure and further strengthened his credentials as a dependable match-winner. His return to the Super Kings set-up now adds another meaningful chapter to a long-standing association with the franchise.

Meanwhile, Fleming leaves behind an impressive legacy after coaching JSK for four seasons. Under his leadership, the team reached the playoffs every season despite falling short of winning the title. Maintaining that remarkable consistency while taking the final step towards championship success will now be the former South-African all-rounder’s biggest task. Expectations are understandably high, and Albie Morkel has the opportunity to build on the strong foundation already established.

Why Albie Morkel Could be a Right Fit to Lead Joburg Super Kings?

Experience makes Albie a perfect choice to lead Joburg Super Kings into a new era. Throughout his playing spell with CSK, he worked closely under Stephen and gained valuable insights into his coaching methods, strategic planning, and calm leadership that shaped the franchise’s success. That understanding should help him preserve the winning culture while introducing his own ideas and approach.

Additionally, the legendary cricketer’s international career with South Africa gives him deep knowledge of local pitches, playing conditions, and the demands of the sport in the country. Having worked under Fleming during his Chennai Super Kings playing days, he understands the culture, discipline, and team-first policy that the legendary coach established. His familiarity with the New-Zealand legend’s strategies should help him instill the same team culture at JSK while adding his own methods.

Combining Fleming’s influence with his own experience allows Morkel to connect naturally with the squad. Such a balanced blend of tactical awareness, local expertise, and franchise culture could make him the strongest contender to guide Johannesburg closer to their long-awaited first title.

title: Stephen Fleming Emerges as the Front-Runner to Take over the Role of England Test Head Coach
content:
Stephen Fleming has emerged as the top contender to become England’s next Test head coach, signaling a potentially significant shift in the team’s red-ball future. His proven leadership and tactical expertise make him a strong candidate for the prestigious post.

Meanwhile, discussions continue as the ECB evaluates the appointment, with hopes that the legendary cricketer’s experience can guide the team towards sustained success in the longest format.

ECB Prioritizes Long-Term Vision Over Immediate Appointment

Renowned for his calm leadership and tactical brilliance, Stephen has emerged as the favorite candidate to succeed as England’s Test head coach. The former New-Zealand captain has built an outstanding coaching reputation across franchise cricket, making him one of the most respected figures in the modern game.

Having guided Chennai Super Kings to five Indian Premier League titles between 2009 and 2026, Fleming recently ended his long association with the franchise. Beyond the IPL, he also served as the coach for Chennai’s sister franchises, JSK and TSK, in SA20 and MLC respectively, further strengthening his credentials across different conditions and competitions. Currently, it remains uncertain whether the New-Zealand legend would be handed the role before the three-match Test series against Pakistan, beginning on August 19 at Headingley. Nevertheless, ECB is prioritizing the appointment of the best talent rather than rushing the process. Officials believe securing the right leader is important as England prepares for next summer’s highly anticipated Ashes series against Australia.

Fleming appears well placed to become England’s next Test head coach, with his impressive achievements and clear understanding of the game placing him among the strongest candidates. His composed approach, strategic thinking and consistent success have earned widespread respect throughout international and franchise cricket.

Why England Eyes Fleming as their Test Head Coach?

During Stephen’s stint with CSK, he lead the side to five IPL titles and two CLT20 championships from 2009 to 2026, earning an immense respect in the cricket world.

Additionally, the legendary cricketer’s familiarity with English cricket enhances his appeal. During his playing career, he represented Middlesex, Yorkshire and Nottinghamshire before later serving as head coach of Southern Brave in The Hundred. Valuable experience gained during the playing spells provides him additional knowledge of English conditions.

Equally important will be his working relationship with his country-man Brendon McCullum, who is set to step down as Test coach while continuing the role in white-ball format until the expiry of his contract at the end of next year. Both former New-Zealand team-mates remain close friends and have also shared business interests, factors that could influence any future coaching partnership. Their strong understanding of each other’s coaching philosophies could help create greater consistency across England’s red-ball and white-ball setups. Should Fleming accept the offer, the ECB would hope that this partnership can strengthen the side’s long-term ambitions in the longest format of the sport.

title: CSK Players Called Up for a Physical Fitness Camp Ahead of Making Trade Decisions Amid Hardik Pandya Rumours
content:
Chennai Super Kings have summoned their players for a two-to-three-day fitness camp, marking the franchise’s first major step toward preparations for the next Indian Premier League season amid Hardik Pandya trade rumours. Every player will undergo intense physical assessments before cricketing activities begin.

Meanwhile, the exercise hints at significant squad decisions ahead, with the management expected to closely evaluate every cricketer’s fitness before deciding on potential retentions, releases, and trade opportunities.

CSK Eye Major Rebuild After Disappointing 2026 IPL Campaign as Hardik Pandya Talks Gather Pace

Following a disappointing 2026 Indian Premier League campaign, CSK have wasted little time in beginning preparations for a fresh start. The franchise has called its players for a two-to-three-day physical test camp, where every member of the squad will undergo detailed evaluations before the francise finalizes its plans for the upcoming season. Beyond testing fitness levels, the camp is expected to provide valuable insights into each cricketer’s readiness for another demanding tournament.

According to journalist Rohit Juglan of RevSports, the management is actively exploring ways to revamp its squad after finishing well below expectations last campaign. Discussions surrounding a possible move for Hardik have gained momentum after both the all-rounder and Mumbai Indians reportedly decided to part ways. Should negotiations progress, MI are believed to be interested in acquiring promising talents like Ayush Mhatre, Dewald Brevis, or Shivam Dube in addition with a few cash amount as a potential option in an exchange involving the two franchises.

With the team determined to bounce back after a disappointing 2026 campaign, the fitness camp is expected to help the side assess its current resources before making key retention, release, and trade decisions ahead of the next season.

CSK’s Fitness Camp: More Than Just Physical Assessment

Although speculation surrounding Pandya’s future continues to dominate the discussions, CSK chief executive Kasi Viswanathan has clarified that there is no final confirmation regarding the power-hitter’s arrival at the franchise. Even so, the franchise have already begun planning for the future by calling squad members for a two-to-three-day fitness examination, where every player will undergo extensive assessments before preparations for the next edition gather momentum.

Meanwhile, the management acknowledged that the IPL has become increasingly competitive with every passing season, leaving little room for sentiment when it comes to squad building. Loyalty alone cannot guarantee a place in the side, as current form, fitness, and the team’s requirements now carry greater importance than ever before. With Chennai Super Kings aiming to bounce back from a poor 2026 run, the physical examination is expected to play an important role in shaping the squad, helping the management make tough decisions on player retentions, releases, and possible trade moves ahead of the next edition.

title: Saiteja Mukkamalla's Patient Fifty Guides Vipers to a Dominant Victory over SFU
content:
Responding with determination, Saiteja Mukkamalla silenced critics through a composed half-century that showcased resilience, maturity, and smart shot selection. His fighting knock guided Desert Vipers to a dominant victory over SFU, with his innings showcasing his ability to handle pressure.

Displaying remarkable character, the TSK star reminded everyone why he remains one of the most promising batters, possessing the temperament and potential to become a key performer for every team he represents.

Desert Vipers Crush San Francisco Unicorns by Nine Wickets

DV produced a brilliant all-round performance to defeat San Francisco Unicorns by nine wickets in Match 7 of Global Super League 2026 at Providence Stadium. Batting first, SFU managed 151/7 in their 20 overs, with Tim Robinson top-scoring with 46 off 35 balls. Despite a few useful partnerships, the batting side struggled to accelerate against the disciplined bowling from the Vipers. Shadab Khan starred with the ball, delivering outstanding figures of 4/13 in four overs to restrict the Unicorns to a moderate total.

Thereafter, DV started the chase carefully yet with a quick approach to gain control through disciplined shot selection and intelligent running between the wickets. Zachary Carter anchored the innings with a blazing 55 from 29 deliveries, destroying the opposition bowling line-up. After Carter’s departure, Saiteja and his TSK team-mate Rilee Rossow stitched a brilliant 78 run partnership, with the USA batter scoring a composed 52 off 42 balls.

Ultimately, the chasing side reached the target of 152 in just 16.1 overs with 9 wickets in hand, thanks to the composed half-century from Mukkamalla under pressure combined with the quick-fire knock from Zachary. This convincing victory highlighted the Vipers’ balance, confidence, and ability to dominate in every department, further strengthening their position as one of the competition’s strongest teams.

Mukkamalla’s Calm Approach Could Make Him a Dependable Batter

Although the right-hander endured a difficult Major League Cricket campaign, he never stopped believing in his abilities. Apart from a notable knock of 80 against Los Angeles Knight Riders, runs were hard to come by, and inconsistency affected his performances. However, his latest fifty reflects confidence, patience, and the willingness to fight through a difficult phase rather than surrender to poor form.

Consequently, this innings could become a significant turning point in his career. Instead of attempting to clear the boundary with every delivery, the 22 year old batsman absorbs pressure, builds his innings carefully, and accelerates only after settling at the crease. Such maturity is a hallmark of dependable batters who consistently contribute in demanding situations. If he maintains this approach and continues developing his talent, his potential could be limitless. Furthermore, he possesses both the temperament and skill required to become a key batsman for every franchise he represents and, more importantly, a positive hope for Texas Super Kings in the next MLC season and a reliable pillar for USA national team in the years ahead.

title: Sanju Samson Reveals Why He Left RR for CSK Despite Risks
content:
Sanju Samson has quickly become one of Chennai Super Kings’ most important players. After one impressive season, he has now revealed that leaving Rajasthan Royals was the biggest risk of his career.

After playing for almost 150 games and 8 seasons in two stints, Samson was not just the captain of the Rajasthan Royals’ side. He was their most versatile yet dependable batter.

Then, why did he suddenly left the team? What really changed? That is what Samson answered in a recent interview on JioHotstars’ new show: Superstars.

Why Sanju Samson Left Rajasthan Royals

“I had long conversations with my family and my wife. They kept asking me if it was an impulsive decision or if I was really sure. We discussed it for two or three weeks, and then we decided it was time. I was convinced it was the right call,” Samson said.

Although Samson did not directly explain the cricketing reasons behind his exit, his role had reduced following Vaibhav Sooryavanshi’s emergence, making a fresh start elsewhere appear increasingly likely.

Why Joining CSK Was A Risk

Still, leaving the team, after captaining it for the past few seasons was a big gamble. But Samson was willing to take it. He remembers, “I told myself, ‘You are 30 years old. Go out and find a way.”

CSK soon acquired Samson in a trade, giving him a fresh start ahead of the 2026 season.

MS Dhoni’s Advice Changed Everything

After registering single-digit scores in his first two matches, questions quickly emerged over Samson’s start to life at CSK.

The pressure grew because Samson was opening the batting while also taking over wicketkeeping duties from MS Dhoni.

Samson even recalls a chat he had with the legend himself. And the former Indian captain reassured him that everything will be alright. That was the nudge that he required.

In the third game, everything changed. Samson not just scored his first fifty, but managed to convert it into a hundred becoming the first centurion of the season. After that, there was no looking back.

Samson finished as the highest runs scorer for CSK, scoring 477 runs in 14 innings. He smashed 2 centuries and 1 fifty, with an average of 43 and strike rate of 165. And 115* runs being highest score against Delhi Capitals.

Can Samson Become CSK Captain?

Sanju’s performance has had a great impact on the fans and the team. And many even want to see him as the future captain of the side. Especially after the below par season that Ruturaj Gaikwad had.

Samson however has no expectations of his own in this. He said, “Even at RR, I never asked for it. Manoj Badale sir, the owner of RR, told me I was the next captain, and I said I was ready.”

He also made it very clear that he is completely enjoying his cricket at the moment. According to him Ruturaj Gaikwad is someone who is taking the team forward in the right direction, and he would love to continue playing under his captaincy.

title: Samson Reveals the Reason Behind Choosing CSK Despite Multiple Franchises Showing Interest in the Right-Hander
content:
Sanju Samson finally disclosed the main reason behind choosing Chennai Super Kings despite attracting serious interest from multiple IPL franchises. His revelation has highlighted the influence of the legendary figure, MS Dhoni, who shaped his cricketing ambitions from childhood.

Meanwhile, the wicketkeeper-batter ignored lucrative opportunities elsewhere, believing that no other franchise would offer the ideal environment to elevate his game and unlock his true potential.

MS Dhoni’s Influence Attracted the Ex-Royal to Join the Super Kings

Following months of speculation, Sanju Samson explained that the opportunity to work under MS Dhoni was the decisive factor behind his move to Chennai Super Kings. Growing up, Samson admired the legendary player’s strategic leadership and aggressive style of batting, which further fueled his interest in the sport. He believed joining CSK would help him improve both as a cricketer and a leader while learning from one of the game’s greatest minds.

Besides Chennai, several franchises explored the possibility of signing the Kerala star, with Delhi Capitals reportedly showing the strongest interest. The Capitals were even prepared to part with Tristan Stubbs, willing to trade the dangerous South-African batsman to secure the wicketkeeper-batter’s services, reflecting how highly they valued him. Nevertheless, the right-hander remained firm about joining the yellow army, convinced that Dhoni’s guidance outweighed every other offer, with his decision eventually triggering a separate trade that saw Ravindra Jadeja move to Rajasthan Royals.

Samson also further added to his revelations that leaving his previous team, RR, was a tough decision for him, after representing the side for nearly a decade, but his Rajasthan team-mates’ readiness to play without the key player like him and the right-hander’s friendship with the Super Kings skipper, Ruturaj Gaikwad, made him choose a fresh path.

The experienced batsman amassed 477 runs across 14 innings, registering two magnificent centuries while providing stability at the top order. Every innings reflected greater confidence, composure, and resilience as he embraced the responsibility of representing one of the league’s most successful teams.

Such moments highlighted his all-round growth since arriving at the yellow army camp, reinforcing the belief that the transfer was the right career decision.
