title: CSK Released Players 2025: From Devon Conway to Matheesha Pathirana
content:
The Chennai Super Kings have finally confirmed their 2026 squad overhaul, and the headline is impossible to ignore, Sanju Samson has officially joined CSK in a blockbuster trade that sends Ravindra Jadeja to Rajasthan Royals. This single move alone signals a dramatic shift in CSK’s long-term planning, leadership structure, and batting strategy.

And alongside that trade, CSK have released nine players as part of their reset ahead of IPL 2026. These aren’t speculations anymore, the retention lists are out, and CSK’s decisions are now fully official. After finishing 10th in IPL 2025 and undergoing key structural changes, the franchise has opted for a cleaner, fresher build going into the new cycle.

Below is the complete CSK Released Players 2026 list, with reasons behind each exit and their IPL stats at CSK.

Why CSK Needed a Reset After IPL 2025

The Chennai Super Kings are known for their stability and trust in players, but their 2025 IPL campaign was historically poor. For a team with five IPL titles under MS Dhoni’s captaincy, finishing at the bottom was unthinkable.

Batting failures: Senior Indian batters like Deepak Hooda, Rahul Tripathi, and Vijay Shankar failed to provide consistent middle-order runs.

Overseas letdowns: Big-ticket names such as Rachin Ravindra, Sam Curran and Devon Conway couldn’t deliver match-winning performances.

Bowling struggles: Even Curran, picked for his all-round ability, managed just 1 wicket in 5 matches, leaving a huge gap in the attack.

The combination of poor form, ageing players, and a lack of match-winners pushed CSK to the bottom of the table. That is why the franchise has chosen to release key names and maximise their auction purse before the mini-auction scheduled for December 13–15, 2025 (pending BCCI confirmation).

CSK Released Players 2026 – Full List

The CSK release player list for the upcoming auction might features some surprising yet logical exits. Let’s look at each name and the reasoning behind their departure. Here is a list of players according to Republic World, that might be on their way out:

Deepak Hooda

Hooda was drafted into the CSK squad for middle-order stability, but his returns were dismal. Scoring just 31 runs across 7 games meant he added almost nothing to the scoreboard. In a team struggling for runs, his poor form stood out.

Rahul Tripathi

Known for his aggressive batting in the power play, Tripathi never got going. His 55 runs from 5 innings translated to a weak average of just 11, making him a liability in the top order. With younger options available in the auction, CSK had little reason to retain him.

Vijay Shankar

Shankar had a better season than Hooda and Tripathi, but his contributions were still modest. Scoring just under 20 runs per innings without any match-winning knock, he didn’t provide the balance CSK expected. With no impact as a bowler, he was an easy release.

Sam Curran

Perhaps the biggest name in the CSK released players 2026 list, Sam Curran, never lived up to his price tag. As an overseas all-rounder, he was expected to finish games with the bat and lead with the ball. Instead, his bowling was ineffective, and his batting lacked firepower. Releasing him not only frees up a crucial overseas slot but also boosts CSK’s purse significantly.

Devon Conway

Conway was CSK’s most reliable overseas opener, but his strike rate and consistency were below par compared to expectations. With Ruturaj Gaikwad set as the team’s primary opener, Conway’s role became less vital. Releasing him allows CSK to chase a more explosive overseas batter at the auction.

Vansh Bedi

Vansh Bedi never got his opportunity in yellow. Injured before the season, he was replaced by Urvil Patel, who ended up becoming one of the breakout stars with a strike rate above 200. CSK had a clear choice to make between retaining Bedi or capitalizing on Urvil’s explosive impact. The decision was straightforward, and Bedi’s exit became official.

(No IPL stats at CSK as he didn’t play a game.)

Andre Siddarth

Andre Siddarth was part of CSK’s depth chart but never forced his way into the starting XI. With CSK tightening their bench and focusing on specialists, Siddarth didn’t fit the evolving squad composition. His release opens up a slot for a more defined role player.

(No IPL stats at CSK as he didn’t play a game.)

Rachin Ravindra

The biggest overseas release. Rachin Ravindra showed flashes of brilliance but couldn’t cement a long-term role. His strike rate was decent, but CSK needed consistency and finishing quality from an overseas top-order option. The Samson trade and the shift in batting dynamics made Rachin surplus to plans.

Rachin Ravindra IPL Stats (CSK)

Shaik Rasheed

Shaik Rasheed is a talented player, but CSK couldn’t afford to keep developing projects when they needed ready-made performers. His strike rate remained moderate, and he failed to produce the kind of innings that forces retention. With younger players stepping up elsewhere, Rasheed was released.

Shaik Rasheed IPL Stats (CSK)

Kamlesh Nagarkoti

Kamlesh Nagarkoti was one of CSK’s long-term gamble picks, but injuries and competition kept him out of the XI. He didn’t feature in a single match in 2025. With priorities shifting toward bowlers who offer immediate value, CSK decided to release him.

(No IPL stats at CSK as he didn’t play a game.)

Matheesha Pathirana

This is the shock release and the biggest emotional exit after Jadeja. Pathirana was once considered the future of CSK’s death bowling, but injuries and fluctuating form made his retention complicated. His economy spiked in 2025, and CSK chose to rebuild their attack around new overseas pacers.

Matheesha Pathirana IPL Stats (CSK)

What is the CSK Auction Purse Amount?

Chennai Super Kings will enter the mini auction with a hefty purse. With these releases and Ravichandran Ashwin’s retirement, CSK’s remaining purse currently stands at INR 43.4 crore, expected to grow further after official salary clearances. Add to this, the amount that will be allotted to each team at the start of the auction.

The Impact of the Samson–Jadeja Trade

CSK trading Ravindra Jadeja, a franchise legend, is the boldest call made in years. But in return, they acquired Sanju Samson, one of India’s premier T20 wicket keeper opener and a natural leader with immense middle-order reliability.

This does three things for CSK:

  1. Resets the core around Ruturaj + Samson
     A young-modern leadership pairing shaping the next era.
  2. Solves the top-order vacuum
     CSK desperately needed an opener after Gaikwad pushed himself down at number 3. Along with Aayush Sanju could open and keep wickets if needed.
  3. Frees up auction bandwidth
    Jadeja’s departure allows CSK to restructure their purse and bowling unit. CSK now has a budget of 43 crores.

Why CSK’s Release Strategy Makes Sense

Releasing nine players isn’t a rebuild. it’s a reset. Here’s what CSK gain:

1. Clear, defined roles

No more cluttered middle-order or uncertain bench picks. They are targeting specialists, not “maybe” players.

2. A new overseas direction

Pathirana, Conway and Rachin exiting means CSK want:

  • A new death bowler
  • A power-hitting overseas batter, ideally a top order batter.
  • Possibly an all-rounder with finishing skills

3. Strong Indian batting core

Ruturaj, Dube, Samson, Mhatre, Urvil and Dhoni. That’s a modern, aggressive nucleus.

4. Budget flexibility for high-impact signings

Releasing Curran earlier + the 2026 exit now gives CSK the financial space to target top-tier names.

CSK Retention List ahead of Mini Auction

Now, let’s look at CSK retained players expected to form the core of the squad:

MS Dhoni: While retirement rumours always swirl, Dhoni is likely to continue in the team for at least one more season.

Ruturaj Gaikwad (Captain): The future of CSK’s batting and CSK’s long-term captain.

Ravindra Jadeja: A key all-rounder and match-winner.

Shivam Dube: CSK’s monstrous middle-order hitter will continue for the fifth season.

Matheesa Pathirana: The Sri Lankan pacer remains a crucial death-bowling option.

Khaleel Ahmed: He was one of CSK’s few bowling positives in IPL 2025, picking up 15 wickets in 14 matches with his left-arm pace.

Noor Ahmad: He emerged as CSK’s strike spinner, finishing the season with an impressive 24 wickets in 14 matches, often breaking crucial partnerships.

Other players like Dewald Brevis, Urvil Patel, and Ayush Mhatre, who were bought as mid-season replacements, will undoubtedly be retained as well. This new CSK team will be built around a strong Indian core, with room to add overseas match-winners at the IPL 2026 Auctions.

Implications of the Releases

Releasing five major players signals a squad overhaul strategy. Here’s what it means for the franchise:

Fresh Auction Approach – By clearing underperformers, CSK can aggressively target new overseas all-rounders and explosive batters.

Indian Core Priority – The failures of Hooda, Tripathi, and Shankar highlight the need to invest in younger Indian batters who can carry the team in future seasons.

MS Dhoni’s Role – With Dhoni leading the side in 2025 in Ruturaj’s absence, CSK can balance experience with fresh talent, ensuring the transition phase doesn’t hurt team culture.

Flexible Purse – Curran’s exit alone saves CSK a big chunk of their budget, giving them freedom to bid on marquee players at the auction.

Young Blood in IPL 2025

Amidst CSK’s struggles in IPL 2025, the real silver lining came from the young blood who brought excitement and energy to the squad. Dewald Brevis showed his fearless hitting, scoring 225 runs in 6 matches, including two fifties at a strike rate of 180, with a top score of 57 that electrified the crowd.

Even more impressive was Ayush Mhatre, who announced himself with 240 runs in 7 games, maintaining a strike rate of 190. Meanwhile, Urvil Patel made the most of his limited opportunities, scoring 68 runs in 3 matches at a phenomenal 212.5 strike rate. These youngsters proved CSK’s future remains bright, giving fans thrilling moments despite an otherwise disappointing campaign.

Auction Timeline & Venue

Auction Dates: December 15, 2025

Venue: The auction will take place in Dubai.

Can CSK Bounce Back in IPL 2026?

The big question now is whether these bold calls can help CSK recover from their worst season ever. Historically, CSK have thrived on continuity, but the failures of IPL 2025 forced them to adapt. A mix of young Indian talent, overseas firepower, and Dhoni’s leadership could revive their fortunes.

Fans will also be eager to see how Ruturaj Gaikwad, the CSK captain, uses his influence to shape the CSK new team. With their purse freed up, CSK are well-positioned to be major players at the mini-auction.

Final Word

The CSK released players 2026 list is not just about cutting underperformers; it’s about resetting the team’s DNA. From the high-profile exit of Sam Curran to the steady departure of Devon Conway, CSK are signalling their intent to build a fresher, sharper squad for the future.

With the IPL 2026 Auctions around the corner, all eyes will be on the yellow brigade as they try to rebuild and climb back from their lowest point in IPL history. If they succeed, this release list could be remembered as the turning point that revived the Chennai Super Kings once again.

title: Donovan Ferreira – Player Profile
content:
Donovan Ferreira has rapidly carved out a reputation as one of the most destructive middle-order batters in modern franchise T20 cricket. Known for his six-hitting ability, versatility, and impact in high-pressure scenarios, Ferreira has grown into a vital asset across multiple leagues worldwide.

His association with the Super Kings’ franchise family, both with Joburg Super Kings (JSK) in SA20 and later with the Texas Super Kings (TSK) in Major League Cricket, has been particularly significant. Ferreira’s aggressive batting approach and finishing ability have not only added firepower to these sides but also helped him earn recognition as a player capable of turning matches in a matter of overs.

Personal Details of Donovan Ferreira

  • Full Name: Donovan Ferreira
  • Date of Birth: July 21, 1998
  • Age (as of September 2025): 27 years
  • Birthplace: Pretoria, South Africa
  • Height: 5 ft 11 in (180 cm)
  • Batting Style: Right-hand bat
  • Bowling Style: Right-arm off-spin
  • Role: All-rounder, Wicket-keeper
  • Nationality: South African

Donovan Ferreira Joburg Super Kings stats

One of the most explosive batters in the South African batting line up, Ferreira is also one of the rare players who have played for multiple Super Kings Franchises. His career started with Joburg Super Kings, but with time we got to see his exploits for the Texas Super Kings as well.

As time goes on, the whole of Super Kings’ fraternity will want to see him in action in the Chennai Super Kings team as well.

Ferreira rose to prominence in the SA20 league with Joburg Super Kings. His performances for JSK showcased his ability to anchor the innings in the middle overs and explode towards the death. Known for his fearlessness, he often came in during challenging phases and counter-attacked with calculated aggression. One of his most memorable innings was an 82-run knock in 2023, which underlined his potential to dominate at the highest level of franchise cricket.

Donovan Ferreira JSK Batting Stats (2023–2025)

Over three seasons with JSK, Ferreira’s batting steadily matured. His strike rate consistently stayed well above 130, and his ability to clear boundaries in crunch moments made him a crowd favorite. Even when opportunities with the ball or behind the stumps were limited, he ensured that his primary role as a batting finisher left a mark on the franchise.

These numbers highlight his progression, Ferreira has steadily improved his batting average and strike rate, while also developing a knack for playing match-defining cameos.

Donnovan Ferreira JSK Bowling Stats 

Ferreira, although primarily a wicket keeper, has also shown great skills with the ball in hand as well. What started as a part time stint in the 2023 season, has now turned into a full-time job. The perfect example of it came in the 2025 season when he picked up 8 wickets in 10 games, and bowled with an economy of 5.

Donovan Ferreira Texas Super Kings (TSK)

In 2025, Ferreira extended his Super Kings’ association by joining the Texas Super Kings in Major League Cricket. He was bought in the player’s draft and his impact was immediate and emphatic.

Donovan Ferreira TSK Batting Stats (2025)

Ferreira’s maiden season with Texas Super Kings was nothing short of sensational. In just 9 matches, he piled up 248 runs at an average of 41.33 with a staggering strike rate of 213.79. He struck 20 sixes and 15 fours, often changing the course of games with explosive finishes. His performances in MLC placed him among the top five six-hitters across global franchise leagues in 2025, highlighting his extraordinary power game.

Donovan Ferreira International T20I Stats

Ferreira’s franchise success eventually earned him recognition at the international level. He made his debut for South Africa during the T20I series against Australia in 2023. While he did not play a large number of matches, he impressed with flashes of his raw talent, including a highest score of 48 runs in the series.

In August 2025, Ferreira was named in South Africa’s T20I squad for the tour of England, a significant step toward cementing his place in the national setup. With his franchise record providing strong backing, expectations are high for him to transition smoothly into consistent international performances.

While his international numbers are still modest, Ferreira’s growth trajectory indicates that he has the potential to become a key figure for South Africa in the shorter formats.

title: CSK Released Players 2025 – Who May Exit Before IPL 2026?
content:
The 2025 season was one to forget for Chennai Super Kings, with the team finishing at the bottom of the points table. As fans look ahead to the next edition, the spotlight is on the CSK rebuild IPL 2025 and how the franchise reshapes its squad for a stronger comeback in IPL 2026.

With retention deadlines looming and the mega auction on the horizon, speculation around players released by CSK and auction strategy has already begun. Hence, in this article we will go over who could be the CSK Released Players ahead of the mini auction of 2025.

Who can be CSK released players?

After a disappointing campaign, several underperforming names are expected to be released as CSK recalibrates its squad. Based on form, impact, and team balance, here’s a look at the probable CSK release list 2025:

Rahul Tripathi – There was a lot of buzz around the name of Tripathi when he was bought in the auction. After all, he was the perfect player, fitting the persona that CSK generally targets.

But just after 5 games that saw him score 55 runs, he might already be in the list of players CSK will release ahead of 2025 mini-auction. It’s clear that Tripathi struggled to adapt to CSK’s setup and the limited contributions may see him released.

Vijay Shankar – Another sensational failure of the season for CSK was the acquisition of Shankar. And he too might be on the list of players released by the team ahead of the auctions. His 7 appearances yielded 118 runs with no standout performance. With younger Indian middle-order options available, Shankar is likely to face the axe.

Deepak Hooda – Once one of the prominent players of Indian cricket team, Hooda turned out to be a major disappointment, scoring just 31 runs in 7 games. He failed to provide the middle-order solidity CSK hoped for.

Rachin Ravindra – Despite a promising start to his career in yellow, Ravindra couldn’t cement his place. Hence, looking at his performance from the last season, his name becomes one of the players CSK can release.

In the 8 matches he played in the last season, Rachin managed 191 runs with just one fifty. Given the team’s batting surplus, he could be let go.

Mukesh Choudhary – 2023 was the breakthrough season for Choudhary. He certainly impressed the management, and was retained in 2025. But Injuries and inconsistencies have hampered his impact. Last season he played just 2 games, and picked up only 1 wicket at an economy of 12. With bowling reinforcements needed, his place looks uncertain.

Jamie Overton – In 3 games, Overton scored just 15 runs and bowled without much success. Which might be the reason behind his departure from the five-time champions’ squad. As CSK seeks a proven overseas all-rounder, Overton is certainly not in their plan.

Retained Core: Building Blocks for the Future

Despite the disappointing 2025 season, CSK still has a solid core to build upon. The franchise is known for loyalty and long-term planning, and their strategy for IPL 2026 will likely revolve around these names:

Ruturaj Gaikwad (Batter) – The captain and batting mainstay with 2502 runs in 70 innings, including a highest score of 108. His growth as a leader is central to the rebuild.

Ravindra Jadeja (Allrounder) – A CSK veteran with 254 IPL matches, 3,260 runs at a strike rate of 130.25, and 170 wickets. His all-round value is irreplaceable.

Shivam Dube (Allrounder) – A hard-hitting middle-order batter with 1460 runs for CSK across 4 seasons, striking at over 150. A key match-winner.

Aayush Mhatre– A youngster who impressed with fearless batting in 2025, showing signs of becoming a long-term asset.

Dewald Brevis (Batter) – Signed in 2025, Brevis has 1787 T20 runs with a top score of 162. Though he is yet to produce big IPL numbers, CSK is investing in his potential.

Khaleel Ahmed (Bowler) – A left-arm pacer with consistent spells, including 15 wickets last season, making him a reliable part of CSK’s bowling attack.

Noor Ahmad (Bowler) – A revelation in 2025, bagging 24 wickets last season and thriving in spin-friendly conditions at Chepauk.

Matheesha Pathirana (Bowler) – The Sri Lankan pacer has already picked up 47 wickets in 32 matches, and his slinging action makes him a lethal death-bowling option.

Will MS Dhoni play IPL 2026?

Dhoni’s presence will continue to shape the squad, though his playing role depends on fitness. As he said, a final decision will come in December 2025. If he plays, CSK will have their talisman one last time; if not, his mentorship will remain invaluable. Urvil Patel, too, will be considered based on combinations and squad balance.

Will Devon Conway play for CSK in 2026?

One player fans were concerned about is Devon Conway, who has been a consistent performer for CSK. His overall numbers are impressive: 1081 runs in 28 innings, with 11 half-centuries, a highest score of 92, and a strike rate of 147.4. In IPL 2025, he managed 156 runs in 6 matches, including 2 fifties, showing that he can still be a match-winner. Conway is expected to be persisted with, especially given his experience and ability to anchor innings in big matches.

What can be CSK Auction Strategy for mini auction?

The CSK auction strategy for IPL 2026 will focus on strengthening weak links, particularly in the all-rounder and pace departments. With Overton likely to be released, CSK will eye a world-class overseas pace-bowling all-rounder. Names like Cameron Green and Jason Holder could be high on their radar.

CSK’s blueprint remains the same: a balance of youth and experience, batting depth, spin options, and trusted death bowlers. However, with the mega auction ahead, expect them to be more aggressive than usual in targeting overseas players who can make an immediate impact.

R. Ashwin Retires After IPL 2025

One of the biggest developments in CSK’s 2025 season was the presence of R. Ashwin, who rejoined the franchise for what turned out to be his final IPL campaign. After a poor season, both personally and for the team, Ashwin announced his retirement from the IPL. He stated his desire to explore opportunities in global T20 leagues, marking the end of a remarkable chapter in Indian and CSK cricket history.

Ashwin’s retirement closes the door on one of CSK’s most experienced campaigners. Across his IPL career, he not only delivered with the ball but also served as a tactical asset. His departure means CSK will need to lean even more on Noor Ahmad and Jadeja in the spin department heading into 2026.

What Fans Can Expect in IPL 2026

The 2026 season promises to be a blend of nostalgia and renewal for CSK. Fans can expect:

Dhoni’s decision: Will IPL 2026 be his last season? His December announcement will shape the emotional tone of the season.

Youthful energy: With stars like Brevis, Aayush, and Urvil stepping up, the next generation of Super Kings is ready to shine.

Strategic leadership: With N. Srinivasan back in an advisory role and Ruturaj maturing as captain, CSK will enter the season with renewed focus.

Auction surprises: The hunt for a marquee all-rounder could redefine CSK’s balance.

CSK’s future in auction

The CSK rebuild IPL 2025 is more than just a tactical reshuffle—it’s about setting the stage for a new era while still honouring the legacy of Dhoni and the veterans who defined the franchise. With underperformers like Ravindra, Hooda, and Overton likely to be released, and with a solid young core backed by the likes of Ruturaj, Jadeja, Dube, and Pathirana, CSK’s plans for IPL 2026 look promising.

Whether it’s Dhoni’s final season, the closing of Ashwin’s chapter, or the emergence of the next generation, fans can rest assured that the Super Kings will leave no stone unturned in their quest to bounce back. IPL 2026 isn’t just another season—it could be the beginning of CSK’s next golden chapter.

title: MS Dhoni IPL 2026 – Will CSK Icon Play His Final Season?
content:
The biggest storyline heading into the next edition of the Indian Premier League is centred around one man: MS Dhoni IPL 2026. The Chennai Super Kings (CSK) icon has kept fans guessing about whether he will play one more season or finally hang up his boots.

For over a decade, Dhoni has been synonymous with CSK, guiding them to multiple titles and shaping their identity as one of the most successful franchises in IPL history.

With his latest remarks, CSK’s rebuild after a dismal 2025 season, and N. Srinivasan’s return to the helm of the franchise, the road to IPL 2026 promises both excitement and uncertainty.

Will MS Dhoni play in IPL 2026?

MS Dhoni has never been one to rush his decisions, and his stance on IPL 2026 is no different. Recently, he addressed the question of his future by saying, “I don’t know whether I’ll play or not. I have some time until December, so I’ll take another couple of months, and then finally, I can make my decision.” This statement perfectly captures the suspense that surrounds his career.

While joking about his persistent knee pain, Dhoni made it clear that the ultimate decision will depend on his fitness. Fans across the cricketing world are clinging to hope, especially since he also teased, “I will always be seen in a yellow jersey. I am not saying I am done, not saying I am coming back.” These cryptic words highlight the deep bond he shares with CSK but also underline the uncertainty about his playing role.

MS Dhoni in IPL 2025: A Modest Season

The 2025 season was one of CSK’s toughest campaigns in recent history, and Dhoni’s performance reflected both his strengths and limitations. Over 14 matches, he scored 196 runs from 12 innings, striking at 135, with 12 fours and 12 sixes. His highest score was an unbeaten 30 off 26 balls, showing glimpses of his old finishing touch but also exposing the challenge of batting lower down the order with limited opportunities.

Criticism followed regarding his batting position and pace, but his value extended far beyond numbers. Dhoni’s calm presence, ability to marshal resources, and mentorship of younger players remained a priceless asset for CSK. Even in a disappointing season where CSK finished bottom of the table, his leadership qualities continued to define the spirit of the team.

CSK’s 2025 Struggles and the Road to IPL 2026

For a franchise built on consistency, the 2025 campaign was a wake-up call. CSK’s failure to qualify and their bottom-place finish was a bitter pill for fans. However, the management has already shifted focus to IPL 2026, conducting extensive player trials and evaluating long-term strategies.

One thing remains central in this rebuild: the uncertainty of Dhoni’s role. Whether as a player, mentor, or behind-the-scenes strategist, his influence is non-negotiable. His decision in December 2025 will shape not only CSK’s squad composition but also the emotional energy of their fan base.

N. Srinivasan’s Return: A Game-Changer for CSK

Perhaps the most significant off-field development for CSK is the return of N. Srinivasan as chairman of Chennai Super Kings Cricket Limited (CSKCL), the parent company of the franchise. At 80 years old, Srinivasan has taken on an advisory role, avoiding extensive travel but staying deeply connected to CSK’s daily operations. His re-entry is viewed as a stabilising force after the turbulent 2025 season.

Srinivasan’s role stretches beyond IPL. He oversees CSK’s international franchises, including ventures in SA20 and Major League Cricket, ensuring the franchise’s influence extends globally. Importantly, he works in close collaboration with his daughter Rupa Gurunath, a full-time director, and CEO Kasi Viswanathan.

Crucially, Srinivasan maintains regular contact with Dhoni. Given the long-standing bond between the two, his return could heavily influence Dhoni’s decision about playing in IPL 2026. For fans, Srinivasan’s presence is reassuring, signalling that the franchise will be guided by an experienced cricket administrator who has been instrumental in CSK’s rise over the years.

Dhoni CSK Captaincy Legacy: Always an Impact

Whether or not IPL 2026 becomes MS Dhoni’s last season, there is no denying his legacy. Dhoni transformed CSK into a powerhouse, winning multiple championships and making the franchise one of the most admired in the world. His calm demeanour, sharp cricketing brain, and ability to back players at the right moments have been the hallmark of his captaincy.

Even in recent years, when he passed the captaincy to Ruturaj Gaikwad, Dhoni continued to play the role of a guiding force. His ability to motivate the younger brigade, mentor bowlers in crunch moments, and manage pressure situations ensured CSK remained competitive even when results didn’t go their way.

The Rise of CSK’s Young Brigade

While Dhoni’s future dominates headlines, the emergence of CSK’s next generation offers hope. Despite the struggles in 2025, bright sparks were visible:

  1. Ruturaj Gaikwad: The young captain continues to grow into leadership, balancing the burden of captaincy with consistent batting performances.
  2. Dewald Brevis: The South African starlet displayed flashes of brilliance, making him one of the most exciting prospects for the franchise. Coming in as a replacement for Gurjapneet, Brevis scored 225 runs in 6 matches.
  3. Urvil Patel: Provided quick runs in key moments, showing potential as a reliable top-order batter. Played only three matches and smashed at a strike rate of over 210. Can keep wickets as well.
  4. Aayush: Shined with his fearless approach, proving that CSK’s scouting eye remains sharp. Scored 240 runs for CSK in seven matches at a strike rate of nearly 200.

This youthful core is expected to form the backbone of CSK’s rebuild. With Dhoni’s mentorship and Srinivasan’s strategic backing, the franchise hopes to bounce back strongly in IPL 2026.

What Can Fans Expect in IPL 2026?

As things stand, CSK fans are caught between nostalgia and anticipation. On one hand, there is hope that MS Dhoni’s IPL 2026 becomes the grand farewell season, allowing fans to see him in action one last time. On the other hand, there’s growing excitement about the new generation of CSK players who are ready to step into the spotlight.

With Srinivasan CSK leadership in place, the franchise is expected to prioritise squad rebuilding, bringing in fresh energy while retaining the ethos that CSK is known for: loyalty, consistency, and strategic stability. Dhoni’s eventual role will only add to this mix, whether as a player finishing his career on the field or as a mentor shaping the next chapter of the Super Kings’ journey.

An Exciting Season Awaits

The buildup to IPL 2026 is unlike any other. Fans are waiting for Dhoni’s December decision, speculating whether this will indeed be MS Dhoni’s last season. His presence, either in the playing XI or as a mentor, remains the most compelling story in IPL 2026 CSK news. Meanwhile, the return of N. Srinivasan provides leadership stability, while Ruturaj Gaikwad and the young brigade are gearing up to take CSK into a new era.

No matter the role, Dhoni’s impact on CSK is eternal. As the franchise prepares for a fresh chapter, one thing is certain: CSK without Dhoni on the field may eventually happen, but CSK without Dhoni’s influence will never exist. IPL 2026, whether it marks his farewell or another twist in his legendary career, promises to be one of the most exciting seasons yet for the Chennai Super Kings and their millions of fans worldwide.

title: CSK Players in Irani Cup 2025: Ruturaj Gaikwad, Khaleel Ahmed, Rasheed & Kamboj in Action
content:
The Irani Cup is just around the corner. The premium Indian domestic cup match will feature the winner of the Ranji Trophy from the last season, Vidarbha and the Rest of India team.

While the one-off match is a spectacle on its own, the fans of Chennai Super Kings have an added incentive, as it features some of the biggest names from our favourite franchise.

CSK players in Irani Cup

This year’s Rest of India team will feature the likes of Shaik Rasheed, Anshul Kamboj, Khaleel Ahmed, and our captain, Ruturaj Gaikwad. Our beloved Gaikwad is also named as the vice-captain of the squad.

Both Gaikwad and Khaleel are coming off a great performance in the Duleep Trophy, which concluded recently. Gaikwad smashed a great hundred in the semi-final against Central Zone.

Ruturaj Gaikwad named Vice Captain of ROI

Gaikwad’s knock of 184 runs was the standout of the first inning for the West Zone as he not only saved his team from a tricky situation but also took them to a respectable total of 438 runs. In return, Central Zone scored 600 runs, eventually qualifying for the final.

However, this turned out to be a crucial knock by our captain on his return to professional cricket. Gaikwad was suffering from an injury he sustained in the IPL earlier this year. Following which, he missed the India A tour and even the County stint he was offered.

Last season Gaikwad featured in just 3 games for his Ranji side, but managed to score 330 runs from 5 innings, at an amazing average of 66.

Khaleel Ahmed the experienced pacer

Khaleel Ahmed is one of the seniormost bowlers in the ROI squad. He picked up 16 wickets in the previous Ranji season, from just 4 games. Furthermore, he also had 4 wickets in the recently concluded Duleep Trophy, where he represented Central Zone.

The player will be looking to continue the decent start he has had to the season and convert it into something more tangible than what it already has been.

Anshul Kamboj the swing maestro

Anshul Kamboj was a find of the season last year. The pace bowler featured in 6 games in which he managed to pick 34 wickets at an average of 13.7. His best figures for the season were 10/49 against the eventual finalist Kerala.

Kamboj then went to make his debut for India as well, in the test series against England. Although it was not at all a great outing for the young bowler, he will be expected to continue his domestic performance in the Irani Cup game.

Shaik Rasheed the Dark Horse

Last but not least is Shaik Rasheed, who had a fantastic season with the bat in the last Ranji Trophy season. Playing for Andhra Pradesh, he scored a massive 627 runs from just 12 innings, at an average of 52.

With so many CSK players featuring in the upcoming Irani Cup Final, it will be interesting to see how the Vidarbha team shapes up and who eventually emerges as the champion.

title: Jadeja Vice Captain: Ravindra Jadeja Named India’s Test Team Deputy vs West Indies
content:
The Indian cricket team announced the 15-man squad for the upcoming series against West Indies, and Ravindra Jadeja was named in the leadership roles alongside Shubman Gill.

According to the squad list shared by the Board of Control of Cricket in India, Ravindra Jadeja will be the vice-captain of the Indian cricket team. This will be the first time he has been seen in this role in the longest format, although he has previously fulfilled it in other formats.

Vice Captaincy for Jadeja

Jadeja has already announced his retirement from the shortest format of the game. However, he still plays a crucial role in both the ODI and Test matches. And he proved his importance during the recent tour of England.

In the recent outing in the UK, Jadeja emerged as one of the most important players for the team. And was very much a part of the force that brought England to their knees, helping India secure a 2-2 draw, after going 2-1 down.

In the 10 innings that Jadeja played in England, he managed to score 516 runs, at an extraordinary average of 86. This saw him emerge as the fourth-highest run scorer of the inning, behind Gill, Rahul, and Root.

This move by the team management shows that they are looking at Jadeja as a player who will be a part of the team for the next WTC cycle as well as the upcoming 2027 ODI World Cup.

Jadeja in recent times

Jadeja made his debut for the Indian team in 2009 in an ODI against Sri Lanka. Fast forward 16 years, and he has emerged as one of the most important players in the history of this team, at least the new generation.

Jadeja has played in a total of 204 ODIs, in which he has scored 3284 runs at an average of 32. While in Tests has represented the team in 85 games and scored 3886 runs.

What’s really fascinating is the fact that Jadeja has scored 2000 test runs in the last 5 years alone. He has been a beast with the bat in hand, but his bowling has not been very far behind.

In fact, he became the first player to score 2000 runs and take 100 wickets in the World Test Championship. This is the very reason behind his reign as one of the longest number 1 ranked Test All-rounder.

It will be interesting to see how Jadeja operates in the familiar territory at home. He was a beast, alongside Ashwin, for the best part of the last decade. But will he be able to continue with the same ferocity?

title: Mithun Manhas BCCI President: From CSK Batter to Indian Cricket’s New Leader
content:
Former middle-order batter of Chennai Super Kings, Mithun Manhas, is all set to be elected as the new BCCI President. However, this leaves many people with the question of who Mithun Manhas really is. And how did he become the BCCI president?

So, here is the story of Mithun Manhas as a player and in administrative roles as well.

Who is Mithun Manhas?

Manhas is an Indian cricketer with immense talent. He has played for Delhi and Jammu and Kashmir in the domestic circuit. Manhas has played 157 FC games and 130 List A matches for both teams.

In First-Class cricket, he scored 9714 runs at an average of 45 and with a similar average, he scored 4126 runs in List A as well. He was a contemporary of players like Rahul Dravid and Sourav Ganguly, among others. As a result, one can simply conclude that he didn’t go on to make it big because he was born in the wrong era.

Mithun Manhas: Administrative Roles and Ideology

Following the conclusion of his playing career, Manhas took up a role in the coaching and administrative field. In recent years, he was part of the coaching staff of RCB and Gujarat Titans.

However, a few years ago, he was appointed as the administrator of the Jammu and Kashmir Cricket Association (JKCA). Prior to that, he was the convener of the North Zone for the Duleep Trophy.

When it comes to sporting ideology, Manhas is very clear in his mind. According to Sportstar, the player wants to ensure that every young player gets the right and “absolute support” for the respective field in which they want to make their career.

Even former Indian Cricket Atul Wassan rallied Manhas’ cause, “It is in continuation of the BCCI’s policy now to have a player at the helm of the board. Mithun’s cricket and his administrative acumen are known to everybody, and I hope he will continue to contribute to the game with his ideas. He did good work in Jammu and Kashmir, and I hope he will do good for the players,” Wassan said, reports Sportstar.

Mithun Manhas’ IPL stats

In 2008, he made his IPL debut for the Delhi Capitals, then moved to the Pune Warriors India, and later joined our beloved Chennai Super Kings in 2014.

Originally, he was considered a replacement for Badrinath, whom we couldn’t buy that year. However, the move didn’t turn out to be the best for both parties.

Coming off consecutive seasons as winners, CSK was under a lot of pressure to perform well, and that pressure seems to have gotten to Manhas. The player only got to bat in 5 out of the 12 games he played in, but failed to make an impact.

Throughout the season, Manhas was only able to score 35 runs from 23 balls at a strike rate of 152. Eventually, that season also turned out to be his last as a player.

 From Player to President

Mithun Manhas’ journey reflects resilience and evolution—from a dependable domestic run-machine to a short IPL stint with CSK, and now a respected administrator. His election as BCCI President marks a new chapter where his cricketing insight and administrative vision can shape Indian cricket’s future, especially for the next generation of players.

title: CSK Trial Camp 2025: Chennai Super Kings Begin IPL
content:
A dismal season saw Chennai Super Kings end up at the bottom of the IPL table for the first time. And being the champion team, they are, what do they do? Decide to return stronger than ever with a better mini-auction strategy.

Yes, the five-time IPL champions have started their preparation for the upcoming auction by organising a trial camp at the High Performance Centre, which is located on the outskirts of Chennai.

CSK Trial Camp 2025

According to a report by The Indian Express, the camp is said to have 40-50 players who are closely monitored by the team’s head coach, Stephen Fleming. Joining him is the fielding coach, Rajiv Kumar. And even former captain MS Dhoni is said to have been involved closely.

Last season was certainly a jolt for the Chennai Super Kings. It was not just that they failed to qualify for the playoffs for two consecutive seasons, but also finished at the bottom of the table. This certainly called for some shakeup within the ranks and even the system.

The management seems to have complete faith in the coaching staff, as they have delivered consistently over the years; hence, the axe falls on the players. It is safe to say that the Mega Auction was not fruitful for the franchise, as the marquee players they secured just failed hopelessly.

Therefore, ever since the trade window opened, CSK has been in the news. Earlier, they were linked with Sanju Samson’s transfer, which Rajasthan Royals declined, as the all-cash deal fell through.

Chennai Super Kings is a team that backs experience over young talent. However, that theory of theirs was shattered last season when seasoned campaigners like Hooda, Tripathi, Shankar, and even Ashwin failed.

What was the agenda of the CSK trial?

On the other hand, the franchise saw the rise of young talent in the form of Mhatre, Brevis, and Urvil Patel, among others. This is a clear sign that the franchise is going to be eyeing more young players coming through the T20-tournament circuit from around the country.

From the type of players that were called to the trial, it is clear that the team is looking to bolster the batting attack. Although the report provided no accurate number, most of the players are said to be bowlers.

This means that the CSK management is happy with the bowling unit. Maybe there will be a few changes, but barring that, it will be the same as the previous season.

What’s really fascinating about these trails is the presence of Stephen Fleming. This indicates that the franchise is serious about bringing about change in the upcoming mini auction; hence, it will be interesting to see how the squad shapes up for the next season.

Chennai Super Kings is a team that is known to bounce back after setbacks. Hence, this CSK trial camp is certainly the start of the comeback that our team is known for.

Hopefully, we will find the right combination before the next season and win the 6th IPL title as well.

title: Kieron Pollard Names MS Dhoni the Best Captain of All Time
content:
Whenever we hear the names MS Dhoni and Kieron Pollard, the iconic IPL rivalry between MI and CSK from the 2010s comes to the forefront. These players were always at each other’s throats, trying to win the game for their team.

But beyond the playing field, they have equal and mutual respect for one another. There are numerous occasions on which MS Dhoni has called Pollard one of the most destructive batters.

This time, it was Pollard’s turn to return the favour, and he did it by calling MS Dhoni the best captain of all time. This revelation came during an interview with News 24, when he was asked about who the best skipper is, according to him.

For someone like Pollard, who had played in several franchises, all around the world, it would have been easier to pick any other name. But the big Caribbean chose the name of one player his fans would have expected the least: MS Dhoni.

“Oo, best cricket captain. I’ve never played alongside him, but I’ve seen some of his tactics on the cricket field, and I really enjoyed MS Dhoni. I’ve really enjoyed it. I really enjoyed his captaincy from afar, playing against him, being in the middle, seeing his tactics and stuff like that. I’ve enjoyed that. So, I’ll say, for me, MS Dhoni,” Pollard answered.

Looking back at the Dhoni-Pollard Rivalry

Only true CSK fans will know that there was only one wicket CSK wanted more than anybody’s on that MI lineup, in a chase, and that was of Kieron Pollard.

MS Dhoni, the master of the stumps, always had his aces out front to outfox the brute force that Pollard was. And call them great field placements, or just mind games, they always seemed to work.

As a result, in the 23 innings that Pollard has played against CSK, he has managed to score 583 runs at an average of 36 and a strike rate of 171.9. But he has also been dismissed 16 times, and that’s what MS Dhoni was a master of.

There are ample instances on the internet where we have seen MS Dhoni and Pollard getting involved in banter. Once our Thala ran 2 runs after Pollard faked fielding.

Then there are other instances where we see a very different kind of field set for the MI finisher. As a result, he always lost his wicket, either playing a wrong shot or by getting outplayed by the CSK team.

MS Dhoni, as a batter, enjoyed a lot against Pollard. Despite having played a handful of balls, he has smashed 10 fours and 6 sixes against the Windies powerhouse, batting with a strike rate of 196.

A Rivalry of Respect: Dhoni vs Pollard in the IPL

Looking back, the Dhoni–Pollard rivalry stands as one of the IPL’s most entertaining storylines. Every clash between CSK and MI carried that extra spark when these two giants faced off—Dhoni’s sharp tactics versus Pollard’s brute force.

What made it special was not just the on-field battles but the mutual respect they carried off it. From clever field placements to game-changing dismissals, from banter to big hits, fans witnessed the perfect mix of intensity and admiration.

In hindsight, this rivalry wasn’t just about wickets and runs—it was about two legends pushing each other to their best, creating moments etched forever in IPL history.

title: Top 5 Players to Watch from Joburg Super Kings in 2025
content:
In cricket, there’s always a debate about whether bowlers win you tournaments or whether batters set the tone. But in the end, teams thrive only when their match winners step up in crunch moments. For us, the Joburg Super Kings Top Players 2025 are not just names on a squad list. They are the heartbeat of the franchise, the anchors of our batting order, the destroyers with the ball, and the glue that holds it all together.

This year, the JSK key players bring something different. They bring depth, experience, and the spark to become top performers in SA20. Every single one of them is capable of being the kind of star players who can turn a match on its head in a matter of overs. Here are the five match winners you cannot take your eyes off this season.

#1: Nandre Burger – The Local Spearhead

If you want to talk about hunger and fight, you talk about Nandre Burger. His time at JSK has been a rollercoaster.

  • In SA20 2023, he played 5 matches, managing only 2 wickets at a painful average of 76.50 while going for 9 runs an over.
  • In SA20 2024 he came back strong with 11 wickets in 11 matches, best figures of 3/26, and kept his economy under 8.

That is the definition of growth. That is what makes Burger one of the Joburg Super Kings Top Players 2025.

At the auction, JSK spent R6.3 million to bring him back. His overall T20 record stands at 78 matches and 88 wickets. A left-arm pacer with steep bounce at the Wanderers is gold in this league. Burger is not just part of the squad. He is one of our true match winners, and in 2025, he will be trusted to lead the pace attack.

#2: James Vince – The Glue at the Top

Consistency has a name, and that name is James Vince. Signed as a pre-auction pick, he is built for the role of providing reliability at the top.

His numbers are elite: 452 matches, 12,591 runs, 80 fifties, 7 centuries, strike rate 136. Few batters in the world can match his record of being calm in powerplays, rotating strike with ease, and then stepping up to accelerate when the game demands it.

For JSK, Vince is one of the most important JSK key players. He allows Faf du Plessis to play with freedom, and together they can be one of the most dangerous opening pairs in SA20 2025. Vince is not flashy. He is a builder, a stabiliser, the man who ensures our innings has a foundation. When paired with the aggression of Rossouw or the power of Ferreira down the order, Vince’s role becomes priceless.

This is why he is among the Joburg Super Kings Top Players 2025. He is not just an opener. He is the glue that keeps the innings together.

#3: Wiaan Mulder – The All-Round Engine

When JSK spent R9 million on Wiaan Mulder, it was a message to the league. It was us saying that we wanted an engine room player, a man who could do everything.

Mulder has played 129 T20 matches, scoring 2,181 runs at a strike rate of 133, with 12 half-centuries, while also taking 67 wickets with the ball. That is not just balance. That is world-class all-round value.

At just 27, Mulder has already become a mainstay for South Africa across formats. His recent triple century in Test cricket shows his skill, but his T20 numbers show his impact. For us, he will likely bat at number 4. If the top order collapses, he steadies. If the team needs acceleration, he has the shots. And with the ball, his medium pace cutters and slower ones are perfect for Joburg conditions.

Mulder is a complete package. In a list of star players, he is not just a name. He is one of our prime match winners.

#4: Prenelan Subrayen – The Versatile Spinner

Not every player gets the hype, but every great team has that one who quietly makes things click. For JSK, that is Prenelan Subrayen.

At 31 years old, Subrayen has played 120 T20s, taken 110 wickets, and scored 492 runs at a strike rate above 120. His numbers demonstrate why he is one of the Joburg Super Kings’ Top Players in 2025.

He is predominantly a bowling all-rounder, but his value goes beyond just wickets. He brings balance to the team. He can bowl in the powerplay with control, squeeze runs in the middle overs, and hit valuable runs when the team is under pressure. In a squad filled with flashy names, Subrayen is the one who provides versatility.

He may not always be on the posters, but make no mistake, he is a true JSK key player and could easily turn out to be one of our most underrated match winners this season.

#5: Rilee Rossouw – The Explosive Southpaw

Some batters build innings. Some destroy them. Rilee Rossouw belongs in the second category.

His numbers are outrageous: 385 T20 matches, 9,434 runs, 53 fifties, 9 centuries, strike rate 144. He is one of the finest left-handers in world T20 cricket.

Rossouw’s role in JSK is simple. Come in at 3 or 4 and take the game away from the opposition. His fearless strokeplay against both pace and spin makes him a nightmare for bowlers. His experience across global leagues ensures that he is never rattled by conditions or pressure.

For us, Rossouw is not just one of the Joburg Super Kings’ Top Players 2025. He is one of our designated destroyers, one of our headline star players, and a guaranteed crowd-puller at the Bullring. He has the ability to win games single-handedly, which makes him one of our most reliable match winners.

JSK Players to Watch Out For

The JSK squad has some of the most exciting young players. These players have made a mark in the youth ranks and have earned a call up to the senior cricket, and expectations from them will be to continue playing at the top of their potential.

Dian Forrester – The Run Machine in Waiting

At 25, Forrester has already made his mark in first-class cricket. In the shorter format, he has played 11 T20S, scoring 266 runs at a strike rate of nearly 130. Not eye-popping yet, but the signs are there. He rotates strike, he builds, and when needed, he clears the boundary.

What makes Forrester exciting is the chance to learn from senior pros like Faf and Rossouw. Surrounded by such experience, his ceiling is high. He is not yet among the JSK key players, but he is a future name to watch closely.

Steve Stolk – The Teenage Blaster

Only 19, but already a talking point. Stolk has been a standout under-19 player for South Africa, particularly in youth ODIs, showcasing his power-hitting skills. While he is yet to make a mark in T20 cricket, his potential is massive.

Stolk represents the future of JSK. He may not be one of the Joburg Super Kings Top Players 2025 yet, but his presence adds depth, excitement, and hope. With the right backing, he could soon graduate from youngster to one of our true star players.

Conclusion

The Joburg Super Kings Top Players 2025 are not just carrying our hopes. They are carrying the promise of something bigger. Burger’s pace, Vince’s calm, Mulder’s balance, Subrayen’s versatility, and Rossouw’s explosiveness form the core of a squad that finally feels ready to challenge for the SA20 title.

These are the JSK key players who can go toe to toe with anyone in the league. They are the names who can become the SA20 top performers of the season. They are our proven star players, and they are the ones who will decide whether we just participate or truly dominate.

And behind them, the next generation waits. Forrester, Stolk, and others remind us that this is not just about today. This is about tomorrow, too.

In 2025, when the dust settles and the trophy is lifted, it will be because our match winners stood up. And if you ask me, this time, the roar of the Joburg Super Kings will echo the loudest.

title: JSK Batting Lineup 2025-2026: Full Players List & Detailed Analysis
content:
It is said that bowlers win you championships, but batters set the stage for that. For years, the Joburg Super Kings have relied on their bowlers to pull them out of tight corners, but in T20 cricket, you need your batting firepower to show up just as much.

This season, the JSK Batting Lineup 2025 feels different; deeper, smarter, and built for modern T20 chaos. Led by the veteran Faf du Plessis, the Super Kings’ charm is back in full swing, and this time, the JSK batsmen look ready to put on a show. With new signings, retained stalwarts, and exciting youngsters, JSK’s batting strategy has never looked sharper heading into SA20 Season 4.

Who are the players in JSK Batters List?

The JSK Batters List for SA20 2025-26 features a blend of experience and youth. Key names include Faf du Plessis, James Vince, Rivaldo Moonsamy, Rilee Rossouw, Brandon King, and youngster Steve Stolk. Together, they offer stability at the top, power in the middle, and fearless finishing options.

1. Faf du Plessis (Retained)

du Plessis is not just the captaion of the team, he is also leader, the anchor, and sometimes the aggressor of JSK batting line up. Across his career, Faf has scored 11,906 T20 runs with 83 fifties and 8 centuries at a strike rate of 137.

For JSK, his role is bigger than just scoring runs; he sets the tone. And when he bats like he did for Texas Super Kings in MLC, striking at over 150, you know the intent will be there from ball one.

2. James Vince (Retained)

The globe-trotting T20 opener. Vince has played 452 matches, scoring 12,591 runs with 80 fifties and 7 hundreds, all at a strike rate of 136. He’s consistent, technically sound, and brings stability. With Vince opening alongside Faf, JSK finally look like they’ve found their reliable opening partner.

3. Donovan Ferreira (Retained)

Donovan Ferreira is our finisher and x-factor. In 121 T20s, Ferreira has scored 2,233 runs at a strike rate of 170, including 10 fifties. He’s the ideal modern T20 wicketkeeper-batter; aggressive, fearless, and capable of clearing boundaries at will, adding much required flavour to JSK batting line up 2025-2026. If he doesn’t keep wickets, it frees him to bowl a few overs of off-spin, making him even more valuable.

4. Rivaldo Moonsamy

In 50 T20s, Moonsamy has made 968 runs at a strike rate of 120. While not explosive yet, he provides depth and is a backup option at the top. His domestic experience could become valuable if injuries strike or rotation is needed.

5. Rilee Rossouw

Rilee Rossouw will act as a powerhouse in the middle order of the JSK batting line up. In 385 T20s, Rossouw has smashed 9,434 runs at a strike rate of 144, including 53 fifties and 9 centuries.

His aggression against both pace and spin makes him one of the most versatile T20 batters. Expect him to be the aggressor in JSK’s batting strategy, taking on bowlers from the get-go.

6. Brandon King

Top-order gold, King is one of those JSK batters, who will be relied upon to stablise the inning when required. With 3,938 runs in 173 matches, including 25 fifties and 2 centuries at a strike rate of 134, King is a perfect modern T20 batter. If included, he’ll likely slot in at number 3, rotating strike and dominating spinners in the middle overs. His ability to accelerate at will gives JSK flexibility.

7. Steve Stolk

At just 19, there isn’t much of a statistical sample for Stolk. But what excites the management is his fearless batting approach. He represents the future of JSK batting, a youngster who can swing hard without fear.

8. Neil Timmers

The backup keeper. While he may not start regularly, his presence ensures JSK are covered for every scenario.

Who are the All rounders in JSK Squad 2025-2026?

Joburg Super Kings (JSK) have built a balanced core with three key all-rounders for the 2025-26 season. These players bring batting depth, bowling options, and stability across formats.

1. Wiaan Mulder

The most expensive buy in the auction, and worth every cent. In 129 T20s, Mulder has scored 2,181 runs at a strike rate of 133, including 12 half-centuries. His ability to bat in the top 5 and also contribute overs makes him a central figure. Mulder will likely play at number 4, a role that allows him to anchor or attack depending on the situation.

2. Shubham Ranjane

From Texas Super Kings to Joburg, Ranjane brings composure. In 48 matches, he’s scored 654 runs, often calming the storm in the middle order. He’s not flashy, but he’s reliable, and in T20 cricket, having a calm head is invaluable.

3. Dian Forrester

Still raw, but in 11 T20s, Forrester has scored 266 runs at a strike rate near 130. He’s a natural striker of the ball and could slot into the lower-middle order if JSK need finishing firepower.

Detailed Analysis of JSK batting

Top Order Analysis

For years, JSK struggled to find a consistent partner for Faf. We tried du Plooy, Conway, and others, but none clicked long-term. With Vince retained, we finally have stability. Vince allows Faf to play with freedom, just like he did in MLC, where he struck at over 150. That means fireworks from ball one, setting the tone for the innings.

If Brandon King features, he’ll likely bat at number 3, bringing rotation and control against spinners while keeping the scoreboard ticking. Rossouw at 4 will be the aggressor, stepping in to dominate bowlers with his range of strokes. Together, this top order analysis shows balance: two anchors (Faf, Vince), one pacifier (King), and one aggressor (Rossouw).

Middle Order & Finishers

Mulder at 4 or 5 gives us a calm all-rounder who can switch gears as required. Given that he is a great tempo as a player, it won’t take him long to understand the pulse of the game and deliver.

Ferreira, one cannot describe his batting prowess in just one sentence. He is our designated finisher, striking at 170, making him one of the most dangerous lower-middle order batsmen in SA20.

Ranjane and Forrester offer backup and firepower. Ranjane has proven his mettle in the MLC and Forrester has done the same in South Africa youth games, to expect some great aggressive batting in the lower order of JSK batting line up as well.

What could be the right batting order for JSK?

The JSK batting plan should be built on adaptability. In crucial matches of the past, our batting has deserted us. Chases that looked gettable suddenly became impossible, and defending low totals became the storyline of our seasons.

But this time, the management has built a squad like the Avengers; an army of specialists, finishers, and versatile strikers. It feels almost impossible to fail when you look at the sheer depth and variety of the JSK Batting Lineup 2025. If ever there was a season to rewrite history, this is the one.

  • Early Overs: Faf + Vince to maximise powerplay.
  • Middle Overs: King for rotation, Rossouw for aggression.
  • Late Overs: Mulder, Ferreira, Subrayen and Hossain to finish with fireworks.

By mixing these stabilisers with aggressors, JSK can avoid collapses that haunted us in the past. Add in Subrayen, Hosein, and Mulder as all-rounders, and the depth stretches all the way to number 8.

Backups and Flexibility

The likes of Moonsamy, Timmers, Stolk, and Forrester ensure we’re never short of options. And with 2-3 genuine all-rounders in the side (Mulder, Subrayen, Hosein, Ferreira), we have the flexibility to shuffle batting roles based on matchups. That’s intelligent squad building; something JSK lacked in earlier seasons.

Can JSK make it big?

The JSK Batting Lineup 2025 isn’t just names on paper; it’s a strategy come alive. Anchors like Vince and Faf, aggressors like Rossouw and Ferreira, and stabilisers like King and Ranjane give us every kind of batter a modern T20 team needs. Add in Mulder’s all-round brilliance and the young blood in Stolk and Forrester, and suddenly this looks like a batting order that can set up wins rather than just survive.

For the first time in years, the JSK batsmen look balanced, versatile, and dangerous. With the altitude of Joburg, six-hitting conditions, and a clear SA20 batting strategy, don’t be surprised if we see record totals at the Bullring this season. This isn’t the old JSK batting unit haunted by collapses. This is a lineup built to dominate.

title: Joburg Super Kings Bowling Attack 2026: Can They Dominate SA20 League?
content:
The Joburg Super Kings Bowling Attack 2026 has the potential to be one of the most balanced and dangerous units in the SA20 League. With a mix of international experience, local talent, quality spin options, and genuine pace, JSK have assembled a bowling lineup capable of dominating every phase of a T20 innings.

Led by proven performers such as Akeal Hosein, Imran Tahir, Nandre Burger, Richard Gleeson, and Reece Topley, the Joburg Super Kings bowlers bring variety, wicket-taking ability, and tactical flexibility. As SA20 Season 4 approaches, the biggest question is whether this attack can establish itself as the best bowling unit in the tournament.

The JSK Bowling Core – Who Do We Have?

JSK bowlers bring the perfect mix of pace and spin, youth and experience. From Burger’s raw speed to Tahir’s timeless craft, this attack has the firepower and control to dominate across all phases of a match.

Here’s the updated table with Richard Gleeson’s T20 stats included:

Akeal Hosein JSK spinner (Retained, Left-arm Orthodox)

Hosein has become a franchise regular for a reason. Across 240 T20 matches, he has taken an impressive 223 wickets, showing why he is trusted in leagues worldwide and will be seen as the leader of the spinner’s unit.

His left-arm orthodox spin gives us control in the powerplay overs, and his ability to tie down even the most explosive batters is priceless. At the Wanderers, his angles will be crucial to offset the small boundaries.

Richard Gleeson (Retained, Right-arm Fast)

Every team needs a wicket-taking enforcer, and Richard Gleeson is ours. His ability to hit the deck hard, bowl yorkers at the death, and surprise batters with sharp bouncers makes him a vital cog. With experience in England’s Blast and The Hundred, Gleeson thrives on pressure.

Nandre Burger (Left-arm Fast)

Our blockbuster signing, and for good reason, Nandre Burger will certainly be the leader of the bowling attack. He has already played 78 T20s and taken 88 wickets, proving himself as one of South Africa’s brightest fast-bowling talents.

With raw pace and bounce, he can dismantle batting line-ups in the power play. Raised on Johannesburg’s West Rand, Burger is literally bowling in his own backyard when he charges in at the Bullring. That home advantage cannot be overstated.

Imran Tahir Joburg Super Kings (Leg-spin)

The ageless wonder. Imran Tahir has featured in 442 T20s, picking up a colossal 563 wickets at an economy of just under 7. But beyond the numbers, it’s his energy; those iconic wicket-taking sprints that make him special. At 46, he still outfoxes batters with his googlies and quicker ones, and his leadership in the spin department makes him indispensable.

Reece Topley JSK bowling attack (Left-arm Fast)

At 201 T20s and 240 wickets, Reece Topley is an absolute steal at his price. His height and left-arm angle create problems, especially under lights when the new ball swings. Partnering Burger, he gives us a devastating left-arm pace attack option that very few SA20 sides can match.

Janco Smit (Right-arm Fast)

The youngster in our squad, Smit, offers depth and hunger. A right-arm fast bowler who can slot in when needed, he gives us a local option to rotate our bowling unit without losing intensity.

The All-Rounders Who Add Depth

If the batters are somehow going to survive the pure bowling wrath of JSK bowlers, we will enter the all rounders. These are players who can contribute with both bat and ball, and are more than capable of winning the games for JSK.

Prenalen Subrayen (Off-spinner)

Subrayen has quietly become one of South Africa’s most consistent spinners. With 110 wickets in 120 T20s, he brings control and variation. More than just a bowler, his ability to contribute quick runs with a strike rate over 120 adds depth to the lower order.

Wiaan Mulder (Medium-pace)

Our crown jewel at the auction and one of the most expensive player for JSK, Mulder has played 129 T20 matches, taking 67 wickets with his deceptive medium pace. His cutters and slower balls are effective on South African pitches, and his batting makes him a dual threat. Mulder isn’t just a bowler; he’s a complete package who gives the captain flexibility in multiple phases.

Shubham Ranjane (Medium-pace, USA All-rounder)

Having represented Texas Super Kings in Major League Cricket, Ranjane joins us as a backup option who can chip in with both bat and ball. He might not feature every game, but his presence ensures depth and squad competition.

Understanding the Picks – Analysis of JSK’s Bowling Strategy

The Joburg Super Kings Bowling 2026 roster isn’t an accident; it’s a carefully designed puzzle.

  • Variety in pace attack: With Burger, Topley, Gleeson, and Mulder, we cover all ends of the fast-bowling spectrum; express pace, swing, hit-the-deck, and change-ups.
  • Spin trio: Hosein, Tahir, and Subrayen give us leg-spin, orthodox spin, and off-spin; full coverage for matchups.
  • Balance: The inclusion of all-rounders like Mulder and Subrayen means we don’t compromise batting depth for bowling strength.

The plan is simple: dominate every phase of the innings, from powerplay to death overs.

Who can make it in JSK final team?

Likely Core XI

  • Openers: Faf du Plessis, James Vince
  • Middle Order: Rilee Rossouw, Donovan Ferreira
  • All-rounders/Spin: Wiaan Mulder, Prenalen Subrayen, Akheal Hosein. 
  • Bowlers: Imran Tahir, Nandre Burger, Richard Gleeson.
  • Flex Spot: Either Brandon King (for batting) or Reece Topley (for bowling)

The Overseas Equation

Only four overseas players allowed; this complicates things:

  • If we pick Brandon King, we get more batting power at the top, while relying on Mulder, Hosein, and Subrayen to share overs.
  • If we pick Reece Topley, our pace attack becomes the most intimidating in SA20: Burger, Topley, and Gleeson, backed by spinners Hosein and Tahir.

No matter which way we go, it’s a good headache to have.

Strengths and Weaknesses of Joburg Super Kings Bowling 2026

Strengths

  • Variety: No overlap in skillsets.
  • South African Core: Burger, Subrayen, and Mulder give local flavour and conditions know-how.
  • Spin Depth: Tahir’s wickets + Hosein’s control + Subrayen’s flexibility = a deadly trio.
  • Death Overs: Gleeson’s pace and Topley’s yorkers make us equipped for crunch overs.

Weaknesses

  • Injury Concerns: Topley and Gleeson have had long injury histories.
  • Age Factor: Tahir’s age means we must manage his workload carefully.
  • Death Overs Pressure: If Burger and Gleeson leak runs, backup options are limited.

JSK bowlers performance at Bullring

Bowling in South Africa is both a blessing and a challenge.

  • General Conditions: Fast, bouncy pitches assist seamers. Spinners must rely on guile rather than turn.
  • The Wanderers (Bullring): High altitude, small boundaries, and quick outfield; paradise for batters, nightmare for bowlers. But bounce also helps seamers like Burger and Topley, while Tahir’s drift can exploit batters going for big swings.

Our JSK bowlers are built for this; Burger and Gleeson to rattle top orders, Hosein to strangle in middle overs, and Tahir to strike when batters attack.

Can JSK Be the SA20’s Best Bowling Unit?

On paper, absolutely. Compare us with other SA20 squads, and few can match the depth we bring:

  • Pace Attack: Burger’s bounce, Topley’s swing, Gleeson’s aggression, and Mulder’s smarts.
  • Spinners: Tahir, Hosein, and Subrayen cover every angle.
  • Backups: Smit and Ranjane ensure we’re never short of options.

We may not have one superstar like Rabada, but our strength lies in variety and balance. That’s what makes the Joburg Super Kings Bowling 2025 unit a contender for the SA20 best bowling unit title.

T20 cricket is all about moments. One magic over can change a game, and one disciplined bowling unit can change a season. With Burger’s bounce, Topley’s swing, Hosein’s control, Tahir’s guile, and Mulder’s all-round utility, we’ve assembled the most balanced attack in our franchise history.

The Joburg Super Kings Bowling 2026 isn’t just about defending scores; it’s about dictating terms. With this depth, variety, and firepower, we’re not just competing. We’re aiming to dominate.

This year, the Bullring won’t just echo with sixes. It’ll roar with wickets too.

title: Joburg Super Kings Most Expensive Players 2025: Top Auction Buys & Full JSK Squad
content:
Comebacks. We aren’t new to this. As Joburg Super Kings, we’ve always embraced the highs and the lows, and each season we come back hungrier, stronger, and more determined. The JSK most expensive player list is proof that we’re adapting to the modern rhythm of T20 cricket; power-hitters, versatile all-rounders, and bowlers who can change games in the blink of an eye.

In the JSK auction 2025 top players section, our management went bold yet calculated. We didn’t just spend on names; we spent on match-winners. Our squad now reflects a perfect blend of youth and experience, local core and overseas spark, all aimed at making this season our best yet in the SA20 highest-paid players conversation.

Joburg Super Kings most expensive players 2025

Ahead of SA20 Season 4, Joburg Super Kings made bold moves at the 2025 auction, securing JSK highest paid players like Wiaan Mulder and Nandre Burger. Backed by proven match-winners, these signings redefine the squad’s firepower and balance.

Wiaan Mulder – R9 million

Bought from the clutches of Durban Super Giants, Wiaan Mulder emerges as JSK’s most expensive player, in the 2025 SA20 auction.

Wiaan Mulder was the all rounder was a hot commodity at the auction and everyone wanted to have him on the their team. As a result, what followed next was a fierce battle between teams to receive his services. Mulder was snapped up for a massive R9 million, making him the third-most expensive player overall. And rightly so.

Mulder has played 129 T20S, scoring 2181 runs at a strike rate of 133, including 12 half-centuries. With the ball, he has claimed 67 wickets, making him a genuine two-in-one package. But what makes him priceless is his rise in international cricket. Recently, he smashed a rare triple century in Test cricket, underlining his adaptability across formats.

For us, Mulder isn’t just a player; he’s the all-round engine. He can bat in the middle order, finish games, or swing the new ball. Expect him to be in the thick of action every match.

Nandre Burger – R6.3 million

Soon after acquiring Mulder, JSK was out for hunt again. This time the target was a former player in the form of Nandre Burger. And once his name showed up, JSK’s baton seldom came down, for they wanted the player at all cost.

As a result, Nandre Burger became one of the highest paid player for JSK. When we went all out for left-arm pacer, at R6.3 million, it wasn’t just about pace, it was about Joburg’s identity. Raised on Johannesburg’s West Rand, Burger is a local lad who has great potential to become headlines our attack.

Burger has featured in 78 T20s and taken 88 wickets, consistently clocking high pace. His left-arm angle, bounce, and aggression make him lethal, especially in the power play. Over the past year, he’s earned international recognition as South Africa’s spearhead; the kind of bowler batters fear.

We believe in backing homegrown firepower, and Burger is our weapon of choice. With him steaming in, expect fireworks at the Wanderers.

Daniel Worrall – R1.5 Million

Joburg Super Kings secured a major asset in Daniel Worrall at the SA20 auction, one of their biggest signings ahead of Season 4. The Australian-English seamer has already proven his worth in the league, with 17 wickets in just 11 SA20 matches, showcasing his swing, seam, and precision under pressure.

Known for his ability to strike early with the new ball and maintain control in the middle overs, Worrall brings both consistency and leadership to the attack. With over a decade of experience, County Championship success, and a reputation for reliability, he’s set to be a game-changer for JSK.

Prenalan Subrayen – R1 million

Not every million is equal. For R1 million, Prenalan Subrayen is a steal. A bowling all-rounder who adds subtlety and craft to our attack, Subrayen is tailor-made for SA20 pitches.

In 120 T20 matches, Subrayen has taken 110 wickets while maintaining a strong economy. But don’t sleep on his batting; he’s chipped in with 492 runs at a strike rate above 120, showing he can swing the willow when needed.

For us, Subrayen is the kind of pick that strengthens balance. He can start with the new ball, strangle opponents in the middle overs, and if required, provide late-order runs. A true utility man.

Reece Topley – R1 million

In the dying embers of the auction, our team was able to add another name to the list of JSK’s most expensive players. This time it was int he form of another pace bowler: Reece Topley.

You don’t often get international giants at this price. But Reece Topley at R1 million is one of those classic auction steals. A towering left-arm pacer with experience across leagues, Topley is our X-factor.

He has played 201 T20s, bagging a massive 240 wickets. His speciality? Swinging the new ball and bowling in clutch death overs. With his height, he extracts bounce even on flat decks, troubling batters across formats.

Topley’s signing complements Burger perfectly. One bends it in, the other hurries you with sheer pace. Together, they’re set to terrorise opening pairs.

Imran Tahir – R600,000

A classic Super Kings’ trope is getting players with ample of experience and Imran Tahir is certainly one of those player. And guess what, with his price tag, he is easily one of the highest paid JSK players for this season.

What do you call a man with 442 T20 matches and 563 wickets? A legend. What do you call him when he’s still at it at 46 years old? Timeless.

Imran Tahir, with his unmissable celebrations, is back in yellow for just R600,000. His economy of 6.98 is remarkable in a format dominated by big hitters. Tahir thrives in pressure moments, where his googlies and flippers outfox even the best.

For us, Tahir is not just about numbers. He’s an entertainer, a leader in the spin department, and a mentor for our younger bowlers. Watching him sprint across the field after a wicket will never get old.

Rilee Rossouw – R500,000

Explosion in the middle overs? That’s why we brought in Rilee Rossouw at R500,000. The 35-year-old is still one of the most feared T20 batters worldwide.

In 385 T20s, Rossouw has smashed 9434 runs at a blistering strike rate of 144. His numbers include 53 fifties and 9 centuries, proving he’s capable of both consistency and fireworks.

Rossouw’s role in our squad is clear: come in, take charge, and change gears instantly. Whether it’s chasing down a stiff target or setting one up, he’s the accelerator we’ve always wanted.

Other Notable Picks for JSK

Of course, auctions aren’t just about the big buys. Some names might not have carried massive price tags, but will play important roles this season.

  • Brandon King (R200,000): The West Indies opener adds dynamism at the top. Known for fearless stroke play, he can set the tempo early.
  • Shubham Ranjane (R200,000): A USA-based all-rounder who has already played for Texas Super Kings in MLC. His dual skills make him an exciting prospect for us in SA20.

These players may not headline as Joburg Super Kings’ expensive players 2025, but their impact could be massive in shaping matches.

JSK’s Auction Plan for 2025

We’ve invested smartly; that’s been the mantra. Instead of stacking up one-dimensional batters, our focus this year was to recruit hitters who can win us games under pressure and all-rounders who can give us flexibility. The fast-changing environment of cricket demands it, and we’ve shown that we’re ahead of the curve.

With Faf du Plessis leading from the front, and experienced names like James Vince, Akeal Hosein, Donovan Ferreira, and Richard Gleeson retained before the auction, we built the spine of our team. Around this core, we went all out for some of the most expensive players in the Joburg Super Kings squad this year, balancing big-ticket buys with bargain legends and promising youngsters.

Conclusion

The Joburg Super Kings’ most expensive players 2025 list reflects ambition and strategy. From investing big in Wiaan Mulder and Nandre Burger to securing experienced stars like Tahir, Topley, and Rossouw at bargain rates, we’ve put together a squad built to win. Add in smart picks like Subrayen, King, and Ranjane, and this feels like the most balanced JSK squad yet.

We’ve been close before, reaching the playoffs consistently, but this year feels different. This year, with the JSK auction 2025 top players on our side, the roar is louder, the intent is clearer, and the belief is stronger. The Wanderers will be our fortress, and with this line-up, we’re ready to finally bring home the SA20 trophy.
