title: Ambati Rayudu Talks About CSK on Shubankar Mishra Podcast
content:
Ambati Rayudu is in the news again. This time, people are talking about an open conversation he had with journalist Shubankar Mishra on a podcast. He spoke about his time in the IPL with both the Mumbai Indians and Chennai Super Kings.

He talked about his all-time favourite team, guessed who might be in the finals in the future and talked about the claims that he favours CSK.

Ambati Rayudu’s on being part of CSK and MI

Rayudu has always been a player who works hard and makes a difference. During the podcast, he remembered winning championships with both the Mumbai Indians and the Chennai Super Kings.

Only a few IPL players have done that. Winning with MI was special, he said. But CSK was different. It felt like being at home. He said that both experiences helped him grow, but he felt more connected to the yellow jersey.

CSK is Home – A Loyalty That’s Real

When asked if he liked MI or CSK better, Rayudu immediately said, CSK will always be home. It’s not just that he likes MS Dhoni. It’s that he feels like he belongs to a team that accepted him, even near the end of his career.

Claims of Favouring CSK: Rayudu Responds

Because of his love for the team, people have been watching him closely. Since he started commenting on matches, some have said that he favours CSK, especially when he’s talking about the games live.

They say he talks about his old team too much. Rayudu answered strongly on social media: “I was a Thala fan. I am a Thala fan. I will always be a Thala fan. He believes that loyalty is something to be proud of, not something to hide.

He further emphasised this point by mentioning the 2023 IPL winning moment, in which Dhoni called him and Jadeja to lift the trophy. It is moments like these that Rayudu admires about the CSK captain, and reestablish his faith in the one and only Thala.

All-Time MI-CSK XI: Important Players

Rayudu also had some fun picking his all-time CSK-MI team. He picked himself as the impact player along with other great players like Dhoni, Rohit, Bumrah, Malinga, and Jadeja. It was more about respect than stats.

The team features a strong batting lineup with Sachin Tendulkar, Rohit Sharma, Suresh Raina, Suryakumar Yadav, and Kieron Pollard, followed by MS Dhoni, Ravindra Jadeja, and Dwayne Bravo in the middle order. The bowling attack comprises Lasith Malinga, Jasprit Bumrah, and Harbhajan Singh.

Looking Ahead: IPL 2026 Predictions

Talking about the coming editions of the IPL, he said that MI, RCB, CSK and KKR will be the top four teams in IPL 2026, with MI winning. This reminded everyone that even though he loves and favours CSK, he still has good judgment.

Ambati Rayudu is the most emotional player in the IPL. He played for different teams, but he played with his heart. He was at home in yellow. He will be remembered for his wins, his reactions to criticism, his team picks and his honest answers.

title: Ruturaj Gaikwad Takes Wicket in Buchi Babu Opener for Maharashtra
content:
Ruturaj Gaikwad takes a wicket in the opening encounter of the Buchi Babu tournament, while representing Maharashtra in the game against Chhattisgarh.

Every CSK fan is aware of how good the player is with the ball in hand. On occasions, we have also seen him keep the wicket for his domestic side in the white ball formats. However, Ruturaj Gaikwad’s bowling and picking wickets were not something that we had expected to see anytime soon.

Watch: Gaikwad takes wicket in Buchi Babu tournament

The event took place on Monday, when Gaikwad was bowling against the 11th numbered batter of the opposition, namely Sourabh Majumdar. Delivering a simple off-spinner, the CSK captain looped the ball for the tailender to have a swipe at.

Sourabh took the bait and went for the big shot, only for the ball to balloon in the air and the direction of Gaikwad. The skipper made no mistake in grabbing one of the simplest catches.

Gaikwad finished the inning with the figures of 1 wicket from 3 balls, in which he also conceded 7 runs. A ball before the dismissal, he ws smashed down the ground for a maximum by the same batter. So, it is safe to say that Ruturaj had a great comeback.

Ruturaj Gaikwas bowling stats

Sadly, this wicket will not count in his domestic tally as Buchi Babu is an invitational pre-season tournament. Hence, the runs scored here or the wickets taken are not officially counted in the first-class tally of the players.

Overall, Ruturaj Gaikwad, the bowler, has bowled around 28 overs in domestic cricket and is yet to claim a scalp. This wicket will certainly motivate him to bowl further, if his team requires the same in the upcoming domestic tournaments.

In all, Maharashtra had a great outing against Chhattisgarh in the first game of the invitational tournament. Their bowlers, Vicky Ostwal and Hitesh Walunj, fired when they needed them to land timely blows.

Sanjeev Desai, with his 93, and Avnish Dhaliwai, with his 52, put together an 84-run partnership for the third wicket, but apart from that, there was not much resistance from the batters as the side was bundled for a score of 252 runs. They played 89.3 overs to get to the total.

Tomorrow, Ruturaj Gaikwad will once again be in action as he will open the batting for his side beside Prithvi Shaw. Both batters will be looking to get some runs under their belt before heading into the Duleep Trophy, where they will be representing the West Zone.

title: Dewald Brevis CSK Signing Sparks Controversy: Ashwin’s Claim & CSK’s Official Clarification
content:
The Chennai Super Kings (CSK) have found themselves at the centre of an unusual debate in IPL 2025, not over on-field performances but regarding the Dewald Brevis CSK signing they made mid-season.

The young South African batter was brought in as a mid-season replacement, but recent comments from R Ashwin sparked speculation that the deal had skirted tournament rules. To quell the controversy, CSK issued a formal clarification insisting that Brevis’ signing was fully compliant with IPL regulations.

Ashwin’s Remark on Brevis’ signing

The conversation ignited when R Ashwin, speaking on his YouTube channel, suggested that CSK might have signed Brevis for a sum higher than the permitted fee. According to Ashwin, Brevis’ market value and bargaining power could have influenced the process.

Ashwin pointed out that other franchises were also in touch with the 21-year-old but eventually backed out, hinting that his camp demanded more than the listed base price. He speculated that Brevis and his representatives may have told CSK: “I’ll need the extra money, because if I play this season, my value in the next auction will go higher.”

Ashwin’s framing of the situation suggested that CSK had perhaps agreed to pay a premium, an action that would have directly breached IPL’s rulebook. His remarks quickly gained traction across social media, fueling a debate about how player replacements are handled behind the scenes and whether star potential sometimes bends the regulations.

CSK offers Clarification

CSK wasted little time in issuing a statement that sought to shut down all speculation. The franchise categorically stated that Dewald Brevis was signed in April 2025 for INR 2.2 crore, the exact same figure as Gurjapneet Singh, the pacer he replaced after injury.

The franchise pointed to Clause 6.6 of the IPL Player Regulations 2025–27, which governs replacement signings. Under this clause, no replacement can be contracted for a fee higher than the injured player’s auction price. CSK stressed that it had followed this procedure to the letter and that Brevis’ contract was fully consistent with the league’s financial and administrative rules.

Moreover, CSK highlighted the IPL’s own media advisory from April 18, 2025, which had publicly confirmed the signing on these exact terms. The franchise argued that this advisory should put the matter to rest, as it serves as the official record of compliance approved by the governing body itself.

The franchise also reminded critics that replacement contracts are pro-rated, meaning the player’s pay is automatically reduced to reflect the games missed before their signing. By law, Brevis could not have received more than the permitted maximum, even if there had been private negotiations beforehand.

Why Brevis Matters to CSK

Beyond the financial debate lies a cricketing truth: Dewald Brevis is not just another mid-season signing; he is a game-changer with long-term potential. Nicknamed ‘Baby AB’ for his stroke-making resemblance to AB de Villiers, Brevis has already shown CSK fans why he’s worth the hype.

After joining the squad, he made an immediate impact, smashing 225 runs in just 6 innings, including two fifties, at a strike rate of 180; numbers that underline his ability to turn matches in a flash.

His rise hasn’t been limited to the IPL. Following Heinrich Klaasen’s retirement, Brevis has quickly slotted into South Africa’s middle order, where he recently announced himself on the international stage with a brilliant century and a half-century against Australia in a high-profile bilateral series. That combination of IPL explosiveness and international pedigree makes him one of the most exciting young batters in the world today.

For CSK, his signing also signalled intent. Rather than replacing Gurjapneet Singh with another pacer, the franchise chose to shore up its batting arsenal, showing they view Brevis not as a stopgap but as a long-term investment. With legends like MS Dhoni nearing the final stretch of their careers, Brevis represents the future: an explosive young player who can anchor their batting core for years to come.

For Brevis himself, CSK is more than a contract; it’s a platform. The exposure of playing under one of the IPL’s most tactically sharp setups boosts both his development and his market value ahead of the next mega auction.

The Brevis–CSK signing controversy may have been sparked by speculation and amplified by a high-profile player like Ashwin, but Chennai’s clarification leaves little room for ambiguity. The rules are clear: a replacement player cannot earn more than the one he replaces, and CSK insists it has followed that regulation to the letter.

While the debate sheds light on the murky perceptions of how IPL negotiations work, the focus now shifts back to the field, where Brevis’ talent, and not the chatter around his signing, will determine how memorable this chapter truly becomes for both him and CSK.

title: Why Joburg Super Kings Could Win SA20 2025?
content:
For the past three seasons of SA20, Joburg Super Kings have been one of the most consistent teams in the tournament. Yet despite reaching the playoffs every single year, the trophy has remained just out of reach. Fans have seen heartbreak after heartbreak, especially in knockout games where JSK looked close but failed to finish the job.

Now, heading into SA20 2025, things look different.

The squad appears stronger, the team balance is better, and the franchise has finally addressed the major weaknesses that hurt them in previous seasons. Many cricket experts already believe the chances of Joburg Super Kingss Win in SA20 2025 are higher than ever before.

This is not just fan hype. It is based on squad depth, experienced leadership, smart retentions, and lessons learned from three difficult seasons.

Three Seasons of Near Misses

Since the launch of SA20, JSK have consistently been among the strongest teams in the competition.

In the inaugural 2023 season, they finished second in the points table under the captaincy of Faf du Plessis. The team played fearless cricket and reached the semi-finals, but their chase against Sunrisers Eastern Cape ended in disappointment.

The 2024 season followed a similar story. JSK again reached the playoffs but struggled with inconsistency during crucial moments. Their batting lineup collapsed under pressure, and once again SEC ended their title hopes.

Even in 2025, the playoff curse continued as they failed to cross the line in another knockout match. Three straight playoff appearances without a final appearance clearly show that JSK have always been competitive but lacked the final push required to become champions.

Looking Back: Three Seasons of Close Calls

In their debut SA20 season in 2023, JSK announced themselves as genuine contenders. Under the captaincy of Faf du Plessis, they finished second in the group stage and powered into the semi-finals. But chasing 215 against Sunrisers Eastern Cape, they fell just 14 runs short. It was a heartbreak, but the kind that builds belief.

The following year, 2024, was a bumpier ride. Inconsistent performances saw them finish fourth, yet they still managed to reach Qualifier 2. Once again, the SEC stood in their way, and once again, a chase of 215 proved too much. This time it ended in a collapse for 142.

By 2025, fans were desperate to see the playoff curse broken. JSK entered the Eliminator against SEC, but the pattern continued. Chasing 185, they fell 32 runs short. Three years, three playoffs, zero finals.

Why has JSK not won SA 20?

As we saw earlier, Joburg has been phenomenal in all their previous three seasons. They have always performed well, but in bunches. There are a strings of good results and often followed by losses. This is often exposes JSK strength as well as weaknesses to the opponents.

For all their fight, JSK have carried two major flaws in their team form over the last three seasons. And they have broken their back time and again. Let’s take a look at what makes JSK falter:

Lack of Consistency at the Top

Apart from Faf du Plessis, the batting lineup has lacked stability in the power play. Openers and top-order batters have been rotated frequently, and no one has consistently supported Faf in building strong starts. This over-reliance on the captain has put pressure on the middle order and made chases trickier.

JSK’s powerplay problem is clear. Faf du Plessis: 894 runs in 31 inns, SR 142.8, eight fifty-plus. That is 28.6% of all JSK runs here. Opening partners churned in 2025: Conway 272 (SR 113.8), Bairstow 232 (SR 134.1), Lubbe 75 (SR 100).

Together 579 in 26 innings; none crossed 300 or SR 140. Others tried up top offered little: Moeen 184 (avg 18.4), Makhanya 118 (avg 14.8). du Plooy 743 (avg 39.1) anchors later, not the powerplay. This over-reliance on Faf strains the middle and complicates chases. JSK strength is Faf; consistency around him is missing. Across three SA20 seasons.

Bowling Issues Hurt JSK in Key Matches

Another major issue for JSK was the inconsistency in their bowling attack.

Unlike other successful Super Kings franchises around the world, Joburg constantly changed bowlers instead of building a settled core. While the pace attack produced moments of brilliance, the overall bowling unit lacked stability.

Fast bowlers like Gerald Coetzee and GC Viljoen performed well, but the team depended too heavily on them for breakthroughs.

The spin department also struggled to consistently dominate the middle overs. Although veterans like Imran Tahir controlled the economy rate, wicket-taking support was often missing.

Important bowling numbers from previous seasons include:

  • Gerald Coetzee – 19 wickets
  • GC Viljoen – 14 wickets
  • Seam trio contributed 44% of total wickets
  • Several bowlers leaked runs at the death overs

These bowling concerns often became the difference between winning and losing tight matches.

Smart Retentions Changed Everything

The biggest reason analysts now believe in Joburg Super Kingss Win possibilities is because of the franchise’s smart retention strategy for SA20 2025.

Instead of rebuilding the entire squad, JSK focused on strengthening their core.

The franchise retained players who fit perfectly into their system while adding experience and balance.

Key Players Retained for SA20 2025

Faf du Plessis:

The captain remains the backbone of the side. His leadership and batting experience are priceless in pressure situations.

James Vince

A world-class T20 batter who brings stability at the top. Vince can reduce the pressure on Faf and allow the batting lineup to play more freely.

Akeal Hosein

One of the best T20 spinners in modern cricket. Hosein offers control, wickets, and lower-order batting depth.

Richard Gleeson

An experienced pace bowler capable of delivering during both powerplay and death overs.

Donovan Ferreira

A powerful finisher who can completely change games in the final overs.

These retentions finally give JSK a more balanced squad heading into SA20 2025.

Strong Super Kings Chemistry

One underrated reason behind the growing Joburg Super Kingss Win predictions is the connection between Super Kings franchises around the world.

Several JSK players also represent Texas Super Kings in Major League Cricket.

This existing chemistry between players like Faf du Plessis, Akeal Hosein, and Donovan Ferreira can become a major advantage in SA20.

When players already understand each other’s game, communication becomes easier, partnerships improve naturally, and pressure situations are handled better. In short tournaments like SA20, team chemistry often becomes the deciding factor.

HWhy SA20 2025 Feels Different for JSK

There are three major reasons why this season feels different for Joburg:

1. Better Squad Balance

For the first time, JSK have genuine depth in both batting and bowling.

2. Defined Player Roles

Players now clearly understand their responsibilities within the team setup.

3. Playoff Experience

After three straight playoff appearances, the squad now understands knockout pressure far better than before.

These improvements significantly increase the probability of Joburg Super Kingss Win in SA20 2025.

Faf du Plessis Remains the X-Factor

No discussion about JSK can happen without mentioning Faf du Plessis.

Even at 41 years old, he remains one of the smartest captains in franchise cricket. His fitness, calmness, and tactical awareness continue to inspire the squad.

More importantly, Faf understands the Super Kings culture better than anyone. His ability to back players during difficult moments could be the difference between another playoff exit and a championship-winning campaign.

If Faf performs consistently again, the dream of Joburg Super Kingss Win may finally become reality.

Key Matches to Watch

To truly be considered title contenders, JSK must set the tone early in the season. Here is where the difference can be made:

  1. Opening Fixtures – A strong start can boost confidence and reduce the pressure later in the season. Vince’s early form will be crucial here.
  2. Clashes Against SEC – With SEC having been their playoff nemesis, these matches will carry extra weight. Breaking that psychological barrier will be huge.
  3. Death Overs Execution – Matches decided in the final three overs have hurt JSK before. Gleeson and Hosein’s execution under pressure will be key.

The Captain’s Role

No discussion of JSK leadership is complete without highlighting Faf du Plessis. At 41, he remains one of the fittest and most tactically astute captains in T20 cricket. His ability to stay calm, read match situations, and back his players is a big part of why JSK have made the playoffs every year.

This season, with the pressure to deliver a trophy, Faf’s role will go beyond just strategy. He will need to manage player workloads, make brave calls in crunch moments, and ensure that the new-look core delivers from day one.

Why 2025 Feels Different

If you strip it down to the essentials, winning the SA20 comes down to three things: a balanced squad, role clarity, and big-match temperament.

  • Balanced Squad – For the first time, JSK have both batting and bowling depth without compromising one for the other.
  • Role Clarity – Retentions and targeted picks mean players know exactly what is expected of them.
  • Big-Match Temperament – With playoff experience under their belt, this squad knows how to navigate pressure situations.

Add to that the shared Super Kings DNA, and you have a recipe for a side that is not just participating, but actively gunning for the title.

Final Prediction: Can Joburg Super Kings Win SA20 2025?

The answer is yes — absolutely.

Joburg Super Kings already proved over the last three seasons that they are one of the most competitive teams in SA20. The only thing missing was consistency during crunch moments.

Now, with:

  • A stronger top order
  • Better bowling balance
  • Experienced finishers
  • Strong franchise chemistry
  • Playoff experience
  • Faf du Plessis leadership

JSK finally look like genuine title favourites.

The road will not be easy because SA20 remains one of the toughest T20 leagues in the world. But if the squad stays fit and performs collectively, there is every reason to believe that Joburg Super Kingss Win could become one of the biggest cricket stories of SA20 2025.

After three years of knocking on the door, this might finally be the season where Joburg Super Kings become champions.

title: Jay Jani, Viral MS Dhoni Fan from IPL 2024, Dies in Tragic Tractor Mishap
content:
Jay Jani, a huge MS Dhoni fan, has died in a tractor accident. He was famous for running onto the field during the 2024 IPL at Narendra Modi Stadium to touch Dhoni’s feet.

Jay Jani From Viral Fame to Tragedy

According to Gujarat First, Jani was driving his tractor to his farm when it overturned. Jani was from Rabarika village in Bhavnagar, Gujarat. He had 18,000 followers on Instagram and 13,000 subscribers on his YouTube channel, Dhoni Ashiq Official.

The video of him meeting Dhoni went viral, and he became a favourite among Dhoni fans all over. His channel had Dhoni tributes, match reactions and other cricket content. Since his death, many have condoled him online.

Dhoni’s Uncertain IPL Future

Dhoni last played in the 2025 IPL. Chennai Super Kings (CSK) retained him as an uncapped player for ₹4 crore under the new rules. He took over as captain mid-season when Ruturaj Gaikwad was injured.

But CSK didn’t do well, finishing last with just four wins in 14 matches. Despite the team’s poor performance, Dhoni scored 196 runs in 13 innings with a strike rate of 135.17. It was nice to have Dhoni back as captain, but he couldn’t stop what was one of the team’s worst seasons.

MS Dhoni hasn’t said yet if he will play in the next IPL. He will decide in December after thinking for a couple of months. At 44, he is still a big name in the league. Dhoni has played the most IPL matches, 278, and scored 5,439 runs. He also has a great record as a wicketkeeper, 201 dismissals.

In a recent interview, MS Dhoni said, I don’t know whether I’ll play or not. I have time to decide. I have some time until December, so I’ll take another couple of months and then I’ll decide.

title: Captain of Joburg Super Kings: Leadership in SA20 League 2025
content:
When you talk about leadership in the SA20, the Joburg Super Kings Captain 2025, Faf du Plessis, stands out as the most influential figure in the competition. For three consecutive seasons, his JSK leadership has guided the team into the playoffs, combining tactical intelligence with match-winning performances.

Loved by fans and respected across the cricket world, Faf du Plessis, the captain, is more than a title; it is the heartbeat of the franchise. His journey from IPL stalwart to the face of Johannesburg’s SA20 side is a story of loyalty, consistency, and an unrelenting hunger for the championship that has so far eluded the team.

The Franchise Boy Who Became the Captain

The Joburg Super Kings’ rise in the SA20 and Faf’s journey have been intertwined since the team’s debut in 2023. As the SA20 team captain, he has been the driving force behind a culture of belief, discipline, and resilience. Under his leadership, JSK has made the playoffs every single season, a testament to both his strategic thinking and his ability to inspire those around him.

Faf is no stranger to the Super Kings’ legacy. He was a key figure at Chennai Super Kings in the IPL before moving to Royal Challengers Bangalore as captain after the 2022 mega auction. In 2025, he represented the Delhi Capitals in the IPL, but his connection to the Super Kings Teams stayed strong. That loyalty extends beyond South Africa, as he also leads the Texas Super Kings in Major League Cricket.

The Batter: Consistency and Class

For JSK, Faf du Plessis, the captain, is not just about field placements and tactical calls; it is also about leading from the front with the bat. In 33 matches, he has scored 894 runs at a strike rate of 143 and an average of 33.11, including 7 fifties and 1 century. This makes him the highest run scorer in JSK history and the fifth-highest in SA20 history.

His ability to adapt to match situations is one of his biggest strengths. Whether setting the tone with quick runs in the power play or anchoring the innings in tense chases, Faf remains reliable. In the high-scoring environment of the Wanderers, he has been both a crowd-pleaser and a consistent run accumulator.

Unmatched Impact: Faf Du Plessis’ Leadership

Faf’s impact on Joburg Super Kings goes far beyond numbers and match results. With over a decade of international cricket and experience in multiple global T20 leagues, he brings a rare combination of tactical depth and situational awareness. His leadership style blends empathy with authority, ensuring players feel trusted yet accountable.

Young talents thrive under his guidance, benefiting from his insights on preparation, shot selection, and handling high-pressure scenarios. As a seasoned SA20 team captain, he has developed a blueprint for success that balances aggression with calculated risk-taking.

His experience in different conditions, from the fast-paced IPL to the evolving MLC, allows him to adapt strategies on the fly. For JSK, Faf is both the anchor and the spark, a captain who steadies the ship in storms and ignites belief when the odds are stacked against them.

Faf du Plessis Captaincy Record with JSK

In a league where captaincy changes are frequent, JSK leadership under Faf has been a model of stability. His captaincy record speaks volumes:

How many matches has JSK won under Faf

Faf du Plessis is the heartbeat of Joburg Super Kings, and the numbers back up what JSK fans feel every season. Since the franchise’s first ball in 2023, he has captained every single match: 34 games, with 14 wins, 16 losses and 3 no-results, a 41.17% win rate.

Most importantly, Faf has taken JSK to the business end every year—playoffs in 2023, 2024 and 2025 (semi-finalists in year one, fourth in the group but through in year two, and qualified again in 2025). For a young franchise, that’s a solid floor set by one leader.

Runs Scored by Faf du Plessis as JSK Captain

With the bat, Faf du Plessis has been far more than just a leader in name—he’s been a consistent run machine for Joburg Super Kings. Across 33 matches as captain, he’s scored 894 runs at an average of 33.25, registering one century and seven fifties.

His best came in 2023, when he amassed 369 runs at 41.00, including the first-ever SA20 hundred (113) and two half-centuries. In 2024, he added 239 runs at 29.88 with three fifties, while 2025 saw him notch 286 runs at 28.60 with two more fifties and a highest score of 87.

JSK Playoff Qualifications by Year under du Plessis captain

What we love most as a JSK fan is how those playoff ticks keep arriving. A 41.17% win rate might look modest on paper, but in a short tournament with tight finishes and weather-hit nights (those 3 NR games matter), Faf’s group keeps finding a path to knockouts. That’s leadership, that’s culture; and that’s why he’s still the first name on our team sheet.

JSK Desire for the Trophy

Three seasons, three playoff runs, but no silverware yet. Faf understands that knockout cricket requires a spark beyond consistency, a decisive moment that changes everything. The close calls have only deepened his determination to see JSK crowned champions.

Whether defending a modest total or chasing a daunting target, Faf du Plessis captain, has shown the composure that keeps his team alive in pressure situations. In 2025-26, this mental strength could be the edge JSK needs to lift the trophy at last.

Leading Beyond Borders

Faf’s influence extends well beyond South Africa. As the SA20 team captain for JSK and skipper of Texas Super Kings in MLC, he has shown remarkable consistency. In 2025, he took TSK to Qualifier 2, mirroring his best result with JSK.

This ability to compete deep into tournaments across different leagues is a quality few captains can claim. It proves that his methods work universally, and his adaptability is not bound by geography or conditions.

The 41-Year-Old Inspiration

At 41, Faf’s career mirrors that of his former CSK teammate MS Dhoni, who famously lifted the IPL trophy in 2023 at the same age. Age has not dulled Faf’s hunger or his sharp cricket brain. His fitness remains elite, his batting is precise, and his game awareness is respected by opponents worldwide.

For young players in the JSK camp, having Faf du Plessis captain serves as both a guide and an inspiration. His professionalism sets a standard that raises the entire squad’s performance.

Looking Ahead: The 2025-26 Season

JSK enters the new season with stability at its core. Alongside Faf, the retained list includes:

  • James Vince – Brings composure and batting depth
  • Akeal Hosein – Offers spin control and tactical variation
  • Richard Gleeson – Adds pace and clever bowling changes
  • Donovan Ferreira – Provides explosive hitting and all-around value

This blend of experience and X-factor players reflects the franchise’s strategy of building around proven leaders. With JSK leadership centred on Faf, the squad is positioned to challenge for the title once again.

The Face of Joburg Super Kings

For the fans, Faf is not just a player; he is the embodiment of their club. When the Wanderers fill with yellow, they cheer not only for runs and wickets but for the man leading them. His bond with supporters is as strong as his on-field partnerships, and his influence in the dressing room is unmatched.

Whether guiding young bowlers through tense overs or driving the chase under lights, he personifies JSK leadership in every aspect of the game.

Conclusion

The Joburg Super Kings Captain 2025 is more than an on-field strategist. Faf du Plessis is the franchise’s heartbeat, a batter of the highest class, and an inspirational leader whose work ethic sets the tone for everyone around him. His captaincy record in SA20 is a story of consistent playoff finishes, and his connection to the Super Kings brand spans continents.

As the new season approaches, the question is not whether Faf du Plessis captain, can lead JSK into the playoffs again, but whether 2025-26 will finally be the year the Bullring celebrates its first SA20 title under his watch.

title: Ayush Mhatre to lead Mumbai in Buchi Babu Tournament in Chennai
content:
Young Ayush Mhatre continues to define new boundaries in his cricketing career. After a successful outing as the captain of India’s U19 team in England, he has been named as the captain of Mumbai for the Buchi Babu tournament.

This is a new feather in his hat, in his short career so far. Having captained India at the U19 level abroad, he will now be a part of a team that will have senior players as well.

The Mumbai team, being captained by Mhatre, will include the likes of Khan brothers: Sarfaraz and Mueen. Furthermore, there will be players like Suved Parker, who is named as the deputy of Mhatre, and two all-rounders, Sairaj Patil and Aakash Parkar.

Ayush Mhatre in Domestic cricket

Mhatre has been a revelation ever since he stepped onto the cricketing field. Last season, he made his debut in the first class while representing Mumbai against Maharashtra. And smashed a stellar 176 runs against the team led by Ruturaj Gaikwad.

In the same season, he was phenomenal with the bat in Ranji Trophy as well. In total, he has featured in 9 FC games, and managed to score 504 runs in them. This includes two centuries, batting at an average of 31.

These great performances gained him his maiden IPL call-up, and the player didn’t disappoint. In just 7 games, Mhatre scored 240 runs in the marquee league. He even came tantalizingly close to scoring his first century in the debut season itself.

Mhatre’s record for India U19

In his recent outing with the Indian Under-19 team in England, he struggled in the white ball format. Featuring in 4 ODIs, he could only manage to score 27 runs, with 21 runs coming in a single inning.

However, once the format changed, Mhatre showed his real colours. Featuring in just 2 games in youth tests, he smashed 340 runs from 4 innings.

Following this phenomenal performance, he was asked to carry the baton for India even in Australia, where he will be leading the side in a multi-format tour, which will feature 2 One Day games and 2 four-day games, starting September 21.

Mumbai in the Buchi Babu tournament

Coming to Mhatre, leading Mumbai in the Buchi Babu tournament. The player is currently present at the Centre of Excellence in Bengaluru, and will directly travel to Chennai for the tournament, which starts from August 18.

Mumbai squad: Ayush Mhatre (C), Musheer Khan, Divyansh Saxena, Sarfaraz Khan, Suved Parkar (VC), Pragnesh Kanpillewar, Harsh Aghav, Sairaj Patil, Aakash Parkar, Aakash Anand (WK), Hardik Tamore (WK), Shreyas Gurav, Yash Dicholkar, Himanshu Singh, Royston Dias, Sylvester D’Souza, Irfan Umair.

title: Dewald Brevis Smashes Record-Breaking T20I Century Against Australia
content:
Dewald Brevis has etched his name in cricket history by becoming the youngest South African to score a T20I century. The sensational knock came during the second T20I of the South Africa vs Australia series in Darwin on Tuesday. At just 22 years and 105 days, Brevis displayed remarkable composure and power, remaining unbeaten on 125 runs off only 56 balls. His innings was the backbone of South Africa’s total of 218 for seven.

Known for his fearless stroke play, Brevis plays for Chennai Super Kings in the Indian Premier League (IPL), where he has impressed fans with his aggressive batting style. On this day, he carried that same IPL flair onto the international stage, sending the Australian bowlers to all parts of the ground.

CSK’s Dewald Brevis Breaks Records in Style with Century Against Mighty Australia

With this blistering innings, Brevis broke the previous record held by Richard Levi, who scored a T20I hundred at 24 years of age. His 41-ball century is now the second-fastest T20I hundred by a South African, just behind David Miller’s 35-ball masterpiece against Bangladesh in 2017.

The atmosphere in Darwin was electric as Brevis reached his century, and the young batter did not slow down even after the milestone. He finished with 10 sixes and 9 fours, ensuring South Africa set a challenging target of 219 for Australia.

Youngest South Africans to Score a T20I Hundred

  • 22 years 105 days – Dewald Brevis
  • 24 years 36 days – Richard Levi
  • 28 years 141 days – David Miller

Fastest T20I Hundreds by a South African

  • 35 balls – David Miller vs Bangladesh, 2017
  • 41 balls – Dewald Brevis vs Australia, 2025
  • 43 balls – Quinton de Kock vs West Indies, 2023

A Bright Future Ahead for the South African Southpaw

Brevis’ performance is a reminder of the exciting young talent in South African cricket. His ability to dominate top-quality bowling attacks at such a young age bodes well for the future of the Proteas. Fans of South Africa vs Australia cricket matches will remember this innings for years to come.

As the series continues, all eyes will be on Brevis to see if he can deliver more fireworks. For now, his record-breaking hundred has given South Africa a massive boost and added another chapter to his already promising career.

title: History of Joburg Super Kings: From SA20 Origins to Now
content:
When the SA20 burst onto the South African cricket scene in 2023, it promised not only world-class cricket but also city-based franchises that would become household names.

Among these six teams was the Johannesburg-based powerhouse, the Joburg Super Kings (JSK). Over the years, JSK has built a reputation as a consistent playoff contender, a side with a strong identity, and a fan base that fills the Wanderers Stadium with a sea of yellow.

This is the history of Joburg Super Kings, from their SA20 origins to their present-day ambitions.

SA20 Team Origins: How Joburg Super Kings Was Born

In August 2022, Cricket South Africa announced the launch of the SA20, a professional Twenty20 league set to start the following year. The idea was to blend South Africa’s cricketing talent with the global T20 franchise model, similar to the IPL, giving fans a mix of local heroes and international stars.

In September 2022, the six city-based franchises were put up for auction. The Johannesburg team was snapped up by Chennai Super Kings Cricket Limited, owners of the iconic IPL side Chennai Super Kings. With the purchase came the vision to replicate CSK’s winning culture in South Africa.

From day one, the Joburg Super Kings background was tied to its IPL counterpart; not just in name but also in cricketing philosophy: stability in leadership, calculated squad building, and a strong emphasis on brand identity.

Crest and Colours: The Roaring Lion of Johannesburg

The franchise adopted the “Super Kings” name to align with its Chennai counterpart. The crest features the head of a roaring lion in orange, crowned to symbolise dominance, with the team name displayed below in green.

The yellow-and-green colour palette mirrors the energy of Johannesburg while maintaining the global Super Kings brand. The team anthem, Whistle For Joburg (translated as “To Joburg We Belong!”), debuted with the franchise and got a fresh version in 2023, quickly becoming a matchday favourite among fans.

Home Ground – The Bullring Advantage

JSK plays its home matches at the Wanderers Stadium, affectionately nicknamed “The Bullring.” With a seating capacity of 34,000, it is one of South Africa’s most iconic cricket venues. Known for its electric atmosphere and high-scoring matches, the Wanderers have been a fortress for JSK.

The combination of altitude-assisted pace and bounce has suited their aggressive brand of cricket, making it a venue where totals of 200-plus are not uncommon.

JSK History: Season by Season

In just three seasons, the History of Joburg Super Kings has been nothing short of eventful. From a strong debut to consistent playoff appearances, JSK has quickly made its mark, proving they are a team built to compete and challenge for titles.

2023: A Strong Debut

In their inaugural SA20 season, JSK quickly established itself as a force to be reckoned with. Led by Faf du Plessis, they finished second in the group stage with six wins, three losses, and one no result.

They advanced to the semi-finals, where they faced Sunrisers Eastern Cape (SEC). In a high-octane chase of 215, JSK fought valiantly but fell just 14 runs short. Faf du Plessis topped the scoring charts for the team with 369 runs, while Gerald Coetzee impressed with 17 wickets.

2024: Learning the Hard Way

The following season saw a more inconsistent run. JSK finished fourth in the group stage, with three wins, five losses, and two no results. They qualified for the playoffs but faced scoreboard pressure in Qualifier 2. Chasing another stiff target of 215, they collapsed for 142.

Leus du Plooy was the standout batter with 377 runs, while Lizaad Williams led the bowling with 15 wickets.

2025: Another Heartbreak

In 2025, JSK made the playoffs yet again, showing their knack for staying in contention. However, in the Eliminator against the SEC, they fell short once more; this time by 32 runs while chasing 185. The recurring theme of falling short in knockout games left both players and fans frustrated but determined.

By Season Summary

Big Match Moments in JSK History

JSK’s history is peppered with unforgettable moments: Faf du Plessis’s blistering knocks at the Wanderers, Gerald Coetzee’s fiery spells, and Leus du Plooy’s match-winning chases. The team’s ability to perform in the group stage has never been in doubt; it’s their playoff curse that remains the final hurdle.

JSK 2026 Outlook – A Balanced Powerhouse

Heading into the 2026 SA20 season, JSK have retained a strong core that blends experience with match-winning flair:

  • Faf du Plessis – Leadership and top-order stability
  • James Vince – Composure and batting depth
  • Akeal Hosein – Spin control in the middle overs
  • Richard Gleeson – Pace and variations
  • Donovan Ferreira – Explosive batting and all-round skills

Potential auction additions like Leus du Plooy could make them even more dangerous. Last season’s Eliminator heartbreak has only fuelled their hunger, with the entire setup united in the goal of turning contenders into champions.

Why the Joburg Super Kings Have a Strong Foundation

The Joburg Super Kings background shows a team built with long-term vision:

  • Consistent Leadership – Faf du Plessis and Stephen Fleming’s partnership mirrors CSK’s success formula in the IPL.
  • Home Advantage – The Wanderers’ conditions favour their style of aggressive cricket.
  • Global Brand Identity – The roaring lion crest and “Super Kings” name carry instant recognition.
  • Balanced Squad Building – Blend of local stars like Coetzee and Williams with seasoned internationals.

JSK Coaching and Support Staff: Stability at the Helm

From the very start, the Joburg Super Kings prioritised strong leadership. Stephen Fleming, one of the most respected coaches in T20 cricket, took the reins as head coach.

He was joined by a top-tier support staff, ensuring the JSK background was built on a strong foundation—one that has clearly reflected in their results.

  • Stephen Fleming – Head Coach
  • Albie Morkel – Assistant Coach
  • Eric Simons – Assistant Coach
  • Greg King – Trainer

This coaching unit brought a wealth of international and franchise experience, ensuring JSK’s tactical approach matched their ambitions.

The Road Ahead – Can JSK Break the Playoff Curse?

From their SA20 team origins to their current squad, the Joburg Super Kings have achieved one thing consistently: they’ve stayed in the hunt for the title every single season. Yet the final push, the leap from playoff contenders to champions, remains elusive.

The signs, however, are promising. The core group is intact, the management is experienced, and the squad has the depth to handle pressure situations. For fans, 2026 represents hope. For the players, it’s about execution.

The Bullring will roar again, the yellow flags will wave, and the “Whistle For Joburg” will echo through the stands. Whether this season finally sees JSK lift the trophy is a question only time can answer, but one thing is certain: in the history of Joburg Super Kings, 2026 could be the chapter where they write their most glorious page yet.

title: Who Will Take Care of My Knees?: MS Dhoni’s Witty Hint on IPL 2026 Comeback Leaves Fans Guessing
content:
For years, MS Dhoni has mastered the art of keeping everyone guessing. Be it opposition captains, bowlers, or even millions of his fans. This time, it wasn’t a last-over finish but a cheeky one-liner that left the cricketing world talking.

In his trademark calm yet mischievous style, Dhoni gave a subtle nod to the question everyone’s been asking: Will he return for IPL 2026? And he did it in a way that was so quintessentially Dhoni: lighthearted, witty, and wrapped in that effortless charm that makes him the “Captain Cool.”

Watch: MS Dhoni Witty reply to fan asking for IPL 2026 return

The scene was set during a recent public event, where Dhoni was interacting with fans. In the midst of the crowd, a voice rang out — “Dhoni bhai, come back for IPL 2026!” It was the kind of request every Chennai Super Kings supporter has been quietly hoping for.

Without missing a beat, Dhoni turned towards the fan and, with a grin, delivered his now-viral reply: “Who will take care of my knee pain?”

The crowd burst into laughter, but beneath the humour lay the deeper question of his future. Was it just a playful deflection, or was he giving everyone a gentle reminder of the physical battles he’s been fighting behind the scenes?

Playing Through Pain: Dhoni’s Relentless Commitment

Dhoni’s knees have been a constant concern for the past few years. The former India captain has spoken openly about the discomfort, and yet, season after season, he’s been there, not just as a figurehead but as a vital part of CSK’s on-field plans.

His presence, even if in a more controlled role with the bat, has been an anchor for the team. That he has managed to keep showing up for three consecutive years, despite the physical strain, shows his commitment and competitive spirit.

Fans have often speculated whether each season might be his last, but Dhoni’s ability to push through pain and still deliver moments of brilliance has kept hope alive.

Will Dhoni return to IPL for one last time?

IPL 2025 was far from the fairy tale CSK and Dhoni fans are used to. For the first time in 16 seasons, the franchise finished at the bottom of the table. It’s the kind of season that can haunt a player of Dhoni’s stature, not because of personal numbers, but because of the legacy he’s built around winning and inspiring.

And that’s where the question lingers: Will the lure of a redemption run tempt him to lace up one more time? With a new generation of CSK stars waiting in the wings, a final campaign led by Dhoni could be the perfect bridge — a last ride to set things right and hand over the baton on his own terms.

If history is any guide, Dhoni won’t reveal his cards until the very last moment. Until then, fans will keep replaying that witty remark — half in jest, half in hope.

title: Ravichandran Ashwin to Leave Chennai Super Kings Ahead of IPL 2026
content:
In a ground breaking revelation, it has been reported that Ravichandran Ashwin has decided to quit Chennai Super Kings ahead of the IPL 2026.

The news has been reported by Cricbuzz, and confirmed by Hindustan Times, which claims that “the player has informed the team about his decision to part ways with them.”

Along with severing ties with the team, he is also most likely to give up his position as the Director of Operations at the CSK Academy. Ashwin held this position for the past year.

Ashwin to leave CSK

The player had earlier made his intensions clear, regarding how he perceived the future. Following this, a meeting was held in Chennai, which was attended by captain Ruturaj Gaikwad and former captain MS Dhoni.

Once all the parties concerned reached a parley, the news was made public. It now indeed has been confirmed that the player will leave the team ahead of the IPL 2026 auction.

With that being said, there has been no reason provided by the team or the player, behind what prompted this decision from his side. However, there are a lot of speculations regarding Sanju Samson joining the team that could have caused an issue.

Ashwin’s second stint with CSK

The legendry spinner re-joined Chennai Super Kings ahead of the IPL 2025. He was picked up in the mega auction for a price of 9.75 crores, but failed to replicate his previous performances.

Featuring in 9 games for the team, he could only manage to pick 7 wickets, that too at an economy of 9.12 runs per over. Which was way below the expectations other players and fans had from him.

Even the player himself was not happy with his performance. He claimed that he could have done better, especially inside the powerplays.

CSK and Samson

With Ashwin’s future uncertain with the team, there is another player who’s future is uncertain, and that’s Sanju Samson of Rajasthan Royals.

Last month there was a lot of buzz around how there were high chances of that player joining CSK. But the RR franchise has turned down any cash deal. They want player in return, otherwise Sanju Samson will not be traded directly to CSK.

While this conundrum continues, the player himself has made it clear to the RR team that he wants to leave. Therefore, it remains to be seen if Rajasthan will be trading him to another team, or let him go to the auction table.

Coming to Chennai Super Kings, they had a torrid outing in the 2025 season. They finished bottom of the table for the first time in 16 seasons. Hence, a shake up is in order, and it will be interesting to see how that happens.

title: Dewald Brevis Named CSA Domestic Players' Player Of The Year 2025
content:
Dewald Brevis wraps up the South African domestic season with a bang. The player was recognised as the CSA Domestic Player Of The Year 2025.

The young batter has had a great outing in the 2025 cricketing season so far. Everyone is aware of that. He managed to catch everyone’s eye during his stint with MI Cape Town during the SA20 season.

However, the base for the same was being set way before that.

Dewald Brevis is Domestic Player Of The Year 2025

The player was a part of the CSA Four-Day Series Division One 2024-25 tournament. It is the County, Ranji Trophy, and Sheffield Shield equivalent tournament of the South Africa.

Dewald Brevis represented the Titans team in this tournament and ended the season as the second highest runs scorer. Partaking in 8 games, and playing in 12 innings, the Baby Ab scored 573 runs at an impressive average of 47.73, this underscores his prowess as a red ball player.

Around the world he is renowned for his great power hitting. But these runs show that he is not just a pinch hitter. Rather, he is someone who can bide his time and play the long ball as well.

Brevis performance in South African Domestic season

Brevis scored 2 hundreds and 2 fifties during his stint for Titans. He was also instrumental behind their journey to the final. However, the team came up short against Lions who beat them on the basis of first inning lead.

Apart from that, he was also guided his team to a great outing in the One Day Cup. There too, playing for Titans, Brevis lead from the front. He scored 398 runs in 8 games at an average of 66 and strike rate of 156.

Overall, he was phenomenal with the bat in hand throughout the season. Following his stint with Chennai Super Kings, he received his maiden call up for the international team, and scored a fifty on his Test debut as well.

The Domestic Players’ Player of The Year for Brevis is just the first of many. He has shown his prowess across formats and with time it is only going to grow.

title: CSK's Ayush Mhatre to Captain India in U-19 Tour of Australia
content:
CSK sensation Ayush Mhatre continues his dream run as captain of Indian U-19 team. Following his success in England, he has now been named as the captain for the 5-match tour of the Indian U-19 team in Australia.

Both teams are set to feature in 3 Youth ODIs and 2 multi-day games in the coming months. And the core of the squad remains the same from the England tour.

CSK’s Ayush Mhatre to captain India

Ayush Mhatre, who was the leader of the pact in England, has been named as the captain once again. This comes after his phenomenal performance in the multi-day games.

The team featured in 2 Youth Tests in England, and Mhatre was the standout performer across both teams. He scored 340 runs in four innings, in which he scored 2 hundreds and 1 fifty as well.

Ayush started the tour poorly. As a batter, he couldn’t accomplish much in the Youth ODIs. Across 4 innings, he was only able to score 27 runs from 21 games.

But he showcased exceptional skills as a skipper. Rotating his bowlers at the right time and holding his nerves when it mattered the most, Mhatre helped his team win the series 3-2.

Vaibhav Suryavanshi, the bright star

Apart from Mhatre, the inclusion of Vaibhav Suryavanshi in the squad has also been the moot point. Ever since his IPL debut, the player has been breaking records left, right and centre.

Having broken the record for the youngest debutant and centurion in IPL, he scored another century in the Youth ODIs. This time, he didn’t just become the youngest player to do so, but also broke the record for the fastest century.

Suryavanshi, batting in his flamboyant style, smashed a ton in just 52 balls. During his short stay, he smashed 10 fours and 7 sixes, showcasing the powerhouse of a player that he is.

India U-19 Tour of Australia

The CSK sensation Ayush Mhatre will have his usual deputy by his side in the form of Vihaan Malhotra. He, too, was instrumental in both series wins.

Malhotra scored 243 in the ODIs, batting at an average of 48 and smashing a century as well. In the multi-day format games, he scored 277 runs in four innings, with 2 fifties and 1 hundred to his name as well.

The tour kicks off on September 21 at Ian Healy Oval in Brisbane. All the ODI games will be played at the same venue on September 21, 24, and 26.

Even the first four-day game will also be played on the same venue on September 30. After which they will move to Mackay for the second test, which starts on October 7.

India Under-19 squad: Ayush Mhatre (capt), Vihaan Malhotra (vice-capt), Vaibhav Suryavanshi, Vedant Trivedi, Rahul Kumar, Abhigyan Kundu (wk), Harvansh Singh (WK), R S Ambrish, Kanishk Chouhan, Naman Pushpak, Henil Patel, D Deepesh, Kishan Kumar, Anmoljeet Singh, Khilan Patel, Udhav Mohan, Aman Chauhan

Standby players: Yudhajit Guha, Laxman, B.K. Kishore, Alankrith Rapole, Arnav Bugga

title: Harbhajan Singh Gets Candid: “You Think I’m Jealous?”–What He Told Ashwin Will Surprise You
content:
In a sport where changing line-ups and competition for spots is routine, fans often build narratives that don’t align with reality. One such long-standing perception has been the supposed Harbhajan Ashwin jealousy, a debate that resurfaced recently during a candid moment on R Ashwin’s podcast. But when Harbhajan Singh finally addressed it, what he had to say was grounded, honest, and far from what many expected.

Harbhajan Singh, one of India’s finest off-spinners and a key figure in India cricket history, set the record straight when Ashwin’s comment suggested he might have been envious of Ashwin’s rise. Rather than deflect or dismiss it, Bhajji responded with calm clarity: “Do you think I’m jealous of you?” It wasn’t sarcasm. It wasn’t aggression. It was a genuine moment that peeled back the curtain on what really goes on when two premier players occupy similar roles in the Indian cricket team.

Ashwin and Harbhajan talk: When One Era Meets the Next

To understand the context of this narrative, one has to look back at how the careers of Harbhajan Singh and R Ashwin overlapped. Harbhajan, who made his Test debut in the late ’90s, was a cornerstone of India’s spin attack for over a decade. From historic spells against Australia to playing a vital role in the 2007 T20 World Cup and the 2011 ODI World Cup, he was more than just a bowler, he was a match-winner.

When Ashwin emerged, India cricket was undergoing a generational shift. Harbhajan’s form had dipped, and fitness issues began surfacing, especially in the longer format. Ashwin, a more modern off-spinner with a different approach and success on subcontinent pitches, quickly cemented his place in Tests and limited-overs formats. Naturally, comparisons arose.

But to imply jealousy is to undermine Harbhajan’s legacy and the nature of professional sport. As Bhajji rightly hinted in the podcast, competitive instinct doesn’t equate to resentment. It’s the drive that keeps elite athletes performing.

The 2015 South Africa Series: One Last Spin

Interestingly, the two off-spinners were part of the same squad during South Africa’s tour of India in 2015. This was one of those rare bilateral series that featured five ODIs and three T20Is. Contrary to popular belief, Harbhajan was chosen in the playing XI ahead of Ashwin in the ODIs, a reminder that even at the twilight of his career, his skills were still valued.

Though South Africa won the ODI series, it became a poignant chapter in Harbhajan’s career. The final match of that series marked his last appearance in an ODI for India. It wasn’t a grand farewell but a quiet exit, typical of how Indian cricket often moves on.

In the T20I series that preceded it, both off-spinners featured, but South Africa took the honours, winning two out of three games. The presence of both Harbhajan and Ashwin in the squad during that tour underlined that the transition wasn’t hostile, it was happening as part of the natural evolution of the team.

2016: Final Bow in Blue

Harbhajan’s last international game came just a few months later in the Asia Cup T20, where India faced UAE. In that match, he returned economical figures of 4 overs, 11 runs, and 1 wicket, a performance that encapsulated his experience and control. While that game didn’t attract much attention, it closed the chapter on a remarkable international career that spanned nearly two decades.

Meanwhile, Ashwin continued to be a vital cog in the Indian setup until the Champions Trophy in 2017, after which Kuldeep Yadav and Yuzvendra Chahal took over the white-ball responsibilities. But even then, there was never any public bitterness from Harbhajan. He remained active in franchise cricket, media, and commentary, offering insights without controversy.

More Than Just Numbers

Let’s not forget Harbhajan’s impact in the 2011 World Cup. He played all nine matches, taking 9 wickets, often in middle overs where containment and breakthroughs were crucial. His spell against Pakistan in the semi-final, where he dismissed Umar Akmal, turned the tide. While newer fans might focus on final-stage performances, those who followed that campaign closely know how critical Bhajji’s role was.

Yet despite these achievements, narratives like the Harbhajan – Ashwin jealousy storyline tend to stick, until moments like this podcast clear the air.

A Lesson in Professionalism

The podcast episode wasn’t just a reflection of two players talking shop; it was a lesson in how real professionals carry themselves. Ashwin, to his credit, acknowledged that even if there had been a tinge of rivalry, it was natural. Harbhajan’s mature response proved once again that beneath the headlines, there are athletes who respect the game and each other.

So, was there ever any Harbhajan Ashwin jealousy?

If you watched the podcast, the answer’s obvious: No. What existed was mutual respect, a shared journey, and the bittersweet transition between two world-class off-spinners, one bowing out with dignity, and the other carrying the torch forward.

And in Indian cricket’s rich history, there’s room for both stories to shine.

title: Sanju Samson's Journey from Rajasthan Royals to Chennai Super Kings
content:
The IPL 2026 player transfer rumours have thrown a major curveball this season, with Sanju Samson CSK talks gaining unexpected momentum.

While whispers about star players switching franchises are common during the off-season, this time, credible reports have surfaced suggesting that Chennai Super Kings (CSK) are genuinely interested in bringing the dynamic Rajasthan Royals (RR) skipper, Sanju Samson, into their setup.

With that being said, it becomes important to capture the journey of the player in the IPL. This will help us understand how the player has evolved over the years and what best can he do for the side.

Sanju Samson IPL Career: A Journey of Talent and Determination

Sanju Samson’s IPL career has been a rollercoaster of dazzling knocks, leadership breakthroughs, and moments that defined his rise as one of India’s most watchable T20 batters.

His ability to open the innings, pace the game, or even play the role of a finisher has earned him a versatile reputation. But beyond numbers, Sanju’s calm presence, sharp wicketkeeping skills, and temperament under pressure make him a prized asset for any franchise.

IPL Career Stats:

Sanju’s impact goes beyond the scoreboard. Time and again, he has been the cornerstone of Rajasthan Royals’ batting, often turning games on their head with his ability to clear the boundary with effortless ease. His fearless stroke play, especially against spinners, and his knack for delivering under pressure have made him one of the most dependable names in the IPL.

Moreover, his evolution from a precocious talent to a dependable captain highlights his leadership growth and maturity. He has consistently been the go-to man for RR in crunch situations, building partnerships, anchoring innings when required, and never shying away from taking on the best bowlers in the league.

Why Chennai Super Kings Want Sanju Samson

Chennai Super Kings’ interest in Sanju Samson is not surprising. As one of the most experienced Indian batters in the IPL, Samson brings explosive batting, reliable wicketkeeping, and proven leadership. Reports linking Sanju Samson to CSK have gained traction because the franchise is looking to strengthen its core ahead of IPL 2026. With Chennai Super Kings focusing on building a squad for the future, Samson fits perfectly into their long-term plans. His ability to attack during the powerplay, accelerate in the middle overs, and lead under pressure makes him one of the most valuable Indian players available in the transfer market.

Sanju Samson’s Entry in RR: The Untold Story

Before becoming the face of Rajasthan Royals, Sanju Samson’s entry into the RR camp was marked by a stroke of fate and a generous word of recommendation. It was none other than fellow Kerala cricketer S. Sreesanth who introduced a young Sanju to Rahul Dravid in a hotel lobby, claiming the youngster had smashed six sixes in an over in a local Kerala tournament.

Years later, Sanju candidly admitted in an interview that the story was a fabrication by Sreesanth intended to boost his career prospects. Yet, destiny had its way, Sanju was picked and made his debut against Royal Challengers Bangalore, scoring a stunning 63 off 41 balls while chasing 172. He concluded his debut season with 206 runs in 11 matches, earning the ‘Emerging Player of the Season’ award.

Over the years, Sanju played under various captains before being named RR’s skipper ahead of IPL 2021. Under his leadership, RR reached the final in IPL 2022 and qualified again for the playoffs in IPL 2024, a testament to his growth as a leader and player.

How Sanju Samson Could Transform CSK’s Batting

If the Sanju Samson CSK transfer materializes, Chennai Super Kings could instantly solve several batting concerns. Samson has consistently delivered quick starts for Rajasthan Royals while also playing match-winning knocks in pressure situations. His presence at the top of the order alongside Ruturaj Gaikwad would provide CSK with one of the strongest opening combinations in the tournament. Moreover, his wicketkeeping skills offer greater team balance, allowing Chennai Super Kings to use overseas slots more effectively. Considering his experience in high-pressure IPL matches, Samson could become one of the biggest signings of the IPL 2026 transfer window.

What a Sanju Samson Transfer Means for IPL 2026

A potential Rajasthan Royals to Chennai Super Kings transfer would be among the biggest stories of IPL 2026. Beyond strengthening CSK, such a move could reshape the balance of power in the league. Chennai Super Kings would gain an experienced Indian batter, wicketkeeper, and leader, while Rajasthan Royals would need to rebuild around a new captain and top-order combination. Although no official deal has been announced, the growing Sanju Samson transfer news has generated significant excitement among fans and cricket experts. Until either franchise confirms the move, the speculation is expected to remain one of the biggest talking points leading into the new IPL season.

CSK’s 2025 Setback: A Season to Forget, A Chance to Rebuild

The 2025 season was a rare low point in CSK’s storied IPL history. Finishing at the bottom of the table, a first-ever wooden spoon, the campaign unraveled when skipper Ruturaj Gaikwad suffered a season-ending injury early on.

The team struggled to find stability, with inconsistent performances and a series of narrow defeats defining their campaign. Yet, amid the gloom, the rise of youngsters like Urvil Patel, Ayush Mhatre, and Dewald Brevis injected fresh hope into the camp.

Their fighting spirit hinted at brighter days ahead. For a franchise that has famously bounced back, winning the title after a poor 2020 season in 2021 and making another triumphant comeback in 2023; this setback feels more like a setup for a stronger return. With a revamped core and strategic moves on the horizon, CSK looks determined to turn the page in IPL 2026.

CSK Player Changes: How Sanju Fits in the Chennai Camp

With the introduction of the Impact Player rule and a well-balanced squad, CSK isn’t expected to make wholesale player changes for IPL 2026. Players like Urvil Patel, Ayush Mhatre, and Dewald Brevis are likely to remain core members of the side.

However, Sanju Samson’s inclusion could see him taking up the role of a full-time opener and wicketkeeper. This move would not only bolster CSK’s top order but also offer a backup leadership option alongside Gaikwad.

Having a player like Sanju, who brings both stability and explosiveness, could give CSK the perfect blend of youth, experience, and depth. His experience leading RR in high-pressure situations would be an added advantage in CSK’s ever-competitive setup.

Sanju Samson and CSK: A Match Made in IPL Heaven?

The Sanju Samson CSK link-up is more than just a transfer rumor, it feels like a strategic move waiting to happen. With CSK’s proven culture of nurturing leaders, giving players the freedom to express themselves, and building a loyal core, Sanju could find a home that perfectly complements his style of play.

On the other hand, for Sanju, a move to CSK would mean stepping into a franchise known for its legacy, backed by fervent fan support, and under the guidance of one of IPL’s sharpest cricketing minds, Stephen Fleming.

While the trade remains speculative at this stage, the possibilities it opens are exciting for fans of both franchises. Whether Sanju stays loyal to RR or dons the iconic yellow of CSK in IPL 2026, one thing is certain, his journey continues to be one of IPL’s most intriguing narratives.

IPL 2026 Player Updates: What the Future Holds

The 2026 IPL season is shaping up to be a fascinating one with a flurry of player updates on the cards. Sanju’s potential move to CSK could set off a domino effect in the transfer market.

Franchises are closely monitoring the situation, especially considering CSK’s history of making calculated, impact-oriented moves rather than knee-jerk reactions.

Moreover, with the next mega-auction likely around the corner, retaining and trading key assets like Sanju Samson could change the entire balance of power among franchises. His potential partnership with Ruturaj at the top could redefine CSK’s approach in the powerplay overs.

Stay tuned for more IPL 2026 player updates as this story unfolds.

Is Sanju Samson joining CSK in IPL 2026?

At present, there is no official confirmation. Reports suggest Chennai Super Kings are interested, but both franchises have yet to finalize any deal.

Why does CSK want Sanju Samson?

Sanju Samson offers explosive batting, wicketkeeping, leadership experience, and flexibility in the batting order, making him an ideal long-term addition to the Chennai Super Kings squad.

Will Rajasthan Royals release Sanju Samson?

RR have not made any official announcement. Since Samson is one of their key players and captain, any transfer would require mutual agreement between both franchises.

Who could CSK trade for Sanju Samson?

Several trade options have been discussed by fans and experts, but no official names have been confirmed by either Chennai Super Kings or Rajasthan Royals.

title: What Went Wrong for Texas Super Kings in MLC 2025 Challenger Game?
content:
Now that the dust has settled on the Major League Cricket 2025 season, it’s time to look back at the Texas Super Kings Match Analysis and decode what really happened in the semi-final clash that shocked many.

The MLC 2025 semi-final analysis leaves more questions than answers for TSK fans, as their strong league campaign ended abruptly with a defeat to MI New York, a team that just scraped into the playoffs but peaked at the right time.

Texas Super Kings’ League Season Recap

The Texas Super Kings (TSK) had a dominant league phase, finishing with 7 wins from 10 matches, securing the second position on the points table. Only Washington Freedom, led by the charismatic Glenn Maxwell, edged past them to claim the top spot. Despite finishing just below the table-toppers, TSK looked like favorites heading into the playoffs.

Leading from the front, 40-year-old Faf du Plessis turned back the clock with a sensational season, amassing 468 runs in 10 innings. His tally included two centuries and three half-centuries, scored at a blistering strike rate of 170. He was the pillar of TSK’s batting unit.

On the bowling front, Afghan spinner Noor Ahmad proved to be TSK’s trump card, picking up 15 wickets in 12 matches at an economy of 8 runs per over. His consistent middle-over spells ensured TSK dominated most of their league matches.

However, the MLC 2025 semi-final analysis shows that things went downhill the moment the playoffs began.

Qualifier 1: The Rain Twist

In the first qualifier, TSK faced Washington Freedom with a direct ticket to the final on the line. However, rain played spoilsport, washing out the game entirely.

As per tournament rules, Washington Freedom, the higher-ranked team, progressed straight to the final. TSK was pushed into Qualifier 2 against MI New York, a team that barely made it into the top 4 with just three league wins.

This no-result match derailed the rhythm and momentum TSK had built up in the league stage.

Qualifier 2: The Collapse Under Pressure

Batting first in Qualifier 2, TSK posted a modest total of 166 runs in their 20 overs. Faf du Plessis and Akeal Hosein scored crucial half-centuries, steadying the innings after early setbacks. Donovan Ferreira chipped in with a quickfire 32 off 20 balls, but the team failed to capitalize in the death overs.

When MI New York began their chase, TSK’s bowling attack initially seemed to have things under control. MI NY stumbled to 83 for 3, with 69 needed off the last six overs. But as history has often repeated itself, the Pollard storm struck the Super Kings once again.

What Went Wrong? Texas Super Kings Match Review

There are many things that went wrong for Texas. Listed below are some that hurt them the most.

1. Dropped Catches and Fielding Blunders

One of the most glaring issues in this MLC 2025 semi-final analysis was TSK’s sloppy fielding. They dropped multiple catches,  and painfully, all of them involved Kieron Pollard.

Giving life to a player like Pollard is a death wish, and TSK paid the price. Simple opportunities were grassed at crucial junctures, allowing MI NY to claw back into the contest.

2. Questionable Team Selection

TSK’s team selection raised a few eyebrows. They opted for a combination that left them without a reliable fifth bowling option. Marcus Stoinis and Donovan Ferreira had to fill the quota, which backfired massively. Both conceded runs at critical stages, failing to apply pressure on MI NY’s middle order.

Going into a knockout game without a proper fifth bowler in a high-pressure encounter is a gamble, and this strategy cost TSK dearly.

3. Batting Failure of the Middle Order

Apart from Faf, Akeal, and Donovan, the rest of the TSK batting lineup flopped. Smit Patel, Saiteja Mukkamalla, Shubham Ranjane, and Marcus Stoinis, all recorded single-digit scores. This collapse meant that TSK fell short by 15-20 runs on a wicket where 185+ looked par.

When the middle order fails consistently in a knockout game, pressure inevitably builds on the bowling unit.

4. Crumbled Under Pressure in Death Overs

Bowling at the death has been a concern for TSK throughout the season, and it haunted them again in the semi-final. Zia-ul-Haq, tasked with defending 50 off the last 24 balls, conceded a whopping 23 runs in a single over. That over turned the game decisively in MI NY’s favor.

Pressure situations often expose a team’s character, and unfortunately for TSK, they couldn’t hold their nerve when it mattered most.

5. The Pollard Factor: An Old Nemesis Returns

Kieron Pollard’s association with heartbreaks for the Super Kings franchise, be it in IPL or MLC, continues. Time and again, he has single-handedly dismantled CSK and now TSK.

He walked in at a critical juncture and scored 47 off 22 balls, a brutal knock that turned the semi-final on its head. Pollard’s experience, calm under pressure, and ability to target the right bowlers proved to be the decisive difference in the MLC 2025 semi-final.

6. The Inexperience in TSK’s Bowling Attack

While Noor Ahmad was exceptional, the rest of the bowling lineup lacked the cutting edge in crunch moments. The absence of a proven death bowler and reliance on part-time options like Stoinis exposed TSK’s strategic shortcomings.

In big games, experience in bowling counts. TSK’s inexperience and tactical errors allowed MI NY to capitalize when the game was on the line.

MLC 2025: A Season of Twists and Surprises

The Major League Cricket 2025 will go down as one of the most unpredictable seasons in franchise cricket. MI New York, who managed only three wins in the league stage, stunned everyone by knocking out Texas Super Kings in Qualifier 2 and eventually winning the championship.

For TSK, this season will be remembered as a story of ‘so near, yet so far.’ They dominated the league, had standout individual performers, and yet fell short at the penultimate hurdle.

Lessons for Texas Super Kings Moving Forward

  • Team Balance is Crucial: Knockout games demand a well-rounded XI. TSK must rethink their combinations to ensure a balanced attack.
  • Fielding Needs Urgent Attention: Catching wins matches. TSK cannot afford to be sloppy on the field, especially against power-hitters like Pollard.
  • Middle Order Stability: The middle order needs to take responsibility and play according to match situations. Dependency on top-order contributions alone won’t win trophies.
  • Death Bowling Options: Invest in specialist death bowlers who can execute under pressure.

The Texas Super Kings Match Analysis for the MLC 2025 semi-final highlights a hard truth, league dominance means little if you falter at the business end. From dropped catches to poor bowling strategies, a combination of factors contributed to their exit.

With a solid core in Faf du Plessis, Noor Ahmad, and young talents like Donovan Ferreira, TSK have plenty of positives to build on. But unless they fix their shortcomings in team selection, fielding, and pressure handling, the elusive MLC trophy will remain out of reach.

For now, it’s back to the drawing board for Texas Super Kings, a team with potential but plenty of hard lessons from the heartbreak of MLC 2025.
