title: All Franchise Teams Owned by CSK: Complete Super Kings Network
content:
There’s something unmistakably special about Whistle Podu. It’s not just a chant; it’s an emotion. A heartbeat that syncs with millions. And at the centre of it all is one man, Faf du Plessis, a true gladiator who has carried the torch of the Super Kings legacy across hemispheres.

From Chennai’s Chepauk roars to the “Whistle for Joburg” anthems echoing at the Bullring and the cricket revolution in the USA through Texas, one heart beats for them all, CSK’s heart, now global.

The Chennai Super Kings (CSK) is no longer just an IPL team; it’s a cricketing empire. With its roaring lion crest and legacy of loyalty, the franchise has expanded beyond the Indian Premier League and is now a global brand.

This is the story of CSK all franchise units under the Super Kings brand, Joburg Super Kings (JSK) in South Africa, Texas Super Kings (TSK) in the United States, and, of course, the heartbeat itself, Chennai Super Kings in India.

Let’s take a deeper look at each part of this powerful Super Kings network.

Chennai Super Kings (CSK): The Origin of the Empire

You can’t talk about the Super Kings without bowing your head to the OGs: Chennai Super Kings.

Founded in 2008 during the inception of the Indian Premier League, CSK quickly grew to become one of the most successful and loved franchises in global cricket. With five IPL titles (2010, 2011, 2018, 2021, 2023) under their belt and the undisputed legacy of MS Dhoni as captain, CSK became the heartbeat of Indian cricket fans.

Even though Dhoni has stepped down, the legacy remains fiercely protected and extended through Faf du Plessis, a former CSK mainstay and a global ambassador of the Yellow Army’s philosophy.

The team’s blend of experience, loyalty, and tactical brilliance is what CSK stands for, and it’s that spirit now flowing into the other CSK franchise teams across the globe.

  • Home Ground: MA Chidambaram Stadium, Chennai
  • Coach: Stephen Fleming
  • Captain (2024 onwards): Ruturaj Gaikwad
  • Titles: IPL Champions (5), Champions League T20 (2)

Joburg Super Kings (JSK): Carrying the Roar to Africa

Joburg Super Kings, the South African arm of the Super Kings family, was born when CSK Cricket Limited purchased the Johannesburg franchise in the newly launched SA20 League in 2022.

JSK is more than just a mirror of CSK; it’s an extension of the same legacy. Wearing the same iconic yellow (with a dash of green), the JSK franchise made a roaring debut with Faf du Plessis as captain and Stephen Fleming as coach, bringing the same leadership combination that defined CSK’s golden years.

Performance & Stats of JSK:

  • Home Ground: Wanderers Stadium, Johannesburg
  • Captain: Faf du Plessis
  • Coach: Stephen Fleming
  • Top Players (Most Runs):
    • Leus du Plooy – 626 runs
    • Faf du Plessis – 608 runs
    • Reeza Hendricks – 411 runs
  • Top Players (Most Wickets):
    • Lizaad Williams – 20 wickets
    • Gerald Coetzee – 17 wickets

JSK’s anthem, “Whistle for Joburg”, echoes through the Bullring, uniting fans in yellow under one roar. With stars like Moeen Ali and Donavon Ferreira and a sharp bowling attack, JSK isn’t just a franchise; it’s a statement: CSK global cricket has arrived in Africa.

Texas Super Kings (TSK): The Yellow Storm in America

From Chepauk to Texas, the lion’s roar now echoes in the land of baseball and Super Bowls. The Texas Super Kings (TSK) represent CSK’s ambitious push into the American market through Major League Cricket (MLC), a league that aims to revolutionise cricket in the United States.

Launched in 2023, TSK is co-owned by Chennai Super Kings Cricket Limited, Ross Perot Jr., and Anurag Jain. With Grand Prairie Stadium as their fortress and Faf du Plessis again leading the pack, TSK carries forward CSK’s core values, experience, entertainment, and excellence.

Performance Overview of TSK:

  • Home Ground: Grand Prairie Stadium, Dallas
  • Coach: Stephen Fleming
  • Captain: Faf du Plessis

2023 Season:

  • League Standing: 2nd
  • Final Standing: Eliminated in Challenger

2024 Season:

  • League Standing: 3rd
  • Final Standing: Eliminated in Challenger

TSK’s roster has seen a dynamic mix of international stars and rising American talents, with players like Devon Conway, Adam Milne, Daryl Mitchell, Noor Ahmed and even wildcard picks like Mohammad Mohsin making headlines.

Despite being a young team, Texas Super Kings have already built a loyal fan base, showcasing how deeply CSK’s values resonate even across the Atlantic. 

Why CSK’s Global Franchise Strategy Works

The Super Kings franchise list isn’t just about adding more teams; it’s about spreading a cricketing culture that’s rooted in loyalty, leadership, and lion-hearted performance.

What makes this strategy work?

  1. Consistency in Leadership: With Stephen Fleming and Faf du Plessis leading all teams, a familiar philosophy is in play.
  2. Unified Brand Identity: From the lion-crested logo to the team anthem and yellow kits, every franchise feels like family.
  3. Talent Pipeline: CSK scouts invest heavily in local and international talent, helping all their franchises stay competitive.
  4. Cultural Integration: Whether it’s “Whistle Podu” or “Whistle for Joburg,” the local culture is respected and blended into the franchise’s DNA.

The Eternal Love Affair: CSK and Its Fans

No matter where the CSK franchise teams play, one thing remains constant: the undying passion of their fans. The love for CSK is not just limited to the stands of Chepauk; it travels across continents, filling the Wanderers in Johannesburg and echoing at Grand Prairie in Texas.

Fans have embraced not just Chennai but the entire Super Kings franchise list, celebrating every victory of Texas Super Kings and Joburg Super Kings as their own.

It’s this extraordinary fan support that has powered CSK global cricket into a brand bigger than just the IPL. From painted faces and yellow flags to roaring “Whistle Podu” chants, the energy of the CSK all franchise followers is unmatched. Their loyalty isn’t seasonal; it’s generational.

This emotional heartbeat is what turns every Super Kings match into more than just a game; it’s a celebration of identity, pride, and pure cricketing love.

The Super Kings Legacy: Beyond the Boundary

The CSK all-franchise initiative is not just a business expansion; it is also a strategic move. It’s a legacy extension. It’s about taking the heartbeat of millions and letting it beat louder across oceans and borders. Every six hit in Joburg, every wicket taken in Dallas, and every boundary scored at Chepauk is a part of the same story.

This is not just about cricket; it’s about belonging. Whether you’re in Chennai, Johannesburg, or Texas, when you wear yellow, you don’t just support a team; you also support a colour. You become a Super King.

One Heart, Many Roars

From Chennai’s spiritual yellow army to the rising tides in Texas and the Joburg revolution, CSK is no longer just a team; it’s a global cricketing movement. Led by the timeless class of Faf du Plessis, guided by the astute mind of Stephen Fleming and united under one crest, the lion, it’s a journey that has only just begun.

So the next time you hear the roar, no matter which continent you’re on, know that it’s the Super Kings, and it’s your team.

Whistle Podu, Whistle for Joburg, Whistle for Texas. The Super Kings are here, and they are everywhere.

title: What is the Meaning of Anbuden? The Soul of CSK Explained
content:
“Namma Thala Dhoni ku periya whistle adinga!”

What is the meaning of Anbuden? If you’re a Chennai Super Kings fan, you’ve probably seen this word on CSK’s social media posts, merchandise, and match-day campaigns. While Anbuden literally means “with love” in Tamil, it carries a much deeper meaning for the Yellow Army.

For CSK supporters, Anbuden CSK represents love, loyalty, unity, and the emotional connection between the franchise and millions of fans across the world. It’s more than a word—it’s an identity that reflects Chepauk’s fortress-like atmosphere and the passion of the Whistle Podu Army.

In this article, we’ll explore the Anbuden meaning in English, its Tamil origin, why Chennai Super Kings adopted it, and how it became one of the most recognizable phrases in IPL history.

The Fortress Called Chepauk

The MA Chidambaram Stadium, lovingly called Chepauk, is not just CSK’s home ground; it’s their citadel. With history etched into every corner of its stands, Chepauk has witnessed countless cricketing miracles. It’s a place where fans don’t just watch; they participate.

And it’s no exaggeration to say that Chepauk is a fortress built with love, the embodiment of Anbuden.

In IPL 2011, the Chennai Super Kings were unbeatable at home. They didn’t lose a single game at Chepauk, asserting their complete dominance and showcasing why it’s called “Den.” For years, tickets for CSK matches at Chepauk have sold out in minutes. Fans line up in digital and physical queues just to get a glimpse of their warriors in yellow.

Even in IPL 2025, when the playoffs were hosted in cities far from Chennai, the contrast was stark. During one of the eliminators, former cricketer and commentator Sunil Gavaskar said, “Had this match been played at Chepauk and CSK been in it, we’d be looking at a full house.” That’s the power of Anbuden CSK.

What is the Meaning of Anbuden?

The Anbuden meaning comes from the Tamil word “அன்புடன்” (Anbuden), which translates to “with love” in English.

The word combines:

  • Anbu (அன்பு) – Love
  • Udan (உடன்) – With or together

Together, Anbuden simply means “with love.”

However, for Chennai Super Kings, the word has evolved into something much more powerful. CSK creatively plays with the word by combining Anbu (Love) and Den, symbolizing their home ground—Chepauk, the Lions’ Den.

This gives Anbuden CSK another emotional interpretation:

The Fortress of Love.

Anbuden: Meaning and Translation in English

So, what is the Anbuden meaning? At its essence, the Tamil word “அன்புடன்” (Anbuden) is a fusion of “அன்பு” (Anbu), meaning love, and “உடன்” (Udan), a suffix indicating togetherness or with. The phrase translates to “with love.”

But for die-hard CSK supporters, this phrase carries a deeper emotional resonance; it’s a heartfelt symbol of unity, connection, and unwavering loyalty. The way CSK has adopted and repurposed the term reflects the creativity and heart that define the franchise.

When fans shout Anbuden CSK, they aren’t just cheering; they’re voicing the spirit of a family that lives and breathes yellow. The term has become integral to CSK’s digital identity, seen in their hashtags, captions, and community messages, embodying traits like resilience, gratitude, and shared triumphs.

Expressions such as:

  • “அன்புடன் உங்கள் ஆதரவாளன்” (Anbuden Ungal Aadharavalan) – With your heartfelt support.
  • “அன்புடன் தொடர்வோம்” (Anbuden Todarvom) – Let’s move forward with love.

These go beyond everyday exchanges. They’re powerful declarations of care, loyalty, and respect deeply rooted in Tamil culture. Whether used in celebration or mourning, the Anbuden meaning retains its essence of warmth and heartfelt intent.

A term like Anbuden, often used as a sign-off in CSK’s posts, letters, and greetings, adds depth and emotional richness. Whether it’s about welcoming someone, bidding farewell, or cheering from the stands, “Anbuden” is the Tamil way of saying: we mean it, from the heart.

Why Did CSK Choose the Word Anbuden?

The popularity of Anbuden CSK dates back to 2018–19.

During the 2018 IPL season, Chennai Super Kings were forced to play home matches in Pune because of protests in Chennai. When the team finally returned to MA Chidambaram Stadium (Chepauk), the CSK social media team introduced #Anbuden to celebrate the Lions’ return to their true home.

The word perfectly reflected two ideas:

  • Anbu = Love
  • Den = The Lions’ Fortress

It became a brilliant piece of branding that connected Tamil culture with CSK’s identity.

The Whistle Podu Revolution

One of the most iconic aspects of CSK fandom is the Whistle Podu anthem. In Tamil, “Whistle Podu” literally means “blow the whistle,” a cheer, a signal of excitement. It started as a catchy tune but soon became a symbol of celebration and support.

Fans, known as the Whistle Podu Army, don’t just cheer: they sing, dance, and drum their way into stadiums. The anthem is blared from speakers across the city on match days, and you’ll find kids, elders, and even grandmothers waving CSK flags and whistling in unison. This level of involvement makes CSK fan slogan culture one of the most unique in the world.

MS Dhoni and the Rise of Anbuden

Much of Anbuden’s popularity is closely linked to MS Dhoni.

Known affectionately as Thala, Dhoni became more than just CSK’s captain.

He became the emotional heartbeat of the franchise.

Expressions like:

  • Enga Thala Dhoni
  • Namma Thala Dhoni ku Periya Whistle Adinga
  • Thala Dhoni Anbuden

CSK Tamil Slogans that Echo Forever

The slogans of CSK are not manufactured marketing lines. They are organically grown battle cries that echo in the hearts of fans. Let’s revisit a few:

  • Whistle Podu: Blow the whistles.
  • Anbuden CSK: Fortress of Love for CSK
  • Thala Dhan: Dhoni is Dhoni; he is the only one. 
  • Namma Thala Dhoni ku periya whistle adinga: Blow the whistles for our very own Thala Dhoni.
  • Enga Thala Dhoni: Our beloved Dhoni.

Each of these phrases holds a world of emotion. They’re inked on posters, painted on walls, and etched in memories. And in 2025 and beyond, as Dhoni transitions into mentorship, these slogans will carry his legacy forward.

So, Anbuden means “with love.” The CSK meaning of Anbuden is both “with love” and “fortress of love.”

Why CSK is a Culture, Not Just a Cricket Team

No other IPL team commands the same kind of loyalty. Fans stand by CSK during defeats. They celebrate the small wins. They defend the players when they’re down and lift them higher when they’re flying.

That’s what Anbuden stands for. Unconditional love. It’s not based on titles. Not based on stats. Based on the heart.

From the heartbreak of 2020 to the joy of 2021, from the uncertainty of Dhoni’s future to the excitement of new faces, CSK has always been a team built on belief. That belief is held together by three words: Anbuden, Chennai Super Kings.

Anbuden Forever

In a cricketing world filled with noise, numbers, and narratives, Anbuden cuts through as a beacon of purity. It reminds us that sport, at its best, is about connection. CSK, with its fortress of love, its slogans, and its spiritual leader, Dhoni, represents that ideal better than any other team.

So the next time someone asks you what Anbuden means, don’t just say “with love.” Tell them it’s the heartbeat of millions, the voice that echoes across Chepauk, and what makes CSK more than a franchise.

It’s a family. An army. A feeling.

Anbuden, CSK. Forever.

content:
MLC 2025 WAF vs TSK Highlights: Washington Freedom, led by Glenn Maxwell, beat Faf du Plessis’s Texas Super Kings by 7 wickets in the 13th match of the MLC 2025 season. The exciting game took place on Monday, June 23, 2025, at Grand Prairie Stadium in Dallas. Washington Freedom won the toss and decided to bowl first.

MLC 2025 WAF vs TSK Highlights: Super Kings Bowlers Fail to Defend 220 against Freedom

Texas Super Kings batted first and put up a very strong total of 220 runs for the loss of 6 wickets in their 20 overs. Captain Faf du Plessis led the charge with an excellent 69 runs off just 31 balls, hitting 8 fours and 4 sixes. Smit Patel scored a quick 24 at the start. Later, Marcus Stoinis added 32 runs and Milind Kumar contributed 31 runs, helping push the total high. For Washington Freedom, Mitchell Owen was the star bowler, picking up 3 wickets for 33 runs, while Glenn Maxwell also took 2 wickets for 35 runs.

Washington Freedom then began their chase of 221 runs, which looked like a tough target. However, their batters showed great skill and determination. Mitchell Owen, opening the innings, played a fantastic knock, scoring 89 runs off 52 balls. He found great support from Andries Gous, who remained unbeaten with a brilliant 80 runs off just 45 balls. Glenn Maxwell also chipped in with a quick 20 runs. Together, they made the high chase look comfortable.

Lest Adam Milne’s Efforts, Back-to-Back Losses Raise Concern for Super Kings

Texas Super Kings tried hard to defend their score, with Adam Milne taking 3 wickets for 42 runs. But the strong batting performance from Washington Freedom, especially from Owen and Gous, ensured they reached the target with two balls to spare, finishing at 223 for 3 in 19.4 overs.

Texas Super Kings put up a huge score, but their bowlers couldn’t hold Washington Freedom back. Despite Adam Milne taking three wickets, TSK’s attack lacked a crucial breakthrough, especially with Mitchell Owen and Andries Gous playing explosive knocks. Dropped catches and a slightly easier pitch under lights also didn’t help TSK’s cause in defending their big total.

title: Why Dewald Brevis Could Be CSK’s Next Big Overseas Game-Changer
content:
In a season that didn’t offer much for Chennai Super Kings fans to cheer for, the most unexpected yet glorious development came in the form of Dewald Brevis. The young South African, once lost in the mix of unfulfilled potential and inconsistent opportunities, became the face of flair and hope for CSK in the TATA IPL 2025.

Brevis wasn’t even in the original squad. He wasn’t among the CSK overseas players listed for the season. But when Gurpajneet Singh was ruled out with injury, CSK made a bold call that changed their narrative for the better; they brought in Brevis.

And boy, did it click. Suddenly, Brevis wasn’t just a replacement. He became the story and the symbol of what could be. When we look ahead at Dewald Brevis CSK future player trajectory, it’s hard not to get excited about the possibilities.

A Foreign Love Affair: CSK’s History with Overseas Batsmen

For all their cultural rootedness and love for experienced Indian players, CSK has had a long-standing affection for overseas batters. From Michael Hussey to Faf du Plessis, from Matthew Hayden to Brendon McCullum, they’ve trusted big names at the top.

Brevis, unlike these greats, isn’t an opener. But like them, he offers explosiveness, match-turning ability, and the X-factor.

What makes Dewald Brevis CSK future player material is not just his batting but the role he can play in the CSK team planning. He can bat anywhere from number 3 to number 7.

In a team that is gradually shifting from the Dhoni era, that kind of versatility is invaluable. He is touted to become one of the most valuable CSK overseas players in recent memory.

Why is Dewald Brevis CSK future player?

Dewald Brevis was once the most talked-about U19 cricketer in the world. His exploits in the 2022 ICC Under-19 World Cup made him an overnight sensation.

Nicknamed “Baby AB” for his striking similarity in batting style to AB de Villiers, Brevis bagged the Player of the Tournament award and found himself in the Mumbai Indians setup by IPL 2022. But the rise didn’t sustain.

In his debut season, he managed just 161 runs in seven games. The inconsistency and a star-studded MI lineup saw him lose his place. He remained unsold in the IPL 2025 auction. For someone who lit up youth cricket with swagger and dominance, Brevis’s fall was steep.

But Chennai, true to its history, found value in a player most had written off. Just as they had with Ambati Rayudu, Shivam Dube, and Ajinkya Rahane in previous years, CSK tapped into Brevis’s underutilized potential.

They didn’t just pick him, and they empowered him. The results followed. As Brevis CSK news exploded across social platforms, especially on X, it was clear a new cult hero was being born.

The Spark He Brought to CSK’s Campaign

In six matches for CSK in IPL 2025, Brevis scored 225 runs at a staggering strike rate of 180. His fearless intent brought life to a tired and toothless middle order.

He struck 17 sixes, three every game, and played two match-winning innings that directly contributed to CSK’s only four wins of the season.

He wasn’t just hitting the ball; he was sending messages. Dewald Brevis CSK future player potential was no longer hypothetical. It was visible, match after match.

Brevis in CSK team planning

His ground coverage, anticipation, and bullet throws added energy to a CSK unit that often looked flat. One of the big changes CSK needs post the Dhoni era is to bring in players who can add value across disciplines. Brevis fits that bill.

He’s not a part-timer, or a one-dimensional hitter. He’s a complete T20 asset. And while his international career for South Africa hasn’t taken off, he has played only two T20Is and failed in both, that doesn’t take anything away from what he can become.

Just like AB became the lynchpin of RCB despite not playing every game for South Africa, Dewald Brevis CSK future player profile suggests he can do the same for Chennai.

He has that rare mix of power, touch, and audacity. And CSK gives players the room to express, fail, and rise again. It’s a franchise that values faith as much as form.

How Brevis influences CSK’s IPL 2026 auction picks?

Perhaps the most attractive part about Brevis is his positional flexibility. In six matches, he batted at three different positions and delivered impactful performances in all of them. That kind of adaptability allows CSK to build a lineup around him rather than just slot him in.

When you’re thinking of IPL 2026 auction picks, the versatility of players becomes a top priority. Brevis’s ability to float between 3 and 7 makes him a tactical advantage for CSK. A few good picks around him, especially in the bowling department, and this squad could rise again.

CSK doesn’t operate on short-term wins. Their entire team-building philosophy revolves around long-term commitment. If the 2025 season was a test, Brevis passed with flying colours. He wasn’t just a backup. He became a cornerstone.

The management sees potential, and the fans see hope. From Brevis CSK news outlets to highlight reels, there’s growing chatter that the franchise has already marked him as part of the core for the next 3-5 years. And rightly so.

And Brevis might not be done yet, he is performing even better following his IPL stint. His numbers in the Vitality Blast are a testament of the same.

Baby AB, Chennai’s Next Big Project

Dewald Brevis is still a raw product. But CSK has a history of refining raw gems into polished match-winners. Brevis, with all his flair, versatility, and untapped ceiling, is everything CSK needs in their transition era. He may have stumbled into the franchise by accident, but he’s walking into its future with purpose. 

As IPL 2026 approaches, there’s little doubt that Dewald Brevis CSK future player profile is locked in. He could be the next big overseas game-changer for a team that has always believed in turning potential into legacy.

And just maybe, Baby AB will become the King of Chennai.

content:

TSK gave it their all, led by a spectacular century from their captain, Faf du Plessis, but the Unicorns’ batting lineup proved too strong, overrunning TSK’s solid total to keep their unbeaten streak alive and breaking TSK’s back-to-back wins streak.

TSK vs SFU, Highlights, MLC 2025: TSK Batting Sets a Strong Target

He blazed his way to a spectacular 100 runs off just 51 balls, showing incredible form and power. He literally carried the TSK innings on his shoulders!

Devon Conway also added a steady 23 runs from 23 deliveries, helping to build partnerships. This loss stings for TSK, especially after Faf’s incredible century, but it also shows the high level of competition in MLC 2025. TSK put up a big score, but the Unicorns simply batted brilliantly to chase it down. TSK will learn from this game and come back stronger in their next fixture!

title: Dewald Brevis: The Baby AB Lighting Up IPL with His Explosive Batting
content:
Life has a strange way of delivering justice. For Dewald Brevis, it came in yellow.

Having set the cricketing world on fire during the ICC U19 World Cup 2022, Brevis was immediately likened to South African legend AB de Villiers.

Dubbed “Baby AB,” he captured imaginations with his fearless batting, 360-degree strokeplay, and a striking resemblance to his idol.

Brevis scored 506 runs in that tournament, breaking Shikhar Dhawan’s long-standing record. He also smashed 18 sixes, setting a new U19 record. The cricketing fraternity took note, and the IPL came calling. For CSK fans, the sight of Dewald Brevis IPL 2025 would remain fresh in their memories.

The IPL Rollercoaster: From Mumbai to Oblivion

Dewald Brevis IPL 2025 wasn’t supposed to happen. At least, not after he went unsold in the 2025 mega auction. Picked by Mumbai Indians in 2022, Brevis scored 161 runs in 7 matches but failed to secure a regular spot in a power-packed line-up.

With form dipping and options increasing, he remained in the shadows, a name fans fondly remembered but franchises avoided. He was overlooked again in 2023 and 2024, causing many to question whether his U19 heroics were one-offs.

But fate intervened in 2025. After Gurpajneet Singh injured himself mid-season, CSK went scouting for a replacement. They found Brevis.

And just like that, he got his golden ticket back to the IPL, this time wearing yellow, with the number 12 on his back—a number gifted by CSK’s management, who signed him on the 12th of the month.

Dewald Brevis IPL 2025: Turning the Tide

Dewald Brevis was the one bright spark in a forgettable season for CSK that ended with just four wins. Brought in mid-season, Brevis played 6 matches and delivered 225 runs at a stunning strike rate of 180. But stats only tell half the story.

Brevis hit 17 sixes in those 6 games, nearly 3 sixes per match. His fearless strokeplay and quick footwork dismantled spin and pace alike. Most importantly, he delivered when it mattered. In two of CSK’s four wins, Brevis was the game-changer.

One of those came against the Kolkata Knight Riders, where he walked in with CSK reeling at 66/5 and slammed a 52 (25), turning the tide single-handedly. The other was against the Gujarat Titans, where he smashed 57* (23) in a finisher role, taking CSK to 230 as they denied GT from finishing in the top 2.

He didn’t just win matches. He electrified a tired, broken middle order.

Middle-Order Makeover: Brevis Brings the Fire

When Brevis entered the CSK playing XI, there was a palpable shift in energy. His presence lifted the tempo. CSK’s middle-order had been struggling to find momentum all season. Ruturaj Gaikwad’s absence and the established players’ inconsistency left a void that needed filling. Brevis did more than fill it; he revolutionized it.

His presence and ability to bat at number 5 allowed the top order the freedom to go harder earlier. It gave Jadeja the liberty to play a pressure absorber role at number 4. Most crucially, it gave bowlers something to think about in the death overs. Dewald Brevis CSK journey in IPL 2025 was not just about runs but about aura. The man who couldn’t find a place a year ago has now become undroppable.

CSK fans, who had spent most of the season drowning in disappointment, clung to Brevis for hope. Their YouTube search history spoke volumes: Brevis batting highlights. Whether it was his momentum-shifting assault against KKR in Vaibhav Arora’s over, taking him on for 30 runs, or the reverse lap for six against Gujarat Titans, Brevis gave them reasons to smile.

Why is Brevis called Baby AB?

Because he moves like him, he thinks like him. And he dares like him.

The moniker “Baby AB” isn’t just a marketing gimmick. It’s rooted in Brevis’ cricketing DNA. From a young age, Dewald Brevis idolized AB de Villiers.

He has spoken multiple times about watching AB’s innings on a loop, mimicking his strokes, and even copying his fitness routines. Brevis trained at the same school as AB, Afrikaanse Hoër Seunskool, and dreamed of replicating the same legacy.

In fact, when asked who he models his game after, Brevis answers without hesitation: “AB, always.”

It’s not just about the unorthodox strokes. It’s the presence. The unpredictability. The fearlessness. In Dewald Brevis IPL 2025, we didn’t just see another exciting batter but glimpses of de Villiers reborn.

That’s why fans and critics alike can’t help but hope he continues on this path. The IPL has seen many stars rise and fall. But very few bring the kind of joy Brevis does.

The Road to Redemption: How Brevis Silenced Critics

Critics questioned his temperament. They said he was too flashy. They doubted his game against spin and dismissed his power game on Indian pitches. But in IPL 2025, Dewal Brevis CSK edition answered every one of them.

He faced spinners like Rashid Khan, Yuzvendra Chahal, and Sunil Narine and struck at over 150 against them. His power game didn’t just survive. It thrived. The fact that he did this with minimal preparation and match time showed immense character.

In just 6 games, Brevis transformed the perception around him. From a failed MI pick to one of the most bankable IPL 2025 rising stars.

A Season of Struggles, A Star Emerges

The Rise of Shivam Dube: CSK’s Middle-Order in IPL 2025

Injuries, inconsistency, and underperformance marred CSK’s 2025 campaign. Gaikwad fractured his hand mid-season. Foreign openers Rachin and Conway were not performing. Jadeja had patches of brilliance but couldn’t carry the team alone. The entire middle order failed. Even the usually electric Shivam Dube had to mend his ways at times.

But Dewald Brevis’ CSK signing provided a silver lining. He not only gave fans something to cheer about but also gave the management a fresh headache, in a good way. How do you build a team around a player you didn’t even plan for?

There’s now a sudden problem of plenty at the top. Even someone as impactful as Urvil Patel is struggling to break into the top 12.

What Lies Ahead: CSK’s Vision for Brevis

With 2026 approaching and CSK looking to rebuild after a disappointing season, Brevis is expected to play a key role in their retention strategy. His ability to float across the batting order, play both pace and spin and maintain an elite strike rate makes him indispensable.

CSK is known for backing players with long-term potential, and with Baby AB in their ranks, they’ve found a gem. If managed well, Dewald Brevis CSK version could become what AB de Villiers was to RCB, a franchise cornerstone.

There’s talk already of moving him to number 3 permanently. Some suggest letting him open. Whatever the role, one thing is certain: he will feature. He is now part of the CSK blueprint for the future.

Fan Frenzy: The Brevis Effect

Social media exploded after every Brevis inning. Twitter trends like #BabyAB became regular features. Even opposition fans couldn’t help but admire the audacity and flair he brought to the crease.

His iconic entry in the field, his electrifying fielding, and that calm, laser-focused stare at the bowler before unleashing carnage, all made for perfect TV. Broadcasters repeatedly played his shots in highlight reels. Kids started emulating his inside-out lofts and no-look pulls.

IPL 2025 was a disaster for CSK in the standings but a marketing goldmine thanks to Dewald Brevis.

More Than Just a Comeback

Dewald Brevis CSK signing in IPL 2025 wasn’t just a return. It was a statement. From being unsold to becoming a mainstay, Brevis proved that all he needed was a chance. Once CSK gave him that, he grabbed it with both hands and swung it for six.

With CSK rebuilding and young guns taking over, Brevis stands tall as a beacon of hope. He’s not just Baby AB anymore.

He’s Dewald Brevis. IPL’s new firestarter.

title: MLC 2025, TSK vs SO Highlights: Texas Super Kings Secure Massive 93-Run Win over Seattle
content:
MLC 2025, TSK vs SO Highlights: Texas Super Kings continued their strong run in MLC 2025 on Monday, June 17, by securing a huge 93-run victory over Seattle Orcas. In a match that saw the Orcas crumble for a mere 60 runs while chasing 154, the Super Kings claimed their third win in a row. It was a dominant performance, especially with the ball, that completely overpowered their opponents.

Earlier in the day, Texas Super Kings batted first and managed to post a total of 153 for 6 in their 20 overs. They faced some early difficulties on a slow pitch where the ball sometimes bounced oddly. Captain Faf du Plessis and Devon Conway found it tough to score quickly and left the crease early. However, Saiteja Mukkamalla and Daryl Mitchell then built a crucial 48-run partnership over six overs.

Mitchell struggled to find big hits, but Mukkamalla smashed a couple of sixes to keep the scoreboard moving. The real turning point in their innings came from Marcus Stoinis. The Australian big-hitter provided a massive boost, smashing four sixes during his quick 12-ball stay. Milind Kumar and Shubham Ranjane finished strongly, hitting two sixes and a boundary in the last over to give Super Kings a healthy total on a challenging pitch.

MLC 2025, TSK vs SO Highlights: The Trio of Zia-ul-Haq, Nandre & Ahmad Led Orcas’ Batting Collapse

Seattle Orcas’ chase quickly turned into a nightmare. Texas Super Kings’ bowlers Zia-ul-Haq and Nandre Burger delivered an incredible spell in the powerplay, tearing through the Orcas’ top batting order. They made the ball move around, constantly beating the batters or finding the edges. By the end of the fifth over, Orcas were struggling badly at 21 for 5.

The misery did not stop there, even when spin bowlers came on. Noor Ahmad joined the wicket-taking spree just two overs later, trapping Sujit Nayak and Harmeet Singh out leg-before, leaving Orcas reeling at 27 for 7.

Aaron Jones and Jasdeep Singh offered the only real resistance for Orcas, both managing to reach double-digit scores. They put together a small 18-run partnership, with Jones even hitting a six off Daryl Mitchell and another off Noor Ahmad. However, Marcus Stoinis soon ended Jones’s enterprising innings. Noor then removed Obed McCoy.

Jasdeep Singh and Waqar Salamkheil tried to extend the innings but scored very slowly before Jasdeep fell to Burger, ending Orcas’ misery at just 60 runs in less than 14 overs. Nandre Burger finished with excellent figures of 3 wickets for 10 runs, while Zia-ul-Haq also grabbed 3 wickets for 16 runs.

Texas Super Kings’ bowlers simply overwhelmed Seattle Orcas, securing a massive 93-run victory. This dominant performance underscores their strength in the MLC 2025 tournament as they celebrate their third consecutive win.

content:

This small “like” from Samson’s manager has caused a huge stir among fans. Many are seeing it as an unofficial way of saying that Sanju will leave Rajasthan Royals and start fresh with the Chennai Super Kings.

Sanju Samson Set to Join CSK in IPL 2026? Let’s see the REAL TRUTH

The idea of the Kerala-born Sanju Samson playing for CSK is making a lot of noise. Since MS Dhoni is getting closer to retiring from the IPL, everyone’s wondering who will lead CSK next, especially someone from South India. Sanju, who is from Kerala, has a huge fan base in the southern part of India. People think his calm style, big hitting, and local connection make him a perfect fit to continue CSK’s winning ways. The thought of a South Indian player leading the mighty CSK has really excited fans online.

This rumour also fits with what people are saying about the Rajasthan Royals. After another not-so-great season, it’s being said that the Royals want to try a new approach. Even though Sanju led them to the final in IPL 2022, they haven’t won the title since 2008.

Sanju Samson’s journey in the IPL has been quite a ride. He started with Kolkata Knight Riders, then played for Rajasthan Royals, then Delhi Daredevils, and then back to the Royals, where he became captain. He’s scored the most runs for Rajasthan Royals. But with his manager’s hint and the idea of him joining CSK, the IPL 2026 auction and any player trades before that are going to be very interesting to watch for Sanju Samson’s future.

title: CSK’s Retention List 2026: Who Will Stay, Who Might Go?
content:
The retention list is here and Chennai Super Kings have already moved into full-rebuild mode. After enduring the worst campaign in their 16-year history and finishing with the wooden spoon for the first time, the franchise has taken decisive action.

CSK have released 10 players, including some heavyweights, cleared major salary space, and signaled that a fresh core is coming. This is clearly a sign of major signings happening in mega auction.

As the next auction approaches, the conversation shifts to who CSK might buy, what the new spine of the team looks like, and where they’ll invest their cash. Let’s break down the updated retention picture, releases, and the direction the franchise seems to be heading as they attempt a serious comeback in IPL 2026.

CSK Retained Players – IPL 2026

The biggest win for CSK after this massive release list is simple: the core is still intact. Despite letting go of 10 players, the spine of the squad remains strong, and that changes everything. This isn’t a franchise starting from zero. This is a franchise clearing clutter to sharpen the structure.

Which means the upcoming auction won’t be a demolition job. It will be precise gap-filling. And to understand why CSK can still compete, all you need to do is look at who’s still here.

Ruturaj Gaikwad (Captain)

The torchbearer post-Dhoni era, Ruturaj Gaikwad, will undoubtedly headline the CSK retention list for IPL 2026. Despite missing half the season due to a hand fracture, Gaikwad showed his class in his six games, scoring two fifties, including a match-winning knock against Mumbai Indians.

His great batting prowess in the past few season ensures his long-term association with CSK seems inevitable.

Sanju Samson

Sanju Samson’s trade to CSK has given the team a massive boost. Samson is an aggressive opener with 4,707 IPL runs in 177 matches at a 140 strike rate. He strengthens the top order, offers a ready wicket-keeping successor to Dhoni, and at 31, brings five strong years of leadership potential to shape CSK’s next core.

Aayush Mhatre

One of the biggest positives of IPL 2025 is Ayush Mhatre. The 17-year-old replacement for Gaikwad made a big impression with 240 runs in 7 innings at a strike rate of 180. His 94 against RCB in a crunch chase has sealed his place in the squad.

Urvil Patel

Urvil Patel had just a 3-match window but struck at a staggering rate of 213. His aggressive starts at the top have earned him a place in the CSK retained players list.

Dewald Brevis (Overseas)

Apart from Mhatre, if someone was able to impress us the most, then it has to be Dewald Brevis. The “Baby AB” came, saw, and conquered the hearts of the CSK family.

In 6 matches, he smashed 225 runs at a strike rate of 180, with two match-winning fifties. He is destined to be a part of CSK’s future middle-order blueprint.

Shivam Dube

In recent years, Dube has become synonymous with CSK’s batting power in the middle overs. Across four seasons (2022–2025), he has 1460 runs, 9 fifties, and 100 sixes at a strike rate of 150+. He’s going nowhere.

Khaleel Ahmed

A bright spot from the mega auction, Khaleel stood out as the go-to bowlers in the first 6 overs of the inning for CSK. He struck early in powerplays and picked up 15 wickets in 14 games. He fills the Deepak Chahar role and will be a key Indian pacer going forward.

Noor Ahmad (Overseas)

CSK’s best performer in 2025. The Afghan wrist spinner bagged 24 wickets in 14 matches and is now the trump card in the CSK retention list for IPL 2026.

Anshul Kambhoj

The India A prospect has shown discipline and promise. His 8 wickets in 8 matches and 8 economy make him a trusted option in the powerplay.

Nathan Ellis (Overseas)

Recent matches have shown that CSK had a gem hidden in Ellis. In Australia, he showed that he is one of the best in business. Hence, his performance was rewarded with a retention by CSK. A Big Bash League-winning captain and preferred over Cummins in the T20 WC, Ellis offers tight lines with new ball and great variations in the death overs.

Mukesh Choudhary

Although he hasn’t hit previous highs, Mukesh’s 2022 season (16 wickets) showed potential. He missed 2023 and has played only 3 games since. He will likely be kept as a backup seamer.

MS Dhoni

If MS Dhoni chooses to continue, he will be retained for some time. Though listed as uncapped, his leadership and brand value transcend all stats.

Jamie Overton

The unlikely name, and the only third overseas player retained by CSK was Overton. But things make sense, if we take a look at his stats in T20s. He brings serious utility to the table: in his T20 career he’s taken 149 wickets in 130 matches at an average of 23.55 and strike rate of 8.17. His pace, long reach, and lower-order hitting make him perfect for the backend—either breaking partnerships with the ball or hitting big when it counts.

Ramakrishna Ghosh

Ramakrishna Ghosh gives CSK a rare mix of pace and raw hitting, something you don’t find often in Indian domestic cricket. His retention fits the squad. He also plays with Gaikwad for Maharashtra, so the captain has likely seen his potential up close.

Shreyas Gopal

Following the departure of Jadeja, Gopal becomes the most experienced player in the bowling line up for CSK. He is an IPL veteran who has represented 3 franchises. In his 10 year long career, he has picked 49 wickets, in as many appearances.

CSK 2026 Released Players

Here are the CSK 2026 released players, most of whom didn’t make the impact expected or were surplus to requirement:

  • Ravichandran Ashwin
  • Ravindra Jadeja
  • Sam Curran
  • Rahul Tripathi
  • Deepak Hooda
  • Vijay Shankar
  • Rachin Ravindra
  • Devon Conway
  • Ramakrishna Ghosh
  • Kamlesh Nagarkoti
  • C. Andre Siddarth
  • Shaik Rasheed

Releasing these players has cleared over 40 crores for CSK, ahead of the mini auction.

IPL 2026 Retention Strategy: What CSK Needs

CSK’s IPL 2026 retention strategy will revolve around plugging a few critical gaps while keeping its core intact.

Indian Left Arm Spinner

CSK lacks a genuine Indian spinner who can weave a web around batters in middle overs. While Sheryas Gopal is decent, someone needs to step in to fill the big void that is left by the absence of Ravindra Jadeja.

Overseas Slot Management

With four players leaving the side, CSK will need overseas firepower. And chances are that some big names might end up being a part of the squad for the next season.

Potential targets:

  • Andre Russell
  • Glenn Maxwell
  • Liam Livingstone
  • Cameroon Green

These all-rounders can slot in at No. 6/7 and contribute in both departments. With Ruturaj likely to bat at No. 3, CSK will also look for a solid overseas opener to partner with Aayush Mhatre or try one of Samson or Patel in that slot.

Predicted CSK Playing XI for IPL 2026 (Based on Retentions)

  1. Aayush Mhatre 
  2. Sanju Samson
  3. Ruturaj Gaikwad (C)
  4. Shivam Dube
  5. Dewald Brevis
  6. All-Rounder (Overseas)
  7. All-rounder (Overseas TBA Maxi/Russell)
  8. MS Dhoni (wicketkeeper)
  9. Indian Spinner (TBA)/ Anshul Kambhoj
  10. Noor Ahmad (Overseas)
  11. Khaleel Ahmed
  12. Nathan Ellis(Overseas)

Suddenly, CSK finds itself with a problem of plenty at the top. Even someone as impactful as Urvil Patel struggles to break into the top 12.

The CSK retention list for IPL 2026 reflects both loyalty and a shift towards youth and impact players. While the team had a dismal 2025 season, the emergence of players like Mhatre, Noor Ahmad, and Brevis gives fans hope. Backed by a smart IPL 2026 retention strategy, CSK is poised for a strong comeback.

With a blend of experience and youth, CSK’s next chapter could mark the rise of a new dynasty, this time led by Ruturaj Gaikwad. Whether Dhoni plays or mentors from the sidelines, the spirit of CSK is intact.

FAQ

Who is the best player in CSK 2025?

Ruturaj Gaikwad is the best player in CSK for 2025. As a key batsman, he consistently delivers strong performances, anchoring innings and scoring crucial runs. His technique, temperament, and ability to handle pressure make him CSK’s standout player and a vital contributor to the team’s success in the 2025 season.

Who is best, CSK or RCB?

Chennai Super Kings (CSK) are considered better than Royal Challengers Bangalore (RCB). With more IPL titles, consistent performances, and a history of strong team management, CSK has proven their dominance over the years. Their experience, balanced squad, and winning mentality give them an edge over RCB in the league.

Who is the owner of CSK

N. Srinivasan and his family are the owners of Chennai Super Kings (CSK) through Chennai Super Kings Cricket Limited (CSKCL). He is a prominent Indian industrialist, a former BCCI president, and serves as the chairman of CSKCL, overseeing the franchise’s operations and strategic decisions.

title: Noor Ahmad's 4-fer Helps TSK Reign Supreme over Knight Riders
content:
MLC 2025, TSK vs LAKR Highlight: For the second game in a row, TSK stepped up to bat first in MLC 2025, and for the second game in a row, TSK posted a strong total and grabbed a fantastic victory. This time, TSK delivered a dominant 57-run win against the Los Angeles Knight Riders, pushing their record to two wins from two in the tournament.

Unlike the thrilling last-ball finish against MI New York, TSK secured this win with a commanding display, particularly from their bowlers. While the batting effort saw contributions from many, Adam Milne and Noor Ahmad truly starred in the bowling department.

Texas Super Kings’ Bowlers Lead a Commanding Victory for Second Time in Row

When LAKR came in to chase TSK’s target of 182, TSK’s bowlers quickly seized control. Milne claimed Andre Fletcher as his first victim early in their innings. Although Alex Hales and Unmukt Chand attempted to build a partnership, they struggled to find momentum as TSK maintained constant pressure. Chand then tried to establish another partnership with Matthew Tromp, who showed some aggression, but TSK’s bowlers never allowed them to settle.

Milne bowled incredibly, taking an early wicket and then finishing LAKR’s collapse by dismissing Tanveer Sangha. He completed his spell with amazing figures of 3.1 overs, conceding just 8 runs for 2 wickets. Noor Ahmad was absolutely sensational, tearing through LAKR’s middle and lower order.

He picked up crucial wickets, including Andre Russell, Sunil Narine, and Matthew Tromp, after already dismissing Nitish Kumar earlier. Noor finished with an outstanding 4 wickets for just 25 runs, completely dismantling their batting lineup.

MLC 2025, TSK vs LAKR Highlight: TSK Batters Set the Stage Early in the Game

Earlier, after TSK won the toss and chose to bat, Devon Conway provided a solid start with a good 34 runs off 22 balls. His partnership with Saiteja Mukkamalla, who aggressively scored 31 off 22, gave TSK a strong foundation. They combined for 57 runs in just 5.1 overs. With 74 runs on the board after eight overs, TSK knew they were headed for a great score.

Daryl Mitchell (a crucial 36 not out off 33 balls), Shubham Ranjane (24 off 19), and especially Donovan Ferreira (an explosive 32 not out off just 16 balls) ensured TSK reached the strong total they desired. Ferreira was outstanding, striking at 200, one of the day’s best strike rates. His hitting in the final overs was key to TSK reaching 181 for 4. Ultimately, this score proved far too many for LAKR to chase.

title: The Ravindra Jadeja Effect: His Role & Impact on CSK’s IPL 2025 Journey
content:
When it comes to consistency, resilience, and undying spirit, Ravindra Jadeja has always been the heartbeat of the Chennai Super Kings. Affectionately called CSK’s golden boy, Jadeja has never been far from the action, be it bat, ball, or field.

His loyalty, grit, and game awareness have made him a vital cog in the franchise. The 2025 season, despite being one of CSK’s worst in terms of results, only cemented his reputation further as CSK’s best all-rounder.

After a dismal auction and poor team planning that saw CSK finish as wooden spooners with just 4 wins, Jadeja stood tall. His impact, both visible and intangible, was monumental. Here’s a deep dive into Ravindra Jadeja’s impact in CSK during the turbulent IPL 2025 season.

CSK’s Auction Woes & Team Misfires

A lot of CSK’s downfall in 2025 stemmed from poor auction decisions. The management invested in Deepak Hooda, Rahul Tripathi, and Vijay Shankar to bolster the middle order. The results were disastrous:

  • Deepak Hooda: 31 runs in 7 matches
  • Rahul Tripathi: 55 runs in 5 matches
  • Vijay Shankar: 118 runs in 6 matches

Add to that a misfiring opener in Rachin Ravindra, and CSK’s top order looked bleak. The batting lacked intent and consistency until mid-season changes brought in exciting names like Ayush Mhatre, Dewald Brevis, and Urvil Patel.

Ravindra Jadeja Impact in CSK

Jadeja has been an integral part of the Chennai Super Kings side. Only a chosen few might be aware of the Jadeja match-winning spells, or those finishing shots that launched CSK to new highs. In short, Jadeja is CSK’s best-all rounder.

Yet many remember him for just one iconic moments, the 2023 IPL final. With 10 runs needed off the last two balls against Gujarat Titans, Jadeja hit a six and a four to secure one of the most dramatic wins in IPL history. That clutch moment isn’t just legendary; it’s proof of his unshakable nerves and big-match temperament.

With that being said, in a season that was not the best for the men in yellow, Jadeja stood out as one of the regular performers. Hence, let’s take a look at his Role & Impact on CSK’s IPL 2025 Journey.

Jadeja at No. 4: A Tactical Shift That Delivered

With CSK struggling, Jadeja was promoted to No. 4, a move that turned out to be a rare positive in their campaign.

  • Matches: 14
  • Runs: 301
  • Strike Rate: 135
  • 50s: 2 (Against MI and RCB)

Against Mumbai Indians, Jadeja’s 50+ score helped CSK post 176. In a tense chase versus RCB, he remained unbeaten on 77 off 45 balls, nearly pulling off a win single-handedly.

Despite CSK’s flaws, Jadeja’s performance in IPL 2025 was a masterclass in grit and adaptability.

Jadeja with the Ball: Underutilized Yet Effective

It was surprising to see a bowler of Jadeja’s calibre being under-bowled:

  • Overs Bowled: 37.5 (Out of a possible 56)
  • Wickets: 10
  • Economy Rate: Over 8 (for the first time in 5 years)

CSK’s decision to rope in R. Ashwin and Noor Ahmad meant that Jadeja was often sidelined during crucial overs. He bowled 12.1 overs fewer than expected, equivalent to three full matches. This tactical oversight prevented him from delivering his usual match-winning spells during the middle overs.

Jadeja Does the Job of Three

If there’s one player who truly defines the term ‘three-dimensional cricketer’, it’s Ravindra Jadeja.

  • With the Ball: A match-winning spinner who builds pressure and breaks partnerships.
  • In the Field: A livewire who saves 10–15 runs every game and takes stunning catches.
  • With the Bat: A finisher, a floater, a rescuer, whatever the team needs.

In essence, Jadeja does the work of three players in one. This unique versatility is what makes him one of the greatest players in IPL history, and undoubtedly the best all-rounder CSK has ever had. His presence lifts the team, and his absence is glaring.

CSK’s Best All-Rounder: Unmatched Legacy in Yellow

Ravindra Jadeja has been a vital cog for Chennai Super Kings since 2012. Over the years, he has amassed 143 wickets and 2198 runs, firmly establishing himself as CSK’s best all-rounder. He was pivotal in the title-winning campaigns of 2018, 2021, and 2023.

In 2021, Jadeja was named the franchise’s MVP, scoring 227 runs at a strike rate of 145 and taking 13 wickets in just 13 matches. And of course, his unforgettable heroics in the 2023 final, a six and a four in the last two balls, remain etched in CSK folklore. His unmatched ability to influence games with bat, ball, and in the field puts him in a league of his own.

Mentoring the Next Gen

Jadeja’s impact extended beyond performance. As the likes of Brevis, Urvil, and Ayush entered the squad, Jadeja transitioned into a mentor. He played anchor when needed and let the young guns shine. His adaptability and guidance were crucial in stabilizing the middle order during the latter half of the season.

Jadeja for CSK in 2025: Season of Grit

In the whirlwind of CSK’s forgettable season, Jadeja CSK 2025 stood out as a pillar of grit and effort. Despite being under-bowled, Jadeja continued delivering subtle match-turning moments with the few overs he got. His lower-order fireworks and two fifties added crucial runs while his fielding remained elite. Among these sparks were some of Jadeja’s match-winning spells, where even a couple of wickets were enough to pull CSK back into the contest. 

In one of the most memorable innings of Jadeja’s IPL career, he scored 77 against RCB* while chasing a mammoth 214. Though CSK fell short by just 2 runs, Jadeja’s knock reminded everyone why he remains a force to be reckoned with. It was a display of clean hitting, smart rotation, and unwavering composure under pressure. His all-round contributions in 2025 were a silver lining in an otherwise gloomy season.

Should CSK release Ravindra Jadeja?

Just like one bad season cannot and should not dictate or define CSK’s legacy, the same is true for Jadeja. One bad season where the team failed as a collective unit, putting the blame on Jadeja doesn’t make much sense.

While Subramaniam Badrinath controversially suggested that CSK should release Jadeja to rebuild around Gaikwad, fans and several analysts believe otherwise. With MS Dhoni’s future uncertain, Jadeja’s leadership, experience, and balance are more crucial than ever.

He is not just a cricketer; he’s a system. A player who can bowl, bat, and field at world-class levels and still find time to lead and mentor. Ravindra Jadeja’s impact in CSK is simply irreplaceable.

Looking Ahead to IPL 2026

As CSK moves into a rebuilding phase under Ruturaj Gaikwad, Jadeja’s role becomes even more vital. With a younger, more dynamic team and with the right acquisitions in the mini-auction, CSK could rise again, and Jadeja will be at the core of that resurgence.

Expect him to bowl more, guide the middle order, and continue delivering the standard renowned and famed Jadeja match-winning spells with both ball and bat. He may not always be loud, but his impact is thunderous.

The Ravindra Jadeja Impact in CSK is Timeless

The 2025 season may go down as CSK’s worst, but it also highlighted their biggest asset, Ravindra Jadeja. With 301 runs, 10 wickets, and irreplaceable fielding and leadership, Jadeja once again proved his worth.

He’s not just CSK’s best all-rounder; he is the emotional and tactical engine of the team. Jadeja’s performance in IPL 2025 was a shining beacon in a forgettable campaign. His consistency, versatility, and fighting spirit are what keep the Ravindra Jadeja impact in CSK alive and thriving.

Heading into 2026, CSK’s hopes may rest on a new generation, but the foundation is still very much Jaddu-powered.

title: The Rise of Shivam Dube: CSK’s Middle-Order in IPL 2025
content:
The curtains have come down on IPL 2025, and while the season brought jubilation to Royal Challengers Bangalore with their first-ever IPL title, it was a historic low for Chennai Super Kings.

For the first time in their history, CSK ended as the wooden spooners, finishing last in the points table. Yet, amidst the wreckage of a disappointing season, one man stood tall – Shivam Dube.

Lovingly dubbed “Aaru Saamy” by the Chennai faithful – a nod to a Tamil action hero (with “Aaru” meaning six and “Saamy” meaning god) – Shivam Dube IPL 2025 campaign was less about brute six-hitting and more about resilience, adaptability, and leadership in the face of adversity.

In this article, we will explore about how CSK’s Middle-Order in IPL 2025 was a wreck, yet Dube emerged as the lone warrior for his side.

CSK’s Middle Order in 2025: A Void Waiting to Be Filled

Chennai went into IPL 2025 with several gaps in their middle order. Veteran Ambati Rayudu retired in 2023, while experienced hands Ajinkya Rahane and Daryl Mitchell were released ahead of the mega auction. The team was rebuilding, placing its faith in fresh Indian faces and retaining Dube as a key middle-order pillar.

However, CSK’s auction strategy failed to deliver. Their new acquisitions – Vijay Shankar, Deepak Hooda, and Rahul Tripathi – failed to live up to expectations. With Rachin Ravindra out of form and MS Dhoni not physically at his peak to bat higher in the order, it was up to Dube to carry the load.

And that’s exactly what he did.

From Shivam Sixer Dube to CSK’s Senior Anchor

When Shivam Dube arrived at CSK during the 2022 mega auction, he was seen as a designated spin basher – someone who could come in and tear apart opposition bowlers in the middle overs. And for three seasons, that’s exactly the role he played. Known for his towering sixes and brute power, he quickly earned the nickname “Shivam Sixer Dube.”

Across his four seasons with CSK (2022–2025), he has played 55 matches, scored 1460 runs, smashed 9 fifties, and maintained a strike rate of over 150. Importantly, he has cleared the ropes 100 times, often lifting CSK from tricky situations or accelerating after solid starts. In CSK’s victorious 2023 campaign, he tallied 418 runs and sent 35 sixes soaring into the stands – a true embodiment of a power hitter.

A New Role in IPL 2025

But 2025 brought a new challenge.

CSK lost five of its first six matches, and Captain Ruturaj Gaikwad suffered a season-ending injury. The team looked devoid of intent and direction. Amidst this chaos, Dube had to reinvent himself.

Instead of being the free-flowing six-hitter, he became the glue holding the batting unit together. He adapted from a carefree destroyer of spin to a responsible middle-order veteran. His strike rate dipped to 132.22, his lowest since joining CSK, but his contributions became far more meaningful and situationally aware.

Shivam Dube IPL 2025 Stats

  • Matches: 14
  • Runs: 357
  • Strike Rate: 132.22
  • Fifties: 1

What these numbers don’t show is the context. In a season where CSK managed only four wins, Shivam Dube was the match-winner in two of them.

  • Against Lucknow Super Giants, CSK were tottering at 111/5, chasing 167. Dube’s gritty 43 off 37 balls*, coupled with a Dhoni flourish (26 off 11), sealed a rare win.
  • In a pressure-filled chase against KKR, he scored a patient yet impactful 45 off 40 balls, guiding the team home in a low-scoring thriller.

These weren’t innings that made highlight reels for monstrous sixes, but they earned respect – from fans, critics, and teammates alike.

CSK Middle Order 2025: A Misfiring Core with One Bright Spark

To put things into perspective, CSK’s investment in Indian middle-order options fell flat in IPL 2025. Deepak Hooda managed just 31 runs in 7 matches, Rahul Tripathi added 55 in 5 games, and Vijay Shankar, the best of the lot, scraped together 118 runs in 6 appearances.

With the trio failing to provide any stability or firepower, CSK’s batting frequently crumbled under pressure. But amidst this misfiring core, Shivam Dube soared high. While others faltered, Dube carried the responsibility of the middle order almost single-handedly, showcasing maturity, adaptability, and a quiet dominance that set him apart from his peers.

He may not feature among the typical IPL 2025 power hitters, but a deeper Dube performance analysis highlights his transformation. He anchors the innings, absorbs pressure, and registers his lowest strike rate since joining CSK, all while others fail to step up.

The Evolution of Shivam Dube: More Than Just a Power Hitter

Shivam Dube sixes have always been a part of the all rounders’ charm. But in IPL 2025, fans saw a cricketer who’s matured, understands game situations, and doesn’t shy away from responsibility. He isn’t just a slugger anymore; he’s become a thinker, a leader, and a mainstay in the CSK middle order for 2025 and beyond.

His ability to rotate strike, absorb pressure, and anchor innings despite wickets falling around him speaks volumes about how much he’s grown. In a format often dominated by flashy cameos, Dube is proving that adaptability is a superpower.

CSK’s Future Core: Young Blood and Experienced Shoulders

The 2025 season might have ended in disappointment, but it has planted seeds for CSK’s future. With Ayush Mhatre, Dewald Brevis, and Urvil Patel breaking into the XI and showing flashes of brilliance, the next generation is knocking.

But youth alone doesn’t win titles.

Chennai needs someone who bridges the gap between the old guard and the new flame—someone who understands the franchise’s culture, the demands of finishing, and the responsibility of rebuilding. That someone is Shivam Dube.

Under Ruturaj Gaikwad’s leadership, CSK will need Dube not just as a batter but also as a mentor, guiding force, and stabilizing presence in the middle order.

Dube’s India Ambitions: Rekindled or Rewritten?

Dube has flirted with the Indian team, playing T20Is and ODIs sporadically. He played a decent hand in India’s 2024 T20 World Cup winning triumph. With his kind of power-hitting and now demonstrated versatility, can a national comeback be on the cards?

Possibly, but that depends on India’s white-ball plans and how Dube fares in domestic cricket and IPL 2026. What is clear, though, is that he’s no longer a one-trick pony. He has shown the grit to adapt, the skill to execute, and the hunger to fight – even when the chips are down. 

Shivam Dube IPL 2025 performance may not visibly warrant a place in the national squad based on numbers alone. Still, a deeper look reveals the immense value he brings in terms of temperament and adaptability.

Shivam Dube sixes could answer India’s ongoing search for middle-order aggression ahead of the 2026 T20 World Cup. If India is ever looking for a flexible, left-handed middle-order option who can finish games and chip in with the ball when required, Shivam Dube’s name will be hard to ignore.

The Pillar CSK Never Knew They Needed

IPL 2025 may not go down as a season to remember for Chennai Super Kings, but Shivam Dube’s rise as a dependable middle-order batter is a silver lining in an otherwise dark cloud. While others faltered, he held the fort. While others lost rhythm, he found his groove in new ways.

He may not have hit as many sixes as before. But he hit the right notes at the right time – the hallmark of a true professional.

As CSK rebuilds for the future, one thing is certain – the middle order will be built around Shivam Dube, the new “Aaru Saamy” of Chennai. A sixer god, yes. But also a pillar of patience, power, and promise.

title: Texas Super Kings vs Seattle Orcas 2026 Match Preview
content:

title: Will MS Dhoni Play in IPL 2026? What Fans and Experts Are Saying
content:
Will Dhoni play IPL 2026? That’s the burning question every Chennai Super Kings (CSK) fan asks these days. As MS Dhoni, the heart and soul of CSK, walked off the field after their final game in IPL 2025, the world of cricket once again found itself glued to a single man’s decision.

With five IPL titles as captain, an iconic legacy, and unwavering fan support, MS Dhoni’s IPL future is more than just a cricketing decision; it’s about emotions, identity, and legacy.

The 2025 season was turbulent for CSK. After a promising start, captain Ruturaj Gaikwad’s unfortunate injury mid-season saw MS Dhoni don the captain’s hat again. Yet, the return of the ‘Thala’ couldn’t stop the free fall.

CSK finished as wooden spooners for the first time in IPL history, winning only four matches. Amid the gloom, the spotlight remained fixed on one man, MS Dhoni. Let’s examine what he said, what experts predict, and what it truly means for CSK and Indian cricket fans.

Dhoni’s Final Words in IPL 2025: Hint or Goodbye?

After CSK’s final league match win over Gujarat Titans, MS Dhoni addressed the post-match presentation with a heartfelt note:

“There is no escaping the fact that I am in the last phase of my career. After this IPL gets over, I have to work hard for another 6–8 months to see if my body can take this pressure. I have another 4-5 months to decide.”

He didn’t confirm his retirement, and he didn’t deny it either. It was vintage Dhoni: calm, composed, and cryptic.

This statement has left fans divided. Some see it as a farewell speech in disguise. Others believe he’s gearing up for one final roar in IPL 2026. After all, the man has defied the odds time and again.

MS Dhoni Retirement 2025: A Decision Still Hanging

MS Dhoni had already passed on the captaincy baton to Ruturaj Gaikwad after winning IPL 2023. Many believed that was Dhoni’s curtain call, but the legend returned for IPL 2024 and 2025 in a supporting role.

In 2025, his batting form raised eyebrows, with 196 runs from 14 matches at a strike rate of 135. It’s not terrible, but it’s far from Dhoni, who used to finish games in his sleep. His inability to close out a few chases and slowing down while keeping sparked criticism. Still, Dhoni brushed off concerns with his trademark wit:

“If cricketers took retirement for poor form, most of them would retire at 22.”

That single quote summarizes MS Dhoni’s mindset, which is that retirement will be on his terms.

Expert Opinions on Dhoni IPL Future: Divided But Hopeful

Former India and CSK batter Robin Uthappa, speaking on JioStar, believes the spark is still alive:

“It all depends on his health and how he feels. The fire still burns to win championships. If he can bring his body back to the level he wants, he’ll play. If not, we’ll see a tweet or an Instagram post before the mini-auction.”

On the flip side, Aakash Chopra and Sanjay Bangar publicly urged Dhoni to retire during the season. They pointed out his declining form and lack of on-field impact.

Former Australian captain Michael Clarke took a contrasting stand on his podcast, boldly predicting: “Dhoni, Kohli, and Rohit will all play one more IPL season. You can’t write them off that easily.”

Meanwhile, Suresh Raina, the man closest to Dhoni on and off the field, was certain: “He’ll play one more season. Mark my words.”

But not all voices were in Dhoni’s corner. Sanjay Manjrekar stirred controversy, stating: “Dhoni’s presence in CSK is more for brand value than cricketing value. His keeping is still great, but the team doesn’t rely on him to bat anymore.”

Even former India cricketer Manoj Tiwary shared a pointed view on Cricbuzz: “He should’ve retired after winning the 2023 IPL. That would’ve been a perfect ending.”

CSK 2026: A New Era Under Ruturaj Gaikwad

Regardless of Dhoni’s decision, CSK have a new core in place. With Gaikwad expected to return as the full-time CSK 2026 captain, the team is slowly transitioning into a fresh era. The franchise has already identified key young talents like Dewald Brevis, Urvil Patel, Ayush Mhatre, Anshul Kamboj, and Khaleel Ahmed as the future building blocks.

Although the 2025 season may have ended in disappointment, the talent pool and structure remain strong. With two to three smart acquisitions and a fully fit Gaikwad, CSK looks poised to bounce back in IPL 2026.

Yet, the Dhoni-sized hole in the team, whether in the dressing room or out in the middle, will be impossible to fill.

The Emotional Connect: Fans Want One More Dance

Ask any CSK fan, Will Dhoni play IPL 2026? and they’ll tell you, They want that answer to be yes.

MS Dhoni once jokingly said: “Even when I’m in a wheelchair, these guys would pull me over.”

That one line reflects the deep bond between Dhoni and the fans. For most CSK supporters, Dhoni is not just a player; he is the identity of the franchise. Whether it’s his calm decision-making, his unbeatable leadership, or his understated humour, Dhoni is irreplaceable.

Even as he was recently inducted into the Hall of Fame, the 11th Indian to receive the honour, there was more talk about his future than his past. That tells you the legend is not done, at least not in the hearts of the fans.

Dhoni IPL Future: What’s Likely to Happen?

Based on his own statements, MS Dhoni will make a final decision 4–5 months after IPL 2025. This timeline aligns with pre-auction preparations for IPL 2026. If his body holds up after rehab and training, don’t be surprised if he returns, not necessarily as a captain or regular starter, but as a player-mentor, a guiding light from behind the stumps.

Given CSK’s young core, his experience could be more valuable than ever. Even if he bats at No. 8 or 9, Dhoni’s presence adds immeasurable confidence to the team.

That said, if his fitness doesn’t meet his high standards, expect a quiet retirement announcement on Instagram, just like in 2020.

So, will Dhoni play in IPL 2026?

As of now, the answer lies in his body and his will. MS Dhoni has never chased farewell tours or grand exits. He’s always been about the team, the process, and playing with dignity. While his form may have dipped, the flame hasn’t died.

Until he speaks again, the cricketing world will keep waiting, hoping, and believing that maybe, just maybe, there’s one last dance left in the legend.

Whether it’s the MS Dhoni retirement 2025, the Dhoni IPL future, or speculations about the Dhoni last IPL, one thing is certain, Thala wont leave quietly.

title: Conway-Milne Help Texas Super Kings Secure 3-Run Win in A Nail-Biter Vs MI New York
content:
TSK vs MINY, MLC 2025, Highlight: The 2025 Major League Cricket (MLC) season is already full of amazing games, and the second match was a total nail-biter! In a clash between two teams whose ‘sister’ franchises have a storied IPL rivalry, the Texas Super Kings (TSK) clinched a sensational three-run victory over MI New York (MINY) in a game packed with dramatic twists and turns.

MI New York led to a shaky start while chasing 186 runs. They lost three wickets very quickly, including their captain Nicholas Pooran. But Monank Patel stayed strong, and even though it was tough early on, he started hitting the ball well and got a half-century (50 runs). Bracewell gave him great support, and these two put together a strong partnership of 97 runs, bringing MI New York right back into the game.

But just when things started looking good for them, Adam Milne and Daryl Mitchell turned the game around for TSK. Milne was fantastic, picking up his third wicket by getting Bracewell out. But the real game-changer came when Mitchell was involved in two amazing run-outs on back-to-back balls! First, he got the dangerous Kieron Pollard out, and then, immediately after, he got Monank Patel run out too! Those were incredible moments that swung the game in TSK’s favor.

Even after that, Trent Boult and Tajinder Dhillon tried to keep MI New York’s hopes alive with some late hits, but they just couldn’t get them over the line. TSK needed them to fall short by nine runs in the final over, and Mitchell bowled cleverly to make sure that happened.

TSK vs MINY, MLC 2025, Highlight: Conway-Savage Help Super Kings Reach 180+ Mark

Earlier in the game, TSK were asked to bat first, and TSK finished with a strong score of 185 for 6. Devon Conway was our anchor, playing a solid innings of 65 runs off 44 balls. But the real hero of our batting was Calvin Savage, who was eventually named Player of the Match! He smashed an unbeaten 53 runs off just 34 balls in the final overs, which really boosted our total. Until Savage’s fireworks, MI New York’s bowlers had mostly kept things under control, with Michael Bracewell taking two important wickets.

Brief Scores: Texas Super Kings 185/6 in 20 overs (Devon Conway 65, Calvin Savage 53*; Michael Bracewell 2-34) beat MI New York 182/8 in 20 overs (Monank Patel 62; Adam Milne 3-22) by 3 runs.

title: MS Dhoni Inducted ICC Hall of Fame 2025
content:
Former India captain MS Dhoni has been officially inducted into the ICC Hall of Fame 2025, marking a proud moment for Indian cricket and fans around the world. The International Cricket Council made this special announcement just before the World Test Championship final at Lord’s, celebrating Dhoni’s exceptional 14-year international career.

MS Dhoni inducted ICC is a historic achievement that honours his success in all formats of the game. He remains the only captain in cricket history to win all three major ICC white-ball trophies, the 2007 T20 World Cup, the 2011 ODI World Cup, and the 2013 Champions Trophy. Dhoni also led India to the top of the ICC Test rankings in the late 2000s, showcasing his leadership across formats.

ICC Honours MS Dhoni with Hall of Fame 2025 Induction

Looking at MS Dhoni cricket statistics, he played 350 One Day Internationals, scoring 10,773 runs, which was his strongest format. In addition, he played 90 Tests and 98 T20 Internationals, having made his international debut in December 2004.

Over his career, he scored more than 15,000 international runs and hit 16 centuries. As a wicketkeeper, he completed 829 dismissals, underlining his all-round brilliance. His highest score as captain, 183 not out against Sri Lanka in 2005, is still MS Dhoni highest score in ODIs and remains one of the finest innings ever by a wicketkeeper-batter.

ICC Hall of Fame 2025: Matthew Hayden & Other Honorary Mentions

The ICC Hall of Fame 2025 class also includes other global cricket icons. From South Africa, Graeme Smith and Hashim Amla were inducted. Smith was the youngest Test captain at 22 and led South Africa in over 100 Tests. Amla scored 56 centuries across formats and averaged over 46 in both Tests and ODIs.

Australia’s Matthew Hayden was honoured as well. Known for his aggressive style, Hayden scored 8,625 runs in 103 Tests and holds the highest individual score by an Australian in Tests, 380 runs against Zimbabwe. He was also a key player in Australia’s 2007 World Cup-winning team.

Daniel Vettori of New Zealand, one of the most successful left-arm spinners in cricket, was also inducted. He took 667 international wickets and scored over 4,500 runs as a dependable lower-order batter.

Women’s cricket legends Sarah Taylor from England and Sana Mir from Pakistan also joined the ICC Hall of Fame 2025. Both were pioneers in their countries and played major roles in the development of women’s cricket worldwide.

MS Dhoni’s induction into the ICC Hall of Fame 2025 celebrates his legendary journey and secures his place among cricket’s all-time greats.

title: Ruturaj Gaikwad to join Yorkshire for County Championship, One-Day Cup
content:
Indian cricketer and CSK captain Ruturaj Gaikwad is set to play for Yorkshire County Cricket Club in England for the rest of the 2025 season. He will take part in five County Championship matches starting in July and also play in the Metro Bank One-Day Cup. This is a big step in Gaikwad’s career as he prepares to face the challenges of English domestic cricket.

Gaikwad, who is 28 years old, is currently the captain of Chennai Super Kings (CSK) in the Indian Premier League. He has played six One-Day Internationals (ODIs) and 23 T20 matches for India. He has a good record in first-class cricket, with an average of 41.77 and seven centuries. In List A cricket (50-over matches), he is even better, with an average of 56.15 and 16 hundreds. Right now, he is touring England with the India A team, getting ready for this new opportunity.

“I’m excited to join Yorkshire”: Ruturaj Gaikwad on His County Championship Inclusion

Speaking about the move, Gaikwad said, “I’m excited to join Yorkshire for the rest of the season. Playing cricket in England has always been one of my dreams. Yorkshire is the biggest and one of the most respected clubs in the country. I know it’s an important part of the season, and I want to perform well. The County Championship is very competitive, and the One-Day Cup is a good chance to win a trophy.”

Yorkshire’s head coach Anthony McGrath welcomed Gaikwad, saying, “We’re very happy to have Ruturaj with us. He’s a classy player with a strong all-round game. He can give our batting more strength and score runs quickly when needed. He’s an exciting talent who’s respected in the cricket world.”

Gavin Hamilton, Yorkshire’s general manager of cricket, also shared his thoughts. “Ruturaj has done well in all formats of the game. He’s a flexible and smart cricketer who will help our team a lot. We’re looking forward to having him join us in July.”

Gaikwad has been out of action since early April due to an elbow injury he suffered during the IPL. Playing in England will not only help him get back to top form but also give him valuable experience in tough conditions. His signing is a big boost for Yorkshire as they aim for strong results in both competitions this season.

Who is the Texas Super Kings Captain 2025?

Faf du Plessis, the TSK captain, needs no introduction in the world of T20 cricket. A former South African captain and a long-time Chennai Super Kings stalwart, Faf has been integral in shaping match-winning moments across global T20 leagues.

Now, as the TSK team captain, Faf’s influence extends beyond the bat. His leadership style is defined by composure under pressure, clear communication, and an ability to bring out the best in his players.

Stephen Fleming and Faf du Plessis: A Proven Formula

Supporting Faf’s captaincy is legendary coach Stephen Fleming, the man behind Chennai Super Kings’ multiple IPL triumphs. Fleming’s understanding of the game, especially T20s, is unparalleled. His chemistry with Faf, developed over the years in Chennai, will be a key asset in MLC 2025 captaincy decisions.

Fleming allows his captains room to express themselves while providing the tactical backing and mentorship they need. The duo of Fleming and du Plessis is a powerful combination of brain and execution, one that promises to drive Texas Super Kings forward with confidence.

TSK leadership Strengh: Skippers Galore

Next on the list is Mitchell Marsh, who is not just an explosive batter but also a regular and integral part of the Australian white-ball cricket team. Together, this trio ensures that the TSK team captain has a brain trust to rely on, whether setting fields, rotating bowlers, or chasing stiff targets.

One of Faf du Plessis’s understated strengths as Texas Super Kings Captain 2025 is his willingness to mentor young players. In the 2024 MLC season, TSK introduced a handful of emerging talents from both domestic US cricket and overseas picks. Faf was seen guiding them with patience and purpose, traits that will be pivotal in 2025 as MLC expands and competition intensifies.

Faf is particularly effective at clarifying roles for young players, whether they are middle-order finishers, strike bowlers, or fielding specialists. Under his leadership, expect TSK to strike the right balance between youth and experience.

Moreover, Faf’s experience playing in different leagues around the world—from the IPL to the CPL to The Hundred—makes him uniquely positioned to handle the diversity of players and styles in MLC. He understands the rhythms of T20 cricket like few others do, making him the ultimate asset for Texas.
