title: R Ashwin Awarded Padma Shri by President Droupadi Murmu
content:
R Ashwin Padma Shri Award: The BCCI (Board of Control for Cricket in India) recently congratulated the great spin bowler Ravichandran Ashwin. He was honored with the Padma Shri award, which is the fourth-highest civilian award in India. The President of India, Droupadi Murmu, gave him this award as part of the 2025 Padma awards list.

The announcement of the awards was made on January 25th. It’s a big deal because Ashwin is the only cricketer who received this honor this year. This really shows how much he has contributed to the sport of cricket.

The Central Board of Cricket in India, BCCI even posted on social media (X) to congratulate him, saying the Padma Shri recognized his amazing achievements and successful career playing for the Indian team.

R Ashwin Padma Shri Award: A Well-Deserved Acclamation for the Veteran

Ashwin’s career has been all about being consistent, brilliant, and helping India win matches, especially in Test cricket, which is the longest format of the game. He’s known for being very smart about cricket. He was a major force in Test matches, taking many wickets with his bowling and also scoring valuable runs with his bat.

He actually retired from international cricket during the Border-Gavaskar Trophy series in Australia in 2024. His very last Test match was the third one in Brisbane, which unfortunately ended in a draw because of rain. That match marked the end of a fantastic career that lasted over ten years.

Ashwin Retirement: A shocker for one and all!

Notably, Ashwin’s retirement surprised many. His final international appearance was a 2024 home series against New Zealand where he uncharacteristically underperformed in India. Earlier, his exclusion from the Perth Test in the 2024 Border-Gavaskar Trophy had raised questions about his future. He played a limited role in the Adelaide Test, possibly influencing his decision to retire from international cricket.

Despite a somewhat subdued exit, Ashwin’s statistics highlight his greatness. With 537 Test wickets at an average of 24.00, he is India’s second-highest Test wicket-taker, behind only Anil Kumble. His exceptional ability to take wickets across all conditions, especially overseas, made him invaluable. Beyond bowling, Ashwin also scored 3503 Test runs, including six centuries and 14 half-centuries.

His sharp cricketing mind and all-round contributions were crucial to India’s Test success, including their undefeated home Test series run from 2012 to 2024, only broken by New Zealand. Ashwin’s consistent performance and leadership in the spin department were key to India’s dominance.

“A Homecoming”: R Ashwin Returns to CSK for IPL 2025

Interestingly, Ashwin’s IPL journey has come back to where it started. He returned to his first team, the Chennai Super Kings (CSK), in the IPL 2025 Mega Auction which happened in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. CSK bought him for a hefty price of Rs 9.75 crore, bringing back a player who was a vital part of their successful years from 2009 to 2015.

Throughout his IPL career, Ashwin also played for a few other teams, including the Rising Pune Supergiant (which is a team that doesn’t exist anymore), the Punjab Kings (where he even captained the team for a while), the Delhi Capitals, and the Rajasthan Royals.

MS Dhoni 400 IPL Match: Mahendra Singh Dhoni, one of the most iconic figures in cricket, recently marked a significant milestone by playing his 400th T20 match during Chennai Super Kings’ (CSK) clash against Sunrisers Hyderabad at the MA Chidambaram Stadium.

At 44, Dhoni may no longer be at the peak of his batting prowess, but he continues to prove his worth as one of the sharpest minds and quickest gloves behind the stumps. With 7,566 runs at a strike rate of 135.90, Dhoni’s impact in the T20 format remains formidable. He also holds the record for the most stumpings in T20s, with 34 dismissals to his name.

MS Dhoni 400 IPL Match: IPL 2025 The Season to Turn Back Time and Timelessness

This season, Dhoni has once again taken up the captaincy reins for CSK in the 2025 Indian Premier League, stepping in after regular skipper Ruturaj Gaikwad was ruled out due to an elbow fracture. Gaikwad sustained the injury after a blow to his right forearm during a match against Rajasthan Royals in Guwahati. Scans later confirmed a fracture, ending his campaign prematurely and forcing CSK to turn to their trusted leader once again.

Dhoni had earlier handed over the captaincy to Gaikwad ahead of the 2024 season, continuing to play a mentoring and supportive role on and off the field. Before that, he had also stepped aside in 2022, briefly passing the leadership to Ravindra Jadeja. However, after a series of underwhelming performances that year, Dhoni returned as captain midway through the season to stabilize the team.

The 2025 season marks his first stint as official captain since the unforgettable 2023 IPL final in Ahmedabad. That night, CSK clinched their fifth IPL title in dramatic fashion, with Ravindra Jadeja smashing a six and a four off the last two balls to seal victory. It was a fitting moment under Dhoni’s leadership, further cementing his legacy as CSK’s most successful captain.

Having led CSK in a record 239 matches, Dhoni’s leadership has become synonymous with the franchise’s identity. He’s guided them through highs and lows, always with an air of calm and precision. With 400 T20 matches under his belt and a trophy-laden legacy, Dhoni’s longevity and influence in the shortest format of the game remain unparalleled.

title: You take so much money for selection: Raina, Harbhajan Slam CSK Over IPL 2025 Disaster
content:
When legends speak, the cricketing world listens. And in the case of Chennai Super Kings’ dismal IPL 2025 campaign, the criticism coming from two of the franchise’s most celebrated icons — Suresh Raina and Harbhajan Singh — feels like a wake-up call that cannot be ignored.

CSK, the proud five-time champions, find themselves in uncharted territory this season. After nine games, the Yellow Army has managed just two wins and now languishes at the bottom of the points table — a rare and painful sight for their loyal fans. But what has added more weight to the ongoing crisis is the vocal disapproval from Raina and Harbhajan, two names synonymous with CSK’s golden era.

Raina Points Fingers at Auction Strategy

Speaking on Star Sports after CSK’s sixth loss, this time to arch-rivals Mumbai Indians, Suresh Raina didn’t mince his words. The former CSK vice-captain blamed poor auction decisions for the team’s collapse.

“I feel that somewhere the auction was not done well by the coach, the management. There were so many talented players in the auction. So many young players – Priyansh Arya debut and scored a century. You take so much money for selection, you left out Rishabh Pant, left out Shreyas Iyer, KL Rahul. I have never seen CSK struggle this much,” said Raina.

His words hit hard, especially coming from someone who has been at the heart of CSK’s identity for over a decade. Raina’s criticism not only reflects frustration but also the emotional investment he still carries for the franchise.

Harbhajan Calls Out Lack of Star Power

Harbhajan Singh, another IPL-winning CSK player, backed Raina’s views and went a step further, questioning the team’s reluctance to bid for proven match-winners in the auction.

“Among the youth selected, we can’t see who could give game-changing performances,” Harbhajan remarked.

He highlighted how CSK, traditionally a team built on experience and leadership, ignored players like KL Rahul and Rishabh Pant — stars who were surprisingly available but left untouched.

No Dhoni Magic This Time

To add to the misery, the team has been riddled with injuries. Captain Ruturaj Gaikwad’s mid-season exit with a fractured elbow handed the reins back to MS Dhoni. While fans hoped for a fairytale comeback, even Dhoni’s leadership has failed to spark a turnaround.

With playoffs mathematically out of reach, the final leg of CSK’s campaign is less about qualification and more about damage control. But with voices like Raina and Harbhajan calling out the cracks, it’s clear the problems run deeper than form — they lie in planning, vision, and decision-making.

As things stand, IPL 2025 may not only go down as CSK’s worst season, but also the one that forces the franchise to finally rethink its future.

title: Ayush Mhatre IPL Debut: CSK’s Young Star Smashes 32 Off 15 vs MI
content:
Ayush Mhatre IPL Debut: Indian Premier League (IPL) 2025 witnessed another young star rise as 17-year-old Ayush Mhatre announced his arrival in style for Chennai Super Kings (CSK) against Mumbai Indians (MI) on Sunday. The Mumbai-born teenager, playing his first-ever IPL match, delivered a thrilling performance that left fans and experts in awe.

Coming in to bat early after CSK lost Rachin Ravindra in the powerplay, Mhatre showed no nerves. Facing only his second ball in the IPL, he confidently drove left-arm pacer Ashwani Kumar for a boundary. Just a few deliveries later, he casually flicked a six over long-on, announcing his fearless intent. When Ashwani tried to intimidate him with a sharp bouncer, Mhatre was ready, pulling it majestically into the mid-wicket stands for another six.

In just four balls, the youngster raced to 17 runs, electrifying the CSK fans in the stadium. What stood out was his composure—despite the high-pressure match against arch-rivals MI, he batted with the freedom of a seasoned player. His aggressive approach in the powerplay even earned a proud smile from CSK captain MS Dhoni, who was seen watching from the dressing room with admiration.

Ayush Mhatre Dream IPL Debut: 17-Year-Old Stuns MI with Fearless 32 (15)

Mhatre’s explosive knock of 32 runs off just 15 balls (including 4 fours and 2 sixes) came to an end in the seventh over when Deepak Chahar deceived him with a clever slower ball. Though his innings was short, it left a lasting impression. As he walked back, India’s T20 captain Suryakumar Yadav, playing for MI, gave him an encouraging pat on the back, a heartwarming moment that highlighted the respect he had earned.

Interestingly, Mhatre wasn’t even part of CSK’s original squad. He was signed as a replacement for the injured Ruturaj Gaikwad midway through the season. A big fan of Rohit Sharma, the teenager had previously impressed in domestic cricket for Mumbai and caught CSK’s attention during trials. His fearless debut proved why he’s one to watch in the future.

Though CSK couldn’t capitalize fully on his fiery start, Mhatre’s innings was a bright spark in the match. With such a confident debut, the 17-year-old has surely taken his first step toward a promising IPL career. Fans will now be eagerly waiting to see more of his fearless batting in the upcoming games.

title: Gurjapneet Singh Injury: Another Injury Scar for CSK Amid Poor Run in IPL 2025
content:
Chennai Super Kings (CSK), the five-time IPL champions, have been dealt another blow in a challenging 2025 season. The team has signed South African youngster Dewald Brevis as a replacement for the injured Gurjapneet Singh, adding to their growing list of injury setbacks. Brevis joins the franchise as their second replacement signing this season, stepping in after CSK confirmed that an overseas slot was still available in their squad.

Gurjapneet Singh’s injury adds to CSK’s woes, with the young pacer being ruled out for the remainder of the tournament. To make matters worse, CSK’s skipper Ruturaj Gaikwad was recently ruled out due to an elbow fracture. In the wake of his injury, CSK made the emotional decision to reinstate the legendary MS Dhoni as captain. While fans were thrilled to see Dhoni back at the helm, the team continues to struggle with form and fitness issues.

Gurjapneet Singh Injury Makes Way for “Baby AB” For Remainder Of IPL 2025

The Chennai-based franchise ropes in Brevis, offering him INR 2.2 crore, significantly above his auction base price of INR 75 lakh. The South African batter, who previously played for Mumbai Indians, has featured in 81 T20 matches across various leagues, boasting an impressive strike rate close to 145.

Brevis played for MI during the 2022 to 2024 IPL seasons, scoring 230 runs in 10 matches at an average of 23. While his performances were modest, CSK saw potential in his recent domestic form. The 21-year-old was in sublime touch for his domestic side Titans, and his consistent run-scoring in both List A and first-class formats earned him a call-up. His notable showing in the SA20 league earlier this year further solidified his reputation as one of South Africa’s brightest young talents.

CSK ‘Happily’ Welcomes the South African Batter

The announcement was made via CSK’s official ‘X’ handle (formerly Twitter), as fans welcomed the dynamic right-hander to the Yellow Army. However, the signing comes amid a turbulent phase for CSK. The franchise is currently placed 10th on the IPL 2025 points table, managing just two wins in their first seven matches.

Notably, the Super Kings have struggled with poor batting, especially in the middle order. The signing of Dewald Brevis, a fearless 360-degree batter will boost their middle-order scoring.

CSK needs a strong winning streak in their remaining seven matches to stay in the playoff race. Youngster Shaik Rasheed also impressed on debut. The team hopes Brevis brings the energy and intent they’ve been missing so far this season.

title: Dewald Brevis Joins CSK as Replacement for Injured Gurjapneet
content:
Chennai Super Kings’ batting has been struggling this season, and they might have received the best boost out there, which is in the form of Dewald Brevis.

Yes, the five-time champions have announced the signing of the player, often dubbed Baby AB (after AB de Villiers). Chennai Super Kings has confirmed this development through a social media post they shared on their official Instagram handle.

Dewald Brevis to join CSK as injury replacement

According to ESPNcricinfo, the South African player will replace Gurjapneet Singh, who was ruled out of the IPL 2025 following an injury. Brevis will join CSK for INR 2.2 crore.

This is not the first time that Brevis will partake in the IPL. He had a taste of the league when he played for Mumbai Indians between the 2022-24 season. However, when he entered the mega auction for a base price of 75 crores, he was overlooked by every team.

Now, Brevis has found a new home in the marquee league, but it is with a team that is a direct rival to the Mumbai Indians.

Brevis has impressed everyone with his clean hitting. He has played in 82 T20 games and scored 1787 runs at a strike rate of 144, with 162 being his highest score in an inning.

Brevis has been in great form recently. Earlier in the year, he was one of the highest run scorers in the SA20 tournament, where he smashed 291 runs for his side, MI Cape Town, in 12 games at an average of 48.5 and a strike rate of 184.

Apart from that, he also showcased good form in the domestic tournaments in South Africa. Playing for Titans, he finished as the second-highest run-getter in both the one-day and the first-class tournaments.

Why is Brevis a good fit for CSK?

Throughout the IPL 2025, the batting of Chennai Super Kings has been criticized for their lack of intent. And that is exactly what Brevis brings to this team.

Known as a fearless hitter, the batter has an uncanny ability of hitting the ball in all parts of the ground. Making him a 360-degree player. Hence, when those middle overs arrive for CSK, they would want someone like Brevis to just get them a move on by scoring runs at a quick rate.

So far, CSK has only managed to register two wins from seven games. Owing to this, they find themselves at the bottom of the table, a position one seldom associates with them.

However, the team desperately needs change, and Brevis can bring just that. Earlier, in their game against Lucknow Super Giants, the team handed a debut to youngster Shaik Rasheed, who also gave the team a fresh breath by scoring quickly upfront.

Chennai also suffered a major blow to their campaign when their captain, Ruturaj Gaikwad, was ruled out of the tournament following a fractured elbow. This left the team under the leadership of MS Dhoni once again.

With just 7 games to go, CSK now cannot afford to lose any more games. Only a string of victories can keep them alive in this tournament, otherwise, they face the threat of becoming the first team to be ousted from the Playoff race.

title: IPL 2025, CSK vs LSG, Highlights: Super Kings End 5-Match Losing Streak, Win by 5 Wickets against Lucknow
content:
IPL 2025, CSK vs LSG, Highlights: Chennai Super Kings (CSK) finally managed to end their five-match losing streak in IPL 2025 with a thrilling win over Lucknow Super Giants (LSG) in Match 30 at the Ekana Stadium. It was a much-needed victory for CSK, and it came in true Dhoni-style fashion—late drama, nerves of steel, and a vintage finish.

LSG, after being asked to bat first, posted a total of 166/7, notably their lowest total of the season. The innings saw an early wobble, with Aiden Markram and Nicholas Pooran dismissed cheaply, thanks to clever bowling set-ups from Khaleel Ahmed and Anshul Kamboj. Rishabh Pant, however, played the anchor role, scoring a steady 63 off 49 balls. His innings was a tale of two halves, initial aggression and later struggle, especially against the spin duo of Noor Ahmad and Ravindra Jadeja. Pant’s late acceleration helped LSG gather 45 runs in the final three overs, aided by a quick cameo from Abdul Samad.

IPL 2025, CSK vs LSG, Highlights: Dube, Dhoni take CSK home

CSK’s chase started brightly, thanks to debutant Shaik Rasheed’s aggressive 27 off 19 balls and a brisk opening stand with Rachin Ravindra. But the middle overs saw CSK falter, with the spin trio of Markram, Bishnoi, and Digvesh Rathi slowing things down and picking key wickets. At 111/5 in 15 overs, needing 56 off the final five, CSK were staring at a sixth straight defeat.

Enter MS Dhoni.

The crowd erupted as the iconic finisher walked in. Alongside a composed Shivam Dube, Dhoni turned the tide. Dube smashed Shardul Thakur for a six and a four, then capitalized on a no-ball to bring the equation down rapidly. Dhoni, with his trademark calm, struck a one-handed six over square leg and a few boundaries, shifting the momentum entirely in CSK’s favor.

Needing just five off the final over, CSK finished the chase with ease, sealing a memorable win and climbing off the bottom of the table. Dube’s 43 and Dhoni’s explosive 11-ball 26 were crucial in this turnaround.

The victory was not just two points—it was a morale booster. CSK showed they still had fight left in them, and with Dhoni back at the helm, fans will hope this marks the beginning of a comeback story in IPL 2025.

title: CSK Sign 17-Year-Old Ayush Mhatre After Gaikwad Injury
content:
Chennai Super Kings have announced the replacement of captain Ruturaj Gaikwad. They have roped in the 17-year-old youngster Ayush Mhatre for the season but he is highly unlikely to feature in their next game.

The five-times champions have not had the best of season in the IPL so far. they have managed to win just 1 out of their 6 games. And to make things worse their only consistent batter, and captain Ruturaj Gaikwad was ruled out for the season with an elbow injury.

Ayush Mhatre joins CSK as injury replacement

At such a time, there were several big names floating on the internet, who could have been named as the replacement for Gaikwad. This included the likes of Prithvi Shaw and Mayank Agarwal as well. However, the team has decided to go with the youngster Ayush Mahatre.

According to a report by cricbuzz, the player has been asked to join the team immediately. But, “He will join the squad in Mumbai in a couple of days,” Cricbuzz reports.

The Chennai based franchise has been keen about the player for the longest of times. He was called for trails ahead of the mega-auction and once again was asked to give a trail mid-season. Mhatre was one of the three players: Urvil Patel of Gujarat, and Salman Nizar of Kerela who trailed for CSK mid-season. and it seems that the franchise has finally decided to continue with Mhatre.

Who is Ayush Mhatre?

Mhatre is a 17-year-old youngster who represents Mumbai in domestic cricket. Although he has only played 9 first-class games, he has amassed 504 runs in them including two centuries and 1 fifty.

Apart from that, he has a pretty decent List A career as well. Mhatre has featured in 7 List A games and managed to score 458 runs in them with 2 centuries to his name.

Chennai Super King’s batting woes

CSK’s batting woes have been a significant concern this season. In their recent match against Kolkata Knight Riders, they posted a meager 103/9 at home, marking their lowest total at Chepauk.

Openers Rachin Ravindra and Devon Conway have struggled to provide solid starts, and the middle order has lacked the necessary firepower to chase down targets or set competitive totals. The team’s inability to capitalize during the powerplay overs has been a recurring issue, leading to mounting pressure on the lower order.

Ruturaj Gaikwad’s absence due to an elbow injury has further exacerbated the team’s challenges. As the captain and a consistent performer, his leadership and batting prowess were pivotal to CSK’s strategy. In his absence, the responsibility falls on seasoned players like MS Dhoni, who has resumed captaincy, and emerging talents to step up.

In addition to Mhatre, CSK has invested in several promising uncapped players this season. Anshul Kamboj, a 23-year-old pacer from Haryana, was acquired for ₹3.4 crore after an impressive domestic season, including a 10-wicket haul in a Ranji Trophy match.

Shaik Rasheed, part of India’s U-19 World Cup-winning team in 2022, was picked up for ₹30 lakh and has shown promise with a recent double century in the Ranji Trophy. Vansh Bedi, known for his power-hitting in the Delhi Premier League, was signed for ₹55 lakh, adding depth to CSK’s batting lineup. These young talents reflect CSK’s strategy to build a robust future by nurturing domestic prospects. ​

title: How can Chennai Super Kings (CSK) Still Make the Playoffs of IPL 2025?
content:
The Chennai Super Kings (CSK) are the most successful and reliable team in the Indian Premier League (IPL)’s historical timeline. CSK fans continue to maintain faith in their team despite the challenging season 2025. You can never counter their never-say-die spirit and their untapped history of pulling a rabbit out of a hat. However, in the ongoing IPL 2025 nothing looked to go CSK’s way.

Murphy’s Law seems to have taken a firm grip on Chennai Super Kings (CSK) in IPL 2025. From a string of defeats to persistent injury setbacks, nothing has gone their way, even MS Dhoni’s leadership hasn’t been able to steer the team out of trouble. CSK are officially out of playoff contention after a crushing loss to Punjab Kings, their eighth defeat in ten matches.

With just 4 points and a dismal Net Run Rate of -1.392, the maximum they can reach is 12 points—well below the projected 16-point playoff threshold. Even the historically borderline 14-point mark wouldn’t suffice, given their poor NRR. Adding to their struggles, CSK have suffered five straight defeats at home, a rare and telling stat for the franchise. With just three games remaining, the focus now shifts from playoff hopes to restoring pride, as they become the first team to be eliminated from IPL 2025.

CSK playoff chances in IPL 2025 are officially over now. The current scenario leads fans to ask: Can CSK reach IPL 2025 playoffs?

Chennai Super Kings Performance Analysis 2025

CSK is currently showing declining performance in the first phase of IPL 2025. They have played eight matches during IPL 2025, completing the following run:

  • CSK vs MI – Won by 4 wickets
  • RCB vs CSK – Lost by 50 runs
  • RR vs CSK – Lost by 6 runs
  • CSK vs DC – Lost by 25 runs
  • PBKS vs CSK – Lost by 18 runs
  • KKR vs CSK – Lost by 8 wickets
  • CSK vs LSG – Won by 5 wickets
  • CSK vs MI – Lost by 9 wickets
  • CSK vs SRH – Lost by 5 wickets
  • CSK vs PBKS – Lost by 4 wickets
  • CSK vs RCB – Lost by 2 runs
  • CSK vs KKR – Won by 2 wickets

This has left them in 10th place on the table, which is reflected in the current CSK points table scenario IPL 2025.

CSK is currently placed at the bottom of the table due to its six-point performance from its twelve games so far. With just 2 matches left to play, its serious playoff pursuit is now officially over. In the final couple of games, CSK will try to end the disappointing season with memorable wins. This defines the current CSK qualification scenario IPL 2025 and leaves their playoff dream out of hand.

Key Challenges That Hindered CSK’s Campaign

Batting Instability

This department emerges because middle-order batters fail to convert starts, but top-order inconsistency leads to subpar performances from Indian batters Rachin and Dube. Note that Tripathi and Hooda have already been dropped off. The current combination is still not offering clarity in the CSK key players for IPL 2025 playoffs.

CSK’s Frail Powerplay Performance

With the ball and the bat, the team gives away important runs during the game’s early stages. The Purple Cap holder Noor Ahmed is the only consistent threat among all other CSK bowlers who have failed to bond for a unified performance.

Net Run-rate

Significant defeat losses have damaged their net run rate, which may be crucial if multiple teams finish with the same points. The CSK net run rate calculation IPL 2025 will certainly play a role in the final league standings.

Strong rivals—GT and RR—will challenge CSK in upcoming fixtures before they can establish form as opponents.

CSK Remaining Matches 2025 & Winning Scenarios

Here is CSK’s remaining match list for IPL 2025:

  1. CSK vs RR – 12 May
  2. GT vs CSK – 18 May

Unfortunately for the team and the fans, CSK became the first team to be out of the playoff race.

Areas for Urgent Improvement

Batting Woes

Apart from the poor performances, CSK has faced a plethora of injuries in their initial matches. With captain Ruturaj Gaikwad, Vansh Bedi and Gurjanpreet Singh out for the rest of the tournament due to injuries. Rachin Ravindra delivered sufficient performance during his first couple of matches, whereas Conway showed signs of some form semblance. The replacements for past players Rayudu and Rahane, including Deepak Hooda, Vijay Shankar, and Rahul Tripathi, have not added any substantial value to the team. Having said that, the inclusion of Ayush Mhatre and Dewald Brevis gave the team a glimmer of hope.

Powerplay Struggles

We have been the worst bowling team in the powerplay, consistently conceding over 11 per over, and with the bat, we have only managed to remain wicketless once, in the game against Punjab Kings. We need to solidify our team with potent players.

If the Chennai Super Kings implement the same formula throughout their rest of the matches in the tournament, they need to clinch a win in all of their five remaining matches. Consistently changing the team formation after matches adversely affects unit cohesion and disrupts teamwork and organizational chemistry.

We are yet to identify our best overseas combination, which is key to executing the Chennai Super Kings winning strategy.

Match-by-Match Outlook

The following matches will hold different challenges for CSK in their upcoming chennai super kings match schedule. Here’s a CSK match-by-match prediction IPL 2025:

  • Vs RR (Home): A virtual knockout. Expect fireworks. We have lost once and it would be the ideal time to return the compliments.
  • Vs GT (Away): If all goes by script, this will define the top 2 or top 4, keeping CSK’s road to IPL 2025 final alive.

Next Match Preview: CSK vs RR

After a poor run in the Indian Premier League 2025 so far, Chennai Super Kings (CSK) and Rajasthan Royals (RR) are set to clash in match number 63 on the iconic MA Chidambaram Stadium, Chennai.

CSK are having a dismal IPL 2025 season, sitting 10th with just 3 wins in 12 matches. After an initial victory, they’ve lost 6 straight games, prompting MS Dhoni to reclaim captaincy from the injured Ruturaj Gaikwad. Their powerplay batting, fielding, and spin attack have all underperformed.

Final Verdict: Can CSK Do It?

CSK’s reputation includes enduring struggles and fighting back against all adversity. Conway’s improving form and spinners’ strength on the Chepauk pitch continue to generate possibilities for success. Consistent performance from the top order, rotational smartness, and controlled death-over bowling could help CSK maintain their playoff standing.

CSK playoff dream alive? In the current, it is not a possibility—but Chennai Super Kings will be hoping to finish the tournament with something special.

Verdict: Out of the tournament, trying to find matches for the next season.

title: I will always be a Thala’s fan: Ambati Rayudu Silences Trolls for MS Dhoni Comment
content:
Former Chennai Super Kings (CSK) batter Ambati Rayudu has finally spoken out against the wave of hate he’s been receiving online for openly supporting MS Dhoni during the ongoing IPL 2025 season. While Dhoni, the legendary former CSK captain, has faced criticism for his batting position and form, Rayudu has consistently stood by him on-air through his commentary on Star Sports.

Despite CSK’s tough run this season, Rayudu has been vocal about his admiration for Dhoni during pre-match, mid-innings, and post-match discussions. However, some fans didn’t take his loyalty too well and began trolling him on social media. Responding to the hate, Rayudu took to X (formerly Twitter) to make it clear that no amount of trolling or negativity would ever shake his admiration for the CSK icon.

Ambati Rayudu Post Silences Crowd for MS Dhoni Comment

“I was a Thala’s fan, I am a Thala’s fan, I will always be a Thala’s fan,” Rayudu posted. “No matter what anyone thinks or does, it will not make a one percent difference. So please stop spending money on paid PR and donate that to charity. A lot of underprivileged people can benefit.”

Rayudu’s powerful statement quickly gained attention from fans, with many praising his loyalty to Dhoni, especially during a challenging season for CSK, who are currently battling at the lower end of the points table.

However, Rayudu wasn’t just targeted by fans. Former cricketer and commentator Navjot Singh Sidhu also took a playful jab at him during commentary. During CSK’s match against Punjab Kings in Chandigarh, Dhoni entered the field in the 16th over to thunderous applause. Rayudu, sitting alongside Sidhu in the commentary box, described the moment with enthusiasm, saying, “MS Dhoni is coming out with a sword, not the bat. The sword will be wielded tonight.”

Sidhu, known for his witty remarks, quickly responded, “You’re speaking like he’s not coming out to play cricket but to fight a war!” The exchange went viral, sparking further debate online, but Rayudu remained unfazed and continued his on-air support for Dhoni.

Despite the criticism, Rayudu’s passion for CSK and Dhoni has remained firm. His message serves as a reminder of the strong bond within the CSK family, one built on loyalty, mutual respect, and years of shared success on the field.

title: MS Dhoni CSK Captain Again! Replaces Ruturaj Gaikwad for Rest of IPL 2025
content:
MS Dhoni CSK Captain Again! Yes, you read it right! In a major twist for Chennai Super Kings (CSK), Thala MS Dhoni is back as captain for the rest of IPL 2025. The announcement came on April 10, just before CSK’s high-stakes match against Kolkata Knight Riders. Dhoni takes over from Ruturaj Gaikwad, who has been ruled out due to an elbow fracture—a huge setback for the struggling franchise.

Gaikwad, who has been CSK’s top run-scorer in three of the last four seasons, suffered the injury during the match against Rajasthan Royals on March 30. Despite playing through pain in subsequent games, scans later confirmed a fracture, forcing him out of the tournament. “Ruturaj tried to push through, but the injury was serious,” said head coach Stephen Fleming. “The initial X-ray didn’t show much, but the MRI revealed the extent of the damage.”

Coach Fleming Confirms MS Dhoni CSK Captain Role in Absence of Gaikwad

With Gaikwad sidelined, the responsibility falls back on Dhoni, the man who has defined CSK’s success over the years. At 43, the veteran wicketkeeper-batter brings unmatched experience, having led the team to five IPL titles and 10 finals. His calm leadership could be exactly what CSK needs to revive their campaign after a dismal start, losing four of their first five matches.

Fleming confirmed that Dhoni didn’t hesitate to step up. “MS knows the team needs him,” he said. “Rutu didn’t want to give up the role, but with this injury, there was no other option.” While Gaikwad’s absence leaves a gap at the top of the order, CSK will likely explore replacements from within the squad before looking externally.

Dhoni last led in the final of IPL 2023 but stepped aside before the first game of IPL 2024, handing over captaincy to Ruturaj Gaikwad.

For fans, Dhoni’s return is a ray of hope. His tactical brilliance and ability to handle pressure could be the spark CSK needs to turn their season around. With playoffs still a possibility, the team will now rely on their iconic leader to guide them through this tough phase. The question is: can Dhoni work his magic one more time?

title: Devon Conway Becomes First CSK Player to be Retired Out; Sparks Debate Online
content:
In an unprecedented move during the IPL 2025 clash between Chennai Super Kings (CSK) and Punjab Kings (PBKS), CSK opener Devon Conway retired_ while batting on a solid 69 off 49 balls.

This tactical decision, with CSK needing 49 runs from 13 balls, marked the first time a CSK player was retired out in IPL, and only the second such instance this season—following Mumbai Indians’ Tilak Varma.

Conway becomes first CSK batter to be retired out

Conway’s IPL innings featured six boundaries and two sixes and had kept CSK in the hunt during their chase of PBKS’s formidable 220-run target. However, the decision to replace him with Ravindra Jadeja raised eyebrows, especially as CSK eventually fell short by 18 runs, finishing at 201/5.

The bold Conway retired decision sparked heated debate among cricket pundits and fans alike. Former Australian captain Michael Clarke expressed his confusion, stating, “I didn’t understand CSK’s decision to retire Devon Conway.”

Similarly, former Indian cricketer Piyush Chawla opined that the timing was off, suggesting that such a decision should have been made earlier to allow the incoming batsman more time to settle.

CSK’s captain Ruturaj Gaikwad later shed light on the rationale, explaining that the team “waited and waited” for the opportune moment to make the change, aiming to optimize their chances in the high-stakes chase.

Retiring out batters a new trend in T20s

This incident underscores the delicate balance teams must strike between innovative strategies and traditional cricketing wisdom. While T20 cricket often rewards bold moves, the value of a set batsman’s momentum remains undeniable. Trusting a well-set player like CSK opener Devon Conway can often be the difference between victory and defeat.

The thrilling IPL 2025 encounter saw Punjab Kings (PBKS) defeat Chennai Super Kings (CSK) by 18 runs. Batting first, PBKS posted an imposing 219/6, propelled by Priyansh Arya’s blistering 103 off 42 balls, featuring seven fours and nine sixes.

Shashank Singh provided valuable support with an unbeaten 52. In response, CSK managed 201/5. Devon Conway anchored the innings with 69 off 49 balls before being controversially retired out. Despite MS Dhoni’s late cameo of 27 from 12 balls, CSK fell short.

title: CSK vs PBKS: Super Kings Suffer Another Disappointing Loss by 18 Runs in IPL 2025
content:
CSK vs PBKS, IPL 2025: Chennai Super Kings (CSK) faced an 18-run defeat at the hands of Punjab Kings (PBKS) in Mullanpur. Despite a decent start in their chase, CSK struggled with a series of mistakes, including poor fielding, missed chances, and a lack of momentum in the middle overs.

The match was largely shaped by young Delhi boy Priyansh Arya, who played a sensational knock of 103 runs off just 42 balls, including 9 sixes and 7 fours. Arya’s aggressive start put the CSK bowlers on the backfoot right from the beginning. PBKS posted a challenging total of 219/6. While CSK’s bowlers tried their best, they struggled to contain the runs, with Khaleel Ahmed and Mukesh Choudhary being particularly expensive. Even the experienced spinners Ravindra Jadeja and R. Ashwin couldn’t make an impact.

CSK vs PBKS Match Highlights: Super Kings’ Mistakes Cost Them Dearly

CSK’s bowling lacked consistency throughout the match. The bowlers struggled to find the right lengths and were punished for giving away too many boundaries. This allowed Punjab Kings to post a formidable total, putting CSK on the back foot early in the game. Priyansh Arya’s aggressive batting took full advantage of the loose deliveries, and the CSK bowlers couldn’t stop the flow of runs.

Fielding also became a significant problem for CSK. The team dropped three catches, including two off Arya early in his innings. These mistakes were costly, as Arya capitalized on the missed chances and built a solid foundation for PBKS. The team’s inability to execute in the field has been a recurring issue, and it hurt them once again in this match.

Yet Another Failed Outing for CSK’s Middle Order

In the chase, CSK’s middle order failed to carry the momentum forward after a solid start. Devon Conway (50 off 38) and Rachin Ravindra (36 off 23) had laid a decent foundation, but once Conway was dismissed, the team struggled to build partnerships. The required run rate kept climbing, and despite Shivam Dube’s fighting knock of 42 off 27, CSK couldn’t keep up the required pace and ultimately fell short.

Another aspect that didn’t work in CSK’s favor was the use of the Impact Player. Bringing in Shivam Dube didn’t have the desired effect, as he couldn’t turn the game in CSK’s favor. His contribution was insufficient to help CSK break the required boundaries at critical moments.

Chennai Super Kings vs Punjab Kings: What’s Ahead for CSK and PBKS?

CSK was outplayed by PBKS in all departments. The dropped catches and poor fielding were crucial moments that turned the game in PBKS’ favor. CSK now needs to address these issues quickly if they want to stay competitive for a playoff spot. PBKS, on the other hand, will be looking to build on this win for the rest of the season. CSK needs to regroup, focus on their fielding and bowling, while PBKS will hope to maintain this winning momentum.

title: Ashwin Steps Back from CSK Discussions on His YouTube Channel Amid Criticism
content:
Veteran all-rounder Ravichandran Ashwin recently announced that he will no longer be discussing Chennai Super Kings (CSK) games during IPL 2025. In a statement on his YouTube channel, Ashwin explained that his decision was based on the recent nature of discussions surrounding CSK matches. He mentioned that one of the panelists had criticized the CSK management for preferring Afghanistan’s left-arm chinaman bowler, Noor Ahmad, over Indian players like Ravindra Jadeja and Ashwin himself.

Ashwin clarified that he wanted to avoid any misinterpretations and ensure that the discussions remained respectful and professional. He emphasized that the views expressed by the panellists were not his own and that he was stepping away from covering CSK games, including both previews and reviews, for the rest of the season. Despite this, Ashwin assured his fans that the integrity of the show would be maintained, and he would continue to promote diverse perspectives.

Non-CSK matches’ analysis to continue on Ashwin Youtube Channel

“We value the diversity of perspectives that come through on our shows and remain committed to ensuring the conversation stays true to the integrity and purpose of the platform we’ve established,” Ashwin said. He also distanced himself from any negative opinions expressed on the show, stressing that they did not reflect his personal views.

Ashwin confirmed that he would continue to analyze and discuss matches involving other IPL teams. He expressed his gratitude to fans for their thoughtful engagement with the show and assured them that “The Small Council” would keep discussing non-CSK games as usual for the rest of the season. “Looking forward to witnessing the rest of this exciting IPL season with all of you,” he added.

In response to Ashwin’s statement, CSK head coach Stephen Fleming was asked about his awareness of the discussions on Ashwin’s YouTube channel. Fleming responded that he was unaware of Ashwin YouTube channel and did not follow such discussions, saying, “That’s irrelevant. You guys are important,” suggesting that media coverage was more important to him than personal shows or opinions.

As for CSK’s performance in IPL 2025, the team has had a tough start, losing three out of their first four matches. They will next face Punjab Kings (PBKS) on April 8, hoping to improve their record in the ongoing season.

title: Chennai Super Kings Invite Mumbai Teenager Ayush Mhatre for Mid-Season Trials
content:
After a shaky run in the IPL 2025 so far, Chennai Super Kings (CSK) have invited Mumbai’s 17-year-old cricketer, Ayush Mhatre, for a mid-season trial in IPL 2025. Notably, this isn’t the first time Mhatre has become the center of attraction. In November 2024, the Mumbai boy was invited by the Super Kings for the pre-season trials as well.

CSK’s managing director, Kasi Viswanathan, confirmed the news, mentioning that Mhatre had impressed their talent scouts. However, he also emphasized that this is only a trial and not a selection at this stage. “If there’s any need, we will consider it,” he said, making it clear that no players are being picked for the squad just yet.

How Ayush Mhatre Received the Opportunity?

Ayush Mhatre is a young right-handed batter from Mumbai. He made his domestic debut in the Irani Trophy last October, where he opened the innings with Prithvi Shaw and scored 19 runs. Ayush Mhatre was part of the star-studded Mumbai team led by Ajinkya Rahane, which also included prominent players like Shreyas Iyer, Shardul Thakur, and Sarfaraz Khan. Mhatre’s journey in domestic cricket has been impressive so far, and his performances have caught the eye of CSK scouts.

Ayush Mhatre has already made a name for himself with some remarkable performances. He became the youngest batter to score more than 150 runs in List A cricket when he blasted 181 runs off 117 balls against Nagaland at the age of just 17 years and 291 days. In addition, he scored a half-century (52 from 71 balls) on his Ranji debut against Baroda.

Mhatre also made headlines when he scored 176 runs from 232 balls in a Ranji match against Maharashtra, a team captained by CSK’s Ruturaj Gaikwad. His performances continued to impress at the Under-19 Asia Cup 2024/25, where he scored 176 runs, the second-most runs for the Indian U19 team.

In List A cricket, Mhatre has also shown his bowling skills, taking 7 wickets. Notably, he dismissed India and Sunrisers Hyderabad opener Abhishek Sharma during his impressive outings.

CSK’s Run in IPL 2025 So Far

CSK started their IPL 2025 campaign with a big win against their arch-rivals, Mumbai Indians. However, things have since taken a turn for the worse. They lost two consecutive games in a span of just three days to Royal Challengers Bangalore (RCB) and Rajasthan Royals (RR). As a result, CSK are currently 7th in the IPL points table, having won just one out of their three matches. On top of that, Super Kings is facing yet another injury scare, with captain Ruturaj Gaikwad probably sidelined for their next fixture.

With the team struggling, CSK will need to bounce back quickly, and the next match, against the unbeaten Delhi Capitals on Saturday, April 5, could be crucial for their campaign.

title: Ruturaj Gaikwad in Doubt for CSK vs Delhi Capitals
content:
Chennai Super Kings (CSK) captain Ruturaj Gaikwad is uncertain for their upcoming match against Delhi Capitals after injuring his elbow in the team’s previous game against Rajasthan Royals. Gaikwad was struck on the elbow while batting and visibly showed signs of pain. Despite the discomfort, he managed to continue batting and even scored his second half-century of the season. However, it was told that after the match, the elbow remained sore, and Gaikwad did not train for a couple of days in the build-up to CSK’s next game.

CSK’s batting coach Michael Hussey shared an update on Gaikwad’s fitness on the eve of the match. Hussey remained hopeful that Gaikwad would recover in time to play, but emphasized that the final decision would depend on how he feels after a training session on Friday, April 4. “He’s going to try and have a bat today for training. It’s still a little bit sore, but it’s improving every day. We are hopeful and confident that he will be fine for tomorrow,” Hussey said.

CSK Coach Suggests MSD “Can do a good job” in Ruturaj Gaikwad’s Absence

Gaikwad, who is an important player for CSK, has been crucial to the team’s batting lineup, especially since they have struggled in that area early this season. Given that CSK is looking for a win after suffering two losses in a row, Gaikwad’s availability would be a big boost for the team. If Gaikwad is unable to play, Hussey suggested that there could be an interesting twist in the leadership role.

Hussey hinted that MS Dhoni, CSK’s former captain, might take charge once again. Dhoni, known for his leadership skills, could step in as captain if Gaikwad is unavailable, but Hussey said it would depend on what decision Stephen Fleming (the team’s head coach) and Gaikwad himself make. “I’m sure Fleming and Rutu have thought about that. But we’ve got a young guy coming through who’s behind the stumps. Maybe he can do a good job,” Hussey said, possibly referring to the emerging talent in CSK’s squad. He also acknowledged that the young player has some experience in leadership, though Hussey wasn’t certain if that would be the route they would go.

The situation remains fluid, and CSK fans will have to wait until the team’s final training session before the match to know for sure whether Gaikwad will be fit to play. Regardless of the outcome, CSK will be eager to get back to winning ways after their recent setbacks.

title: Why MS Dhoni is Batting Lower in IPL 2025? CSK Coach Explains
content:
The Indian Premier League (IPL) 2025 has brought some intriguing moments, particularly around MS Dhoni’s batting position for Chennai Super Kings (CSK). Fans have been left puzzled by his lower-order position, especially after a narrow loss to Rajasthan Royals (RR) in Guwahati. The focus on MS Dhoni batting position continues to grow, with many wondering why the legendary cricketer isn’t coming in earlier, despite CSK’s need for stability in the middle overs.

In the IPL 2025 match against RR, MS Dhoni batted at number seven, scoring 16 runs off 11 balls in a tense chase of 183. This was a change from the usual role fans are used to seeing Dhoni play, and many questioned the decision. However, CSK head coach Stephen Fleming has now explained the reason behind this choice, shedding light on why MS Dhoni is batting lower in the order.

MS Dhoni’s Knee Condition a Matter of Concern for Super Kings?

Stephen Fleming provided some clarity on why MS Dhoni’s batting position in IPL 2025 is different from what fans might expect. Fleming revealed that Dhoni’s knee condition plays a significant role in determining when he is sent in to bat. “MS judges it. His body is… his knees aren’t what they used to be,” Fleming explained. He further added that while Dhoni is still agile, the physical toll on his knees means he cannot bat for extended periods as he used to. As a result, MS Dhoni is no longer able to bat 9-10 overs, and his batting position has been adjusted to reflect this.

Fleming went on to say that the team management assesses each match carefully, determining the best time to send Dhoni in, depending on the situation. “He can’t bat ten overs running full-stick. So, he will gauge on the day what he can give us,” said Fleming. This strategy ensures that Dhoni can have a maximum impact when required, without overloading him physically.

CSK’s Strategy: MS Dhoni batting position

The decision to have MS Dhoni batting lower in the order, especially in the IPL 2025 season, is part of CSK’s broader tactical approach. The younger players in the team are encouraged to take control early in the innings, allowing Dhoni to come in later as the finisher. This role is where Dhoni’s experience and power-hitting skills can be most effective. While fans might feel uneasy about MS Dhoni batting lower, CSK coach Stephen Fleming believes this strategy plays to Dhoni’s strengths, particularly as he still has the ability to change games in the final overs.

“If the game’s in the balance like today, he will go a little bit earlier,” Fleming mentioned after the CSK Rajasthan Royals match. This approach allows MS Dhoni to enter the game when it’s most beneficial for the team, keeping his physical limitations in mind.

The decision to have MS Dhoni batting lower in IPL 2025 may raise eyebrows, but it is a well-thought-out move by CSK. The MS Dhoni batting position has been carefully adjusted to manage his knee condition and ensure he can still contribute powerfully at the death. With his leadership, wicket-keeping, and finishing abilities, Dhoni remains a key player for Chennai Super Kings in IPL 2025, and this tactical approach aims to maximize his impact while ensuring his physical well-being.

title: MS Dhoni Breaks Suresh Raina's IPL Record in Chepauk Stadium
content:
In a historic occasion for Chennai Super Kings (CSK) and IPL fans, MS Dhoni IPL records has etched another page in the history by breaking Suresh Raina’s long-standing record as CSK’s highest run-scorer in the Indian Premier League (IPL). The legendary wicketkeeper-batter reached the milestone on March 28, 2025, during CSK’s IPL 2025 match against Royal Challengers Bangalore (RCB) at Chepauk Stadium, making it a night to remember.

Dhoni, who is widely regarded as one of the greatest finishers in the history of the IPL, needed just 19 runs to surpass Raina’s record of 4687 runs. He achieved this feat in dramatic fashion, hitting RCB all-rounder Krunal Pandya for a six on the third ball of the final over, sending the crowd into a frenzy. By the end of his brief but impactful innings of 30 runs from 16 balls, Dhoni had accumulated a total of 4699 IPL runs for CSK, overtaking Raina’s tally.

With 236 IPL matches under his belt, Dhoni continues to be an instrumental figure for the franchise, demonstrating his prowess both with the bat and behind the stumps. In addition to his incredible run-scoring record, Dhoni has hit 224 sixes and 333 fours in the IPL. He also boasts 22 half-centuries, further cementing his reputation as one of the league’s finest performers.

MS Dhoni IPL Records and Legacy

MS Dhoni’s IPL career is studded with remarkable achievements, and his 4699 runs make him the undisputed leader in the list of most runs for CSK. His journey in the IPL began in 2008, and over the years, he has become the most capped player in the tournament’s history. Beyond his batting, Dhoni’s leadership and wicketkeeping skills have been integral to CSK’s success, including guiding the team to multiple IPL titles.

While Dhoni’s record-breaking moment was celebrated, CSK unfortunately fell short in the match against RCB. Despite Dhoni’s late heroics, CSK could not chase down RCB’s target of 197, losing by 50 runs. RCB’s captain, Rajat Patidar, was awarded Player of the Match for his brilliant 51-run knock, which helped his side post a formidable total.

As Dhoni continues to add to his IPL stats, including his role in setting records like the highest score at Chepauk Stadium, fans will eagerly follow his every move, with the CSK legend showing no signs of slowing down.

CSK vs RCB IPL 2025 Match Recap

In a game that saw RCB post 196/7 in their allotted 20 overs, CSK’s run chase never quite took off. Despite a solid effort from Dhoni, CSK were restricted to just 146/8, suffering their second loss to RCB in Chennai.

Super Kings will face Rajasthan Royals in their next IPL encounter. Both CSK and RR has had iconic teams, made news due to their squad selection details. CSK is known for its team full of experience. MS Dhoni’s presence in the team after all these years, especially when he’s at the age that he is is the perfect example of this. Old is Gold and CSK adheres by it. 

As CSK heads into the remainder of the season, all eyes will be on Dhoni’s next record-breaking move in the IPL.

title: CSK vs RCB: Matheesha Pathirana Ruled Out as Chennai Faces Injury Setback
content:
The Chennai Super Kings are dealt a heavy blow ahead of their second game against Royal Challengers Bengaluru in IPL 2025. Their star bowler, Matheesha Pathirana, has been ruled out of the clash due to an injury.

Everyone knows that CSK vs. RCB is one of the most anticipated fixtures in the IPL. Hence, both teams want to be at their full potential coming into the game. However, the home team will have to do without Pathirana, who has been a crucial asset in their bowling lineup.

Matheesha Pathirana Injury: Doubtful for RCB Clash

According to reports circulating on the internet, the Pathirana injury was caused by the remodeling of his bowling action. This issue had already kept him out of action during the season’s opening encounter, and now he is set to miss the game against RCB as well.

In a recent interview, CSK head coach Stephen Fleming provided a Pathirana injury update, assuring fans that the pacer is recovering progressively and will not be ruled out of the tournament entirely. However, he confirmed that Pathirana’s IPL injury will keep him sidelined for this crucial fixture.

This leaves CSK with a selection dilemma. While they have players like Jamie Overton as backup, he is an all-rounder and not a specialist pacer like Pathirana. Given CSK’s usual approach, a change in the playing XI might not happen, as they already went with Nathan Ellis in the first game.

CSK’s Strong Start to IPL 2025

Despite Pathirana’s IPL injury, CSK started their campaign in dominant fashion, defeating Mumbai Indians in their opening encounter. Bowling first, they restricted MI batters to just 152 runs, thanks to exceptional spells from Noor Ahmad (4 wickets) and Khaleel Ahmed (3 wickets).

CSK’s spin-heavy attack, featuring Ravindra Jadeja and Ravichandran Ashwin, looked in complete control. With the match against RCB set to be played at Chepauk, CSK will be confident of maintaining their stronghold at home.

RCB’s Bright Start to IPL 2025

RCB, on the other hand, cannot be taken lightly. In their opening encounter, they chased down 175 runs against KKR with ease, thanks to some explosive batting from Phil Salt, Virat Kohli, and Rajat Patidar. They secured victory with 3.4 overs and seven wickets to spare, showing their batting firepower.

With Pathirana’s injury ruling him out, CSK’s bowling attack will have to be at its absolute best to contain RCB’s batting lineup. Khaleel Ahmed, Jadeja, Ashwin, and Noor Ahmad will play key roles in ensuring that Chennai maintains its home advantage.

CSK vs RCB: The Chepauk Factor

Chepauk has been a fortress for CSK, especially against RCB. The Bengaluru-based franchise has not won at this venue since 2008, losing every encounter since then. Even in terms of overall head-to-head battles, CSK has won 21 out of the 33 games played between these two teams.

However, RCB will be motivated by the fact that they knocked CSK out of IPL 2024, defeating them in a crucial match at Chinnaswamy Stadium. This adds an extra layer of intensity to the upcoming showdown at Chepauk.

With Matheesha Pathirana’s injury update confirming his absence, CSK’s bowling attack will have to step up. Can they extend their 17-year unbeaten run against RCB at home, or will Bengaluru finally break the streak? Fans are in for an electrifying contest!

title: How MS Dhoni Shaped D Gukesh's Chess Mindset with IPL Influence?
content:
D Gukesh, the youngest world chess champion, is not just admired for his exceptional chess skills but also for his calm demeanor under pressure, which has played a pivotal role in his rise to the top. Interestingly, Gukesh credits one of India’s most iconic sports figures, MS Dhoni, for inspiring him to handle high-pressure situations with a clear mind. Their shared connection to Chennai, Gukesh’s hometown and Dhoni’s long-time leadership of Chennai Super Kings (CSK), has only amplified this influence.

In an interview with the CSK YouTube channel, Gukesh spoke about how MS Dhoni’s ability to remain unflustered during intense moments of a cricket match deeply impacted his chess approach. “MS Dhoni is one sportsperson I really admire. To this day, he is the one. How he doesn’t react to anything that happens. How he is able to calmly think in any situation. In the highest-pressure moments, he is able to think with a clear mind,” Gukesh shared. Watching Dhoni maintain composure on the field during crucial moments, such as the 2011 World Cup final, sparked in D Gukesh the desire to mirror this level-headedness in his own game of chess.

For a sport like chess, where mental focus is crucial, staying calm is key, especially when stakes are high. Whether it’s the intense pressure of a critical match or the stress of a momentary lapse in strategy, Gukesh learned from Dhoni to avoid emotional reactions. This ability to “think simple” and maintain mental clarity, even during stressful situations, became an integral part of Gukesh’s chess mindset.

“I tend to think, how did Dhoni handle so much of pressure?”: D Gukesh

The IPL influence runs deep for Gukesh, who not only admires Dhoni’s leadership qualities but also his calm approach in handling pressure during high-stakes cricket moments. Gukesh confessed that he often reflects on how Dhoni would tackle pressure during his own chess games. “In those high-pressure moments, I tend to think, how did Dhoni handle so much of pressure?” said Gukesh. This thought process has helped the young grandmaster remain focused and make thoughtful moves on the chessboard.

A dedicated sports enthusiast, Gukesh, who also follows CSK’s journey in the IPL, recently visited the iconic MA Chidambaram Stadium (Chepauk), where he met CSK spinner R. Ashwin. He expressed his admiration for Dhoni’s World Cup-winning six in 2011 as one of his most cherished memories.

D Gukesh’s rise to the top of the chess world reflects the powerful influence of MS Dhoni’s leadership and composure. As the world watches the upcoming IPL 2025 season, it’s clear that the connection between these two sporting icons will continue to inspire and influence generations to come.

title: 'Even If I Am In A Wheelchair…': MS Dhoni Breaks Silence On IPL 2025 Retirement Rumours
content:
Chennai Super Kings legend MS Dhoni is all set to feature in his 18th consecutive season of the Indian Premier League (IPL). CSK fans’s “Thala”, Dhoni has played a pivotal role in leading the franchise to five IPL titles—the joint-most in the history of the competition. His leadership and match-winning abilities have made him one of the most iconic figures in the IPL. Last season, however, Dhoni stepped down as captain, handing over the reins to Ruturaj Gaikwad, his trusted teammate. Despite this change, Dhoni’s presence and influence in the CSK squad remain undeniable.

Since announcing his international retirement in 2020, Dhoni’s future in the IPL has been a topic of constant speculation. As he prepares for yet another IPL season, questions regarding whether the 43-year-old will retire from playing cricket continue to loom large. Nevertheless, his unwavering commitment to the game and Chennai Super Kings suggests that the end of his playing career may not be imminent.

“This is my franchise“: MS Dhoni Promises to Play for CSK Ever on Wheelchair

During the IPL 2023 season, Dhoni played through a painful knee injury, which eventually led him to undergo surgery. Despite the setback, he played a vital role in guiding CSK to their fifth IPL title. That victory helped the franchise tie with Mumbai Indians for the most IPL titles in history. Dhoni’s decision to bat lower down the order in 2023 as a finisher—amidst his injury—highlighted his adaptability and his enduring value to CSK. He has consistently proven that age is no barrier to his performance, and his ability to deliver in pressure situations remains unmatched.

In a candid interview with JioHotstar, Dhoni gave a hint about his future, stating with characteristic humor that even if he were to be in a wheelchair, CSK would drag him onto the field to play. “This is my franchise. Even if I am in a wheelchair, they will drag me,” Dhoni jokingly remarked, showcasing his undying commitment to the team and the game.

Cricket legend Sunil Gavaskar has also weighed in on the ongoing debate about Dhoni’s future. Gavaskar believes that questioning Dhoni’s ability is futile, as the former captain consistently proves his doubters wrong. “Every time people question MS Dhoni, he proves them wrong,” Gavaskar said, adding, “Even at this age, he’s hitting sixes not just past the boundary but into the stands during practice. Age is just a number when it comes to Dhoni.”

title: MS Dhoni Turns Into 'Animal' in 2025 Ad for Sandeep Reddy Vanga
content:
Can you imagine Thala Dhoni, who is known for his calm and composed demeanor on and off the field, transforming into an ‘Animal’? This is exactly what we saw in the recent 2025 advertisement for EMotorad. This features MS Dhoni Animal Ad in a completely unexpected and exciting new avatar. The ad, directed by Sandeep Reddy Vanga, has gone viral, creating a buzz that’s impossible to ignore.

In the advertisement, Dhoni sports long hair, resembling Bollywood actor Ranbir Kapoor’s look in the much-anticipated movie Animal. The visual transformation was complemented by Dhoni delivering a line that has since become iconic: “Sunaiye de raha hai mujhe, behra nahi hu main” (I can hear, I’m not deaf). It’s a moment that perfectly encapsulates Dhoni’s intense, fearless side – one that fans rarely get to see.

MS Dhoni Animal Ad 2025: From Captain Cool to Fierce New Avatar

The ad not only showcased Dhoni’s fierce new image but also highlighted his easy camaraderie with director Sandeep Reddy Vanga. At one point, Dhoni even jokingly asks if his new long hair look is “too much,” leading to an amusing exchange between the two. This playful yet bold new avatar is reminiscent of Ranbir Kapoor’s Animal. This has sparked a massive reaction on social media, with fans expressing their excitement and surprise. MS Dhoni Animal Ad viral success is a testament to the fact that Dhoni’s influence extends far beyond the cricket field.

While Dhoni has long been known for his ‘Captain Cool’ persona, this advertisement shows fans a new, unfiltered side of him. And as he gears up for IPL 2025, this fresh look may just signal a shift in the way he approaches the upcoming season, like intense, focused, and full of surprises.

Harbhajan shared, “I asked him, ‘Isn’t it tough to maintain this level of fitness at your age?’. Dhoni responded, ‘Yes, it’s difficult, but it’s the only thing I love doing.’”

His daily practice routine in Chennai is a testament to his relentless work ethic. He is often the first to arrive and the last to leave the practice ground, even at this stage in his career. Harbhajan added, “It’s not just about surviving; Dhoni is still dominating. MS Dhoni and the EMotorad Electric Cycle Ad: A New Chapter for the Legend

Finally, Dhoni’s partnership with EMotorad for the electric cycle ad is yet another sign that the cricket icon is embracing new ventures. The ad, which was released just before IPL 2025, shows Dhoni in a new light. Not only is he taking on the role of a fierce, ‘Animal’-like character in the ad, but he’s also aligning himself with an environmentally conscious product. As India moves toward sustainability, Dhoni’s association with EMotorad highlights his ability to adapt and evolve with the times, both as a cricketer and as a public figure.

With IPL 2025 just around the corner, Dhoni’s commitment to his fitness and his newfound ‘Animal’ persona have fans excited for what’s to come. Whether on the field or in front of the camera, MS Dhoni is proving that age is just a number and that he’s still capable of surprising us in the most unexpected ways. So, the question remains: Will Dhoni’s fierce new avatar help propel him to yet another unforgettable IPL season? Only time will tell, but one thing is for sure—his transformation into an ‘Animal’ is a glimpse into the fierce determination that will drive him forward.

title: The Making of Ruturaj Gaikwad: CSK’s Journey with Their Star Opener
content:
The first episode of the “The Making of…” The Chennai Super Kings series is finally out. And it features none other than our beloved Captain Ruturaj Gaikwad.

Titled “The Making of Ruturaj Gaikwad,” the episode features Gaikwad’s cricketing journey.

What is the Making of Ruturaj Gaikwad CSK series about?

It takes one back to the early 2000s, when Ruturaj was still just a small kid trying to understand the game. Beginning with the narration by Rutu’s father, we learn that he started playing at a very tender age.

Firstly, his parents helped him understand the dynamics of the game. Later, he started practicing in a field, where others used to admire him.

Watching Ruturaj practice with a hard leather ball and still manage to connect and time his shots, people started calling him “Chhota Tendulkar.” We also see some newspaper clippings that his father has collected over the years that call Gaikwad the “Chhota Tendulkar” of Sangvi.

Following this, the episode details his cricketing journey in particular. We learn that Gaikwad has represented Maharashtra at every age level. However, he was not able to make it to the India Under-19 Squad. We are also told about how he broke his finger ahead of his Ranji debut.

The last segment of the episode is dedicated to Ruturaj’s journey in the Chennai Super Kingsteam. It describes how he became an integral part of the team and eventually its captain.

Where to watch The Making of Ruturaj Gaikwad?

The The Making of Ruturaj Gaikwad, a CSK series can be wathced for free on the CSK YouTube page:

Ruturaj Gaikwad in CSK

Ruturaj Gaikwad has been a revelation at the top of the order for Chennai Super Kings. His elegant stroke play, impeccable timing, and ability to pace an innings make him a vital cog in CSK’s batting unit.

He formed a formidable partnership with Faf du Plessis, playing a crucial role in CSK’s 2021 title triumph. Later, he seamlessly adapted to a new opening partner in Devon Conway, with the duo becoming one of the most consistent opening pairs in the league.

Since making his debut for Chennai Super Kings (CSK) in IPL 2020, Ruturaj Gaikwad has been a vital cog in the team’s batting lineup. In 52 matches for CSK, he has amassed 1797 runs at an impressive average of 39.07 and a strike rate of 135.52.

His breakout season came in 2021, where he scored 635 runs in 16 matches, winning the Orange Cap and helping CSK secure their fourth IPL title. Over the years, he has smashed 14 fifties and a century, solidifying his reputation as a consistent opener. Now, as captain, he looks to script a new chapter in CSK’s history.

Ruturaj Gaikwad will return to action very soon. He will captain the Chennai Super Kings in their first game of the IPL 2025 against the Mumbai Indians.

title: "The Making Of" Chennai Super Kings to release new Docu-Series: Know release dates
content:
Chennai Super Kings have released a trailer to announce the release of their new docu-series, “The Making Of…” which seems to feature CSK’s players and their lives on and beyond the cricket field.

The five-time IPL champions teased about it using clips that went viral on the internet. The trailer received a lot of love from the fans, and hence, the CSK “The Making of…” trailer is finally out.

What is CSK docu-series “The Making Of…” about?

From the first glimpse, the series seems to focus on only four players now. The first one is Ruturaj Gaikwad, who opens the trailer by talking about how he will fight for his teammates.

There are several other scenes of Gaikwad, but one of the most famous is captain Ruturaj Gaikwad’s conversation with his wife. In the video, it was shown how his wife, Utkarsha Pawar, who is also a cricketer, got the news that Gaikwad will be the next captain of Chennai Super Kings.

Then, we have a glimpse of Ravichandran Ashwin’s parents. The legendary spinner’s mother talks about how her husband has been obsessed with our spin maestro since he was a kid.

In the third scene, we are introduced to our silent killer-slinger, Matheesha Pathirana. It appears that his sister, along with his family, is featured in this series, and they narrate the other side of Pathirana’s life—how he is beyond the field.

The fourth player teased in the trailer is Gurjapneet Singh. He is a surprise inclusion here, for he has yet to play a season for the Chennai Super Kings. However, that doesn’t mean people won’t want to know his story.

What really got every CSK fan hooked is the one scene featuring MS Dhoni. His wry smile tells a different story. Hence, it will be interesting to see if we get to witness MS Dhoni in the new CSK Series.

When is CSK series “The Making Of…” releasing?

The Chennai Super Kings’ recently launched trailer for their new series has no release date. It reads “coming soon,” but one can be rest assured that the series will be dropped before the IPL 2025.

This could be a strategic move to get people involved with the squad. Get them talking about the players, hence, when the action unfolds on the ground, the people know what these players have endured to get where they are today.

How many players feature in the Chennai Super Kings series?

The trailer shows four CSK players in the new docu-series announced by CSK: Ruturaj Gaikwad, Ravichandran Ashwin, Matheesha Pathirana, and Gurjapneet Singh.

But this doesn’t necessarily mean that the series will be limited to these players. The trailer reads, “Get ready for some inspiring, emotional, hilarious, exciting stories,” so it’s anyone’s guess.

Still, given their positioning so far, one can guarantee that the series will feature some new and unseen sides of our favorite players. As fans, that’s what we really ask for.

Other series on Chennai Super Kings

There is another series on Chennai named “Roar of the Lion.” This series was made after Chennai Super Kings returned to IPL in 2018 with a bang and won their third title as well. The main purpose of this story was to show how much the team meant to the players and the fans alike.

CSK’s ban was lifted in 2018, and they returned after two seasons. Hence, immense pressure was on them to prove their innocence and that playing the game was their biggest and most cherished possession.

That’s exactly what the team did. Dubbed as “daddy’s army,” for having too many senior players in their late 30s. However, the team proved everyone wrong by winning the title.

If you haven’t watched it, the series is great viewing and is available at Jio Hotstar.

title: Rachin Ravindra, Kane Williamson Break Records in Champions Trophy Semi final 2025
content:
In an electrifying Champions Trophy Semi Final 2025 clash between New Zealand and South Africa, two of the most impressive figures in world cricket, Rachin Ravindra and Kane Williamson, shone bright, breaking records and taking New Zealand to the final. This high-stakes match not only showed depth of New Zealand’s batting but also witnessed historic milestones, with both players playing pivotal roles in setting a record total for the tournament’s semifinal stage.

Rachin Ravindra, Kane Williamson Show in Champions Trophy Semi Final 2025

Rachin Ravindra stole the show with a brilliant century in the Champions Trophy 2025, showcasing his ability to perform under pressure. Ravindra’s knock became the highest individual score in a Champions Trophy semifinal 2025, helping New Zealand reach an imposing total of 362. His temperament and technique in tackling the South African bowling attack proved why he is becoming one of the most consistent young batsmen on the international circuit.

Following Ravindra’s spectacular innings, Kane Williamson, the experienced New Zealand captain, also displayed his class with an elegant century against South Africa. His innings were crucial in stabilizing the team after early wickets and allowing the middle order to build partnerships. Williamson’s leadership and expertise were key factors in New Zealand’s impressive batting performance in the Champions Trophy 2025, with the team finishing with the highest total in Champions Trophy semifinal 2025.

Rachin Ravindra Records in New Zealand vs South Africa Champions Trophy 2025 semifinal match

Here are 5 notable milestones of Rachin Ravindra in the New Zealand vs South Africa Champions Trophy 2025 semifinal match:

  1. Ravindra scored his fifth ODI century in ICC tournaments (three in the 2023 World Cup and two in the 2025 Champions Trophy), making him the only player to have scored their first five ODI centuries in ICC tournaments. This remarkable feat highlights his consistency on the big stage.
  2. With an impressive batting average of 67.00 in ICC ODI tournaments (World Cup and Champions Trophy), Ravindra has accumulated 804 runs in 13 innings with two fifties and five hundreds. This is the highest average among 80 players with a minimum of 750 runs in these tournaments, showcasing his dominance in global events.
  3. Ravindra was part of the record-breaking New Zealand total of 362/6 against South Africa, the highest total ever in a Champions Trophy semifinal, surpassing Australia’s 356/5 against England in Lahore. This high total helped New Zealand secure a commanding position.
  4. Ravindra’s ability to anchor the innings during critical phases of the game was evident, as he contributed significantly to setting up the total. His composed innings were pivotal in ensuring New Zealand’s strong batting performance.
  5. Ravindra’s performance in the semifinal underlined his ability to shine in ICC knockout matches, where his contributions have been a key factor in New Zealand’s success. With consistent runs and crucial centuries, Ravindra continues to establish himself as one of the premier players in ICC events.

New Zealand’s total, driven by these two exceptional performances, was enough to overwhelm South Africa, securing a place in the final. Their partnership exemplified New Zealand’s strength in ICC tournaments and further solidified their reputation as one of the most dangerous teams in world cricket.

How Rachin Ravindra Strengthens CSK in IPL 2025?

In addition to their Champions Trophy feats, Rachin Ravindra is also expected to make a significant impact in the 2025 IPL. As a key player for Chennai Super Kings (CSK), Ravindra’s all-round skills will be crucial in strengthening CSK’s lineup. His batting prowess, along with his ability to contribute with the ball, makes him a valuable asset for the franchise in 2025. Ravindra’s role in CSK 2025 will likely see him become one of the standout players, with his ability to handle pressure situations a key asset for the team.

Rachin Ravindra and Kane Williamson’s performances in the Champions Trophy Semi Final 2025 not only cemented their place in cricket history but also set the stage for New Zealand’s exciting future in international cricket.

title: MS Dhoni Fuels For Last IPL 2025 Retirement Rumors with Cryptic Hint
content:
MS Dhoni Last IPL Season: As the 2025 edition of the Indian Premier League (IPL) approaches, MS Dhoni has once again sparked retirement rumors with a cryptic hint that could signal the end of his illustrious career in the tournament. Known for his leadership of Chennai Super Kings (CSK), Dhoni has become synonymous with the franchise, but his recent actions have left fans wondering if the 2025 IPL will mark Dhoni’s last IPL season.

MS Dhoni, who has captained CSK to multiple IPL titles, arrived in Chennai for the preseason training camp ahead of IPL 2025. The camp will take place at the Chepauk Stadium, preparing for CSK’s first match against arch-rivals Mumbai Indians on March 23. However, it wasn’t just his return to the city that got fans talking but a striking message on his t-shirt that caught everyone’s attention. Written in Morse code, the shirt boldly displayed the words: “One last time.” This cryptic message has quickly gone viral on social media, igniting speculation that MS Dhoni’s final IPL season in 2025 could be upon us.

MS Dhoni Last IPL Season: Is IPL 2025 Dhoni Retirement Season? 

This isn’t the first time Dhoni’s retirement has been a topic of discussion. Over the past few years, fans and media have often speculated about his future in the IPL, with the 43-year-old hinting at stepping away from the game in previous seasons. However, this time, the cryptic retirement message seems more deliberate. Coupled with his comments earlier this month about wanting to enjoy his remaining years in cricket “like a child,” Dhoni’s actions suggest that he might be contemplating his last IPL season in 2025.

In addition, there’s been further intrigue about Dhoni’s participation in IPL 2025 due to a rule reinstated by the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI). According to this rule, Indian players who haven’t featured in international cricket for at least five years are considered “uncapped” for the IPL auction. With Dhoni’s last international appearance being in the 2019 World Cup, he qualifies for this status, adding another layer of mystery to the upcoming season.

Whether or not MS Dhoni final IPL season 2025 is truly here remains to be seen. But with his “One last time” message, it’s clear that his Chennai Super Kings last season could be a sentimental farewell for both Dhoni and his fans. As the IPL season begins, all eyes will be on Dhoni as he potentially plays his final game in the league that made him a legend.
