title: Rachin Ravindra Injury: Doubtful for SA ODI After Pakistan Blow
content:
New Zealand batter Rachin Ravindra might not play in the upcoming ODI against South Africa on Monday after getting injured during the New Zealand vs Pakistan tri-series match on Saturday. Rachin Ravindra suffered a dangerous-looking injury while fielding and is now being closely monitored by the team’s medical staff.

Rachin Ravindra head injury happened in the 37th over of Pakistan’s innings when Ravindra was fielding at deep square leg. Khushdil Shah played a slog-sweep shot off Michael Bracewell’s bowling, sending the ball towards Ravindra. He prepared to catch it but seemed to misjudge the ball’s flight. Instead of taking the catch, the ball hit him hard on the forehead.

The impact was strong, and Rachin Ravindra took a blow to forehead. After getting hit, he appeared stunned and remained still for a moment, looking down at the ground. Blood was seen flowing from his forehead as medical staff quickly rushed to assist him. His teammates and fans watched with concern as he received treatment on the field.

New Zealand Cricket (NZC) later provided an update on his condition. They stated that despite the head injury, Ravindra is otherwise fine. Rachin Ravindra sustained some stitches. Hence, the team’s medical staff will continue to observe him to ensure he recovers fully before he returns to play.

Head injuries in cricket can be serious, so the team management is being cautious. If Ravindra does not recover in time, he is likely to miss Monday’s match against South Africa. His health and safety remain the top priority for the team.

Ravindra is an important player for New Zealand, and his absence could be a setback for the team. However, they have other players ready to step in if he is unable to play. Fans will be hoping for his quick recovery so he can return to action soon.

Despite the unfortunate incident, New Zealand will hope to have Ravindra back in the team soon at least after South Africa vs New Zealand. He has been a key player for them, and his absence could be a setback. However, the team’s priority will be his health and safety. With the Champions Trophy 2025 on the horizon, New Zealand will be eager to have all their key players fit and available for the upcoming challenges.

Moreover, New Zealand’s Glenn Phillips scored his maiden ODI century in the same match. Known for his explosive T20 style, Phillips demonstrated remarkable composure, anchoring the innings with a perfect blend of aggression and smart shot selection. His century was pivotal in steering New Zealand to a competitive total against a disciplined bowling attack.

title: India vs England: Shivam Dube Fifty and Pandya's Partnership Help India Seal T20 Series
content:
CSK’s Shivam Dube made an immaculate comeback in the T20I, scoring a match-winning fifty. Playing his first match after almost half a year in the shortest format of the game, Dube made it count with a 30-ball fifty in the 4th IND vs ENG T20I in Pune. All-rounder Hardik Pandya also delivered a powerful performance, scoring a blistering 53 off just 30 balls. Shivam Dube fifty and the 87-run partnership with Hardik Pandya guided India to a respectable total of 181/9 in the fourth T20I against England.

Courtesy of Shivam Dube and Hardik Pandya’s performances, India beat England by 15 runs in the fourth T20I at the Maharashtra Cricket Association Stadium in Pune on Friday to clinch the series 3-1. Moreover, concussion substitute Harshit Rana (3/33) was the pick of the bowlers for India with three wickets.

IND vs ENG 4th T20I Live Updates:

India’s innings got off to a shaky start, losing three wickets in the second over itself. However, a crucial 87-run partnership between Pandya and Shivam Dube revived the innings. Dube, who was a late replacement for Nitish Kumar Reddy, played a crucial role, scoring a quickfire 53 off 34 balls. Shivam Dube fifty in Pune was is fourth in this format.

Pandya, initially slow to get going, exploded in the 17th over, unleashing a barrage of powerful shots against Jofra Archer. He showcased his incredible hitting power, clearing the ropes four times and finding the boundary four times. The highlight of his innings was a breathtaking no-look six off Jamie Overton, where he didn’t even bother to look at the ball as it sailed over long-on.

Dube also played a significant role, taking on the England bowlers aggressively. He particularly targeted Adil Rashid, hitting him for several sixes, helping India recover from a disastrous start. However, During his comeback innings, Shivam Dube was struck on his head by a Jamie Overton bouncer, and it led to him getting replaced by Harshit Rana as a concussion substitute on his T20I debut.

Earlier, England captain Jos Buttler won the toss and opted to bowl first, a rare occurrence in the series. However, the Indian lower order, led by Pandya and Dube, ensured that India posted a competitive total despite losing wickets at regular intervals. This partnership proved crucial in putting pressure back on England and setting up an exciting finish to the match.

content:

His ability to handle pressure and play powerful strokes highlights that this latest CSK signee has the potential to become a future star for Indian cricket.

The Chennai Super Kings fans eagerly await Siddarth’s IPL debut, hoping to see him shine in the upcoming season. Given his recent Ranji Trophy 2025 achievement, he could become an exciting addition to CSK’s lineup. Siddarth was also part of India’s U19 squad for the U19 Asia Cup 2024, scoring 92 runs in four innings.

Apart from Siddarth, Ravindra Jadeja was another CSK player who had a great outing in the Ranji Trophy. He picked up 12 wickets for Saurashtra in their triumph against Delhi and was adjudged the man of the match for his great bowling efforts.

CSK’s IPL 2025 squad features a mix of experienced players and young talents like Andre Siddarth. Key retained players include Ruturaj Gaikwad, Ravindra Jadeja, Matheesha Pathirana, Shivam Dube, and MS Dhoni.

With his current form in domestic cricket, Andre Siddarth is certainly a player to watch as he prepares to take his skills to the next level in the IPL 2025.

title: Ravindra Jadeja cryptic Instagram post sparks retirement rumors
content:
Indian cricket star Ravindra Jadeja has set the cricket world abuzz with a cryptic Instagram post featuring his Test jersey. Fans and experts are trying very hard to decipher the meaning, with some fearing it might be a hint of his retirement from Test cricket.

The post has gone viral, sparking numerous speculation on social media. Fans are left guessing, with some questioning its significance and others offering farewell messages. This comes after Jadeja’s retirement from T20Is following India’s World Cup win last year. However, he remains active in ODIs and Tests.

Jadeja’s recent performance in the Test series against Australia, which India lost 1-3, has also come under scrutiny. Reports suggest the BCCI selection committee might be considering his future due to his underwhelming performance (4 wickets and 135 runs at an average of 27).

Is Ravindra Jadeja Going to Announce Retirement from Test Cricket?

The timing of the post adds to the mystery, as India has a busy schedule ahead. With squad announcements for the upcoming T20I, ODI series against England, and the Champions Trophy, Jadeja’s inclusion or exclusion could be a significant indicator of his future.

Reports suggest the selectors, along with head coach Gautam Gambhir, are thinking of a transition to younger players for the 2027 World Cup. This raises questions about whether they’ll retain Jadeja or opt for a fresh approach.

“Happy Retirement Jaddu”: Fans React to Jadeja’s Instagram Post

Jadeja’s Instagram story left many guessing, with some interpreting it as a hint that Jadeja might be considering retirement from Test cricket. Reactions poured in on X (formerly Twitter), where fans speculated on the significance of the post.

While one user commented, “Any hint?” another wrote, “Happy Retirement Jaddu.” The post comes after Jadeja retired from T20Is following India’s World Cup triumph in June last year. However, the spin-bowling all-rounder continues to be active in ODIs and Test cricket.

title: New CSK Signee Jamie Overton Attempts R Ashwin-like Run Out in BBL
content:
Chennai Super Kings’ (CSK) new recruit, Jamie Overton made headlines during a Big Bash League (BBL) match between the Adelaide Strikers and the Perth Scorchers at the Adelaide Oval. Representing the Strikers, Overton attempted a Mankad against Finn Allen, a former RCB batter playing for the Scorchers, but chose to issue a warning instead.

The incident occurred during the 8th over when Overton noticed Allen leaving the non-striker’s crease early. Overton stopped his delivery, dislodged the bails, and could have appealed to dismiss Allen. However, he decided to give Allen a second chance by issuing a warning. This moment highlighted Overton’s sportsmanship despite the tension in the match.

Allen responded strongly on the last ball of the over, smashing a back-of-a-length delivery from Overton for a stunning six over deep cover. The match also saw heated exchanges between the two players, adding drama to the contest.

Jamie Overton, who was bought by CSK in the IPL 2025 auction for INR 1.5 crore, has gained attention for his competitive spirit. On the other hand, Finn Allen went unsold in the auction.

“Our Vibe Should Attract the Tribe”: R Ashwin Reacts to CSK’s Jamie Overton Mankad Attempt

Former India off-spinner R Ashwin reacted to Jamie Overton’s attempt to run out Finn Allen. Ashwin appeared to support Overton, who was quick to notice Allen leaving the non-striker’s crease before the delivery stride was completed.

Running out a batter at the non-striker’s end for backing up too far has long been considered controversial, with many viewing it as unsporting. However, this perception has changed in recent years. In October 2022, the International Cricket Council (ICC) reclassified this dismissal as a legitimate “Run Out,” aiming to remove any stigma associated with it.

The topic gained significant attention during the 2019 IPL season when Ashwin, then captain of the Punjab Kings, ran out Rajasthan Royals’ Jos Buttler at the non-striker’s end. This sparked widespread debate about the spirit of cricket. Despite facing criticism, Ashwin defended his actions, emphasizing that the dismissal was fully within the laws of the game.

Since then, Ashwin has been a vocal advocate for the dismissal, often pointing out that it promotes fairness by holding batters accountable for staying within their crease.

Jamie Overton, who issued a warning to Finn Allen in the BBL instead of completing the run-out, is set to join Ashwin at the Chennai Super Kings for IPL 2025. Their shared views on this mode of dismissal could make for interesting conversations in the CSK dressing room.

Interestingly, Jamie Overton is set to play alongside Ashwin for Chennai Super Kings in the IPL 2025 season.

title: MS Dhoni: "If You Play Good Cricket, You Don’t Need PR"
content:
Mahendra Singh Dhoni, one of India’s most iconic cricketers, recently shared his honest thoughts on social media and public relations ( widely known as ‘PR’). Despite being a hugely popular figure, Dhoni has always maintained a subtle distance from social media platforms like X and Instagram. Notably, his last Instagram post was in July 2024, and he hasn’t been active since. Despite that, netizens keep picking on him for having a strong “PR” team and claiming that his team’s efforts make him famous ignoring all the greats of Thala Dhoni.

Read More: List of Brand Endorsed by MS Dhoni

The former Indian skipper revealed that throughout his career, many managers encouraged him to build his online presence. However, Dhoni firmly believed that good cricket speaks louder than PR. “I have never been a big fan of social media. Throughout, I have had so many managers and all of them keep pushing. I started playing in 2004; Twitter got popular later on, after which Instagram came in. All the managers told me, ‘you should do some PR, build this and build that’. I had the same answer that if you play good cricket, you don’t need PR,” Dhoni said during the Eurogrip Tred Talks.

Why MS Dhoni Never Really Needed ‘PR’ for his Popularity?

Dhoni’s cricketing career, which began in 2004, is nothing short of legendary. As India’s captain, he achieved unparalleled success. He remains the only captain in history to win all three ICC limited-overs trophies: the 2007 T20 World Cup, the 2011 ODI World Cup, and the 2013 Champions Trophy. In Test cricket, he led India in 60 matches, securing 27 wins and taking the team to the top of the ICC Test Rankings. Dhoni also captained India in 200 ODIs, with a win percentage of 55%, and 74 T20Is, winning 41 games with a win rate of 58.33%.

Now 43 years old, Dhoni is set to return to action in the 2025 Indian Premier League (IPL) for Chennai Super Kings (CSK). The franchise retained him for INR 4 crore under the new uncapped player rule. Dhoni will once again play for CSK side in a season that is considered to be his last. CSK has also retained key players like Ruturaj Gaikwad and Ravindra Jadeja, both valued at INR 18 crore, along with Shivam Dube and Matheesha Pathirana.

Dhoni’s decision to avoid social media and focus on his game reflects his no-nonsense approach to life and cricket. His accomplishments, both on and off the field, continue to inspire millions. As he gears up for another IPL season, fans are excited to see their beloved “Thala” back in action, leading CSK in their signature yellow jersey but not officially as a captain.

title: CSK Announces FedEx as Leading Sponsor Ahead of IPL 2025
content:
FedEx, the world’s leading express transportation company, has announced a significant global cricket sponsorship. The company will serve as the principal sponsor and official logistics partner for both Chennai Super Kings (CSK) in India and Johannesburg Super Kings (JSK) in South Africa.

This multi-year partnership, beginning in 2025, will see the FedEx logo prominently displayed on the back of CSK in the Indian Premiere League and JSK in the SA20 League. Leveraging its extensive global network, FedEx will efficiently transport team kits, match equipment, and official materials between India, Johannesburg, the U.S., and other locations where Super Kings players are based.

“Sports transcend borders”: FedEx CEO on Partnership with CSK

The sponsorship aims to engage with fans, customers, and communities through the shared passion for cricket.

“Sports transcend borders, uniting communities through passion, resilience, and shared experiences,” said Richard Smith, Chief Operating Officer, International, and CEO, Airline, FedEx. “Cricket is the heart and soul of India, a strategic market for FedEx, and this collaboration reflects our dedication to energizing growth and prosperity for businesses and people across the country and beyond.”

FedEx has a long history of sports sponsorships, including partnerships with the NFL, NASCAR, the PGA Tour, and the UEFA Champions League. “The marriage between two great brands – FedEx and CSK – is a statement of intent in terms of our intentions to grow big in India,” Smith added.

Kami Viswanathan, President of FedEx Middle East, Indian Subcontinent, and Africa, emphasized the alignment between FedEx’s values and the Super Kings’ ethos of winning excellence and teamwork.

“There is an alignment of our values in terms of winning excellence, teamwork and gives us an opportunity to engage with,” Viswanathan said.

She highlighted Chennai as a key growth market for FedEx and noted that South India presents significant growth potential. Choosing CSK among other IPL teams reflects the company’s recognition of CSK’s status as the most valuable IPL franchise, known for its strong fan following and consistent success. This partnership provides a valuable platform for FedEx to connect with cricket fans and strengthen its brand presence in India and beyond.

title: BREAKING!!! Ravichandran Ashwin Announces Retirement from International Cricket
content:
Indian off-spinner R Ashwin announced his retirement from all formats of international cricket on Wednesday, December 18th. Ashwin declared his decision during a press conference in Brisbane after the third Test match of the Border-Gavaskar Trophy against Australia ended in a draw.

Ashwin expressed his desire to continue playing cricket at the club and franchise level, stating that he still feels he has something to offer. He thanked his teammates and captain Rohit Sharma for the memories they shared throughout his career.

“This will be my last day as an Indian cricket in all formats of the game at the international level. I do feel there is a bit of punch left in me in a cricketer. I would like to showcase that in club-level cricket. So this will be my last day. I have had a lot of fun. I must say I’ve created a lot of memories alongside Rohit and several of my teammates,” Ashwin said at the press conference.

Speculations about his retirement arose earlier in the day when he was seen embracing former captain Virat Kohli in the dressing room. Ashwin later confirmed the news, ending the rumours.

title: “I’ve never seen a leader like MS Dhoni”: Sanjay Goenka Praises CSK Captain
content:
Sanjiv Goenka, owner of the Lucknow Super Giants, surprised many by recently praising MS Dhoni. This comes despite Goenka removing Dhoni as captain of his previous IPL team, the Rising Pune Supergiants, back in 2017.

Dhoni, still a vital part of the Chennai Super Kings (CSK), continues to impress fans with his on-field performances despite injuries. Goenka, speaking on a recent podcast, acknowledged Dhoni’s exceptional leadership qualities.

“He’s an amazing leader, constantly thinking and adapting,” Goenka said. “Even now, he’s finding new talent, like bowler Pathirana. He knows how to get the best out of his players, and I always learn something when I talk to him.”

WATCH: Sanjay Goenka Shares Heartwarming Interaction Between his Grandson and MS Dhoni

Goenka also shared a heartwarming anecdote about Dhoni’s interaction with his cricket-loving grandson.

“I have an 11-year-old grandson who is crazy about cricket. Dhoni in my home taught him how to play cricket, some 5-6 years ago. He constantly asked him questions, and I told my grandson, ‘Leave him now.’ Dhoni replied, ‘Let it be; I am enjoying this conversation.’ Dhoni went on to have a conversation with him for half an hour. This human quality with a kid where he spent so much time for a kid. It makes you learn how to speak with others, and that is why he is Dhoni. Whenever he plays against Lucknow, the entire stadium is filled with yellow to support him,” he added.

Even when busy, Dhoni patiently spent time answering the child’s questions, showcasing his genuine personality. This, Goenka believes, is a big part of Dhoni’s enduring popularity.

“I have no reason, perhaps he does,” says Harbhajan Singh

During his recent interview with CricketNext, the off-spinner hinted that Mahendra Singh Dhoni might have some reason to not having any proper chat with him as he believes. He also said that there is no such thing for him towards the former Indian skipper.

“No, I don’t speak to Dhoni. When I was playing at CSK, that’s when we spoke, but otherwise, we haven’t spoken. It’s been 10 years and more. I have no reason; perhaps he does. I don’t know what the reasons are. When we were playing in the IPL at CSK, that’s when we used to talk, and that, too, was restricted to the ground. After that, he did not come to my room, nor did I go to his,” he said.

They have been part of many memorable moments together apart from their CSK days like T20 World winning campaign of 2007 and the 50-overs World Cup victory in 2011.

I have nothing against Mahendra Singh Dhoni: Harbhajan

Harbhajan expressed that he tried to speak Dhoni many a times but didn’t get any reply from the latter so he decided to refrain himself from doing so.

“I don’t have anything against him. If he has something to say, he can tell me. But if he did, he would have told me by now. I never tried to call him because I have a lot of passion. I only ring up those who pick up my calls. I don’t have the time otherwise. I stay in touch with the ones I am friends with. A relationship is always about give and take. If I respect you, I hope you will respect me back. Or you respond to me. But if I call you once or twice but don’t get a response, I will probably only meet you as much as I am needed to,” he added in the same interaction.

Notably, Harbhajan Singh was part of the Chennai based Indian Premier League (IPL) franchise from 2018 to 2020 but their talks were limited to the on-field talks about the game.

With the pressure touching the sky, Dhoni, known for his finishing abilities, wasted no time. He hit Dayal out of the Chinnaswamy Stadium on the very first ball of the over, reducing the target to 11 runs from 6 balls. However, Dayal remained calm under pressure. On the fifth ball, with 11 runs still needed, he outfoxed Dhoni, forcing him to top-edge the ball. Dhoni, visibly frustrated, walked off the field after being dismissed.

It was a redemption story for Dayal, who had previously been on the receiving end of a brutal attack by rising star Rinku Singh. Dayal only conceded 7 runs in that final over, proving his nerves of steel and delivering a crucial performance that kept RCB’s hopes alive.

With the upcoming IPL 2025, Dayal shared a video of that moment on social media, reliving the dismissal of MS Dhoni. However, this move sparked a debate among fans. “Yash Dayal needs to hesitate”: RCB Pacer Faces Backlash for Sharing MS Dhoni Dismissal in IPL 2024

title: Deepak Chahar and Family Share Emotional Posts On CSK Exit After IPL 2025 Auction
content:
Mumbai Indians (MI) secured the services of Deepak Chahar for ₹9.25 crore in the recently held IPL 2025 mega auction. This marks the end of Chahar’s long association with Chennai Super Kings (CSK). Deepak had been an integral part of CSK since joining the franchise in 2018, contributing significantly to the team’s success over the years.

He played 76 matches for CSK, taking 76 wickets and was instrumental in their title wins in 2018, 2021, and 2023. His skills with the ball, especially in the death overs, were crucial to the team’s strategy. However, despite his impressive contributions, he was not retained by CSK in the auction, leading to his move to MI.

Deepak Chahar and Family Reflect On CSK Exit After IPL 2025 Auction

Despite the sadness of leaving CSK, Deepak expressed excitement about his new journey with MI. In an interview, he mentioned that while he had hoped to continue with CSK, he was eager to join another successful franchise with a rich history of IPL victories.

“I’m quite happy. I had hoped to continue with CSK, but no regrets. Now, I’ll be playing for another great franchise that has won five IPL trophies. I’ll obviously miss playing with MS Dhoni. Mumbai Indians is a great franchise, so I’m really looking forward to playing for them.”

Deepak admitted that he would miss playing alongside MS Dhoni but looked forward to new challenges and opportunities with MI. He also shared his goal of making a comeback to the Indian team, focusing on performing well in IPL 2025 and beyond.

Deepak’s departure from CSK has been emotional, not just for him but also for his family. His sister, Malti Chahar, shared a heartfelt post on social media expressing her gratitude to CSK for the love and memories created over the years. She reflected on their beautiful journey with the team, cherishing the love they received and the memories of three IPL title victories. Her emotional words, “My heart will always belong to you,” resonated with many fans who saw the Chahar family as an inseparable part of CSK’s legacy.

Deepak’s wife, Jaya Bhardwaj, also shared an emotional message after the auction, reminiscing about her time with CSK. She fondly recalled the moment in 2021 when Deepak proposed to her in front of the entire crowd at the Dubai stadium after a match against Punjab Kings. Jaya’s Instagram post highlighted how CSK had become a part of their lives, and she expressed her eternal connection to the franchise, saying, “My heart will always be tied to this team.”

title: CSK Fails to Buy Back Loyal Pacers Deepak Chahar and Tushar Deshpande in IPL 2025 Mega Auction
content:
In a surprising twist during the IPL 2025 Mega Auction, Chennai Super Kings (CSK) failed to secure two key players who had been vital to their bowling attack in recent seasons. After many efforts, CSK failed to buy back Deepak Chahar and Tushar Deshpande. Both players, who had contributed significantly to CSK’s success in previous years, were bought up by rival franchises Mumbai Indians and Rajasthan Royals respectively.

CSK Losses Deepak Chahar to Mumbai Indians; Tushar Deshpande’s Departure to Rajasthan Royals

The most notable move was Deepak Chahar’s shift from CSK to arch-rivals Mumbai Indians. Chahar, a player who had become a reason for CSK’s success, especially in the powerplay overs, was expecting to return to the franchise. Chahar had been a key part of CSK’s bowling attack since 2018, excelling with his swing and precision. In the 2019 season, he claimed 22 wickets in 17 matches, playing a crucial role in the team’s run to the final.

However, during the IPL 2025 Mega Auction, CSK was unable to retain Chahar after a fierce bidding war. Starting at a base price of INR 2 crore, Chahar’s price quickly escalated as multiple franchises, including Punjab Kings (PBKS) and MI, entered the war. MI, determined to strengthen their pace attack, eventually secured Chahar for INR 9.25 crore, a record price for the pacer. CSK’s efforts to retain him with a bid of INR 8 crore were not enough, and Chahar ended up with MI, marking a painful loss for CSK.

Another setback for CSK came with the loss of Tushar Deshpande to Rajasthan Royals. Deshpande had played a crucial role in CSK’s 2023 IPL title run, taking 21 wickets in 16 matches. He followed this up with a consistent performance in 2024, taking 17 wickets in 13 matches, proving his value as a reliable pacer for the team. His ability to bowl in the death overs made him an essential part of CSK’s bowling lineup.

In this year’s auction, CSK made an early bid to bring Deshpande back, but Rajasthan Royals soon joined the bidding. After a tense auction battle, CSK chose not to exercise their Right to Match (RTM) option when the price reached INR 6.50 crore. Deshpande was ultimately bought by Rajasthan Royals for this amount, marking the end of his stint with CSK.

Both Chahar and Deshpande’s departures were a blow to CSK, who had relied on their bowling abilities in recent seasons. With these key players now gone, CSK faces the challenge of rebuilding their pace attack ahead of the 2025 season.

title: "A Homecoming": R Ashwin Returns to CSK Ahead of IPL 2025
content:
The return of Ravichandran Ashwin to Chennai Super Kings (CSK) ahead of IPL 2025 has created excitement among fans, with CSK head coach Stephen Fleming describing the move as a true “homecoming.”

During the IPL 2025 Mega Auction in Jeddah, Chennai Super Kings secured the services of R Ashwin for INR 9.75 crore, beating competition from Rajasthan Royals, Royal Challengers Bengaluru, and Lucknow Super Giants in an intense bidding battle.

Ashwin previously represented CSK from 2009 to 2015 and played a key role in the franchise’s success during its golden era. His return reunites one of Chennai’s most successful spinners with the five-time IPL champions.

Stephen Fleming on R Ashwin’s Return to CSK

Speaking about the veteran off-spinner’s return, Stephen Fleming emphasized that Ashwin’s value extends beyond the price tag.

According to Fleming, Ashwin’s experience, versatility, and understanding of Chennai Super Kings’ culture make him an ideal fit for the squad.

“It’s a bit of a homecoming for Ashwin, but he’s a world-class bowler,” Fleming said.

Fleming explained that CSK’s focus was never solely on the auction price but on how Ashwin could strengthen the team’s balance and strategy.

“It’s not so much the price – you look at how someone fits in, and there’s an emotional attachment for Ashwin with Chennai, so it’s a nice fit.”

The CSK coach also highlighted Ashwin’s impressive record, cricketing intelligence, and ability to contribute with both bat and ball. Despite being in the later stages of his career, Ashwin remains one of the most skilled spin bowlers in world cricket.

Why R Ashwin Is Important for CSK in IPL 2025

The signing of R Ashwin gives Chennai Super Kings a proven wicket-taking option in the middle overs. In modern T20 cricket, containing runs alone is not enough, and Fleming stressed the need for bowlers capable of consistently breaking partnerships.

Ashwin brings several advantages to the CSK squad:

  • Vast IPL experience
  • Match-winning off-spin bowling
  • Tactical awareness and leadership
  • Ability to contribute valuable runs lower down the order
  • Deep understanding of Chennai conditions

His return strengthens an already formidable spin department and provides CSK with additional flexibility throughout the IPL 2025 season.

CSK Also Retain Faith in Devon Conway and Rachin Ravindra

Apart from Ashwin, Chennai Super Kings made two notable overseas acquisitions by bringing back New Zealand stars Devon Conway and Rachin Ravindra.

CSK signed Conway for INR 6.25 crore, while Ravindra was secured for INR 4 crore.

Fleming admitted he was surprised by the lack of bidding interest in Ravindra, especially after the all-rounder’s impressive performances during New Zealand’s Test tour of India.

The CSK head coach believes Ravindra has tremendous potential and could develop into a complete all-round cricketer for the franchise.

Fleming compared Ravindra’s long-term value to players who contribute in multiple departments, making him an exciting prospect for Chennai Super Kings moving forward.

A Perfect Homecoming for Ashwin

For Chennai Super Kings fans, R Ashwin’s return feels like the reunion of a franchise legend with his original team. Having started his IPL journey with CSK and contributed to multiple title-winning campaigns, the veteran spinner’s comeback adds experience, leadership, and quality to the squad.

As IPL 2025 approaches, all eyes will be on Ashwin as he once again dons the iconic yellow jersey and begins a new chapter with Chennai Super Kings.

Full List of Players CSK Bought in IPL 2025 Mega Auction:

Devon Conway – Rs 6.25 Crore

Chennai Super Kings initiated their first buy by securing New Zealand batter Devon Conway. Swooping the Kiwi batter for a price of 6.25 crores. The best thing about the Conway rejoining CSK is that they reserved their RTM.

Devon Conway played a key role in Chennai Super Kings’ success in IPL 2023. After making his CSK debut in 2022, Conway was bought for INR 1 crore, a wise investment by the team. In IPL 2022, he scored 252 runs in 7 matches at a strike rate of 147.

The following year, he impressed further by scoring 672 runs in 16 matches with an average of 52 and a strike rate of 140, finishing as the third-highest run-scorer. His best performance came with a 92* against Punjab Kings, though CSK lost that match in a thrilling finish.

Having missed the previous IPL season due to a thumb injury, Conway would be hoping to contribute to CSK’s successes in the upcoming IPL 2025. His addition adds an extra layer to the team, especially in the wicketkeeping position. 

Rahul Tripathi – Rs 3.4 Crore

After acquiring the Kiwi opener, CSK quickly secured Rahul Tripathi for just 3.4 crores, making it a bargain of a buy. In the previous IPL season, 33-year-old Tripathi played for Sunrises Hyderabad after making his debut for Pune Super Giants in 2017.

Rahul Tripathi has been a consistent performer in the IPL, amassing 2,236 runs in 95 matches. His batting average is 27.27, with a strike rate of 139.31. In 2022, he had his best season, scoring 413 runs in 14 matches at a strike rate of 158.24. Tripathi has also shown solid performances in 2021 and 2023, scoring 397 runs in 17 matches and 273 runs in 13 matches, respectively. Though his runs dipped in 2019 and 2020, he could be an impactful player for his new IPL team, providing stability and firepower in the middle order.

Rachin Ravindra – Rs 4 Crore

Minutes later in the auction, CSK used their RTM to capture left-handed Rachin Ravindra for a price of 4 crores. In December 2023, Ravindra was bought by Chennai Super Kings for the 2024 IPL season. However, he was unexpectedly released after having a decent run with the team.

A rising star from New Zealand, Ravindra has been making waves with his impressive performances. Born in Wellington on November 18, 1999, he developed his love for cricket early, picking up a bat at the age of five. Inspired by cricket legends like Sachin Tendulkar, Ravindra honed his skills in New Zealand and made trips to Bangalore for club cricket, where he received expert coaching.

Ravindra quickly rose through the ranks, representing New Zealand in the Under-19 World Cups of 2016 and 2018. His breakthrough came during the 2023 ODI World Cup in India, where he impressed with his batting skills, particularly with a memorable century against England.

His versatility as an all-rounder, strong batting ability, and knack for taking crucial wickets made him a valuable addition to the CSK squad, especially with Devon Conway back after the injury. Ravindra has shown his ability to score quickly time and again.

Ravichandran Ashwin – Rs 9.75 Crore

Adamant to bring their ‘Ash Anna’ back home, Chennai Super Kings bought Ravichandran Ashwin for a whooping Rs 9.75 Crore. Recently, the India all-rounder re-joined his former Indian Premier League franchise in an administrative role. He took on the responsibility of managing their high-performance centre. Notably, Ashwin’s shift to CSK had suggested his possible return to CSK for the next IPL season.

Ashwin made his IPL debut with CSK in 2009 and played for the franchise until 2015. During his seven-year stint, he was part of CSK’s two IPL-winning teams in 2010 and 2011. Ashwin also played a key role in CSK’s 2010 Champions League victory, finishing as the highest wicket-taker of the tournament with 13 wickets. In 2018, after CSK’s two-year ban, Ashwin was picked up by Kings XI Punjab (now PBKS) during the mega auction. His contributions to CSK’s success were vital during his time with the team.

 Khaleel Ahmed – Rs 4.80 crore

CSK’s next buy came in the form of Khaleel Ahmed for 4.80 crore. Khaleel has shown steady progress in the IPL, with notable performances, especially in 2019 and 2022. His economy and wicket-taking ability have improved over the years especially with his previous IPL team Delhi Capitals, establishing him as a key bowler.

Khaleel Ahmed recently reflected on a memorable incident from the 2018 Asia Cup, where MS Dhoni played a crucial role in his career. During this tournament, Khaleel made his ODI debut and had the opportunity to bowl the first over for India, a moment he had dreamed of since childhood.

In a conversation with Aakash Chopra on YouTube, Khaleel spoke about his deep respect for Dhoni, describing him as more than just a friend or elder brother. He referred to Dhoni as his ‘guru,’ acknowledging the immense guidance and support the former captain had provided throughout his journey. Khaleel expressed how Dhoni’s wisdom and advice had a lasting impact on him, both as a cricketer and as a person.

The bond between them is not just one of friendship but also of mentorship, which has helped shape Khaleel’s career in Indian cricket. Fortunately, the 27-year-old will now get to live his dream of playing under Dhoni’s mentorship wearing the “Yellove Jersey”.

Noor Ahmad – Rs 10 crore

This 19-year-old very soon left Ash Anna behind to become CSK’s most expensive buy in IPL 2025 Mega Auction so far. Noor Ahmad, a talented left-arm wrist spinner from Afghanistan, follows in the footsteps of Rashid Khan and Mujeeb Ur Rahman, gaining recognition in T20 leagues worldwide.

In his debut IPL season with Gujarat Titans in 2023, he took 16 wickets, playing a key role in their run to the final. However, his former team lost the final to CSK, his new IPL franchise.

Vijay Shankar – Rs. 1.20 crore

Chennai Super Kings acquired all-rounder Vijay Shankar for 1.20 Crores. He started his IPL career with CSK in 2014, later playing for teams like Sunrisers Hyderabad, Delhi Capitals, and Gujarat Titans.

Vijay Shankar has had a steady IPL career, showcasing his ability as both a batter and a bowler. With a career average of 25.34 and a strike rate of 129.80, he has contributed significantly with the bat, especially in 2023, where he scored 301 runs at a remarkable strike rate of 160.11.

As a bowler, Shankar’s performance has been more modest, with 9 wickets at an average of 38.22. While his batting has been more consistent, his bowling in 2020, with 4 wickets at an economy rate of 6.22, stands out as his best. Overall, Shankar’s all-round abilities could be valuable for CSK in the upcoming IPL season.

Sam Curran – Rs 2.4 crore

Chennai Super Kings (CSK) successfully brought back former player Sam Curran on Day 2 of the ongoing IPL 2025 Auction in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. The five-time IPL champions secured the 26-year-old English all-rounder for Rs 2.4 crore.

Curran had previously played for CSK in the 2020 and 2021 seasons, where he made notable contributions. His return adds valuable experience and versatility to CSK’s squad, further strengthening their lineup for the upcoming season. Fans will be excited to see Curran back in Chennai’s yellow after his impactful performances in previous IPL campaigns.

Shaik Rasheed – Rs 30 lakh

20-year-old Shaik Rasheed returns to CSK as their first uncapped buy in the IPL 2025 Mega Auction. This Andhra boy first made his name with an outstanding 94-run innings in the U-19 World Cup 2022 semi-final. Rasheed then smashed 50 runs off 84 balls against England in the final and helped India win the title for the fifth time.

Shaik Rasheed was a member of CSK in the previous year’s IPL but couldn’t debut in the cash-rich tournament. However, when Rasheed got his maiden chance to field for the team against Punjab Kings, he made sure to shine by taking a blinder to dismiss in form Jitesh Sharma playing at 21 off 9 balls.

Anshul Kamboj – Rs 3.4 crore

Anshul Kamboj, a right-handed batsman and medium pacer, registered for the IPL 2025 auction at a base price of INR 30 lakh. However, his auction quickly turned into a bidding war between Delhi Capitals, Chennai Super Kings (CSK), and Mumbai Indians.

After intense competition, CSK secured Kamboj for INR 3.40 crore, which is 11 times his base price. This shows the faith CSK has in Kamboj’s potential. As he joins the CSK squad for IPL 2025, fans will be eager to see how he performs and justifies the investment made by the franchise to strengthen their team.

Mukesh Choudhary – Rs 30 lakh

CSK has re-signed Mukesh Choudhary for IPL 2025 at his base price of INR 30 lakh. The 28-year-old left-arm pacer originally made his IPL debut with CSK in 2022, where he impressed by taking 16 wickets in 13 matches. However, an injury kept him out of the 2023 season, and in 2024, he played just one match without taking a wicket.

In domestic cricket, Mukesh plays for Maharashtra and has been in strong form during the ongoing Ranji Trophy, taking 15 wickets in the last three games, and aiming to make an impact in IPL 2025.

Deepak Hooda – Rs 1.7 crore

Deepak Hooda has been bought by Chennai Super Kings (CSK) for INR 1.7 crore. This signing is seen as a valuable addition to CSK’s squad, as Hooda brings experience and versatility to their middle-order batting. He is also an option for off-spin bowling, providing an extra dimension to CSK’s lineup as they aim for another title in the upcoming season.

Hooda made his IPL debut in 2015 with Punjab Kings and has since played for multiple teams, including Sunrisers Hyderabad and Lucknow Super Giants. Over the years, he has established himself as a reliable all-rounder, known for performing in critical moments and brilliant fielding. In 118 IPL matches, Hooda has scored 1,465 runs, with a highest score of 64 and an average of 18.31. He has also taken 10 wickets with an economy rate of 8.54.

In the 2024 IPL season, Hooda played 11 matches, scoring 145 runs at a strike rate of 138.10, showing his ability to accelerate when needed. His standout season came in 2022, where he scored 451 runs at an average of 32.21, proving his potential as a middle-order anchor for CSK.

Gurjapneet Singh – Rs 2.2 crore

CSK signed Tamil Nadu pacer Gurjapneet Singh for Rs 2.2 crore at the IPL 2025 auction. His base price was Rs 30 lakh. Gurjapneet, a 6’3″ left-arm seamer, has an inspiring journey. Born in Ludhiana and raised in Ambala, he moved to Chennai at 17.

After debuting in the Ranji Trophy with impressive figures of 6 for 22, he became a net bowler for CSK. Despite a setback due to a back injury, he made a strong comeback in 2023, impressing selectors with his performances in the Tamil Nadu Premier League (TNPL) and Ranji Trophy.

Nathan Ellis – Rs 2 crore

CSK secured Australian pacer Nathan Ellis for Rs 2 crore on the second day of the IPL 2025 Auction after a heated bidding war. Known for his variations, which suit Chepauk’s conditions, Ellis was initially bid by CSK at his base price of Rs 1.25 crore. His former team, Punjab Kings (PBKS), quickly joined the contest, raising his price. Just when CSK looked set to win, PBKS considered using their Right to Match (RTM) option. However, after much deliberation, PBKS decided not to match CSK’s final bid, securing Ellis for the Chennai franchise.

Jamie Overton – Rs 1.5 crore

English fast bowler, Jamie Overton was bought by Chennai Super Kings for ₹1.5 crore at the auction. The 6 feet 4 inch tall bowler represented England in the 2012 Under-19 World Cup. Moreover, he was a part of the Manchester Originals in The Hundred and was also the player of the tournament in 2023 edition. In 2023, he was signed by the Adelaide Strikers.

Fans will be keen to see how Jamie adapts to the Indian conditions as he is ready to make his IPL debut for CSK.

Kamlesh Nagarkoti – Rs 30 lakh

Chennai Super Kings have signed Kamlesh Nagarkoti for INR 30 lakh at the IPL 2025 auction. The right-arm pacer, who last played in the IPL in 2022, became famous for his impressive fast bowling during the 2018 Under-19 World Cup.

He was bought by Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR) for INR 3 crore in 2018 but has struggled with injuries, limiting his IPL appearances. He made his debut in 2020, playing 10 matches and taking 5 wickets. After a few injury setbacks and a lack of game time, he was released by teams but now joins CSK for the upcoming season.

Editor’s Note: Nathan Ellis, Jamie Overton, and Kamlesh Nagarkoti with their immense skill sets could be great pace replacements for Tushar Deshpande and Deepak Chahar as CSK lost both of the dependable pacers in IPL 2025 Mega Auction.

Ramakrishna Ghosh – Rs 30 lakh

Ramakrishna Ghosh was bought by Chennai Super Kings for ₹30 lakh at the auction. This Nashik born all-rounder plays for Maharashtra in the coveted Ranji Trophy and is all set to make his IPL debut for the ‘Yellove Army’.

Shreyas Gopal – Rs 30 lakh

Chennai Super Kings bought Shreyas Gopal for INR 30 lakh at the IPL 2025 auction. The 31-year-old leg-spinner, also a useful lower-order batsman, plays for Karnataka in domestic cricket. Gopal’s IPL journey started with Mumbai Indians in 2014, where he played just six games in three seasons. His career took off when he joined Rajasthan Royals in 2018, becoming an important part of the team.

Over three seasons with Rajasthan, he took 41 wickets. He had a brief stint with Mumbai Indians in 2022 and played for Sunrisers Hyderabad in 2024 before joining CSK.

Vansh Bedi – Rs 55 lakh

CSK acquired 21-year-old Vansh Bedi for 55 Lakhs. This Delhi-based wicketkeeper batsman made his name with a decent performance in the recently held Delhi Premiere League for PuraniDilli.

Andre Siddarth – Rs 30 lakh

18-year-old Andre Siddarth became CSK’s last but not least buy in the much anticipated IPL 2025 Mega Auction. This Tamil Nadu-based cricketer secured Rs 30 lakh as his maiden IPL salary.

title: Ruturaj Gaikwad Set to Lead Maharashtra in SMAT 2024-25
content:
Maharashtra has announced their squad for the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy (SMAT) 2024-25, naming Ruturaj Gaikwad as captain. Known for his calm and steady leadership, Gaikwad will be looking to guide Maharashtra to success in this season’s T20 tournament. After failing to reach the knockout stages last year, Maharashtra is determined to bounce back stronger with a well-balanced squad featuring both experienced players and young talent.

Gaikwad will have plenty of support in his leadership role, with seasoned players like Ankeet Bawane, Rahul Tripathi, and Mukesh Choudhary by his side. For wicketkeeping, Maharashtra has two options in Nikhil Naik and Dhanraj Shinde. In the bowling department, Rajvardhan Hangargekar and Prashant Solanki will play key roles in helping the team perform well throughout the tournament.

Maharashtra has been placed in Group E, which is a tough group with strong teams like Kerala, Mumbai, Andhra Pradesh, Goa, Services, and Nagaland. It’s going to be a challenging phase for Maharashtra, but with Ruturaj Gaikwad in excellent form and his tactical captaincy, fans will be hopeful for a strong performance in 2024-25 SMAT. Having missed out on the knockout stage last year, the team will be eager to turn things around and prove their capabilities.

Maharashtra will start their campaign on Saturday, November 23, against Nagaland. The pressure is on the team from the beginning, but with the talent in the squad, there is a real chance for success. Gaikwad has already shown that he can handle pressure in leadership roles, and he’ll be looking to inspire his team to play their best cricket. If they start off strong, they have a good opportunity to reach the knockout rounds.

The squad for Maharashtra in the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy 2024-25 includes:

Ruturaj Gaikwad (c), Ankeet Bawane, Arshin Kulkarni, Rahul Tripathi, Nikhil Naik (wk), Dhanraj Shinde (wk), Divyang Hinganekar, Vicky Ostwal, Ramkrishna Ghosh, Mukesh Choudhary, Prashant Solanki, Atharva Kale, Siddharth Mhatre, Satyajeet Bachhav, Rajvardhan Hangargekar, Azim Kazi, Rushabh Rathod, and Sunny Pandit

title: Suresh Raina Supports Rishabh Pant for Over 25 Crore Tag ahead of IPL 2025 Mega Auction
content:
The former Indian cricketer and Chennai Super Kings (CSK) legend Suresh Raina has predicted that Rishabh Pant could fetch between Rs 25-30 crore in the upcoming IPL 2025 Mega Auction. The auction is set to take place in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, on November 24-25.

It will feature 574 players, including 48 capped Indian players and 193 overseas stars. Given the competition, Pant is expected to be one of the most sought-after players, with his name appearing on every franchise’s wish list.

Pant, who is part of the first set of star players, has the potential to break IPL records for the highest price ever. Currently, the most expensive players in IPL history are Mitchell Starc and Pat Cummins, who were bought for Rs 24.75 crore and Rs 20.50 crore, respectively. However, Raina believes Pant’s all-round abilities like his leadership skills and massive popularity could drive his price even higher.

Suresh Raina Praises Rishabh Pant, Predicts Him as Top Buy for IPL 2025

Speaking to a respected media house, Raina praised Pant for his talent, describing him as not only a powerful batsman and wicketkeeper but also a leader capable of leading any team to an IPL title.

Pant captained Delhi Capitals in 2021 and 2022, and his leadership potential continues to grow. In addition to his skills on the field, Pant has built a strong brand presence, making him a top choice for both cricket franchises and brands looking for endorsements.

Pant’s IPL career began with Delhi Daredevils (now Delhi Capitals) in 2016, where his fearless and aggressive batting style quickly made him a standout performer. He was retained by Delhi in 2018 and 2022, earning Rs 16 crore per season. Despite missing some time due to injury, Pant remains one of the most exciting and talented players in Indian cricket.

While teams like Punjab Kings and Royal Challengers Bangalore are looking for fresh leadership, Chennai Super Kings (CSK) could also target Pant in the auction. Known for their emphasis on strong leadership and experienced players, CSK might view Pant as a future captain. With CSK’s substantial purse and history of nurturing young talent, Pant could be a perfect fit for their team, adding both explosive batting and potential leadership for the years to come. Much like their favourite Thala who has been offering the same sets of skills and much more.

title: Cheteshwar Pujara Set to Join Team India in a Never-Seen Avatar in BGT 2024-25
content:
The much-anticipated Border-Gavaskar Trophy 2024-25 is set to begin on November 22 in Perth, but this year’s series will see some significant changes that fans may find hard to adjust to. One of the biggest talking points is the absence of Cheteshwar Pujara, who has been a key figure for India in Test cricket, especially in the BGT. Known for his solid batting and ability to anchor the innings, Pujara won’t be playing this time. Instead, he has taken on a new role as a commentator for Star Sports Hindi.

Pujara’s contribution to India’s Test cricket success, particularly in Australia, has been immense. He has often been the backbone of the Indian batting lineup, wearing down opposition bowlers and playing long innings. His absence will certainly be felt, especially on the fast pitches in Australia, where his composure and technique were invaluable.

Devdutt Padikkal Replaces Cheteshwar Pujara After Shubman Gill Gets Injured Ahead of BGT 2024-25

In Pujara’s place, Shubman Gill was initially expected to step up. However, with Gill suffering an injury, there is a chance that Devdutt Padikkal could open the batting in the first Test in Perth.

Pujara’s record in Australia speaks for itself. Over his career, he has scored 993 runs in 11 Test matches at an average of 47.28, including three centuries and five half-centuries. His best performance came in the 2018-19 series, where he scored 521 runs in seven innings. His tally included three centuries and he was named Player of the Series. That remarkable effort was crucial in India’s historic 2-1 win in Australia, their first-ever series victory Down Under.

This year’s Border-Gavaskar Trophy is special because it is the first five-match series between India and Australia since 1991-92. After the opening match in Perth, the series moves to the Adelaide Oval for a pink-ball Test from December 6-10. The third Test will be played in Brisbane, followed by the fourth in Melbourne, with the final Test set for the Sydney Cricket Ground from January 3-7.

title: Deepak Chahar Remains Hopeful About CSK Buying him in IPL 2025 Mega Auction
content:
Indian fast bowler Deepak Chahar has expressed hope that his former IPL franchise, Chennai Super Kings (CSK), will bid for him in the upcoming IPL 2025 mega auction. Chahar has been associated with CSK for several years and certainly holds fond memories of his time with the team. Although he was not retained by CSK ahead of the 2022 season, the franchise still invested heavily in him. Being bought back for Rs 14 crore at the auction, Chahar made a big statement. On top of that, MS Dhoni’s belief in him and his skills reinforced his value to the team as a key bowler.

In a recent interview, Chahar shared his desire to return to CSK and highlighted his strength in taking wickets during powerplay overs. He noted that his ability to restrict runs early in the game has become even more crucial in modern T20 cricket, where scoring rates in the powerplay have significantly increased.

https://twitter.com/ItzThanesh/status/1856220290650443885

“I was not retained by them in the last mega auction as well. But they went all out for me and bought me back. I don’t know what will happen this year, but I know my skill will be valued more now given the fact that around 90-100 runs are being scored in the Powerplay and that’s why the teams are scoring more than 200 more frequently. I have proved how valuable I can be in limiting runs in that phase of the game,” Chahar told a reputed media house.

CSK Retains Young Matheesha Pathirana Over Deepak Chahar ahead of IPL 2025 Mega Auction

Chahar has faced challenges due to injuries that kept him out of action for extended periods. Despite that, he remains confident that his proven track record will make him a valuable asset for any team. CSK has retained Ruturaj Gaikwad, Ravindra Jadeja, MS Dhoni, Shivam Dube, and Matheesha Pathirana for the 2025 season. Consequently, they do not have a Right To Match (RTM) card for the auction. This means their strategy for acquiring players will be crucial and may not guarantee Chahar’s return.

However, Chahar is optimistic about CSK’s interest in him but also remains open to other options. If CSK doesn’t bring him back, Chahar said he would like to play for Rajasthan Royals, aligning with his roots and expressing admiration for the franchise. “I think they will bid for me again. I would like to don the yellow jersey again and if not that, then I would want Rajasthan Royals to bid for me,” he added.

With high-profile players like Rishabh Pant, KL Rahul, Deepak Chahar, and Shreyas Iyer in the pool, the IPL 2025 Mega Auction will certainly be one to watch. It will be interesting to see how CSK goes by with the auction. According to CSK CEO Vasi, the franchise will look to sustain its core team. Nonetheless, nothing can be predicted, hence, the auction will be a massive treat for the viewers ahead of the real show.

title: BREAKING!! MS Dhoni Receives Legal Notice Regarding Old Business Dispute
content:
Widely known for his moral conduct, former India captain MS Dhoni received a legal notice from the Jharkhand High Court following a business related case. The case is filed by his former business partners, Mihir Diwakar and Soumya Das. Both Diwakar and Das are directors of Aarka Sports and Management Ltd., a company Dhoni had worked with to establish cricket academies under his name.

https://twitter.com/ndtv/status/1856494688171139200

The dispute began when Dhoni lodged a formal complaint on January 5 in Ranchi, claiming that Diwakar and Das had defrauded him of INR 15 crore. According to Dhoni, despite leaving their authority in 2021, Diwakar and Das continued to open cricket academies using his name without permission. This led Dhoni to take legal action, accusing the co-directors of breaking the terms of their agreement.

Former Business Partners Lodge Complaint Against MS Dhoni in Jharkhand High Court

In response, Diwakar and Das challenged the notice issued by a judicial magistrate by taking the matter to the High Court. The Jharkhand High Court has now directed Dhoni to appear and present his side of the story. The court has also summoned Diwakar, his wife, and their company, Aarka Sports and Management Ltd., to attend the hearing and provide their explanation on the matter.

Aarka Sports is well-known for its involvement in player management and the development of sports facilities. The company provides budding cricketers with training opportunities and support to help them grow in the sport. The company is established in Sector 63, Noida, and has been active in promoting cricket and managing players for several years.

Dhoni’s partnership with Diwakar and Das dates back to 2017 when they initially agreed to work together on launching cricket academies. However, things took a turn in 2021 when Dhoni withdrew his authority, leading to legal battles.

title: CSK Invites 17-year-old Ayush Mhatre for Trails Ahead of IPL 2025 Mega Auction
content:
Ayush Mhatre has become the center of attention as the IPL 2025 auction approaches. With preparations underway for the big event, Chennai Super Kings (CSK) has shown interest in this promising young talent from Mumbai. At just 17 years old, Mhatre’s strong performances in First-Class cricket have caught the eye of none other than former CSK captain, MS Dhoni.

Consequently, CSK has invited Mhatre to their High-Performance Centre in Navalur for trials before the IPL auction, which is set to take place on November 24 and 25 in Jeddah. This shows CSK’s proactive approach in scouting fresh talent and preparing for the new season.

Mhatre’s rise in domestic cricket has been impressive. He made his First-Class debut for Mumbai during the Irani Cup earlier this season and quickly made a name for himself with solid performances. Over five matches, he scored 321 runs at an average of 35.66. This included one century and one half-century, proving his ability to play crucial innings under pressure and contribute significantly to his team’s scores.

One of the highlights of Mhatre’s young career came during his third First-Class match when he scored a remarkable 176 runs against Maharashtra. This innings stood out not just for the high score but for the maturity and confidence Mhatre displayed at the crease. His ability to play with composure while also showcasing aggressive strokes impressed many, signaling that he could be a future star in Indian cricket.

MS Dhoni’s interest in Mhatre’s progress further emphasizes the young player’s potential. Dhoni, who has been a vital part of CSK’s success, knows the importance of having reliable young talent in the team. The franchise is keen to bring in new players as they plan for the future, and Mhatre fits the bill with his promising skills and performances.

CSK CEO Kasi Viswanathan has already reached out to the Mumbai Cricket Association (MCA), requesting permission for Mhatre to attend the trials. This step indicates that CSK is serious about evaluating the young opener and possibly securing him for the upcoming season. If Mhatre impresses during the trials, he could be a valuable addition to CSK’s lineup, adding depth to their batting order and bringing fresh energy to the team.

title: "Have spoken to Dhoni and Gaikwad": CSK CEO on Signing Rishabh Pant Ahead of IPL 2025 Mega Auction
content:
Chennai Super Kings (CSK) CEO Kasi Viswanathan recently addressed rumors about the franchise’s interest in signing Rishabh Pant at the upcoming IPL 2025 mega auction. Speculation began after India’s T20 World Cup win, when a report suggested at CSK’s interest in the wicketkeeper-batter. The talk grew when Delhi Capitals did not include Pant in their retention list. This has placed him in the pool of high-profile Indian players available for the auction, alongside KL Rahul and Shreyas Iyer.

When asked if CSK would bid for Pant, Kasi Viswanathan spoke to former CSK player Ambati Rayudu on Provoke TV. While he didn’t rule out the possibility, he made it clear that CSK’s primary focus is on retaining their core team from the 2024 season. He acknowledged that their budget might limit them in securing top players during the auction.

“We had discussions with Ruturaj (Gaikwad), the captain, MS (Dhoni), and coach Stephen Fleming before finalizing the retentions. We prioritized players who had contributed to the team’s success and stability in recent seasons,” Kasi explained. He mentioned that choosing the retentions was straightforward, with Gaikwad, Ravindra Jadeja, MS Dhoni, Shivam Dube, and Matheesha Pathirana being key players being retained. He added that retaining these players meant CSK would have a smaller auction purse, making it challenging to compete for the high-profile Indian players.

CSK’s retention decisions have left them with an auction budget of INR 55 crore. According to Kasi, they are likely to focus on getting back some of their overseas players from last season, such as Rachin Ravindra, Devon Conway, and Maheesh Theekshana. Among Indian players, they may look to bring back Deepak Chahar. CSK also has one Right-To-Match (RTM) card, which could be used to reclaim a key player during the auction.

IPL 2025 mega auction is set to be held on November 24 and 25 in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, following last year’s overseas auction in Dubai. A record 1,574 players, including 1,165 Indian and 409 overseas, have registered. Teams have retained 46 players, spending a combined Rs 558.5 crore. Each team can have up to 25 players, with a maximum of eight overseas. New RTM card rules allow only teams with fewer than six retentions to use them, promising a competitive and strategic auction.

title: Chennai Super Kings vs Mumbai Indians Head To Head Match-Ups, Team Records, Top Performances
content:
IPL is full of team rivalries, it is a common knowledge. Over the years, there have been several moments that have made two teams bitter rivals of one another. Be it the Starc vs Pollard showdown, or Harbhajan vs Shreesanth fight. But no rivalry comes close to the hype and interest that CSK vs MI generates.

Chennai Super Kings and Mumbai Indians have the most intense and long-standing history in the Indian Premier League. The CSK vs MI is clash also renowned as the ‘El Clasico of cricket’, considering the high voltage matches. From the highly competitive League matches to the thrilling showdowns in the finals, both Chennai Super Kings and Mumbai Indians have had a fiery rivalry. 

Apart from league stage matches, Chennai Super Kings and Mumbai Indians have clashed for four finals, with Mumbai Indians emerging victorious on three occasions in 2013, 2015, 2019 and Chennai Super Kings winning in one in 2010. 

Chennai Super Kings and Mumbai Indians encounters have been home to packed stadiums considering the presence of global cricket icons like Mahendra Singh Dhoni, Rohit Sharma, Lasith Malinga, Suresh Raina and many more. 

In this article we’ll delve on the Head To Head Match-Up Record between Chennai Super Kings and Mumbai Indians, the Team Records, and Top Performances. 

CSK vs MI All Time Head To Head Record:

Chennai Super Kings and Mumbai Indians have locked horns for 37 matches in the history of the Indian Premier League. Among these 37 encounters, the Mumbai Indians have dominated the Yellow Army and have emerged victorious on 20 occasions while CSK have emerged victorious on 17 occasions. 

CSK vs MI Recent Encounters:

In the past 5 encounters between Chennai Super Kings and Mumbai Indians, CSK has won 4 encounters while the Mumbai Indians managed to win only 1. 

CSK vs MI in 2024 

Chennai Super Kings won by 20 runs  

The 29th match of IPL 2024 was yet another thriller with Chennai Super Kings and Mumbai Indians locking horns for their only encounter of the season. In the match, Chennai Super Kings batted first and posted a decent total of 216 at the Wankhede Stadium in Mumbai.

Despite their best attempts, Mumbai Indians who were struggling from a poor form failed to chase the target, and The yellow army won the match by 20 runs. The Chennai Super Kings prodigy Matheesha Pathirana  was awarded as the player of the match for his four wicket haul. 

CSK vs MI 2023

Chennai Super Kings won by six wickets

In the 49th match of IPL 2023, Chennai Super Kings restricted Mumbai Indians at 139 in 20 overs. The Kings then successfully chased the 140 runs target within 17.4 overs securing an easy victory by six wickets. Matheesha Pathirana was awarded as the player of the match for his 3 wicket haul. 

Chennai Super Kings won by seven wickets

In the 12th match of IPL 2023, Mumbai Indians batted first and put 157 runs on the board at the end of 20 overs. CSK successfully chased the 158 runs target within 18.1 overs securing a seamless victory by 7 wickets. Ravindra Jadeja was awarded as the player of the match for his 3 wicket haul. 

CSK vs MI 2022 

Mumbai Indians won by three wickets 

In the low scoring match, Mumbai Indians restricted Chennai Super Kings at 97 after dismissing the entire batting lineup in 16 overs. The hosts then chased the target within 14.5 overs and won the match by three wickets. Daniel Sams was awarded as the player of the match for his 3 wicket haul. 

Chennai Super Kings won by five wickets

In the 33rd match of IPL 2023, Mumbai Indians batted first and scored 155 runs in 20 overs.The Yellow Army chased the target on the last ball of the innings securing an easy victory by 5 wickets. Mukesh Choudhary was awarded as the player of the match for his 3 wicket haul. 

CSK VS MI Performance Highlights: Highs and Lows

Highest & Lowest Team Totals: 

Chennai Super Kings and Mumbai Indians scored their highest ever totals against in the same encounter in IPL 2021 in Delhi. MI’s star all-rounder Keiron Pollard scored 87 off 34, as Mumbai changed the target of 218. Despite the loss of six wickets, Mumbai Indians successfully chased the target and scored 219 runs to win the match by four wickets. 

Back in IPL 2013, Chennai Super Kings registered their lowest ever total against Mumbai Indians, with the hosts restricting the team at 79, as the Yellow Army chased 140. As the team’s top order collapsed, the Kings lost the game to MI by 60 runs. 

In IPL 2021, Chennai super Kings restricted Mumbai Indians at the score of 136 to win the match by 20 runs. The score marked Mumbai’s lowest in the history of IPL against Chennai Super Kings. 

Top Individual Performances in Mumbai Indians vs Chennai Super Kings

Over the years, several players’ names have consistently turned up in the high voltage matches between Chennai Super Kings and Mumbai Indians. From Rohit Sharma, Suresh Raina and Mahendra Singh Dhoni shattering the batting records to Dwayne Bravo and Lasith Malinga taking over the bowling duties, several players have consistently thrashed the opponent over the years. 

While Rohit Sharma has been the top scorer in the head-to-head matches between the teams, scoring over 800 runs, Dwayne Bravo and Lasith Malinga have jointly picked the most number of wickets across both the sides, 37.

Suresh Raina of CSK holds the record for most runs in the games between CSK and MI. He has scored a total of 710 runs in this fixture alone. Rohit Sharma has the opportunity this year to overtake Mr IPL on this list.

title: "Shame to even appeal": Ruturaj Gaikwad Fumes over 'Pathetic' Dismissal in Ranji Trophy
content:
Ruturaj Gaikwad took to social media to express his frustration over the controversial dismissal of his Maharashtra teammate Ankit Bawne during a Ranji Trophy match against Services. Gaikwad is currently touring Australia, he scored 145 for Maharashtra in his last game before joining India A. Gaikwad has been following the progress of his domestic team closely. Although he scored 0 and 5 in India A’s recent match against Australia A, he stayed connected with Maharashtra’s ongoing match.

The controversy arose after Maharashtra bowled out Services for 293 in the first innings. Despite starting solidly at 137-3, Maharashtra suffered a batting collapse, losing all their wickets for 185 runs. Bawne’s dismissal was a key moment in this collapse. He edged the ball towards second slip, where the fielder moved low to his right to make the catch. The fielding side appealed, and Bawne was given out by the umpires. However, video replays later showed that the ball had bounced before reaching the slip fielder’s hands.

“Shame to even appeal”: Ruturaj Gaikwad Voices Disappointment with Ranji Trophy Umpires

Despite clearly seeing the bounce in the replays, the decision stood. Bawne protested with the umpires on the field, arguing his case, but the decision was not overturned, forcing him to leave the field. This incident forced Gaikwad to voice his disappointment on Instagram, where he shared a story calling the decision “absolutely pathetic.” He questioned how such a call could be made in a live match, highlighting the unfairness of the ruling. Gaikwad also criticized the fielding side for appealing for the catch, stating, “Shame to even appeal this for a catch!”

Maharashtra’s collapse and Bawne’s contentious dismissal put them in a tough spot. By the end of Day Two, Services had reached 15-0 in their second innings, extending their lead to 123 runs. The situation underscored how crucial Bawne’s wicket was to the match and why Gaikwad, a key player for Maharashtra, felt so strongly about the decision.

title: Chennai Super Kings (CSK) Retentions for IPL 2025: A Quest for Redemption
content:
Twenty20 fever in the country is back. IPL 2025 is right around the corner, and teams are all set to make a comeback following the previous edition’s debacle, wherein Chennai Super Kings (CSK) finished fifth.

They lost narrowly to their arch-rivals Royal Challengers Bangalore (RCB) in a last-gasp finish to the points table, in a game that sealed their exit from the playoffs. This heartbreak will lead into next season, and the franchise’s retentions in recent days tell me of a team primed for redemption. Ultimately, CSK has retained five core players who have added experience to their side with youth.

CSK’s IPL 2025 Retentions

– Ruturaj Gaikwad: INR 18 crore

– Matheesha Pathirana: INR 13 crore

– Shivam Dube: INR 12 crore

– Ravindra Jadeja: INR 18 crore

– MS Dhoni: INR 4 crore (as an uncapped player)

Ruturaj Gaikwad: The Captain

Ruturaj Gaikwad is retained by INR 18 crore at the top of CSK’s batting and leadership charts. ‘Rockstar Ruttu’ has earned a reputation for being a man for all situations, but his forte has been opening the batting and anchoring innings. His calm demeanor and match-winning temperament make him invaluable as CSK tries to regain its winning form. He will also be fronting a side in transition, mixing in some fresh blood with the experienced heads. His leadership and versatility in situations have been the reason behind CSK’s resurgence plan.

Matheesha Pathirana: CSK’s Young Strike Bowler

His retention at INR 13 crore speaks a lot about his potential as a valuable top bowler. He has a sling action that reminds you of Lasith Malinga and brings his quality to CSK’s bowling attack. Pathirana has a knack for breaking partnerships, and it can be damaging in the death overs, especially. Not to forget his ability to break the stumps.

The 21-year-old is expected to play a pivotal role for CSK in bowling in high-pressure situations as he gains experience. However, this retention reiterates CSK’s inclination to feed young talent steeped enough to rise to the occasion in such moments.

Shivam Dube: Middle-Order Muscle

Shivam Dube returns to his CSK roots, retained at INR 12 crore, and he brings power and flexibility to CSK’s lineup. He offers a balance in the middle order between stability and aggression and an ability to kick on if required. His bowling, too, provides versatility, and CSK can have another option for different matchups.

His middle-order batting provides a balance between stability and aggression, with an ability to accelerate when needed. His bowling also adds versatility, giving CSK an additional option for various match ups. His retention shows a flexibility and depth strategy, as he plays both batting and bowling as required.

CSK has earmarked him to make a balanced side that will be able to give the best response to different game situations. Bought back in the 2022 mega auction, he saw his career take an upward spiral! CSK’s newest Raina: Shivam Dube.

Ravindra Jadeja: CSK’s Veteran All-Rounder

The retention of Ravindra Jadeja at INR 18 crore underlines the fact that the CSK can’t do without him. He is a true all-rounder who does well in batting, bowling, and fielding, and he is a proven game-changer. He’s in-disposable in close contests with his powerful lower-order hitting and economical bowling.

Jadeja has experience and leadership qualities beyond that to guide the younger players. As CSK hurries to make a comeback from the setback of last season and challenge for a title, his influence on the team’s strategy and team spirit will be crucial. Controversial take: He is as important as MSD for this team.

MS Dhoni: The Captain’s Legacy Lives On

Perhaps the most symbolic retention was of MS Dhoni, who was retained for INR 4 crore under a special rule allowing retired players without recent international appearances to fall under the uncapped head. Dhoni’s limited on-field presence can be replaced, but his game sense and tactical acumen are irreplaceable.

As a mentor and strategist, his value allows for stability and insight. Dhoni’s calm and his abilities to read the game inspire his teammates, and having him reflects CSK’s commitment to throw the Leviathan and the Legacy out the window and keep on with continuity. His retention follows CSK’s ethos of leadership and experience.

CSK’s retention policy demonstrates a fine balance between youth and experience, resulting in a team that adapts and is about resistance. They are powered by their close loss to RCB in the last league match of 2024. Keeping this mix of players means that CSK has a squad with adequate depth, versatility, and competition winners. As they try to rebrand themselves back among the league’s elite, this balance will be essential.

With IPL 2025 in sight, CSK fans have a season to look forward to, during which redemption and the hunger to win will be at their peak. CSK has a resilient lineup, and the strategy has been all about synergy and adaptability, which will make for an exciting ride back to the top.

title: "A line has to be drawn": Robin Uthappa Voices Disappointment on Rachin Ravindra Training in CSK Academy
content:
Former Indian cricketer Robin Uthappa has criticized Chennai Super Kings (CSK) for allowing New Zealand’s Rachin Ravindra to train at their academy in Chennai before a Test series against India. Ravindra had also practiced at the CSK academy ahead of New Zealand’s one-off Test against Afghanistan in Greater Noida, helping him adjust to Indian conditions.

This preparation paid off for the 24-year-old as he delivered an outstanding performance. In the first Test match in Bengaluru Rachin scored a superb 134 off 157 balls. He followed it with an unbeaten 39* in the second innings, guiding New Zealand to a successful chase of 107 runs and marking New Zealand’s first Test win in India in 36 years. His efforts earned him the Player of the Match award. During the award ceremony, Ravindra acknowledged that his practice sessions in Chennai significantly improved his batting.

“CSK is a wonderful franchise…but there needs to be a line”: Robin Uthappa

Uthappa, who played for CSK in 2021 and 2022, recently criticized this move on his YouTube channel. He emphasized that while CSK is known for supporting its players, a boundary should be maintained when prioritizing the country over franchise interests, especially when helping a foreign player.

“CSK is a wonderful franchise that cares deeply for its players, but there needs to be a line where the interest of the country takes precedence over franchise matters, especially when a foreign player is involved who could play against India,” Uthappa stated. He added that CSK often goes above and beyond for their players. However, there should be limits when national interests are at stake.

Uthappa praised Ravindra’s brilliant century, describing it as one of the finest innings by an overseas player on Indian soil. He highlighted the significance of Ravindra’s 134-run knock on a challenging pitch, showcasing the young player’s solid skills. Uthappa also noted that Ravindra’s performance demonstrated that he is a promising talent for New Zealand.

CSK’s star batter Rachin Ravindra continued his strong form by scoring 65 in the first innings of the second Test in Pune. Throughout the series, he scored 256 runs in six innings, averaging 51.20. He also played a key role in New Zealand’s historic 3-0 series whitewash over India.

content:
Donald Trump has won the 2024 U.S. presidential election, becoming the 47th President of the United States. He defeated Democratic candidate and current Vice President Kamala Harris, making a significant comeback to the White House after his loss to Joe Biden in 2020. This victory marks Trump’s return to power after four years, drawing attention globally as the world responds to the election results.

Fans Flood Internet With “Thala for a Reason” Memes as Donald Trump Wins US Presidential Elections

One reason Dhoni’s fans are celebrating Trump’s victory has to do with the symbolism of the number 7, which is Dhoni’s iconic jersey number. A viral post on social media highlighted how the date of the U.S. Election Day—November 6, 2024—adds up to 7 when the digits are summed up (6+1+1+2+2+4 = 16; 1+6 = 7). This quirky connection has led fans to draw parallels between Trump becoming the 47th president and Dhoni’s jersey number. One fan shared a split image of Trump and Dhoni with the caption, “The forty-7th president—Thala for a reason,” adding a fun twist to the election coverage.

The association between Trump and Dhoni also stems from a golf match they played together last year, which fans have shared online alongside their witty posts. For many, Dhoni’s jersey number 7 represents more than just a number—it embodies the love CSK fans have for Dhoni. His fans have used this moment to highlight the qualities that make Dhoni a beloved figure not just in cricket but also in the hearts of millions who admire him as a leader.

MS Dhoni is all set to feature in his 18th IPL season. Retained by CSK, Dhoni will hope to help his IPL franchise win another title as his final years in cricket inch closer and closer. Apart from Thala, Ruturaj Gaikwad, Shivam Dube, Ravindra Jadeja, and Matheesha Pathirana have also been retained by Super Kings.
