title: England All-rounder Moeen Ali Announces International Retirement
content:
England all-rounder Moeen Ali has announced his retirement from international cricket, marking the end of a decade-long career. 37-year-old Ali made his international debut in 2014 and became a key player for England across all three formats of the game. His decision to retire comes after a career filled with significant achievements, including being part of the England squads that won the ICC World Cup in 2019 and the T20 World Cup in 2022.

Moeen’s retirement marks the close of an era for English cricket. He first retired from Test cricket in 2021, only to return for the 2023 Ashes series against Australia. Despite his brief return, where he contributed to a series that ended in a draw, Moeen has now decided that the time is right to step away for good. In an interview with Nasser Hussain for the Daily Mail, Moeen expressed that he believes it is time for the next generation to take over.

“I could hold on and try to play for England again, but I know in reality I won’t,” Moeen said, reflecting on his decision. “Even retiring, I don’t feel it’s because I’m not good enough—I still feel I can play. But I get how things are, and the team needs to evolve into another cycle. It’s about being real to myself.”

Moeen’s impact on the field has been undeniably good. A stylish left-handed batter, he scored five centuries in Test matches and three in One Day Internationals (ODIs). His versatility as an off-spinner added another dimension to his game, allowing him to claim 204 wickets in Test cricket, 111 in ODIs, and 51 in T20 Internationals. The stats underscore his value to the England team over the years.

Moeen Ali for Chennai Super Kings (CSK) in IPL

Any global cricket fan would like to believe that Moeen Ali’s style of playing best suits the longest format of the game and that he’d be ineffective in T20s. However, Moeen Ali’s stats for Chennai Super Kings (CSK) in IPL tell a different story.

Moeen Ali has been a valuable asset for Chennai Super Kings (CSK) since joining the franchise in 2021. Retained for INR 8 crore ahead of the 2022 Mega Auction, Moeen’s all-round abilities have bolstered CSK’s lineup. A stylish left-handed batter and an aggressive off-break bowler, he has consistently delivered impactful performances for the team.

In the 2021 season, Moeen scored 357 runs in 15 matches with a strike rate of 137.30, demonstrating his ability to accelerate the innings. His highest score of 58 highlighted his role as a reliable middle-order batter who can stabilize the innings and accelerate when needed. With the ball, Moeen contributed six wickets, maintaining an economy rate of 6.35, showcasing his knack for breaking partnerships.

Moeen’s best bowling performance for CSK came in the 2023 season, where he took 9 wickets in 15 matches, including a match-winning 4/26. His all-round contributions were crucial in CSK’s campaigns, particularly with his ability to handle spin bowling and adapt to various match situations.

Making his debut in IPL 2020, Ruturaj Gaikwad’s journey with Chennai Super Kings has been remarkable. Over the past few years, he has emerged as a key player, known for his consistency and powerful performances.

Gaikwad has become a dependable top-order batter, capable of starting slowly to build an innings and finishing with explosive power. Despite a challenging season as CSK captain, the franchise sees a bright future with him in hindsight, recognizing his growing stature and potential to lead the team forward.

One can constantly find the 28-year-old representing and proving his mettle for his home side Maharashtra in the BCCI domestic circuit. Is Ruturaj Gaikwad Playing in Duleep Trophy 2024-25?

Yes, Ruturaj Gaikwad is participating in the Duleep Trophy 2024-25. He can be seen opening for the India C side in this tournament, of which he is also named as the captain.

Red ball tournaments like Ranji Trophy, Irani Cup, Duleep Trophy, and Buchi Babu are the perfect platforms for any talented uncapped Indian cricketer to make his way into the national red ball team. Given the growing transparency in selection processes, we can notice young talents like Sarfaraz Khan and Dhruv Jurel make their way into the national team after proving their competence in such domestic tournaments.

Due to the growing stature of the white ball and short-format cricket with the emergency of the Indian Premier League, it is quite visible that current players neglect to play in such tournaments due to how tiresome and challenging they are. Yet, some players who don’t want to leave any opportunity untouched use them as a platform to highlight their skills in the eyes of national selectors.

Chennai Super Kings’ captain Ruturaj Gaikwad is one such player. Gaikwad was recently named the Ranji Trophy Captain for the upcoming domestic season 2024-25 by the Maharashtra Cricket Association. On top of that, Gaikwad is rewarded with captaincy of India C in the ongoing Duleep Trophy 2024-25.

The 2024-25 senior men’s Indian domestic cricket season began on Thursday with the Duleep Trophy, a crucial event in the preparation for India’s home Test series and the upcoming tour to Australia. The tournament serves as a platform for top players to showcase their skills ahead of these important international fixtures.

Ruturaj Gaikwad in Duleep Trophy 2024-25

In their maiden match of the season, Ruturaj Gaikwad led India C to a thrilling 4-wicket victory over India D in the 2024 Duleep Trophy. Gaikwad’s leadership and his crucial knock of 46 from 48 balls were instrumental in the chase on a challenging Anantapur pitch.

Despite early dismissals, Gaikwad’s intent and strategy ensured India C remained competitive. His partnership with Rajat Patidar set the foundation, and even as wickets fell, Gaikwad’s influence on the game was evident. His captaincy, combined with a solid batting performance, played a key role in securing the win on Day 3.

In the 4th match of the tournament, India C put up a strong performance against India B, scoring 525 in their first innings, with Ruturaj Gaikwad contributing 58. Notably, Gaikwad was forced to retire hurt on the very second ball of his innings. Gaikwad had started with a boundary on his first ball but was hit on the hand by a delivery from Mukesh Kumar on Day 1 of the match in Anantapur, leaving him in visible pain. Despite the injury, the India C captain came to bat later in the match and scored a valuable half-century. India B, in response, were bowled out for 332.

Moreover, in the second innings, Gaikwad continued his consistency, scoring 62, helping India C declare at 128/4. While the match was declared drawn with both the teams sharing a point, Gaikwad’s leadership and steady batting were been key for India C throughout the match.

Win in the first and a draw in the next helped Ruturaj Gaikwad-led India C secure a place in the Duleep Trophy 2024 final against Mayank Agarwal-led India A.

Coming into the final with immense confidence, Ruturaj Gaikwad-led India C lost a hard-fought battle against India A in the 2024 Duleep Trophy final by 132 runs. India A posted 297 in the first innings, thanks to Shashwat Rawat’s 124, while India C replied with 234 and declared their second innings at 286/8, setting a challenging target.

Despite Sai Sudharsan’s brilliant 111, India C was bowled out for 217. Prasidh Krishna’s three late wickets, including Sudharsan, sealed the win for India A with just 4.1 overs remaining. Aaqib Khan and Tanush Kotian also played key roles in India A’s title triumph.

Inspite of the loss in the final, Gaikwad was appreciated for his captaincy and consistent performance, scoring a total of 232 runs from 6 innings, at an average of 38.65. Consequently, the 27-year-old has been recently chosen as the Rest of India captain for the upcoming Irani Trophy 2024, to be played against Mumbai.

Despite his continuous performances, Ruturaj Gaikwad has yet to impress the national selectors to earn a permanent spot in the national squad. Hence, he will look to prove his worth in the going Duleep Trophy to make his way into the white-collar brigade ahead of the Australia series.

title: What is meaning of Chepauk: How CSK Home Ground Got It's Name?
content:
Chennai Super King’s home ground is one of the most popular venue for cricket all around the world. However, it is known by different names. Some call it “Chepauk,” while others refer to it as “MA Chidambaram Stadium,” on your lucky day you’ll also find someone using “MCC stadium,” to refer to the stadium.

But that leaves us with the question as to, what is the meaning of Chepauk? Who was MA Chidamaram? And what does MCC Stands for?

M.A. Chidambaram Stadium, also known as Chepauk Stadium, is one of the premier cricket grounds, providing a cricketing ambience that is as old as the game itself. This ground, which has been witness to many cricketing events in the past, is not only a sports stadium but also an emblem of the cricketing culture of Chennai.

However, the way this famous stadium got its name, Chepauk, is quite interesting. The history of this region starts in the 18th century with an introduction to the culture and history of the place. Then, it takes the reader through the colonial period and the period of cricketing success.

So, without further ado, let’s dive into the enticing history of this beautiful stadium.

What is meaning of Chepauk?

The term Chepauk is one of the most associated name with the home ground of Chennai Super Kings. However, to understand the meaning of Chepauk, you’ll have to don the hat of a historian and linguist.

Jokes apart, the history of Chepauk’s name is quite interesting. It is said to have been derived from the word used in the Hindustani language, Che Baagh, meaning Six Gardens; these gardens were developed during the 18th century by the Nawab of Arcot, a powerful nobleman who influenced the area.

The Nawab was fond of gardens and thus developed six gardens that were a fusion of Mughal and South Indian style architecture. These gardens were beautiful, and the greenery and calmness of the area became the signature of the place.

Over the years, these gardens evolved into more than just the aesthetic elements of the area they belonged to. The locality around these gardens began to be called Chepauk, and this name has remained until today.

It was here, during the Bonduvar village of the historic gardens, that the erstwhile Madras Presidency under the British colonial government set the pace for a new direction of development of the region that would lead to the formation of one of India’s most famous cricket grounds.

History of Chepauk

The history of Chepauk dates back to 1859, when the oceanfront Chepauk Palace, owned by the Nawab of Arcot, was bought by the Madras Presidency for a sum of ₹ 589000.

This can be considered a turning point in the cricketing history of Chennai city. With the palace ground coming under the jurisdiction of the Madras Presidency, the foundation was laid for a new cricket ground.

Madras Cricket Club (MCC) was a very active club in 1916, and it was this club that helped to set up Chepauk Stadium. The MCC gave land for building a cricket ground that became one of the most famous cricket stadiums in India.

Originally founded as the Madras Cricket Club Ground, Chepauk gained popularity among the locals and became one of the best cricket venues in the area.

The first-ever Test match at the venue was scheduled for 1934 when the Indian cricket team played the English cricket team, and since then, Chepauk has become one of the most important cricket grounds in the country.

Evolution of Chepauk

It is worth mentioning the transformation of the Madras Cricket Club Ground into the M.A. Chidambaram Stadium as a fine example of effort, organization, and passion for the sport.

In 1982, the stadium was named after another great man, M. A. Chidambaram Chettiar, who played a significant role in the growth of Indian cricket.

Chidambaram had contributed immensely to the development of cricket administration in a manner that had not been seen before. As the President of TNCA and BCCI, he imparted leadership skills not limited to Chepauk Stadium.

Who is MA Chidambaram?

Muthiah Annamalai Chidambaram, popularly known as MAC, was a business tycoon and sports enthusiast in India. Born to the Chettiar community, known for its entrepreneurship and philanthropy, Chidambaram was always likely to be a leader and an innovator.

Chidambaram’s father, Raja Sir Annamalai Chettiar, was the Raja of Chettinad, and young Chidambaram was raised in a royal family rich in wealth, tradition, and power.

Chidambaram stepped into the world of entrepreneurship at the age of 31 when he set up Automobile Products of India Limited in 1946 as a scooter company based in Mumbai.

He was very ambitious and had good business acumen, and so, at a very young age, he was appointed as the director of the Indian Aluminium Company.

However, Chidambaram did not only cater to the business world during his term of office. He also did a lot in the social service sector; he served as the Mayor of Madras in 1955 and the President of the Southern Indian Chamber of Commerce and Industry between 1951 and 1957.

Legacy in Cricket Administration

Chidambaram’s real contribution, however, has been to the administration of cricket. He joined the board of BCCI in 1953 and became the Vice President of the bank in 1956. With effective management skills, he became the President of BCCI in the years 1960-1961. During his tenure in office, he was very keen on the growth of Indian cricket and was instrumental in the development of cricket in India.

He played a very active role in the renovation of M.A. Chidambaram Stadium, which has been a world-class cricket stadium. The stadium’s red soil pitch, which was expected to provide good bounce and carry, was preferred by the players as well as the fans.

The stadium has an overall seating capacity of 50,000. During match days, the people of Chennai are noted to be very supportive and lively, and they always ensure that they contribute to the match through their cheers.

Chepauk: A Cricketing Fortress

The term ‘Chepauk’ has now become a phrase that is synonymous with cricket; it is a place that nurtures and gives birth to champions and sets records.

The people of Chennai are very passionate and helpful, and the crowd’s presence in Chepauk really boosts the morale of every player in the match. The chants, slogans, and celebrations in the stadium make the environment rather unfriendly for the away team and quite encouraging for the home team.

Chepauk is known for its history and culture, and cricket is a sport that will be cherished and played for as long as people remember. The more domestic and international matches that are held in the stadium, the more one cannot help but pay homage to the great minds of the past, M.A. Chidambaram included, and the great legacy of Chepauk. It will always remain close to the heart of Indian cricket.

title: Australians to play for CSK in IPL: The Aussie Impact (2025 Update)
content:

Renowned for their rich winning history, a key factor that has consistently contributed to CSK’s success in the IPL has been strategically deploying the international players, particularly Australians. 

Over the years in the IPL, several Australian cricketers have donned the yellow jersey of the Chennai Super Kings as they etch their mark on the franchise’s legacy. In this article we will take a look at all Australians to play for CSK.

The Australian Connection: CSK’s Strategy

CSK’s affinity for Australian players is no coincidence since they have always backed experience, and a winning mentality, which have been synonymous with Australian cricketers. Since the inception of IPL, the Chennai Super Kings have spotted the potential of the Aussies to contribute to their success.

The strategy behind welcoming Australians in their squad lies in their ability to adapt to the dynamic pitch conditions, be it the slow and spinning tracks of Chepauk or the other seamer-friendly fields of other venues. Australians also bring in ample experience of participation in high-pressure tournaments, courtesy to their success in the global tournament conducted by the ICC. 

Notable Australian Players in CSK: The Batting Powerhouses 

Matthew Hayden: The Opening Sensation

One of the first Australian players to make a significant impact in the Chennai Super Kings squad was Matthew Hayden, who joined CSK in the inaugural of the Indian Premier League season back in 2008. Hayden promptly became a fan favorite as he was known for his aggressive batting style.

Hayden’s fiery starts at the top of the order consistently laid a strong foundation for several victories for Chennai Super Kings. Over the course of participation in  three seasons with the yellow army (2008-2010), Hayden put 1107 runs on the board in 32 matches at an average of 36.90 and a strike rate of 137.51.

His ability to dominate the lethal bowling attack of the opponents and play quick knocks made him a crucial asset for CSK during their early seasons of the IPL.

Michael Hussey: Mr. Cricket’s Journey with CSK 

Michael Hussey, popularly known as ‘Mr. Cricket,’ is another Australian who played a key role in Chennai Super Kings’ triumphs in the IPL. Hussey’s striking yet consistent performances with the bat as he managed his ability to anchor the innings made him a star performer for the team.

Playing for Chennai Super Kings for eight years from 2008 to 2015, Hussey aggregated 1768 runs in 50 outings at an impressive average of 42.09 and a strike rate of 123.63, while his undisputed knock of 116* still remains to be one of the finest knocks in the history of the tournament.

Beyond his  remarkable numbers, Hussey always brought a calm demeanor to the team unlike the usual nature of the Australian cricketers, while often guiding the squad through the various challenging situations.

Shane Watson: The All-Round Marvel

Shane Watson’s association with CSK began during the later stages of his career, but he still managed to make an everlasting impact on the franchise. Joining the squad in Chennai Super Kings’ comeback year in 2018, Watson played an instrumental role in CSK’s title win in that season.

Shane Watson’s all-round abilities of destructive batting, and medium-pace bowling, made him a steal deal for CSK. Watson aggregated 1252 runs in 43 matches for the team, including two centuries, with a highest score of 117*.

Watson always stood tall in big matches, a prime example being the IPL final in 2018, where he smashed 117*, becoming one of the most valuable players for Chennai Super Kings.

Known for his unique ability to swing the ball both ways, Hilfenhaus consistently proved his worth during the powerplay. His best figures of 3/27 highlight his effectiveness as a pace bowler for CSK where his contributions were pivotal in maintaining CSK one of the strongest forces in the championship.

Other Australian Bowlers Who Donned the Yellow Jersey

Apart from Bollinger and Hilfenhaus, several other Australian bowlers have also represented Chennai Super Kings. Ben Laughlin played two games for CSK back in 2013, registering a wicket along with Dirk Nannes who also played in five matches in the same season, claiming four wickets.

title: Brendon McCullum Takes on Dual Role as England White-Ball and Test Coach
content:
Brendon McCullum has been appointed as England’s new men’s white-ball head coach, adding to his current role as the Test team coach. This move is part of a “strategic restructure” by the England and Wales Cricket Board (ECB). McCullum has signed a new three-year deal, which means he will oversee England’s white-ball teams through to the 2027 World Cup in South Africa, while also coaching the Test team up to the next Ashes series in 2027.

McCullum’s dual role will officially begin in January 2025, with Marcus Trescothick continuing as the interim head coach for England’s upcoming white-ball series against Australia and their tour of the Caribbean in November. McCullum’s appointment follows the end of Matthew Mott as the white-ball coach in July, after disappointing performances in both the 50-over and 20-over World Cups. The ECB, led by Rob Key, was keen to secure a top candidate for the role, especially after several prominent names, including Ricky Ponting and Eoin Morgan, ruled themselves out.

Brendon McCullum Set to Bring his “Bazball” Approach to England’s White-ball Cricket

Although McCullum initially showed little interest in the white-ball coaching role, his success with the Test team, particularly the “Bazball” approach that has revolutionized England’s Test cricket, convinced him to take on the challenge. He will now bring this same positive mindset to England’s white-ball teams, which are captained by Jos Buttler and are expected to go through significant changes in the coming years.

“I’m excited to extend my role to include the white-ball sides,” McCullum said. “This new challenge is something I’m ready to embrace, and I’m eager to work closely with Jos and the team to build on the strong foundations already in place.”

Rob Key expressed his happiness with McCullum’s decision, emphasizing the advantages of having a unified coaching structure, particularly as the cricket schedule eases from 2025 onwards. He believes this change will help bring out the best in both the players and the coaching staff.

McCullum also emphasized his commitment to nurturing the talent within English cricket and creating an environment where players can thrive across all formats. He is due to take a short break in New Zealand after the current series against Sri Lanka before rejoining the Test squad for their tour of Pakistan in October.

title: Ajinkya Rahane scores maiden ton for Leicestershire in clash against Glamorgan
content:
Earlier this year in June, Leicestershire secured the services of Ajinkya Rahane for the entirety of the One Day Cup and five County Championship matches. Rahane, known for his calm and composed style, had a decent run in the 50-over competition, amassing 378 runs in 10 games at an average of 42, including four half-centuries. Building on this solid performance, Rahane has now made an impressive start in the County Championship, marking his presence with a maiden first-class century for Leicestershire.

In a match against Glamorgan, Leicestershire batted first and were bowled out for 251 runs, with Rahane contributing a modest 42. Glamorgan, in response, put up a massive total of 550-9, driven by a remarkable 257 not out from Colin Ingram. Leicestershire found themselves in a challenging position as they began their second innings, losing two early wickets for just 37 runs, which brought Rahane to the crease.

Rahane initially formed a 37-run partnership with Ian Holland before teaming up with Peter Handscomb for a vital fourth-wicket stand of 183 runs. This partnership was crucial in stabilizing Leicestershire’s innings and guiding them to a position of relative safety. Rahane’s contribution was particularly significant as he showcased his experience and resilience, reaching his 40th first-class century. However, his innings came to an end when he was caught behind off Kiran Carlson, having scored 102 off 192 balls. At the time of his dismissal, Leicestershire was 296-5, still in a battle to save the match.

This century was Rahane’s second in the County Championship, with his first coming for Hampshire against Nottinghamshire in 2019. It was also a long-awaited milestone, as it marked his first century in first-class cricket in over a year and a half. The last time Rahane reached three figures in this format was during the Ranji Trophy for Mumbai against Assam in January 2023.

Rahane’s recent performances come after a period of limited international appearances. His last stint with the Indian national team was in the West Indies, where he served as vice-captain during the two-Test series in July 2023. Now at 36 years old, Rahane has accumulated 5,077 runs from 85 Tests at an average of 38.46.

title: CSK Legend Dwayne Bravo Announces Retirement, Set to Make Final Bow in CPL
content:
Chennai Super Kings’ Dwayne Bravo, the legendary all-rounder and one of the most charismatic personalities in cricket, has announced his retirement from all forms of the game. The 40-year-old Trinidadian shared the news on Instagram, revealing that the current Caribbean Premier League (CPL) season would be his final appearance on the professional cricket stage. Bravo’s retirement marks the end of a remarkable career, with his final stint being particularly special as it takes place in front of his home fans, playing for the Trinbago Knight Riders (TKR).

Bravo’s career has been extraordinary, defined by his flamboyance both on and off the field. He began his professional journey with the West Indies in 2004 and quickly became known as a versatile all-rounder, capable of turning matches with both the bat and ball. While his international career was illustrious, it was in the T20 format where Bravo truly made his mark. Notably, he had played a pivotal role in the West Indies’ T20 World Cup victories in 2012 and 2016, consistently performing on the biggest stages and earning a reputation as one of the finest T20 players in the world.

Dwayne Bravo currently partners with CSK as the bowling coach

Bravo’s CPL retirement comes almost three years after he ended his T20I career following West Indies’ early exit at the 2021 T20 World Cup in the UAE. Then in 2023, Bravo retired from the IPL, and has served as Chennai Super Kings’ bowling coach since in the league.

It was Bravo’s stint with the Chennai Super Kings (CSK) in the Indian Premier League (IPL) that truly solidified his legendary status. Joining CSK in 2011, Bravo became an integral part of the franchise, contributing significantly to their success over the years. His all-round abilities, particularly his death bowling and his knack for taking crucial wickets, made him one of the most valuable players in the league.

Bravo’s impact on CSK was immense. He was a key figure in CSK’s IPL triumphs, helping the team win multiple titles. Known for his ability to deliver under pressure, Bravo often took on the role of the finisher with the bat, while his bowling at the death overs became one of the most feared weapons in T20 cricket. His record as the first player to take 183 wickets in the IPL is a testament to his consistency and skill.

Beyond the numbers, Bravo’s energy and enthusiasm were infectious, making him a fan favorite. His signature ‘Champion’ dance became synonymous with CSK’s victories, and his camaraderie with teammates, especially captain MS Dhoni, was a highlight of his time with the franchise. Bravo’s presence in the CSK dressing room brought a sense of confidence and fun, which was reflected in the team’s performances.

Bravo’s association with the Chennai Super Kings wasn’t just about his on-field contributions; he embodied the spirit of the franchise. His leadership qualities, even when not captaining the side, were evident as he mentored younger players and led by example. His experience and tactical mind played a significant role in CSK’s strategy, particularly in close games where his calmness under pressure was invaluable.

As Dwayne Bravo steps away from professional cricket, his legacy with CSK and the broader T20 cricket world will be remembered for years to come.

title: IPL Uncapped Player Rule Explained
content:
With the next IPL auction around the corner, Chennai Super Kings (CSK) is planning its moves to build a better team for the next season, and the Uncapped Player rule in IPL can be a game-changer for them.

To ensure that key players are not poached from the team and to build a strong squad, CSK management is targeting particular areas of the game that require strengthening.

One key element of their strategy is the notion of the ‘uncapped player,’ a rule that could be vital in allowing the retention of legendary wicketkeeper-batsman MS Dhoni and effectively controlling the team’s fiscal capacities. 

Understanding IPL Uncapped Player Rule

There is a lot of buzz on the internet around the IPL’s Uncapped Player rule. Hence, in this article, we have decided to decode the mystery behind this rule in context with Chennai Super Kings. We will also delve into how this rule can help CSK retain their Thala.

In the IPL, an uncapped player is someone who has not played for India in any International cricket formats. This gives franchisees the right to keep or buy such players at a lower base price than the capped players, the players who have played for the country.

The initial price for uncapped players is Rs 20 Lakh, and the highest is capped at Rs 4 crore, depending on the player’s experience and performance in previous league seasons. 

The importance of this rule is that it makes the system better placed to enable franchises such as CSK to retain good players while at the same time not having to break the bank. This is because uncapped players are cheaper to buy, and therefore, franchises can use the money they have saved to purchase other essential players or to retain other players. Furthermore, this rule is helpful for players who have played for their countries and then retired but still have the capabilities and the authority to enhance their IPL teams. 

Highest Paid Uncapped Players in IPL Auctions

  • Avesh Khan – The Lucknow Super Giants made headlines in 2022 when they splashed a whopping ₹10 crore on Avesh Khan, making him the most expensive uncapped player in IPL. Avesh’s raw pace and ability to bowl yorkers at will made him a sought-after asset, and his performance did justice to his price tag. His knack for picking crucial wickets at crunch moments proved he was worth every penny, making him one of the most expensive uncapped players in IPL history.
  • Krishnappa Gowtham – In 2021, Krishnappa Gowtham created waves at the IPL auction when Chennai Super Kings snapped him up for ₹9.25 crore. A versatile off-spinner and a handy lower-order batsman, Gowtham’s T20 exploits earned him a hefty payday. While the pressure of his price tag was immense, his ability to contribute with both bat and ball was something CSK banked on, even if his performances were mixed.
  • Shahrukh Khan – Punjab Kings took a significant punt on Shahrukh Khan in 2022, bidding ₹9 crore to bring the hard-hitting batsman into their fold. Known for his six-hitting ability and finishing skills, Shahrukh became an instant fan favourite. His fearless approach and powerful strokes made him an exciting addition to Punjab’s lineup, validating the hefty investment.
  • Rahul Tewatia – Gujarat Titans spent ₹9 crore on Rahul Tewatia in the 2022 auction, betting on his all-round capabilities. Famous for his unforgettable match-winning innings against Punjab Kings in 2020, Tewatia’s leg spin and explosive batting made him a prized pick. His unpredictability and match-winning potential justified the high price tag.
  • Krunal Pandya – The 2018 auction saw Krunal Pandya becoming one of the highest-paid uncapped players when Mumbai Indians secured him for ₹8.8 crore. With his sharp left-arm spin and powerful batting down the order, Krunal was a crucial player for MI, often turning games in their favour with his all-around performances.
  • Varun Chakravarthy – Kings XI Punjab took a bold step in 2019 by acquiring Varun Chakravarthy for ₹8.4 crore. Known for his mystery spin, Chakravarthy’s unknown factor in the bowling department made him a valuable asset. Despite the high expectations, his ability to bamboozle batsmen with his variations showcased why franchises were willing to shell out big bucks for uncapped talent.

MS Dhoni’s Potential as an Uncapped Player

This could well be a masterstroke by Chennai Super Kings (CSK) as they gear up for the next season of the Indian Premier League (IPL) in retaining MS Dhoni as an uncapped player. This news is still in the rumour phase, with no confirmation from CSK’s management.

We all know that MS Dhoni is a cricket icon and the backbone of CSK. He has played a big role in the franchise’s success. Besides, he has won five IPL titles, including two recently in 2021 and 2023, and his leadership and in-game knowledge cannot be replaced. 

In 2024, Dhoni played under Ruturaj Gaikwad’s leadership. Gaikwad’s leadership was the phase where the transition was taking place. Despite not making it to the playoffs, CSK only ranked fifth.

Dhoni’s presence on the field inspired other players, especially the young ones, and he also ensured that the team’s morale was high. Therefore, it is important for CSK to use the IPL uncapped player rule and retain MS Dhoni.

But this might leave you with the question as to how MS Dhoni will fall in the category of an uncapped player. Let’s understand this further.

How can MS Dhoni play as an uncapped player in the IPL?

According to the IPL guidelines, any player who has not played international cricket for the last five years is considered an uncapped player.

For Dhoni, this would mean a price of four crores, as opposed to twelve crores, which he would attract as a capped player. This Rs 8 crore saving can be a big relief for CSK as it would provide the franchise with more options to reinforce other departments in the auction. 

This will help CSK retain its core while infusing new players into the playing squad. He has a lot of experience in pressure moments, is a great coach for young players, and is a favourite of the CSK supporters.

If the IPL clears him to play, this might just be the triggering factor that would ensure CSK’s continued victory. 

Moving forward to the next season, CSK may likely retain Dhoni as an uncapped player. Dhoni retired from international cricket more than five years ago, making him eligible to be bought as an uncapped player according to IPL rules.

In other words, his base price would be effectively Rs 4 crore and not Rs 12 crore, which would have been the case if he had been a capped player. This could be a real saving for the franchise, which could then be invested in other parts of the squad. 

 But what needs to be mentioned here is that the IPL governing body has not made any decisions on Dhoni and has not declared him an uncapped player.

If this rule is to be implemented, then it will be beneficial for CSK to get their beloved captain at a lower price, which will help the ‘Yellow Army’ be a strong entity in the auction and on the field.

title: "MS Dhoni… I like his coolness": Adam Gilchrist Names Top 3 Wicket-Keeper Batters
content:
Adam Gilchrist, celebrated as one of cricket’s all-time greats, not only transformed the role of a wicketkeeper-batter but also enjoyed a huge international career, highlighted by winning two ODI World Cups. Over his career, Gilchrist played 96 Tests, 287 ODIs, and 13 T20Is, amassing 15,461 runs and 905 dismissals—second only to the legendary Kumar Sangakkara in international wicketkeeping records.

In a recent interview, Gilchrist shared his views on the greatest wicketkeeper-batters of all time, placing MS Dhoni prominently in his top three. For Gilchrist, Dhoni’s inclusion at number two reflects his admiration for the former India captain’s unique blend of calmness and leadership. “MS Dhoni… I like his coolness. He did it his way, always calm,” Gilchrist told The Times of India. This praise comes from a fellow great who himself redefined the role with his aggressive batting and outstanding keeping skills.

Gilchrist’s top choice is Australian legend Rodney Marsh, who he idolized early in his career. Marsh’s influence was pivotal in shaping Gilchrist’s approach to wicketkeeping and batting. Completing Gilchrist’s top three is Sri Lankan maestro Kumar Sangakkara, whose elegance and technical proficiency with both bat and gloves have earned him a global name.

“To win in India… was a fulfilling experience”: Adam Gilchrist

Reflecting on memorable moments from his career, Gilchrist pointed to the iconic Kolkata Test of 2001 as his toughest day on the field. In that match, VVS Laxman and Rahul Dravid’s historic partnership thwarted Australia’s efforts, leading to an Indian victory despite a follow-on. Gilchrist described the experience as being part of something special, highlighting the challenge and the spectacle of that historic match.

Gilchrist also spoke about his own leadership experience, noting a significant achievement in 2004-05 when Australia won a Test series in India—a feat that had eluded them for a long time. Taking over as captain due to Ricky Ponting’s injury, Gilchrist led Australia to a 2-1 series victory. “Captaincy brings different pressures and expectations… To win in India in 2004-05, that was a fulfilling experience,” he reflected. This success not only underscored his leadership but also added to the excitement and satisfaction of his cricketing career.

title: BCCI Allows Uncapped Player Rule for MS Dhoni: Reports
content:
In a significant development for Chennai Super Kings (CSK), the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) is reportedly considering to let MS Dhoni play as an uncapped player for the 2025 IPL season, according to a report by Times Of India. This move would be a return to the BCCI’s previously halted policy, which categorizes players who have been retired from international cricket for at least five years as uncapped.

If this policy is implemented, it would be a major advantage for CSK, as retaining Dhoni, the legendary former India and CSK captain, would be far less costly under the new rules. Previously, an uncapped player could be retained for INR 4 crores, a major decrease compared to the INR 12 crores CSK paid for Dhoni in the 2022 season.

“Will do what’s best for CSK”: MS Dhoni on IPL retirement

When asked about whether Dhoni would be classified as an uncapped player in the 2025 IPL auction, CSK CEO Kasi Viswanathan responded, “I have no idea about it. We’ve not requested for it. They (the BCCI) have themselves told us that the ‘uncapped player rule’ may be kept, that’s all. They haven’t announced anything as yet. The rules and regulations will be announced by the BCCI.”

The potential rule change was reportedly advocated by CSK management during a meeting with IPL franchise owners and the BCCI on July 31 in Mumbai. Dhoni, who last played for India in the 2019 World Cup semifinal against New Zealand, announced his retirement from international cricket on August 15, 2020.

Ahead of the IPL 2024 season, Dhoni had handed over the CSK captaincy to Ruturaj Gaikwad. Despite being 43 years old, Dhoni showcased his prowess by scoring 161 runs off just 73 balls, at an impressive strike rate of 220.54 and an average of 53.66, primarily batting in the death overs.

At a recent promotional event in Hyderabad, Dhoni mentioned that he would decide on his participation for the next IPL season after the player regulations are announced. “There is a lot of time for it. We have to see what decision they take on player retention, etc. Right now, the ball is not in our court. So, once the rules and regulations get formalized, I will take a call, but it needs to be in the best interest of the team,” Dhoni stated. This indicates that while the potential classification as an uncapped player could influence his decision, Dhoni remains focused on what is best for CSK.

title: Devon Conway Opts Out of New Zealand Central Contract
content:
New Zealand opener Devon Conway has chosen to let go the central contract for the 2024-2025 season, opting instead for a casual contract to allow flexibility in his schedule. This decision will enable him to participate in South Africa’s SA20 league next January. Despite this shift, Conway will remain available for all nine Tests on the Black Caps’ calendar and the ICC Champions Trophy scheduled for early next year, according to New Zealand Cricket (NZC).

Conway, born in Johannesburg and having represented New Zealand since 2020, has played 20 Tests, 32 ODIs, and 50 Twenty20 internationals. The 33-year-old emphasized that his decision was made with careful consideration for his and his family’s needs. “Playing for the Black Caps is still the pinnacle for me, and I’m hugely passionate about representing New Zealand and winning international cricket matches,” Conway stated in a news release.

Devon Conway Follows Williamson’s Steps, Opts Out of New Zealand Central Contract

His choice mirrors that of former captain Kane Williamson, who is also set to play in the SA20 league under a similar casual contract arrangement. NZC has adopted this flexible approach to retain their top players amidst the increasing allure of lucrative T20 leagues around the world.

Scott Weenink, NZC’s chief executive, highlighted the necessity of such flexibility: “In the current environment, it’s important to have flexibility in our system to navigate some of the challenges posed by franchise cricket.”

Conway, along with Williamson, has been included in the 15-man squad for a one-off Test against Afghanistan and a two-match series in Sri Lanka this September. Conway expressed his excitement about these upcoming fixtures, emphasizing his commitment to the Black Caps and his anticipation for the Champions Trophy in Pakistan next February.

Additionally, Finn Allen, another Black Caps opener, has also opted out of a central contract, choosing to be available for selection on a match-by-match basis. NZC will offer central contracts to two yet-to-be-determined players to fill the vacancies left by Conway and Allen.

title: Mitchell Santner Takes a Flying Catch In The Hundred: Watch Viral Video
content:
The saying “Catches win matches” is timeless in cricket, and it was perfectly exemplified by New Zealand and Chennai Super King’s Mitchell Santner in a recent match of The Hundred. During a crucial game between London Spirit and Northern Superchargers at Headingley, Leeds, Santner took a stunning catch to dismiss Michael Pepper.

Pepper, who had scored just three runs, lofted a delivery from Reece Topley towards mid-on. Santner, charging from mid-on, tracked the ball with precision and executed a spectacular full-stretch dive to complete the catch. The official social media handle of The Hundred highlighted this impressive moment with a post showcasing various angles of Santner’s extraordinary effort.

Watch: Mitchell Santner comes from behind to take a ‘Flying’ catch in The Hundred viral

This isn’t the first time when Santner has pulled out a stunner. In the 2023 ODI World Cup, the Kiwi spinner had taken a ‘Screamer’ to dismiss Afghanistan captain Hashmatullah Shahidi on the bowling of Lockie Ferguson. 

The catch happened on the last ball of the 14th over with Santner taking a near-improbable catch. On a short ball by Lockie Ferguson, Hashmatullah Shahidi went for a pull shot but he miss-timed it. Santner then leaped and ran backwards to take the terrific catch. 

Talking about the match, the Northern Superchargers secured a crucial victory over London Spirit in a rain-affected game, which has kept their hopes alive in the tournament. The win lifted them to second place on the table with 11 points. To advance to the knockout stages, they now need Welsh Fire or Manchester Originals to win their remaining matches.

Adil Rashid was instrumental for the Superchargers, delivering a stellar performance with the ball. He claimed 3 wickets for 16 runs, dismantling the London Spirit’s batting lineup by removing key players like Matt Critchley, Shimron Hetmyer, and Andre Russell in quick succession. His efforts restricted London Spirit to a modest total of 111 runs from their 100 balls.

For London Spirit, Liam Dawson was a standout performer, scoring 27 runs from 19 balls. Ravi Bopara added 31 runs, but it wasn’t enough to set a challenging target. When rain intervened, the Superchargers were comfortably ahead on the Duckworth-Lewis-Stern (DLS) method, leading to a premature end of the match. This defeat marked London’s seventh loss in eight games, a disappointing end to their campaign.

title: BCCI Makes Changes in Player Retention Rules in IPL, Allows up to Six Retentions
content:
Despite the suggestion and controversies, the Indian Premier League (IPL) mega auction is set to remain a fixture in the cricket calendar, as confirmed by the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI). With the 2025 season right around the corner, the BCCI has announced significant changes to the player retention rules, increasing the number of players each team can retain from four to six. This move comes in response to concerns raised by several franchise owners during a meeting with the BCCI on July 31.

During the meeting, franchise owners, particularly those from Sunrisers Hyderabad and Kolkata Knight Riders, expressed their suggestions about the mega auction format. They argued that the restriction of retaining only four players had the potential to undo the progress teams had made since the last auction in 2022. These owners pointed out that the frequent mega auctions force teams to opt for temporary solutions rather than building a stable, long-term squad. Their primary concern was that the auction format disrupts team harmony and continuity, which are crucial for sustained success.

IPL Player Retention Rules: BCCI Allows teams to retain up to six players

In response to these concerns, the BCCI has agreed to increase the number of retained players from four to six, providing teams with more flexibility to build and maintain a stable squad. This change is expected to allow franchises to retain their core group of players, bringing in continuity and long-term planning.

Additionally, there is speculation that the Right to Match (RTM) option may be reintroduced. The RTM, which was last used in 2018, allows teams to retain players by matching the highest bid for them at the auction. If reinstated, teams could retain players through a combination of direct retentions and RTMs, with possible combinations like a 4+2 or 3+3 system. This would further enhance the ability of franchises to maintain a competitive edge.

CSK Demand Retaining MS Dhoni as an Uncapped Player

Amidst these discussions, the Chennai Super Kings (CSK) have put forward a unique request regarding the retention of their iconic captain, MS Dhoni, for the 2025 IPL season. CSK is exploring the possibility of retaining Dhoni as an uncapped player, an idea that was discussed during the meeting with the BCCI and the ten franchises in Mumbai on Wednesday last week.

CSK’s proposal hinges on the reintroduction of an old rule that classified players who had retired from international cricket for five or more years as uncapped. This rule was in place from the inaugural IPL season in 2008 until it was scrapped in 2021. By reintroducing this rule, CSK hopes to retain Dhoni without using one of their six capped player retention slots.

However, this suggestion has met with resistance from other franchises, who are not in favor of bringing back the rule. The opposition is likely due to the fact that allowing such an exception could set a precedent that might complicate the player retention process for other teams and of course any franchise would do anything to get Dhoni out for auction if possible.

title: CSK Advocates Sustainable Initiavies by Partnering with IIT Madras
content:
The very beloved IPL franchise Chennai Super Kings (CSK) on 19th March announced their partnership with the Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IIT Madras). This is to promote sustainable initiatives ahead of the upcoming IPL 2024. This collaboration with an aim to expand CSK social initiatives is set to leverage the combined expertise, vision, and resources of both institutions to drive meaningful environmental change and create a positive impact on the community

CSK believes in giving back to the community that has supported them through thick and thin. Keeping that in mind, the partnership will focus on implementing innovative strategies to minimize the environmental footprint during the IPL season. This includes the adoption of renewable energy solutions and waste management practices to promote sustainability throughout the matches. By utilizing the research capabilities of IIT Madras, the partnership will explore cutting-edge technologies and solutions to tackle various environmental challenges, ensuring that the initiative is both impactful and forward-thinking.

KS Viswanathan, CEO of Chennai Super Kings Cricket Limited, expressed his enthusiasm for the collaboration, stating, “We are committed to making a positive impact on the environment. Our collaboration with IIT Madras reflects our shared vision for a sustainable future. By combining our reach and IIT Madras’ academic prowess and research capabilities, we have the opportunity to pioneer innovative solutions that address pressing environmental challenges. Together, we hope to inspire a generation towards a more sustainable future.”

V Kamakoti, Director of IIT Madras, echoed this sentiment, emphasizing the importance of sustainability in today’s world. “Sustainability is critical to every organization and is an area where we are going to see the most number of jobs being created in the future. IIT Madras has proven expertise in this area, and we are very happy to partner with CSK—an iconic organization in Chennai—in their journey towards sustainability. IIT Madras is also deeply committed to the health and fitness of its students, faculty, and staff. Association with one of India’s premier sport franchises will also help us move towards this goal.”

This partnership marks a significant step towards integrating sustainable practices in sports and serves as an inspiration for future collaborations between academic institutions and sports franchises.

More About CSK Charity and Other Social Initiatives

The Chennai Super Kings (CSK) are renowned not just for their on-field excellence but also for their impactful social initiatives. The team actively engages with the community, organizing cricket clinics for aspiring young talents and participating in charitable events and social causes. These initiatives reflect CSK’s commitment to making a positive difference in society, using their platform to inspire and uplift others.

One of the most significant aspects of CSK’s outreach is their focus on nurturing the next generation of cricketers. Through youth academies and mentorship programs, they provide young boys and girls across India with opportunities to learn from their cricketing idols. This effort is instrumental in encouraging the dreams of countless youngsters who aspire to one day wear the iconic yellow jersey.

CSK also champions diversity and inclusion, celebrating the diverse cultures that make up India. The team has taken meaningful steps to promote women’s cricket, hosting exhibition matches and supporting women’s leagues. This commitment to gender equality is paving the way for a more inclusive future in sports.

By fostering excellence, integrity, and teamwork both on and off the field, CSK continues to inspire and unite people from all walks of life, demonstrating the profound impact that sports can have on society.

Chennai Super Kings, a franchise with five IPL titles, is reportedly the most valuable in the league, with a brand valuation of $231 million, according to a report by investment bank Houlihan Lokey Inc. Looking ahead, CSKCL plans to launch additional training academies aimed at nurturing young cricket talent in schools, boosting fan engagement through various initiatives, and increasing revenue through enhanced sponsorships and merchandise sales. title: All Players Retained by Joburg Super Kings ahead of SA20 League 2025
content:
All the teams have begun to prepare for the Betway SA20 Season 3, beginning on February 9th 2025. Having said that all six teams have started revealing their retention list for next year’s SA20. In this article, let’s take a look at Joburg Super Kings’ (JSK) player retention list.

On Wednesday, Joburg Super Kings have announced their retention list for the SA20 2025, confirming that Faf du Plessis will once again lead the team.

Ahead is the full list of players retained by Joburg Super Kings for SA20 League 2025. Read below without further ado.

JSK Player Retention List for SA20 League 2025

The full list of Joburg Super Kings’ (JSK) retentions for Season 3 includes:

Faf du Plessis (captain)

Du Plessis has been an exceptional performer for the Johannesburg-based team, amassing 608 runs at an average of 35.76 and a strike rate of 145.10 over the past two seasons. His impressive record includes the first-ever Betway SA20 century and five half-centuries. Ranked sixth on the list of all-time Betway SA20 run-scorers, du Plessis is just 18 runs behind his opening partner Leus du Plooy.

Leus du Plooy

The most prominent and deserving player in the JSK retentions is Lues du Plooy. He has showcased consistent performance for Joburg Super Kings in the SA League across the 2023 and 2024 seasons. In 2023, du Plooy played 9 matches, contributing significantly with the bat. He scored 249 runs at an impressive average of 62.25 and a strike rate of 137.57. His highest score was 81, and he recorded two half-centuries, hitting 27 fours and 7 sixes.

Building on his strong 2023 performance, du Plooy continued to excel in 2024, playing 11 matches and amassing 377 runs at an average of 37.70. His strike rate of 159.07 reflects his aggressive batting style. He scored three half-centuries with a highest score of 71 and demonstrated his boundary-hitting ability with 37 fours and 17 sixes. 

Imran Tahir

Imran Tahir has been a reliable bowler for the Joburg Super Kings in the SA20 League 2024 season. Over 11 matches, Tahir took 9 wickets with a best performance of 2/13, maintaining an average of 26.22 and an economy rate of 7.61. While his batting contributions were minimal, scoring just 3 runs in 3 innings, his primary role as a spinner was pivotal in controlling the opposition’s scoring, making him an essential part of the Super Kings’ bowling attack.

David Wiese

Among the Players retained by Joburg Super Kings is David Wiese, despite a challenging 2024 season in the South African T20 League for the Joburg Super Kings. As a bowler, he played 4 matches but failed to take any wickets, conceding 85 runs with an economy rate of 10.63. His batting performance was also modest, scoring 9 runs at an average of 9.00 with a strike rate of 56.25. Despite his struggles, Wiese’s experience and all-round capabilities remain valuable assets for the team in future seasons.

Donovan Ferreira

Donovan Ferreira showcased his bowling skills for the Joburg Super Kings in the Protean T20 League, particularly in the 2023 season. In 11 matches, he took 3 wickets with best figures of 1/3, maintaining an impressive average of 18.00 and an economy rate of 6.00. However, he did not bowl in the 2024 season. Ferreira’s contributions in 2023 highlighted his potential as a reliable bowler, adding depth to the Super Kings’ bowling attack.

Moeen Ali

In the 2024 SA20 League, Moeen Ali showcased his all-round abilities for the Joburg Super Kings. As a bowler, he played 11 matches, took 5 wickets with best figures of 2/31, and maintained an economy rate of 8.11. With the bat, Ali scored 169 runs in 11 innings, averaging 28.17 and striking at 127.07, with a top score of 36. His fielding was sharp, contributing 10 catches, underlining his versatility and value to the team.

Nandre Burger

Nandre Burger is also ready to solidify the JSK Squad. He showcased his bowling prowess for the Joburg Super Kings in the SA20 League. In 2024, he played 11 matches, taking 11 wickets with best figures of 3/26, maintaining an economy rate of 7.94 and an average of 25.27. In 2023, he appeared in 5 matches, claiming 2 wickets with an economy rate of 9.00 and an average of 76.50. Burger’s performance in 2024 marked a significant improvement, making him a valuable asset to the team’s bowling attack.

Gerald Coetzee

Gerald Coetzee had a remarkable performance for the Joburg Super Kings in the Protean T20 League, especially in 2023. He played 9 matches, taking 17 wickets with best figures of 4/24, maintaining an impressive average of 13.53 and an economy rate of 8.07. Additionally, he achieved three four-wicket hauls. However, he did not play in the 2024 season. Coetzee’s exceptional 2023 performance made him a standout bowler for the team, significantly contributing to their success.

Lizaad Williams

Lizaad Williams has been a key bowler for the Joburg Super Kings in the SA20 League. In 2024, he played 9 matches, taking 15 wickets at an average of 16.53, including a best of 4/26, although his economy rate was 9.92. In 2023, he managed 5 wickets in 3 matches at an average of 14.00, with a best of 4/36. His batting contributions were minimal, but his impressive wicket-taking ability made him a crucial asset for the team.

Sibonelo Makhanya

Sibonelo Makhanya showed potential during his time with the Joburg Super Kings in the South African T20 League. In 2024, he played 5 matches, scoring 72 runs at an average of 24.00, with a top score of 40 and a strike rate of 122.03. His fielding was notable, with 7 catches and 2 run-outs. In 2023, Makhanya’s opportunities were limited, scoring 16 runs across 7 matches. Despite the modest figures, his consistent fielding and batting promise make him a valuable team player.

What Does Joburg Super Kings 2025 Squad Look Like Up Till Now?

The pre-signed overseas players are Maheesh Theekshana (Sri Lanka) and Jonny Bairstow (England). The team also made a strategic trade, acquiring Tabraiz Shamsi from the Paarl Royals in exchange for Dayyaan Galiem.

Joburg Super Kings have also strengthened their squad with significant additions for the upcoming season. Notably, England’s Jonny Bairstow has been signed, bringing his extensive experience, including winning the 2019 ICC Men’s ODI World Cup and multiple IPL seasons, to the team.

title: How Can CSK Retain MS Dhoni as Uncapped Player in IPL?
content:
In a recent development, Chennai Super Kings (CSK) are exploring the possibility of retaining MS Dhoni as an uncapped player for the IPL 2025 season. This idea was discussed during a meeting between the BCCI and the ten franchises in Mumbai on Wednesday. CSK suggested the reintroduction of an old rule that classified players who retired from international cricket for five or more years as uncapped. This rule existed from the inaugural edition in 2008 until it was scrapped in 2021. However, most other franchises were not in favor of bringing back this rule.

MS Dhoni retired from international cricket on August 15, 2020. Ahead of the mega auction before IPL 2022, Dhoni was the second player retained by CSK, after Ravindra Jadeja, at the cost of INR 12 crore from the franchise’s auction purse. In contrast, an uncapped player retained that year cost the team only INR 4 crore. CSK is keen to retain Dhoni as an uncapped player if the IPL sets similar costs for uncapped players retained ahead of the 2025 auction. However, several other franchises oppose giving long-retired internationals uncapped status.

Sunrisers Hyderabad owner Kavya Maran argued that allowing a retired player to be retained as an uncapped player would “disrespect” the individual and their value, which would be much higher at an auction. She suggested that retired players should be part of the auction, where the market would determine their fair price. Another franchise agreed to this sentiment, stating that a former international player should not be considered uncapped, regardless of how many years they had been retired.

“Will do what’s best for CSK”: MS Dhoni on IPL retirement

The question of whether Dhoni, 43, will continue to play in the IPL has arisen towards the end of the last few seasons. After undergoing knee surgery in 2023, Dhoni handed over the CSK captaincy to Ruturaj Gaikwad ahead of the 2024 season and played a limited role with the bat, coming in late in the innings as a boundary-hitter. Dhoni recently mentioned that he and CSK would wait for the player retention rules to be finalized before deciding on playing the 2025 season.

Notably, MS Dhoni in a recent interview throwing light on the discussion said that his IPL retirement solely depends on what’s in CSK’s benefit and new IPL retention rules. Despite stepping down as CSK captain in 2024, Dhoni remains integral to the franchise, hinting at possibly another season in 2025 under Ruturaj Gaikwad’s leadership. As one of the legendary CSK captains, Dhoni’s influence continues to shape including his iconic MS Dhoni hairstyle, continues to shape the team’s future and inspire its players.

title: "Will do what's best for CSK": MS Dhoni on IPL retirement
content:
Former India captain and CSK star MS Dhoni recently revealed at an event that he is still thinking about his retirement plans from the Indian Premier League (IPL). The 41-year-old Dhoni explained that his decision will be focused on the larger benefit of CSK, as he is deeply connected to the franchise. His retirement considerations will also take into account the updated IPL retention rules. Dhoni has been a pivotal part of CSK, leading them to a joint-record five IPL titles, which are all part of his illustrious MS Dhoni IPL records.

The topic of Dhoni’s retirement has been debated ever since he stepped down from the CSK captaincy role ahead of IPL 2024, handing over the duties to Ruturaj Gaikwad. After CSK won their fifth IPL title in 2023, Indian cricket fans began anticipating that the 2024 season would be Dhoni’s last. However, Dhoni has yet to disclose any strong details about his retirement, leaving the door open for yet another season in 2025.

“…That is the ultimate goal”: MS Dhoni on his retirement plan from the IPL

“There’s a lot of time left for the franchises and management to decide on the retention rules and everything. So when all of it is decided, then we will take a decision. We don’t have the ball in our court yet. When the regulations are decided, then we will be able to take a call. At the end of the day, we will have to make a decision that is best for CSK, and that is the ultimate goal,” Dhoni said at the event.

Under Ruturaj Gaikwad’s captaincy, CSK failed to qualify for the IPL 2024 playoffs. Despite this, Gaikwad received praise for his first leadership stint with the franchise. Throughout the season, there were numerous occasions where Dhoni, one of the esteemed CSK captains, was seen giving his guidance to Ruturaj during matches. This mentorship has only heightened the anticipation around Ruturaj potentially becoming the long-term captain of the franchise.

title: Faf du Plessis' Dream to Conquer MLC 2024 Shattered, TSK Lose to SFU by 10-runs in a Nail-biter
content:
In a thrilling encounter at the Major League Cricket (MLC) 2024, the San Francisco Unicorns (SFU) defeated the Texas Super Kings (TSK) by a narrow margin of 10 runs. Despite a valiant effort from Faf du Plessis-led TSK, SFU’s first innings total of 200/6 proved just enough to secure the win in a match that went down to the wire.

With this Texas Super Kings’ dream campaign came to an end having not won an MLC title in 2 years despite being the tournament favourites in both the seasons.

MLC 2024: Finn Allen Proved out to be Too Strong for TSK, Despite Good Start Super Kings Fell Just Short

San Francisco Unicorns set the stage with a commanding total of 200/6 in their allotted 20 overs. The highlight of the innings was Finn Allen’s remarkable century. Allen scored a magnificent 101 off 53 balls, anchoring the innings and smashing the TSK bowlers with countless boundaries.

Supporting Allen, Josh Inglis played a crucial knock of 37 off 25 balls, ensuring SFU reached a formidable total. Among the bowlers, Noor Ahmad stood out for TSK, claiming 3 wickets for 27 runs in his 4 overs. Mohammad Mohsin also contributed with a tight spell, taking 1 wicket for 37 runs.

In response, Texas Super Kings started their chase with determination. Devon Conway and Joshua Tromp led the charge with valuable contributions. Conway scored 62 off 38 balls, while Tromp added 56 off 36 balls. Their efforts kept TSK in contention throughout the innings.

As the match approached its end, TSK needed 18 runs off the final over. Despite some innovative and aggressive batting from Tromp, who had earlier smashed boundaries off Pat Cummins and Haris Rauf, TSK fell short. Tromp’s scoop shots and Conway’s consistent striking kept the ‘Yellove’ fans on the edge of their seats.

However, SFU’s bowlers held their nerve in the death overs. Juanoy Drysdale and Hassan Khan were instrumental, with Drysdale taking 2 wickets for 33 runs and Khan conceding just 25 runs in his 4 overs. Haris Rauf and Pat Cummins, despite being expensive, managed to restrict the runs in crucial moments.

For TSK, the loss was a hard pill to swallow, especially for captain Faf du Plessis, whose dream of conquering MLC 2024 took a hit. Yet, the performance exhibited resilience and fighting spirit, promising more thrilling encounters in the future of Major Cricket League.

title: Maheesh Theekshana Reveals How MS Dhoni Helped Tackle Sweep Shot Against Him
content:
Sri Lankan spinner Maheesh Theekshana recently opened up about how legendary India captain MS Dhoni helped him counter batters who used the slog sweep against him. Theekshana will be in action in the upcoming three-match T20I series against India starting from July 27. He has emerged as one of the rising stars from Sri Lanka with his impressive performances in the limited-overs format.

The 23-year-old spinner shared insights into the valuable lessons he learned from Dhoni while playing under his leadership for Chennai Super Kings (CSK) in the Indian Premier League (IPL). According to Theekshana, Dhoni’s advice on handling batters who played the sweep shot was crucial in his development as a bowler.

“I have learned a lot of things from MS Dhoni”: Theekshana Revealed

According to Theekshana’s revelation, Dhoni suggested that Theekshana bowl a bit fuller to counter the sweep shot, a strategy that not only reduced the number of boundaries but also helped him develop a lethal yorker.

“I have learned a lot of things from MS Dhoni, but in particular, how he helped me bowl to batters who would employ the sweep shot against me. With my action, I would bowl quicker, but they would still hit boundaries. He asked me to bowl a bit fuller. That’s also how I developed my yorker. I gradually gained confidence bowling in the death overs. Dhoni always has a plan. But he goes to the bowler’s plan first and only if it does not work, does he guide you,” Theekshana told Sony Sports Network.

Theekshana’s journey in the IPL has been noteworthy. He has played 27 matches for CSK, picking up 25 wickets at an average of 31.88 and an economy of 7.66, with his best figures being 4/33. His performance in the recently concluded Lanka Premier League (LPL) was also commendable, where he took ten wickets from ten innings at an average of 29.40 and an economy of 7.35.

The young spinner will be eager to continue his brilliant form in the upcoming T20I series against India and help Sri Lanka secure their second T20I series win against the Men in Blue. However, the Sri Lankan team faces a challenge as they have been hit by injuries ahead of the series. Seamers Nuwan Thushara and Dushmantha Chameera have been ruled out, which could impact their bowling attack.

Theekshana’s experiences under Dhoni’s mentorship have clearly played a significant role in his development. His ability to adapt and improve his bowling techniques under pressure highlights the importance of having a seasoned leader like Dhoni. As Theekshana prepares for the series against India, his learnings from Dhoni will undoubtedly be a crucial factor in his performance.

title: Maharashtra Cricket Association Names Ruturaj Gaikwad as Captain for Ranji Trophy 2024-25
content:
In a significant development in domestic cricket, the Maharashtra Cricket Association (MCA) has announced its tentative 28-member senior men’s squad for the 2024-25 Ranji Trophy season. A notable change in the squad is the shift in captaincy, with the MCA deciding to replace the 31-year-old Ankit Bawne as the team’s skipper. Indian batter and Chennai Super King’s captain Ruturaj Gaikwad has been appointed the new leader.

This decision was impending for two primary reasons: Maharashtra’s below-par performance under Bawne’s captaincy, failing to advance beyond the knockout stages in three out of the four seasons he led, and Gaikwad’s valuable captaincy experience gained during IPL 2024 under the mentorship of MS Dhoni.

Former Tamil Nadu head coach Sulakshan Kulkarni, who led Tamil Nadu to the final of the premier domestic red-ball tournament in 2024, will undertake his first assignment with the squad when the 89th season of the Ranji Trophy begins this October. Kulkarni has been appointed as head coach of the Maharashtra side for an initial two-year term.

Notably, the squad will be refined and reduced as the tournament approaches. Among the 28-member provisional squad is the promising young all-rounder Arshin Kulkarni. Kulkarni made his IPL debut in 2024 and played his sole first-class match against Services, scoring 2 and 58 and claiming 2/41. He will be anticipated to be a player to watch this season.

Additionally, Rahul Tripathi, who represented Goa in the 2024 edition of the Ranji Trophy, has been included in the provisional lineup and is expected to be an impactful player of the unit moving forward.

The MCA’s announcement has generated excitement among fans, with the association tweeting: “New season, new squad! 💪 Here’s our probable team for the upcoming Ranji Trophy Season 2024-25. The stage is set for another thrilling season!”

As the new season approaches, the Maharashtra team, under new leadership of Ruturaj Gaikwad and Sulakshan Kulkarni’s guidance, is poised to make a strong impact in the upcoming Ranji Trophy.

title: CSK Set to open Super Kings Academy in Sydney, Australia
content:
Chennai Super Kings (CSK), the Indian Premier League (IPL) franchise, has recently announced the establishment of their third overseas Super Kings Academy, this time in Sydney, Australia. This highlights CSK’s commitment to fostering young cricket talents globally. The new academy will join the existing international centers in Dallas, USA, and Reading, United Kingdom.

Located at Cricket Central, 161 Silverwater Road, Sydney Olympic Park, the Super Kings Academy in Sydney will feature exceptional indoor and outdoor training facilities. These facilities will operate year-round, providing impactful cricket coaching for boys and girls. The academy will be starting in September.

CSK CEO, KS Viswanathan, expressed his enthusiasm for this new venture, emphasizing the special relationship between CSK and Australia that dates back to the start of the IPL in 2008. “We are happy to extend our special journey with Australia, which began with the inception of IPL in 2008. Australia is a champion country with a strong sporting culture and rich cricketing legacy. The Super Kings Academy will tap into and help groom cricketers, both boys and girls, adding to the already strong system in the country,” he said.

Viswanathan also highlighted the significance of the global expansion in cricket, noting how geographical boundaries are rapidly decreasing in size. He remarked, “Geographical boundaries are shrinking rapidly in cricket over the last few years. With presence in India, USA, UK and now Australia, we have the opportunity to develop the next generation of cricketers through our world-class facilities, strong coaching curriculum, exchange programmes and more.”

The Super Kings Academy aims to nurture young talent and provide them with the best possible training and facilities. This initiative is part of CSK’s broader vision to contribute to the growth and development of cricket worldwide. The academy will offer full year-round coaching facility and facilitate exchange programs, thereby creating opportunities for budding cricketers to learn and grow.

List of All Super Kings Academies in India

The most loved IPL franchise Chennai Super Kings have 8 academies across the South Indian landmark. Here’s a list of all Super Kings Academies in India:

1. Super Kings Academy, Hosur

    This franchise-based Academy is located at the MS Dhoni Global School. The main ground has two turf wickets and one matting wicket. The practice facility has five turf wickets, one matting wicket and two Astro turf wickets. The Academy has been operational since April 2023.

    2. Super Kings Academy, Coimbatore

    The centre at FE Sports Zone, Peelamedu is equipped with state-of-the-art facilities with nine pitches (5 Turf, 2 Matting and 2 Astro Turf) and floodlights. Coaching classes for boys and girls commenced in January 2024.

    3. Super Kings Academy, Chennai – Sri Ramachandra Medical College

    This is our third center in Chennai and is equipped with 10 pitches (8 Turf and 2 Astro Turf pitches) and floodlights for practice. It has been operational since April 2024.

    4. Super Kings Academy, Trichy

    The franchise-based facility at Kamala Niketan Montessori School is equipped with five turf wickets, two matting wickets and two Astro turf wickets and floodlights. The Academy in Trichy has been operational since April 2023.

    5. Super Kings Academy, Karaikudi

    Alagappa Institutions in Karaikudi offer a franchise facility with eight pitches (4 Turf, 2 Astro Turf, and 2 Matting wickets), floodlights, and a full-fledged ground with turf and matting pitches for practice. It has been operational since April 2024.

    6. Super Kings Academy, Chennai – Guru Nanak College

    This state-of-the-art facility in Guru Nanak College is equipped with a total of 8 pitches (2 Turf, 3 Matting, and 3 Concrete pitches) and floodlights for practice. It has been operational since April 2024.

    8. Super Kings Academy, Tiruppur

    The franchise-based centre at the Yali Sports Limited is a state-of-the-art facility with ten pitches (5 Turf pitches, 3 Matting pitches, and 2 Astro Turf pitches) and floodlights. Coaching classes for boys and girls commenced in February 2024.

    9. Super Kings Academy, 361 Madha Koil St, Vivekananda Nagar, Thoraipakkam, Chennai

    This state-of-the-art centre has 14 Turf pitches, two concrete wickets and five indoor wickets apart from an open net. It also has a fitness center, a lounge and a classroom. It has been operational since April 2022.

    The academy’s launch aligns with CSK’s long-term vision of developing cricket talent and promoting the sport across different regions. With the addition of the Sydney academy, CSK now has a significant presence in key cricketing nations, enhancing its ability to scout and nurture young talent globally.

title: Mitchell Santner: A Key Player for CSK in IPL 2024
content:

Early Career 

Santner’s rise to the New Zealand national squad was attributed to his 2014–15 season-long excellence in domestic cricket. After Daniel Vettori announced his retirement from the 2015 World Cup, Santner was considered a potential left-arm spin option for New Zealand. In June 2015, he played his first One Day International for the national squad, and his bowling ability made a significant impression. Soon, he became an important member of the New Zealand side, known for taking big wickets and making significant runs lower down the order. Notably, Santner also made an impact as one of the key New Zealand players in CSK.

Mitchell Santner IPL Career

Santner’s IPL career began in 2019, when he joined with the Chennai Super Kings (CSK), one of the tournament’s most successful clubs. Even though Santner may not have played in many games, his presence was crucial for CSK. The squad gained an extra dimension and depth to their bowling arsenal with his clever left-arm orthodox spin bowling. While Santner didn’t have many chances to bat, he shown his ability as a trustworthy all-round player when the club management needed him to.

Mitchell Santner Stats for CSK in IPL 

Over the course of his 15-match IPL career, Santner has claimed 13 wickets at an outstanding economy rate of 6.88. And with 193 wickets in 189 outings at an economy rate of 7.11, his overall T20 record is as amazing and shows how good he is in the game’s shortest format.

Batting & Fielding Stats

He has worked with clubs in the Caribbean Premier League, The Hundred, Major League Cricket’s Texas Super Kings, and The Hundred’s Southern Brave. In franchise cricket, teams are keen to use his abilities in both the bowling and batting departments due to his adaptability and versatility.

Bowling

Apart from his achievements on the field, Santner has taken on leadership roles for New Zealand, having led the team in Twenty20 Internationals. Santner is still a key component of New Zealand’s aspirations in all formats as he develops as a cricket player. With his cricketing intelligence, relentless dedication, and proven track record, Santner is destined to reach even higher heights in the coming years, cementing his place as one of the world’s best all-rounders.

What is the future of Mitchell Santner in the IPL?

Mitchell Santner is one of the smartest all-rounder in modern day cricket. Despite the limited chances with the CSK in IPL, he has proven his loyalty and mettle time and again for the franchise. A clever left-arm spinner and a handy batter, Santner is a valuable asset for the Men in Yellove.
