title: ZIM vs IND: Tushar Deshpande makes India debut, pacer's wife filled with pride
content:
Nabha Gaddamwar, Tushar Deshpande’s wife, was filled with pride as her husband made his debut for the Indian cricket team. Deshpande donned national colors for the first time on Saturday, July 13, in the fourth T20I against Zimbabwe’s Sikandar Raza at the Harare Sports Club. He replaced Avesh Khan in the playing XI, and his wife was present in Harare to witness the achievement.

Nabha emphasized the considerable sacrifices made by Deshpande’s parents, claiming that their efforts had finally paid off with his selection. Deshpande was overjoyed to have his wife by his side during this important occasion, and he thanked his family for their support and sacrifices. “This is a truly unforgettable experience. It all boils down to the sacrifices his parents made to witness this day. “And, of course, his hard work; it’s quite overwhelming,” Nabha said in a video released on BCCI’s X account. 

Deshpande also remarked on the occasion, stating, “I’m extremely glad for my father who is in Mumbai. It was our desire, as a family, for me to play for the country. This is only the beginning for me and my family, and my wife’s presence is a source of pride“.

Deshpande dismissed Raza, who was making a challenge.

Deshpande performed admirably on his debut, despite failing to bowl his full four-over requirement. He finished with statistics of 3-0-30-1, taking the wicket of Raza, who was in the midst of making a serious challenge with a knock of 46 off 28 balls, including two fours and three sixes. 

Deshpande’s opportunity arose after India rested their first-choice pacers, Jasprit Bumrah and Mohammed Siraj. His inclusion in the national squad came after a string of outstanding performances for the Chennai club in the Indian Premier League (IPL), which piqued the selectors’ interest.

Deshpande’s debut was not only a tremendous personal achievement, but also a reflection of his family’s united work and goals. Both he and his wife acknowledged the difficulty of the trip as well as the excitement of reaching such a watershed moment. Deshpande’s debut signals the start of what he believes will be a great international career, fueled by his hard work and the encouragement of his loved ones.

title: Texas Super Kings: CSK Buys Texas Franchise in Major League Cricket
content:
Chennai Super Kings (CSK) has taken a major step forward in expanding its footprint in global cricket by acquiring a Texas franchise in Major League Cricket (MLC) in the US. On 18 March, 2023, the franchise had announced the news on Twitter, a key moment in its development process. Stay updated on the latest developments in MLC cricket to follow CSK’s expansion and future plans.

In their cryptic social media posts, CSK had captioned the announcement, “Soon big announcement. Howdy Texas! Show some yellow to our overseas cousin, @TeamTexasMLC! This exciting message caused quite a buzz with.”

The development had come just one day before the MLC Domestic Player Draft, which was scheduled to take place in Houston. With over 100 players eligible to represent the “U.S. cricket team” in the tournament, the announcement by CSK had added some excitement to the meet.

How CSK NRI Cousin Texas Super Kings Got its Name?

In the lead-up to the 2023 draft on March 19, the Texas franchise revealed its partnership with the Chennai Super Kings. After the draft, they held a press conference where co-owner Anurag Jain, along with Stephen Fleming and K.S. Viswanathan, announced their team name, the Texas Super Kings, as well as their logo and coach. However, in late April, they changed their logo to resemble the logos of the Chennai and Joburg Super Kings.

In their inaugural season, the Texas Super Kings impressed by finishing second in the league standings and securing a spot in the semi-finals. Despite a strong start, including notable victories over the Los Angeles Knight Riders and MI New York, they were eliminated in the playoffs. Standout performances from Faf du Plessis, Devon Conway, and Dwayne Bravo established the team as a formidable contender. With valuable lessons learned and experience gained, the Texas Super Kings are gearing up for a promising return in the 2024 season.

With this, CSK fans have got another opportunity to celebrate and spread the “Yellove” love. Along with Chennai Super Kings in the Indian Premiere League and JoBurg Super Kings in the SA20, the Men in Yellow are ready to win hearts as the Texas Super Kings in America’s very own franchise league, the Major League Cricket.

title: TSK vs WAF, MLC 2024: Faf du Plessis Smashes Century in Rain-Affected Clash Against Washington Freedom
content:
TSK vs WAF, MLC 2024: Captain Faf du Plessis played a sensational innings, scoring a 58-ball 100 to take Texas Super Kings to a formidable 203/5 in their 20 overs. However, rain stopped what promised to be an exciting chase by Washington Freedom, resulting in the two teams sharing the two points.

Coming off with a loss to LA Knight Riders just two days prior, the Super Kings were determined to make a strong start in their second match of the season. Du Plessis and his opening partner, Devon Conway, set the tone with a remarkable 109-run partnership in just 10.2 overs. The South African skipper led from the front, dismantling the bowling attack with a flooding of boundaries. Contributing 39 runs to the partnership before being dismissed, Conway provided solid support.

TSK vs WAF, MLC 2024: Faf du Plessis led from the front to take Super Kings to 200-plus total

Du Plessis’ innings featured 12 fours and five sixes, showcasing his aggressive intent and excellent shot selection. He was eventually dismissed in the 19th over, but by then, the Super Kings had amassed 203/5, marking the season’s first 200-plus total.

Washington Freedom’s chase got off to a flying start, with Travis Head and Steve Smith demonstrating their intent right from the beginning. The duo raced to 62/0 in just four overs, making a strong statement against the challenging target. Smith led the charge initially, combining with Head to take 17 runs off the second over from Naveen-ul-Haq.

Head had a lucky escape when Dwayne Bravo dropped a catch at mid-on, and he capitalized on this reprieve by punishing Aaron Hardie in the fourth over. Head smashed two fours and two sixes, both of which sailed over deep square leg, showcasing his aggressive stroke play.

Unfortunately, rain intervened just as the fifth over was about to start, allowing only one no-ball delivery before the players were forced to leave the ground. The weather stopped the play, and no further play was possible. As a result, both teams had to settle for a point each, leaving the MLC cricket match with no winner.

title: IND vs ZIM: Ruturaj Gaikwad's Brilliant 77 Helps India Crush Zimbabwe by 100 Runs
content:
Ind vs Zim, 2nd T20I: India’s 100-run win over Zimbabwe in the second T20I at Harare on July 7, was powered by a great batting display by Ruturaj Gaikwad. Supporting Abhishek Sharma in the assault Gaikwad scored an unbeaten 77 off 47 balls. After a defeat for Shubman Gill’s team had come from Zimbabwe during their first match of the T20I series played on July 6 they recovered to beat Sikandar Raza’s side and to come back in the 5-match series.

India’s innings was powered by Abhishek Sharma, who scored a maiden century off just 47 deliveries, featuring seven boundaries and eight sixes. His explosive performance laid a solid foundation for India’s total. Sharma was eventually dismissed by Wellington Masakadza on the last ball of the 14th over, caught brilliantly by Myers. His efforts earned him the Player of the Match award for his superb innings and maiden hundred.

IND vs ZIM: Ruturaj Gaikwad’s Brilliant 77 Helps India Crush Zimbabwe by 100 Runs

Following Sharma’s dismissal, Ruturaj Gaikwad continued the assault on the Zimbabwean bowlers. Gaikwad’s innings was a masterclass in T20 batting, combining calculated aggression with elegant stroke play. His unbeaten 77 was filled with boundaries and strategic placements, ensuring that India’s run rate never dipped.

Gaikwad found excellent support from Rinku Singh, who added a quick-fire 48 off 22 balls, propelling India to a formidable total of 234/2. This score set a new record for the highest team total against Zimbabwe in T20Is, surpassing the previous best of 229/2 by Australia in 2018.

Zimbabwe’s bowling attack struggled to contain the onslaught. With only Wellington Masakadza and Blessing Muzarabani managing to take a wicket each. The massive target of 235 runs set by India was always going to be a daunting challenge for the Zimbabwean batting line-up.

In response, Zimbabwe’s innings faltered under the pressure of the massive chase. Wessly Madhevere top-scored with 43 runs, while Brian Bennett added 26. Despite their efforts, the Indian bowlers dominated from the outset. Mukesh Kumar and Avesh Khan led the attack, each taking three wickets. Ravi Bishnoi contributed with two wickets, and Washington Sundar chipped in with one.

Zimbabwe’s entire innings crumbled for 134 runs in 18.4 overs, marking their highest defeat margin by runs in T20Is. Previously, Australia had defeated Zimbabwe by 100 runs in 2018.

Notably, this victory was crucial for India, not only to level the series but also to regain momentum and confidence after the initial setback. Ruturaj Gaikwad and Abhishek Sharma’s innings were instrumental in achieving this dominant win. Their composed and aggressive approach ensured that India posted a formidable total, which ultimately proved too much for Zimbabwe to handle.

title: IND vs ZIM: Shivam Dube replaces Nitish Reddy in India’s squad for Zimbabwe T20I series
content:
All-rounder Shivam Dube has been selected to replace the injured Nitish Reddy in the Indian T20I squad for the upcoming tour of Zimbabwe, as announced by the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) on Wednesday. The tour will feature five T20 Internationals, all scheduled to take place in Harare, beginning on July 6.

BCCI mentioned that medical team is monitoring Nitish’s progress

In a statement, the BCCI said, “The men’s selection committee named Shivam Dube as the replacement for the injured Nitish Reddy in India’s squad for the upcoming tour of Zimbabwe.” The BCCI also mentioned that its medical team is closely monitoring Nitish Reddy’s progress to ensure his recovery.

Reddy was crucial to Sunrisers Hyderabad during the 2024 Indian Premier League (IPL) season and was named the team’s Emerging Player. The 21-year-old demonstrated his batting ability by amassing 303 runs with a strike rate of 142.92 and an average of 33.67. His most memorable innings, which included eight sixes and three fours, came against the Rajasthan Royals. He scored a match-winning 76 runs off 42 balls in that innings. Reddy also took three wickets at medium speed with his bowling, including a noteworthy two-for-17 against the Delhi Capitals.

Along with Reddy, Riyan Parag and Abhishek Sharma received their maiden call-ups to the national squad for the white-ball tour of Zimbabwe as a reward for their outstanding performances in the previous IPL season. Under Shubman Gill’s leadership, the Indian team will embark on this tour, giving a number of emerging talent showcases on a global scale. 

Given that they are currently competing in the T20 World Cup in the Americas, it has been decided to rest key players including skipper Rohit Sharma, Virat Kohli, Hardik Pandya, Suryakumar Yadav, Ravindra Jadeja, and Jasprit Bumrah. The goal of this relaxation break is to get them ready for the gruelling cricket season that lies ahead. Younger players now have the opportunity to contribute to the team’s success and earn important experience because of their absence.

Shivam Dube’s presence gives the team more depth thanks to his versatility. Dube is a capable alternative for the injured Reddy because of his reputation for hard-hitting batting and practical medium pace, as well as his international experience.

The upcoming series in Zimbabwe offers a blend of experienced and young players, aiming to strike a balance between building for the future and achieving immediate success. With matches being held in Harare, it will be a test for the Indian team to adapt and perform in different conditions. This tour serves as a significant opportunity for emerging players to leave their mark on the international stage.

title: "I’ve always given my best for my country": Ravindra Jadeja Announces T20I Retirement
content:
Team India’s star all-rounder, Ravindra Jadeja, announced his retirement from T20I following India’s T20 World Cup victory. Jadeja’s announcement came after Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma also declared their retirement from the shortest format of the game. Jadeja took to his official Instagram account to confirm his retirement, expressing his gratitude and reflecting on his journey.

Jadeja’s Instagram post read, “With a heart full of gratitude, I bid farewell to T20 internationals. Like a steadfast horse galloping with pride, I’ve always given my best for my country and will continue to do so in other formats. Winning the T20 World Cup was a dream come true, a pinnacle of my T20 International career. Thank you for the memories, the cheers, and the unwavering support.”

Looking Back at Ravindra Jadeja Illustrious T20I Career

Throughout his career, Jadeja had been an integral part of the Indian T20I squad, playing a key all-round role in the 2024 edition. In the semi-final against England, he produced a crucial cameo. Jadeja smashed an unbeaten 17 off just 9 deliveries, which contributed significantly to India’s victory. While he took only one wicket in the tournament, Jadeja’s economy rate of 7.57 highlighted his effectiveness and control in the game.

Jadeja’s contributions are not limited to his recent performances. Over his T20I career, he represented India in 74 matches, scoring 515 runs in 41 innings with an impressive 17 not-out innings. His batting prowess was often showcased in the lower-middle order, where he played many crucial innings. With the ball, Jadeja maintained a strong economy rate. Post retirement, Jadeja ended his T20I career at an impressive 7.13 runs per over, and he claimed 54 wickets in the format. This is not it, Jadeja’s quickness and accuracy while fielding is hidden from none. While players have a specific batting down or bowling spell secured to their name, Jadeja had the point fielding area written to his.

Despite his retirement from T20Is, Jadeja will continue to play in Tests and ODIs. Given his all-round prowess, he still remains a key member of the Indian team. He missed the 2022 edition of the T20 World Cup due to injury, which saw India fall in the semi-finals with a 10-wicket defeat to England. His return to T20Is in December last year, after over a year’s absence, signified the team management’s intention to rely on his experience and skill for the 2024 T20 World Cup. Jadeja played in all of India’s matches in this edition, contributing significantly to the team’s success.

title: "My heart rate was up": MS Dhoni Reacts After Team India Clinch ICC T20 World Cup 2024
content:
In a rare and heartfelt social media post, T20 World Cup 2007 winning captain MS Dhoni celebrated India’s T20 World Cup 2024 triumph, expressing his deep gratitude to Rohit Sharma and the Indian team. India clinched their second T20 World Cup title by defeating South Africa by seven runs in a thrilling final at Kensington Oval, Barbados. This victory marked a significant milestone for Indian cricket, ending an 11-year drought for an ICC trophy.

MS Dhoni, who seldom posts on his social media handles, took to Instagram to share a photo of the victorious Indian team. In his post, he wrote, “WORLD CUP CHAMPIONS 2024. My heart rate was up, well done on being calm, having the self-belief, and doing what you guys did. From all the Indians back home and everywhere in the world, a big thank you for bringing the World Cup home. CONGRATULATIONS. Arreeee thanks for the priceless birthday gift.” The heartfelt message from Dhoni, who led India to their first T20 World Cup win in 2007 and the 2011 ODI World Cup.

Dhoni’s acknowledgment of the team’s efforts and his gratitude for what he called an early “priceless” birthday gift underscored the emotional significance of this victory for both the players and fans. The victory in Barbados was not just a win on the field but a moment of immense national pride and joy, a reminder of the days when Dhoni himself led the team to glory. It also highlighted the reason Dhoni is named Thala—a testament to his leadership and the deep respect he commands.

Rohit Sharma Leads Team India to T20 World Cup Victory After MS Dhoni in 2007

India’s journey to the final was a testament to their consistency and resilience. The team remained unbeaten throughout the tournament, a historic feat that highlighted their dominance in this edition of the T20 World Cup. Batting first in the final, India posted a formidable total of 176/7, thanks to a crucial innings from Virat Kohli, who scored 76 runs, and a quickfire 47 from Axar Patel. South Africa, in response, managed 169/8, with a stellar performance from Jasprit Bumrah, who took 2/18 and was named Player of the Tournament.

Dhoni’s praise for Rohit Sharma’s calm and self-belief reflected his admiration for the current captain’s leadership qualities, which played a crucial role in India’s success. The triumph in the 2024 T20 World Cup not only added another feather to India’s cap but also highlighted the seamless transition of leadership from Dhoni to Sharma.

This victory was particularly special as it bridged the gap between Dhoni’s era and the current team. Dhoni’s message, filled with pride and gratitude, resonated with fans worldwide, reminding everyone of the legacy he left behind and the bright future that lies ahead for Indian cricket.

Coming into the side, Stoinis has a lot of experience and has played in many T20 leagues across the globe, such as BBL and IPL, where he has been a champion performer. Hence, his presence in the middle order and his ability to bowl crucial overs in the power play make him a great asset to the Super Kings. With Stoinis in the team, the side will look like a more balanced and powerful team that will wage a stern challenge for the 2024 MLC championship.

Naveen-ul-Haq: The Afghan Star

Naveen-ul-Haq, the Afghan fast bowler who came into the limelight while playing for the Lucknow Super Giants (LSG) in the Indian Premier League (IPL), will strengthen the Texas Super Kings camp. Naveen is a fast bowler, and he will further enhance the strength of the Super Kings’ bowling department. He has been excellent in the death overs and bowling at any juncture of the match, which is evident from his performance in different T20 leagues around the world.

During his stint with LSG in the IPL, Naveen showed how he can always keep the opposition’s batsmen on their toes with his variations and good line. This is because he is capable of bowling Yorkers and slower balls, which is useful in power play-overs. Moreover, his exposure to international cricket for Afghanistan has helped him develop his game to suit different conditions.

The Texas Super Kings will be hoping that Naveen will add more strength to their bowling department and help the team in a big way. His ability to combine with other bowlers in the team will be crucial in the team’s attempts to contain the opposition and take crucial wickets. Naveen is now ready for the MLC season, and he will play a crucial role in getting the Super Kings closer to their title aspirations.

Aaron Hardie: WACA Superstar

Aaron Hardie, an All-rounder from the Western Australia Cricket Association (WACA), is all set to join the Texas Super Kings and play for the Major League Cricket (2024). A powerful striker of the ball and a useful seam bowler, Hardie has been making his way up the Australian domestic cricket.

He has played for Melbourne Stars and Sydney Thunders in the Big Bash League(BBL), and his performance in pressure situations is commendable, which makes him a good T20 player. With Hardie, the Super Kings get a player who can not only chip in with the bat but can also roll his arm over when the team needs him to in the bowling department.

Hardie was roped in by the Perth Scorchers in the Big Bash League (BBL), and he played some crucial knocks in the important matches. His talent for playing fast and quick knocks in the lower order and taking wickets in the initial overs will help the Texas Super Kings a lot. The inclusion of him means that the team’s middle order is also boosted, and he is also a good bowling option. 

2023 Season Recap

The Texas Super Kings, in their first season, showed a lot of promise as they finished second in the league standings and qualified for the semi-finals. Although the Super Kings got off to a good start, notably beating the Los Angeles Knight Riders and MI New York, the team was later knocked out in the playoffs. Faf du Plessis, Devon Conway, and Dwayne Bravo played some brilliant innings and put the team’s showing down as a force to be reckoned with. With those lessons learned and experiences acquired, the Texas Super Kings are set to return in the 2024 season.

title: CSK Owner: Who Owns Chennai Super Kings?
content:
Chennai Super Kings is owned and operated by Chennai Super Kings Cricket Limited (CSKCL). N. Srinivasan is the company’s chairman, not the personal owner of the IPL franchise. India Cements originally acquired CSK in 2008 before the franchise rights moved to CSKCL in February 2015.

CSK Owner: Quick Facts

The latest official 2025-26 annual report available identifies N. Srinivasan as Chairman and K. S. Viswanathan as Managing Director and CEO. It also records EWS Finance & Investments Private Limited as the largest disclosed shareholder, with a 47.08% stake, while the total promoter-group holding stood at 47.22% as of March 31, 2026.

Source: Chennai Super Kings Cricket Limited Annual Report for FY 2025-26

Which Company Owns Chennai Super Kings?

Chennai Super Kings Cricket Limited is the legal owner and operator of the Chennai Super Kings IPL franchise. Commonly referred to as CSKCL, it is a separate company established to hold and manage the franchise.

The company structure means the franchise is not personally owned by one individual. CSKCL has its own shareholders, including members of the promoter group, who hold shares in the company. The company itself remains the entity that owns and operates the IPL franchise.

N. Srinivasan serves as the chairman of CSKCL. His position as chairman, however, is different from ownership of the company. A chairman leads the company’s board, while ownership is determined through the company’s shareholding structure.

So, who owns Chennai Super Kings? The legal answer is Chennai Super Kings Cricket Limited. Individuals associated with the company may hold shares or management positions, but the franchise itself is held and operated through CSKCL. This is why the owner of Chennai Super Kings should be identified as the company rather than attributed to a single person.

Is N. Srinivasan the Owner of CSK?

No, N. Srinivasan is not the legal owner of CSK personally. He is the chairman of Chennai Super Kings Cricket Limited (CSKCL) and is part of the company’s promoter group. The franchise is owned and operated by CSKCL, so his position within the company should not be confused with personal ownership of the team.

N. Srinivasan has been the central individual associated with Chennai Super Kings since the franchise was acquired in 2008. His long-standing involvement with the team has led to him being widely described as the “CSK owner” in public discussions. However, that is a common shorthand rather than a description of the franchise’s legal ownership.

CSKCL has multiple shareholders, including entities and individuals within its promoter group. This means the ownership of the company is broader than Srinivasan alone.

Srinivasan has also held prominent positions in cricket administration. He previously served as president of the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) and chairman of the International Cricket Council (ICC). These roles add to his association with Indian cricket, but they do not change the ownership structure of CSK.

Narayanaswami Srinivasan is his full name, and he remains one of the most prominent figures associated with the franchise.

CSK Ownership Structure and Major Shareholders

The CSK ownership structure includes a promoter group and other shareholders, rather than one individual holding the entire company. As of March 2026, the promoter group collectively held 47.22% of Chennai Super Kings Cricket Limited (CSKCL). EWS Finance & Investments Private Limited was the largest disclosed promoter shareholder, with a 47.08% stake.

The figures also show why the term CSK shareholders needs to be viewed at both the individual and group level. EWS Finance holds the largest disclosed stake, while the combined promoter group accounts for 47.22%. The remaining 52.78% belongs to other shareholders. As a result, the owners of Chennai Super Kings are represented through CSKCL’s wider shareholding structure. A person described as a CSK co-owner may have a stake in the company, but that should not be confused with personally owning the entire franchise. 

Shareholding figures are based on the latest available Chennai Super Kings Cricket Limited annual report.

Who Was the First Owner of CSK?

India Cements was the first owner of CSK, acquiring the Chennai franchise in the inaugural IPL franchise auction in 2008. The company won the franchise rights for US$91 million, which was reported at around ₹346 crore at the time.

N. Srinivasan, then Vice Chairman and Managing Director of India Cements, was the senior figure most closely associated with the franchise. His involvement is one reason the team’s early ownership was often linked directly to his name, although India Cements was the original corporate owner.

This distinction is important when looking back at the old owner of CSK. The franchise was not originally purchased by Srinivasan as an individual. India Cements acquired the rights and initially operated Chennai Super Kings as part of its business.

The ownership structure later changed, with the franchise transferred to Chennai Super Kings Cricket Limited. Therefore, India Cements belongs to the history of CSK’s original ownership, while CSKCL is the current legal owner and operator. The team was created as an IPL franchise in 2008, so referring to India Cements as the original CSK owner is more accurate than describing an individual as its founder.

Why Did CSK Ownership Move from India Cements to CSKCL?

The shift in CSK ownership history was largely a corporate restructuring shaped by governance concerns and the need to separate the franchise from India Cements.

  1. Separate cricket business: India Cements created Chennai Super Kings Cricket Limited (CSKCL) as a dedicated company and transferred the franchise rights to it during 2015.
  2. Governance concerns: The restructuring came amid questions over N. Srinivasan’s commercial connection to CSK while he held senior positions in the BCCI. Separating the franchise into its own company helped address this conflict.
  3. Post-2013 scrutiny: The controversy surrounding Gurunath Meiyappan and the wider IPL betting investigation brought additional attention to the relationship between CSK, India Cements and cricket administration.
  4. Greater independence: Housing the franchise separately allowed CSK to function as a standalone cricket business and develop its commercial interests independently.
  5. Transfer value: The franchise rights were transferred to CSKCL at a reported book value of approximately ₹7.83 crore, with the BCCI approving the restructuring.

This made CSKCL the legal home of the franchise while maintaining continuity with its previous ownership structure.

Does India Cements Still Own CSK?

No. India Cements does not currently own Chennai Super Kings. India Cements was the franchise’s original corporate owner, but the rights were transferred to Chennai Super Kings Cricket Limited (CSKCL) on 20 February 2015. CSKCL now owns and operates the Chennai IPL franchise.

India Cements remains part of the franchise’s ownership history, but it should not be identified as the current owner of CSK. The legal owner and operator today is CSKCL, which is a separate company.

The relationship between the two companies also changed formally over time. The FY2025 annual report records that India Cements ceased to be a related party of CSKCL on 25 December 2024. 

Therefore, when referring to the CSK owner company, Chennai Super Kings Cricket Limited is the correct name, not India Cements.

CSK Owner, Chairman and CEO: What Is the Difference?

The CSK team ownership structure becomes easier to understand when the company’s ownership and management roles are separated. Chennai Super Kings Cricket Limited owns and operates the franchise, while different individuals are responsible for the company’s leadership and day-to-day management. The latest annual report identifies N. Srinivasan as Chairman, K. S. Viswanathan as Managing Director and CEO, and Rupa Gurunath as a Wholetime Director.

In simple terms, the CSK chairman leads the board, while the Managing Director and CEO is responsible for managing the company and its operations. Therefore, the CSK CEO name and the chairman’s name refer to two different roles. Keeping these positions separate also makes the franchise’s ownership structure much easier to understand.
excerpt: Who is the CSK owner? Chennai Super Kings is owned by Chennai Super Kings Cricket Limited. Learn N. Srinivasan’s role and CSK’s ownership history.

title: CSK Auction Strategy: 5 players Chennai Can target in 2025 mega auction
content:
The 2024 IPL season brought a mix of anticipation and resilience for Chennai Super Kings (CSK). With Ruturaj Gaikwad leading as captain, fans saw promising leadership amid several challenges. This heightened the need for a foolproof CSK auction strategy for 2025, especially with MS Dhoni’s potential retirement on the horizon.

In this article, we delve into CSK’s approach to the IPL 2025 auction and explore five key CSK target players for 2025 who could be game-changers for the Yellow Army. With auction season upon us, let’s look at the CSK target players 2025 list and possible new faces that could bring glory back to Chennai.

CSK’s Strategic Blueprint for IPL 2025 Auction

With Gaikwad as captain, CSK’s target players for 2025 will align with their established strategy of building a balanced team. Key targets in the CSK target players 2025 auction are expected to cover these roles:

A dynamic all-rounder

A versatile No. 3 bowling option

An overseas top-order batter

An experienced overseas pacer

A middle-order stabilizer

This framework, rooted in CSK’s success over the years, ensures that the CSK target players for the 2025 auction will bring the perfect mix of experience and talent. As CSK gears up for this new era of leadership under Gaikwad, fans eagerly await the CSK target players for 2025 who could make a significant impact.

Projected Top 3: It is anticipated that CSK’s top three in the 2025 season will feature Devon Conway and Ruturaj Gaikwad as openers, with Rachin Ravindra following at No. 3.

Key Departures: The Shifting CSK 2025 Players List

As CSK approaches the IPL 2025 auction, the CSK target players 2025 list may also come with a few significant departures. For instance, Ajinkya Rahane may be considered for release as CSK looks to inject fresh energy into the squad. Similarly, either Daryl Mitchell or Moeen Ali could be released, creating space for high-profile acquisitions.

One of Daryl Mitchell or Moeen Ali will exit from CSK, a decision that mirrors their past approach to making room for high-profile acquisitions in IPL history.

Therefore, the most important task is the order of the batting. An opener, middle-order batsman, and an aggressive allrounder in the batting department. In terms of bowling we shall mostly retain most of our core in the auction by re-purchasing our young fast bowlers and with Jadeja being one spinner we will not buy another.

With that being said, let’s take a look at the five players CSK can target in the mega auction of 2024.

Top 5 CSK Target Players for 2025 Auction

1) Glenn Phillips

Glenn Phillips, as the name goes, does more than just score runs. Many times, his outstanding fielding abilities have changed matches in the team’s favour. Known for his energy and finesse on the ground, Phillips is a live wire in the field, who is capable of getting crucial run-outs as well as taking spectacular catches. He is one player who is most likely to be a part of the CSK Auction Player list.

Besides what he does with the bat, his fielding excellence gives him an extra level as a player. He is biding the time on the bench in the Sunrisers Hyderabad (SRH) squad and is perhaps not going to be considered in the next season. Although it is clear that he is a talented player and can turn matches, he has been unable to get a regular spot in the XI.

In addition, Phillips’s legacy in New Zealand cricket has been huge. His repeated good showing in domestic cricket and remarkable stints in international cricket have made him a promising talent. Phillips’ performance under pressure and his ability to change the course of the match in the dying moments have earned him admiration and respect. As a result, he is now sought after as an asset for teams, including CSK, where he stands out as one of the valuable CSK NZ players.

2) Nitish Rana

It is improbable that Nitish Rana, an excellent middle-order batter, will be retained by the Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR) in the upcoming mega auction. The future of Rana at KKR becomes doubtful with the emergence of new talents and arrangements in the roster.

Yet, his vast experience and long list of achievements make him a tempting target for other franchises, and land him a place in the CSK auction players list. Rana as an anchor in the innings and the ability to change the gears when necessary is a win-win situation for any team.

His potential to team up with youngsters like Rizvi and Rachin promises a balanced and powerful CSK middle order. Rana, being a veteran campaigner in the IPL, provides steadiness and leadership to the middle order, a very important quality for CSK to have in the upcoming season, which is why he is a good asset for them in the IPL in the second season.

3) Dhruv Jurel 

The CSK Auction agenda certain revolves around getting a good wicket keeper. Dhruv Jurel, the wicketkeeper-batsman who hails from India, sizzles as one of the viable selections for the playing XI of CSK in terms of steadiness and finishing power. Though his retention is still in the air, the inclusion of him in the mega auction could prove to be an expensive affair.

Nevertheless, the mega auction form, focused on building a team until the next cycle, takes care of instant financial consequences. Jurel’s feature of comfortably blending into the playing XI and delivering as an assuring finisher makes him a very viable option for CSK.

In addition, the potential of MS Dhoni’s departure creates a vacuum – Jurel’s presence can help in bridging the gap. His experience and maturity in critical moments enable him to deal with crucial situations, which makes him a valuable asset in the CSK squad. Jurel becomes an alternative for ensuring the team’s equilibrium and competitiveness in future seasons.

4) Liam Livingston

The possibility of Liam Livingstone being up for grabs in the mega auction can be a mouthwatering prospect for CSK. His status with Punjab Kings (PBKS) remains ambiguous but is a good fit for CSK’s needs. Livingstone being a power-hitting batsman able to hit sixes at his will gives CSK the much-required firepower in the batting order. Additionally, he is a good spin bowler, which provides diversity in its arsenal and adds another dimension to the bowlers on the team, making him the most likely candidate to land on the CSK auction players list.

In case Moeen Ali is released, Livingstone can readily fill up the open spot doing justice to the team’s dynamics with his all-round skills. His flexibility to play in any position and deliver important overs of spin bowling are attributes that could be precious for CSK’s campaign for IPL 2025. Having two-way dominance in the game, Livingstone is surely one of the deserving players to be included in CSK’s retention name.

5) Mitchel Marsh

In 2025, Mitchell Marsh becomes a very attractive option for CSK’s roster as he has a valuable amount of experience and leadership qualities. The current T20 captain of Australia, Marsh’s credentials are indicative of the quality cricketer that he is. His possible presence adds an interesting twist to CSK’s combination and is the return of an Australian talent to the franchise following the likes of Josh Hazelwood and Shane Watson.

The ease with which Marsh can be fitted into the XI, probably at a number three position that matters the most, strengthens the CSK batting lineup greatly. Additionally, his overall abilities, followed by quality medium-pace bowling and swing upfront, bring extra flexibility and breadth to the team’s set-up.

Marsh comes across as a player with the required temperament and set of skills to deliver under pressure and thrive in big-match scenarios and with a record of such performances, this makes him a significant player for CSK in IPL 2025.

While IPL 2025 is lurking in the shadows with just 8-9 months left before the game starts, doubt and enthusiasm are in the air. Even though discussions and assumptions about possible player acquisitions and team tactics are numerous, one should keep in mind that the cricket environment changes all the time. Every prediction made concerning IPL CSK player retention, auctions, and team composition dynamics remains highly speculative until the event is upon us, no matter what these actual factors may be.

With the expectations of IPL 2025 at the doorstep, there is a need to enjoy the present while the cricketing action is alive. Though we wait with bated breath for the mega auction and the ensuing excitement of IPL cricket, let’s also throw our support behind our national team as they prepare for the ICC T20 World Cup. While the high of T20 cricket is on, we come together to cheer for India and celebrate the game and not wait for the IPL extravaganza to mesmerize us again.

title: Daryl Mitchell Set to Miss MLC 2024 for Texas Super Kings
content:
Daryl Mitchell will miss the 2nd season of Major League Cricket (MLC) due to an undisclosed injury. The news has been confirmed through an official statement released by Texas Super Kings’ social media handles.

After making a decent debut for Chennai Super Kings in the IPL 2024, Mitchell was set to join hands with his international teammates Mitchell Santner and Devon Conway in the USA to play for CSK’s sister franchise TSK. However, the development comes in a big blow for TSK management and fans alike.

Daryl Mitchell was one of the most prominent signings for the men in yellow hoping to clinch the MLC title after falling short in the maiden season. After the signing, the star batter had come forward to talk about what the move meant to him and how excited he was to represent Texas Super Kings in the MLC.

“I’m really excited to be part of the Texas Super Kings and to get to yellove again and be part of the CSK family, I think the cool thing about the MLC following the World Cup being in the West Indies and the America [is] the conditions should be pretty similar and hopefully we continue to adapt to the different conditions and get stuck in,” Mitchell was quoted. 

Noor Ahmad Replaces Daryl Mitchell, Set to Join TSK Ahead of MLC Season 2

19-year-old Noor Ahmad comes in as Daryl Mitchell’s replacement for the season. Initially falling short of a bowler, TSK took the opportunity to include an impactful leggie in their squad.

Afghanistan bowler Noor Ahmad despite being so young comes in with some years of experience in franchise cricket, having debuted in 2020 with the St Lucia Zouks in the Caribbean Premier League. Moreover, he joined the Chennai Super Kings as a net bowler for the 2021 Indian Premier League. In February 2022, he was bought by the Gujarat Titans for the 2022 Indian Premier League.

Earlier, TSK signed star all-rounder Marcus Stoinis and Aiden Markrum for the upcoming season. Both Stoinis and Markrum boost the squad with prowess in their respective departments. Stoinis had an extraordinary IPL 2024 season with the bat having scored a century in the match against Chennai Super Kings. On the other hand, Markrum playing for SRH stood for his team whenever needed taking SRH to the final of IPL 2024.

Texas Super Kings will start their MLC 2024 campaign against Los Angeles Knight Riders in the 2nd match of the season at Grand Prairie Stadium, Texas on 6th July. Faf du Plessis-led TSK will aim to clinch their maiden MLC title coming in with a formidable squad and highly experienced team management with Stephen Fleming as the head coach and Albie Morkel as the assistant coach.

title: Dhoni Fans go Crazy after Cristiano Rolando Post UEFA Euro from FIFA World Cup 'Thala' touch
content:
With the UEFA Euro 2024 coming up in just a few days, the world awaits to see Cristiano Ronaldo as he leads Portugal, the 2016 UEFA Euro winners, in their first game against the Czech Republic on Wednesday. Ronaldo who is himself one of the most famous athletes and has led Portugal to its first European title in 2016, received a special shoutout from FIFA that has captivated MS Dhoni fans in India. On the eve of Portugal’s Euro opener, the official FIFA World Cup Instagram handle shared a post featuring Ronaldo.

In a surprising twist, the FIFA World Cup Instagram account linked Ronaldo’s post to Dhoni, indirectly referencing the cricket legend. Captioning the post with “Thala for a reason,” the handle drew parallels between Ronaldo and Dhoni. The term “Thala,” which means “leader” in Tamil, is a nickname for Dhoni, the iconic figure of the Chennai Super Kings (CSK) franchise. Dhoni, who wore the No.7 jersey for CSK in the Indian Premier League (IPL) 2024, also sported the same number during his illustrious international career from 2004 to 2019.

This clever crossover has fueled the viral “Thala for a reason” trend, which is synonymous with Dhoni and, consequently, drew eyes towards the upcoming FIFA World Cup 2024. The former CSK skipper’s connection to the number 7 is well-documented, with his fans often flooding social media with tributes. Earlier, Google joined this trend, honoring Dhoni in a heartwarming post, and multiple brands have shared their takes on the trend during the IPL season. Despite retiring from international cricket in 2020, Dhoni remains active in the IPL, where his presence continues to inspire.

Fans React to FIFA World Cup’s Post for Cristiano Ronaldo with “Thala” Touch

The FIFA post featuring Ronaldo with a “Thala” touch quickly went viral, delighting Dhoni’s army of loyal fans. Social media buzzed with excitement as fans celebrated the unexpected homage to their national hero.

In IPL 2024, Dhoni was the center of speculation regarding his career’s end. Ahead of the IPL 2024 opener between CSK and Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB), Dhoni stepped down as the captain of CSK, handing over the reins to Indian opener Ruturaj Gaikwad. Despite Dhoni’s leadership, CSK couldn’t secure a playoff spot, finishing fifth in the 10-team tournament with seven wins from 14 matches.

As Dhoni’s fans enjoy the FIFA World Cup’s tribute, it became clear that the cricket legend’s influence extends far beyond the cricket field. The “Thala for a reason” trend continues to unite fans across sports, celebrating the legacy of MS “Thala” Dhoni.

title: David Wiese retires from international cricket After Namibia's T20 World Cup Campaign
content:
Namibia all-rounder David Wiese has officially retired from international cricket following his team’s final T20 World Cup group stage match against England on Sunday. Namibia’s campaign ended with their third group stage loss, this time to the defending champions, England. Their only win in the tournament came against Oman.

In a rain-curtailed match, Wiese, batting up the order at number three, showcased his aggressive batting style by hitting two sixes and a four in successive balls off Adil Rashid, scoring 27 runs off 12 balls. However, his valiant effort was cut short when Jofra Archer dismissed him in the final over of Namibia’s chase. As Wiese walked off the field, he raised his helmet and bat to the applauding crowd, a gesture that marked the end of his illustrious international career. He was warmly greeted by his teammates, including captain Gerhard Erasmus, at the dugout.

During the post-match press conference, Wiese reflected on his decision to retire. “The next T20 World Cup is still two years away, and I’m 39 years old now. In terms of international cricket, I don’t know if there’s much left in me,” he said. “I still want to play the game for a couple more years because I feel like I’ve got a lot to contribute. But ending my international career with Namibia at a World Cup against a world-class team like England just seemed like the right time.”

Wiese’s journey in international cricket is notable for his significant contributions to both South Africa and Namibia. Originally from South Africa, Wiese made his T20I debut for the Proteas in 2013 and his ODI debut in 2015.

He represented South Africa in the 2016 T20 World Cup before switching allegiance to Namibia, where he played a pivotal role in their qualification for the Super 12s in the 2021 T20 World Cup. Over three consecutive T20 World Cups, Wiese became an integral part of the Namibian squad, known for his powerful batting and effective bowling.

A Fairy tale comes to an end: Joburg Super Kings bids farewell to David Wiese

Chennai Super Kings’ sister franchise Joburg Super Kings bids farewell to all-rounder David Wiese as the 39-year-old retires from international cricket. Hailing originally from South Africa, Wiese is a member of the Joburg Super Kings family since the previous season of SA20 League. Playing 4 matches for the franchise, the all-rounder scored 85 runs, however, went wicketless in the season.

Namibia captain Gerhard Erasmus confirmed that the game against England was Wiese’s last for the national team. “Unfortunately, it was his last game, but what a great moment for him to perform like that,” Erasmus said in the post-match interview. “David has had a massive impact on our team. He’s not only a great performer on the field but also someone from whom we’ve learned a lot off the field. He’s inspired us to reach new heights.”

Erasmus further praised Wiese’s contributions to Namibian cricket, highlighting his leadership and experience as vital to the team’s development. “He’s a great guy, and his influence has been tremendous. We’re grateful for everything he’s done for us, and his legacy will continue to inspire future generations of Namibian cricketers.”

title: Ziva Dhoni Shares Heartwarming Father's Day Video For MS Dhoni
content:
MS Dhoni’s daughter, Ziva, delighted fans with a touching Father’s Day video on Instagram on Sunday, June 16. In the adorable clip the former Indian cricket captain is seen in a relaxed and joyful mood, spending quality time with his daughter and their dogs. Ziva, the only daughter of MS Dhoni and his wife Sakshi, captioned the video with a simple yet heartfelt “Familia ❤️🧿.”

Born in February 2015, Ziva often shares glimpses of her family life, which offers fans a rare look into the personal life of the cricket legend. Given Dhoni’s absence from social media, these posts by Ziva are eagerly anticipated by his admirers, providing them with updates and insights into his off-field life. Will MS Dhoni play in IPL 2025?

At 42 years old and having battled injuries, Dhoni’s continued presence in the IPL remains uncertain. His contributions to CSK and Indian cricket are unparalleled, and his potential retirement would mark the end of an era.

title: Shardul Thakur Undergoes Successful Foot Surgery, Set to Miss 3 Months of Cricket
content:
India all-rounder Shardul Thakur underwent a successful foot surgery on Wednesday in London. Consequently, Thakur is expected to be out of competitive cricket for at least three months. The 32-year-old cricketer shared a post-surgery photo on his Instagram page with the caption: “Operated successfully.”

This is Thakur’s second foot surgery, the first being five years ago in 2019. The injury resurfaced during the South Africa tour earlier this year. Despite this setback, Thakur made a commendable return in the Ranji Trophy last season, playing a crucial role in Mumbai’s 42nd title win. To ensure proper recovery and preparation time, Thakur had requested the BCCI for longer breaks between matches.

In the Indian Premier League (IPL) this season, Thakur represented Chennai Super Kings, taking five wickets in nine matches with an economy rate of 9.75. As a Grade C annual contract holder of the BCCI, the board covered the expenses for his treatment.

Regarding his comeback, while there is no official statement, sources suggest that Thakur will need around three months to return to training. This timeline indicates that he could be back in action before or just in time for the upcoming domestic season.

T20 World Cup 2024: Shardul Thakur CSK Partner Shivam Dube Plays a Significant Innings against USA

Shivam Dube and Surya Kumar Yadav’s sensible innings help India secure their third win in the ongoing T20 World Cup 2024 against co-host USA. Chasing a meager target of 111 India lost early wickets of Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli, while Rishabh Pant chipped in a bit, Dube and Yadav stood up for the team and secured the team.

Dube finished with 31 off 35 balls, though the scorecard doesn’t reflect his struggle against USA’s cutters. Initially scoring just 5 off 14 balls, he broke the pressure with a crucial six off Corey Anderson in the 15th over, reducing India’s requirement to 44 from 35 balls. Known for his spin-hitting prowess in the IPL with Chennai Super Kings, which earned him a World Cup spot, Dube is also expected to contribute with the ball. On Wednesday, however, his single over went for 11 runs.

title: Texas Super Kings
content:
Founded in 2023, Texas Super Kings is a professional cricket franchise that competes in Major League Cricket in the United States. The Dallas-based team is co-owned by Anurag Jain and Ross Perot Jr. in partnership with Chennai Super Kings, one of the most successful franchises in the Indian Premier League.

Led by Faf du Plessis and coached by Stephen Fleming, Texas Super Kings has quickly emerged as one of MLC’s most competitive teams. Although the franchise is yet to win its first Major League Cricket title, it has reached the playoffs in both the 2023 and 2024 seasons, establishing itself as a serious contender in American cricket.

Texas Super Kings Owner, Players, and Trophies

Texas Super Kings Owner

Texas Super Kings is co-owned by Anurag Jain and Ross Perot Jr. in partnership with Chennai Super Kings. The franchise combines American business investment with the cricketing experience and global brand value of Chennai Super Kings, one of the Indian Premier League’s most successful teams.

How Anurag Jain Helped Bring Cricket to Major League Cricket

Long before Texas Super Kings entered Major League Cricket, Anurag Jain believed franchise cricket could succeed in the United States. After watching the rapid rise of the Indian Premier League in its early years, Jain saw an opportunity to build a professional cricket ecosystem for fans living outside traditional cricket-playing nations.

Based in the United States and deeply connected to the sport, Jain became one of the early investors pushing for cricket’s expansion in America. His involvement later helped bring Texas Super Kings into Major League Cricket as one of the league’s founding franchises.

The partnership with Chennai Super Kings gave the project immediate cricketing credibility. It also connected the new franchise with one of the strongest brands in global T20 cricket, helping Texas Super Kings attract experienced players, coaches, and international attention ahead of MLC’s launch.

How was Texas Super Kings Team formed?

The foundation of Texas Super Kings as a team was laid in 2020, when American Cricket Enterprises secured a long-term lease for a former baseball stadium in Grand Prairie, Texas. The venue was later redeveloped into a dedicated cricket facility ahead of Major League Cricket’s launch.

As Major League Cricket expanded its plans for a professional T20 League in the US, TSK emerged as one of the first franchises, because it already had the right infrastructure. Later, in 2022, co-owners Anurag Jain and Ross Perot Jr. partnered with Chennai Super Kings, bringing IPL experience and global cricket expertise to the new franchise ahead of the inaugural 2023 season.

Texas Super Kings’ Homeground: Grand Prairie Stadium

Grand Prairie Stadium serves as the home ground of Texas Super Kings in Major League Cricket. Located in Grand Prairie, Texas, the stadium was originally a Minor League Baseball venue before undergoing major upgrades for professional cricket.

The ground currently has a seating capacity of around 7,200, with expansion plans for larger events. Since the launch of MLC, the venue has become one of the central hubs for cricket in the United States, regularly attracting strong crowds and helping grow the sport’s popularity among both local fans and overseas cricket communities.

Texas Super Kings Trophies in Major League Cricket

Texas Super Kings is yet to win a trophy in Major League Cricket. They have participated in two editions of the tournament in 2023 and 2024 respectively and on both occasions they were knocked out in the Challenger stage.

Texas Super Kings in Major League Cricket 2023

Texas Super Kings enjoyed a strong debut season in Major League Cricket in 2023, finishing second in the league stage and qualifying for the playoffs. However, their campaign suffered a setback after a heavy defeat against Seattle Orcas in the Qualifier. The loss pushed Texas into the Challenger match, where they faced MI New York in one of the tournament’s emerging rivalries.

Texas Super Kings lost once again, while MI New York went on to win the inaugural MLC title. Devon Conway starred with the bat for TSK, scoring 221 runs in seven innings, while Dwayne Bravo contributed valuable performances as an all-rounder throughout the season.

Texas Super Kings in Major League Cricket 2024

The 2024 Major League Cricket season followed a familiar pattern for Texas Super Kings, as the team once again reached the playoffs but failed to progress beyond the Challenger stage. Seattle Orcas eliminated Texas for the second consecutive season, extending the franchise’s wait for its first MLC title.

Despite the disappointing finish, captain Faf du Plessis delivered one of the standout batting performances of the tournament. The former South African opener scored 420 runs in just eight innings at an average of 52, finishing as the tournament’s leading run scorer.

Marcus Stoinis also impressed with the ball, including a match-winning spell against MI New York during a dominant nine-wicket victory.

Texas Super Kings in Major League Cricket 2025

The 2025 season proved to be the most heartbreaking campaign yet for Texas Super Kings in Major League Cricket. Texas dominated the league stage, winning seven of their 10 matches and finishing with 14 points. However, their momentum came to a frustrating halt when the Qualifier against Washington Freedom was washed out due to rain.

Because Washington finished higher on the points table, they advanced directly to the final, while Texas Super Kings dropped into the Challenger match. TSK then suffered a narrow defeat against MI New York, ending another strong season without a title. Faf du Plessis starred again with 468 runs in 11 matches, while Noor Ahmad impressed with 15 wickets at an economy rate of 8.

Current Texas Super Kings Squad 

The Texas Super Kings squad boasts a blend of international experience and emerging talent. Notably, players in MLC are attained in different ways: by directly signing international players, drafting local players, and at least one USA Under-23 player in each squad. This composition ensures that domestic players get as much opportunity as possible, eventually helping cricket grow in the USA.

title: Ajinkya Rahane Joins Leicestershire for County Season Amid India Hopes
content:
In a significant development, Indian cricketer Ajinkya Rahane has signed with Leicestershire for the ongoing County Championship season. The 35-year-old, who will turn 36 in four days, had previously inked a contract with Leicestershire for the previous season. However, his participation was hindered by his commitments to the Indian national team, including the World Test Championship 2023 final against Australia and a subsequent two-match Test series against the West Indies. These engagements led Rahane to withdraw from his county stint, citing the need for a break from the demanding cricket schedule.

Rahane’s upcoming stint with Leicestershire marks his second appearance in England’s premier red-ball competition, having previously represented Hampshire in 2019. During that season, he scored 307 runs in 13 innings, showcasing his ability to adapt to English conditions.

Times of India reports suggest Ajinkya Rahane signing for the County Championship 2024

The news of Rahane’s signing was reported by The Times of India, although no further details about the contract were disclosed. This move comes after a challenging Ranji Trophy campaign for Rahane, where he led Mumbai to the title after an eight-year drought but struggled personally, accumulating only 214 runs in eight matches at an average of 17.83. Despite this, Rahane’s vast experience and prior successes, including his leadership in India’s historic 2-1 Test series victory against Australia in 2020-21, make him a valuable addition to Leicestershire.

Ajinkya Rahane’s First Class career, which began in 2007, boasts an impressive tally of 13,225 runs in 318 innings. His presence in the County Championship Division Two campaign for 2024 is expected to bolster Leicestershire’s batting lineup and provide a wealth of experience to the team.

In addition to Rahane, several other Indian cricketers are currently playing in the county circuit. Cheteshwar Pujara is showcasing his skills for Sussex, while Prithvi Shaw, Karun Nair, and Siddharth Kaul are plying for Northamptonshire. Rahane’s participation in the county season aligns him with a growing trend of Indian players seeking to refine their skills in English conditions.

After fulfilling their commitments with their respective counties, Rahane and Shaw will join Mumbai’s pre-season camp, preparing for the domestic season ahead. This period in county cricket will be crucial for Rahane as he looks to regain form and make a compelling case for his continued inclusion in the Indian national team.

title: Kedar Jadhav Announces Retirement from All Forms of Cricket
content:
Kedar Jadhav has officially announced his retirement from all forms of cricket, sharing the news through his social media accounts. Jadhav made his debut for India in June 2014 against Bangladesh in an ODI series. Over his career, he played 73 ODIs for India, scoring 1389 runs at an average of 42.09. His ODI career highlights include six half-centuries and two centuries. Jadhav’s last international appearance for India was on February 8, 2020.

Jadhav’s T20I career was brief, featuring in just nine matches. In six T20I innings, he amassed 122 runs at an average of 20.33, with his highest score being 58. Despite his limited opportunities in T20Is, he was recognized for his valuable contributions. Be it as a middle-order batsman and a handy bowler he made his mark. In ODIs, Jadhav also contributed with the ball, picking up 27 wickets.

From 1500 hrs, consider me retired from all forms of cricket: Jadhav writes

As newer hard-hitting talents like Suryakumar Yadav, Shivam Dube, and Axar Patel emerged, Jadhav found it increasingly challenging to secure a place in the Indian team. Reflecting on his journey, he expressed gratitude for the support he received throughout his career. “Thank you all for your love and support throughout my career. From 1500 hrs, consider me retired from all forms of cricket,” Jadhav wrote in his Instagram post.

Jadhav’s cricketing career had its share of notable moments and achievements. Known as a natural T20 player due to his impressive performances in domestic cricket, he was drafted into the Delhi Daredevils squad for the Indian Premier League (IPL) in 2008-09. He made an immediate impact, scoring a blistering 50 off just 29 balls, which caught the attention of the cricketing world. Later, in 2016, he was signed by Royal Challengers Bangalore, further solidifying his reputation as a dynamic T20 player. Other than that, he has represented Kochi Tuskers, RCB, Chennai Super Kings and Sunrisers Hyderabad in the IPL over the years.

One of Jadhav’s standout performances came during India’s tour of Zimbabwe in 2015, where he scored a magnificent century. He was again part of the squad for the Zimbabwe tour in 2016, although he did not get an opportunity to bat in the series. His significant involvement with the Indian team came during the five-match ODI series against New Zealand in 2016, where he was a crucial player. Additionally, Jadhav was included in India’s squad for the Champions Trophy in 2017, highlighting his importance in the team during that period.

CSK Posts a Thank You Post for Kedar Jadhav on his Retirement

Despite the ups and downs, Jadhav’s career is marked by his resilience and ability to perform under pressure. His contributions to Indian cricket, both as a batsman and a bowler, will be remembered by fans and teammates alike. As he steps away from professional cricket, Jadhav leaves behind a legacy of determination and skill, ready to embrace new challenges ahead.

title: Joburg Super Kings
content:
Joburg Super Kings (JSK) are a professional T20 cricket team based in Johannesburg, South Africa. Founded in 2022, they made their debut in the inaugural SA20 season in January 2023.

Owned by Chennai Super Kings Cricket Limited, JSK form part of the wider Super Kings franchise network. This guide covers the team’s latest squad, ownership, coaching staff, home ground and SA20 record.

What Is Joburg Super Kings?

Joburg Super Kings (JSK) were established in 2022 as one of the six original franchises in South Africa’s SA20 league. Representing Johannesburg, the team adopted “Joburg”, a shortened name for the city, alongside the Super Kings identity shared with Chennai Super Kings.

JSK made their debut in the inaugural tournament in January 2023, with Faf du Plessis as captain and Stephen Fleming as head coach. They finished second in the league stage before losing to Sunrisers Eastern Cape in the semifinal, ending their first campaign one victory short of the final.

Who Owns Joburg Super Kings?

Joburg Super Kings are owned by Chennai Super Kings Cricket Limited (CSKCL), the company that also owns Chennai Super Kings in the IPL. The company runs JSK through its South African subsidiary, Joburg Super Kings (Pty) Ltd. Both teams belong to the wider Super Kings franchise network.

JSK forms the South African arm of the Super Kings franchise network, alongside CSK in India and Texas Super Kings (TSK) in the USA. While all three carry the Super Kings identity, they operate through distinct franchise structures in their respective T20 leagues. 

Here is detailed information of who owns CSK, and a look at the ownership of JSK and how its parent organization also runs the Chennai Super Kings. 

JSK Captain and Coaching Staff

For the upcoming fifth season of the SA20, JSK’s captain has not yet been announced, even though the full squad has been assembled following the completion of the 2027 auction. Joburg Super Kings’ head coach is Albie Morkel, appointed ahead of the season after Stephen Fleming decided to part ways with the franchise.

JSK have also appointed Allan Donald as bowling coach and Pierre de Bruyn as fielding coach. Evan Speechly joins as physiotherapist, completing the franchise’s updated coaching and support setup.

Joburg Super Kings Squad and Players

For SA20 2027, the Joburg Super Kings squad has a balanced mix across the batting, wicketkeeping, all-round, and bowling departments. At the top of the order, Faf du Plessis and James Vince provide experienced batting options, while Kieron Pollard strengthens the lower-middle order with his power-hitting caliber. 

Donovan Ferreira and Matthew de Villiers provide wicket-keeping cover, while also providing support to the middle order. The all-round options include Dian Forrester, Jason Holder and Jamie Overton, while Duan Jansen and Blessing Muzarabani lead the pace attack. Akeal Hosein adds depth to the spin bowling unit. With many other players available across the Joburg Super Kings squad, the team appears balanced and strong for the upcoming season. 

Leus du Plooy and Rilee Rossouw add further batting options, while Andries Gous joins Donovan Ferreira and Matthew de Villiers among the wicketkeeper-batters. Dayyaan Galiem, Jason Rowles and Jarren Bacher expand the all-round options, while Janco Smit adds another bowling option and Prenelan Subrayen strengthens the spin department. These additions complete JSK’s 19-player squad for SA20 2027.

JSK Home Ground: The Wanderers Stadium

JSK’s home ground is the Wanderers Stadium, which is located in Illovo, Johannesburg, South Africa. Officially known as DP World Wanderers Stadium, it serves as the home venue for Joburg Super Kings during the SA20 tournament.

Known by the nickname “The Bullring,” the stadium has hosted major international matches, including the 2003 Cricket World Cup final. It has an approximate seating capacity of 34,000.

JSK’s Recent Record at the Wanderers

JSK won three of their five home fixtures in SA20 2025, beating MI Cape Town, Sunrisers Eastern Cape and Paarl Royals. They lost to Durban’s Super Giants, while their match against Pretoria Capitals ended without a result. myKhel

Joburg Super Kings’ SA20 Record by Season

Although Joburg Super Kings are yet to win the SA20 trophy, they have qualified for the playoffs in every season through 2026. In their latest campaign, JSK finished fourth in the league stage before ending their campaign in the Eliminator, losing to Paarl Royals. JSK’s SA20 record reflects its consistency and determination, with the team regularly keeping itself in contention. 

How Many Trophies Have JSK Won?

JSK did not win any SA20 trophies through the 2026 season, although it has reached the playoffs in every campaign. Their best finish came in the 2024 season, when it reached the Qualifier-2 by defeating Paarl Royals in the Eliminator, before losing to Durban Super Giants. Hence, the total number of Joburg Super Kings’ titles remains zero.

Joburg Super Kings’ schedule for the fifth SA20 season features fixtures from January to February 2027. JSK will kick-off its campaign against Paarl Royals, in the second game of the tournament.

What does JSK stand for?

JSK stands for Joburg Super Kings, a professional T20 cricket team based in Johannesburg, South Africa.

Yes. Johannesburg Super Kings refers to the same team, but the official franchise name is Joburg Super Kings. “Joburg” is a shortened name for Johannesburg.

Joburg Super Kings compete in SA20, South Africa’s T20 franchise cricket league. They made their debut in the inaugural season in January 2023.

JSK play their home matches at the Wanderers Stadium in Illovo, Johannesburg. The venue is popularly known as “The Bullring.”

title: Which players will CSK retain ahead of IPL 2025 Auction?
content:
In the nail-biting rollercoaster that was IPL 2024, Chennai’s Super Kings were all set to be on the brink of glory, only to miss out on a play-off spot by the skin of their teeth. Although they played valiantly, their tale was one of despair as RCB condemned them to defeat in direct competition. This dramatic turn of events has been a major highlight in CSK IPL news 2024.

With the dust settling and the excitement for IPL 2025 starting to build up, the Chennai franchise is at a unique crossroads. It will have to make some key decisions that may alter its destiny.

Among the strengths and weaknesses of the previous season, some areas became too obvious and showed some weaknesses of the CSK. With the host of injuries that kept out Mustafizur Rahman, Matheesha Pathirana, and Deepak Chahar, as well as some shortfalls such as the missing Conway and the departure of Moeen Ali, the Chennai team was under a lot of pressure.

As the clock starts ticking to the mega auction, attention shifts to the most important question of player retention. Having made the speculation in this critical reconstruction period, we analyse who should CSK retain ahead of the IPL 2025 auction to create a powerful revival next season.

Players CSK can retain ahead of IPL 2025 auction

CSK’s retention list will be an intimidating one. They have had some great individual performances all over the season. From Shardul Thakur, to Mahesh Theekshana, and even Daryl Mitchell, they have plethora per individual performance that changed several games in their favour. 

Still, they will have to make a tough choice to retain just four players ahead of IPL 2025. Hence, let’s take a look at the four players CSK can retain ahead of the mega auction of IPL.

Ruturaj Gaikwad- Captain 

Ruturaj Gaikwad, our skipper, shines as a paragon of resilience and quality in Chennai Super Kings’ difficult journey in IPL 2024. Including an awe-inspiring performance that landed him in second place in the prestigious Orange Cap race, Gaikwad has been extremely impressive with the willow. 

Hence, he must be the first player that CSK retains ahead of the mega auction 2024. In Gaikwad’s successful IPL career, having played 66 matches, he has written his name in the books of cricketing history by scoring an awesome 2380 runs at a lofty average of 42. His uniformity is highlighted by 18 half centuries and two sublime hundreds in his name.

However, the recently concluded season of IPL saw Gaikwad in much livelier form. He led CSK’s batting line-up with elegance and aplomb, scoring a mammoth total of 583 runs in just 14 matches, including four half-centuries and a sizzling century, which made his play crucial. 

With a strike rate of an impressive 141, he played the role of an anchor of the innings, along with offering the necessary force to the CSK’s chase for the title. His leadership and batting potency make him an irreplaceable asset, justifying his retention before the mega auction.

Ravindra Jadeja

Ravindra Jadeja is the pulse of Chennai Super Kings; he represents the spirit of both consistency and versatility in cricket. His multifaceted brilliance transcends the ordinary through his consistent selection in the CSK line-up, making him a no-brainer addition to the squad. In IPL 2024, his contribution went beyond the conventional metrics that make him a true match-winner.

Even though Jadeja’s supreme batting prowess came to the fore, his utility with the ball and on the field was unmatched. Having won two Man of the Match awards, Jadeja also showed his mettle with the bat, scoring 267 in 14 matches at a decent strike rate of 142. In addition, his qualities with the bat, capturing 8 vital wickets at an economy rate of less than 8, highlighted his all-around game impact.

The lynchpin of CSK’s campaign, Jadeja’s aura, reinforces unity and strong will on the side, which would be an asset to be retained in the mega auction.

Shivam Dube

The passage of Shivam Dube in IPL 2024 symbolises the peaks and troughs with which professional cricket is associated. The drop in form in the latter part of the season, however, does not diminish the Chennai Super Kings’ credo of developing talent and thus puts Dube in the running to be retained for the mega auction.

In the early stages of IPL 2024, Dube was a revelation as a dynamic batsman, scoring 396 runs in 14 matches at a staggering strike rate of 162.3. His capacity to speed up the innings and settle the middle order significantly influenced CSK’s triumph. Additionally, his run-scoring success over the last three seasons, accumulating 1103 runs with eight half-centuries in 41 games, highlights his franchise longevity and adds to the growing list of CSK centuries.

Admitting the trials he was facing in the later part of the season, the commitment of CSK to develop talent makes Dube a treasure in their dream to win the IPL.

Matheesha Pathirana (Overseas) 

Matheesha Pathirana, who has been aptly positioned as the latest Malinga of the Chennai Super Kings, comes to the fore to strengthen the franchise’s bowling. Though injuries had dogged his performances during IPL 2024, his influence on CSK’s fortunes is vital. Pathirana’s excellent performance was one of the main reasons for CSK’s victorious run in IPL 2023; thus, he was well on his way to becoming one of the key components of the team.

During his IPL journey, Pathirana has been an impressive wicket-taking bowler, earning 34 wickets in 20 matches. He did not play in many IPL 2024 matches due to injury problems, yet he proved his worth by taking 13 wickets in just six matches, showing that he could make a difference when healthy. In the previous season, Pathirana’s excellent 19 wickets in 12 matches performance added to his image as a match winner.

title: BCCI considering Stephen Fleming's appointment as Head Coach of Team India
content:
The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) is considering Stephen Fleming, former New Zealand captain and current coach of the Chennai Super Kings, as the potential Head Coach for the Indian Men’s Team. This move comes as the tenure of the present coach, Rahul Dravid, is set to conclude at the end of the upcoming ICC T20 World Cup 2024. If appointed, Fleming would serve a term of three and a half years, concluding on December 31, 2027.

Fleming boasts a notable record in the coaching arena, particularly with the Chennai Super Kings in the Indian Premier League (IPL), where he has led the franchise to five titles. His tenure of 16 years with the team makes him the longest-serving coach in the IPL. With his extensive experience and familiarity with Indian players during his coaching stint, Fleming emerges as a potential candidate for the high-profile position with the Indian cricket team.

The responsibilities associated with the role of Head Coach are significant. The chosen candidate will be tasked with developing a world-class cricket team capable of achieving sustained success across various conditions and formats. Additionally, they are expected to inspire both current and future generations of cricketers and stakeholders with their approach to the game.

Furthermore, the Head Coach will hold overall responsibility for the performance and management of the India Men’s team across all three formats of the game. This entails leading a team of specialist coaches and support staff, defining their roles, monitoring their performance, and facilitating their ongoing development.

Dravid has the option to re-apply for the coaching role

Regarding Rahul Dravid, although his tenure as coach was initially slated to end after the World Cup 2023, it was extended by five months. While Dravid has the option to re-apply for the coaching role, it appears unlikely. Another contender for the position is former India batter, VVS Laxman. Laxman has previously served as head coach of the Indian team during Dravid’s sabbatical and was part of the coaching staff that guided the Indian team to a gold medal in the Asian Games 2023.

title: Ravindra Jadeja Wins Most Player of the Match Awards for CSK in IPL History
content:
CSK vs PBKS, IPL 2024: In yet another stunning display of his all-round prowess, Ravindra Jadeja guided Chennai Super Kings (CSK) to a commanding 28-run victory over Punjab Kings in Dharamsala. Jadeja’s stellar performance with both bat and ball earned him the Player of the Match award, further solidifying his status as one of CSK’s most valuable assets in IPL history.

Chennai’s victory was built on the foundation of a disciplined bowling effort, led by Tushar Deshpande and Mitchell Santner, which restricted Punjab to a modest total of 139/9 in their pursuit of 168 runs. Deshpande’s fiery spell in the powerplay, dismissing key batsmen Jonny Bairstow and Rilee Rossouw, set the tone for Chennai’s dominance early in the match. Meanwhile, Santner’s economical bowling provided crucial breakthroughs, ensuring CSK’s control throughout the innings.

Despite a promising partnership between Prabhsimran Singh and Shashank Singh, Jadeja’s impactful spell of 3/20 tilted the game decisively in CSK’s favor. His ability to consistently dent Punjab’s middle-order, dismissing key batsmen such as Prabhsimran Singh, skipper Sam Curran, and Ashutosh Sharma, disrupted Punjab’s chase and ultimately sealed the victory for Chennai.

Jadeja’s contributions weren’t limited to the bowling department, as he also made a significant impact with the bat. His blistering knock of 43 runs off just 26 deliveries propelled CSK to a competitive total of 167/9. Jadeja’s aggressive batting style and ability to accelerate the innings during crucial phases further underscored his importance to the CSK lineup.

Ravindra Jadeja has won most Player of the match awards for CSK in IPL history

With his standout performance against Punjab Kings, Jadeja added another Player of the Match award to his illustrious IPL career. His ability to consistently deliver match-winning performances under pressure has earned him the distinction of being the player with the most Player of the Match awards for CSK in IPL history.

Jadeja’s all-round brilliance and invaluable contributions have been instrumental in CSK’s success over the years, making him a fan favorite and a vital cog in the team’s lineup. As CSK continues their campaign in IPL 2024, Jadeja’s form and impact on the field will be crucial in their quest for further glory in the tournament.

In conclusion, Ravindra Jadeja’s CSK exceptional performance against Punjab Kings reaffirms his status as one of the premier all-rounders in world cricket and cements his legacy as a key player for Chennai Super Kings in the IPL. His ability to consistently deliver match-winning performances makes him a formidable force to reckon with in the T20 format. IPL CSK fans celebrate his contributions that propel the team towards success.

title: How Can Chennai Super Kings Still Qualify for Playoff in IPL 2024?
