title: Ruturaj Gaikwad IPL: Player Profile, Background and Stats
content:
The newly appointed CSK captain, Ruturaj Gaikwad IPL journey has been one to remember. In recent years he has become one of the most important players for the Chennai Super Kings. His name has become synonymous with consistency. As with every passing year, the player has grown in stature and developed as an individual.

On top of that, what he has done more is deliver power-packed performances year in and year out in the last four years.

In the last three years, Ruturaj Gaikwad has been one of the most potent batters in the top order of the Chennai Super Kings’ lineup in the IPL. He has established himself as someone who can afford a slow start to build an inning and then finish off strongly towards the end of the inning.

Hence, it doesn’t matter if he plays a run-a-ball inning; the opposition will always be on their toes as long as he is on the crease. They are aware of how much explosive power Ruturaj Gaikwad possesses.

Despite a not-so-par year for the Chennai Super Kings under his captaincy, they certainly see a great future in this set up. But let’s understand what makes Ruturaj so special. In this article, we will take a comprehensive look at his background, stats, and career in IPL.

Read further: Breaking!! MS Dhoni Steps Down as CSK Captain, Ruturaj Gaikwad replaces the Legend

Ruturaj Gaikwad IPL Stats

Ruturaj Gaikwad’s IPL performance  is evidence of his development as a cricket player. Analyzing his achievements over time provides valuable insights into his development and maturity as a player. Ruturaj gaikwad best score in IPL came in 2024 as he smashed 108* runs. 

Ruturaj Gaikwad total runs in IPL has been an aggregate 2380 runs. Ruturaj Gaikwad IPL price for CSK in 2024 was INR 6 Crores. 

Ruturaj Gaikwad IPL 2020: First Steps and Positive Indications Ruturaj Gaikwad IPL Chennai Super Kings  started with a promising performance in the 2020 Indian Premier League season. He amassed 204 runs in six games. Despite the small sample size outing his strike rate of 120.71 and average of 51.00 indicated that he could adapt to the demands of T20 cricket.

Even though CSK had a bad outing in the season, Gaikwad was the silver lining of the season that gave them hope heading into the future.

Ruturaj Gaikwad IPL 2021: Making Waves with Reliability

Ruturaj Gaikwad’s IPL breakthrough season came in the very next year. The year 2021 saw him score an astronomical 635 runs in 16 games, including an incredible century. With an excellent average of 45.35 and a strike rate of 136.26, he established himself as his team’s dependable top-order batsman. Not only that, he was the formidable force for CSK upfront, battling with the veteran Faf du Plessis and eventually winning the Orange Cap.His performance was a key part of the highest scores CSK in IPL history.

In that season he also established his highest score for the team. Here is the Ruturaj Gaikwad Century in ipl Scorecard:

Chennai Super Kings

Gaikwad IPL performance improved drastically in this season. He showed great signs of growing maturity and poise under pressure by turning bad starts into noteworthy scores, as exemplified by his perfect century.

Ruturaj Gaikwad IPL 2022: Getting Through Difficulties

Ruturaj Gaikwad IPL stats in the 2022 season wasn’t upto the standards that he set last season as he scored 368 runs in 14 games. Though his average was lower at 26.29, he showed tenacity and perseverance, barely missing a century with a best score of 99. While the season was less productive in terms of runs, Gaikwad’s time with CSK do indeed show that his ability to produce significant runs in difficult circumstances demonstrated his growing maturity as a batter.

Ruturaj Gaikwad IPL 2023: Combining Effect and Growth

Moving onto Gaikwad’s 4th season with CSK, this season showed that he continued to solidify his progress in the game, as he managed to amass 590 runs in 16 games. He continued to contribute significant innings for his club with an improved average of 42.14 and a striking strike rate of 147.50. Even though he was unable to get a century, Gaikwad’s reliable IPL performances and ability to quicken the pace of scoring cemented his place in the starting lineup. Due to his impact on the team, Ruturaj managed to help CSK to win their 5th IPL title.

Ruturaj Gaikwad IPL 2024: Role as CSK Captain with MSD’s guidance 

Ahead of IPL 2024, in a significant development Chennai Super Kings’s management made a surprising announcement by declaring the 27-year-old Ruturaj Gaikwad their new captain succesing “Captain cool” MS Dhoni. This marked an important change in CSK history by ending Dhoni’s golden era as the skipper. 

Gaikwad has earned a significant amount of praise as well as critique for his time as CSK captain. Some even saw similarities between the current CSK captain and Thala Dhoni. 

In an article published by Cricinfo, the writer stated that MS Dhoni, the last captain of Chennai Super Kings, has a deep bond with the team as he often got emotional when discussing them and expressing a desire to end his career at their home ground. Similarly, the new captain, Ruturaj Gaikwad, shares this strong connection. Gaikwad’s bond with CSK is evident and serves as the driving force behind his leadership. Like Dhoni, Gaikwad’s attachment to the team is expected to inspire and guide his captaincy, continuing the legacy of dedication and passion that Dhoni embodied for the Chennai Super Kings. This is not all, Ruturaj Gaikwad IPL profile also made his name with the bat by becoming the only CSK opener to score 2000+ runs in IPL. On top of the that, he also jumped passed Virat Kohli to accumulate 2000+ runs in IPL history and became the only Indian to achieve the milestone.

Wrapping Up: A Positive Path for Ruturaj Gaikwad IPL

To sum up, Ruturaj Gaikwad’s IPL performances over the years show a strong trend with consistent improvement and progress. Gaikwad has demonstrated tenacity, flexibility, and maturity as a batter from his early steps in 2020 to his breakout season in 2021 and subsequent struggles in 2022. His reputation as a dependable top-order batsman who can significantly contribute to his team’s success was further solidified in the 2023 campaign.

His consistency with the bat and maturity on the field not only earned him respect and love amongst the CSK fans but also the franchise and Dhoni’s trust hence the team captaincy in 2024. Gaikwad emerges as a player to keep an eye on in future IPL seasons, having the potential to have a long-term effect on the league as he refines his talents and improves his performance.

How many centuries has Ruturaj Gaikwad scored in IPL?

Ruturaj Gaikwad has come close to scoring centuries on several occasions. His first century however came in the year 2021, when he smashed 101* runs against Rajasthan Royals. This fabulous innings of his involved 9 fours and 6 sixes, that propelled him to the milestone in just 60 deliveries. 

It was because of his brilliance, that Chennai Super Kings was able to amass a total of 189 runs, out of which 101 were scored by him. However, the result of the game did not go in his team’s favour. Some good batting in the second inning by Yashashvi Jaiswal and Shivam Dube saw the royals over the line with 15 balls to spare.

Moreover, his second ton came in the most recent IPL season in 2024 against Lucknow Super Giants, where Gaikwad showcased his exceptional batting prowess, scoring an unbeaten 108 runs off just 60 balls. This knock is also Ruturaj Gaikwad highest score in ipl. Supported by Shivam Dube‘s explosive 66 off 27 deliveries, CSK posted a challenging total of 210 for 4 on the scoreboard. 

Ruturaj Gaikwad personal life and background

Born in Pune on January 31, 1997, the 27-year-old Ruturaj displayed his sportsmanship spirit in most matches since his entry into the cricket world at an early age. Ruturaj started playing with a leather ball at the young age of 5. By the age of 11, he was already practicing at the Vengsarkar Cricket Academy. Which provided him the platform to make his mark at the Maharashtra U14 and later U16 teams as well.

In an interview, Gaikwad mentioned the pivotal role the academy has played in his life. “I would like to also thank my academy ,Vengsarkar Cricket Academy, which is, located in the PCMC (Pimpri-Chinchwad) area,” Ruturaj says.

“I’ve been there since the last 9-10 years, right since the age of 11. They’ve always been supportive and encouraging. Even today, they oblige whenever I request them to let me practice.”

He is an Indian international cricketer playing for the Maharashtra team in domestic cricket and for the CSK (Chennai Super Kings) in the IPL. He made his international debut in July 2021 against Sri Lanka for the Indian team. In the Asian Games in 2022, Ruturaj was selected as the Captain of the Indian team.

Ruturaj has had a steady career in cricket, showing this trait since the early days of his career when, in the 2010 Cadence Trophy, he scored 63 (71) against Mumbai’s MIG Cricket Club for Varroc Vengskar Academy.

Again in 2015, Ruturaj scored an impressive 306 runs at the Maharashtra Invitational Tournament in partnership with 522 runs with Vinay, his teammate. This success became evident as he made his First-Class debut for Maharashtra in the Ranji Trophy-2016-17 followed by a Twenty20 debut in the Inter-State Twenty20 Tournament in February 2017.

No wonder, Ruturaj is a very prominent name in the cricket world. His success rate is noteworthy!

The Captain of the Maharashtra Team in T20 and List A cricket, Ruturaj made his international debut for the Indian cricket team in July 2021 against Sri Lanka and also became the Captain of the Indian squad at the Asian Games in 2022. As Captain, he needs to be thanked, as the Indian squad in the Asian Games bagged the Gold Medal.

Before we look at his international presence in the cricket world, let us have a glimpse at his successes in domestic cricket.

Ruturaj Gaikwad stats in Domestic Circuit

A steady cricketer, Ruturaj made his List A debut in the 2016-17 Vijay Hazare Trophy (on February 25, 2017) for Maharashtra. His performance in this trophy merits particular reference as he scored 444 runs along with a 63.42 average in 7 matches. Ruturaj created a record by scoring 3 half-centuries and one century, thus being rated as the third-highest run-getter in Vijay Hazare Trophy in 2016-17.

As years passed, Ruturaj kept showing his maturity in one game after another. No wonder, he played for India A, India B, India Blue, Maharashtra, and India U-23. In October 2018, Ruturaj was named in India B-squad for Deodhar Trophy-2018-19 and included in India’s team for the 2018 ACC Emerging Teams Asia Cup in December 2018.

The year 2019 was extremely significant in his cricket career, studded with several successes. To exemplify, he scored four centuries in four matches in the Mandke Trophy and registered an impressive 187 not out for India A against Sri Lanka A in 2019.

In the same year, Ruturaj was named in the India Blue Team’s squad for Duleep Trophy-2019-20 and also in India B’s squad for the 2019-20 Deodhar Trophy.

Ruturaj entered the cricket world at the early age of just 13, making his debut by joining the Pimpri Chinchwad Municipal Corporation’s Varroc Dilip Vengskar Academy in Thergaon in Pimpri Chinchwar of Pune.

In 2021, he was the leading run-scorer in the IPL Season and also captained Maharashtra in the 2021 Mushtaq Ali Trophy, scoring a hefty 259 runs in five matches, averaging 51.80, including three fifties at a strike rate of 150.71.

Continuing with the tempo of his very good performance, Ruturaj became one of the top scorers in the tournament in Vijay Hazare Trophy-2021-22, scoring 400 and equaling the score record of Virat Kohli for getting the maximum hundreds in a single Vijay Hazare tournament and securing 600 runs in the tournament for Maharashtra.

In the 2022-23 Vijay Hazare Trophy, Ruturaj created another history during the 2nd Quarter Final match between Maharashtra and Uttar Pradesh. He created the distinction of being the first batter to hit seven sixes in an over (one off a no-ball) in all forms of cricket.

In the Final of Vijay Hazare Trophy 2022-23, Ruturaj achieved a 108-run knock against Saurashtra and created a record for the most centuries by any player in this trophy’s history (12).

A Pune-based franchise of the MPL (Maharashtra Premier League) inked an agreement with Ruturaj for three years on a payment term of Rs. 14.8 crore. It also announced him as the captain for the inaugural season.

Ruturaj’s International Journey

Known internationally as an ace cricketer, Ruturaj was named in India’s ODI squad in June 2021 and the Twenty20 International squad for the series against Sri Lanka. Making his debut in T20I on July 28, 2021, against Sri Lanka, Ruturaj was included in India’s ODI squad in December 2021 for the South African series.

Acknowledged as one of the most dependable cricketers of India, Ruturaj was named in India’s ODI squad in January 2022 against West Indies and in June 2022, he scored his maiden T20I century against South Africa.

In Conclusion 

2024 must have been a magical year for Ruturaj Gaikwad, from being married to the love of his life to succeeding MS Dhoni as one of the esteemed CSK captains and scoring his second IPL century. Overall, the current CSK captain had a decent form in IPL 2024.

Having such a huge responsibility on his shoulder, Ruturaj accumulated 583 runs in 14 matches with an impressive average of 53. Initially, the CSK captain led from the front by scoring his only second ton in IPL career against LSG. However, he eventually failed to take his team in the season’s playoffs after a heartbreaking defeat by the hands of Royal Challengers Bangalore. 

On top of that, Ruturaj failed to make his way into India’s squad for the upcoming T20 World Cup 2024. Despite consistently performing and leading India to Commonwealth Games 2022 finals, Gaikwad fell short in the eyes of BCCI selectors.

When did Ruturaj Gaikwad make his debut in the IPL?

Ruturaj Gaikwad made his IPL debut for Chennai Super Kings in the year 2020. Since then, he has been a phenomenon to be reckoned with in the Indian Premier League.

What is the highest score of Ruturaj Gaikwad in IPL?

Ruturaj Gaikwad’s highest score in the IPL is 101, achieved during the 2021 season against the Rajasthan Royals.

Is Ruturaj Gaikwad a good player?

Yes, Ruturaj Gaikwad is considered a promising talent in Indian cricket, known for his solid technique and ability to score runs consistently in the IPL.

Why is Ruturaj Gaikwad not playing today?

Ruturaj Gaikwad may not be playing today due to injury, rest, or team strategy, which is common in a long tournament like the IPL.

title: Prime Sports Owner reacts to Dhoni Doning his Brand Sticker ahead of IPL 2024
content:
CSK captain MS Dhoni recently caught the attention of fans and cricket enthusiasts when he unveiled a new bat sticker during his training sessions for the upcoming IPL 2024. The sticker prominently displayed the label ‘Prime Sports,’ a gesture from Dhoni to his childhood friend Paramjit Singh, the owner of ‘Prime Sports.’

Paramjit Singh, who is the founder of ‘Prime Sports,’ has been a longtime friend of Dhoni, and the new bat sticker was Dhoni’s way of acknowledging their friendship and supporting his friend’s sports apparel company. ‘Prime Sports’ began its journey two decades ago as a store in Ranchi, and Paramjit Singh expressed his pride and joy upon noticing Dhoni’s heartwarming gesture.

Prime Sports Owner reacts to Dhoni Doning his Brand Sticker ahead of IPL 2024

“I am feeling very proud of him. He has always been there for us. And this is our friendship. Friendship No. 1,” Paramjit Singh shared in an interview with Aaj Tak. He also revealed a bat gifted to him by Dhoni, autographed with the message: “Best wishes, Chhotu Bhaiya.”

Dhoni’s choice to feature ‘Prime Sports’ on his bat is in line with his tradition of showing gratitude and courtesy towards individuals or institutions that have supported him throughout his cricketing journey. Notably, during Dhoni’s final game for India in the 2019 World Cup semi-final, he adorned stickers representing SS and BAS, the first two major bat sponsors in his cricketing career.

As Dhoni approaches what is likely to be his final IPL season, he continues to exemplify his gratitude towards those who have played a significant role in his life. The news of Dhoni’s new bat sticker made headlines, even reaching international shores, with Australian cricket legend Adam Gilchrist commenting on it during a T20I match between Australia and West Indies.

“I saw him hitting some balls in the nets, MS Dhoni. There’s a new bat sticker on his bat. Just a local sports store of one of his schoolmates. Whack the company name on your bat just to give a boost to sales,” remarked Gilchrist during the commentary.

Dhoni’s gesture not only highlights his loyalty to friends but also serves as an inspiring example of acknowledging and supporting grassroots businesses and local connections. As the IPL 2024 approaches, fans eagerly await to witness Dhoni’s final hurrah on the cricket field, and his off-field gestures continue to leave a lasting impact.

title: Ravindra Jadeja celerates 15 years in international cricket
content:
Star Indian all-rounder Ravindra Jadeja recently celebrated a significant milestone in his cricket career, completing 15 years in international cricket. He took to his social media to express gratitude for the journey, sharing pictures from his cricketing adventures.

Jadeja’s international journey commenced on February 8, 2009, with his ODI debut against Sri Lanka. Since then, he has been a key player for the Indian cricket team, showcasing his skills with both bat and ball.

In ODIs, Jadeja played 197 matches.

In ODIs, Jadeja has played 197 matches, scoring 2756 runs at an average of 32.42 and claiming 220 wickets. His T20I debut came on February 10, 2009, also against Sri Lanka. With 66 T20I appearances, he contributed 480 runs at an average of 22.86, along with 53 wickets.

Test Cricket in 2018 against England

Jadeja entered Test cricket in 2018 against England, becoming a vital part of India’s Test squad. With 101 innings, he scored 2893 runs at an impressive average of 36.16 and took 280 wickets.

Noteworthy is Jadeja’s remarkable Test century against Sri Lanka in 2022, scoring 175* off 228 balls, including 17 boundaries and 3 sixes.

Currently recovering from a hamstring injury sustained during the first Test against England, Jadeja showcased his brilliance in that match, scoring 89 runs despite India’s narrow defeat by 28 runs. As he undergoes rehabilitation at the National Cricket Academy (NCA), fans eagerly await his return to the field, recognizing that his valuable contributions will continue to enrich Indian cricket.

Jadeja’s versatile skills have made him a formidable force in all formats of the game. His journey from a debutant in 2009 to a seasoned cricketer with numerous records reflects his dedication and passion for the sport. As he marks 15 years in international cricket, Jadeja stands as a symbol of consistency and excellence in the Indian cricketing landscape, leaving an indelible mark on the hearts of fans and fellow players alike.

title: SA20 2024: Top 5 Performers of Joburg Super Kings
content:
Amid a difficult campaign, where losses were more than wins JSK managed to qualify for playoffs and is looking to surprise against all odds. With the highly critical Eliminators set for tomorrow, it is an appropriate time to look back and appreciate some of our outstanding performers who have made this journey possible. Despite the challenges, these people showed unbeatable determination and expert performance to take JSK in winning ways. As the playoffs come closer, their contributions become a light of hope that assures everyone around him or her that no matter how difficult things might be at certain times they can still win. Let us focus on the results of our best performers who have been instrumental in our crusade.

Leus Du Plooy: The Southpaw Prodigy 

Our initial foresight was vindicated at the start of the season when we predicted Leus Du Plooy to be a star and he indeed delivered a stellar breakthrough season. Being a left-handed batsman, Du Plooy’s grace and power were seen in every innings he played.

Over eight matches, these included two half-centuries he accumulated a phenomenal 299 runs. In particular, Du Plooy is the only batsman of JSK who makes it among the top 10 run scorers in the league and this proves the huge talent which he demonstrated. It was his contributions that added to the campaign for JSK and not only made fans confident in him but also inspired respect among teammates.

Lizaad Williams: The Wicket-Taking Dynamo 

The South African, Lizaad Williams topped JSK’s list this season in the number of wickets taken as a fast bowler. His performances were spectacular as he regularly took wickets in almost every game that he played. Williams was a force to be reckoned with as he picked up 15 wickets in the nine games that he played and this has been an impressive tally. Most significantly, he demonstrated his ability to bowl in various aspects of the match – from powerplay overs through death. In addition, his commendable economy along with an average for a T20 bowler, also proved to him as being JSK’s most important player in the bowling unit, helping them get lots of wins.

Imran Tahir: The Evergreen Strategist 

Imran Tahir at 44 years is the perfect example of age no longer being a barrier with his unflinching commitment and staying talented; having played all games for JSK this season. Though he might not top the wicket-taking leaders, Tahir’s influence goes beyond mere numbers. The experienced spinner has taken seven wickets from nine matches at an incredible economy of 6.58 and is the core of JSK’s bowling attack. Tahir’s value cannot be quantified only by his individual performances because his experience and guidance enhance the performance of other bowlers. Recognized for performing under pressure, Tahir’s steadfastness and strategic insight make him an irreplaceable asset to JSK epitomizing the spirit of resilience & experience.

Moeen Ali: The Versatile Virtuoso

Though his contributions may not be loudly trumpeted in the statistical tables, Ali cannot be dispensed with JSK. He switches adroitly from one role to the other, bowling when circumstances necessitate and indubitably economical on the field. Adroit and brave, Ali finds a vital space in the middle order for his bat wielding it with elegance and courage. His versatility has played a vital role in the recent upturn that JSK is witnessing and as such he happens to be their talisman. In other words, Ali is the ultimate strength of JSK; he combines the ability to adapt, consistency and commitment.

Donovan Ferriera turns out to be the very face of a game-changer for JSK since no match can remain unaffected at all by his ability to switch innings explosively. His incredible skill of acting impressively under pressure has remained the foundation of JSK’s success in this season.

Ferriera’s contributions are not limited to his batting only but going behind the stumps, he exhibits supreme capabilities in ensuring accuracy and quickness throughout. His defining moments include a scorching blow of 50 runs off just 18 deliveries against the Pretoria Capitals, which proved to be very instrumental in turning around JSK’s fortunes. Besides, a 14-run cameo from three balls he played against Durban Super Giants proved the deal breaker setting up JSK’s best man of the moment.

Honorable Mention: Nandre Burger 

Nandre Burger should be praised for his stellar set of skills and consistent performances which are often put in the shadows by others’ stardom. Although Burger is an underground character for JSK, he has demonstrated a stellar growth path characterized by an exponential trajectory that culminates in his becoming one of the critical pillars to anchor on if JSK continues with its plans. With six wickets in seven matches, Burger’s effectiveness especially his powerplay expertise has not gone unnoticed. He can perform well when things are difficult and contribute immensely towards the success of the team which makes him crucial in JSK’s bowling department. As his career keeps rising, Burger is still a prospect who could prove pretty massive for JSK.

In the playoffs, preparing for their hardest battles to date yet as a team – these remarkable performers are JSK’s backbone in its aspirations. With their relentless pursuit of perfection under pressure, they instil confidence and trust in teammates as well as spectators. Under increasing focus and mounting pressures, what the combined efforts of these individuals do involve is finding a way through to negotiate the unchartered waters of playoff cricket. title: Qualifier 2: Klassen Shines as JSK’s Run in SA20 League 2024 Comes To an End
content:
The 2024 SA20 league was characterized by hot cricket fights on the pitch, revealing South African cricket talent at its peak. In this crowd among the finalists, the Johanessburg Super Kings (JSK), led by the seasoned warrior Faf du Plessis, was the terror team. Despite our determined efforts and courage, we stalled in the second qualifiers failing to make it into the finals.

However, we were not defined by defeat; instead, it was a springboard for growth and reflection. Our adventure throughout the season, with ups and downs, success and pitfalls, and eye-opening takeaways, is covered in detail in this blog. Despite however the disappointment, we emerged with new courage, determined to pass our knowledge into future victories. Be our companion in eavesdropping our story on the journey in the SA20 League 2024 –a story of working together, perseverance, and unwavering spirit.

Klassen and Mulder Harm Us:

Our demise impinged on a critical match due to the dynamic duo of Klassen and Mulder. Even though we managed to get their side down to 95 for 4 with the likes of Matthew Breetzkee and Quinton De Kock gone, we went on to stumble as the duo of Klassen and Mulder emerged with a sterling partnership, adding on 101 runs in almost 7 overs.

Their attack on our bowlers, especially Klassen’s rampage against Imran Tahir and Mulder’s domination over Sam Cook, meant that they finished with a massive total of 211. Regrettably, this crucial alliance reversed the tide in our favour, which eventually caused our downfall. Heinrich Klassen concluded 72 off 30 balls and Wiaan Mulder finished with a 23-ball 50 unbeaten.

South African League Flair:

The distinctiveness of the South African League came to the fore yet again as teams continued to neither give an inch, even stitching balls put out with a very high number of runs that needed to be cruised before getting bowled out. It is a league where players release a breeze of genius, bewitching the fans with their talent and madness on the floor. This flair is not merely about runs and wickets; it’s about unfathomable depths of quality limits irrespective of adversities, an unbridled sense of application within the game and an eye for opportunities. The speciality of the SA2O league is every match of the league is an escapade; where players perform and show talent and determination, making the moment pure cricketing magic.

Key Moments and Turning Points:

1) Imran Tahir’s Costly Over:

An important turning point in the match was when Imran Tahir’s expensive aided DSG took control of momentum decisively. Klassen’s brutal onslaught destroyed our bowling outfit, with Tahir leaking 29 runs to which DSG took control and turned the course.

2) Powerplay Failure of JSK:

Losing on that crucial powerplay as we strived to get to 212 proved to be the death knell of it all. As the scoreboard read an unstable 32/3, our batting core failed to gain momentum, a gigantic burden on the middle order as it only made chasing the target even tougher.

3) Ali’s Wicket and the Collapse: The wicket of Ali under immense pressure proved to be the dagger in the heart. The pairs through Hendricks and Ali presented a lot of promise but once Dwaine Pretorius came into the game due to Keemo Paul’s injury, things went a different way. Pretorius’ bowling caught Ali while he batted freely at 30; this resulted in a collapse and eventually sustained DSG’s win.

Unfortunately for our team, the batting collapse resulted in meagre runs of 142. Indeed it was a shape-less performance with the bat, however, qualifiers are about seeing who better gets cricket done upon the day and our adversaries better take advantage of their lucky breaks. Although this was a huge setback, sadly, there were tremendous silver linings to be viewed through the disappointment.

Season Takeaways

The season was full of blessings but one of the most amazing ones occurred in the form of our new-look young core, arising around Leus Duploo, Donovan Ferriera, Simbonelo Makhanya, Lizaad Williams, and Nandre Burger. Such players showed great perspectives and skills, revealing at least part of the future of our team. They displayed resilience and perseverance thus contributing greatly to our voyage during the entire season.

From these new stars, Leus Du Plooy and Lizaad Williams shone brightly as top players. Du Plooy’s undisputed batting excellence saw him score 377 runs across the 11 matches with a stable batting avenue for us. On the other hand, Williams turned out to be a prolific bowler after picking up 15 wickets in 9 matches and proving himself —one of the main nemesis of other batsmen.

Still, our biggest challenge was travelling by some means. Our lack of showcasing of main characters in the semi-finals, Lizaad Williams, for example, for sure influenced our party. Even amid challenges, and learning of important players’ sacrifices such as Coetzee and Williams, we demonstrated persistence and dedication that led to the semi-finals with only perseverance and combined efforts.

“We will come back stronger, thats what we are known for.”

In the end, even if we miss the ultimate honor we can still take a place in our hearts for the job performed this season. Coming third in the league tables is not an easy accomplishment and it says a lot about the attitude and spirit of our players. Looking back on the highs and lows of the season, we have to remember the improvements they’ve made, the lessons learned, and the abundance of talent our young core possess. As long as we continue to work hard and stick to our guns, the sky is the limit for our cricketing unit, and we still believe firmly in achievement in the cricket arena.

Just like the Super Kings fought back more furious in 2018 after the lapses, we too shall emerge stronger from this battle. From the resilience, we will draw motivation to go back, revisit our experiences and be back next SA20 season with more vigour and will.

title: CSK Captain MS Dhoni: Important for a leader to earn respect with deeds rather than words
content:
MS Dhoni and his legendary captaincy and adept man-management skills are often cited in cricket folklore, and the former India skipper emphasized on Friday that earning respect and loyalty from players through actions is the cornerstone of leadership.

During Dhoni’s captaincy, India achieved remarkable success, winning two World Cups and a Champions Trophy, along with reaching the top of the ICC Test rankings for the first time.

“Loyalty has a lot to do with the respect factor. Unless the support staff or players respect you, it is difficult to get that loyalty when you talk about the dressing room.

“It is actually about what you are doing and not about what you are speaking. You may not actually speak anything, but your conduct can earn that respect,” said Dhoni during an event organized by Single.ID.

CSK Captain MS Dhoni: Important for a leader to earn respect with deeds rather than words

Dhoni stressed that a leader’s respect is derived from actions rather than words.

“I always felt that earning respect (as a leader) is important as it does not come with the chair or rank. It comes with your conduct. People are insecure at times. Sometimes, even if the team believes in you, you are actually the first person who will not believe in you.

“To sum it up, don’t try to command respect but earn it, as it is very organic. Once you have that loyalty, the performance will follow,” he explained.

According to Dhoni, the first step towards earning respect is understanding each player in the dressing room, and recognizing their strengths and weaknesses.

“Some people love pressure, and some people don’t like pressure. What is important is to understand the strengths of the individual and the weaknesses of the individual.

“Once you have done that, you will start working on the weakness of a player without actually telling him that this is a weakness.

“So, it keeps a player confident and keeps the player from doubting himself. They like to see how it works and that is the job of a captain or coach to figure out what works for who,” he added.

Dhoni emphasized the importance of keeping things simple as a leader to achieve the best results from a team.

“In that process, the simpler you keep things, the easier it will become for you. I always felt that the team (that he captained) had character because all of us were different.”

title: Ravindra Jadeja Strongly Denies Father's 'Nonsense' Allegations, Condemns Attempt to Tarnish Wife Rivaba's Image
content:
Indian all-rounder Jadeja has strongly refuted the allegations made by his father, Anirudhsinh Jadeja, in a recent interview with a Gujarati daily. Dismissing the interview as “scripted” and “nonsense,” Ravindra Jadeja condemned it as an attempt to tarnish his wife Rivaba’s image. Taking to his social media account, he labeled the claims as meaningless and untrue, emphasizing that it is a one-sided story.

Jadeja, who completed 15 years in international cricket, expressed his denial of the allegations and called the attempts to damage his wife’s image reprehensible. While acknowledging that he has a lot to say, he stated that he won’t address the issues publicly.

Father blames wife for unhealthy relationship with Ravindra Jadeja

In the interview with Divya Bhaskar, Anirudhsinh portrayed his simple life away from the fame surrounding his son. Despite residing in Jamnagar, where Ravindra owns a farmhouse, Anirudhsinh claimed to live in a 2BHK apartment, managing expenses from his wife’s ₹20,000 pension. He accused Ravindra of not maintaining cordial relations with him and his sister, expressing his disappointment and shedding light on the family dynamics.

Anirudhsinh accused Ravindra’s wife, Rivaba, of creating differences in the family, citing a dispute over the ownership of Ravindra’s restaurant right after their marriage. Allegedly, Rivaba insisted on transferring ownership to her name, leading to a major altercation. Anirudhsinh also highlighted the strained relationship between Ravindra and his sister, expressing sadness over their lack of communication.

The fit-again Ravindra Jadeja, who missed the second Test against England due to a hamstring injury, is expected to return to the India Test squad. Currently undergoing rehabilitation at the NCA in Bengaluru, Jadeja is likely to be included in the squad for the remaining three Tests against England, with the third Test scheduled to begin in Rajkot on February 15.

title: CSK Captain MS Dhoni Adorns Bat with Childhood Friend Sports Shop Sticker During Nets Return
content:
In a touching display of friendship, Mahendra Singh Dhoni, the legendary Indian cricketer, has been seen endorsing his childhood friend Paramjit Singh’s sports shop during a recent practice session in Ranchi. A video of the session has gone viral, showing Dhoni using a bat adorned with a ‘Prime Sports’ sticker, owned by Paramjit.

This seemingly ordinary act holds deep significance, as Paramjit and other close friends played a crucial role in shaping Dhoni’s early cricketing journey. The enduring camaraderie depicted in the movie “MS Dhoni: The Untold Story” highlighted the vital role friends played in Dhoni’s formative years.

WATCH: CSK Captain MS Dhoni Adorns Bat with Childhood Friend Sports Shop Sticker During Nets Return

The video of Dhoni using a bat with the Prime Sports sticker has resonated across social media, symbolizing the enduring bonds and shared history between Dhoni and his childhood friends, transcending his fame and success.

title: Faf Du Plessis and Wayne Madsen fire as JSK qualify for SA20 Semifinals

The final ended in breathless fashion, as we had a ball remaining, this chased down the target, creating waves in the camp of JSKs. This incredible win guarantees our playoff berth and we face a wild, pulsating eliminator against the Paarl Royals. title: NZ vs SA: Rachin Ravindra turns his maiden Test hundred into double hundred
content:
In a dazzling display of batting prowess, Rachin Ravindra not only secured his maiden Test century but elevated it to a splendid double hundred on a sunny Monday afternoon during Day 2 of the ongoing first Test against South Africa. The young New Zealand opener showcased exceptional resilience and skill, facing 340 balls and crafting an innings that featured 21 boundaries and 1 six.

Throughout his remarkable innings, Rachin Ravindra found reliable partners in Daryl Mitchell, who contributed a commendable 75, and later collaborated with Tom Blundell as he approached the 190s. Ravindra’s composure remained unshaken even after Blundell’s dismissal, reaching the non-striker’s end on 199*. The crowd was fully engaged, offering thunderous applause for every delivery Ravindra faced, particularly during Dane Paterson’s tight spell.

Rachin Ravindra becomes 4th New Zealand batter to turn his maiden Test hundred into double hundred

Facing pressure from the South African bowlers to slow down the scoring rate, Ravindra demonstrated unwavering focus. The pivotal moment arrived when he found a single off Neil Brand, propelling him into an elite group of New Zealand cricketers, including Martin Donnelly, Mathew Sinclair, and Devon Conway, who transformed their maiden Test centuries into double centuries.

Rachin Ravindra’s incredible journey to this milestone commenced on the opening day of the Test match, where he and Kane Williamson propelled New Zealand into a commanding position with both securing centuries. Ravindra’s overnight score of 118 blossomed into an impressive double hundred during the second session on Day 2, consolidating New Zealand’s dominance as they crossed the 400-run mark in 131 overs.

This monumental achievement adds another feather to Ravindra’s cap, affirming his talent and potential. Notably, his record-breaking performance in the ODI World Cup 2023, where he outshone cricket legends by scoring 578 runs, foreshadowed the brilliance witnessed in his Test double century. Ravindra’s innings was a masterclass in blending patience with aggression, navigating the South African bowling attack with finesse, and securing a pivotal milestone in his burgeoning cricketing career.

title: Chennai Super Kings Highest Score in IPL History (2025 Updated)
content:
Chennai Super Kings is arguably one of the most famous IPL franchises. With its massive fan following, the team is almost synonymous to records in IPL. They hold several records to their name, one of them being the team with most appearances in the Finals. At one point, they were also the team with most titles in the tournament, when they won their third title.

However, that record was taken from them when Mumbai Indians won the title for a fifth time. Currently, they also have several impressive CSK records in IPL history to their name and are joint best team in the tournament with 5 titles.

But, there is one record held by CSK that no team has been even able to come close to breaking. We are talking about the record of most 200+ scores in the history of IPL, a testament to their ability to consistently deliver high-scoring performances and CSK winning trophy moments.

Did you know? Chennai Super Kings hold the record for the most 200+ scores in IPL history. They have crossed the 200-run mark a staggering 28 times. The closest competitor is Royal Challengers Bangalore (RCB), with 24 such totals.

In this article, we’ll take you through the CSK’s highest scores in IPL history. So, buckle up as we explore the best of the best innings from Chennai Super Kings.

Table of Contents

  • CSK highest score in IPL
    • #4) CSK – 226/6 Against RCB | Bengaluru | April 23rd, 2023
    • #3) CSK – 223/3 Against SRH | Hyderabad | May 08, 2013
    • #2) CSK – 240/5 Against KXIP | Mohali | April 19, 2008
    • #1) CSK – 246/5 Against RR | Chennai | April 03, 2010

CSK highest score in IPL

CSK or Chennai Super Kings are always at the forefront when it comes to shattering old records and creating new ones. The team’s success also contributes to the impressive MS Dhoni records, highlighting his pivotal role in their achievements. CSK remains a team to reckon with in this T20 tournament.

Chennai Super Kings have scored 200+ scores a record 13 times in the tournament.

Today, let’s have a look at their top four team scores, and we’ll analyze how they scored such a big score.

Let’s have a look!

#4) CSK – 226/6 Against RCB | Bengaluru | April 23rd, 2023

In last year’s IPL league match between CSK and RCB, the men in yellow once again scored a huge 226 on the scoreboard, batting first. Thanks to Devon Conway’s blistering 83 off 45 balls with 8 fours and 8 sixes, Shivam Dubey’s 52, and some late fireworks from English all-rounder Moeen Ali’s 9-ball 19*; CSK put a mammoth total on the board.

Batting second, RCB had a huge total to pursue with its batting stars, Faf Du Plessis and Virat Kohli, donning the job of openers.

Unfortunately, batting maestro Virat Kohli (6) got out early, courtesy of being clean-bowled by Akash Singh. But, Faf continued his rampage before edging Dhoni behind the stumps. Faf Du Plessis’ 33-ball 62 with 5 boundaries and four sixes set the tempo of the match. Then, Maxwell’s 36-ball 76 (4s x 3, 6s x 8) helped RCB go past 200. With 29 runs to win from the last 2 overs, RCB could only score 21 runs and thus finished their innings at 218/8. With this, CSK won the match by 8 runs.

#3) CSK – 223/3 Against SRH | Hyderabad | May 08, 2013

CSK piled up a huge total of 223/3 in IPL 6 against SRH in Hyderabad. Winning the toss, SRH decided to bowl first, but they weren’t aware of what was coming! CSK’s dashing duo, Murali Vijay (29) and Mr. Cricket (Michael Hussey), gave a blasting start to the team.

CSK openers added a quick 45 runs in 5.2 overs before the right-hander fell prey to SRH’s Perera. Then, Suresh Raina (99*) added a 133-run partnership with Hussey for the second wicket as CSK looked set to go past 200. At 17.2 overs, Hussey departed for 67 (42 balls, 4s x 5, 6s x 4). But Raina continued to score fluently across the ground with 11 boundaries and 3 sixes. At the end of the innings, CSK successfully put 223/3 after 20 overs.

From the very start, it looked a mammoth target for SRH. Apart from Parthiv Patel’s defiant knock of 44 (30 balls, 4s x 6, 6s x 1), Hyderabad’s top and middle order collapsed like a pack of cards in the match. Though Karn Sharma’s 39* showed some resistance at number 8, it was already too late then. At 20 overs, SRH finished their innings at 146/8, thus conceding a 77-run defeat at the hands of CSK.

#2) CSK – 240/5 Against KXIP | Mohali | April 19, 2008

Out of CSK’s top two scores, the Dhoni-led team’s 240 for 5 against KXIP way back in 2008 still continues to remain at the team’s top two highest scores. In the very first edition of the tournament, the CSK vs KXIP match soon became the talk of the town as both teams played well, and the match was a spectacle of 400+ runs in just 40 overs.

Winning the toss, CSK opted to bat first, scoring a gigantic 240 on the scoreboard, courtesy Michael Hussey’s 116* off 54 balls with 8 fours and 9 sixes. He was well supported by Raina (32) and Badrinath (31) in the match, as the team posted a huge total on the board, despite losing their first three wickets for just 62 in 7.1 overs.

Chasing CSK’s huge total, KXIP got off to a flying start as both openers clicked. Karan Goel (24) and James Hopes (71) added 56 runs for the first wicket, as the match was up for a thriller. Then, Sangakkara’s 54 (33b, 4s x 5, 6s x 2) made the match more interesting. However, after the southpaw’s dismissal at 17.4, the target looked somewhat unachievable as Punjab still needed 50 runs from 14 balls. After 20 overs, Punjab finished their innings at 207/4, thus CSK won the match by 33 runs.

#1) CSK – 246/5 Against RR | Chennai | April 03, 2010

Finally, here comes CSK highest score match in IPL. Did you remember IPL 3 which CSK won against the legendary Sachin Tendulkar’s revenant Mumbai Indians at his home venue in the grand finale? Yes, you got that right. It was during IPL 2010 when CSK registered their highest team total on the scoreboard.

CSK managed a score of 246 for 5 against Rajasthan Royals at Chennai at the 32nd game of the IPL 2010. Batting first, CSK got off to a flying start, with both its openers Murali Vijay (127) and Mathew Hayden (34) adding 62 runs for the first wicket. Though Hayden departed early at the 6th over, Vijay’s rampage continued.

The stylish right-hander went on to score 127 off 56 balls with 8 boundaries and 11 sixes. Then, Albie Morkel also launched a scathing attack on RR, hitting 62 off 34 balls with three boundaries and five sixes. CSK finished at 246 for 5 after 20 overs.

After Lumb’s dismissal, Naman Ojha’s onslaught continued and got good support from Shane Watson’s 60 (25b, 4s x 5, 6s x 5). With 54 runs needed in the last 17 balls, the match thus slipped away from RR’s favor; still, they were appreciated for their fearless performance on the ground. Eventually, CSK won the match by 23 runs as RR’s innings came to a halt at 223/5 after 20 overs.

Taking a look at CSK’s explosive batting performance as csk highest score in ipl, no record is too big for them. title: Ravindra Jadeja set to miss 3rd Test against England: Reports
content:
Ind vs Eng, 3rd Test: In a significant setback for the Indian cricket team, the upcoming Rajkot Test against England is poised to witness the absence of key players, with all-rounder Ravindra Jadeja likely to be ruled out due to a persistent hamstring injury, according to reports from Cricbuzz. The team, already grappling with a slew of injuries and withdrawals, finds itself in a more challenging position than initially anticipated.

The second Test against England, scheduled to commence in Visakhapatnam on Friday, will lack crucial contributors such as Virat Kohli, KL Rahul, Ravindra Jadeja, and Mohammed Shami. This depletion of talent may extend to the remaining three Tests, with only a few exceptions. The Indian team, currently trailing one-nil in the five-Test series, confronts the formidable challenge of taking on England without some of its regular players under the leadership of Rohit Sharma and coach Rahul Dravid.

Ravindra Jadeja visits NCA Due to prolonged hamstring injury; set to miss 3rd Test against England: Reports

Insiders reveal that Jadeja’s hamstring injury may necessitate a more prolonged recovery period than initially indicated. Typically, healing for hamstring issues takes four to eight weeks, casting doubt on his fitness for the fourth Test in Ranchi scheduled from February 23 to 27. Consequently, Jadeja is almost certain to miss the third Test in his hometown of Rajkot. While the recent BCCI media release mentions his absence only for the second Test, speculations arise about his availability for the subsequent matches.

Mohammed Shami’s current situation is equally grim. The pacer is contending with an ankle issue during landing, and although details about surgery remain undisclosed, he is reportedly undergoing treatments with injections in London. His participation in any match of the ongoing five-Test series appears highly unlikely, leaving questions about his readiness for the Indian Premier League (IPL) scheduled for March to May.

The situation surrounding Virat Kohli remains shrouded in silence, with the BCCI respecting his privacy. Initially declared unavailable for the first two Tests, Kohli’s status remains uncertain, adding to the team’s concerns.

On a relatively brighter note, KL Rahul’s condition seems less alarming. The batsman, experiencing right quadriceps pain related to a thigh surgery in 2022, is currently undergoing treatment at the National Cricket Academy (NCA), much like Jadeja. The BCCI, taking precautions due to Rahul’s crucial role in the batting lineup, expects him to recover in time for the third Test, scheduled to commence on February 15.

As Ravindra Jadeja touches down at the NCA following his hamstring injury, the team will have to rely on replacements to make a comeback in the series amidst the challenges posed by the absence of key players.

His hundred was not just a personal milestone but a testament to his adaptability and composure on the international stage. Ruturaj Gaikwad’s innings showcased his ability to thrive under pressure, and it hinted at the bright future that lies ahead for the young batsman in the national colors.

The Future Captain: A Leadership Prospect

Ruturaj Gaikwad had the privilege of sharing the cricketing field with the legendary MS Dhoni as part of the Chennai Super Kings (CSK) squad in the Indian Premier League (IPL). Ruturaj Gaikwad’s association with MS Dhoni in CSK has provided him with a unique opportunity to learn and grow under the guidance of a seasoned cricketer and an astute captain. Playing alongside MS Dhoni, especially in high-pressure situations, has likely offered Ruturaj Gaikwad valuable insights into the nuances of cricket and leadership. Dhoni’s mentorship can be pivotal in shaping the career of young players, instilling in them the importance of composure, adaptability, and a strong work ethic.

As Ruturaj Gaikwad celebrates another year, the cricketing fraternity looks ahead with anticipation. With his consistent performances and cricketing acumen, Gaikwad is increasingly seen as a potential future captain for the Indian cricket team. The leadership qualities he has displayed in domestic and franchise cricket, coupled with his batting prowess, make him a compelling candidate to don the captain’s hat.

Ruturaj Gaikwad: CSK’s Rising Cricket Star Celebrates Another Year

In a cricketing landscape that is witnessing a transition of leadership, Ruturaj Gaikwad stands out as a player who not only promises runs on the board but also exhibits the temperament and strategic understanding needed to lead a team. As the sun sets on another year of Ruturaj Gaikwad’s life, cricket enthusiasts eagerly await more glorious chapters in his career and the promise of seeing him guide the Indian team to new heights in the future. title: JSK Keep Qualification Hopes Alive with Convincing Win Over MICT in Rain-truncated match
content:

Nonetheless, amid the flurry of wickets, David Wiese’s penultimate over saw MICT return the shade as they scored 96 runs to set a target for JSK to chase.

LDP in their bow is the season-long Mr Midas, Leus du Plooy, who this time leads the charge alongside Faf du Plessis, a seasoned fighter, exhibiting a shift approach. While CAPT Faf du Plessis bounced back well to solve an important recurring issue on his re-discovery of batting prowess, he unleashed a magnificent 20 ball half century that guided JSK chase with sublime efficiency and authority. Key Moments and Turning Points from MICT vs JSK Game

1. Imran Tahir’s Double Strike: Early into the match there was a decisive moment when veteran spin bowler Imran Tahir wiped off MICT with the ball, thanks to his over in which he struck twice. Faf du Plessis then got that moment. The time he had the urge to restore his batting form and was ready for it. He took 20 delivery in which he hit a glorious fifty off him with an outstanding stint of power-hitting while smashing 4 fours and 3 sixes. Not only did his batting take JSK closer towards the goal but also injected conviction and certainty among members in their quest for victory that precipitated an encapsulating finish.

3. DLS Intervention: The unpredictability of the weather conditions through all days brought about an important factor to determine the winner in case of draw that was Duckworth-Lewis-Stern (DLS) method, which toppled at JSK’s favour. The data-driven method whereby the rain would need to stop wasn’t conclusive as challenges during matches could alter or birth new methods; with rain interrupting play and reducing the contest to an 8-over match, the application of DLS method in recalibrating JSK’s chase target was necessary. Even with the difficult situations, capitalizing of the new target alertly and deliberate’s calculated DLS which facilitated in mastering their batting strategy. The realigned target enabled JSK to gain both a focused aim while it also accentuated our confidence that allowed us to approach this chase on even footing with ease and alongside confidence. 

JSK produced an astonishing display of power-hitting and tactical nous to chase down the target—just 34 balls into the run chase, marked their arrival in hurting business of this playoff bracket; rekindling gusto of making it through. This important victory was enough for JSK to leap up a large number of points, sitting fourth in the league standings and just a couple of games behind playoff contentions with two major hurdles standing in their way against the two best rivals in the league.

In their unwavering pursuit of success, JSK’s convincing conquest can be considered as a glowing testimony of the team to their ability to commemorate victory regardless of tough circumstances that mitigate such an ambitious claim. Given their standing, the stage is set and every match will become a ‘do-or-die’ for JSK as they seek to perform remarkable feats by dodging death amidst the challenges that await them in SA20 tournament. With their destiny in their own hands, JSK marches forward, fueled by the fervent support of their loyal fans, as they embark on the final leg of their gripping journey towards glory.

title: 'What MS Dhoni Does…', Ben Stokes On Learnings From CSK Captain During IPL 2023 Campaign
content:
England Test captain Ben Stokes shared insights into his experience with the Chennai Super Kings (CSK) in the IPL 2023, expressing gratitude despite facing challenges. Stokes, who received the TFC Award (Thanks For Coming), acknowledged that injuries disrupted his plans but highlighted the incredible experience of being part of the esteemed CSK franchise. Having previously collaborated with Stephen Fleming and MS Dhoni during his stint in Pune, Stokes marveled at the dynamic between the coach and captain, emphasizing their trust and quick decision-making for the team’s benefit.

Reflecting on the trust exhibited by MS Dhoni and Stephen Fleming in their roles, Stokes noted the unique perspective each brings to the game. Dhoni, actively involved on the field, provides an emotional connection, while Fleming, observing from the sidelines, offers a more detached viewpoint. Stokes, along with Baz (presumably referring to Brendon McCullum), aims to emulate this approach, basing decisions on what is best for the team.

Stokes shed light on the decision to field three spinners in the 1st Test against India at Hyderabad, a strategy not commonly employed by England. Defying expectations, left-arm spinner Tom Hartley excelled with a seven-wicket haul in an innings. Stokes defended the choice, emphasizing the importance of not overemphasizing the significance of experience. While acknowledging the comfort that experience provides, Stokes prioritized selecting spinners based on their potential to challenge and succeed against India.

Watch Ben Stokes talk about MS Dhoni and his experience with Chennai Super Kings in IPL

According to Stokes, the focus should be on understanding the talents of the selected spinners and providing them with the platform to express themselves without undue concern about the outcome. He stressed the simplicity of cricket, where bowlers aim to take wickets, and batsmen focus on scoring runs. By removing fear and anxiety surrounding the outcome, Stokes aims to allow players to concentrate on their roles, simplifying the game and enabling individuals to play to their strengths.

In essence, Ben Stokes’ reflections on his time with CSK and his strategic decisions in the Test series against India reveal a commitment to team-centric decision-making, drawing inspiration from the successful partnership of Dhoni and Fleming. Stokes values a straightforward approach to the game, emphasizing the importance of providing players with the freedom to express their talents without unnecessary pressure, thereby fostering a positive and effective team environment. Despite setbacks, Stokes remains appreciative of the learnings gained from his IPL experience and is focused on contributing to England’s success on the international stage.

title: SA20: Faf Du Plessis Explosive 20-Ball 50 Helps Jo'burg Super Kings Defeat MI Cape Town
content:
Faf du Plessis made a triumphant return to form during the SA 20 schedule, playing a crucial role for Jo’burg Super Kings as they convincingly defeated MI Cape Town, significantly bolstering their chances of securing a playoff spot. Before this crucial encounter, both Super Kings and MI were in contention for the final playoff position, and the yellow-clad team enhanced their prospects with a resounding victory in the rain-affected match, earning them a valuable bonus point. The win in the SA 20 schedule was a pivotal moment, reinforcing the Super Kings’ position as strong contenders in the league.

MI struggled in their batting innings, with Rassie van der Dussen’s slow start (16 off 18 balls) contributing to their powerplay score of only 43 runs. Rain interrupted the match after six overs, causing a three-hour delay before the restart. The reduced fixture to eight overs compelled MI to adjust their plans. Despite the setbacks, Kieron Pollard’s late onslaught, featuring three sixes off David Wiese in the final over, propelled MI to a total of 80/3.

With the revised target set at 98 runs in eight overs, Du Plessis showcased his intent from the beginning, taking charge of the chase. Leus du Plooy provided a blazing start, hitting the first two balls for sixes in Nuwan Thushara’s opening over, which went for 18 runs. Du Plessis continued his aggressive approach, particularly against Kagiso Rabada, amassing 36 runs in the first two overs.

Du Plessis, showing no signs of his earlier poor form, took on Rabada for a hat-trick of boundaries and a six. The openers displayed urgency with the looming threat of rain. Racing against time, Du Plessis accelerated towards an unbeaten 20-ball fifty. Du Plooy, at the other end, contributed an unbeaten 41 off just 14 balls. In a remarkable display, Super Kings chased down the target in less than six overs, securing a comprehensive 10-wicket victory through the DLS method.

Brief scores: MI Cape Town 80/3 (Kieron Pollard 33*; Imran Tahir 2/13) in 8 overs lost to Jo’burg Super Kings 98/0 in 5.4 overs (Faf du Plessis 50*, Leus du Plooy 41*) by 10 wickets (DLS method)

title: Ravindra Jadeja and KL Rahul ruled out of Team India for second Test against England
content:
Ravindra Jadeja and KL Rahul will be absent from Team India for the upcoming second Test against England in Visakhapatnam, scheduled to commence on February 2. The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) announced that Jadeja sustained a hamstring injury during the fourth day of the first Test in Hyderabad, while Rahul complained of pain in his right quadriceps. This setback for India prompted the inclusion of Sarfaraz Khan, Saurabh Kumar, and Washington Sundar in the squad.

Saurabh Kumar, a left-arm spinner from Uttar Pradesh with a commendable first-class record, had previously been part of the Indian Test squad for the Bangladesh tour in December 2022. Despite not making his debut yet, his recent form, including a five-wicket haul in India A’s victory over England Lions, earned him the call-up. Sarfaraz Khan, known for his prolific first-class performances, boasting an average of 69.85 with 14 centuries in 45 games, also joins the squad.

The absence of Jadeja and Rahul and Virat Kohli’s withdrawal for personal reasons leave India facing a considerable challenge to recover from their 28-run defeat in the first Test. Jadeja, a key all-rounder, contributed with both bat and ball in Hyderabad, while Rahul scored 86 in India’s first innings.

The task of replacing Jadeja, especially given his stellar all-round record since 2016, averaging over 40 with the bat and under 25 with the ball in 53 Test matches, poses a significant challenge. Washington Sundar, who has performed well with the bat in his four Test matches but lacks Jadeja’s bowling workload, may be considered for a like-for-like replacement. However, India might opt for a frontline spinner to replace Jadeja, with Kuldeep Yadav being a likely candidate due to his attacking left-arm wrist-spin.

India team for second Test against England

India’s preferred XI also includes spin-bowling allrounders R Ashwin and Axar Patel. Therefore, Kuldeep Yadav, with an impressive Test record and recent Player of the Match honors, is likely to feature in the playing XI. The updated squad for the second Test includes Rohit Sharma (C), Shubman Gill, Yashasvi Jaiswal, Shreyas Iyer, KS Bharat (WK), Dhruv Jurel (WK), Ravichandran Ashwin, Axar Patel, Kuldeep Yadav, Mohd. Siraj, Mukesh Kumar, Jasprit Bumrah (VC), Avesh Khan, Rajat Patidar, Sarfaraz Khan, Washington Sundar, and Saurabh Kumar.

title: "Can play for another 2-3 more seasons": CSK pacer Deepak Chahar on Dhoni IPL Retirement
content:
Chennai Super Kings’ pace bowler, Deepak Chahar, has provided a positive update on MS Dhoni’s recovery from a knee injury, expressing confidence that the 42-year-old can continue playing in the Indian Premier League (IPL) for another 2 to 3 years. Dhoni, who led CSK to victory in the 2023 IPL, had earlier confirmed his return for the 2024 T20 tournament, delighting fans of the Super Kings.

The perennial question of MS Dhoni’s IPL retirement surfaces each season, but the veteran cricketer has consistently defied age-related concerns. Despite retiring from international cricket in August 2020, Dhoni has maintained his fitness and captained the Chennai Super Kings to IPL triumphs in 2021 and 2023, sharing the title of the most successful IPL captain with Rohit Sharma.

Dhoni’s commitment to his team was evident during the 2023 IPL, where he led CSK to their fifth title while managing a persistent injury. Following successful knee surgery in June, Dhoni underwent an extensive rehabilitation process with the aim of returning to full fitness for the 2024 IPL season.

IPL 2024: MS Dhoni can play for another 2-3 more seasons, says CSK pacer Deepak Chahar

Deepak Chahar, expressing optimism about Dhoni’s future, stated, “I think he has a lot to give to cricket. He can play for another 2-3 seasons. He has recovered well.” Chahar added that, for him personally, Dhoni should continue playing, acknowledging the captain’s crucial role in CSK and the team’s identity being closely associated with Dhoni.

The relationship between Chahar and Dhoni has evolved, with the fast bowler describing the former captain as his “elder brother.” Chahar credited Dhoni’s support during the 2018 IPL season, where he played all 14 games, as a pivotal moment that paved the way for his debut for the Indian national team later that year.

Reflecting on their bond, Chahar shared, “It took me 2-3 years to get comfortable around him. I see him as an elder brother, and I think he treats me as a younger brother.” The duo even engaged in off-field activities, playing PUBG together during the lockdown. Chahar expressed gratitude for the learning opportunities provided by Dhoni, emphasizing the pivotal role the veteran played in his career.

Currently recovering from personal reasons that led to his absence from the South Africa tour and the Afghanistan series, Chahar is determined to make a strong comeback in the IPL, with an eye on securing his spot in the T20 World Cup squad.

title: Deepak Chahar reveals why he skipped South African tour; Eyes T20 World Cup for International comeback
content:
Indian pacer Deepak Chahar is gearing up for a significant comeback on the international stage after a challenging period marked by personal reasons and injuries. With an unwavering focus on securing a spot in the national squad for the upcoming T20I World Cup in the Americas, Chahar’s journey reflects not just a return to form but a quest for redemption.

The turbulent phase began towards the close of the previous year when Chahar had to make the difficult decision to miss India’s tour of South Africa and the home series against Afghanistan. The reason behind his absence was deeply personal – his father’s recovery from a brain stroke. In an exclusive interview with PTI, Chahar shed light on the emotional turmoil he faced during this time, emphasizing the paramount importance of family.

“For me, my father comes first. I am here only because of him. Whatever I have achieved is because of my father. If I am not there for him in those situations, then obviously, what kind of son I am?,” Chahar exclaimed, highlighting the straightforward nature of his decision to prioritize family over cricket.

Spending 25 crucial days with his father in the hospital in Aligarh, Chahar navigated a challenging period that required not only emotional strength but also forced adjustments to his fitness routine. Despite being limited to exercises initially, he expressed the difficulty in participating in cricketing activities during that period, leading to his unavailability for the Afghanistan series.

However, Chahar is actively working on regaining his form at the National Cricket Academy (NCA), underscoring his commitment to earning a spot in India’s T20 World Cup squad. Acknowledging the constraints on his fitness training during the tumultuous phase, he affirmed his full fitness and readiness for the upcoming challenges.

“Missed two T20 World Cups because of my injuries” – Deepak Chahar

For Chahar, the opportunity to secure a spot in the T20 World Cup squad holds immense personal significance. Having missed the last two T20 World Cups due to persistent injuries, he sees this as a chance for redemption and a resumption of his role as a vital asset for the team.

“I have missed two (T20) World Cups because of my injuries. If I was fully fit, I would have been a part of the World Cup team as well. In any scenario or (in) any team combination, there is always a requirement for a bowler who can bat at No. 7, 8, 9. I have done that and scored runs for the Indian team,” Chahar stated, emphasizing the dual role he can play as a lower-order batsman and a proficient bowler.

With 25 T20 matches under his belt, Chahar has taken 31 wickets at an average of 24.10, conceding around 8.30 runs per over. His standout performance includes an impressive individual figure of 6 for 7, showcasing his potential impact on the game.

As Chahar navigates through personal challenges, his journey becomes a testament to resilience, determination, and the unyielding spirit to reclaim his position in the Indian cricketing landscape. The upcoming T20I World Cup holds the promise of not just redemption but the fulfillment of a long-cherished dream for the talented pace bowler.

title: Ravindra Jadeja Milestones to Watch Out for in 2024
content:
Ravindra Jadeja, one of India’s most dependable all-rounders in all formats of the game, is eyeing several records this year. As India hosts England for the ongoing bilateral five-test series, the talented southpaw is expected to create several new records.

Jadeja’s performance with both bat and ball has always been sublime in home matches.

Even his 87 in India’s first innings at Stumps on day two of the first test, chasing England’s 246 at Hyderabad, is set to be crucial in deciding the fate of the match. Besides, his 3 for 88 in bowling created quite a ripple in the English middle order, including the prized wicket of Joe Root at 29.

This is just the beginning of the things that are yet to come from our own Chennai Super King’s stalwart. And, here we provide you with a list of all the achievements that Jadeja can reach in the year, in test cricket.

Ravindra Jadeja’s 3000 Test Runs

Ravindra Jadeja, with 2804 runs already in his kitty, just needs 196 more runs to accomplish 3000 runs. However, at the time of writing this article, Jadeja was playing at 81* at stumps on day two of the 1st test between India Vs England. So, he needs another 100+ odd runs to achieve the feat. He’ll do it sooner than later.

Whenever Jadeja achieves the 3000-run mark, he’ll become only the third Indian after Kapil Dev and Ashwin to claim over 250+ test wickets and accumulate 3000+ test runs.

In his 15 years of international cricket career, the 35-year-old has 275 test wickets and around 2900* (as of Jan 26th) test runs to his credit, including 3 tons and 19 fifties and 12 fifers.

Ravindra Jadeja’s 200 Test Wickets at Home

Jaddu just needs three more wickets to claim 200 test wickets at home. Before him, only four Indian bowlers have achieved the feat.

The illustrious list includes legendary bowlers like Ashwin (337), Kapil Dev (219), Anil Kumble (350), and Harbhajan Singh (265). All these bowlers have picked more than 200 wickets at home.

Moreover, Jadeja has been extremely lethal at home. His 10 five-wicket hauls (out of 12 fifers) have come on Indian soil, showcasing his excellent bowling at Indian venues.

Jadeja completes 100 International Wickets Vs England (All Formats)

Coming to Jadeja’s performance against the English side, it has been phenomenal. He has 97* (as on Jan 26th) international wickets to his credit against England.

It is his second-best to Australia, against which the superstar all-rounder’s wicket tally stands at 134.

As soon as Ravindra Jadeja claims three more wickets against England, he’ll become only the fourth Indian to achieve the feat. Only Kumble (117), Ashwin (124), and Kapil Dev (113) have taken more wickets against England across formats than Jaddu.

550+ International Wickets Across All Formats for Jadeja

Exactly, just a day back, Jaddu created another milestone, scalping his 551st international wicket against England. He now becomes the seventh Indian to repeat the feat.

Others on the list include the likes of Anil Kumble (953), R Ashwin (721), Harbhajan Singh (707), Kapil Dev (687), Zaheer Khan (597), and Javagal Srinath (551).

Considering Jadeja’s spectacular form and availability for all formats, he is likely to climb up the list within a few years.

550+ Wickets & 6000+ Runs Double

Besides his unflinching commitment to India’s spin department, Jaddu’s contribution with the bat has also won many matches across formats.

Ravindra Jadeja, with 6000+ runs and 550+ wickets, is just the second Indian after the legend Kapil Dev to complete the international double of 6k runs and more than 550 wickets. It demonstrates the left-arm-all-rounder’s exceptional performance on a consistent basis.

Conclusion

For a long time, India had been searching for a reliable all-rounder across formats. India’s search stopped at Ravindra Jadeja. Over the last one and a half decades, Jadeja has continued to impress everyone with his outstanding batting and bowling. It shows how the left-arm spinner dominates India’s spin and lower middle order in batting.

With just 900 runs away from reaching the 7000 runs across formats, and plenty of cricket left in him, there’s no doubt that Jadeja is likely to emerge as one of India’s most potent all-rounders in the history of the game in recent times.

Most of his accomplishments and records are likely to be registered in the ongoing series against England in the five-match test series. So, just wait and watch! And keep rooting for Sir Jadeja. He is sublime, supreme, and spontaneous. Owing to his marvelous form, Jaddu is set to create many more records and solidify them in the history of the game soon.

title: Matthew Hayden says MS Dhoni is number one player of CSK
content:
Former Australian cricketer Matthew Hayden, who played a key role in the success of Chennai Super Kings has opened about his former IPL team and the immense support the franchise gets every season in IPL.

Speaking with Star Sports, the 2009 orange cap winner said that despite retiring from the IPL, he still gets the same love whenever he visits Chennai for commentary during IPL. This strong fan support has been a constant, even during the years when CSK was banned from the tournament.

Hayden feels that five-time IPL winning captain MS Dhoni will never retire from the hearts of CSK fans. The wicket-keeper batter said that players like Dhoni, Suresh Raina, and Ravindra Jadeja will always be remembered by CSK.

‘I retired from IPL in 2010, but fans still love me when I visit the city for commentary during IPL and other series. I want to say that MS Dhoni will never retire from CSK. He is the number 1 player over there. I am 2, and Suresh Raina is 3 on the list. CSK fans love success, they love players, and they will never leave you behind,” Hayden, who known for his destructive batting said on Star Sports.

“MS Dhoni is one of those heroes in Chennai” – Matthew Hayden praises MS Dhoni

The former wicket keeper batter said that people in Chennai love cricket and are more passionate about cricket than any other franchise.

Hayden said:

‘They love heroes, and MS Dhoni is one of those heroes in Chennai. The fans love Ravindra Jadeja and he is popular among the fans. It is the passion, energy, and motivation that keep fans attached to the Chennai Super Kings,”

“Even when Chennai was banned from the IPL, and Dhoni was playing for Pune, the fans from Chennai came to the city to watch their favorite player playing in the league. It is not just about MS Dhoni. The passion and emotion for cricket among CSK fans are higher than any other franchise,” Hayden added.

Matthew Hayden won two IPL titles in 2010 and 2011. He became one of the primary players in the league, and in 2009 won the Orange Cap as the season’s highest run-getter, with 572 runs.

title: Ind vs Eng, 1st Test: Riding on Jadeja's Brilliance and England's Struggles India Dominates in Series Opener
content:
Ind vs Eng, 1st Test: Ravindra Jadeja showcased his all-round prowess on the second day of the 1st Test against England, playing a pivotal role with both bat and ball. He played a crucial innings, remaining unbeaten at 81 and forming an unbroken eighth-wicket stand with Axar Patel, contributing to a lead of 175 runs for India at stumps. Jadeja’s partnership with KS Bharat and his own fifty-plus stand with Axar Patel demonstrated his resilience and ability to steer India’s innings.

Earlier in the day, Jadeja, along with KL Rahul and Shreyas Iyer, dominated the England spinners, especially during the second session. His partnership with Rahul yielded 65 runs off 74 balls, with both batsmen being ruthless against the struggling England spinners. Though Rahul fell short of a century, Jadeja continued to anchor the innings after his departure.

Jadeja’s performance with the ball was equally impactful, as he, along with Ravichandran Ashwin and Axar Patel, took crucial wickets to restrict England to 246 in their first innings. Notably, Jadeja and Ashwin both claimed three wickets each. England’s struggles against the spin duo allowed India to seize control of the match.

Throughout the day, Jadeja’s contributions with both bat and ball played a significant role in India’s dominance, highlighting his all-round abilities and solidifying his position as a key player in the series.

Ind vs Eng, 1st Test: Rahul, Jadeja, and Jaiswal Lead India’s Charge Against England

KL Rahul and Yashasvi Jaiswal showcased stellar performances in India’s innings against England. Rahul, along with Shreyas Iyer, formed a solid partnership of 64 runs off 106 balls. Subsequently, Rahul continued his impressive run, adding 65 off 74 balls alongside Ravindra Jadeja. Their partnership was particularly ruthless against the struggling England spinners, who grappled with consistency.

Despite Rahul missing out on a century with a score of 86 off 123 balls, Jadeja carried on, eventually crossing the half-century mark. The duo’s resilience helped India maintain a commendable run rate, putting the hosts in a dominant position. Jaiswal, on the other hand, played a scintillating innings on the first day, racing to 76 off 70 balls before stumps. His aggressive approach, especially against England debutant Tom Hartley, added significant momentum to India’s innings.

Jaiswal, along with India captain Rohit Sharma, orchestrated an explosive partnership of 80 runs in just 12.2 overs. Despite Sharma’s dismissal to Jack Leach, Jaiswal continued his attacking style, leaving England surprised and struggling to contain the onslaught. The young batsman’s special liking for Hartley, who conceded 63 runs in nine overs, highlighted the dominance of India’s batting.

As the second day approaches, the focus remains on Jaiswal’s aggression and Rahul’s contribution, setting India in a commanding position with a lead of 175 runs. England’s challenges in containing these prolific batsmen will likely be a key factor in determining the course of the match.
