title: Chennai Super Kings Full List of Coaches | Updated 2027
content:
Chennai Super Kings have appointed three head coaches between 2008 and 2027: Keppler Wessels, Stephen Fleming and Zaheer Khan. Wessels coached CSK during their inaugural season, while Fleming took charge in 2009 and remained at the helm through 2026. Zaheer Khan then took over ahead of the IPL 2027 season.

This list covers every head coach who has led the franchise, along with their respective tenures and key support staff across the team’s IPL journey.

CSK Coaches List: Quick Facts

Complete List of CSK Head Coaches From 2008 to 2027 

Note: Chennai Super Kings did not compete in the IPL during 2016 and 2017 due to their two-season suspension. 

CSK Coaching Staff — Year-wise 

The CSK coaches list from 2008 to 2027 below tracks the franchise’s head coaches alongside other confirmed coaching appointments across each IPL season. It also shows how the CSK coaching staff evolved over the years. 

CSK Head Coaches Through the Years

CSK have appointed only three head coaches across their IPL history. From Kepler Wessels leading the inaugural campaign to Stephen Fleming’s long reign and Zaheer Khan’s appointment for 2027, each tenure represents a distinct phase in the franchise’s development.

Keppler Wessels: CSK’s First Head Coach

Kepler Wessels became CSK’s first coach when Chennai Super Kings entered the IPL in 2008. Before moving into coaching, Wessels enjoyed an outstanding international career, representing both Australia and South Africa in Test cricket. 

As CSK’s coach, Wessels oversaw 16 matches in the inaugural season, guiding the side to nine wins and seven defeats. CSK reached the 2008 IPL final against Rajasthan Royals but fell short of the title. Wessels departed after that first season, ending a one-year tenure.

His place in CSK coach history remains significant as the man who led the franchise through its first IPL campaign.

Stephen Fleming: CSK’s Longest-Serving Coach

Stephen Fleming took over as CSK head coach in 2009. He had played for CSK in 2008, scoring 196 runs in 10 innings. His partnership with MS Dhoni became central to CSK’s identity, with Fleming contributing to strategy, squad balance and player roles.

From 2009 to 2015, CSK reached five IPL finals, winning two, plus two Champions League T20 titles. Returning in 2018, Fleming added three IPL titles, taking his tally to five IPL titles and two Champions League T20 titles.

Zaheer Khan: CSK Head Coach From 2027

Chennai Super Kings appointed Zaheer Khan as their head coach ahead of IPL 2027, replacing Stephen Fleming after his 18-year association with the franchise. Zaheer signed a one-year contract with an option to extend, marking his first IPL head-coaching role.

He brings extensive experience from previous positions, including working as a bowling consultant with India, serving as Director of Cricket Operations and Global Head of Cricket Development at Mumbai Indians, and mentoring Lucknow Super Giants.

His appointment signals a new phase for CSK, with the franchise looking to rebuild after missing the playoffs from 2024 to 2026. Zaheer’s immediate task will be to help CSK return to the playoffs while identifying a core group of five to seven players for the next cycle. The one-year deal also allows both sides to assess the direction before committing longer term. 

For the full details, read our Zaheer Khan appointment article. 

CSK Specialist Coaches Through the Years

CSK’s specialist coaching appointments have not been documented consistently across every IPL season. Public records from the franchise’s early years identify the head coach and some bowling and fielding coaches, but no separate batting coach could be verified.

The roles within the CSK coaching staff became more clearly defined after the franchise returned to the IPL in 2018.

CSK Batting Coaches Through the Years

Michael Hussey became CSK’s first clearly documented specialist batting coach when the franchise returned to the IPL in 2018. He remained in the position through the 2026 season and was part of the coaching staff during CSK’s title-winning campaigns in 2018, 2021 and 2023.

During his tenure, Hussey worked with established players and younger batters, including Ruturaj Gaikwad, Ayush Mhatre and Urvil Patel. His position within Zaheer Khan’s coaching staff for IPL 2027 has not yet been confirmed.

CSK Bowling Coaches Through the Years

Venkatesh Prasad was CSK’s first clearly documented bowling coach, serving during the 2009 and 2010 seasons. Andy Bichel replaced him in 2011 and remained with the franchise through 2015. Across their combined tenure, CSK won the IPL in 2010 and 2011 and the Champions League T20 in 2010 and 2014.

When CSK returned in 2018, former player Lakshmipathy Balaji became bowling coach, with Eric Simons joining as bowling consultant. Balaji held the role through 2022 before Dwayne Bravo took over for the 2023 and 2024 seasons.

Sridharan Sriram joined as assistant bowling coach in 2025. Simons served as bowling coach in 2026, supported by Sriram. Both remain part of CSK’s current support setup, but their exact roles for IPL 2027 have not yet been confirmed.

CSK Fielding Coaches Through the Years

CSK have consistently treated fielding as an important part of their cricketing philosophy. This has been reflected in the presence of outstanding fielders such as Suresh Raina, Ravindra Jadeja and Faf du Plessis during the franchise’s early years, followed by Ruturaj Gaikwad and Dewald Brevis in recent seasons.

While the players supplied the skill and athleticism, CSK’s fielding coaches deserve credit for maintaining those standards across different squads. Steve Rixon established the early setup, Rajiv Kumar carried it forward after CSK’s return in 2018, and James Foster took charge in 2026 with support from Arun Karthik.

How CSK’s Coaching Staff Changed Over Time

CSK’s coaching setup has evolved from a small group handling multiple responsibilities into a specialised team of batting, bowling and fielding coaches. These changes can be divided into four clear periods, each reflecting the franchise’s priorities at the time.

CSK’s Original Coaching Setup: 2008

Chennai Super Kings began their IPL journey in 2008 with Kepler Wessels as their head coach. Available public records do not confirm separate batting, bowling, or fielding coaches for CSK’s 2008 season. As a result, CSK has no reliably documented specialist appointments from its inaugural season. V. B. Chandrasekhar was a key member of the franchise’s cricket management and decision-making team during the inaugural auction and the team’s initial setup.

The Fleming, Bichel and Rixon Core: 2009–2015

The 2009–2015 period established the coaching core that shaped CSK’s early identity. Stephen Fleming led the side, with Venkatesh Prasad handling bowling in 2009 and 2010 before leaving in early 2011 to rejoin Royal Challengers Bangalore. Andy Bichel replaced him, while Steve Rixon handled fielding and assistant-coaching duties. 

It was a formidable coaching lineup, combining tactical experience with a strong emphasis on athleticism and fielding. CSK became renowned for their work in the field, with players such as Ravindra Jadeja, Faf du Plessis, Brendon McCullum and Suresh Raina contributing to that identity. The period produced two IPL titles and two Champions League T20 titles. 

A More Specialised Coaching Staff: 2018–2022

The 2018 return marked a clear shift towards a more specialised CSK coaching staff. Stephen Fleming continued as head coach, while former CSK players Michael Hussey and L. Balaji joined as batting and bowling coaches. Rajiv Kumar handled fielding, with Eric Simons serving as bowling consultant. 

Bringing Hussey and Balaji into the setup was significant, as much of the squad retained from CSK’s previous IPL stint was now older, increasing the need for player development and role management. The franchise retained this core for five straight seasons, qualifying for the playoffs in three of four seasons from 2018 to 2021, reaching three finals and winning the IPL in 2018 and 2021. This group helped maintain CSK’s competitive identity through a crucial transition. 

Transition and Rebuilding: 2023–2027

CSK’s coaching setup began changing more frequently from 2023. Dwayne Bravo replacing L. Balaji as bowling coach before leaving after 2024. Sridharan Sriram joined as assistant bowling coach in 2025, followed by James Foster as fielding coach in 2026. With Zaheer Khan taking charge in 2027, the CSK enters a new chapter, while the CSK coaching staff 2027 continues to take shape. 

Which CSK Coach Has Won the Most IPL Titles? 

Stephen Fleming has won five IPL titles as CSK head coach, making him the coach with the most CSK coach IPL trophies. His titles came in 2010, 2011, 2018, 2021 and 2023, across two spells with the franchise. Fleming also guided CSK to two Champions League T20 titles, in 2010 and 2014. His five IPL trophies make him the standout figure in the CSK head coaches list for championship success.

As he continues to make his mark in domestic cricket, Shaik Rasheed’s dedication and the wisdom gained from cricket stalwarts like MS Dhoni are shaping his journey towards success. title: Ravindra Jadeja, Virat Kohli among 4 nominees for ICC men’s cricketer of the year 2023
content:
In the race for the ICC Men’s Cricketer of the Year 2023, four standout players have been nominated for the prestigious Sir Garfield Sobers Trophy. The Indian duo of Ravindra Jadeja and Virat Kohli faces tough competition from Australia’s Pat Cummins and Travis Head.

Ravindra Jadeja

Ravindra Jadeja, who faced a setback with a knee injury in the 2022 Asia Cup, made a triumphant return in 2023. In the Border-Gavaskar Trophy, he showcased his left-arm spin brilliance by taking 22 wickets, contributing significantly to India’s series win. His impact wasn’t limited to Test cricket, as he shone in white-ball cricket, picking up 31 ODI wickets, including a remarkable 5/33 against South Africa in the World Cup.

Virat Kohli

Virat Kohli, after a brief struggle, found his form in the latter half of 2022 and continued his stellar performances into 2023. His notable contribution included a crucial 44 against Australia in the second Test of the 2023 Border-Gavaskar Series. This innings played a pivotal role in India’s victory, showcasing Kohli’s resilience and batting prowess across Test and ODI formats.

Travis Head

Travis Head, a key member of the ICC Men’s ODI Team of the Year 2022, faced challenges in 2023, dealing with a fractured hand that jeopardized his World Cup participation. Despite the setback, Head not only made a strong comeback but also played crucial roles in the semi-final and final, earning the Player of the Match title. His outstanding ODI form saw him score 570 runs, with a remarkable strike rate of 127.51 during the World Cup.

Pat Cummins

Pat Cummins had an exceptional 2023, excelling both as a player and captain. After a disappointing start with the loss of the Border-Gavaskar Trophy, Cummins led Australia to significant victories in the WTC final and the Ashes defense in England. The highlight was Australia’s remarkable comeback in the ICC Men’s Cricket World Cup, winning nine consecutive games to secure their sixth title.

title: MS Dhoni Allegedly Duped Of ₹15 Crore, Files Case Against 2 Former Business Partners
content:
Former Indian cricket team captain MS Dhoni has filed a criminal case against two individuals, Mihir Diwakar and Soumya Vishwash, associated with Aarka Sports Management in Ranchi. The dispute revolves around a cricket academy deal made in 2017, where Aarka Sports allegedly deceived Dhoni of ₹15 crore.

In 2017, Diwakar and Vishwash, representing Aarka Sports Management, entered into an agreement to operate a global cricket academy. The terms of the deal required Aarka Sports to pay a franchise fee and share revenue, but they reportedly failed to comply with these obligations. Despite reminders and legal notices, the issues persisted, leading Dhoni to revoke the authority letter granted to the company on August 15th, 2021.

As per sources, Aarka Sports Management did the Breach of Agreement

According to Dayanand Singh, the legal representative for Dhoni through Vidhi Associates, Aarka Sports Management cheated them, resulting in a significant loss of ₹15 crore. The breach of the agreement prompted Dhoni to take legal action against Diwakar and Vishwash.

The case highlights the alleged failure of Aarka Sports to fulfill their commitments under the agreement. The breach involved non-payment of the franchise fee and failure to share revenue as stipulated in the initial deal. Despite attempts to resolve the matter through reminders and legal notices, Dhoni and his team claim that Aarka Sports did not rectify the situation.

MS Dhoni withdrew the authority letter from Aarka Sports Management that was granted in 2021

Taking a decisive step, Dhoni withdrew the authority letter granted to Aarka Sports Management in August 2021, signaling the termination of their association. This legal move underscores Dhoni’s determination to address the alleged fraud and seek compensation for the reported ₹15 crore loss.

As legal proceedings continue, the case sheds light on the complexities of sports management deals and the importance of ensuring compliance with contractual obligations to maintain the integrity of such agreements. Dhoni’s pursuit of justice reflects his commitment to upholding the principles of fairness and accountability in professional collaborations.

title: Chennai Super Kings Sponsors 2025 (Updated )
content:
Chennai Super Kings (CSK) have garnered substantial sponsorship interest over the years, helping them consolidate their position as one of the most popular franchises in the IPL tournament year after year.

Besides being an IPL champion, the Dhoni-led CSK has always been in the news for retaining sponsors’ continued interest for years, with a notable record of total IPL trophies. In this article we will take a look at key partners and Chennai Super Kings sponsors 2025.

Chennai Super Kings Principal Partners/Sponsors

TVS Eurogrip:

This Madurai-based tire manufacturing giant serves as the Principal Partner and jersey sponsor of CSK. Since 2021, TVS Eurogrip, a major player in the 2-wheeler and 3-wheeler tire manufacturing industry, has entered into a three-season contract for IPL 2022, 2023, and 2024. Their association with the yellow army is uncertain for now.

The deal, valued at Rs. 100 crore, includes TVS Srichakra Limited becoming the Principal Partner, with the TVS Eurogrip logo prominently displayed on the front of the players’ shirts, replacing Myntra’s logo from IPL 2021.

Etihad Airways As A Sponsors of CSK:

CSK sponsors 2024 list, ahead of the 17th season of the IPL, Chennai Super Kings announced their collaboration with the national airline of the United Arab Emirates, Etihad Airways.

The UAE based airline already has a deep history of sports partnership and became a part of the CSK Sponsors 2025 list . One of the most popular team sponsored by them is Manchester City, the defending champions of England’s premier football competition: Premier League.

India Cements:

As the owner of the team it doesn’t surprise anyone to see India cement as a part of the CSK kit sponsors. This Chennai-based company has held the right to feature its corporate logo on the back of the team’s shirts since 2008. India Cements recently introduced two CSK-themed products – Conkrete Super King and Halo Super King in March 2022.

iv. Gulf: In 2011, Gulf, the Indian unit of the Pittsburgh-based oil company, secured the rights to showcase its corporate logo on the front of the CSK shirt. The agreement stipulates that Gulf’s logo be positioned on the top left corner of the team’s match-day shirt.

v. SNJ Distilleries: As a Principal Partner/Sponsor, SNJ Distilleries can display its logo until IPL 2024. Established in March 2022, the deal includes SNJ 10000 Logo featured on the strong arm of the CSK jersey 2024, on both sides of the match-day trouser, and on the sleeves of the match-day shirt. Additionally, the British Empire logo can be seen at the back of the cap and helmet worn by the players.

vi. Reliance Jio: Mumbai-based telecom company Reliance Jio is a Principal Partner/Sponsor with all eight IPL teams. The partnership, which commenced in 2018, entails Jio’s logo appearing on the left side of the team’s match-day cap and helmet.

vii. Nippon Paint: As an Associate Sponsor since 2018, this Osaka-based paint producing company’s Indian unit sees its logo featured on the sleeves of the CSK match-day shirt.

viii. British Empire: The British Empire logo is prominently displayed at the back of the cap and helmet worn by CSK players.

ix. Astral Pipes: This Ahmedabad-based company became a an official partner in 2021, specializing in pipes for drainage and plumbing systems, Astal Pipes features its logo on CSK merchandise.

Official Partners of CSK sponsor 2024

i. Garuda Aerospace: This drone startup became the official drone partner which joined as a Chennai Super Kings sponsor for the 2023 IPL season, marking the first-ever drone partnership for an IPL team. The deal includes M.S. Dhoni serving as the CSK brand ambassador list.

ii. Vision11: Vision11, with Fantasy Sports Vision11 Pvt Ltd as its flagship, became the official associate sponsor for the season. The partnership involves the Vision11 logo being positioned on the caps and helmets of CSK players.

iii. ICICI Bank: In March 2022, ICICI Bank announced a co-branded credit card partnership with CSK, offering exclusive privileges for the Super King fan base.

iv. Sunfeast Supermilk: As the Official Strong Biscuit partners for the 2023 season, making it a part of the Chennai Super Kings Sponsors 2023 list. Sunfeast Supermilk launched the “Strongaa Whistle Podu” campaign to celebrate CSK fandom across India.

v. Equitas Small Finance Bank: Engaged as the official retail banking  CSK partners for the team since 2020.

vi. Dream11: Acting as the designated fantasy partners for six out of eight IPL teams, excluding the Kolkata Knight Riders and the Royal Challengers Bangalore.

CSK Merchandise Partners 2025

i. FanCraze: Partnered with this blockchain-based decentralized marketplace for creating ownable assets and play-to-earn experiences.

ii. FanPlay IoT: Official fan engagement partner since IPL 2020 and listed as a CSK Merchandise Partner ahead of IPL 2022.

iii. PlayR: Roped in as the official merchandise partner, producing a range of sports apparel, equipment, bicycles, and accessories. They are also the principal CSK Jersey Sponsors.

iv. Hello FM: This private FM network returned as the official radio partner for CSK in IPL 2023 after previous partnerships in the 2011 and 2012 seasons.

Conclusion

Over the years, CSK has emerged as one of the most beloved franchises in the IPL. With a massive fan following and a global audience, CSK has become a significant platform for brand promotion. The array of diverse and esteemed sponsors underscores the team’s appeal and market presence in the world of cricket.

title: Ex-CSK player Ambati Rayudu joins YSRCP in Andhra Chief Minister's presence
content:
Former Indian cricketer Ambati Rayudu recently joined the Yuvajana Sramika Rythu Congress Party (YSRCP) in the presence of Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister YS Jagan Mohan Reddy at the CM office in Vijayawada. The event was attended by Andhra Pradesh Deputy CM Narayana Swamy and MP Peddireddy Mithun Reddy, who warmly welcomed Rayudu into the political fold. The official YSRCP X (formerly Twitter) handle shared a video of the program, announcing the cricketer’s affiliation with the party.

His cricketing journey included representing Andhra Pradesh and Hyderabad in domestic cricket. The former India One Day International (ODI) specialist had earlier retired from international cricket, a decision influenced by his omission from the 2019 World Cup squad in England.

During a visit to Mutluru village in June, he expressed his intention to serve the people through politics. Rayudu stated his plan to tour different parts of the district, connecting with the public to understand their concerns and needs.

Speculation had arisen regarding Rayudu’s potential candidacy in the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, with suggestions that he might contest from either Guntur or Machilipatnam parliamentary constituencies.

The YSRCP’s tweet acknowledged Rayudu’s entry into the party, emphasizing the significant moment of his induction into politics. The participation of Chief Minister YS Jagan, Deputy CM Narayana Swamy, and MP Peddireddy Mithun Reddy underscored the party’s support for Rayudu’s political journey.

Ambati Rayudu’s transition from cricket to politics represents a common trend where sports personalities venture into public service. His decision to understand the people’s needs firsthand and engage with local communities reflects a commitment to grassroots politics and a desire to contribute to the welfare of Andhra Pradesh.

title: Ind Vs Sa 1st Test: Shardul Thakur Hit On Helmet, Undergoes Concussion Test
content:
IND VS SA 1st Test: In a display of remarkable resilience, India’s all-rounder Shardul Thakur courageously continued to bat after being struck on the helmet by a sharp bouncer from South African pacer Gerald Coetzee on the first day of the Boxing Day Test in Centurion. Facing a challenging situation as India’s top order crumbled under Kagiso Rabada’s bowling prowess, Shardul stepped up to the crease during the second session.

Despite the adversity, Shardul Thakur formed a crucial partnership for the 7th wicket alongside wicketkeeper-batsman KL Rahul. The duo provided stability to the Indian innings after the loss of key wickets, including Virat Kohli and captain Rohit Sharma, in quick succession to Rabada.

IND VS SA 1st Test: Shardul Thakur displayed courage despite encountering a rapid bouncer from Coetzee striking his helmet

However, Shardul encountered a momentary setback when a rapid bouncer from Coetzee struck his helmet, prompting immediate attention from the physio and Indian team doctors. Television visuals captured a noticeable swelling on Shardul’s forehead, emphasizing the force of the impact. Undergoing the mandatory concussion test, Shardul received an ice pack to reduce the swelling before his helmet was thoroughly examined and replaced.

In a heartening turn of events for Indian fans at the SuperSport Park, Shardul Thakur, undeterred by the incident, securely fastened his helmet straps and resumed batting. The partnership with Rahul surpassed 40 runs in the second session before Kagiso Rabada claimed Shardul’s wicket, marking his 14th five-wicket haul in Test cricket. Despite a visibly disappointed walk back to the pavilion, Shardul’s contribution included a solid 24 runs off 33 balls and a valuable 43-run partnership for the seventh wicket with KL Rahul.

Bad light stops play after KL Rahul’s gritty fifty takes IND to 208/8

As India faced South Africa’s bowling attack, the scorecard reflected 164/7 in 46.2 overs after Shardul Thakur’s dismissal. KL Rahul, on his return to the Test side since the Border-Gavaskar Trophy, showcased fluency and composure in the middle, anchoring the innings amidst the fall of wickets around him.

KL Rahul exhibited remarkable resilience, skillfully guiding the innings alongside the lower-order batsmen to propel India to 208/8 before play was curtailed by rain on Day 1. His courageous half-century not only lifted the team’s score beyond 200 but also stood as a commendable achievement, particularly when reaching 150 appeared to be a challenging task. Regrettably, India’s promising progress was abruptly halted by a combination of rain and bad light, ultimately dashing hopes of a resumed play and compelling an early end to Day 1 amid a relentless downpour.

Thank you for reading.

title: CSK's Suresh Raina to join Lucknow Super Giants as mentor ahead of IPL 2024
content:
In a significant development for the upcoming IPL 2024 season, former Indian cricketer and ex-Chennai Super Kings player Suresh Raina is set to take on the role of mentor with the Lucknow Super Giants. This move follows the departure of Gautam Gambhir, who bid farewell to the franchise and returned to the Kolkata Knight Riders.

Suresh Raina will join LSG in 2024

Raina confirmed the news on the social media platform X, responding to a tweet from a sports journalist. The tweet in question accused another Twitter handle of spreading false information about the seasoned left-hander. Raina, known for his impactful performances during his IPL stint, expressed his stance on the matter through the platform.

During his illustrious IPL career, Suresh Raina played a pivotal role in the success of the Chennai Super Kings. In a remarkable 205 IPL matches, he amassed 5528 runs, showcasing his consistency as a batsman. His innings featured one century and an impressive 39 half-centuries, complemented by 506 boundaries and 203 sixes. Additionally, Raina contributed with the ball, securing 25 wickets over the course of his IPL journey.

With Raina stepping into the mentorship role for the Lucknow Super Giants, the team’s IPL 2024 squad boasts a formidable lineup. Led by KL Rahul, the squad includes notable names such as Quinton de Kock, Nicholas Pooran, Ayush Badoni, Kyle Mayers, Marcus Stoinis, Deepak Hooda, Devdutt Padikkal, Ravi Bishnoi, and Naveen-ul-Haq, among others. The diverse mix of experienced players and emerging talent positions the team as a strong contender for the upcoming season.

As the cricketing community eagerly anticipates the action-packed IPL 2024, the addition of Suresh Raina as the mentor for Lucknow Super Giants adds an extra layer of excitement and expertise to the franchise’s journey in the tournament.

title: Ruturaj Gaikwad Set to Miss Test Series Against South Africa Due to Injury
content:
Indian batter Ruturaj Gaikwad will miss the upcoming two-match Test series against South Africa due to an injury to his right ring finger sustained while fielding in the second ODI in Gqeberha. The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) confirmed this development on Saturday, stating that Gaikwad underwent scans and, following expert consultation, has been ruled out for the remainder of the tour. Abhimanyu Easwaran has been named as Gaikwad’s replacement in the squad.

The first Test of the series is scheduled to start on Boxing Day at Centurion, with the second Test set to begin on January 3 in Cape Town.

“He will be reporting to the National Cricket Academy (NCA) for further management of his injury. The Men’s Selection Committee has named Abhimanyu Easwaran as his replacement,” stated the BCCI.

Gaikwad’s absence was noticeable in the third and final ODI against South Africa, where captain KL Rahul revealed at the toss that the opener was benched due to a finger injury. Rajat Patidar took Gaikwad’s place in the playing XI, making his ODI debut.

(He) hasn’t fully recovered: BCCI’s official statement said about Gaikwad absence from the South Africa Test series

The BCCI had earlier mentioned, “(He) hasn’t fully recovered from the blow he sustained to his ring finger while fielding in the second ODI. He remains under the supervision of the BCCI Medical Team.”

In a separate development, fast bowler Harshit Rana will miss the four-day match against South Africa A starting on December 26 at Willowmoore Park in Benoni due to a hamstring injury. The Selection Committee has made changes to India A’s squad, adding Rajat Patidar, Sarfaraz Khan, Avesh Khan, and Rinku Singh, while releasing Kuldeep Yadav from the squad.

The updated India A squad for the four-day match against SA A includes Abhimanyu Easwaran (C), Sai Sudharsan, Rajat Patidar, Sarfaraz Khan, Tilak Varma, Dhruv Jurel (wk), Axar Patel, Washington Sundar, Avesh Khan, Navdeep Saini, Akash Deep, Vidhwath Kaverappa, Manav Suthar, and Rinku Singh.

Thank you for reading.

title: CSK bowler Tushar Deshpande gets married to Nabha Gaddamwar
content:
Chennai Super Kings’ emerging player, Tushar Deshpande, who played a crucial role as a bowler in the 2023 Indian Premier League, has recently celebrated his marriage to Nabha Gaddamwar in a heartwarming ceremony surrounded by friends and family.

CSK Star Tushar Deshpande gets married

The journey to marriage started when Deshpande got engaged to his long-time “school crush” earlier this year in Mumbai, following the conclusion of the IPL season. He shared a photo on Instagram, capturing the moment as he and his wife exchanged wedding vows.

Deshpande, a talented right-arm fast bowler, gained recognition for his impactful performances in CSK’s successful campaign in the IPL 2023. His standout performance included a pivotal role in CSK’s thrilling victory over the defending champions, Gujarat Titans, in a closely contested final at the Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad. With an impressive tally of 21 wickets in 16 matches, he emerged as CSK’s leading wicket-taker and the sixth-highest wicket-taker in the tournament.

Ruturaj Gaikwad had opted out due to his marriage commitments

Earlier, another CSK player, Ruturaj Gaikwad, had opted out of the reserve opener position for the Indian team in the ICC World Test Championship (WTC) final due to his marriage commitments. Gaikwad had tied the knot with Utkarsha Pawar, an accomplished all-rounder with experience playing for Maharashtra in domestic tournaments.

Deshpande, with a commendable record in various formats, holds 80 wickets in 29 first-class games, 35 wickets in 34 List A matches, and 83 wickets in 59 T20Is. His outstanding performance in the IPL 2023 highlighted his dedication and skill on the field. Reflecting on his success, he credited former CSK skipper MS Dhoni for his guidance, describing their relationship as that of a soldier to his commander. Deshpande expressed trust in Dhoni’s leadership, believing that the legendary captain would always guide him in the right direction.

Deshpande expressed his commitment to follow Dhoni’s advice

In a recent statement, Deshpande acknowledged Dhoni’s clear plans and simple approach. He emphasized Dhoni’s selflessness, noting that he provides guidance and support during challenging times. Deshpande expressed his commitment to follow Dhoni’s advice, stating, “Like a soldier, I will just follow whatever he says. I know he can never take me on a wrong path.” Deshpande also highlighted Dhoni’s encouragement, mentioning the captain’s advice to remain calm and focused on the game.

content:

Daryl Mitchell describes CSK as a “COOL” Franchise

title: Most Expensive Players for CSK in IPL 2025 Update
content:
Ben Stokes is the most expensive CSK player in IPL history, signed for ₹16.25 crore in the 2022 auction. Chennai Super Kings have made several big signings over the years, yet none of them come even close to the price they paid for the Englishman’s services in 2022.

Chennai Super Kings have built their IPL success on smart, but not high-value, auction buys. They are not a team you expect to break their purse on a particular player. Their formula has been simple: experience and intent.

Yet, over the years, there have been some exceptions to this rule. There have been times when CSK has gone all out to acquire all-rounders who they know are certain match winners. These players are power hitters and versatile bowlers who fit the conditions at Chepauk and complement the team’s balanced core.

So, let’s take a look at some of CSK’s most expensive players.

CSK’s most expensive player 2025 Updated

For Chennai Super Kings, you have to be a three-dimensional player to earn the big bucks. And this is evident from the most valuable player list. These players, mostly, are all-rounders who can contribute in more than one facet of the game.

Ben Stokes

Ben Stokes — widely regarded as one of the world’s premier all-rounders — became the most expensive CSK player in 2023. Known for a potent combination of aggressive batting, improved bowling, and match-winning credentials across formats. That pedigree convinced CSK to shell out ₹16.25 crore for him in the 2023 auction, making him the most expensive CSK buy ever.

However, his debut season for Chennai did not live up to expectations. Stokes featured in just two matches, scoring a total of 15 runs. His limited opportunities, coupled with an injury (toe injury, reportedly), meant he was largely unable to contribute.

As a result, his stint with CSK passed without meaningful impact. Though billed as a marquee buy, his injury woes and absence from key games meant CSK never got to fully capitalise on his all-round abilities.

Prashant Veer

The young 20-year-old Indian all-rounder, became a part of the elite list of most expensive CSK players in the Mini auction in 2025, when Chennai Super Kings bid 14.2 crore rupees for him. This doesn’t just how his prowess as a player but also how CSK are stepping away from their philosophies to ensure results.

CSK are traditionally conservative at auctions, especially when it comes to uncapped players, but Veer represented a profile that simply does not surface often — a bowling-first left-arm spin all-rounder with proven T20 impact.

His domestic performances showed sustained control through the middle overs, combined with the ability to finish innings in short bursts. That combination aligned closely with CSK’s long-standing preference for role clarity and tactical reliability.

Kartik Sharma

Kartik Sharma’s inclusion among CSK’s most expensive buys stands out precisely because it runs counter to the franchise’s historical preference for experience over youth. At just 19, he became one of the costliest uncapped players in IPL history, a decision driven not by promise alone but by an unusually strong domestic résumé across formats.

Unlike many age-group signings, Kartik arrived with first-class hundreds, a prolific List A season, and evidence of finishing ability in T20 cricket. CSK’s scouting process identified not just his strokeplay but his composure and adaptability, traits the franchise values as non-negotiable.

The investment was less about immediate returns and more about securing a long-term wicketkeeper-batter capable of growing into responsibility. For CSK, spending big on a teenager was a rare move — but one backed by numbers, temperament, and a clear development pathway.

Daryl Mitchell

Daryl Mitchell is the second-highest-paid CSK player in IPL history. He is a modern-style middle-order batter with the ability to dispatch spin, rotate strike, and provide occasional overs — attributes highly valued by CSK, especially given the spin-friendly nature of their home ground. Ahead of the 2024 season, CSK invested ₹14 crore to secure him, betting on his recent form and all-round potential.

Through this move, CSK wanted to add depth and flexibility to their squad. But the move didn’t live up to the billing, as Mitchell failed to get going in the IPL 2024.

In the 15 games that he played for the side, he could only muster 351 runs at a strike rate of 131 and an average of 27. Furthermore, only 10 sixes and 28 fours came off his bat, and there was no real contribution with the ball in hand as well, leading to another failed high ticket move.

Deepak Chahar

Deepak Chahar has become synonymous with CSK since their return in 2018. He was the front-line pacer for the MSD-led side that won the 2018 title and came up second best in 2019.

Although he struggled in 2020 with injuries, his return in style with another title in 2021 made it certain that CSK will back him no matter what. Hence, when his name showed up in the 2022 auction, everyone knew that CSK would go for him.

In the 2022 mega auction, CSK paid ₹14 crore to bring him back, marking him the franchise’s priciest Indian signing ever (at that time). However, things didn’t go well for him, as he was ruled out due to an injury.

He returned to the squad in 2023, another title-winning season with 10 wickets in 13 games, but the impact was just not the same. 2024 was the same story for Chahar, as he continued to struggle with injuries and could only feature in 8 games, taking five wickets. He was released in 2025.

Noor Ahmad

The latest addition to the list of CSK’s most expensive players is Noor Ahmed. In the 2025 mega auction, CSK paid ₹10 crore to acquire Afghan left-arm wrist-spinner. What attracted CSK was his “chinaman” style — a rare, high-value spin bowling variation that can generate sharp turn and deceptive wrist-spin on Indian pitches.

His 2025 season validated that investment. In just 14 matches for CSK, Noor emerged as their leading wicket-taker: he picked up 24 wickets, the second-highest haul in the entire tournament. A standout moment came in a match at Chepauk, where he scalped 4 for 18 against the Mumbai Indians — dismantling their middle order and steering CSK to a crucial win.

Given his age, skill set, and immediate impact, Noor looks more like a long-term asset than a one-season gamble. By delivering consistently under pressure, he strengthened CSK’s spin attack, offering a potent middle-overs wicket tally, something vital on turning Indian tracks.

Ravindra Jadeja

Ravindra Jadeja, the Cricket Thalapathy of CSK, is one of the most expensive CSK players. Back in 2012, CSK paid ₹9.8 crore for him, at a time when that was a significant investment. The fee reflected his promise as a match-winner in all departments.

Over the years, Jadeja delivered consistently: contributing with the bat in the middle order, turning games with his left-arm spin, and often turning pressure into wickets. His longevity with CSK, spanning more than a decade, speaks volumes about his long-term impact.

He played a key role in multiple title-winning campaigns, becoming one of the franchise’s most dependable and balanced core players. However, the most memorable of them all will always be the final in Ahmedabad against the Gujarat Titans, in which he scored 10 off two balls in the last over to win his side the historic fifth title.

Krishnappa Gowtham

Krishnappa Gowtham was CSK’s surprise pick at the IPL 2021 auction. The team spent over 9.25 crores to bring him on board. Krishna is known for his sharp off-spin bowling and useful lower-order batting. But despite all the hype, Krishna couldn’t justify the expectations built around him. He has played 35 T20 matches and picked up 21 wickets. However, it’s also true that he didn’t get enough opportunities to prove his potential in this tournament yet.

Moeen Ali

Moeen Ali has been associated with CSK since 2021. Previously, he regularly played for RCB. In 2021, Moeen was bought by CSK for Rs. 8 crores. Moeen Ali proved his mettle out in the middle during the IPL 2021 season for CSK, scoring 357 runs and picking up 6 crucial wickets, helping men-in-yellow bounce back at crucial times.

In the last three seasons, the English allrounder has turned into someone who is indispensable. He has been the backbone of the middle order of CSK’s batting lineup. He has the capacity to play the game according to the requirements of the situation. He will score at pace when the opposition is at the top, but when the chips are down, he will look to sail out the turmoiled time and then take his chances.

Ali has scored a total of 725 runs for CSK in the last three seasons. Apart from that, he has also managed to claim 23 wickets to his name, making him one of the most valuable assets to the team.

Kedar Jadhav 7.8 crores (2018)

Chennai Super Kings (CSK) bought Kedar Jadhav for 7.8 crores in the IPL 2018 auction. In that season, the player sustained a very grave injury in the very first game he featured. Although he won the game for his team, he was ruled out for the rest of the tournament.

Chennai went on to win that tournament, but Jadhav didn’t make a comeback to the side. Though Kedar is immensely talented, unfortunately, he couldn’t perform consistently well in this hyper-competitive championship. Jadhav played in 95 IPL matches, scoring over 1200+ runs and four fifties to his credit.

Andrew Flintoff 7.5 crores (2008)

Former English skipper Andrew Flintoff played only one IPL season, and he was the most expensive pick for his side. CSK paid a huge sum of money amounting to Rs. 7.5 crores to bring him to the squad, but Flintoff didn’t play much in that season due to injury. Following this season, he announced his retirement from the IPL.

FAQ

Who is the most expensive player in CSK history?

Ben Stokes remains the most expensive player ever bought by Chennai Super Kings (CSK). He was acquired for ₹ 16.25 crore in the 2023 auction.

Who is CSK’s most expensive Indian player?

Deepak Chahar holds that distinction: he was bought by CSK for ₹ 14.00 crore in the 2022 auction — making him the most expensive Indian player that CSK has spent on.

Who was CSK’s costliest signing in 2023?

In the 2023 auction, CSK’s costliest signing was again Ben Stokes at ₹ 16.25 crore.

Who could be CSK’s most expensive player in 2025?

As of now, no 2025 auction has yet confirmed a signing that surpasses Ben Stokes’s ₹ 16.25 crore mark. The most expensive CSK buy in 2025 (so far) remains Noor Ahmad, purchased for ₹ 10.00 crore.

title: 'How will CSK fans feel…,' Dhoni's graceful reply when asked to support RCB
content:
Chennai Super Kings, the reigning champions of the 2024 Indian Premier League , went all out during the recent mini-auction in Dubai to secure their squad for the upcoming season. Despite facing some competition, CSK managed to fill the void left by Ambati Rayudu by acquiring the services of the uncapped power-hitter Sameer Rizvi.

Adding to their firepower, CSK made a smart move by bagging New Zealand all-rounder Rachin Ravindra at a bargain price of INR 1.8 crore. The Kiwi sensation, who impressed in the 2023 World Cup, is set to join forces with MS Dhoni’s squad. Furthermore, CSK invested significantly in Daryl Mitchell, replacing the released Ben Stokes with the Kiwi all-rounder by securing him for INR 14 crore.

A fan expressed a desire for Dhoni to replicate his success with CSK and bring home trophy for RCB

In the midst of these strategic acquisitions, CSK head coach Stephen Fleming addressed the succession plan for MS Dhoni during a press conference in Dubai. Meanwhile, a devoted Royal Challengers Bangalore (RCB) fan made a heartfelt plea to Dhoni, urging him to join RCB and lead the Virat Kohli-led side to IPL glory. The fan expressed a desire for Dhoni to replicate his success with CSK and bring home a trophy for RCB.

In response, Dhoni, known as “Thala” by CSK fans, displayed his trademark grace. He acknowledged RCB as a formidable team, emphasizing that in cricket, plans don’t always unfold as expected. Dhoni expressed his belief that every IPL team has a fair chance, much like how his acquisition as one of the most expensive players in CSK’s history has shaped the team’s success. He diplomatically explained that his focus is currently on his responsibilities with CSK, wishing all teams the best but emphasizing the challenges of supporting another team.

Dhoni’s response showcased humility and dedication to his current team while acknowledging the competitive spirit of the IPL. As CSK is ready for the 2024 season, fans eagerly anticipate another thrilling chapter in the franchise’s storied history under the captaincy of the legendary MS Dhoni.

title: Robin Minz's IPL Break: Gujarat Titans Sign 'Ranchi ka Gayle'
content:
Robin Minz, a 21-year-old cricketer from Ranchi, recently gained recognition in the IPL auction. Employed as a security guard at Ranchi airport, his father, Francis Xavier Minz, shared the moment when Gujarat Titans picked Robin for Rs 3.60 crore after a bidding war with Mumbai Indians.

The Minz family, originally from Telgaon, a village in Gumla district, has a background in sports, with a focus on hockey. However, Robin’s interest in cricket developed in Ranchi, influenced by the city’s cricket icon, MS Dhoni.

Robin’s journey in cricket started under the guidance of Chanchal Bhattacharya, Dhoni’s childhood coach. Chanchal recalls the early days when there was only one cricket academy in Ranchi. Robin, who aspired to be like Dhoni, excelled in wicket-keeping and powerful hitting.

“Koi nahi lega toh hum le lenge”, Dhoni said to Father Franics

Father Francis too has Dhoni story. “I had met Dhoni at the airport recently. He told me Francisji koi nahi lega toh hum le lenge. (If no one picks him, we will),” he says. Robin, often compared to West Indian player Chris Gayle, is known for his aggressive playing style, aiming for a high strike rate.

Training at the Sonnet Cricket Club in Ranchi under coaches like Asif Haque and S P Gautam, Robin is described as “Ranchi ka Gayle” due to his left-handed, powerful batting style. Despite efforts to encourage shots along the ground, Robin prefers aggressive hitting, reminiscent of Dhoni’s early days.

In a similar development, another young cricketer from Jharkhand, Kumar Kushagra, was picked by Delhi Capitals for Rs 7.20 crore in the same auction. This follows the trend of IPL teams recognizing and investing in emerging talents from the region, as seen previously with players like Ishan Kishan.

title: WATCH: MS Dhoni, Rishabh Pant spotted playing Tennis after IPL 2024 Auction in Dubai
content:
The IPL 2024 Auction not only created a massive buzz on social media for its anticipated player signings but also captured attention for a friendly game of tennis between Chennai Super Kings captain MS Dhoni and Delhi Capitals captain Rishabh Pant. The video of their post-auction tennis match quickly went viral on social platforms, drawing attention and admiration from cricket fans.

In the video, Rishabh Pant, who is in the process of recovering from a recent accident, showcased good movement on the tennis court, providing positive news for fans concerned about his well-being.

In an interview with IPL ahead of the auction, Pant reflected on the challenges he faced during his recovery from the accident, expressing gratitude for being alive. He described the initial phase as physically demanding due to the pain endured. However, Pant emphasized the progress in his recovery, stating, “I felt like I couldn’t face people and all, and I felt like I had to do something which gives me confidence.”

Despite the challenges, Pant actively participated in the auction proceedings. On the other hand, MS Dhoni, the skipper of Chennai Super Kings, was not present at the auction venue. Both players are set to lead their respective franchises in the upcoming IPL season, adding to the excitement and anticipation surrounding the league.

title: CSK Responds to Reports of Approaching MI for Player Trades
content:
Reports surfaced recently suggesting that there might be discontent within the Mumbai Indians (MI) camp, particularly in the wake of Hardik Pandya being named captain and his subsequent trade from Gujarat Titans.

Social media posts from players like Suryakumar Yadav and Jasprit Bumrah added fuel to these speculations. Some even hinted at the possibility of a trade involving key players such as Rohit Sharma, Suryakumar Yadav, and Jasprit Bumrah.

CSK Responds to Rumor of approaching MI for Rohit, Surya and Bumrah for trade

However, Mumbai Indians have unequivocally refuted these rumors. Speaking at the IPL 2024 auction in Dubai, Chennai Super Kings’ CEO Kasi Viswanathan addressed the speculations surrounding a potential trade with MI. Viswanathan emphasized that CSK neither believes in nor practices player trading as a principle. He dismissed any talks of approaching MI for a trade, stating, “We don’t trade players as a principle, and we also don’t have players to trade with Mumbai Indians. We have not approached them, and we don’t intend to either.”

Mark Boucher, the head coach of Mumbai Indians, also downplayed reports of internal strife within the team. Acknowledging the emotions involved in the decision to appoint Hardik Pandya as captain, Boucher explained that it’s a natural transition phase for the team. He highlighted Rohit Sharma’s remarkable contribution to MI over the years and clarified that the decision to move forward with a new captain is part of a strategic transition.

Boucher acknowledged social media rumours but asserted that the internal handling of the situation was optimal. He emphasized the need to focus on the transitional phase, recognizing the decisions made by the team to progress and evolve.

Both teams denied the talks of such trade

Both CSK and MI have strongly denied any talks of a player trade involving Rohit Sharma, Suryakumar Yadav, or Jasprit Bumrah. Mumbai Indians’ head coach emphasized the team’s commitment to a smooth transition, while Chennai Super Kings’ CEO clarified their stance on player trading as a matter of principle.

title: Rizvi to Ravindra: List of Players Bought by CSK in IPL 2024 Auction
content:
The Indian Premier League (IPL) auction for the upcoming 2024 season took place in Dubai on Tuesday, December 19. The mini-auction was a perfect opportunity for franchises to complete their squads. By adding exactly what’s needed at its best price they were given a chance to acquire what was missing the previous time.

Notably, players not only bring their skills with them but also fulfill many other requirements such as much-needed experience. In contrast, young and uncapped players work as modeling clay for the captain and the management that can be molded as required.

The Chennai-based IPL franchise Chennai Super Kings is a 5-time winner of the cash-rich tournament and is led by the most successful Indian captain, MS Dhoni. Under his guidance, CSK has repeatedly proven their mantel, despite being considered a squad full of senior players and lacking youth power.

Having said that, in this season’s auction, CSK management has bought a “pride” of young lions to complete their family.

From Rizvi to Ravindra, check out the full squad and list of players bought at the auction by Chennai Super Kings.

CSK IPL 2024 SQUAD

MS Dhoni (c), Moeen Ali, Deepak Chahar, Devon Conway, Tushar Deshpande, Shivam Dube, Ruturaj Gaikwad, Rajvardhan Hangargekar, Ravindra Jadeja, Ajay Mandal, Mukesh Choudhary, Matheesha Pathirana, Ajinkya Rahane, Shaik Rasheed, Mitchell Santner, Simarjeet Singh, Nishant Sindhu, Prashant Solanki, Maheesh Theekshana, Rachin Ravindra, Shardul Thakur, Daryl Mitchell, Sameer Rizvi, Mustafizur Rahman, Avanish Rao Aravelly. 

Squad strength: 25

Overseas players: 8

Players bought by CSK at IPL 2024 auction

Rachin Ravindra (Rs. 1.8 crore), Shardul Thakur (Rs. 4 crore), Daryl Mitchell (Rs. 14 crore), Sameer Rizvi (Rs. 8.40 crore), Mustafizur Rahman (Rs. 2 crore), Avanish Rao Aravelly (Rs. 20 lakh).

CSK purse remaining: Rs. 1 crore

CSK total player slots available: 0

CSK total overseas player slots available: 0

Rachin Ravindra earns Maiden IPL Contract after brilliant performance in World Cup 2024

Chennai Super Kings (CSK) secured the services of the promising New Zealand all-rounder Rachin Ravindra at a remarkable bargain, acquiring him for INR 1.8 crores during the IPL 2024 auction in Dubai. The auction saw an intense bidding battle between CSK and Delhi Capitals (DC) for the left-arm all-rounder, whose base price was INR 50 lakh.

Rachin Ravindra’s emergence came to the forefront during the 2023 World Cup in India, marking a breakthrough period in his international cricket career. Recognized as one of the emerging talents at the prestigious tournament, Rachin showcased his exceptional batting skills by notching up a maiden World Cup century in his debut match against England in the opening match.

Sameer Rizvi amongst the uncapped players bought by CSK

Chennai Super Kings made a significant addition to their squad by securing Uttar Pradesh batter Sameer Rizvi for a noteworthy sum of Rs 8.4 crore during the auction. Despite having a modest base price of Rs 20 lakh, Rizvi found himself at the center of a bidding war, initially between CSK and Gujarat Titans, later joined by Delhi Capitals. Gujarat Titans eventually withdrew at 7.6 crore, paving the way for CSK to secure the talented batter.

Sameer Rizvi gained prominence following his remarkable performance in the recent UP T20 League, where he accumulated 455 runs in nine innings for the Kanpur Superstars, including two centuries.

The 20-year-old showcased his prowess as a powerful hitter in the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy earlier in the season, smashing 18 sixes at a remarkable frequency, hitting one every 11 balls faced.

With an impressive record in T20 cricket, Rizvi has played 11 matches, amassing 295 runs at an average of 49.16. Additionally, he demonstrated his skills in the Men’s Under-23 State A tournament, contributing two fifties and two centuries, including a crucial 50-ball 84 in the final that played a pivotal role in Uttar Pradesh’s victory. Notably, Rizvi topped the charts for the most sixes in the tournament, hitting an impressive total of 37. His multi-faceted batting abilities make him a promising addition to the Chennai Super Kings lineup.

Lord Shardul, Daryl Mitchell ready to don the yellow jersey

Shardul Thakur has rejoined the MS Dhoni-led Chennai Super Kings (CSK) as the five-time champions successfully navigated bidding wars to secure the India all-rounder.

Having been released by the Kolkata Knight Riders after being traded for Rs 10.5 crore from Delhi Capitals, Shardul Thakur experienced a significant decrease in pay at the IPL auction. Nevertheless, the all-rounder is expected to be delighted to return to the CSK squad 2018 and play under the leadership of MS Dhoni.

Interestingly, in the IPL 2024 mock auction held on Monday, former CSK vice-captain Suresh Raina accurately predicted Shardul’s homecoming, emphasizing the all-rounder’s exceptional performances under MS Dhoni’s captaincy.

Shardul Thakur had a productive stint with Delhi Capitals, picking up 15 wickets in 14 matches, although conceding at a rate close to 10 runs per over. However, in the 2023 season, while playing for KKR, Shardul managed only 7 wickets in 11 matches and conceded at an average of 10.48 runs per over.

On the other hand, Kiwi batting all-rounder Daryl Mitchell became the third millionaire in the auction after Chennai Super Kings (CSK) took him for ₹14 crores.

In the 16th season of the IPL, the Kiwi opener did not take part in the tournament. His last season was in 2022 with Rajasthan Royals (RR).

He played only two matches in the extravagant T20 tournament and scored 33 runs. However, in the upcoming season, he will don the yellow jersey.

Also read: Who is Samir Rizvi? Uncapped player bought for 8.40Cr by Chennai Super Kings in Mini-auction

Thank you for reading.

title: CSK Buys Daryl Mitchell for ₹14 Crores After World Cup Heroics
content:
On Tuesday, Chennai Super Kings secured the services of another New Zealand all-rounder in the form of Daryl Mitchell. The player was sold to the Chennai based franchise for a staggering figure of 14 crores. And the player still cannot believe what change just one World Cup in India has brought for him.

Post the auction, the player was live with Stuff.co.nz where he was quoted saying:

“It was obviously a pretty special night for us as a family, sitting here with my wife watching the whole auction. To see your name come up and then to go through that whole experience is definitely something that will stick with us for the rest of our lives. Your heart starts to pump a little bit, as you see the paddles going up. But having been through the auction before and going unsold, it was a pretty special night last night to experience that.”

CSK buy Daryl Mitchell for whopping amount

Mitchell had a stellar outing in the ODI World Cup just last month. He was the part of the New Zealand set-up that reached the semifinal of the tournament. They had a stellar team, but Mitchell along with Rachin Ravindra managed to outshine the likes of others.

The Kiwi allrounder brought forth his batting masterclass in the tough Indian conditions. And in just 10 matches he managed to score 552 runs for his side. These include 2 centuries, both of which came against India.

This performance of his was met with several teams showing great interest in his services. Everyone had seen what great prowess he possessed against spin bowling, on slow Indian tracks. Hence, everyone was out to buy him. However, it was CSK in the end who managed to secure him for a whopping $2.5 Million Australian dollars.

They are the reason why we do all this– Mitchell on family

Further in the same interview, Mitchell also mentioned how these little things matter for the family. He told everyone that it was his little girl’s fifth birthday and this was perhaps the best present that he could have given her.

“She’s got a pretty good present, waking up to that – not that she understands what’s going on. But that’s the whole thing about these sorts of situations – it helps set up your family in many ways so that they can grow up and enjoy the things they love. For me, that’s the really cool thing about it. They’re the ones that are the reason why you do all this.”

Mitchell earlier was bought by Rajasthan Royals in 2022 auction as well. However, he did not get the chance to showcase his talent at the biggest stage, as he featured just in one game for the inaugural winners.

Now, he will be playing alongside his compatriots in the form of Devon Conway, Mitch Santner and Rachin Ravindra. It will be exciting to see how CSK will line up with this fired up Kiwi Stacked lineup.

title: Story of MS Dhoni IPL auction 2008: How much CSK Paid for him?
content:
MS Dhoni was so quick to become such a cult favourite in Chennai after leading the  Chennai Super Kings (CSK)  that it was a treat to watch him reach great success in a short time in the Indian Premier League (IPL). Since 2008, back when CSK signed him for a hefty amount of $1.5 million, Dhoni has been an irreplaceable player and leader, leading and guiding the team to a remarkable five IPL titles.

In MS Dhoni’s IPL auction in 2008, his purchase details, along with other star players like Shane Warne, Shoaib Akhtar, Adam Gilchrist, Muttiah Muralitharan, and Mahela Jayawardena, were noted on the auction sheet by Richard Madley. Here is a list of them all.

Table of Contents

  • Bidding story of MS Dhoni in IPL 2008 auction
  • MS Dhoni emerged as the Costliest player in IPL 2008 auction
  • RCB, MI, and CSK went on bidding war for MS Dhoni
  • MS Dhoni: CSK Player’s Icon player in 2008
  • MS Dhoni: Chennai Super King’s Talisman
  • Did a bidding war take place for MS Dhoni in IPL auction 2008?

  • What impact did MS Dhoni’s purchase have on CSK?

  • What were the reactions to MS Dhoni’s purchase at the time?
  • What is MS Dhoni’s IPL auction price in 2023?
  • What is MS Dhoni’s IPL auction price in 2024?

Bidding story of MS Dhoni in IPL 2008 auction

The bidding war and the IPL auction have only recently become a popularised normal thing in recent years. However, this was far to be the case back in the early days of IPL and certainly not in 2008, ahead of the inaugural edition of the mega T20 League.

In fact, the idea is so western to begin with that even the players that were bought in the first IPL had their prices mentioned in western figures of millions and hundreds of thousands. Unlike the Lakhs and Crores that we witness nowadays.

Among those figures stood out the name MS Dhoni seeing as he was bought as the most expensive player by Chennai Super Kings ahead of the auction. He was bought alongside several superstars’ names, including of Shane Warne, Adam Gilchrist, Shoaib Akhtar and Mahela Jayawardena. Yet, he managed to stand out.

Promptly, Dhoni’s IPL price became the talk of the town. Dhoni’s IPL auction history has been interesting ever since. 

MS Dhoni emerged as the Costliest player in IPL 2008 auction

There is no surprise to find that MS Dhoni IPL Auction price was the highest, making him the most expensive player in the inaugural edition of the IPL. However, for today’s fans, it might sometimes come as a surprise. Hence, the reason behind the same is worth mentioning.

The year was 2008, the memories of the 2007 triumph of the Indian team in South Africa were still very fresh in everyone’s mind. They had defeated Pakistan in the final of T20 World Cup, by the barest of margins. Anything, left or right could have seen India lose another marquee event.

But, there was one man who made the right decision. Played the right squad and then reaped the results of the same. It was none other than Mahendra Singh Dhoni. He was the mastermind behind the victory, and the world was quick to recognise that. As a result, when the first season of the Indian Premier League came around, everyone wanted him onboard, however, CSK IPL Auction Bid was the highest, making them welcome MS Dhoni. 

RCB, MI, and CSK went on bidding war for MS Dhoni

After 16 editions of IPL, can you imagine MS Dhoni playing for another franchise? Perhaps beside Virat Kohli in RCB? Or besides Rohit Sharma in Mumbai Indians? Well, it was almost turned into a reality in the 2008 IPL Auction Highlights because of MS Dhoni.

The then-captain of India in the shortest format of the game drew considerable interest from both Mumbai Indians and Royal Challengers Bangalore. Both the teams went neck to neck for the services of MS Dhoni in the IPL auction.

As the auction progressed, the RCB team pulled short of the price that was being demanded by the auctioneer, following interest by MI and Chennai Super Kings, as MS Dhoni IPL Auction price kept rising. 

Talking about the missed chance of buying MS Dhoni in 2008 by RCB, Richard Madley, former IPL Auctioneer, revealed: With this very bidding pad, RCB underbid for MS Dhoni IPL Price in the 2008 Auction, quite regretfully I must say.

MS Dhoni: CSK Player’s Icon player in 2008

Things still wouldn’t have been easier for both RCB and MI to sign the star in the form of MS Dhoni in IPL Auction 2008. And the reason behind the same was that both the teams already had an icon player on their team. 

According to the rules that were formed at that time, every team was allowed to have only one icon player and that player was to receive 15% of extra fees than the highest-paid pick by a team. The Bengaluru side had already claimed Rahul Dravid as their icon. The same constraint was faced by the Mumbai Indians side as well.

Chennai didn’t have any Icon player in their side, heading into the IPL auction, as a result they were able to buy MS Dhoni in IPL auction, which made CSK IPL Auction in 2008 noteworthy.  MS Dhoni Auction Price in 2008 was 9.5 Crores as CSK won the bid, making the list of CSK’s most expensive players even more impressive.. 

Dhoni IPL 2023 Price was INR 12 Crores. Even though several young players’ prices were higher, Dhoni 2023 price still remained as one of the highest. MS Dhoni IPL Auction 2024 was INR 12 Crores, same as Dhoni IPL 2023 Price. 

MS Dhoni: Chennai Super King’s Talisman

In the history of the IPL, the Chennai Super Kings have managed to come out at the top as one of the most successful franchises, mainly because of the fact that its remarkable leadership is that of MS Dhoni. Dhoni is not just the captain; he is the driving force behind CSK’s consistent success.

Over the years, Dhoni’s influence on the team has been massive which is evident in the numerous IPL titles CSK has won under his captaincy. What sets Dhoni apart is not just the trophies but the sacrifices he has made for the team. Dealing with a persistent knee injury, he played through pain, applying ice packs during and after games, showcasing a level of commitment that goes beyond expectations.

A moment that stood out to the fans and spectators alike was when Dhoni’s resilience occurred in the 2023 season. Despite his troublesome knee, he led CSK to their fifth title, a record-setting feat. This victory wasn’t just about the trophy; it was a proof of Dhoni’s constant dedication to the team’s success and fortified the impressive MSDhoni records in IPL.

More than just statistics, Dhoni’s impact on CSK is evident in his impressive captaincy, calm demeanor under pressure, and the ability to guide young talents. It can be said that CSK’s fortunes align with the rhythm of Dhoni’s leadership, and his influence extends beyond the cricket field.

As fans eagerly await each IPL season, there’s a collective acknowledgement that CSK’s success is inseparable from MS Dhoni’s presence. His leadership isn’t just about victories; it’s about creating a lasting legacy that solidifies his status as the driving force behind the Chennai Super Kings. And now, even though he no longer captains for his team, it is a well known fact that the team can never be separated from the persona of MS Dhoni. His mere presence fills fans and players alike with fire to win. To keep the legacy going.

According to the first auction of IPL, there surely was a bidding war for MS Dhoni between three teams: RCB, MI, and eventually the winners Chennai Super Kings.

MS Dhoni was the most valuable player in the inaugural season of IPL. He was bought by Chennai Super Kings for a staggering price of 9.5 Crore rupees.

Under MS Dhoni’s leadership, Chennai Super Kings have won 5 IPL titles, indicating his strong impact on the team. 

Who were the other top buys in the 2008 IPL auction?

MS Dhoni was bought alongside several superstars’ names, including Shane Warne, Adam Gilchrist, Shoaib Akhtar and Mahela Jayawardena. 

What were the reactions to MS Dhoni’s purchase at the time?

MS Dhoni’s iconic bidding price in the IPL instantly became the top of the town as he became the most expensive player in the IPL 2008 auction.

MS Dhoni IPL Auction 2024 was INR 12 Crores same as in IPL 2022.

title: Ms Dhoni IPL Runs Records CSK Record
content:
MS Dhoni is almost synonymous with the IPL team Chennai Super Kings and is popularly considered the best captain in the Indian Premier League. He started his IPL journey with the Chennai-based franchise and over the years has become a legend not just for the team but for the tournament itself, including his most important CSK statistics.

Every year, thousands of fans gather around in every stadium to witness the Indian great bat out in the middle and play some of the most flamboyant cricketing shots. He has been one of the longest surviving players since the inception of the league and on the way he has broken and created several records.

In this article we will take a look at Dhoni IPL runs Records that he has made with the Chennai Super Kings (CSK), along with his achievements in the 2023 IPL, and some of his standout performances over the years.

MS Dhoni’s record for CSK

Dhoni’s IPL records have been exceptional over the years. Dhoni has been part of 249 IPL games, playing in all 16 editions since 2008. He represented CSK in 14 editions, except for 2016 and 2017, when the team was banned. His contributions to CSK have led them to several milestones, including the CSK highest score in IPL history.

He has been quite an important player for Chennai since 2008. He played in 219 matches, scoring 4,508 runs with a staggering average of 40.25 and also maintained a quick strike rate of 137.52.

As captain in 211 games, he achieved a good win/loss ratio of 1.536, leading Chennai to victory in 126 matches. While Suresh Raina has more individual runs, Dhoni’s unbeaten 84 and consistent contributions make him a just an important of an asset. As of March 2025, , Dhoni’s role as a player remains to be essential to Chennai’s cricket success.

MS Dhoni IPL Records

The List of MS Dhoni highest scores in ipl history  is very long. The former Indian and CSK captain has been the heartbeat of the most pulsating franchise league in Cricket. He has been the biggest crowd-puller for the last two-three seasons of IPL. Hence, it doesn’t come as a surprise that he has some tremendous records to his name as well.

These records are the testament of his longevity in this format of the game. At the very old age of 42, the former Indian skipper is all set to return to the field, perhaps for one last time, not only as a player, but perhaps as the skipper of his out beloved team Chennai Super Kings.

Well, 42 MS Dhoni could have officially held the IPL record of the oldest player in the history of captain an IPL team. However that couldn’t happen, although that changes nothing as the player has already broken several IPL records. Hence, in this article we will take a look at MS Dhoni IPL highest score.

Most Dismissal as wicketkeeper in IPL

As if being a captain and player was not enough for the great man, the Dhoni IPL records also boast of a huge number when it comes to the player being a wicket keeper. Dhoni has been in a league of his own over the years with most dismissals as a wicketkeeper in the history of the tournament.

The player has taken the field as wicket keeper on 240 odd games and performed magic with his glove work. MS dhoni highest score in ipl dismissals with a number of 178 dismissals to his name. When further broken down, he has taken 137 catches as a wicket keeper and performed 36 stumpings as well.

Everyone knows that MS Dhoni is a master gloveman. He has been phenomenal from behind the stumps over the years. There is a section of the cricketing pundits who believe that he could change the game’s direction from behind the stumps. The manner in which he anticipated the batter’s mind, maneuvered his bowlers and field accordingly is the reason behind all the MS Dhoni achievements in IPL.

Awards won by MS Dhoni

The Chennai Super Kings, led by the man the myth the legend, MS Dhoni himself, have made a strong mark in the Indian Premier League. They have managed to win many trophies and regularly reached the playoffs, thus proving exceptional skill and dominance in the tournament.

However, the mention of awards won by MS Dhoni in IPL including Dhoni’s highest score in IPL will be incomplete without the trophies. Under his leadership, the team won the IPL title in 2010, 2011, 2018, 2021, and 2023, 2024 showing how good and consistent they have been over the years.

With Dhoni at helm, CSK always did great and made it to the semifinals or playoffs for 11 years in a row from 2008 to 2019. The only times they were not in the IPL playoffs was in 2020 and 2022 season, however, they won a season on the rebound everytime. In 2021 they cameback strong with a title win, and something similar happened in 2023. Let’s enumerate more on that:

In 2021, CSK made a strong comeback and won their fourth IPL title, showing their tenacity and strength and simply the fact that they could. They have done well over the years, reaching the semifinals 14 times and making it to the final nine times in 2008, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2015, 2018, 2019, and 2021 and 2024. Notably, they achieved a remarkable feat by reaching the top two in four successive seasons from 2010 to 2013, securing back-to-back titles in 2010 and 2011.

2025, will be the second time that MS Dhoni will not take on the mantle of captain. In this season, MS Dhoni Trophy Collection force will not be at work. But being a great leader that Dhoni already is, he will be hoping to provide the best of insights to his successor to ensure the team reaches new heights.

MS Dhoni IPL Runs

Even with the bat in hand, MS Dhoni has been very impactful and has scored a total of 5192 runs in 227 innings, at an average of 39 and strike rate of 137. He might not have batted at the most favorable positions, but had some great impact with the bat in hand and it is evident in the MS Dhoni IPL Total Runs’ tally.

The Indian keeper has been able to surpass the total of 400 on 4 different occasions while csk dhoni batting at one of the toughest position for his team. Batting so low down the order, these kind of numbers are really staggering, along with the total average that the player has maintained.

In the very first season, that saw Chennai go all the way to the final MS Dhoni IPL Runs tally reached 414. After that, he repeated the feat in 2013 with another good season that saw him 461 runs at an average of 41 and strike rate of 162.

When he returned with Chennai Super Kings in 2018, MS Dhoni was a different beast, and produced one of his best season with the bat in hand. He once again went past the score of 400 runs and scored 3 fifties in the tournament. What’s more fascinating is the number of boundaries scored by him in the season. He smashed 24 fours and whopping 30 sixes throughout the season.

MS Dhoni Highest IPL Scores CSK

MS Dhoni: Debut IPL game

In MS Dhoni’s first IPL game for CSK on April 19, 2008, against Punjab Kings (formerly Kings XI Punjab) in Mohali, he didn’t have a great start. Dhoni, who is known for being an excellent captain and finisher, only scored two runs in three balls before getting out to James Hopes.

Despite this, CSK performed really well as a team and scored an impressive 240-6 in 20 overs. They ended up winning the match by 33 runs. Although Dhoni didn’t have a standout performance in his first game with the bat, it marked the beginning of his important journey with CSK in the Indian Premier League.

As the years went by, his leadership and strategic skills played a big role in making CSK one of the most successful teams in the IPL. This game as it turns out was just a stepping stone in the long list of MS Dhoni achievements in IPL.

What next? Will Dhoni Feature in IPL 2025?

Mahendra Singh Dhoni is set to make a comeback as the most important player of the Chennai Super Kings in the 2025 Indian Premier League season. The team officially announced this on their social media on November 26th. Dhoni, who has led the team to victory in five IPL seasons (2010, 2011, 2018, 2021, and 2023), was uncertain about participating in the upcoming edition of the lucrative league at first.

How many titles has MS Dhoni won in IPL?

MS Dhoni has won five titles in the Indian Premier League. He has achieved this as captain of the Chennai Super Kings, leading them to victory in:

  • 2010 IPL season
  • 2011 IPL season
  • 2018 IPL season
  • 2021 IPL season
  • 2023 IPL season

How Many Champions League T20 Trophy has MS Dhoni won?

MS Dhoni has won two Champions League T20 trophies, both while captaining the Chennai Super Kings (CSK):

  • 2010 Champions League T20: CSK beat the South Australian Redbacks in the final.
  • 2014 Champions League T20: CSK triumphed over the Sri Lankan team Colombo Kings in the final.

It’s worth mentioning though that the Champions League T20 was a tournament featuring the winners of major T20 leagues from around the world. It was discontinued after the 2014 season, so Dhoni’s record of two titles remains still impressive.

In how many games has MS Dhoni captained Chennai Super Kings?

MS Dhoni has captained Chennai Super Kings in an impressive 214 games across various tournaments, including:

Indian Premier League (IPL):

  • 200 matches: Dhoni has led CSK in 200 IPL matches, the most by any captain in the league’s history. He has a win percentage of 61.88% in these matches, leading CSK to five IPL titles.

Champions League T20:

  • 14 matches: Dhoni captained CSK in 14 Champions League T20 matches, leading them to two tournament victories.

Overall:

  • 214 matches: Combining both IPL and Champions League T20, Dhoni has captained CSK in a total of 214 matches, maintaining his position as one of the most successful captains in franchise cricket history.

FAQ:

Which IPL team was captained by MS Dhoni from 2008 to 2021?

MS Dhoni captained the Chennai Super Kings from 2008 to 2021. He also led the Rising Pune Supergiant in 2016 when CSK was temporarily suspended from the league.

How many runs of MS Dhoni in IPL?

MS dhoni total runs in ipl was over 4,800 runs .

What world record does Dhoni hold in the IPL?

MS Dhoni holds the world record for the most matches as captain in IPL history, having led Chennai Super Kings in over 200 matches.

What is Dhoni’s highest score in the IPL, and against which team did he achieve it?

title: CSK Instagram Followers: Chennai becomes Most Followed IPL Team on Instagram
content:
CSK’s Instagram followers have reached a new milestone, making them the most followed IPL team on Instagram. This achievement highlights the team’s immense popularity and strong fan engagement.

Recently, CSK surpassed other IPL teams in Instagram followers, achieving a significant milestone in their social media presence.

CSK’s Instagram Followers Milestone

Interestingly, the arch-rivals of Mumbai Indians, the Chennai Super Kings (CSK), found themselves benefiting from this development. As a result of the backlash faced by Mumbai Indians, CSK now claims the top spot as the most-followed IPL team on Instagram.

IPL Teams Instagram Followers

Rohit Sharma, who took over the captaincy of Mumbai Indians from the legendary Sachin Tendulkar in 2013, has been instrumental in guiding the team to five IPL titles. In his inaugural season as captain, Rohit led MI to their maiden IPL championship, and the team has continued its winning streak with four additional titles.

As a measure of the impact of this leadership change, Mumbai Indians’ Instagram handle experienced a significant loss of followers. The count dropped by as many as 150,000 followers, indicating the extent of discontent among fans.

Despite this setback, Mumbai Indians remain a close second to CSK, both boasting a substantial following of 13 million on Instagram. The news of Rohit Sharma being replaced by Hardik Pandya evidently did not sit well with the fan base, highlighting the emotional connection and loyalty fans have towards their team’s leadership.

What makes CSK Special? Why is CSK the most followed team? 

On Thursday, following the bombshell announcement by Mumbai Indians (MI) regarding Rohit Sharma’s departure as captain, the Chennai Super Kings (CSK) took to Twitter to acknowledge Rohit’s decade-long journey with the team. In a tweet, CSK expressed their respect for Rohit’s spirited challenges, accompanying the message with a photo of MS Dhoni shaking hands with Rohit.

Rohit Sharma assumed the captaincy for MI in 2013, taking over from Ricky Ponting four games into the season. The team secured their first IPL title that year by defeating CSK in the final by 23 runs. MI’s second title came in 2015, once again triumphing over CSK in the final.

An intriguing twist unfolded in 2017 when MI faced Rising Pune Supergiant in the final, a team captained by Dhoni during CSK’s suspension from the league. MI clinched their third title with a victory in that final. The fourth IPL title for MI was secured in 2019 with a thrilling win over CSK, and they went on to successfully defend their title in 2020, defeating Delhi Capitals.

Rohit Sharma, now the fourth-highest run-scorer in IPL history with 6,211 runs, contributed significantly as captain, amassing 3,986 runs across 157 innings at a strike rate of 129.37, including 25 fifties. Among IPL captains, his run tally is the third-highest after Virat Kohli’s 4,994 runs and MS Dhoni’s 4,660.

Hardik Pandya, Rohit’s successor, began his IPL career with MI in 2015, scoring 1,476 runs and taking 42 wickets for the franchise. Initially signed as an uncapped player for INR 10 lakh, Pandya played a pivotal role in MI’s title-winning campaigns in 2015, 2017, 2019, and 2020.

As of now, Chennai Super Kings (CSK) is the most followed IPL team on Instagram, with over 12 million followers.
