Chennai Super Kings (CSK) has over 15.9 million followers on Instagram, making them the most followed IPL team.

Why is CSK the most followed IPL team on Instagram?

CSK’s popularity can be attributed to their consistent performance, star players like MS Dhoni, and strong fan engagement on social media platforms.

title: Madras HC Sentences IPS Officer After MS Dhoni's Contempt Case
content:
Former Indian cricket captain MS Dhoni has taken legal action against IPS officer Sampath Kumar, filing a contempt of court petition. The Madras High Court quickly responded by sentencing Kumar to 15 days in prison for his alleged involvement in spreading false claims about Dhoni during the 2013 Indian Premier League.

Accusations made by Zee Media and others

The case revolves around accusations made by Zee Media, Kumar, and others, suggesting Dhoni’s involvement in betting and match-fixing during the 2013 IPL. Justices SS Sundar and Sunder Mohan, however, suspended Kumar’s sentence for 30 days, allowing him to appeal the decision.

During the 2013 IPL, the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) faced challenges as Chennai Super Kings and Rajasthan Royals came under scrutiny. CSK’s principal owner, Gurunath Meiyappan, was accused of betting and sharing confidential information. The Royals faced severe consequences, with players Ankeet Chavan, Ajit Chandila, and Sreesanth receiving lengthy bans for their involvement in spot-fixing. CSK also faced a two-year ban due to management’s alleged role in spot-fixing, making it a tough period for Dhoni.

In response, Dhoni filed a defamation case

In response to the allegations, the 42-year-old cricketer filed a defamation suit against Zee Media, Kumar, and others for falsely implicating him in the scandal. Dhoni obtained a restraining order against media houses and Kumar, who was investigating the matter, preventing them from making malicious statements about him.

Zee Media and others countered Dhoni’s defamation suit with written statements. In the course of the legal proceedings, the CSK captain lodged a contempt of court petition, alleging that Kumar had made additional defamatory statements. Advocate PR Raman represented Dhoni throughout the legal proceedings.

title: MS Dhoni’s iconic No.7 jersey retired, no longer up for grabs
content:
The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) has decided to honor former captain M.S. Dhoni by retiring his iconic No. 7 jersey, following in the footsteps of a similar tribute to Sachin Tendulkar’s No. 10 in 2017. This move means that current and upcoming Indian cricketers, especially debutants, are not allowed to choose these revered numbers.

BCCI official informed players of National Team

According to a senior BCCI official, the directive has been communicated to players, emphasizing that the No. 7 jersey, worn by Dhoni during his illustrious career, is now off-limits. This decision limits the choices available to Team India players when selecting their jersey numbers. Despite the International Cricket Council (ICC) allowing players to pick any number between 1 and 100, the BCCI has designated around 60 numbers for regular and potential team members.

Retiring tradition of jersey numbers is not unique.

This tradition of retiring jersey numbers is not unique to cricket. In soccer, the Italian Serie A club Napoli has refrained from assigning the No. 10 jersey since Diego Maradona’s departure, and the Chicago Bulls permanently retired the No. 23 jersey in basketball after Michael Jordan’s retirement. These gestures symbolize the irreplaceability of legendary players.

The BCCI’s decision to retire Tendulkar’s No. 10 in 2017 was prompted by an incident involving Mumbai fast bowler Shardul Thakur, who wore the number and faced backlash on social media for allegedly trying to imitate Tendulkar. Thakur eventually switched to No. 54, highlighting the emotional attachment fans have to iconic numbers.

Even at the junior level, players aspire to wear iconic numbers. Shubman Gill, a promising young batsman, couldn’t obtain his preferred No. 7 during his U-19 days and settled for No. 77, which he continues to wear in the senior team.

Currently, popular jersey numbers among Indian players include Virat Kohli’s No. 18 and Rohit Sharma’s No. 45. As these players age and potentially retire, it wouldn’t be surprising if their jersey numbers are also retired as a mark of respect and acknowledgment of their significant contributions to Indian cricket.

CSK’s 222 for 5 against Delhi Daredevils in 2012 and 217 for 7 versus Lucknow Super Giants in 2023 also feature prominently. In 2024, LSG chased down 213 for 4 in 19.3 overs, marking another high-scoring IPL match in Chennai.

title: Rishabh Pant to Replace MS Dhoni at CSK in IPL 2025?
content:
Anticipation is building as the mini auctions for the IPL 2024 draw near, with fans eagerly awaiting the 17th edition of the tournament. A significant focal point of interest is the participation of former India captain MS Dhoni, who has led the Chennai Super Kings to five IPL titles. At 42 years old, Dhoni has confirmed his involvement in the upcoming season, but speculation suggests that this season could potentially mark a farewell for the legendary wicketkeeper-batsman.

With Chennai Super Kings (CSK) now contemplating a suitable successor to Dhoni, former India wicketkeeper Deep Dasgupta has voiced his opinion, suggesting that Delhi Capitals’ star Rishabh Pant is the ideal candidate. Pant, who has yet to make a comeback after a serious road accident in December last year, has significantly improved his training, making his presence likely in IPL 2024.

Dasgupta remarked, “Don’t be surprised if they get Rishabh Pant by IPL 2025. MS Dhoni and Rishabh Pant are very close. Obviously, Rishabh adores MS, and MS also likes him very much. They spend a lot of time together. Their connection and Rishabh’s thinking are very similar, considering he is very attacking and positive. He’s always talking about winning and whatnot.”

Rishabh Pant yet to join DC for training ahead of IPL 2024

While Delhi Capitals have already initiated their training for IPL 2024, Pant was not practicing with the team then, as confirmed by Sourav Ganguly. Ganguly assured that Pant, who is now in good health, will participate in the IPL next season, with expectations of further improvement by January 2024.

In a related development, Chennai Super Kings, the defending champions, have released England all-rounder Ben Stokes and will enter the mini auctions with a substantial purse of Rs 32.2 crore. The auctions promise intriguing dynamics as teams strategize and make crucial decisions for the upcoming season.

Thank you for reading.
excerpt: With CSK now contemplating a suitable successor to Dhoni, Deep Dasgupta said that Delhi Capitals' Rishabh Pant is the ideal candidate.

title: Why Was CSK Banned for 2 Years? The Complete IPL Suspension Story
content:
Chennai Super Kings (CSK) were banned from the IPL for two seasons, 2016 and 2017, after team official Gurunath Meiyappan was found guilty of betting during the 2013 IPL season. The Justice R. M. Lodha Committee ruled that his conduct brought the game into disrepute and imposed a two-year suspension on CSK.

The ban was part of the fallout from the wider 2013 IPL betting and spot-fixing scandal, which involved allegations and investigations concerning players, team officials and others connected to the league. Importantly, CSK were not suspended simply because the broader scandal occurred. The franchise’s punishment was specifically linked to the findings against Meiyappan, who was identified as a team official associated with CSK.

The suspension meant CSK could not participate in the 2016 and 2017 IPL seasons. During those two years, several CSK players represented the newly formed Rising Pune Supergiant, while others moved to different franchises. CSK returned to the IPL in 2018, marking the end of one of the most significant suspensions in the league’s history.

Why Was CSK Banned From the IPL?

Chennai Super Kings (CSK) were suspended from the IPL for two seasons, 2016 and 2017, because team official Gurunath Meiyappan was found guilty of betting during the 2013 IPL season.

However, one point is often misunderstood: CSK itself was not found guilty of spot-fixing or match-fixing. The franchise was punished because the conduct of its official was held to have brought the game into disrepute.

What Happened During the 2013 IPL Scandal?

The controversy began during the 2013 IPL season, when a major investigation uncovered allegations of betting and spot-fixing involving individuals connected with the tournament. The scandal led to investigations by the Delhi Police and Mumbai Police, bringing players, team officials and other individuals under scrutiny.

One of the people investigated was Gurunath Meiyappan, who was closely associated with CSK. He was the son-in-law of N. Srinivasan, then the owner of India Cements, the company that owned CSK, and was also serving as BCCI president during the period. Meiyappan had publicly represented himself as a CSK team official and was involved with the franchise during the 2013 season. The incident became widely known as the 2013 IPL Spot-Fixing Scandal. 

The investigations examined Meiyappan’s betting activities and his communications with others involved in the betting network. The Supreme Court-appointed Justice R. M. Lodha Committee subsequently examined the evidence and concluded that Meiyappan had been involved in betting on IPL matches.

Importantly, the finding against Meiyappan was betting, not spot-fixing. There was no finding by the Lodha Committee that CSK as a franchise had fixed matches.

Why Was CSK Suspended If It Wasn’t Guilty of Spot-Fixing?

This is where the distinction between an individual’s offence and the franchise’s punishment becomes important.

The Lodha Committee treated Meiyappan as a team official of CSK. His betting activities were therefore considered conduct connected to the franchise, and the committee held that his actions had brought the game of cricket and the IPL into disrepute.

The committee consequently imposed a two-year suspension on CSK, preventing the franchise from participating in the 2016 and 2017 IPL seasons. Rajasthan Royals received the same two-year suspension following findings concerning its team official Raj Kundra.

So, the simplest way to understand the CSK ban is this: Meiyappan was found guilty of betting, and because he was considered a CSK team official, the franchise was held responsible for the reputational damage caused by his conduct. CSK was not banned because the team itself was found to have fixed matches.

The suspension ended after the 2017 season, allowing CSK to return to the IPL in 2018.

How Long Was CSK Banned?

Chennai Super Kings (CSK) were banned from the IPL for two seasons: 2016 and 2017. The suspension was imposed in 2015, meaning CSK missed the next two editions of the tournament before returning for the 2018 IPL season.

CSK’s IPL Absence in 2016 and 2017

The suspension took effect from the 2016 season. As a result, CSK did not participate in the ninth edition of the IPL, which began in April 2016. It was the first time the franchise had been absent from an IPL season since the league was established in 2008.

CSK remained out of the competition in 2017, completing its second and final season of suspension. To fill the gap created by CSK and Rajasthan Royals, two new franchises, Rising Pune Supergiant and Gujarat Lions, competed in the 2016 and 2017 editions.

CSK’s players were also temporarily separated during this period. A player draft was held ahead of the 2016 season, allowing the two replacement franchises to build their squads using players from the suspended teams.

The two-year absence therefore meant CSK did not play a single IPL match during either the 2016 or 2017 season.

CSK’s Return in 2018

CSK became eligible to return once its suspension had been completed. The franchise made its comeback in the 2018 IPL, alongside Rajasthan Royals, which had served the same two-season suspension.

The return was more than a routine reinstatement. CSK immediately returned to competitive action with much of its familiar core and went on to win the 2018 IPL title, defeating Sunrisers Hyderabad in the final.

In simple terms, the timeline is:

  • 2015: Two-year suspension announced.
  • 2016: CSK missed the IPL.
  • 2017: CSK missed the IPL again.
  • 2018: CSK returned to the IPL.

So, if the question is “How many years was CSK banned?”, the answer is two years. The franchise served the suspension across the 2016 and 2017 IPL seasons and returned to the competition in 2018.

What Happened to CSK During the 2016 and 2017 Ban?

For two IPL seasons, Chennai Super Kings did not participate in the tournament. The franchise served its suspension throughout 2016 and 2017, leaving one of the IPL’s most established teams on the sidelines. For fans, CSK During the Ban meant watching the franchise’s players take the field in different colours while waiting for the yellow jersey to return. 

The ban applied to the franchise, not its entire playing squad. CSK’s players were not individually banned because they were not found to have been involved in the conduct that led to the franchise’s suspension. Instead, the players became available to represent other IPL teams during the two-season period.

Where Did MS Dhoni Play?

The biggest change for CSK fans was seeing MS Dhoni in another team’s jersey.

Dhoni, who had captained CSK since the inaugural IPL season, joined Rising Pune Supergiant (RPSG), one of the two franchises introduced during CSK and Rajasthan Royals’ absence. He captained RPSG in the 2016 season, leading the side during its first IPL campaign.

In 2017, Dhoni remained with RPSG but no longer served as captain, with Steve Smith taking over the leadership role. Dhoni continued to play as a wicketkeeper-batter before CSK’s eventual return in 2018.

How Did the IPL Look Without CSK?

The IPL itself continued without Chennai Super Kings. 

For CSK supporters, however, the two seasons felt very different. The franchise had built an enormous following over its first eight years in the competition, and its absence left fans waiting for the day they could see the famous yellow jersey back on the field.

The anticipation extended well beyond Chennai. CSK’s return had become one of the most eagerly awaited storylines in Indian cricket, with supporters across the country looking forward to seeing the franchise and Dhoni reunite in the IPL.

After two seasons away, that wait finally ended in 2018, when CSK returned to the tournament.

How Did CSK Return to the IPL in 2018?

The wait was finally over. CSK’s two-season IPL suspension officially ended on 14 July 2017, clearing the way for the franchise to return for the 2018 season. After two years without the yellow jersey, Chennai Super Kings were back—and they returned with a squad that felt instantly familiar to their fans.

Rebuilding the Chennai Family

Ahead of the 2018 mega auction, CSK retained three of its biggest pillars: MS Dhoni, Suresh Raina and Ravindra Jadeja. At the auction, the franchise used its Right to Match cards to bring back Dwayne Bravo and Faf du Plessis, taking the number of retained core players to five.

And suddenly, it felt like Chennai was home again.

Raina was back at number three, Jadeja was donning the yellow and bowling tight spells through the middle overs, while DJ Bravo was outfoxing batters with his variations. Dhoni was back behind the stumps and, more importantly, back at the helm. Familiar faces returned while new players joined the Chennai family, creating that unmistakable feeling CSK had never really left.

The season itself carried a festive energy. Every game felt like a reunion. The yellow jerseys were back, the supporters were roaring again, and the franchise was creating memories almost immediately. There were iconic moments aplenty, with Dhoni looking close to his best and the experienced core delivering when it mattered.

The 2018 Championship Run

CSK finished the league stage second and defeated Sunrisers Hyderabad in Qualifier 1, with Faf du Plessis’ unbeaten 67 guiding them into the final. SRH returned through Qualifier 2, setting up another clash with Chennai. 

In the final, Shane Watson’s magnificent unbeaten 117 powered CSK to an eight-wicket victory and their third IPL title. The triumph was especially significant after Mumbai Indians had matched CSK’s three titles a year earlier. 

After two seasons away, Chennai returned to the IPL not just as contenders, but as champions, making the CSK 2018 comeback truly unforgettable for CSK fans. 

How Did the Two-Year Ban Affect CSK’s Legacy?

Even with five IPL titles today, the two-year suspension remains an inescapable black mark in Chennai Super Kings’ history. It damaged the franchise’s reputation, interrupted its momentum and cost CSK two full seasons in which it could have competed for another championship.

Two Years That Changed the Story

For CSK fans, the absence was about more than missing cricket. The franchise had been one of the defining teams of the IPL, and suddenly, it was gone. Supporters carried the disappointment through two seasons while the tournament moved on without the yellow jersey.

There was another painful reminder of what CSK had missed: Mumbai Indians won the 2017 IPL title while Chennai was serving its suspension. MI’s victory gave its biggest rival another championship during a period when CSK could not even compete for one.

The suspension therefore left a genuine gap in CSK’s sporting legacy. Those two seasons cannot simply be removed from the record, and neither can the reputational damage that accompanied them.

2018: Success Delayed, Not Denied

Then came the return.

CSK’s first match back in 2018 was against Mumbai Indians, and it produced an instant IPL classic. Chasing 166, Chennai were in serious trouble at 118/8 before Dwayne Bravo’s extraordinary 68 off 30 balls turned the match around. Kedar Jadhav then finished the job with a dramatic cameo.

It was the perfect opening chapter to the comeback. Bravo, one of the players CSK had brought back at the auction, showed exactly why he belonged in that yellow jersey.

From there, 2018 became one memorable match after another, culminating in Shane Watson’s unbeaten 117 in the final and CSK’s third IPL title.

That victory changed the sporting narrative. The suspension had delayed CSK’s pursuit of success, but it had not denied the franchise its chance to return to the top. The triumph was sweeter precisely because of everything that had come before it.

The ban will always remain part of CSK’s history. Five titles cannot erase that chapter—but the 2018 comeback ensured that the chapter did not define the story.

FAQs

  1. Was CSK banned for match-fixing?

No. CSK was not found guilty of match-fixing; its two-year suspension followed findings against team official Gurunath Meiyappan.

  1. Was CSK banned for spot-fixing?

No. CSK was not found guilty of spot-fixing; Meiyappan was found guilty of betting on IPL matches.

  1. Why was CSK banned for two years?

CSK was suspended because the Justice R. M. Lodha Committee held that Meiyappan’s conduct as a team official brought the IPL and the game into disrepute.

  1. Which years was CSK banned?

CSK missed the 2016 and 2017 IPL seasons after receiving its two-year suspension in 2015.

  1. Who was involved in the CSK betting case?

Gurunath Meiyappan, a CSK team official, was the key figure in the franchise’s betting case and was found guilty of betting during the 2013 IPL.

  1. When did CSK return to IPL?

CSK returned to the IPL in 2018, immediately reaching the final and defeating Sunrisers Hyderabad to win its third IPL title.
excerpt: Let us understand the reason behind why was the top most franchise of IPL; Chennai Super Kings banned for the 2016 and 2017 season.

title: Ruturaj Gaikwad Reveals MS Dhoni's Message on Team's Score
content:
Ruturaj Gaikwad, India’s opening batsman, credits his enhanced grasp of the T20 format to the valuable guidance provided by Chennai Super Kings captain MS Dhoni. Gaikwad’s impressive display in the ongoing T20I series against Australia, where he scored 213 runs, featuring a century in the third Guwahati match, highlights the positive influence of Dhoni’s mentorship.

Communication between Ruturaj and MS Dhoni

Gaikwad appreciates the valuable lessons he learned during his time with CSK, highlighting Mahendra Singh Dhoni’s careful approach to understanding the game. According to Gaikwad, Dhoni consistently communicates about the team’s goals and the specific needs for a situation, whether the batsman is starting or well into the innings. Gaikwad believes that this mindset has greatly influenced his approach, and he aims to continue applying these insights.

In the third game, despite Gaikwad’s impressive century, India experienced a defeat, largely attributed to an outstanding performance by Glenn Maxwell. Gaikwad’s century was a significant moment as it became the first time an Indian player scored a hundred against the strong Australian team in T20Is. The CSK opener now joins an elite club of Indian players, such as Rohit Sharma, KL Rahul, Virat Kohli, Suresh Raina, Yashasvi Jaiswal, Deepak Hooda, and Suryakumar Yadav, who have achieved the milestone of scoring a century in T20 internationals.

“He sends a message that you have to look for the team score and what the team requires irrespective of the situation of the game. In T20s, you always have to be ahead of the game mentally and I give a lot of importance to that. The night before, I visualise what kind of situation may occur during the game, and how the pitch may behave,” Ruturaj said.

India is getting ready for the last T20I against Australia in Bengaluru, and Gaikwad’s path showcases how Dhoni’s guidance and the significant role of CSK have shaped his approach to T20 cricket.

title: CSK CEO Confirms MS Dhoni’s Return for IPL 2024 Season
content:
Chennai Super Kings (CSK) have retained MS Dhoni for the upcoming 2024 season of the Indian Premier League (IPL), putting an end to speculations about the legendary cricketer’s future. Dhoni, who initially left the cricketing community wondering about a potential retirement after the 2023 season, confirmed his commitment to return for the 2024 season after working on his fitness.

CSK fans, known for donning the iconic yellow jerseys with Dhoni’s name, had become a distinctive sight during the 2023 IPL season, emphasizing the captain’s immense popularity and influence. Despite grappling with a knee injury throughout the 2023 season, Dhoni, with heavy strapping on his knee, consistently contributed to CSK’s performance.

CSK CEO offers a big statement on whether MS Dhoni will play IPL 2024

In a statement about Dhoni’s comeback, CSK CEO Kasi Viswanathan expressed confidence in the captain’s commitment, stating, “If our leader has given a word, he has never gone back. He already told what he was planning to do in that interview. I am sure that knowing MS, he will always do what he has committed to do. He is quite fit. Thalaivan is thalaivan (our leader is our leader).”

Dhoni, known as “Thala” by CSK fans, underwent a successful left knee surgery in June 2023 and has been actively training in Ranchi since the conclusion of the 2023 season. Despite managing injuries, Dhoni led CSK to a remarkable fifth IPL title in the previous season, further solidifying his status as one of India’s most successful cricket captains.

As the only active player who captained a team in the inaugural IPL season in 2008, Dhoni remains a cricketing icon, having concluded his international career on August 15, 2020. Notably, he is the sole international captain to secure victories in the ODI World Cup, T20 World Cup, and the Champions Trophy. Dhoni also led India to the top of the Test rankings in 2009, leaving an indelible mark on Indian cricket.

title: MS Dhoni Spotted Driving Mercedes G Class With a Special Number Plate
content:
Former Indian captain MS Dhoni, known for his prowess both on and off the cricket field, recently made headlines as talks settled on his retention by Chennai Super Kings (CSK) for the upcoming Indian Premier League (IPL) 2024. However, Dhoni’s latest appearance in the limelight extends beyond the cricket pitch.

A video surfaced on social media, shared by Dhoni’s ‘tennis partner’ Sumeet Kumar Bajaj, capturing the cricketing legend behind the wheel of an exquisite Mercedes G class car. The footage, believed to be from Ranchi, showcases Dhoni cruising in the black Mercedes, adding another chapter to his well-known passion for cars and bikes.

Dhoni’s affinity for vehicles, vintage bikes, and luxury cars has been a recurring theme on social media. The recently shared video is another testament to his love for automobiles. Notably, the car in question bore the registration number 0007, a symbolic figure closely associated with Dhoni throughout his cricketing career. Even now, he continues to sport the No. 7 jersey for Chennai Super Kings in the IPL.

Looking ahead to the cricketing front, Dhoni’s CSK faces a challenging task in the upcoming IPL auction. title: Ruturaj Gaikwad Hits Maiden T20I Century vs Australia
content:
In order to win the five-match series against Australia, Ruturaj Gaikwad opened and had a great game by playing a huge part in building India’s strong total in the third T20I in Guwahati. This match also saw Ruturaj Gaikwad’s T20I century where the audience got the treat of watching Ruturah Gaikwad maiden T20 hundred. After doing so well with a fifty in the last game, he kept up his aggressive batting against the Australian bowlers at Barsapara Cricket Stadium and the match more or less seemed like it was Ruturaj Gaikwad century vs Australia . He then proceeded to score a phenomenal century, setting new records for the series.

Following quite an easy win in the second T20I against Australia, Suryakumar Yadav and his team decided to make a single change in their lineup. By bringing pacer Avesh Khan in to replace Mukesh Kumar and confirming Deepak Chahar as Mukesh’s replacement while he took a break for his marriage.

In the Guwahati match, India chose to bat first but was faced challenges early on in the game itself when the young players of the team Yashasvi Jaiswal (6) and Ishan Kishan (0) filed to score well which ultimately ended up bringing India to 24-2.

Table of Contents

  • Ruturaj and Suryakumar took the score to 80-2 in first 10 overs
  • Ruturaj Gaikwad’s first International century; joins Rohit and Virat club
  • Second-highest individual score for India in T20I cricket; 123 runs off 57 balls

Ruturaj and Suryakumar took the score to 80-2 in first 10 overs

Despite initial setbacks, Gaikwad and skipper Suryakumar worked together to bring India back into the game, taking the team to 80-2 within the first 10 overs. After Suryakumar’s having left the field in the important 10th over, Gaikwad took hold of the charge by pushing India towards a strong total. He managed to reach his half-century in 32 balls and speeding up in the final overs, achieving his century in the next 20 balls.

Ruturaj Gaikwad’s first International century; joins Rohit and Virat club

The Chennai Super Kings player, Ruturaj Gaikwad succeeded in scoring his first international century in only 52 balls. This puts him in the same category as Rohit Sharma, KL Rahul, and Virat Kohli, who have also achieved centuries for India in T20Is. Gaikwad is now the ninth Indian batter to reach a century in T20Is and the sixth to do so in the last two years. His remarkable performance is also reflected in the CSK highest score in IPL scorecard.

Second-highest individual score for India in T20I cricket; 123 runs off 57 balls

His phenomenal score of 123 runs off 57 balls has helped India reach a total of 222-3 in 20 overs and became a part of the India vs Australia 3rd T20I highlights. This makes it the second-highest individual score for India in T20I cricket, with Shubman Gill’s 126* against New Zealand being the highest. It is also important to mention that Gaikwad with this feat became first Indian batter to score a T20I century against Australia. This day is sure to be remembered in Ruturaj Gaikwad’s cricket records.

title: Ruturaj Gaikwad Recreates Iconic Sweep Against Australia in Third T20
content:
Ever since his triumph at the Asian Games 2022, Ruturaj Gaikwas has been on cloud nine while batting for the Indian Cricket team. And an example of the same was on display yet again in the third T20I between India and Australia here in Guwahati.

In the latest CSK player News, Ruturaj Gaikwad played a magnificent 123* run inning of just 57 balls to help the Indian team post a total of 222 in their 20 overs.

However, the highlight of his inning was the shot against Aron Hardie that Gaikwad swept over the deep backward square leg to get into his 90s in the game.

Ruturaj Gaikwad sweeps Aron Hardie over square leg

Ruturaj had already smacked 2 sixes in the over, and both of them had come from a line that was within his hitting zone. Hence, Hardie decided to go wide outside off-stump just to change things up.

But the form that Gaikwad was in it just made things easy. The CSK opener walked across his crease and went down on one knee to just sweep it over the square-leg region to deposit it into the crowd.

This shot got the internet buzzing as it reminded them of another shot that Ruturaj had played against the very best of the Indian cricket team.

In the previous edition of IPL, Gaikwad had given the same treatment to Jasprit Bumrah over the square leg boundary. And the shot against Hardie was uncannily similar to that.

Here is the video of the same, as posted on the social media.

Ruturaj Gaikwad smashed a total of 13 fours and 7 sixes in his inning. He had opened the inning with Jaiswal and witnessed the onslaught by the Australian bowlers, who reduced India to 24 for 2 in 2.3 overs.

He built the inning with captain Suryakumar Yadav, who departed in the 11th over. From there onward, the baton of scoring was passed on to Gaikwad, who smashed it in all parts of the ground to bring up his century and a massive score for his team.

Maxwell Takes Australia over the line

Sadly, Indian bowlers were also unable to defend the massive total. Courtesy to a scintillating century scored by none other than the “Big Show” Glenn Maxwell.

He smashed 104 runs in just 48 balls to help his team chase down the total in the final ball of the inning. He smashed 15 out of the 21 runs his team required in the game’s final over.

It was a nail-biting finish for both the teams. With this victory, Australia is still alive in this series, and it will be interesting to see how it unfolds in the upcoming games.

title: MS Dhoni Confirmed for IPL 2024 as CSK Announce Retention List
content:
Chennai Super Kings have shared the names of players they are keeping and letting go for the upcoming Indian Premier League season, scheduled in Dubai on December 19. This is happening for the first time that an auction is scheduled outside India.

Notably, the team has confirmed that former captain MS Dhoni will be playing again. This news is important, especially since Dhoni had surgery on his knee after the IPL 2023.

Ben Sokes won’t be playing in IPL 2024

The team has made a surprising choice to let go of Ben Stokes, who was bought for a high price of 16.25 crores just a year ago. Stokes, who plays as an all-rounder for England, has announced that he won’t be playing in the IPL 2024. He wants to focus on staying fit for the upcoming five-match Test series against India and the T20 World Cup in June.

Chennai Super Kings let go of several players, including Dwaine Pretorius, K Bhagath Varma, Subhranshu Senapati, Ambati Rayudu, Kyle Jamieson, Akash Singh, and Sisanda Magala. Unfortunately, Jamieson, who was initially selected in the IPL 2023 auction, couldn’t play due to an injury, and Magala filled in as his replacement.

Chennai Super Kings have chosen a combination of experienced players and rising talents for the upcoming season. The retained players are Moeen Ali, Deepak Chahar, Devon Conway, Tushar Deshpande, Shivam Dube, Ruturaj Gaikwad, Rajvardhan Hangargekar, Ravindra Jadeja, Ajay Mandal, Mukesh Choudhary, Matheesha Pathirana, Ajinkya Rahane, Shaik Rasheed, Mitchell Santner, Simarjeet Singh, Nishant Sindhu, Prashant Solanki, and Maheesh Theekshana.

CSK has the budget of ₹32.1 crore for the upcoming auction

Ambati Rayudu left the team, and it seems linked to his retirement after IPL 2023. Even with some important players leaving, CSK appears solid and has a budget of ₹32.1 crore for the upcoming auction. The team recently won against the Gujarat Titans in the IPL 2023 final. Now the team is working to make its squad stronger for the next season. This win marked their fifth IPL title, putting them alongside the Mumbai Indians with the most IPL titles in history.

title: CSK Squad: List Of Players Retained, Released And Traded Ahead Of IPL 2024 Auction
content:
Chennai Super Kings (CSK) have made strategic decisions ahead of the IPL 2024 auction, releasing notable players such as Ben Stokes and Ambati Rayudu.

Chennai Super Kings’s (CSK) player retention list confirms MS Dhoni’s continuation as captain for the upcoming season. Key foreign players released include Kyle Jamieson, Sisanda Magala, and Dwaine Pretorius. Among Indian players not retained, Akash Singh stands out, having played several matches in the previous season. Bhagath Varma and Subhranshu Senapati were also released.

title: IND vs AUS: Ruturaj Gaikwad becomes 3rd Indian to get out for a diamond duck in T20Is
content:
On Thursday, November 23, Ruturaj Gaikwad entered a unique record book, becoming only the third Indian batsman to experience a “diamond duck” in T20 Internationals (T20Is). Gaikwad faced a bizarre dismissal during the first T20I against Australia, led by Matthew Wade, in Visakhapatnam.

In the penultimate delivery of the first over in India’s run-chase, Gaikwad found himself in a dreadful mix-up with Yashasvi Jaiswal. While attempting a second run, Jaiswal left his partner stranded, leading to Gaikwad’s dismissal without facing a single ball. India lost their first wicket with the score at 11 in just 0.5 overs.

Ruturaj Gaikwad becomes 3rd Indian to get out for a diamond duck in T20Is

This unfortunate feat puts Gaikwad in the company of Amit Mishra and Jasprit Bumrah as the only Indian batsmen to have suffered a diamond duck in T20Is. Bumrah experienced this unusual dismissal on February 9, 2016, against Sri Lanka at the Maharashtra Cricket Association Stadium in Pune. Mishra faced a similar fate in January 2017 against England at the Vidarbha Cricket Association (VCA) Stadium in Nagpur. In total, 21 Indian batsmen have encountered diamond ducks in the history of Indian cricket.

The list of players who share this peculiar record includes Bishan Singh Bedi, Roger Binny, Anshuman Gaekwad, Chetan Sharma, Venkatpathy Raju, Javagal Srinath, Abey Kuruvilla, Rajesh Chauhan, Navjot Singh Sidhu, MSK Prasad, Harbhajan Singh, Rahul Dravid, Sreesanth, Zaheer Khan, Rahul Dravid (mentioned twice), Virat Kohli, Bhuvneshwar Kumar, and Umesh Yadav.

Looking ahead, Gaikwad aims to make a strong comeback in the second T20I as India strives to identify the right combination ahead of the upcoming T20 World Cup, scheduled to take place in the West Indies and the United States of America (USA).

title: Ben Stokes Opts Out of IPL 2024, CSK's Next Move Unclear
content:
Ben Stokes opts out of the IPL 2024 season, citing the need to manage his workload and focus on his fitness. The franchise expressed support for Stokes’ decision, but it remains unclear whether they will release him from the team.

The deadline for IPL franchises to announce player retention and releases for the 2024 season is set for Sunday, November 26. Stokes became the most expensive purchase in Super Kings

Stokes, who became the most expensive purchase in Super Kings’ history ahead of the 2023 IPL season, played only two matches due to a left-knee injury, adding to the list of costly acquisitions by CSK.

Super Kings’ coach, Stephen Fleming, had emphasized the team’s commitment to waiting for Stokes to be “100% ready” before resuming his bowling duties. The player recently revealed his decision about undergoing knee surgery after the World Cup, and the timeline for his return will be determined based on his rehabilitation progress in collaboration with the England and Wales Cricket Board (ECB).

Despite his limited IPL appearances, Stokes showcased his prowess during the World Cup in India after coming out of ODI retirement. He played six of England’s nine games, emerging as their second-highest run-scorer with 304 runs in six innings, including two half-centuries and a century. 

Stokes commendable performance in the tournament

Stokes, who did not bowl during the tournament, ended with an impressive average of 50.66 and a strike rate of 89.14. His performances stood out even as England faced challenges in the tournament, with a notable scoring sequence of 64 against Australia, 108 against Netherlands, and 84 against Pakistan.

Looking ahead, Stokes, also the England Test captain, remains optimistic about participating in the upcoming five-Test series in India, scheduled from January 25 to March 11. title: “My favourite batting partner was MS Dhoni”: Gautam Gambhir
content:
Renowned Indian cricketer Gautam Gambhir, a key figure in the nation’s cricketing success, recently shared a surprising revelation about his favorite batting partner in white-ball cricket, eliciting waves of nostalgia among cricket enthusiasts. Despite having shared the crease with cricket legends like Sachin Tendulkar and Virender Sehwag, Gambhir unveiled that his preferred companion at the crease was none other than the former captain, MS Dhoni.

Known for his reserved demeanor, Gambhir’s disclosure added a new layer to his cricketing journey, which began in 2003 with his debut for the Indian cricket team in an ODI against Bangladesh. Over the years, he not only proved to be a dependable batter but also had the honor of captaining India in international cricket from 2010 to 2011. His crucial contributions to India’s World Cup victories in 2007 and 2011 have solidified his legacy in cricketing history.

Gambhir’s significant innings, such as his memorable 54-ball 75 in the inaugural ICC World Twenty20 final against Pakistan in 2007 and his resilient knock of 97 in the 2011 ICC Cricket World Cup final against Sri Lanka, have highlighted his prowess as a match-winner.

“My favourite batting partner was MS Dhoni”: Gautam Gambhir

In the midst of discussions about India’s recent loss in the 2023 ODI World Cup final against Australia, Gambhir surprised many by naming MS Dhoni as his favorite white-ball cricket batting partner. Contrary to popular belief, he emphasized that despite partnerships with other greats like Sehwag, it was playing alongside Dhoni that he cherished the most, especially in white-ball cricket.

“My favorite batting partner was MS Dhoni. People think that it was Virender Sehwag, but I actually love playing more with Dhoni, especially in white-ball cricket. We shared big partnerships.” 

Gambhir was quoted saying by Times Now.

The Gambhir-Dhoni partnership, instrumental in India’s 2011 World Cup triumph, showcased their deep understanding, resilience, and complementary playing styles, further solidifying MS Dhoni’s significance in India’s cricketing journey.

Gautam Gambhir returns to Kolkata Knight Riders as mentor in IPL 2024

Gautam Gambhir is set to make a homecoming to the Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR) as a “Mentor” for the upcoming 2024 season of the Indian Premier League (IPL), as announced by the two-time champions on Wednesday.

The former KKR skipper, Gambhir, will be collaborating with head coach Chandrakant Pandit to bring his wealth of experience back to the team. Gambhir, who was an integral part of KKR from 2011 to 2017, played a pivotal role in leading the team to two IPL titles in 2012 and 2014. Additionally, under his captaincy, KKR secured a runner-up finish in the Champions League T20 in 2014.

Expressing his sentiments about the return, Gambhir stated, “I am not an emotional person, and not many things move me. But this is different. This is back to where it all started. Today, there is a lump in my throat and fire in my heart as I think about slipping into that purple and gold jersey once again. I am not only coming back to KKR but I am coming back to the city of joy. I am back. I am hungry. I am number 23. Ami KKR.”

KKR co-owner Shah Rukh Khan expressed his enthusiasm about Gambhir’s return, saying, “Gautam has always been part of the family, and this is our Captain coming back home in a different avatar as a ‘Mentor.’ He was sorely missed, and now we all look forward to Chandu Sir and Gautam instilling the never-say-die spirit and sportsmanship they stand for, creating magic with Team KKR.” The reunion of Gambhir with KKR is anticipated to bring a renewed vigor and a touch of magic to the team’s upcoming IPL campaign.

Thank you for reading.

title: Pat Cummins' captaincy swung the World Cup final in Australia's favour: Suresh Raina
content:
After the eagerly awaited cricket World Cup final between Australia and India, former Indian cricketer Suresh Raina gave a fair analysis of the World Cup. He pointed out important reasons for Australia’s win. Raina recognized the important part played by Pat Cummins’ captaincy, especially his smart move to bring in Glenn Maxwell to bowl, leading to the key dismissal of Rohit Sharma, supported by a great catch from Travis Head.

Raina commented on Australia’s performance in World Cup final

Suresh Raina noted that Australia’s performance stood out, especially in their fielding. He mentioned that their players, like Head, Warner, and Labuschagne, made agile plays that saved an estimated 30 to 40 runs. Raina also praised Cummins for his captaincy. He further highlighted how strategically he rotated bowlers to put pressure on India’s strong batting lineup.

Raina praised Travis Head’s important innings for Australia during their chase, especially when they were at 47 for three. He further commended Head’s positive and impactful batting, acknowledging that it changed the direction of the game in Australia’s favor. He observed that India struggled to sustain pressure with the bat, influenced by Australia’s smart use of short deliveries and diverse bowling strategies on a dry wicket, resulting in a below-par total of 241.

Looking back at the entire tournament, Raina praised the competitive and lively atmosphere of the World Cup. He pointed out Afghanistan and the Netherlands for their good performances. He also mentioned outstanding play from players such as Bas de Leede, Paul van Meekeren, Rachin Ravindra, and Mohammad Wasim.

From an Indian viewpoint, Raina recognized KL Rahul’s impressive performances. However, he singled out Mohammed Shami as the standout player of the tournament, praising his impactful bowling. Raina also praised Rohit Sharma’s captaincy, comparing it to the leadership style of MS Dhoni and highlighting the team’s cohesion and excellence.

Suresh Raina mentioned special moments; Virat’s 50th century

Even though India didn’t win the final, Raina stayed positive about the team’s future. He said they did well in different areas throughout the tournament. Raina mentioned special moments, like Virat Kohli making his 50th century in front of his idol, Sachin Tendulkar. Raina finished by saying he believes the Indian team can do well in future tournaments. He knows handling pressure, especially when playing at home, is something that takes time to learn.

title: CSK Captain 2027: Complete List from 2008 to 2027
content:
As of 31 August 2026, Ruturaj Gaikwad is the captain of Chennai Super Kings (CSK). He has been leading the team as full-time captain since the 2024 IPL season, succeeding MS Dhoni. 

So far, 4 players have captained CSK in the IPL. Dhoni remains the franchise’s most successful captain, guiding the side to 5 championship titles. Here is a look at the complete list of players who have captained CSK from 2008 to 2026.

Who Is the Current Captain of CSK?

Ruturaj Gaikwad is the current captain of Chennai Super Kings. He was appointed as the franchise’s permanent captain ahead of the IPL 2024 season on March 21, the day before CSK’s season opener. He succeeded the former leader, MS Dhoni, as part of CSK’s long-term leadership transition. 

Gaikwad is the team’s permanent captain, although Dhoni did make a return in 2025, when Ruturaj was ruled out with an injury. Gaikwad again resumed his leadership role ahead of the 2026 Indian Premier League. 

In IPL matches as CSK captain, Gaikwad has led the team in 33 matches, recording 14 wins and 19 losses, with a win percentage of 42.42%. With the team undergoing a transition phase, the management decided to opt for him as the franchise’s long-term leader for the post-Dhoni era, considering his potential.

CSK Captain List from 2008 to 2027

Every Player Who Has Captained CSK

Statistics cover IPL matches only and are updated through IPL 2026. 

Former CSK Captains

MS Dhoni

MS Dhoni captained CSK from 2008-2015 and 2018-2023, with a brief return in 2025 mid-season. He was the captain for CSK’s final nine matches of IPL 2025 after Gaikwad was ruled out with an elbow injury. 

Dhoni emerged as the franchise’s first captain in 2008, considering the strong leadership skills he displayed during his stint with the Indian cricket team. Dhoni led Chennai Super Kings in the Indian Premier League in 219 matches, winning 131 and losing 85, with three contests ending in no result. MS Dhoni remains CSK’s most successful captain, guiding the team to 5 IPL championships.

Suresh Raina

Suresh Raina served as CSK’s stand-in captain when Dhoni was unavailable. As one of the team’s most experienced players and considering his close cricketing bond with Dhoni, he was a natural choice to lead the side. He captained CSK for four matches, three in 2010 and one in 2019, winning only 1 match, while losing 3.

Ravindra Jadeja

Ravindra Jadeja captained Chennai Super Kings in 2022, taking over the role from Dhoni as part of a planned leadership transition. As one of the team’s most experienced players and a long-standing CSK member, he was seen as the natural next leader after Dhoni. He led the side in 8 matches, winning 2 and losing 6. Following the team’s poor results, Jadeja stepped down from the captaincy, with Dhoni resuming the role again for the second half of the season.

Four players have captained CSK: MS Dhoni, Suresh Raina, Ravindra Jadeja and Ruturaj Gaikwad.

Ravindra Jadeja began the 2022 IPL season as captain for CSK, leading for 8 matches. Following the team’s poor performance, he stepped down from the role, with Dhoni returning as the side’s full-time captain for the second half of the season.

Notably making his annual appearance during the Indian Premier League (IPL) after retiring from international cricket in 2020, Dhoni surprised fans by choosing to visit his ancestral village in Uttarakhand with his wife, Sakshi, instead of attending the Cricket World Cup matches where Team India is currently in action.

Read more: Dhoni Spotted: Sakshi shares wholesome pic with MS Dhoni, netizens call them ‘cuties’

Team India takes 2019 World Cup’s Revenge while MS Dhoni Enjoys Family Time in Ancestral Village

While Dhoni enjoys his hiatus from the sport, the Indian cricket team secured a spot in the World Cup final with an impressive 70-run win over New Zealand in Mumbai. In this crucial match, Virat Kohli achieved a record-breaking 50th one-day international hundred, scoring 117. Shreyas Iyer complemented this with a rapid 105, contributing to a commanding total of 397-4. The innings also featured Shubman Gill’s unbeaten 80, who retired hurt on 79.

The bowling highlight of the match was Mohammed Shami’s sensational seven-wicket haul (7-57), dismissing New Zealand for 327. Despite reaching the finals at the last two World Cups and defeating India in a 2019 semi-final, New Zealand fell short this time.

India is now set to face either South Africa or Australia in the World Cup final scheduled for Sunday.

title: Ravindra Jadeja Wins Best Fielder Award in Semifinal Match
content:
Awarding the best fielder after every match, has become a tradition for Indian cricket team, this world cup. In every group stage match, the player with most outstanding performance on the field is awarded with a medal for their valiant efforts.

The same happened after India’s dominating win over New Zealand in the first semifinal here on Wednesday. Indian cricket team’s fielding coach presented the medal for the best fielder to Ravindra Jadeja.

Suryakumar Yadav deliver’s speech after Jadeja awarded best fielder award

Earlier, it was notice that the medal along with the name of the winner was announced in a very fancy and sometimes even dramatic fashion. However, this time it was not the case at all.

On Wednesday, according to the video put out by the official handle of Indian cricket team, the medal as presented in a simple manner. However, Suryakumar Yadav still managed to find a way to win everyone’s heart.

The Indian batter gave a speech using excerpts from the famous Bollywood movie, Bajirao Mastani. Describing the Indian cricketer, Suryakumar recited, “Cheetah ki chaal, Baaj ki nazar aur Royal Navghan ki fielding se koi nahi bach sakta (No one can escape: Cheteeh’s speed, Hawk’s vision and Royal Navghan’s fielding.)”

Jadeja was crowned as the best fielder in the game for his amazing catches under pressure. The first one came in the form of Glenn Philips who was heating up to produce another batting masterclass. Philips was caught at long on, at the score of 41 from just 33 balls.

Next victim of Sir Jadeja turned out to be Mark Chapman, who was caught at long leg while trying to sweep Kuldeep Yadav. This wicket gave Indian team a huge boost of confidence. The final nail in coffin came in the form of the catch of Daryl Mitchell.

This time standing at Mid-wicket, Jadeja took a tame catch for his standards, to dismiss the New Zealand’s centurion for the score of 134 runs from just 119 runs, to seal the deal for his side.

Phenomenal Indian bowling display

The Indian bowling attack has been dominating throughout the tournament. However, for the first time they seem to be in trouble, but that was before Mohammed Shami came into the attack.

Shami broke the entire top order single handedly by dismissing Conway and Ravindra in his first spell and later Williamson and Latham in his latter spell. With some good bowling from Bumrah and Kuldeep in support, India was able to tie the tail of New Zealand batting order. Before Shami tidied things up to make a 7-fer for himself.

India will now face Australia in the final of the ODI World Cup in Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad.

title: Breaking: CSK set to release Ben Stokes ahead of 2024 auction
content:
Chennai Super Kings (CSK) are apparently planning to let go of English all-rounder Ben Stokes. They acquired him for Rs 16.25 crore in the last mini-auction. The reason behind this decision is Stokes’ likely unavailability for IPL 2024.

Ben Stokes to be released by Chennai Super Kings ahead of 2024 IPL

Stokes, who participated in only two games in the previous season, is set to undergo knee surgery, requiring a two-month recovery period. The CSK management, not willing to take a risk on his availability for the IPL, has been in talks with Stokes about his focus post-World Cup.

Although England’s World Cup campaign has ended. Direct contact between CSK and Stokes remains pending, and talks with his manager have proven inconclusive.

An official from CSK emphasized their high regard for Stokes as a big match player. The official stated, “We would not consider releasing Stokes if he could be available. “However, concerns about blocking Rs 16 crore without on-field contribution have prompted the consideration of potential releases.

KKR to release Lockie Ferguson

In a parallel development, there are indications of a potential release for Lockie Ferguson. Initially purchased by Gujarat Titans in 2022 for Rs 10 crore. Later traded to Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR) in 2023. KKR is reportedly contemplating Ferguson’s release due to his injury history.

Rumors circulating about a trade between KKR and Royal Challengers Bangalore involving Shardul Thakur and Harshal Patel have been confirmed as unfounded. However, intense discussions on high-profile trades among franchises are ongoing, with the outcome expected to be revealed by November 19 which is the last day for trades to be completed. Franchises are mandated to announce their lists of retentions and releases by November 26. The subsequent auction is scheduled to take place at the Coca Cola Arena in Dubai on December 19.

As the cricketing community eagerly awaits the finalization of player trades and team compositions. The dynamics leading up to the upcoming IPL season promise intrigue and potential strategic shifts among the participating franchises.

title: Wanderers Stadium: Know history of Bullring Stadium, Capacity and JSK Home Record in SA20
content:
The Wanderers Stadium, also affectionately known as “The Bullring,” is a majestic landmark in the heart of Johannesburg, South Africa. Established in 1956, this iconic cricket ground has been the stage for countless unforgettable cricketing moments, earning its reputation as one of the most revered venues in the world of sports.

History and Development of Wanderers Stadium:

The Wanderers Stadium replaced its predecessor, the Old Wanderers Stadium, which had served as the primary cricket ground in Johannesburg since 1896. The new stadium’s construction was a testament to the growing popularity of cricket in South Africa and the need for a larger and more modern venue.

The Wanderers Stadium was officially inaugurated in 1956, and it quickly established itself as a formidable host for international cricket matches. The stadium’s design, with its steep banks and close proximity to the field, created an intimidating atmosphere for visiting teams.

Why is Wanderers Stadium called the Bullring Stadium?

The Wanderers Stadium, nestled amidst the vibrant city of Johannesburg, South Africa, is more than just a cricket ground. It’s a hallowed arena steeped in history and tradition, where legends have been born and battles won. Affectionately referred to as “The Bullring,” the stadium’s intimidating nickname resonates through the years, a testament to its unique atmosphere and the fierce rivalry it has witnessed.

The stadium’s nickname, “The Bullring,” can be traced back to its early days. When the stadium was first constructed in the 1950s, its steep banks and close proximity to the field created an intimidating atmosphere for visiting teams. The passionate and vocal crowd added to the intensity, transforming the stadium into a true bullring, where opposing batsmen faced relentless scrutiny and hostile bowling attacks.

The nickname “The Bullring” perfectly captures the stadium’s reputation as a formidable venue where visiting teams must tread carefully. The stadium’s history is littered with tales of courageous batting displays against unrelenting bowling attacks, adding to its mystique and enhancing its reputation as a true test of cricketing prowess.

Over the years, the Wanderers Stadium has hosted numerous memorable matches, including South Africa’s final Test before their international isolation due to apartheid in 1970, Mike Atherton’s heroic 11-hour resistance to save the Test match against England in 1995, and South Africa’s victory over England in the Cricket World Cup semi-final in 1999. These matches, and countless others, have cemented the Wanderers Stadium’s place in cricket history.

Today, the Wanderers Stadium remains a formidable venue, where reputations are made and broken. The nickname “The Bullring” continues to resonate, a reminder of the stadium’s intimidating atmosphere and legacy as a true test of cricketing skill.

Wanderers Stadium Renovations and Upgrades

Over the years, the Wanderers Stadium has undergone several renovations and upgrades, ensuring it remains a world-class facility. In 1996, new floodlights were installed, enabling day-night matches to be played. In 2003, the stadium underwent a major revamp in preparation for the Cricket World Cup.

Significant Historical Events and Records in Wanderers Stadium:

The Wanderers Stadium has witnessed some of South African cricket history’s most memorable and significant events. Here are a few notable examples:

  • 1970: South Africa’s final Test match before their international isolation due to apartheid.
  • 1995: Mike Atherton’s heroic 11-hour resistance to save the Test match against England, securing South Africa’s re-entry into international cricket.
  • 1999: South Africa’s victory over England in the Cricket World Cup semi-final, sending the nation into a frenzy.
  • 2003: South Africa hosted the Cricket World Cup, with the Wanderers Stadium serving as a key venue.
  • 2007: The thrilling T20 World Cup final between India and Pakistan, held at the Wanderers Stadium.

Famous Cricketers Who Call Wanderers Stadium Their Home:

The Wanderers Stadium has been the home ground for numerous legendary South African cricketers, including:

  • Graeme Pollock: A prolific run-scorer and one of South Africa’s greatest batsmen.
  • Barry Richards: A flamboyant batsman known for his aggressive strokeplay.
  • Eddie Barlow: A fiery all-rounder who captained South Africa in their final Test before isolation.
  • Faf du Plessis: A modern-day icon, leading South Africa to Test series victories in Australia and England.
  • Quinton de Kock: A destructive wicketkeeper-batsman, holding the record for the fastest century in ODI cricket.

What is the Joburg Super Kings’ home record in SA20?

The Joburg Super Kings had the best record in SA20 for playing at home. They played 5 games at home and won almost all of them. 

Their first game at home in the tournament was against Pretoria Capitals, in which they secured a narrow win by a margin of 6 runs. They posted a total of 168 and managed to curtail the opposition to 162, courtesy of some great bowling by Aron Phangiso.

In their second outing at home, they faced Durban Super Giants. It was a high-scoring encounter in which Faf du Plessis came to the party with his first and only century of the tournament. This inning of his helped his team chase down the target of 178 runs with 5 balls to spare.

Wanderers Stadium pitch report

The Wanderers Stadium is renowned for being a batter-friendly pitch, unlike the others in the rest of the country. A consistent rainfall in Johannesburg might result in the pitch bringing in some moisture while assisting the bowlers. Especially in the second innings, the pitch becomes fairly easy to bad due to the dew factor. The average score on this pitch is around 151. 

Wanderers stadium weather

Johannesburg in South Africa is prone to high rainfall, which has resulted in the abandoning of five T20 matches in this stadium in the past. Dew often plays a significant factor in the matches conducted on this field. 

Wanderers stadium boundary size

The Wanderers stadium has an approximate straight boundary size of 88.87 Meters. 

Wanderers stadium capacity

The Wanderers stadium has an approximate seating capacity of 34,000 spectators. 

Conclusion:

The Wanderers Stadium has played an integral role in the history of South African cricket. It has hosted countless memorable matches, witnessed the rise of legendary players, and symbolised national pride and sporting excellence. The stadium’s legacy is one of resilience, passion, and an enduring love for the beautiful game of cricket.

title: Ben Stokes Shines in Crucial Moment for England vs Pakistan
content:
England vs Pakistan: Ben Stokes showcased his stellar form, securing his third consecutive fifty and falling just 16 runs short of his second century in the World Cup. His remarkable innings played a pivotal role as England asserted their batting prowess against Pakistan, posting a formidable total of 337/9. Alongside Jonny Bairstow’s impactful half-century, Stokes and Joe Root orchestrated a crucial partnership to rebuild the innings. The late contributions from Harry Brook and Jos Buttler added the finishing touches.

Jos Buttler’s decision to bat first proved crucial, setting the tone for England’s dominant performance. Bairstow and Dawid Malan provided a rapid start, capitalizing on favorable conditions. Despite a brief period of restraint introduced by Mohammad Wasim Jr., Stokes and Root accelerated the scoring, accumulating 58 runs between the 21st and 30th over. Stokes, displaying a hint of mobility struggle, reached his fifty in the 34th over and continued to elevate the scoring rate.

Ben Stokes shines again as England flex batting muscles vs Pakistan

Stokes, aiming for another century, faced a setback when Shaheen Afridi’s return catch opportunity was dropped. However, Stokes couldn’t capitalize on this stroke of luck and eventually departed for a well-fought 76-ball 84. Root, too, fell for 60 off 72 in the following over.

Despite the two quick wickets, Jos Buttler and Harry Brook took charge in the death overs, swinging for the fences. Shadab Khan’s attempt to dismiss Buttler was thwarted as he stepped onto the boundary with the ball in hand. Brook, particularly aggressive against Afridi, concluded an impactful 20-run over with consecutive sixes. Although Afridi and Rauf ended their fiery cameos, England managed to amass 97 runs in the last 10 overs, securing a substantial total. Stokes’ standout performance remained a highlight, guiding England to a commanding position in the match.

Thank you for reading.

title: Ravindra Jadeja Takes Fifer Against South Africa in World Cup
content:
On Sunday ( 5th Nov) , India and South Africa clashed in their eighth match of the 2023 World Cup at Eden Gardens in Kolkata.

India won the toss and chose to bat, and they started the match strongly, scoring 326 runs for the loss of five wickets. The star of the show was Virat Kohli, who performed admirably and scored 101 not out, his 49th ODI century. Other players, including Shreyas Iyer, Rohit Sharma, and Ravindra Jadeja, scored 77, 40, and 29* points, respectively. Keshav Maharaj, a South African bowler, took one wicket while conceding 30 runs.

Ravindra Jadeja claims fifer against South Africa

India’s bowlers dominated South Africa in response, dismissing all of their batsmen for 83 runs. This outstanding performance followed a similar one against Sri Lanka, whom they dismissed for 55 runs. Ravindra Jadeja was the standout performer, taking five wickets, while Mohammed Shami and Kuldeep Yadav each took two.

Ravindra Jadeja became the eighth Indian bowler to take five wickets in a single World Cup match. It’s interesting to note that the first Indian to achieve this feat was former captain Kapil Dev, way back in 1983, during a match against Australia in Nottingham.

Moreover, Mohammed Shami achieved a special record by becoming the only Indian bowler to take five wickets in a World Cup match on multiple occasions. He has done this three times, with two of those instances happening in the ongoing World Cup, against New Zealand and Sri Lanka.

Santner is leading in the overall fielding impact, with David Miller from South Africa and David Warner from Australia following closely behind. On the other hand, Virat Kohli, who was leading in the starting, is now in sixth place. His teammate Ravindra Jadeja has moved ahead and is currently in fifth place.

Mitch Santner is the best fielder so far in ODI World Cup

India and Australia are both doing well in fielding, with David Warner in third place and Glenn Maxwell in eighth. South Africa is leading the fielding ratings, making 44 catches, which is the most among all the teams. They have also saved 44 runs, which shows their skills in stopping the other team from scoring. India has two players who are doing great, and Australia has a strong presence, too, showing they are important in the World Cup’s fielding.

The Netherlands is in second place for team fielding, with only six dropped catches, the second lowest among all teams. Defending champions England closely followed in third place, having dropped just four catches, the lowest among all the teams participating.

Overall performance of Santer in World Cup

Mitchell Santer has had a mixed bag of a tournament so far. In the 7 games that he has featured for the Kiwis, his performance has been poles apart with the ball and bat in hand.

While bowling, Santner has managed to claim 13 wickets in the 7 games. He has emerged as the top wicket-taker for his team. Bowling in difficult circumstances, he has not only managed to clinch crucial wickets, but his economy of 4.88 shows that he has also applied breaks to free-flowing innings, eventually resulting in his team curtailing the opposition for a good score.

The batting, however, has not been easy for the southpaw. Batting in the lower order, he has just not come to the party yet. As a result, has only managed to score 61 runs in his four innings at an average of 30.5, which is below his standards. Even in crunch games like that against Australia, he was not able to contribute with the bat, which led to the eventual defeat of his team.

Santner is a class player, and he will definitely step up with the bat when his team needs it, while doing what he is already with the ball.

Hopefully, with his due diligence, the Blackcaps will lift their first ODI World Cup.

title: MS Dhoni Provides Update on IPL 2024 and Knee Injury Recovery
content:
Former India captain MS Dhoni provided a significant update on his knee injury and his participation in the 2024 season of the Indian Premier League (IPL) with the Chennai Super Kings. Dhoni, who had led CSK to the title in IPL 2023, was plagued with a knee injury that had limited his batting contributions. After the season, he underwent knee surgery and disclosed that he was experiencing no complications and was progressing toward complete recovery.

Dhoni, 42, was speaking at an event in Bengaluru. The legendary player said medical professionals had assured him that he would feel significantly better by November. The iconic wicketkeeper-batter also said that his knee had successfully withstood the surgery and that he was undergoing a rehabilitation process.

MS Dhoni drops big hint about participation in IPL 2024, provides clarity on injury

The host at the event addressed a question to Dhoni by saying, “As you have retired…”. On hearing this, the individual sitting beside Dhoni interrupted and clarified that he’s only retired from international cricket and not the IPL. A smiling Dhoni agreed and said “yes” as fans cheered.

Dhoni clarified his injury status: “Knee has survived the operation, going through the rehab patch, the doctor told me you would feel much better by November. But no problem in day-to-day routine,” said Dhoni.

Dhoni also added that he never wanted to be recognized as just an accomplished cricketer. Instead, he highlighted the importance of leaving a legacy as a decent human being.

After leading the Chennai Super Kings to the title, Dhoni thanked the supporters for all the love and pledged that he would leave no stone unturned in trying to make a comeback.

“Circumstantially, it’s the best time to announce retirement. The easy thing for me is to say thank you and retire. But the amount of love I have received from CSK fans, it would be a gift for them to (see me) play one more season,” Dhoni had said after CSK beat Gujarat Titans.

The IPL player auction for the 2024 season is reportedly scheduled for 19 December in Dubai. This will be the first time that the auction will take place outside India.

The 10 IPL teams need to submit their lists of retained and released players by 15 November. Following this deadline, the auction pool will be confirmed by early December.

You can read more blog about MS Dhoni Fitness

Thank you for reading.

title: Jos Buttler Praises MS Dhoni’s Calm Composure Behind the Stumps
content:
The ODI World Cup 2023 is in full swing, and each team is enjoying their time in the house of cricket, India. As the tournament approaches its final leg, defending champions England, led by captain Jos Buttler, will face Sri Lanka in their next ICC ODI World Cup league match at M. Chinnaswamy Stadium in Bengaluru on Thursday. With England under pressure after a difficult start to the tournament, Buttler will be key in guiding his team as they look to turn their fortunes around and keep their semi-final hopes alive.

Reeling from three defeats in their first four games, England knows they need a huge turnaround if they are to make it to the semi-finals, with the defending champions sat at the bottom of the table following Afghanistan’s shock win over Pakistan on Monday.

England captain Jos Buttler has come under big pressure, particularly for his decision to bowl first in the heat of Mumbai against South Africa – a decision that contributed to a humbling loss for England.

While England are not in the most desired place on the points table, they will hope to make a miraculous comeback to find a spot in the top four.

However, in a recent interview, England captain Jos Buttler keeping the pressures of loss aside expressed praise for former India captain MS Dhoni.

“I’m a huge MS Dhoni fan”: England World Cup Captain Jos Buttler praises Dhoni’s “Cool Composer” behind the stumps

Before their match against Sri Lanka in an interview with Star Sports, England’s Jos Buttler said, ” I am a huge MS Dhoni fan and I really enjoy how he goes about his cricket… Mostly his demeanor in that sort of ice-cool status he presents behind the stumps. So yeah, I think for most wicket-keeper batsmen MS is the best.”

Well, this isn’t the first time Rajasthan Royal’s recruit Jos Buttler has expressed his thoughts on MS Dhoni’s greatness. In the 2021 edition, four out of eight franchises were captained by wicket-keepers, and Buttler felt the credit should go to Dhoni for setting the trend. Buttler believed the legendary Mahendra Singh Dhoni is the inspiration behind the emergence of wicketkeeper-captains in the world’s biggest T20 league, the IPL.

“I am sure MSD (Dhoni) has something to do with the sixth sense and breeding of wicketkeepers who can captain. He obviously has been a fantastic captain and there are lots of players who want to follow his footsteps,” Buttler had told PTI Bhasha in an interview.

Buttler himself a wicketkeeper, feels stumpers enjoy an advantage as captains as they get a 360-degree view of the proceedings.

title: Ravindra Jadeja Wins Fielder of the Match with Stunning Catch
content:
India’s star all-rounder, Ravindra Jadeja, was honored with the “Fielder of the Match” award for his outstanding diving catch at backward point during the World Cup match against Bangladesh in Pune. The award was presented by the team’s fielding coach, T. Dilip. What made this recognition particularly special was that Jadeja had expressed his desire to win the award immediately after taking the catch.

Jadeja’s exceptional catch triumphed over another remarkable fielding effort by wicketkeeper-batter KL Rahul, who had taken a spectacular one-handed diving catch to dismiss Mehidy Hasan Miraz in the same game, causing wild celebration in the Indian dressing room.

A behind-the-scenes video shared by the BCCI captured a lighthearted moment in the Team India dressing room as the fielding coach announced the winner. His teammates surrounded Jadeja, and KL Rahul, the previous award recipient, was asked by Dilip to present the medal to Jadeja. In a wonderful gesture, Jadeja, instead, draped the medal around the neck of the fielding coach himself.

However, this time, Dilip added an extra twist to his announcement of the “Fielder of the Match” award. Following the team’s previous match against Pakistan, he revealed the result with a nicely edited video featuring KL Rahul, complete with special effects. But this time, the result was unveiled on the stadium’s large screen, taking the entire Indian squad by surprise.

During the award presentation, the Indian fielding coach praised the outstanding diving efforts in the field made by both Rahul and Jadeja. He emphasized the team’s commitment to taking individual catches and delivering an all-around performance to save runs, ultimately leading him to choose Jadeja as the recipient of the best fielding award.

“A grand win, a grand Medal Ceremony A celebration of “Giant” proportions This time the Dressing room BTS went beyond the boundary – quite literally,” BCCI posted on X with the video. A user, then, cut out the portion from the video where Dilip points toward the big screen to declare the fielder of the match award.

Watch: Jadeja’s incredible catch graces the big screen, Sparking wild celebration in the Indian dressing room

“We have played enough. We all know that win isn’t built-in runs or wickets. I think it is also built on marvelous catches, and tremendous diving and today was a great example of that. It’s not the way we save, but the numbers saved. Two game-changing catches by KL and Jadeja. We as a team saved 13 runs today. That was fantastic. So let’s roll the carpet for today’s evening star. On the field today one person was like a lion. Commanding on the field, outstanding effort with the direct hit, saving, and fantastic top catch- Jadeja,” Dilip said in the video.

Thank you for reading.

title: Mitchell Santner Takes 100 ODI Wicket in Chennai Victory
content:
Mitchell Santner has emerged as a standout star in the early stages of the 2023 ICC Men’s Cricket World Cup. What’s more, he enjoyed the added advantage of playing at his Indian Premier League franchise’s home ground, the Chennai Super Kings, when New Zealand faced Afghanistan on Wednesday.

In front of his Chennai Super Kings fans, Santner played a pivotal role in dismantling Afghanistan’s middle and lower order, finishing the match with impressive figures of 3/39, contributing to New Zealand’s convincing 149-run victory. This strong start in the tournament has catapulted Santner to the top of the wicket-taking charts, with a total of 11 wickets in New Zealand’s four matches so far.

“I guess when we turn up here for IPL, we’ve played on wickets that kind of look similar to that,” Santner said in reference to his experience of conditions at the MA Chidambaram Stadium.

“Today, it looked like it swung a little bit and actually spun a little bit more under lights, which kind of helped that we lost the toss and batted first.”

Mitchell Santner Completes 100 ODI Wickets in Chennai

Furthermore, Santner’s first wicket on Wednesday in Chennai marked a significant milestone as he became only the second Black Caps spinner to achieve 100 One Day International dismissals, following in the footsteps of fellow spinner Daniel Vettori.

“It’s obviously nice to get to that milestone,” the left-arm spinner said.

“I guess I wasn’t thinking about it too much leading into the game it’s just about trying to perform my role and do a job out there just like every other game.

“I think I’m 200 odd wickets behind him, so it’s going to be a tough challenge to get there.”

Santner’s exceptional performance on the Indian pitches not only places him atop the overall wicket-taking list but also sets him apart by nearly doubling the tally of the next-highest spinner in that category, Afghanistan’s Rashid Khan.

The 31-year-old attributes his success not only to his own skills but also to the pressure created by his team’s opening bowlers. Often utilized during the middle overs, Santner emphasizes the advantage of bowling in tandem with New Zealand’s fast bowler, Lockie Ferguson.

“It’s obviously nice to come here and see the ball spin a little bit, you don’t really get those (wickets) in New Zealand,” Santner noted.

“I think as a whole, we’ve been bowling in partnerships, that’s what we talk about. The guys up front today Boult and Matt Henry did an exceptional job in getting that run rate up, and then it kind of makes them want to play bigger shots in the middle (overs).

“I think as a partnership, as a unit, we’ve been bowling pretty well and I was lucky to chip in today for a few. But I think the way the seam has kind of set that up was massive for us.”

Santner’s contributions were not limited to his bowling performance against Afghanistan; he also shone in the field with an outstanding catch that helped dismiss Afghanistan’s skipper, Hashmatullah Shahidi.

Santner and his unbeaten New Zealand team’s next challenge will be against tournament hosts India in Dharamsala on Sunday.
excerpt: Mitchell Santner enjoyed the added advantage of playing at his Indian Premier League franchise's home ground, the Chennai Super Kings, when New Zealand faced Afghanistan on Wednesday.

title: Ben Stokes Set to Return to England’s XI Against South Africa in ODI World Cup 2023
content:
Ben Stokes is well on his way to recovery and is expected to be fit for England’s crucial 2023 World Cup match against South Africa on October 21 (Saturday). He had to miss the first three games of the tournament due to a hip injury.

Stokes, who made a surprising return to the ODI squad for the World Cup after announcing his retirement from the format last year, has been a spectator for England’s initial matches, where they suffered losses against New Zealand and Afghanistan.

England’s prospects for reaching the semi-finals now hinge on winning five out of their last six games in the World Cup. The team could receive a significant boost with Stokes’ anticipated return, as he had pinpointed the match against South Africa as his comeback target. Stokes had even batted in the nets before the Afghanistan game and was very close to playing, as indicated by Jos Buttler, but he ultimately did not feature in the playing XI.

England’s head coach optimistic about Ben Stokes return against South Africa in ODI World Cup

England’s head coach, Matthew Mott, provided an update on Stokes, expressing confidence in his availability for the South Africa game. Mott mentioned on Tuesday, “We’ve been cautious with his recovery, but our medical staff has been optimistic about targeting the South Africa match.” Although I haven’t received a recent update in the last 24 hours, prior to that, he was on track to return.

“So fingers crossed, he can tick off all the things that need to be ticked off and he comes back into that side. He’s like the spiritual leader of the group in many ways, and he certainly spoke really well after the game the other day, and spoke about that need to really assert ourselves.”

Stokes also addressed his teammates after the Afghanistan defeat, encouraging them to adopt a more aggressive approach in the remaining matches. He had previously rallied the team following their loss to Ireland in the 2022 T20 World Cup, which led to England winning four consecutive games, including the final.

Stokes, a standout performer in the 2019 World Cup final, has accumulated 3,159 runs at an average of 40.50 and taken 74 wickets in 108 ODIs since his debut in 2011.
