title: SA20: Joburg Super Kings Squad (2024 Updated)
content:
Joburg Super Kings Squad (JSK) is a South African professional T20 franchise cricket team that competes in the SA20, a domestic Twenty20 cricket league established by Cricket South Africa in 2022. title: CSK Mourns Gokulakrishnan’s Passing: Former BCCI Referee & Coach
content:
On Wednesday, October 11, D.J. Gokulakrishnan, a former BCCI referee and coach for Tamil Nadu, passed away. The all-rounder played for a total of twelve years. When Gokulakrishnan passed away, he was fifty years old. He had a cardiac arrest. Gokulakrishnan was a player from 1993 to 2004 who participated in 39 first-class matches, amassing 103 wickets and 1,116 runs. He participated in 45 games in List-A cricket, amassing 552 runs and claiming 71 wickets. In addition to Tamil Nadu, he was a domestic player for Assam and Goa.

Gokulakrishnan ended his playing career and went on to officiate BCCI matches for the Vijay Hazare Trophy and the Ranji Trophy. In addition, he served as a Tamil Nadu Premier League referee. An accomplished level 2 coach, he served as assistant coach for the Tamil Nadu squad twice, in 2008 and 2013. He was their bowling coach in 2010. In 2015, he also served as the Tamil Nadu u-19 team’s head coach.

Gokulakrishnan also had a lengthy career with the Chennai Super Kings (CSK), who has won the Indian Premier League five times. He was formerly a talent scout for the team captained by MS Dhoni. He served as a special coach at the Super Kings Academy as well. Both the Chennai Super Kings (CSK) and the Tamil Nadu Cricket Association (TNCA) issued comments expressing their sympathies for the premature death of the fifty-year-old man, who was affectionately referred to as “Geeks.”

CSK mourn sudden demise of former Tamil Nadu coach and BCCI referee DJ Gokulakrishnan

Tamil Nadu cricketer Abhinav Mukund shared condolences on the former coach’s sudden demise, “Absolutely shellshocked hearing the news coming out of chennai! Former FC cricketer, my U-17 & U-19 coach DJ Gokulakrishnan passes away. He was 51. He was a BCCI Match referee and I met him recently during the TNPL. Life is so unpredictable- prayers and strength to his family. Deepest condolences to his brother Umpire Madanagopal as well.”

Thank you for reading.

title: AnbuDen Meaning: Why CSK Uses the Hashtag for Chepauk
content:
AnbuDen is a Chennai Super Kings hashtag based on the Tamil word அன்புடன் (Anbudan), which means “with love.” 

CSK calls it AnbuDen. In Tamil, the word “Anbu” means “love.” “Den” refers to M.A. Chidambaram Stadium in Chennai, famously known as Chepauk, the team’s home ground. The name also reflects the franchise’s lion identity.  

Therefore, the hashtag combines the original Tamil meaning with a reference to the Lion’s home. 

What does AnbuDen mean in Tamil? 

The original Tamil word is அன்புடன் (Anbudan), which means “with love.” It can be used to end letters, messages, and greetings in a respectful way, as in “அன்புடன் உங்கள் ஆதரவாளன்” (Anbuden Ungal Aadharavalan), which means “With your heartfelt support.”

The word can also appear within a sentence to express that something is done with love, as in “அன்புடன் தொடர்வோம்” (Anbudan Thodaruvom), which means “Let’s move forward with love.”

Consisting of two parts, அன்பு (Anbu) meaning “love” or “affection,” and உடன் (Udan) referring to “with,” together, the phrase அன்புடன் means “with love.” 

Anbudan is a common English transliteration of the Tamil word and reflects its pronunciation. 

How did CSK turn Anbudan into AnbuDen? 

CSK changed the English spelling from Anbudan to AnbuDen by modifying the second half of the word to “Den.” The actual word and its meaning remain the same, but the revised spelling creates a connection with the team’s home venue.

Splitting the phrase “AnbuDen,” the term “Anbu” means “love” in Tamil, with the word “Den” referring to Chepauk, where the team plays its home matches. 

Since the franchise uses the lion as its identity, the stadium is often symbolized as the Lions’ territory. Hence, the revised term is known as “The Den with Love,” referring to the venue as the beloved home of the lions affectionately.

When did CSK explain #AnbuDen? 

Chennai Super Kings publicly explained the meaning of #AnbuDen in April 2019 through one of its official social media posts, with the franchise writing, “The Super Kudumbam off to the #AnbuDen!” 

A fan then asked what the hashtag meant, and the Super Kings replied, “It means ‘With Love.’ Also refers to Chepauk – the Den!” 

This reply became the clearest official explanation of the hashtag. It confirmed that the franchise intended the word to carry both the Tamil meaning and its reference to the venue.

The franchise was suspended from the IPL in 2016 and 2017. It returned in 2018 but played only one home match at Chepauk. The remaining six home games were held in Pune because of security concerns during the Cauvery protests. 

As a result, the 2019 Indian Premier League was CSK’s first season; it hosted every match at Chepauk after its return. This made the hashtag especially meaningful as the franchise reunited with its original home ground.

What does AnbuDen represent for CSK? 

For Chennai Super Kings, AnbuDen represents both its Tamil roots and its connection to Chepauk. The hashtag combines a familiar Tamil expression with a reference to the stadium that is considered the home of the Lions with affection.

CSK remained unbeaten at Chepauk during the 2011 IPL season, winning all eight of its home matches, including the memorable final. That campaign helped establish Chepauk as one of the toughest away venues in the IPL. The side continued to enjoy a strong home record in the following seasons, strengthening its reputation at the venue. 

The team’s sustained success at M.A. Chidambaram Stadium helped it to develop a strong bond with the ground and the supporters.That combination is why #AnbuDen continues to be associated with the team whenever it returns to Chepauk to play a match.

Frequently Asked Questions

1. What does AnbuDen mean?

AnbuDen means “with love.” It is based on the Tamil word அன்புடன் (Anbudan). CSK stylises the ending as “Den” to connect the expression with Chepauk, the home ground of the Lions.

2. Which spelling is correct: Anbudan, Anbuden or AnbuDen?

Anbudan is a common English transliteration of the Tamil word அன்புடன். Anbuden is another spelling used online. AnbuDen is CSK’s branded version, with “Den” referring to Chepauk. Use Anbudan for the Tamil word and #AnbuDen for the CSK hashtag.

3. How is Anbudan pronounced?

Anbudan is pronounced roughly as “An-bu-dan.” In CSK’s hashtag, the final part is written as “Den” to make the reference to Chepauk clear.

4. What does Anbudan mean in English and Hindi?

In English, Anbudan means “with love.” Its closest Hindi equivalents are “प्यार के साथ” (pyaar ke saath) and “सप्रेम” (saprem), particularly when used as a warm sign-off.

5. Why is the letter D capitalised in AnbuDen?

CSK capitalises the letter D to highlight the English word “Den.” It refers to Chepauk as the home of the Lions and creates a second meaning within the original Tamil expression.

6. Why does CSK use the #AnbuDen hashtag?

CSK uses #AnbuDen to connect three parts of its identity: its Tamil roots, its affection for supporters and its relationship with Chepauk. The word expresses love while “Den” represents the team’s home ground.

7. When did CSK explain the meaning of #AnbuDen?

CSK explained the hashtag in April 2019. After the franchise used #AnbuDen in an official social media post, a fan asked what it meant. CSK replied that it meant “With Love” and also referred to “Chepauk, the Den.”

8. Are AnbuDen and Whistle Podu the same?

No. AnbuDen means “with love” and represents CSK’s connection with Chepauk. Whistle Podu means “blow the whistle” and is used as a celebratory call for CSK supporters. Both belong to CSK culture, but they serve different purposes.

title: Ravindra Jadeja Dismisses Steve Smith with a Stunning Delivery in CWC 2023
content:
During the Sunday encounter between India and Australia for the Cricket World Cup 2023 in Chennai, Ravindra Jadeja pulled off an incredible miracle to dismiss Steve Smith.

Jadeja chose to assault Smith with a back-of-the-length delivery despite the fact that he appeared to be in good form. After landing roughly along the leg-stump line, the ball abruptly turned to strike the top of the off-stump. The Australian batter did follow the delivery’s line, but the late variation utterly caught him off guard. Smith was rendered speechless by the delivery, and even Virat Kohli was taken aback by the ball’s movement, giving India the vital wicket.

Jadeja broke a crucial partnership between Marnus Labuschagne and Steve Smith that extended to 36 in the 28th over with a ripper. Steve Smith, who was looking good in the middle at 46, was undone by a classical left-arm spinner’s delivery that pitched on the middle stump line and hit the top of the off-stump. Smith looked clueless as he acknowledged the genius of Jadeja with a bewildered look on his face.

Jadeja compared the Chepauk pitch to a Test match wicket where some balls twisted and others went straight.

“The way I started the first over, the ball was stopping after it pitched. The wicket looked dry in the afternoon when it was hot. I thought the stump line would be good as some balls would dart in while some would turn. So, it won’t be easy for the batsman.

“My plan was to bowl on the stump and luckily the ball to Smith turned more. I thought this was a typical Test match wicket. We should not do any experiment and bowl stump-to-stump.”

“My plan was to bowl on the stump and luckily the ball to Smith turned more. I thought this was a typical Test match wicket. We should not do any experiment and bowl stump-to-stump.”

The all-rounder was also asked how different was his role from that of Ravichandran Ashwin and Kuldeep Yadav. He had the biggest smile on his face on hearing the question.

“There is no role. Only role is to get as many wickets as quickly as we could.”

Jadeja then went on to describe the wicket.

“On that wicket, all the three (spinners) would have thought the same: “I should get more wickets”. And if that’s in your mind, it’s not wrong. If everyone is thinking like this, then the opposition team will be bowled out quickly.” He did agree that Smith’s dismissal was the turning point.

“I think that was the turning point…a wicket like that of Steve Smith. From there onwards, it was not easy to come and rotate the strike for the new batters.

“So from there, they were 110 for 2 and became 199 all-out. I know the conditions in Chennai. I have been playing here (for CSK) since 10-11 years. I know how the conditions in this ground work. I enjoyed and whatever I contribute to the team I always feel happy.”

Ravindra Jadeja did not need much time to warm up to the World Cup 2023 campaign as he was on the mark in India’s World Cup 2023 opener against Australia at the MA Chidambaram Stadium on Sunday, October 8. title: Devon Conway hits first century of ODI World Cup 2023
content:
New Zealand’s Devon Conway and Rachin Ravindra hit the first centuries of the Cricket World Cup on Thursday in the opening match of the tournament against England.

Left-handed opener Conway made his fifth ODI ton off 83 balls studded with 13 fours and two sixes at the world’s biggest cricket stadium in Ahmedabad.

The left-hander is the 15th batter to achieve the feat in World Cups and the fourth Kiwi batter after Glenn Turner, Nathan Astle and Scott Styris. Conway reached the mark off just 83 balls on the back of 13 fours and two sixes.

Chennai Super Kings’s batter Conway eventually finished unbeaten on 152, during a thumping nine-wicket win, and registered the fourth-highest score by a World Cup debutant. Conway’s knock was also the highest score by a batter in a successful chase at the World Cup.

Fellow left-hander Ravindra soon followed with his maiden ODI century off 82 balls with nine fours and four sixes.

Set 283 to win by the defending champions, New Zealand lost Will Young for a duck in the second over of the chase but Conway and Ravindra took on the opposition bowlers with a string of boundaries and built a partnership of over 200.

The 13th edition of the World Cup has 10 teams and will run for 45 days in 10 Indian cities with the final in Ahmedabad on November 19.

Devon Conway, Ravindra record 4th-highest World Cup partnership with 273-run stand

Chasing a 283-run total against the defending champion, New Zealand lost opener Will Young for a duck in the second over before Ravindra and Conway teamed up for an unbeaten match-winning stand. Their 273-run stand came off just 211 deliveries.

The left-handed duo counter-attacked against the English seamers and raced to their respective hundreds in their debut World Cup match. Conway and Ravindra became the 15th and 16th batters to score a hundred on their 50-over World Cup debut, respectively.

The second-wicket stand is also the highest and the first 200-plus partnership by a New Zealand pair, breaking the previous highest of 168 by Chris Harris and Lee Germon, set in 1996 against Australia in Chennai.

Thank you for reading.

title: MS Dhoni dons a vintage-inspired new hairstyle by Aalim Hakim
content:
MS Dhoni Hairstyle: When Mahendra Singh Dhoni made his India debut in 2004, his flamboyant batting and skill behind the stumps won over the crowd. The former captain of India dazzled everyone with his cricket prowess as well as his magnificent mane.

When Dhoni won his first ICC title, the T20I World Cup in 2007, with long hair, it became fashionable, and many fans wanted to copy him. MS Dhoni’s hairstyle hadn’t gotten that long since his most recent hairdo is evocative of the time when he first became well-known in international cricket.

MS Dhoni’s New Hairstyle Ahead Of IPL 2024 

Celebrity hairstylist Aalim Hakim tweeted pictures of MS Dhoni’s new hairstyle, which is his most recent haircut. The 42-year-old’s hair is noticed to have streaks and to be longer.

After experimenting with a number of different haircuts in the past, before the most recent Indian Premier League (IPL), when everyone was cutting their hair short and crisp, Dhoni showed Hakim the fan-made image of him with long hair.

Alim Hakim Reveals The Inspiration Behind Former CSK Skipper’s New Look 

Hakim said he was fascinated by it and asked Dhoni to grow his hair long. They both promised each other that they “will not touch his hair” and will grow it before cutting it and styling it. “I have been a huge fan of Mahi bhai’s long hair, we decided to create an all-new texture and colour for the hair…I really enjoyed creating this effortless hairstyle for Mahi bhai,” Hakim wrote. He said he clicked these images just before Dhoni went for an ad film shoot.

Fans React on MS Dhoni’s Hairstyle

Alim Hakim’s post about MS Dhoni’s hairstyle instantly went viral as fans couldn’t stop sharing the pictures on their social media accounts. A user commented, ‘Vintage Dhoni is back’, while the other commented, ‘ Thala in 2007 World Cup Look’. The fans went bananas on the wicket-keeper batter’s new hairstyle. 

Celebrities React on MS Dhoni’s Hairstyle

Actor Anil Kapoor appreciated the hairstylist and wrote, “He’s looking great aalim .. great hair cut and the aalim touch.” “Wowwww Aaaaalim Bhai! Looks Fab!” actor Aparshakti Khurana said. “Internet is gonna blast today,” wrote a netizen. “This is going to be the most liked post of yours,” another person said.
excerpt: Aalim Hakim tweeted pictures of Dhoni with his new haircut. The 42-year-old's hair is noticed to have streaks and to be longer.

title: Deepak Chahar Reveals Why MS Dhoni Often Scolds Him
content:
White-ball cricket’s one of the most celebrated swing bowlers, Deepak Chahar, is now out of action for Team India due to injury. CSK bowler Deepak Chahar, who has excelled in shorter formats, particularly while Dhoni, with his iconic MS Dhoni hairstyle, served as captain in the IPL, is making a full recovery. His performances were crucial in helping Chennai win their fifth IPL championship this season. However, Chahar has consistently worried about injuries. He missed the first half of IPL 2023 due to a hamstring problem, and the entire 2022 IPL season due to a back injury.

Chahar idolizes Dhoni, who is frequently seen by spectators calling out the bowler during games. Chahar clarified this scenario in an interview with Sports Tak.

I am Dhoni Bhai’s love: CSK Bowler Deepak Chahar reveals his equation with Skipper MS Dhoni

“Dhoni is my elder brother,” Chahar shared with Sports Tak. “I am Dhoni Bhai’s love. Everyone has a different way of showing love. I consider him my elder brother and he is my idol. I have learned a lot from him and he treats me like a younger brother. For the elder brother, his younger brother always remains small and never grows up. And that’s why I get scolded. The relationship between me and Mahi Bhai is very strong and I consider myself very lucky.”

Chahar has entered the business realm in addition to his cricket career by establishing his sports brand, “D Nine Sports.” The company sells reasonably priced caps, t-shirts, and sneakers with a focus on aspiring cricketers. Chahar emphasized that the company serves those who cannot afford expensive equipment, reducing injuries from poor gear.

Chahar is not currently a member of the ODI World Cup roster despite his accomplishments, which include being a member of the 2018 Asia Cup winning team. Chahar has amazing statistics: 16 wickets in 13 ODI matches, 29 wickets in 24 T20 matches, and 72 wickets in 73 IPL games. He is eager to rehabilitate and get back on the field. He debuted in the ODI and T20 formats in 2018 and the IPL in 2016.

Thank you for reading.
excerpt: CSK's Deepak Chahar, who has excelled in shorter formats, particularly while Dhoni served as captain in the IPL, is making a full recovery

title: Gautam Gambhir Makes Bold Comment on MS Dhoni Before World Cup
content:
Former India opener Gautam Gambhir has praised MS Dhoni, describing him as a selfless captain. According to Gambhir, Dhoni sacrificed his international runs and focused more on leading India to major ICC trophies.

Gambhir has been a vocal critic of Dhoni in the past. He has often stated that one man didn’t win the World Cup for India [in 2011], referring to the latter’s 91* in the final against Sri Lanka.

However, in a recent video on Star Sports, the former cricketer lauded the Indian legend for putting team above self.

“Because of captaincy, he couldn’t achieve what he could have achieved as a batter. A lot of times as captain you have to keep team first. If MS was not captain, he could have batted at No 3. I am sure he could have broken several ODI records. He has won a lot of trophies, but individually he sacrificed his international runs for trophies,” Gambhir opined.

The 41-year-old went on to describe Dhoni as the first wicketkeeper of India who could change the game with his batting.

Elaborating on his thoughts, Gambhir said:

“Earlier, they were keepers first and batters later, but MS was batter first and then was a wicketkeeper. It was a blessing for Indian cricket that in MS Dhoni, we got a wicketkeeper-batter who can win you matches from No 7, because he had that power game.”

One of India’s most successful ODI batters, Dhoni scored 10773 runs in 350 matches at an average of 50.57, with 10 hundreds and 73 fifties.

During another interaction on Star Sports, 41-year-old Gautam Gambhir opined that Dhoni has had a big role to play in current Indian captain Rohit Sharma’s success.

Speaking after Rohit became the second fastest batter to score 10000 runs in ODIs, the former opener said:

“Scoring 10,000 runs was not easy for him. Saw many ups and downs. Having seen that phase, Rohit, as a captain, will back youngsters who go through a difficult period. Rohit Sharma is Rohit Sharma today because of MS Dhoni.”

“MS backed him continuously in his initial struggling phase. If he wants to leave a legacy behind, not in terms of runs but as a captain, a lot will depend on how he backs the young players. It will be interesting to see how he grooms the upcoming players,” the 41-year-old added.

Rohit led Team India to a 10-wicket win in the Asia Cup 2023 final against Sri Lanka in Colombo on Sunday.

Thank you for reading.
excerpt: Gautam Gambhir opined that Dhoni has had a big role to play in current Indian captain Rohit Sharma’s success.

title: Ben Stokes Smashes Record 182 in ODI Return Against New Zealand
content:
Following a brilliant knock against New Zealand in the thrilling ICC World Cup 2019 final, Ben Stokes has returned to the same format of the game from which he generated discussion of knighthood. Benjamin Andrew Stokes made his comeback in the third One Day International (ODI) in the bilateral series between the 2019 World Cup finalists, when he produced a brilliant knock to aid England in escaping a precarious circumstance.

At the Kennington Oval in London, where the penultimate ODI of the series between the two World Cup contenders was played, Stokes rewrote history by slamming a thunderous century to spark England’s comeback against the Kiwis. In the 50-over format, Stokes scored his first century since 2017. For the reigning world champions against the Black Caps, the England Test captain and teammate Dawid Malan also registered the greatest partnership (for any wicket).

Eoin Morgan and Joe Root’s famous 198-run stand against New Zealand in Nottingham in 2015 has been eclipsed by Stokes and Malan. While Stokes scored the fastest ODI century of his career, England’s Malan (96) was removed by Trent Boult in the 32nd over, preventing him from reaching his century. In just 76 balls, Stokes reached his century as England came back from 13-2 to post a difficult total against New Zealand.

Ben Stokes breaks England’s record for highest ODI score

With 63 ODI centuries in 2023, Stokes’ is the 12th-fastest century among players from full-member nations. Stokes’ fourth ODI century was also his first after coming out of retirement. In the 29th over, bowled by Glenn Phillips, the Englishman reached his century total. The superstar of the Chennai Super Kings (CSK) batted 76 balls to get his century, smashing 11 fours and three sixes. In preparation for the World Cup in India, Stokes has rejoined the England ODI team. After England played South Africa in a 50-over match at Chester-le-Street last year, the 32-year-old announced his retirement from the format.

In the 50-over format, Stokes blasted the highest individual score for England by turning his quick-fire century into a record-breaking knock. Against New Zealand in the third ODI, Stokes broke the 180-run mark to change the course of history. Jason Roy, who had hit 180 against Australia in 2018, was surpassed by Stokes. Stokes scored 182 off 124 balls in a fun innings during which he hit 15 fours and nine sixes.

Thank you for reading.

title: Ben Stokes Shines in ODI Return, Smashes 52 Against New Zealand
content:
Ben Stokes, the star of England who won the 2019 World Cup, had a triumphant return to the ODI lineup on Friday, September 8 by smashing 52 runs against New Zealand. Stokes played in his maiden 50-over match after coming out of retirement during the match that took place at Cardiff’s Sophia Gardens. Stokes unexpectedly ended his ODI career in July 2022 against South Africa, but the management of the national team pushed for his comeback.

At No. 4, Stokes did not feel the heat as the hosts got off to a strong start thanks to openers Harry Brook (25) and Dawid Malan (54). However, Stokes was forced into action in the 16th over as wickets started to fall quickly. When a short ball caught him off guard, the 32-year-old almost got out for a golden duck, but the shot flew over the point fielder. He would later, nevertheless, bolster his innings with the help of Joe Root (6) and Jos Buttler (72).

Stokes took a wise strategy, picking his spot on boring deliveries, and eventually scored his fifty. Three fours and a six were the only outs in his inning. He put on an 88-run partnership for the fourth wicket with captain Buttler while scoring at a strike rate of 75. The latter was also in excellent form and assisted England in reaching 291/6 in their 50 overs.

Twin Centuries from Devon Conway, Daryl Mitchell make Ben Stokes ODI return against New Zealand sorrowful

In the opening one-day international in Cardiff on Friday, New Zealand defeated hosts England by eight wickets thanks to outstanding hundreds from Devon Conway and Daryl Mitchell, stepping up their preparations for the World Cup in India later this month.

After being put in to bat at Cardiff’s Sophia Gardens, England scored 291-6 thanks to half-centuries from Dawid Malan, Ben Stokes, Jos Buttler, and Liam Livingstone.

The chase for New Zealand got off to a fast start thanks to runs from Will Young and Henry Nicholls, followed by a magnificent 180-run partnership between Conway (111 from 121 balls) and Mitchell (118 from 91).

Rachin Ravindra was the pick of New Zealand’s bowlers, picking up three wickets for 48, his best figures so far in his fledgling ODI career.

The second match of the four-game series will be played at the Rose Bowl in Southampton on Sunday.

Thank you for reading.
excerpt: Twin Centuries from Devon Conway, Daryl Mitchell make Ben Stokes ODI return against New Zealand sorrowful

title: Joburg Super Kings Stats: Most Runs scorers, Highest Wicket takers for JSK in SA20
content:
The Joburg Super Kings are a South African professional Twenty20 franchise cricket team that first competed in the inaugural season of the SA20 tournament in 2022. The team is based in Johannesburg, South Africa, and is owned by the Chennai Super Kings.

The Super Kings have had a successful start to their history, finishing as runners-up in their first season. They are captained by Faf du Plessis, a former South African international batsman who is considered one of the best Twenty20 batsmen in the world. The team’s coach is Stephen Fleming, a former New Zealand international batsman who is also a highly respected coach.

The Super Kings have a strong batting lineup led by du Plessis. They also have the likes of Leus du Plooy, Rassie van der Dussen, and David Miller in their ranks. Their bowling attack is also well-rounded, with the likes of Kagiso Rabada, Anrich Nortje, and Lungi Ngidi.

Most Runs for JSK

The Super Kings are one of the favorites to win the SA20 tournament in 2023. They have a good balance of youth and experience, and they are led by one of the best captains in the world. If they can play to their potential, they could be the team to beat this season.

Leus du Plooy

Leus du Plooy, the rising star from England, has carved a niche for himself with his audacious strokeplay. And in the second season for the Joburg Super Kings side, he has emerged as the highest runs corer for them, overtaking their captain Faf du Plessis.

This season has really been a difficult one for JSK. They have to face rain marred matches, and tough losses. But du Plooy stood tall among them all. He is the only star who has stepped up the game for them. Hopefully, he will shine bright enough to send his team to another semifinal this season.

Du Plooy’s journey from domestic cricket to the international stage is a testament to his determination and talent, and he’s poised to be a cornerstone for the Proteas in the coming years.

Faf du Plessis

Having led his team from the front in the first season, Faf du Plessis finds himself in a muddle in the season. He has struggled to get runs for his side in the latest edition of the SA20 League.

Still, with a total of 418 runs from 15 games, he remains the most runs getter for the side in this tournament. Also, everyone knows the capabilities that Faf possesses, hence there will be no one to put things past him and rule him out of the tournament as a finished player.

Reeza Hendricks

Reeza Hendricks, a name synonymous with elegance and class, has amassed 368 runs in 15 matches. His impeccable timing and ability to anchor the innings have made him a cherished asset for South Africa.

The season season has not been kind on him as well. He has struggled to get going in the tournament. Opening the batting with Faf, both the batters have often found themselves in situations from where they cannot rescue neither themselves, nor the team.

That doesn’t change the fact that Hendricks did a great job in the first season and is more than capable of turning things around for his team, and take them to the semifinals in another season.

Donovan Ferreira may not be a household name yet, but his 164 runs in ten matches hint at the potential that lies within. Ferreira’s rise through the ranks is a testament to the depth of talent in South African cricket, and his performances have ignited hopes for a promising future.

Romario Shepherd

Romario Shepherd, the Caribbean dynamo, has left a mark with his explosive batting. His ten appearances have yielded 117 runs, often coming in breathtaking fashion. Shepherd’s journey from the cricketing hotbed of Guyana to international recognition mirrors the rich cricketing heritage of the West Indies.

Matthew Wade, the Australian veteran, may have featured in just three matches, but his 66 runs signify the value of experience. Wade’s versatility, both with the bat and behind the stumps, makes him an indispensable asset for his team. His journey from a gritty wicket-keeper to a seasoned campaigner is a testament to his resilience.

Aaron Phangiso

Aaron Phangiso, the left-arm spinner, has played a pivotal role with both ball and bat, contributing 39 runs in six matches. His journey from the bustling streets of Soweto to the international stage reflects the power of passion and perseverance in cricket.

Kyle Verreynne

Kyle Verreynne, with five matches and 34 runs, represents the new generation of South African cricket. His wicket-keeping skills and burgeoning batting prowess make him a promising prospect. Verreynne’s journey from the cricketing heartland of Western Province to the national team is a story of talent nurtured in the crucible of domestic cricket.

Janneman Malan and George Garton

Janneman Malan and George Garton, with three matches each, are the fledgling talents of their respective teams. Malan’s aggressive batting style has earned him 23 runs, while Garton, the left-arm pacer, has contributed 20 runs. Their journeys, from local leagues to international representation, are tales of aspiration and determination.

In conclusion, beyond the numbers lies the tapestry of cricketing stories that define these ten individuals. They represent the diverse tapestry of backgrounds, talents, and dreams that converge on the international stage. As these players continue to etch their names

His ability to generate pace and bounce has put him on the fast track to stardom, and his performances are a testament to the future of South African fast bowling. Donovan Ferreira, an all-rounder, has contributed with both bat and ball, taking three wickets in eleven matches. His ability to provide breakthroughs and chip in with handy runs in the lower order makes him a valuable asset for his team.

While their international experience is limited, their presence in the squad highlights the depth of talent in South African cricket. Both players have the potential to evolve into match-winners for their respective teams.

In conclusion, these bowlers, each with their unique skills and journeys, form the backbone of their teams’ bowling arsenals. While the spotlight often gravitates towards the run-scorers, it’s crucial to acknowledge the role these bowlers play in shaping the outcome of matches. As they continue to hone their craft and deliver memorable performances, they add depth and excitement to the world of cricket.

title: MS Dhoni Plays Golf With Former US President Donald Trump
content:
After witnessing Carlos Alcaraz and Alexander Zverev play in the US Open men’s singles quarterfinal match, former India captain MS Dhoni was invited to play golf at the Trump National Golf Club Bedminster by former US President Donald Trump.

Sanghvi shared a video of Dhoni and Trump playing golf together in one of his Instagram stories.

Sanghvi, a businessman from Dubai, was with MS Dhoni and has posted a number of pictures with the former India captain on his social media pages.

A day before, MS Dhoni, Sanghvi, and a friend of theirs were all spotted at the US Open.

‘No One Knows Dhoni?’: MS Dhoni Playing Golf With Donald Trump Leaves Cricket Fans in Funny Banter

A thrilling video of MS Dhoni and Donald Trump playing a golf match became viral online. However, this unanticipated encounter caused a meme frenzy on social media as users expressed their shock in a variety of ways.

For Dhoni’s devoted followers, seeing these two individuals, each with their own tales and successes, on a golf course was nothing short of a surprise. In actuality, it was a potent testament to Dhoni’s exceptional journey from a position of destitution to becoming the recognized face of Indian cricket. This voyage has touched people all across the world in addition to inspiring admirers in India.

One user humourously questioned, “Donald trump: president ki kursi ke peeche se bhi game badal sakte ho???” Another sarcastically remarked, “Apparently no one knows Dhoni outside India.,” addressing the misconception that Dhoni’s fame is confined to his home country. Someone else commented, “In today’s episode of ‘mahi inspires’,” alongside the now-viral picture.

Mahendra Singh Dhoni had a successful surgery on his left knee earlier this year in a Mumbai hospital, giving him hope that he will take part in the 17th Indian Premier League season the following year.

After the championship game, Dhoni took a flight from Ahmedabad to Mumbai, where he met with renowned sports orthopaedic surgeon Dr. Dinshaw Pardiwala. Pardiwala is a member of the BCCI medical panel and has operated on many of the country’s top cricketers, including Rishabh Pant.

Dhoni had played the entire season with heavy strapping on his left knee and while he looked absolutely fine during wicket-keeping, he came into bat as low as No. 8 at times and didn’t look in his element while running between the wickets.

title: MS Dhoni Watches Carlos Alcaraz vs Alexander Zverev at US Open
content:
MS Dhoni, a former captain of India, watched Carlos Alcaraz overcome Alexander Zverev on Wednesday to advance to the US Open 2023 semifinals.

Since helping Chennai Super Kings win their sixth IPL championship a few months ago, Dhoni has been absent from the cricket field and is frequently pictured having fun.

Dhoni was spotted watching the World No. 1 play Zverev in the US Open quarterfinals on Wednesday.

Alcaraz, a 19-year-old Spanish prodigy, defeated Zverev in the match on a Wednesday by a score of 6-3, 6-2, 6-4. This victory was particularly significant since it allowed Alcaraz to advance to the 2023’s final big tournament’s semifinals.

Watch: MS Dhoni in attendance during Carlos Alcaraz vs Alexander Zverev US Open 2023 quarterfinal

Having led Chennai Super Kings to their fifth Indian Premier League championship earlier this year, Dhoni, on the other hand, is relishing his time away from the game.

Dhoni went from being a ticket taker at a train station to becoming India’s foremost trophy aficionado by captaining the team to the ICC T20 World Cup 2007, ICC ODI World Cup 2011, and ICC Champions Trophy 2013. Unquestionably, MS Dhoni is among the best captains in the history of cricket.

The fact that Dhoni is not active on social media is bad news for the followers of the wicketkeeper-batter because of how popular he is. His followers must rely on viral videos and images to catch a glimpse of the player because he rarely updates the platform.

In August 2020, Dhoni ended his career in international cricket. He did, though, continue to play in the Indian Premier League.

His involvement in the IPL for the following year is still unknown, though.

title: MS Dhoni Named Brand Ambassador for Free Fire India by Garena
content:
Battle Royale games are especially beloved by Indian gamers, while Call of Duty, Garena Free Fire, and BGMI are hugely popular in the Indian gaming market. These games are enjoyed by millions of Indian gamers, so any news pertaining to them is quite important to them.

After a 10-month restriction, the game was recently made available in India, much to the joy of BGMI aficionados. Garena Free Fire players have reason to believe that their game will soon be allowed to return to India after BGMI’s unbanning, and rumors of this have been circulating for the past several days.

Players of Garena Free Fire may now stop waiting because the game is about to reopen in India with a new name and some new guidelines. The Government of India outlawed Free Fire, BGMI, and a few other applications in February 2022 due to security concerns.

In India, Garena Free Fire will relaunch as Free Fire India. The game will “incorporate unique content and features to encourage a safe, healthy, and enjoyable gameplay experience,” according to the creator. Yotta, a Hiranandani Group subsidiary, will offer the local cloud hosting and storage infrastructure for the game.

“As a MeitY-empanelled service provider, Yotta will ensure best in-class management of personal data of Indian users on local servers and network connectivity services to support Garena’s product offerings in India, including in exports,” Garena said in a press release.

The game will be available to download from September 5 and will include features such as a verification system to enable parental supervision, gameplay limitations and ‘take a break’ reminders.

Garena names MS Dhoni as brand ambassador for Free Fire India

Garena also announced that MS Dhoni has joined as the game’s brand ambassador and will be available as a playable character in the game named ‘Thala’. Other leading sportspersons, such as football captain Sunil Chhetri, badminton champion Saina Nehwal, tennis legend Leander Paes, and Kabbadi champion Rahul Chaudhari will join Dhoni.

Garena says that MS Dhoni will be ‘celebrated as the first Indian sportsperson to be featured in-game as a playable character Thala’.

Mr Gang Ye, Co-founder of Garena, commented on the game’s relaunch and said,

“India is home to very passionate communities of esports enthusiasts and we are excited to be able to support our fans from Bharat with the launch of Free Fire India. We look forward to providing an engaging and highly localized experience for Indian users.

We believe our partnership with Yotta will ensure that our users can enjoy the highest quality gameplay experience and benefit from Yotta’s expertise in protecting and securing Indian user data. We are also committed to supporting the development of India’s esports and startup ecosystems.

The Free Fire India Esports Championships is our first step in building out our platform of esports events and activities in the coming months to empower Indian esports athletes to succeed globally.”

Thank you for reading.
excerpt: Garena names Chennai Super Kings skipper 'Thala' MS Dhoni as brand ambassador for Free Fire India

title: Ambati Rayudu Joins St Kitts & Nevis Patriots for CPL 2023
content:
Ambati Rayudu has been signed by St. Kitts & Nevis Patriots as their star player for the upcoming season, making him the second Indian to play in the men’s Caribbean Premier League (CPL).

After aiding Chennai Super Kings win their sixth IPL championship in May of this year, Rayudu, 37, announced his retirement from both international and Indian cricket. Then, Texas Super Kings revealed Ambati Rayudu as one of their new additions for the country’s first Major League Cricket competition.

But five days before the league’s start, Rayudu withdrew in protest of the BCCI’s plan to require retired Indian players to wait a year before taking part in foreign franchise competitions.

Rayudu would increase the Indian representation in the men’s league if he is cleared. When Pravin Tambe was playing for Trinbago Knight Riders in 2020, he became the first Indian to compete in the men’s CPL. The men’s CPL has featured two other Indian cricketers, Sunny Sohal and Smit Patel, however they were eligible as USA players. Shreyanka Patil will also play in the Women’s CPL for the first time this season after signing with the Guyana Amazon Warriors.

Even though Rayudu hasn’t played international cricket in the Caribbean, he did participate in the 50-over Carib Beer Cup in 2002–2003, where teams from several islands battled against India A and the West Indies B. At the time, he had played six games and recorded 289 runs while taking seven wickets.

Ambati Rayudu signs up for St Kitts & Nevis Patriots ahead of Caribbean Premier League (CPL)

As a member of the Patriots’ international roster, Rayudu will join the South African group of Dewald Brevis, Tristan Stubbs, Corbin Bosch, and George Linde as well as Izharulhaq Naveed of Afghanistan. Following Bravo’s departure, Evin Lewis, who had previously captained Patriots to the men’s 6IXTY championship last year, will lead the CPL team this season.

Currently, Indian players are only permitted to participate in foreign competitions if they have retired from both BCCI-run tournaments like the IPL and international cricket. Indian cricketers have recently took part in franchise events after leaving the international game include Unmukt Chand, Robin Uthappa, Yusuf Pathan, and Sreesanth.

From August 16 to September 24 in the Caribbean, five locations will host the men’s CPL 2023. The CPL will coincide with the Lanka Premier League playoffs as well as the Hundred in England, which this year runs from August 1 to August 27. On August 19 in St. Lucia, Patriots will play TKR, a frequent CPL champion.

Thank you for reading.
excerpt: Ambati Rayudu has been signed by St. Kitts & Nevis Patriots, making him the second Indian to play in the men's Caribbean Premier League (CPL).

title: MLC 2023: MI New York Defeat Texas Super Kings to Reach Final
content:
MLC 2023 Eliminator: MI New York (MINY) defeated the Texas Super Kings (TSK) in the Challenger match to advance to the final of the inaugural MLC team.

Chasing 159 to win, cameos from Shayan Jahangir (36) and Tim David (33) were enough to help MINY cruise to victory with six wickets in hand. The two franchises have had an age-old rivalry in the IPL, particularly in the playoffs, and MINY would be happy to avenge their league setback over TSK.

Our batting has been below par: Faf du Plessis after the heartbreaking defeat in MLC 2023 Eliminator

Faf du Plessis, Texas Super Kings skipper: Our batting has been below par right throughout the tournament, starting with myself. We scratched our way to most of the totals. Tonight we held some composure and got to a decent total. Fought really hard in the field but they’ve got a really strong middle order. Really tough to find form, especially when the conditions are different on the field and at practice.

Skip concluded by saying, “It’s not like a one-day game where you can take some time, there’s always scoreboard pressure. Some guys have been in good form while others have struggled. We need to really try and dominate the first 10 overs.

Finally, Faf du Plessis thanked the spectators and TSK supporters, “The second 10 overs is where the damage gets done so it’s about playing well in the first 10. Get a good score and then there’s always a death bowler you can target. Seen a lot of yellow shirts, it’s been a positive. Thank you all very much.”

The Brevis-David duo paved the way for MI New York after Boult’s 4-fer

Earlier in the day, MI New York won the toss and put the Texas Super Kings into bat. Trent Boult got MINY off to a terrific start when he dismissed Captain Faf du Plessis for 6 runs off 9 balls in the third over. Mitchell Santner and Cody Chetty were also sent packing in quick succession as the Super Kings found themselves in deep trouble at 34/3.

However, Devon Conveyand Milind Kumar rebuilt the Super Kings’ innings and took the score to 98/3 in 14 overs. Nonetheless, the wickets fell on quick succession and the Super Kings found themselves on 158 in 20 overs. Meanwhile, Boult left the field with an impressive 4/24 in his four-over quota.

Despite losing Slade van Staden early in the game, Shayan Jahangir made sure MI New York got off to a good start on the powerplay. He scored 36 points on 18 shots and helped his side recover from their initial setback.

MINY continued to lose wickets at regular intervals, leaving Dewald Brevis and Tim David to consolidate the chase. MI New York appeared to be leaving it too late at one point. However, runs began to flow from both ends, with David hitting three sixes against Mohammad Mohsin in the 16th over.

After Tim David left, David Wiese joined Brevis and made certain that the kid received the best possible support from the opposite end. Brevis hit a boundary to bring up the winning runs, and his excitement demonstrated how important the franchise was to him.

MINY will now face the Seattle Orcas in the MLC 2023 final on Monday, July 31 at 6 a.m. IST.

Thank you for reading.

title: MLC 2023 Qualifier: Orcas Beat TSK by 9 Wickets to Final
content:
MLC 2023 Qualifier: The Texas Super Kings (TSK) were defeated by the Seattle Orcas by nine wickets, setting up a match against the MI New York in Qualifier 2 of the Major League Cricket (MLC) Playoffs.

The side led by Faf du Plessis was far from its best, scoring only 126-9 in the first innings after electing to bat first. On the strength of Quinton de Kock’s undefeated half-century, the Orcas easily chased down the total with five overs to spare.

TSK struggled to get going with the bat, with Daniel Sams finishing with the most runs (26). Over the duration of the innings, only two other batters managed to score 20 runs. Andrew Tye was the bowler to beat, finishing with statistics of 3-32. Imad Wasim, a left-arm spinner, also contributed with a 2-23 spell.

“It’s a bad day at the office” – Faf du Plessis addressed TSK’s tame loss in Qualifier 1

TSK were outplayed across all three departments in the Qualifier 1 clash against league leaders Seattle Orcas. The Wayne Parnell-led side became the first finalist of the inaugural MLC tournament, while TSK have to battle it out against old foes for a spot in the final.

Admitting that he made the wrong decision at the toss, Faf du Plessis said during the post-match presentation:

“It’s a bad day at the office. We thought the pitch was going to be real slow. But it’s night time so I think we made a mistake at the toss. Hindsight is always 20/20.”

He continued:

“Came on to the bat better later and they played really well. Big wake-up call for tomorrow and we’ll have to be better in all areas. The beautiful thing about tomorrow is that it’s a new day. As bad as today was, tomorrow is a new opportunity.”

Fans criticized TSK’s attitude, intent, and decision to bat first after winning the toss, while MI New York fans are looking forward to a showdown with their rivals. Here are some of the Twitter reactions:

MLC 2023 Qualifier: Can TSK still qualify for the finals?

Faf du Plessis and company will face the MI New York on Friday, July 28 at Grand Prairie Stadium in Dallas, Texas, as part of the MLC 2024, for a chance to battle for the trophy against the Seattle Orcas. During the league stage match between the two teams, the Men in Yellow came out on top.

Thank you for reading.

title: MLC 2023: Faf du Plessis' Kings Suffer 8-Wicket Loss in Match 10
content:
MLC 2023, TSK vs SO: With their third straight victory of the season, Seattle Orcas went to the top of the MLC tournament 2023 points table thanks to their eight-wicket victory over Texas Super Kings, which was aided by Wayne Parnell’s fifer and Quinton de Kock’s half-century.

When Super Kings were put in to bat, they suffered a setback right away when devon Conway was dismissed with a first-ball duck. During the powerplay, Faf du Plessis and Cody Chetty briefly kept the inning from stumbling until Andrew Tye dispatched the TSK captain and Parnell smashed through the middle of the order with three quick strikes.

Their problems were made worse when Mitchell Santner was caught behind and undone by extra pace from Cameron Gannon in the following over. Daniel Sams and Dwayne Bravo’s unconventionally conservative attitude helped the Super Kings restart their innings. Even though there weren’t many possibilities, the pair patiently awaited their scoring chances and moved quickly to punish the Orcas bowlers’ line mistakes. In 45 balls, the pair scored 56 runs together, but Tye broke the stand, and Parnell added two more wickets to dismiss TSK for 127.

MLC 2023, TSK vs SO: Parnell, de Kock lead TSK demolition

Orcas responded by moving cautiously in the direction of the objective. De Kock and Nauman Anwar, the openers, put up a 67-run partnership that came at almost run-a-ball. Anwar in particular had trouble getting going. The pace trio of Sams, Juan Theron, and Zia-ul-Haq consistently outran him throughout the powerplay, which resulted in Orcas scoring just 33 runs.

Orcas were moving at less than run-a-ball until the ninth over of the chase, and De Kock was having a difficult time, too. After that, the southpaw found his footing and took Mitchell Santner down the track, hauling him for a six, and then swiveling Bravo for another six in the following over.

Anwar’s agony, which had lasted 32 balls and 19 runs, ended in the eleventh over when Santner got rid of him. In Santner’s following over, De Kock, who was just about to get going and had reached his fifty with another pulled six off Zia, was also removed. But right when it appeared that TSK might have a slim chance, Heinrch Klaasen disproved that.

He dismantled Mohammad Mohsin in the fifteenth over after already switching to assault mode at the outset. The South African batter hit the bowler for three boundaries and two sixes in the 24-run over after being knocked down by him off the opening ball of the over. The hunt was almost over after that.

We didn’t bat well: TSK Captain, du Plessis after the abashing loss

Faf du Plessis, Captain Texas Super Kings: We didn’t bat well, obviously tricky wicket, you gotta get through first six overs. It does get a bit better after first 10. First six overs for the them was tricky too and then it got easier. We have to find a way and the learning here is to play the first ten overs. After a game like this, we don’t want to have an emotional response, just look at the things you can get better at.

Thank you for reading.

title: Texas Super Kings Beat LAKR by 69 Runs in MLC 2023 Opener
content:
At the Grand Prairie Stadium in Dallas on Friday, Texas Super Kings defeated LA Knight Riders by a score of 69 runs in the Major League Cricket (MLC) 2023 season opener. Despite Andre Russell scoring a half-century (55), LAKR were dismissed for 112 runs in just 14 overs while chasing a target of 182. 

Mohammad Mohsin, meanwhile, claimed four wickets for TSK. Texas initially scored 181/6 in 20 overs thanks to notable scores from Miler (61) and Conway (55). Lockie Ferguson and Ali Khan each claimed two wickets for LAKR.

David Miller, Devon Convey provided TSK inning momentum

TSK used their allotted 20 overs to post a respectable total of 181 runs for the cost of 6 wickets. With 55 runs off 37 balls, including 7 fours and 1 six, Devon Conway had a significant inning. Consequently, Conway became the first batter to hit a half-century in the maiden Major League Cricket. 

On top of that, David Miller stood out as the star performer with two fours and four sixes in his scorching 61 off just 42 balls. Mitchell Santner made an immediate contribution of 21 runs off 14 pitches. With two wickets each, Ali Khan and Lockie Ferguson were the Knight Riders’ top two bowlers.

When LAKR needed to score 182 runs to win, they struggled and were dismissed for just 112 runs in 14 overs. With an incredible knock of 55 runs off 34 balls that contained 7 fours and 3 sixes, Andre Russell displayed some tenacity. Jaskaran Malhotra also contributed 22 runs off 11 deliveries, playing a useful knock. The Super Kings bowlers, though, proved to be too powerful for the Knight Riders. Taking 4 wickets for just 8 runs in his 3 overs, Mohammad Mohsin excelled. Gerald Coetzee and Rusty Theron both put forth strong performances, both taking two wickets.

The Super Kings demonstrated their superiority in both bowling and hitting in this triumph.

Miller was named the deserving “Player of the Match” for his impressive at-bats.

Fact trivia

Similar to Chennai Super Kings in Ipl, all its sister franchise teams including Texas Super Kings and Jo’burg Super Kings have won their opening matches in MLC 2023 and SA 20 League, respectively.

title: MS Dhoni Calls Deepak Chahar "Like a Drug" in Bromance Moment
content:
Many Indian cricketers, including well-known figures like Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma, see MS Dhoni as a mentor, and they have all expressed gratitude for the advice he provided them in the early stages of their careers. Between 2007 and 2018, Dhoni led India as its captain for over 11 years. He has also led Chennai Super Kings as its captain since the league’s first season in 2008.

On top of that, the most successful team in the history of the Indian Premier League (IPL), Chennai Super Kings (CSK), is renowned for its culture and capacity to bring out the best in its players. Since MS Dhoni and Stephen Fleming are known for making players comfortable in the roles they want them to play in before giving them a long run, many young stars have played for India following a time with CSK. As a result, they are not afraid of losing their place if one or two games don’t go well.

All-around fast bowler Deepak Chahar is one of the alumni of this CSK academy. Since the days of the Rising Pune Supergiants, Chahar has played with Dhoni and Fleming and has developed into a bowling all-rounder who provides much more than simply four overs in a T20 match. CSK pursued him and spent INR 14 crore in the major auction to keep him, demonstrating their commitment to and desperation for him.

MS Dhoni takes a hilarious dig on Deepak Chahar for his ‘drug-like’ influence

“Deepak Chahar is like a drug, if he is not there, you would think, where is he – if he is around, you would think, why he is here – good part is that he is maturing but he takes time and that is the problem, in my lifetime, I won’t see him matured (smiles),” Dhoni said on the sidelines of the trailer and audio launch of his production company Dhoni Entertainment’s maiden film ‘Let’s Get Married’.

Chahar and Dhoni have a unique bond because they have been together for a while. While Chahar never misses an opportunity to tease Dhoni and has tried to annoy him in amusing ways on numerous occasions because he is not particularly social media friendly, the captain also never misses an opportunity to poke fun at or troll the pacer whenever he gets the chance.

IPL 2023 served as yet another reminder of this, with Dhoni scaring Chahar away with his shadow batting in the dugout, pretending to hit him during practice, or best of all, refusing to sign his jersey after CSK won the title because he dropped a catch. The two had a number of hilarious moments together, and now that they were sharing more about their relationship, the CSK captain decided to troll him once more.

Chahar pointed out another classic example of MS Dhoni’s leadership qualities

Deepak Chahar played an integral role in CSK winning their fifth IPL title this year. He recently gave an example of how Dhoni works with his bowlers. “I was bowling in the death overs for the very first time. They never made me bowl in the death because it was not needed. There were bowlers like Shardul and Bravo to bowl the death overs. Now Bravo got injured. It was a critical match,” said Chahar in a recent episode of Breakfast with Champions.

Chahar said that he ended up bowling two beamers on the trot and was reprimanded by Dhoni. “He (Dhoni) came to me and said ‘you act smart as if you know everything. Why are you bowling in this manner?’ I was thinking that my career was over. Then I gave 5 runs off the next 5 balls and after the match he hugged me,” the pacer said.

Needless to say, Dhoni’s cheerful demeanour with his teammates outside the playing arena and his father-like reprimanding inside the field makes him great leader and a class apart.

Moreover, despite paying such a huge sum, CSK are likely to retain Deepak Chahar for IPL 2024 and with MS Dhoni set to play for one last time, the fans will get to see the banter between the duo yet again.

Thank you for reading.
excerpt: CSK are likely to retain Deepak Chahar for IPL 2024, with MS Dhoni set to play for one last time, fans will get to see the banter yet again.

title: Moeen Ali to Play for Jo’burg Super Kings in 2024 SA20
content:
Moeen Ali, off-spin all-rounder from England, will represent Jo’burg Super Kings in the SA20 league in 2024. This announcement comes as the six teams reveal the players they have pre-signed and retained for the league’s second season, which will begin in January 2024.

Jo’burg Super Kings: Retention and fresh signings

Ali played for the Sharjah Warriors in the inaugural ILT20 tournament last year because SA20’s dates clashed with that of ILT20’s. But as things stand right now, Ali will play for Chennai Super Kings’ sister Johannesburg team in SA20. Opening batsman Faf du Plessis and bowler Gerald Coetzee have been retained by Johannesburg to lead their attack.

Along with Ali, David Wiese of Namibia, Zahir Khan of Afghanistan, and Sam Cook of England, who was The Hundred’s Player of the Final from the previous season, will also join the team.

Check out what each fresh signing has to offer

The Faf du Plessis-led side finished as the semifinalists in the inaugural edition of the tournament. However, Jo’burg Super Kings will be hopeful to win their maiden SA20 title after the pre signing of the new overseas players for the second edition of the League that will be held in South Africa.

Moeen Ali

The England all-rounder Moeen Ali has a wealth of experience in all game formats. In 129 ODIs, 74 T20Is, and 65 Tests, Moeen has played for England. In international cricket, he has amassed over 6000 runs and over 300 wickets.

Since IPL 2021, the all-rounder has also been a part of the Chennai Super Kings organisation. In 59 IPL games, the left-hander has scored over 1000 runs and claimed 33 wickets. Additionally, Moeen was a member of the CSK teams that won the IPL in 2021 and 2023.

David Wiese

In international cricket, David Wiese has played for both South Africa and Namibia. Wiese has participated in 15 ODIs and 39 T20 Internationals. He is an all-rounder with the ability to hit hard and take key wickets.

In addition, he has participated in more than 300 T20 games throughout his career, including the Indian Premier League, Pakistan Super League, Caribbean Premier League, and The Hundred.

Zahir Khan

Zahir Khan, a left-arm leg spinner from Afghanistan who is 24 years old, has the ability to extract turn and bounce off the pitch. He has also played in all three game formats for the Afghan national team. Zahir has experience playing in both the Caribbean Premier League and the Big Bash League. In his T20 career, he has captured around 100 wickets.

Sam Cook

Sam Cook is an English right-arm medium bowler who has over 200 first-class wickets to his credit. Cook has experience acting in the film The Hundred, in which he played a part for the Trent Rockets. He picked up four wickets in the The Hundred Final last year and was named Player of the Match.

Cook, a speedster who can bat either way, will be a crucial addition to the Joburg team for the second SA20 tournament.

Here are what the squads look like for each time as of now:

Durban Super Giants: Quinton de Kock, Prenelan Subrayen, Kyle Mayers, Naveen-ul-Haq, Bhanuka Rajapaksa, Reece Topley

Jo’burg Super Kings: Faf du Plessis, Gerald Coetzee, Moeen Ali, David Wiese, Sam Cook, Zahir Khan

MI Cape Town: Kagiso Rabada, Dewald Brevis, Sam Curran, Liam Livingstone, Rashid Khan, Tom Banton

Paarl Royals: David Miller, Corbin Bosch, Jos Buttler, Obed McCoy

Pretoria Capitals: Migael Pretorius, Anrich Nortje, Jimmy Neesham

Sunrisers Eastern Cape: Aiden Markram, Ottniel Bartman, Dawid Malan, Liam Dawson

According to a report in The Cricketer, the tournament will probably conflict with England’s Test series against India in 2024. Due to their prospects of being selected for the tour, Moeen and Curran may have to quit the competition in the middle.

Prior to the September draught, the pre-signing period for SA20 has now ended. The six teams still have until July 21 to trade South African players, keep foreign players from their 2023 teams, or buy out players with long-term contracts.

The wage pots for SA20 franchises can now be increased for the 2019 season, giving them an extra £250,000 to create their team.

Don’t forger to revisit the site for more Jo’burg Super Kings news!

Thank you for reading.

title: MS Dhoni Wins Hearts with Gesture Towards Security Guard
content:
MS Dhoni, the former captain of the Indian cricket team, has been making headlines with a viral video showing him dropping off a security guard at the gate of his farmhouse on his bike. The video gives us a rare glimpse into Dhoni’s life away from the cricket field as he takes a break from the spotlight to spend quality time with his family.

Dhoni recently led the Chennai Super Kings (CSK) to a victorious campaign in the 2023 Indian Premier League (IPL). Despite battling a knee injury throughout the tournament, Dhoni’s leadership skills shone through, and he guided CSK to victory, although he only batted in a few deliveries in most matches due to his injury.

After the successful IPL season, Dhoni underwent knee surgery in Mumbai. He will need a few months to complete his rehabilitation and recovery process. This break allows him to recharge and spend valuable time with his loved ones.

MS Dhoni drops his security guard on bike

MS Dhoni the large-hearted man

The thread includes heart-warming videos of the legendary captain crediting his team in front of fans, motivating his teammates, and encouraging young players to join him in celebrating victory.

One video shows Dhoni interacting with a fan who thanks him for winning numerous trophies, to which Dhoni humbly responds, “It’s the whole team.” It’s worth noting that Dhoni is considered the most successful captain, having led his team to victory in all ICC tournaments. title: Ben Stokes' Incredible Innings of 155 Against Australia at Lord's goes in vain as hosts falter
content:
Chennai Super Kings fans were glued to their screens on Sunday as Ben Stokes put on a batting masterclass against Australia at Lord’s. Stokes’ innings of 155 was one of the most incredible things they had ever seen, and it was a joy to watch him play.

Stokes came to the crease with England in trouble at 45/4, and he proceeded to take the attack to the Australian bowlers. He hit 9 sixes and 9 fours, and at times, he looked completely unstoppable. He even hit a six off the first ball he faced from Josh Hazlewood.

Ben Stokes the embodiment of Bazball

This inning was an embodiment of everything England’s new approach, “Bazball,” stands for. This is a term that has been coined to describe England’s new, aggressive batting style. Stokes’ innings were a perfect example of this style, and it is sure to inspire other batsmen to play with the same kind of freedom and attacking intent.

However, what makes this inning even more impressive is the fact that he did it on a pitch that was offering plenty of assistance to the bowlers. The ball was seaming and swinging, and Stokes had to play some incredible shots to survive. But he never gave up and kept fighting until the very end.

England fails to conquer at Lord’s

In the end, Stokes’ innings fell just short as England lost by 43 runs. But even in defeat, Stokes’ performance was nothing short of heroic. He showed incredible courage and determination, and he gave his team every chance to win.

As a CSK fan, I was particularly proud of Stokes’ innings. He is one of my favourite players, and I have always been impressed by his all-around ability. He is a brilliant batsman, a world-class bowler, and a fantastic fielder. And he is also a great leader.

Stokes’ innings at Lord’s was a reminder of just how special a player he is. He is one of the best cricketers in the world, and he is an inspiration to us all.

Here is a more detailed look at Stokes’ batting performance:

  • He scored 155 runs off 214 balls.
  • He hit 9 sixes and 9 fours.
  • He had a strike rate of 72.41.
  • He faced 102 dots balls.
  • Josh Hazlewood dismissed him.

Stokes’ innings was a masterclass in how to bat on a difficult pitch. He showed great patience and discipline, and he never gave up. He is a true warrior and an inspiration to us all.

title: CSK Centuries And Fifties
content:
CSK total centuries was 13, which is the third-most of any team in the IPL. In this article, we will take a look at the players with the most centuries and fifties for CSK, including those who contributed to the CSK highest score.

Chennai Super Kings is the most popular team in the marquee tournament of Indian Premier League. They have been a part of the tournament since its inception (barring the 2-year ban in 2016-17)and have emerged as a powerhouse and a team to beat in the IPL. Over the years, Chennai Super Kings has attracted the trophy, solidifying their reputation in the league.

Over the 14 seasons in which they have partook in the tournament, they have managed to win 5 titles and reached the final of the tournament on 9 different occasions. One of the most impressive batting records in CSK is the CSK total centuries their players have scored, including the CSK highest score in IPL history

CSK Players Century Statistics

Who has Most Centuries for CSK in IPL?

Chennai Super Kings has had three batsmen who have scored two centuries each and hold the title of most centuries for CSK altogether. These batters are Murali Vijay, Shane Watson, and most recent joiner Ruturaj Gaikwad. So without further ado, let’s take a look at their performances

Murali Vijay

Murali Vijay was the first batter to score 2 centuries for CSK in IPL. His first hundred came against RR in 2010, where he stunned the opposition with a magnificent innings of 127 runs from just 56 balls. This inning came at the home ground of CSK, and included sky lighting 8 fours and 11 sixes.

Two years down the line Vijay scored his second century for CSK. This time it was against Delhi, again at the popular Chepauk Stadium. This time he scored 113 runs from 58 balls, which included 15 fours and 4 sixes.

Shane Watson

The Australian best and the reason behind Chennai Super King’s 2018 IPL triumph also holds 2 centuries to his name. What’s even more amazing is the fact that both these centuries came in the same season.

Watson scored his first century of the season against Rajasthaj Royals in Pune, which was CSK’s temporary home in that season. It was a great inning of 106 runs from just 57 balls. The second hundred was more decisive and important as it came in the final of the same season against SRH, at Mumbai.

His blistering knock of 117* off 57 ensured that Chennai went over the line to complete a fairy tale comeback in IPL. This knock helped Chennai Super Kings secure their third IPL title, after returning to the league post 2 year ban.

Ruturaj Gaikwad

The new CSk captain Ruturaj Gaikwad is already a part of the elite group of players with most centuries for Chennai Super Kings. Ever since his debut in 2020, Gaikwad has been impressing fans with his immensely great performance.

However, his first century came in 2021 against Rajasthan Royals in Abu Dhabi. Ruturaj played an amazing knock of 101* off just 60 balls. His inning included 9 fours and 5 sixes. Although CSK went on to lose that game, his inning was a trailer of things to come in future.

The second Century came 3 seasons later in 2024 against Lucknow Super Gaints. In this game, Ruturaj scored 108* off 60 balls to become the first captain of CSK to score a century in IPL. The inning included 12 fours and 3 sixes, and sealed the win for the team as well.

Michael Hussey

Most fifties for CSK in IPL

Suresh Raina

Suresh Raina has been known to be the one leading run-scorer for CSK in the IPL. He has accumulated a total of 4687 runs which makes him a legend for the CSK fans and franchise. He has no only scored this many runs but he has also scored the most fifties for the team which now counts to 33 fifties in total. He has been a part of the tournament for 16 years now.

After making his IPL debut when it first started back in 2008 and has since been an irreplaceable member of the team. He has been an important part of winning the IPL title for three times along with being the Man of the Tournament in 2010. He has been a regular member of the Indian national team and he has played in over 200 ODIs and T20s.

MS Dhoni

The player after Raina with most fifties for Chennai Super Kings is none other than captain cool, Mr MS Dhoni. He has accumulated 22 half centuries for CSK and he is still playing.

Right after making his debut back when the IPL first began in 2008, Dhoni has since then scored over 4000 runs for his team. He has also scored 49 fifties for the team. Dhoni is a right-handed batter and has a strike rate of over around 130 in the IPL itself. He is known to be a very good wicket keeper and has taken over 100 catches in the entirety of IPL.

Faf du Plessis

Faf du Plessis joined CSK in 2022. Being a South African batsman. He has since then scored over around 2700 runs for CSK and he has also scored 20 fifties. Du Plessis is a right-handed batsman who is known for his aggressive batting style. 

After making his IPL debut back in 2012 Du Plessis has since then played for a number of teams in the league. He then joined CSK in 2022 and has since continued to be a very important member of the team. 

How many centuries have CSK scored in the IPL?

Chennai Super Kings (CSK) players have scored a total of 13 centuries in the history of the Indian Premier League (IPL).

FAQ

Who scored the first-ever century for CSK in IPL history?

The first-ever century for Chennai Super Kings (CSK) in IPL history was scored by Michael Hussey. He achieved this milestone on April 25, 2008, against Kings XI Punjab during the inaugural season of the IPL.

How many hundreds has Suresh Raina scored for Chennai Super Kings?

Suresh Raina, who is one of the leading runs scorers for CSK has scored 3 centuries for the franchise in IPL.

Has MS Dhoni scored a hundred for Chennai Super Kings?

No, Mahendra Singh Dhoni has never scored a century for CSK in IPL, but he has 22 fifties to his name.

Which player has scored the most runs for the Chennai Super kings since the team was created in 2008?

The player with the most runs for Chennai Super Kings since the team was created in 2008 is Suresh Raina. He scored 4,687 runs for CSK across multiple IPL seasons, making him the highest run-scorer in the franchise’s history.

title: Ajikya Rahane Reappointed as Vice-Captain of Indian Test Team
content:
In cricket there are very few stories of redemption at the moment that are better than that of Ajikya Rahane, as he returns as the vice-captain of Indian Test Team, after title winning season with Chennai Super Kings.

The veteran batter was dropped in February 2023 after a torrid outing in South Africa. Before that he was stripped of the vice-captaincy role as well.

Ajinkya Rahane returns to vice-captain India in test

But he did not give up. And returned to domestic cricket, worked hard on his skills. Now on the back of a good domestic season and excellent IPL for CSK under Dhoni’s Leadership, he is reinstated to his previous post.

The player was presented a glamorous chance of featuring in the WTC 2023 Final. In the absence of Shreyas Iyer, Rahane played a magnificent 89 run knock in first inning which saved India somewhat.

In the second inning too he played a magnificent knock, albeit in a losing cause. He emerged as the highest scorer for India in the game. And hence retained his spot in the team for the upcoming West Indies test series.

Reasons behind Rahane’s appointment

Although it seems that there are several factors at play in Rahane’s return, the main factor is another Indian stalwart losing his place.

Yes, it is the absence of Cheteshwar Pujara, that has paved way for Rahane. Since the Indian side has some young player, the selectors have to maintain a balance. And hence, the place for Rahane in the team opens up.

Also, the young Indian team lacks leadership skills, is another reason behind Rahane being named as the vice captain. Virat Kohli has clearly pulled out his name from any form of captaincy and leadership role.

Hence, in the absence of KL Rahul and Pant, if Rohit Sharma gets injured, India needs a senior player to lead them. And who can be better than Rahane to do that job.

Nobody in India will forget his heroics Downunder, 2 years ago. He along with some young guns managed to clinch a historic test win in Australia’s backyard.

The Indian team will be missing some big names from the squad. Having dropped Pujara and Umesh Yadav, they have rested Mohammad Shami. Which sees, Mukesh Kumar and Navdeep Saini being named in the squad.

It will be interesting to see the combination india goes with, especially in batting. In the absence of Pujara, Gaikwad and Jaiswal have been named in the team. Although, both being openers, it will be a tough call to play either of in the middle order.

Whatever the future holds for the team, Ajinkya Rahane will be ready to take it on. He has been playing a new brand of cricket. after being written off at the start of IPL, he has changed quite drastically.

His gave has more purpose and aggression, which lacked previously. Rahane showcased the great arsenal of cricketing shots he possesses. Now, it will be all about his intent and scoring runs that will ensure he stays with the team for a longer stint or not.
excerpt: Ajinkya Rahane redemption phase complete, as the stalwart veteran batter is reinstated as the vice captain of Indian team.

title: Ruturaj Gaikwad named in India's Test Squad for West Indies
content:
Following an amazing domestic season, Chennai Super King’s opening batter Ruturaj Gaikwad has received a maiden call up to the Indian Test Team.

Earlier the batter was named in the standbys for the WTC Final 2023. But has to pull out due to his marriage commitments. Many wondered if the player would ger another chance.

But, he has been once again named in the Indian Test Team, when the squad for the West Indies tour was announced, on Friday, 23rd of June.

Ruturaj Gaikwad receive maiden Indian Test team call-up

Rauturaj Gaikwad has earned a place in the Indian set up for quite a while now. Although he has made a debut in the shortest format his numbers suggest that he deserves to be playing in every format of the game.

Gaikwad, while playing for Maharashtra, has a first class average of 42.19 from 28 games this season. This includes 6 centuries on the part of the batter. And over the time, his technique has been impressing the selectors who have been looking to bring him into the Indian Test set up.

Gaikwad is not the only batter who is receiving a maiden call up. Along with him will be another player from Maharashtra, the state, if not team and his name is Yashasvi Jaiswal.

Everyone known Jaiswal for his amazing blitz from the IPL 2023. But very few know that he too had an amazing domestic season. This season he has an average of 80.21 from 26 innings. And is coming off an amazing knock of 213 and 144 in the Irani Cup game for Rest of India against Madhya Pradesh.

With these two knocks he created history for the highest aggregate score for a batter in Irani Cup game.

Apart from these two stalwarts of IPL, we have another player receiving his maiden call up in the form of Mukesh Kumar. The 30-year-old pace bowler from Bengal has had an impressive time out in the domestic circuit. He clinched 149 wickets in 39 first class games to get a call up for India.

Major Changes in the Indian test team

There was a glee of hope for Indian fans, to witness Shreyas Iyer, Jasprit Bumrah, and KL Rahul in action. But the recent announced squad has left them devastated.

Neither of the player have recovered from the surgeries they had to undergo. And hence won’t be seen in the Indian set up during the West Indies tour of India.

However, another major blow to the older generation of Indian cricket has come in the form of Cheteshwar Pujara, who has been dropped from the team. The veteran was not able to perform well in the WTC Final. He made 27 and 14 respectively in the two innings against Australia. And hence has been dropped from the squad.

Redemption for Ajinkya Rahane

One man’s loss seems to be another’s gain, as Ajinkya Rahane has been appointed as the vice-captain of the team. He had the title against his name as he was dropped in the February month, earlier this year.

He went back to the domestic circuit and played his heart out to earn a call-up for the WTC final in England. In the game he played two magnificent knocks for his side. although the team ended on losing side, his performance stood out.

In other news, Navdeep Saini, and Jaydev Unadkat have also been called up to replace Shami who has been rested and Umesh Yadav who has been dropped.

India’s Test squad: Rohit Sharma (capt), Shubman Gill, Virat Kohli, Ajinkya Rahane (vc), Ruturaj Gaikwad, Yashasvi Jaiswal, KS Bharat (wk), R Ashwin, Ravindra Jadeja, Axar Patel, Shardul Thakur, Mohammed Siraj, Mukesh Kumar, Jaydev Unadkat, Ishan Kishan (wk), Navdeep Saini
