title: CSK CEO Shares Updates on MS Dhoni's IPL 2024 Return Plan
content:
The Chennai Super Kings ended the IPL 2023 on an all time high. They managed to clich their fifth IPL title and have gone level on the most number of titles won by a team.

But what delighted the fans most was the announcement made by their Thala, their captain, and the mastermind behind the wickets; MS Dhoni. And now we have fresh updates on what is actually going to be the future of CSK Captain.

CSK CEO Provides insights on MS Dhoni situation

Everyone knows that Dhoni was nursing a knee injury throughout the tournament. And the CEO of CSK, has provided new insights on the situation in an interview with ESPNCricinfo.

“Actually, he told us immediately after the final is over, he’ll fly to Mumbai, have surgery and go back to Ranchi for rehab. In Mumbai, after Ruturaj’s wedding [on June 4], I visited him. It was a courtesy call. He’s quite comfortable. He said he’ll rest for three weeks and then start his rehab. And like he said, he’s not going to play until January-February. We don’t need to remind him about all that.”

on ESPNCricinfo

This clearly means that there are a lot question still unanswered regarding MS Dhoni’s future. Throughout the season there was a lot of speculation over whether Dhoni would retire after this season.

And when Chennai won the league, everyone held their breath, dreading the inevitable. However, that inevitable didn’t arrive. At least not yet, during his last post match talk, MS Dhoni made his feelings clear towards retirement.

MS Dhoni on his availability in IPL 2024

He told the crowd that it would be the perfect and most easy way to leave the game. “Circumstantially if you see, this is the best time to announce my retirement…” before continuing “… but the amount of love and affection I have been shown wherever I have been this year, the easy thing would be for me to say ‘Thank you very much’, but the tough thing for me is to work hard for another 9 months and come back and play at least 1 more season of IPL.”

Hindustan Times

Dhoni definitely had a great IPL, not only as a captain but as a batter as well. He played some very important cameos for his team, and with clean hitting, it was clear that he has still got it.

Dhoni’s fitness struggles in IPL 2023

The main concern for him however has been fitness over the years. In this year’s IPL it was quick visible that he was suffering from physical ailments that were holding him back.

As one of the fastest runners between the wicket, MSD was struggling to convert ones into twos. But with his power hitting he managed to turn the clock back a decade.

The fans were absolutely thrilled to see MS Dhoni the finisher on the crease. Along with that some of his captaincy decisions were also spot on. Hence, the franchise along with the fans in general will be expecting him to return to the field for one last time next season.

He was a real crowd puller in 2023 edition of IPL. And if he indeed announces 2024 to be his last season, there will be immense crowd gathering, just to witness the phenomenon in action for one last time.

title: All Super Kings Franchise Teams: Complete CSK Global Team List
content:
There are three Super Kings teams in professional franchise cricket, namely Chennai Super Kings, Joburg Super Kings and Texas Super Kings. Chennai Super Kings (CSK) competes in India’s Indian Premier League (IPL), and Joburg Super Kings (JSK) plays in South Africa’s SA20, while Texas Super Kings (TSK) participates in Major League Cricket (MLC) in the USA. 

Together, the three teams form the wider Super Kings network. Chennai Super Kings Cricket Limited operates CSK and controls JSK through its South African business structure, while TSK is owned through a partnership involving the company and Texas-based investors.

How Many Super Kings Franchise Teams Are There?

There are currently three Super Kings franchise teams.

Complete List of Super Kings Teams Around the World

The Super Kings brand has expanded beyond the IPL into South Africa’s SA20 and Major League Cricket in the United States. Here is a complete list of Super Kings teams around the world. 

Chennai Super Kings

Chennai Super Kings (CSK) was founded in 2008 as one of the original IPL franchises, representing the city of Chennai from Tamil Nadu. The side plays its home matches at the M. A. Chidambaram Stadium, popularly known as Chepauk. 

CSK has won five IPL trophies in 2010, 2011, 2018, 2021, and 2023. Besides the IPL trophies, it has also won two Champions League T20 titles in 2010 and 2014. 

With its iconic yellow colours and strong connection to Chennai, CSK has become the flagship of the Super Kings brand. Its success helped the brand expand through JSK in South Africa and TSK in the USA. The wider organisation also operates Super Kings Academy centres focused on youth cricket development.

Joburg Super Kings

Joburg Super Kings (JSK) was formed in 2022 and made its debut in the inaugural SA20 season in 2023 along with five other teams. JSK is owned through Chennai Super Kings Cricket Limited (CSKCL), making it part of the wider Super Kings network.

Based in Johannesburg, the franchise plays its home matches at the Wanderers Stadium and carries the Super Kings identity through its yellow-and-green colours. The team has reached the SA20 playoffs in all the four seasons it has participated. Its highest finish came in 2024, when the side reached Qualifier 2 after defeating Paarl Royals in the Eliminator before losing to Durban’s Super Giants. 

Texas Super Kings

Formed in 2023, Texas Super Kings (TSK) entered Major League Cricket as one of the league’s six inaugural franchises, marking the Super Kings brand’s entry into the USA. The franchise is owned in partnership with Chennai Super Kings and Texas-based investors Anurag Jain and Ross Perot Jr., who have been involved in the team since its formation. 

Based in the Dallas–Fort Worth area, TSK plays its home games at Grand Prairie Stadium. Since the league began, the team has reached the playoffs in 3 out of 4 MLC seasons, with its performances helping the city of Texas establish itself as an important centre for developing professional cricket in the United States. 

Who Owns the Super Kings Franchise Teams?

The three Super Kings franchises have different ownership arrangements, although they are connected through the same brand. 

How Are CSK, JSK and TSK Connected?

Chennai Super Kings (CSK), Joburg Super Kings (JSK), and Texas Super Kings (TSK) are part of the wider Super Kings cricket network, sharing the Super Kings name, lion-based logo, and yellow-led branding. The teams are connected through Chennai Super Kings Cricket Limited and have shared cricketing and management links over the years. 

Several players have represented multiple Super Kings teams. Faf du Plessis, Akeal Hosein and Devon Conway have played for CSK, JSK and TSK, while Stephen Fleming previously served as head coach of all three franchises.

At the same time, each team maintains its own local identity. CSK represents the city of Chennai from Tamil Nadu in India, while JSK and TSK represent Johannesburg in South Africa and Texas in the United States, respectively. Importantly, JSK and TSK are connected to CSK, but they are different teams competing in separate leagues. 

Super Kings Teams by Country and Competition

The Super Kings franchise has teams in three countries: India, South Africa, and the United States. In India, Chennai Super Kings (CSK) competes in the Indian Premier League (IPL), while Joburg Super Kings (JSK) and Texas Super Kings (TSK) represent the franchise in South Africa’s SA20 league and Major League Cricket (MLC) in the United States, respectively. 

Both JSK and TSK originate from Chennai Super Kings and are international franchise teams established by CSK, expanding its presence beyond India into South Africa and the United States. 

Super Kings Franchise Achievements

The Super Kings franchise has achieved notable success across the IPL, SA20, and Major League Cricket. 

The above records are last updated as of September 29, 2026.

title: Texas Super Kings name Faf du Plessis as captain
content:
The revolution of franchise cricket is here, and the Super Kings franchise is spreading its wings in different parts of the world. Earlier, the Chennai-based franchise had bought a team in the SA 20 tournament, which is played in South Africa.

Now they have managed to get their hands on a franchise that is based in the USA. Yes, Super Kings now have a team in the upcoming Major League Cricket, and it will be captained by none than the fan-favorite Faf du Plessis of South Africa.

Faf du Plessis named captain of Texas Super Kings

Faf du Plessis has been an integral part of the Super Kings franchise. He spent the best part of his IPL career with Chennai Super Kings before moving on to RCB, during which time he worked closely with Chennai Super Kings’ official partners.

But his bond with the franchise was never weakened. And the same was on display when he was seen in yellow colors during the SA 20 League. And now he will be donning the colors once again for the Texas-based Super Kings team.

The news of Faf’s appointment was shared on social media by Texas Super Kings. They shared a video of Faf reacting to fans asking for him to be named the Texas captain.

Faf du Plessis to find some familiar CSK faces in camp

Du Plessis, however, will not be alone in his endeavors with the new team. Some more familiar faces and teammates will join him. According to a report, the Texas Super Kings will feature some key players in the likes of Devon Conway, Mitchell Santner, Ambati Rayudu, and even David Miller.

Barring Conway, Faf has most probably played with all of the other players on the same team. Santner and Rayudu were a part of CSK’s 2018 title triumph. While David Miller has been a compatriot of du Plessis on his national side.

Apart from players, du Plessis will also be joined by the likes of CSK’s coaching staff which includes Dwayne Bravo and Stephen Fleming as bowling and head coaches, respectively.

Every tea featuring in the Major League Cricket is allowed to have 19 players in the squad. Out of which, 9 players can be internationals, while the remaining have to be domestic players.

Even in a squad, only 6 international players are allowed per side. Hence, it will be interesting to see what combination will Texas Super Kings adopt in the inaugural competition. And will they be able to replicate their success from SA 20?

SA 20 triumph for Super Kings

CSK-owned Joburg Super Kings had the best outing in the inaugural edition of SA20. They were able to reach the final, and despite a loss against Sunrisers Eastern Cape, they were the team to beat in that tournament.

Faf du Plessis led the team from the front with his batting as well as captaincy. He set an example for others to follow in the team. Therefore, the fans will be expecting him to repeat the feat in the upcoming MLC tournament in the USA.
